function formatDuration(ms: number | null): string {
  if (ms === null || ms === undefined || ms < 0) return '-';
  if (ms < 1000) return `${ms}ms`;
  const sec = (ms / 1000).toFixed(1);
  return `${sec}s`;
}

function formatDateTimeWithTz(isoString: string | null): string {
  if (!isoString) return '-';
  try {
    const d = new Date(isoString);
    return `${d.toLocaleString('id-ID', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: 'short',
      day: 'numeric',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
      second: '2-digit',
    })} WIB`;
  } catch {
    return isoString;
  }
}

function getJobTypeLabel(type: AdminJobType): string {
  switch (type) {
    case 'DOCUMENT_EXTRACTION':
      return 'Ekstraksi Dokumen';
    case 'DOCUMENT_CLEANUP':
      return 'Pembersihan Dokumen';
    case 'AI_SUMMARY_GENERATION':
      return 'Ringkasan AI';
    case 'AI_FLASHCARD_GENERATION':
      return 'Flashcard AI';
    case 'AI_QUIZ_GENERATION':
      return 'Kuis AI';
    default:
      return type;
  }
}

function renderDatabaseStatusBadge(status: AdminJobStatus) {
  switch (status) {
    case 'PENDING':
      return (
        <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-200 dark:bg-amber-950 dark:text-amber-300 dark:border-amber-800 text-xs gap-1">
          <Clock className="h-3 w-3" />
          Menunggu
        </Badge>
      );
    case 'PROCESSING':
      return (
        <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border-blue-200 dark:bg-blue-950 dark:text-blue-300 dark:border-blue-800 text-xs gap-1">
          <Activity className="h-3 w-3 animate-pulse" />
          Diproses
        </Badge>
      );
    case 'COMPLETED':
      return (
        <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800 text-xs gap-1">
          <CheckCircle2 className="h-3 w-3" />
          Selesai
        </Badge>
      );
    case 'FAILED':
      return (
        <Badge variant="danger" className="text-xs gap-1">
          <XCircle className="h-3 w-3" />
          Gagal
        </Badge>
      );
    default:
      return <Badge variant="secondary">{status}</Badge>;
  }
}

function renderQueueStatusBadge(queueStatus: AdminQueueStatus) {
  switch (queueStatus) {
    case 'waiting':
      return (
        <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs bg-muted/60 text-muted-foreground border-border">
          Antrean: Menunggu
        </Badge>
      );
    case 'active':
      return (
        <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border-blue-200 dark:bg-blue-950 dark:text-blue-300">
          Antrean: Aktif
        </Badge>
      );
    case 'delayed':
      return (
        <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-200 dark:bg-amber-950 dark:text-amber-300">
          Antrean: Tertunda
        </Badge>
      );
    case 'completed':
      return (
        <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-300">
          Antrean: Selesai
        </Badge>
      );
    case 'failed':
      return (
        <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border-rose-200 dark:bg-rose-950 dark:text-rose-300">
          Antrean: Gagal
        </Badge>
      );
    case 'not_found':
      return (
        <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs font-normal">
          Dibersihkan dari Memori
        </Badge>
      );
    case 'unavailable':
      return (
        <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs bg-muted text-muted-foreground">
          Tidak Tersedia
        </Badge>
      );
    default:
      return <Badge variant="secondary">{queueStatus}</Badge>;
  }
}

function AdminJobsContent() {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();

  // Read initial filter values from URL search params
  const initialPage = Math.max(1, parseInt(searchParams.get('page') || '1', 10) || 1);
  const initialLimit = [10, 20, 50].includes(Number(searchParams.get('limit')))
    ? Number(searchParams.get('limit'))
    : 20;
  const initialStatus = (searchParams.get('status') as AdminJobStatus) || '';
  const initialType = (searchParams.get('type') as AdminJobType) || '';
  const initialSearch = searchParams.get('search') || '';
  const initialSelectedId = searchParams.get('jobId') || null;

  // State
  const [page, setPage] = React.useState(initialPage);
  const [limit, setLimit] = React.useState(initialLimit);
  const [status, setStatus] = React.useState<string>(initialStatus);
  const [type, setType] = React.useState<string>(initialType);
  const [searchInput, setSearchInput] = React.useState<string>(initialSearch);
  const [debouncedSearch, setDebouncedSearch] = React.useState<string>(initialSearch);

  // Data states
  const [jobsData, setJobsData] = React.useState<AdminJobListResponse | null>(null);
  const [isJobsLoading, setIsJobsLoading] = React.useState(true);
  const [jobsError, setJobsError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  const [queuesData, setQueuesData] = React.useState<AdminQueuesSummaryResponse | null>(null);
  const [isQueuesLoading, setIsQueuesLoading] = React.useState(true);
  const [queuesError, setQueuesError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  // Detail Sheet state
  const [selectedJobId, setSelectedJobId] = React.useState<string | null>(initialSelectedId);
  const [jobDetail, setJobDetail] = React.useState<AdminJobDetail | null>(null);
  const [isDetailLoading, setIsDetailLoading] = React.useState(false);
  const [detailError, setDetailError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  // Copy feedback state
  const [copiedKey, setCopiedKey] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleCopy = (text: string, key: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedKey(key);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setCopiedKey((curr) => (curr === key ? null : curr));
    }, 2000);
  };

  // Debounce search input
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handler = setTimeout(() => {
      const trimmed = searchInput.trim();
      setDebouncedSearch((prev) => {
        if (prev !== trimmed) {
          setPage(1);
        }
        return trimmed;
      });
    }, 300);
    return () => clearTimeout(handler);
  }, [searchInput]);

  // Synchronize state to URL query parameters
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    if (page > 1) params.set('page', String(page));
    if (limit !== 20) params.set('limit', String(limit));
    if (status) params.set('status', status);
    if (type) params.set('type', type);
    if (debouncedSearch) params.set('search', debouncedSearch);
    if (selectedJobId) params.set('jobId', selectedJobId);

    const qs = params.toString();
    const newUrl = qs ? `/jobs?${qs}` : '/jobs';
    window.history.replaceState(null, '', newUrl);
  }, [page, limit, status, type, debouncedSearch, selectedJobId]);

  // Fetch queue summary
  const loadQueuesSummary = React.useCallback((signal?: AbortSignal) => {
    setIsQueuesLoading(true);
    setQueuesError(null);

    fetchAdminQueuesSummary({ signal })
      .then((res) => {
        if (!signal?.aborted) setQueuesData(res);
      })
      .catch((err: any) => {
        if (!signal?.aborted) setQueuesError(err.message || 'Gagal memuat status antrean');
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!signal?.aborted) setIsQueuesLoading(false);
      });
  }, []);

  // Fetch jobs list
  const loadJobs = React.useCallback((signal?: AbortSignal) => {
    setIsJobsLoading(true);
    setJobsError(null);

    // If search looks like a CUID / ID, we can query by jobId or userId
    const isSearchJobId = debouncedSearch.length > 20 && !debouncedSearch.startsWith('usr_');
    const isSearchUserId = debouncedSearch.startsWith('usr_') || debouncedSearch.length > 20;

    fetchAdminJobs(
      {
        page,
        limit,
        status: (status as AdminJobStatus) || undefined,
        type: (type as AdminJobType) || undefined,
        jobId: isSearchJobId ? debouncedSearch : undefined,
        userId: !isSearchJobId && isSearchUserId ? debouncedSearch : undefined,
      },
      { signal }
    )
      .then((res) => {
        if (!signal?.aborted) setJobsData(res);
      })
      .catch((err: any) => {
        if (!signal?.aborted) setJobsError(err.message || 'Gagal memuat daftar pekerjaan');
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!signal?.aborted) setIsJobsLoading(false);
      });
  }, [page, limit, status, type, debouncedSearch]);

  // Initial and reactive data fetching with cancellation
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    loadQueuesSummary(controller.signal);
    loadJobs(controller.signal);

    return () => {
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, [loadQueuesSummary, loadJobs]);

  // Fetch single job detail when selectedJobId changes
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedJobId) {
      setJobDetail(null);
      return;
    }

    const controller = new AbortController();
    setIsDetailLoading(true);
    setDetailError(null);

    fetchAdminJobDetail(selectedJobId, { signal: controller.signal })
      .then((res) => {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) setJobDetail(res);
      })
      .catch((err: any) => {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setDetailError(err.message || 'Gagal memuat rincian pekerjaan');
        }
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) setIsDetailLoading(false);
      });

    return () => {
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, [selectedJobId]);

  const handleRefreshAll = () => {
    loadQueuesSummary();
    loadJobs();
    if (selectedJobId) {
      setIsDetailLoading(true);
      fetchAdminJobDetail(selectedJobId)
        .then((res) => setJobDetail(res))
        .catch((err: any) => setDetailError(err.message || 'Gagal memuat rincian'))
        .finally(() => setIsDetailLoading(false));
    }
  };

  const totalPages = jobsData?.pagination.totalPages || 1;
  const totalItems = jobsData?.pagination.totalItems || 0;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-6 p-4 md:p-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto w-full">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground md:text-3xl">
            Monitoring Pekerjaan & Antrean
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
            Pantau status operasional antrean BullMQ dan riwayat pemrosesan dokumen serta AI.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            onClick={handleRefreshAll}
            disabled={isJobsLoading || isQueuesLoading}
            className="gap-2"
          >
            <RefreshCw
              className={`h-4 w-4 ${isJobsLoading || isQueuesLoading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`}
            />
            <span>Segarkan</span>
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Queue Summary Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        {queuesData?.queues.map((q) => (
          <Card key={q.name} className="border-border bg-card shadow-xs">
            <CardHeader className="pb-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  {q.name.includes('document') ? (
                    <FileText className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
                  ) : (
                    <Sparkles className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
                  )}
                  <CardTitle className="text-base font-semibold">{q.label}</CardTitle>
                </div>
                {q.status === 'available' ? (
                  <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-300 text-xs">
                    Tersambung
                  </Badge>
                ) : (
                  <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border-rose-200 dark:bg-rose-950 dark:text-rose-300 text-xs">
                    Tidak Tersedia
                  </Badge>
                )}
              </div>
              <CardDescription className="text-xs">{q.retentionNote}</CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              {q.status === 'available' && q.counts ? (
                <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2 text-center">
                  <div className="rounded-md border border-border/70 p-2 bg-muted/20">
                    <span className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground block">
                      {q.counts.waiting}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground block mt-0.5">Menunggu</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="rounded-md border border-border/70 p-2 bg-muted/20">
                    <span className="text-lg font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 block">
                      {q.counts.active}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground block mt-0.5">Aktif</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="rounded-md border border-border/70 p-2 bg-muted/20">
                    <span className="text-lg font-bold text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 block">
                      {q.counts.delayed}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground block mt-0.5">Tertunda</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="rounded-md border border-border/70 p-2 bg-muted/20">
                    <span className="text-lg font-bold text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 block">
                      {q.counts.failed}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground block mt-0.5">Gagal</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="rounded-md border border-border/70 p-3 bg-muted/10 text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  Status antrean BullMQ saat ini tidak dapat dihubungi atau Redis offline.
                </div>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        )) || (
          Array.from({ length: 2 }).map((_, idx) => (
            <Card key={idx}>
              <CardHeader className="pb-3">
                <Skeleton className="h-5 w-40" />
                <Skeleton className="h-4 w-60" />
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2">
                  {Array.from({ length: 4 }).map((__, i) => (
                    <Skeleton key={i} className="h-14 rounded-md" />
                  ))}
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          ))
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Notice on Retention */}
      <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-lg border border-primary/20 bg-primary/5 p-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        <Info className="h-4 w-4 text-primary shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        <span>
          <strong>Catatan Operasional:</strong> Angka antrean di atas merefleksikan kondisi memori saat ini pada BullMQ Redis dan dibatasi oleh kebijakan retensi. Riwayat pekerjaan permanen dan kegagalan jangka panjang tercatat lengkap pada tabel basis data di bawah.
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Filters Bar */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          {/* Status Filter */}
          <Select
            value={status || 'ALL'}
            onValueChange={(val) => {
              setStatus(val === 'ALL' ? '' : val);
              setPage(1);
            }}
          >
            <SelectTrigger className="w-36 h-9 text-xs">
              <SelectValue placeholder="Status" />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              <SelectItem value="ALL">Semua Status</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="PENDING">Menunggu</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="PROCESSING">Diproses</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="COMPLETED">Selesai</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="FAILED">Gagal</SelectItem>
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>

          {/* Type Filter */}
          <Select
            value={type || 'ALL'}
            onValueChange={(val) => {
              setType(val === 'ALL' ? '' : val);
              setPage(1);
            }}
          >
            <SelectTrigger className="w-48 h-9 text-xs">
              <SelectValue placeholder="Jenis Pekerjaan" />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              <SelectItem value="ALL">Semua Jenis</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="DOCUMENT_EXTRACTION">Ekstraksi Dokumen</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="DOCUMENT_CLEANUP">Pembersihan Dokumen</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="AI_SUMMARY_GENERATION">Ringkasan AI</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="AI_FLASHCARD_GENERATION">Flashcard AI</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="AI_QUIZ_GENERATION">Kuis AI</SelectItem>
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>

          {/* Reset button if filter is active */}
          {(status || type || debouncedSearch) && (
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => {
                setStatus('');
                setType('');
                setSearchInput('');
                setDebouncedSearch('');
                setPage(1);
              }}
              className="h-9 px-2.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
            >
              Reset Filter
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Search by Job ID or User ID */}
        <div className="relative w-full md:max-w-xs">
          <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
          <Input
            placeholder="Cari ID Pekerjaan / ID Pengguna..."
            value={searchInput}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchInput(e.target.value)}
            className="pl-9 pr-8 text-xs h-9"
          />
          {searchInput && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setSearchInput('')}
              className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
            >
              <X className="h-4 w-4" />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {jobsError && (
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
          <AlertTitle>Terjadi Kesalahan</AlertTitle>
          <AlertDescription className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 mt-2">
            <span>{jobsError}</span>
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => loadJobs()}
              className="bg-card text-foreground"
            >
              Coba Lagi
            </Button>
          </AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}

      {/* Jobs Table */}
      <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-card shadow-xs overflow-hidden">
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <Table>
            <TableHeader>
              <TableRow className="bg-muted/40">
                <TableHead className="w-[180px]">ID Pekerjaan</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="w-[180px]">Jenis</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="min-w-[160px]">Pengguna</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="w-[120px]">Status DB</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="w-[90px]">Attempt</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="w-[90px]">Durasi</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="w-[180px]">Waktu Dibuat</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="w-[80px] text-right">Aksi</TableHead>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              {isJobsLoading ? (
                Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, idx) => (
                  <TableRow key={idx}>
                    <TableCell><Skeleton className="h-4 w-28" /></TableCell>
                    <TableCell><Skeleton className="h-5 w-28 rounded-full" /></TableCell>
                    <TableCell><Skeleton className="h-4 w-32" /></TableCell>
                    <TableCell><Skeleton className="h-5 w-20 rounded-full" /></TableCell>
                    <TableCell><Skeleton className="h-4 w-12" /></TableCell>
                    <TableCell><Skeleton className="h-4 w-12" /></TableCell>
                    <TableCell><Skeleton className="h-4 w-32" /></TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-right"><Skeleton className="h-8 w-16 ml-auto" /></TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                ))
              ) : jobsData && jobsData.items.length > 0 ? (
                jobsData.items.map((job: AdminJobListItem) => (
                  <TableRow
                    key={job.id}
                    className="hover:bg-muted/30 cursor-pointer"
                    onClick={() => setSelectedJobId(job.id)}
                  >
                    <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs text-foreground font-medium">
                      <span className="truncate block max-w-[150px]" title={job.id}>
                        {job.id}
                      </span>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      <Badge variant="secondary" className="font-normal text-xs whitespace-nowrap">
                        {getJobTypeLabel(job.type)}
                      </Badge>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      <Link
                        href={`/users/${job.userId}`}
                        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                        className="text-xs text-foreground hover:underline hover:text-primary transition-colors block truncate max-w-[180px]"
                        title={job.userName}
                      >
                        {job.userName}
                      </Link>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      {renderDatabaseStatusBadge(job.status)}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-mono">
                      {job.attempts} / {job.maxAttempts}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-mono">
                      {formatDuration(job.durationMs)}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-xs text-muted-foreground whitespace-nowrap">
                      {formatDateTimeWithTz(job.createdAt)}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-right" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                      <Button
                        variant="ghost"
                        size="sm"
                        onClick={() => setSelectedJobId(job.id)}
                        className="h-8 px-2 text-xs gap-1"
                      >
                        <Eye className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        <span>Detail</span>
                      </Button>
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                ))
              ) : (
                <TableRow>
                  <TableCell colSpan={8} className="h-40 text-center">
                    <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2">
                      <Activity className="h-8 w-8 text-muted-foreground/50" />
                      <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
                        Tidak ada riwayat pekerjaan ditemukan
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        {debouncedSearch || status || type
                          ? 'Coba sesuaikan kata kunci pencarian atau filter status yang dipilih.'
                          : 'Belum ada antrean pekerjaan yang tercatat pada sistem.'}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              )}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        </div>

        {/* Pagination Footer */}
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-3 border-t border-border px-4 py-3 bg-card text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          <div>
            Menampilkan{' '}
            <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">
              {jobsData && jobsData.items.length > 0 ? (page - 1) * limit + 1 : 0}
            </span>{' '}
            hingga{' '}
            <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">
              {jobsData ? Math.min(page * limit, totalItems) : 0}
            </span>{' '}
            dari{' '}
            <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">
              {totalItems.toLocaleString('id-ID')}
            </span>{' '}
            pekerjaan
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-end sm:self-auto">
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
              disabled={page <= 1 || isJobsLoading}
              className="h-8 px-2.5 gap-1"
            >
              <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
              <span>Sebelumnya</span>
            </Button>
            <span className="px-2 font-medium text-foreground">
              {page} / {totalPages}
            </span>
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => setPage((p) => Math.min(totalPages, p + 1))}
              disabled={page >= totalPages || isJobsLoading}
              className="h-8 px-2.5 gap-1"
            >
              <span>Berikutnya</span>
              <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Slide-over Sheet for Job Operational Detail */}
      <Sheet open={!!selectedJobId} onOpenChange={(open) => !open && setSelectedJobId(null)}>
        <SheetContent side="right" className="sm:max-w-md w-full overflow-y-auto">
          <SheetHeader className="text-left border-b border-border pb-4">
            <SheetTitle className="text-lg flex items-center gap-2">
              <Activity className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
              Detail Pekerjaan Operasional
            </SheetTitle>
            <SheetDescription className="text-xs">
              Informasi pelacakan teknis dan riwayat eksekusi pekerjaan secara aman.
            </SheetDescription>
          </SheetHeader>

          {isDetailLoading ? (
            <div className="py-6 space-y-4">
              <Skeleton className="h-6 w-32" />
              <Skeleton className="h-20 w-full" />
              <Skeleton className="h-20 w-full" />
              <Skeleton className="h-20 w-full" />
            </div>
          ) : detailError ? (
            <div className="py-6 space-y-4">
              <Alert variant="destructive">
                <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
                <AlertTitle>Gagal Memuat Detail</AlertTitle>
                <AlertDescription className="text-xs mt-1">{detailError}</AlertDescription>
              </Alert>
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => selectedJobId && setSelectedJobId(selectedJobId)}
                className="w-full"
              >
                Coba Lagi
              </Button>
            </div>
          ) : jobDetail ? (
            <div className="py-4 space-y-4 text-xs">
              {/* ID Pekerjaan */}
              <div className="rounded-md border border-border p-3 bg-muted/20">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground font-medium block">ID Pekerjaan</span>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mt-1">
                  <span className="font-mono text-xs text-foreground select-all break-all">
                    {jobDetail.id}
                  </span>
                  <Button
                    variant="ghost"
                    size="sm"
                    className="h-6 px-1.5 text-xs gap-1 shrink-0"
                    onClick={() => handleCopy(jobDetail.id, 'jobId')}
                  >
                    {copiedKey === 'jobId' ? (
                      <Check className="h-3 w-3 text-emerald-500" />
                    ) : (
                      <Copy className="h-3 w-3" />
                    )}
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Status Section */}
              <div className="rounded-md border border-border p-3 bg-muted/20 space-y-2">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground font-medium block">Status Operasional</span>
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground">Status Database (Permanen):</span>
                    {renderDatabaseStatusBadge(jobDetail.status)}
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground">Status Antrean (BullMQ):</span>
                    {renderQueueStatusBadge(jobDetail.queueStatus)}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground/80 pt-1 border-t border-border/50">
                  Status antrean menandakan kondisi transien pada Redis. Jika job telah melewati batas retensi, antrean menampilkan &quot;Dibersihkan dari Memori&quot;.
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* Identitas Pengguna */}
              <div className="rounded-md border border-border p-3 bg-muted/20 space-y-1.5">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground font-medium block">Pengguna Terkait</span>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-foreground font-semibold">{jobDetail.userName}</span>
                  <Button variant="outline" size="sm" asChild className="h-6 px-2 text-[11px]">
                    <Link href={`/users/${jobDetail.userId}`}>
                      <User className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
                      Profil
                    </Link>
                  </Button>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-muted-foreground text-[11px]">
                  <span className="font-mono truncate max-w-[200px]">{jobDetail.userId}</span>
                  <Button
                    variant="ghost"
                    size="sm"
                    className="h-5 px-1 text-[11px]"
                    onClick={() => handleCopy(jobDetail.userId, 'userId')}
                  >
                    {copiedKey === 'userId' ? 'Disalin' : 'Salin ID'}
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Job Metadata */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                <div className="rounded-md border border-border p-2.5 bg-muted/20">
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground block text-[11px]">Jenis Pekerjaan</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold text-foreground mt-0.5 block">
                    {getJobTypeLabel(jobDetail.type)}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="rounded-md border border-border p-2.5 bg-muted/20">
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground block text-[11px]">Attempt</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold text-foreground font-mono mt-0.5 block">
                    {jobDetail.attempts} / {jobDetail.maxAttempts}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Timestamps */}
              <div className="rounded-md border border-border p-3 bg-muted/20 space-y-1.5">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground font-medium block">Jejak Waktu</span>
                <div className="space-y-1 text-xs">
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground">Waktu Dibuat:</span>
                    <span className="font-mono text-foreground">
                      {formatDateTimeWithTz(jobDetail.createdAt)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground">Waktu Mulai:</span>
                    <span className="font-mono text-foreground">
                      {formatDateTimeWithTz(jobDetail.startedAt)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground">Waktu Selesai:</span>
                    <span className="font-mono text-foreground">
                      {formatDateTimeWithTz(jobDetail.completedAt)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  {jobDetail.failedAt && (
                    <div className="flex justify-between text-destructive">
                      <span>Waktu Gagal:</span>
                      <span className="font-mono">
                        {formatDateTimeWithTz(jobDetail.failedAt)}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  )}
                  <div className="flex justify-between border-t border-border/50 pt-1 mt-1">
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground font-medium">Durasi Eksekusi:</span>
                    <span className="font-mono font-semibold text-foreground">
                      {formatDuration(jobDetail.durationMs)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Error Information (if failed) */}
              {jobDetail.status === 'FAILED' && (
                <div className="rounded-md border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/10 p-3 space-y-1 text-xs text-destructive">
                  <div className="font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
                    <span>Kode Kesalahan: {jobDetail.errorCode || 'UNKNOWN_ERROR'}</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-foreground/80 mt-1 leading-relaxed">
                    {jobDetail.safeErrorMessage || 'Terjadi kegagalan operasional saat mengeksekusi pekerjaan.'}
                  </p>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Privacy Notice */}
              <div className="rounded-md bg-muted/50 p-2.5 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
                <span className="font-semibold block text-foreground mb-0.5">
                  Proteksi Privasi Pengguna:
                </span>
                Isi dokumen PDF, teks prompt, respons model AI mentah, kredensial, dan URL unduhan materi dilindungi secara ketat dan tidak diekspos melalui portal administrator.
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </SheetContent>
      </Sheet>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function AdminJobsPage() {
  return (
    <React.Suspense fallback={<JobsSkeleton />}>
      <AdminJobsContent />
    </React.Suspense>
  );
}

          <CardHeader>
            <Skeleton className="h-6 w-48" />
            <Skeleton className="h-4 w-80" />
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              {Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, idx) => (
                <Skeleton key={idx} className="h-24 rounded-lg" />
              ))}
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function UserDetailContent() {
  const params = useParams();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();

  const userId = typeof params?.id === 'string' ? params.id : '';

  // Preserve query string for "Kembali" button
  const backHref = React.useMemo(() => {
    const qs = searchParams.toString();
    return qs ? `/users?${qs}` : '/users';
  }, [searchParams]);

  const [userDetail, setUserDetail] = React.useState<AdminUserDetail | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = React.useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isNotFound, setIsNotFound] = React.useState(false);

  // Copy feedback state
  const [copiedKey, setCopiedKey] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleCopy = (text: string, key: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedKey(key);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setCopiedKey((curr) => (curr === key ? null : curr));
    }, 2000);
  };

  const loadDetail = React.useCallback(
    (signal?: AbortSignal) => {
      if (!userId) return;

      setIsLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      setIsNotFound(false);

      fetchAdminUserDetail(userId, { signal })
        .then((res) => {
          setUserDetail(res);
        })
        .catch((err: any) => {
          if (signal?.aborted) return;
          if (err instanceof AdminApiError && err.statusCode === 404) {
            setIsNotFound(true);
          } else {
            setError(err.message || 'Gagal memuat rincian pengguna');
          }
        })
        .finally(() => {
          if (!signal?.aborted) {
            setIsLoading(false);
          }
        });
    },
    [userId]
  );

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    loadDetail(controller.signal);

    return () => {
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, [loadDetail]);

  const handleRetry = () => {
    loadDetail();
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    return <UserDetailSkeleton />;
  }

  if (isNotFound) {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col items-center justify-center p-4 md:p-8 max-w-xl mx-auto w-full text-center">
        <div className="rounded-full bg-muted p-4 mb-4">
          <UserX className="h-10 w-10 text-muted-foreground" />
        </div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground mb-2">
          Pengguna Tidak Ditemukan
        </h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-6">
          Akun pengguna dengan ID tersebut tidak ditemukan di sistem atau telah dihapus.
        </p>
        <Button asChild variant="default">
          <Link href={backHref}>
            <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
            Kembali ke Daftar Pengguna
          </Link>
        </Button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error || !userDetail) {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-6 p-4 md:p-8 max-w-5xl mx-auto w-full">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" asChild>
            <Link href={backHref} className="gap-2">
              <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
              <span>Kembali ke Daftar Pengguna</span>
            </Link>
          </Button>
        </div>

        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
          <AlertTitle>Terjadi Kesalahan</AlertTitle>
          <AlertDescription className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 mt-2">
            <span>{error || 'Gagal memuat rincian pengguna'}</span>
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={handleRetry}
              className="bg-card text-foreground"
            >
              Coba Lagi
            </Button>
          </AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-6 p-4 md:p-8 max-w-5xl mx-auto w-full">
      {/* Page Header and Back Action */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" asChild>
            <Link href={backHref} className="gap-2">
              <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
              <span>Kembali</span>
            </Link>
          </Button>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground md:text-3xl">
              Detail Pengguna
            </h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
              Informasi akun dan ringkasan penggunaan platform
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            onClick={handleRetry}
            disabled={isLoading}
            className="gap-2"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`h-4 w-4 ${isLoading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
            Segarkan
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6">
        {/* Card 1: Informasi Akun */}
        <Card className="border-border bg-card shadow-xs">
          <CardHeader className="pb-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <User className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
              <CardTitle className="text-lg">Informasi Akun</CardTitle>
            </div>
            <CardDescription>
              Data identitas, hak akses, dan status keanggotaan pengguna.
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-4">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-sm">
              {/* Nama Lengkap */}
              <div className="rounded-md border border-border/60 p-3 bg-muted/20">
                <span className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground block">
                  Nama Lengkap
                </span>
                <span className="font-semibold text-foreground text-base mt-0.5 block">
                  {userDetail.name}
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Email */}
              <div className="rounded-md border border-border/60 p-3 bg-muted/20">
                <span className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground block">
                  Alamat Email
                </span>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mt-0.5">
                  <span className="font-mono text-sm text-foreground truncate">
                    {userDetail.email}
                  </span>
                  <Button
                    variant="ghost"
                    size="sm"
                    className="h-7 px-2 text-xs gap-1 shrink-0"
                    onClick={() => handleCopy(userDetail.email, 'email')}
                  >
                    {copiedKey === 'email' ? (
                      <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-500" />
                    ) : (
                      <Copy className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    )}
                    <span>{copiedKey === 'email' ? 'Disalin' : 'Salin'}</span>
                  </Button>

              {/* ID Pengguna */}

<file path="apps/admin/src/app/api/[...path]/route.ts">
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { ADMIN_COOKIE_NAMES } from '@studyflow/shared';
import { resolveForwardedClientIp } from '@/lib/clientIp';

const INTERNAL_API_URL =
  process.env.INTERNAL_API_URL ||
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ||
  'http://localhost:3001';

const STATE_CHANGING_METHODS = new Set(['POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE']);

function validateCsrfOrigin(req: NextRequest): { valid: boolean; reason?: string } {
  if (!STATE_CHANGING_METHODS.has(req.method)) {
    return { valid: true };
  }

  const origin = req.headers.get('origin');
  const referer = req.headers.get('referer');
  const trustedOrigin = req.nextUrl.origin;

  // 1. Explicitly reject null origin
  if (origin === 'null') {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'Origin null tidak diizinkan' };
  }

  let requestOrigin: string | null = null;

  if (origin) {
    requestOrigin = origin;
  } else if (referer) {
    try {
      const url = new URL(referer);
      requestOrigin = url.origin;
    } catch {
      requestOrigin = null;
    }
  }

  // 2. Reject missing Origin & Referer on mutations
  if (!requestOrigin) {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'Header Origin atau Referer wajib ada untuk request ini' };
  }

  // 3. Reject foreign/attacker origins
  if (requestOrigin !== trustedOrigin) {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'Origin tidak diizinkan atau CSRF terdeteksi' };
  }

  return { valid: true };
}

function filterAdminCookies(cookieHeader: string | null): string {
  if (!cookieHeader) return '';
  const cookies = cookieHeader.split(';').map((c) => c.trim());
  const allowed = [
    ADMIN_COOKIE_NAMES.accessToken,
    ADMIN_COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken,
  ];
  return cookies
    .filter((c) => allowed.some((name) => c.startsWith(`${name}=`)))
    .join('; ');
}

async function handleProxy(
  req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ path: string[] }> }
) {
  // Validate Origin/CSRF before proxying state-changing requests
  const csrfCheck = validateCsrfOrigin(req);
  if (!csrfCheck.valid) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error: {
          code: 'CSRF_ORIGIN_INVALID',
          message: csrfCheck.reason || 'Permintaan ditolak: CSRF terdeteksi',
        },
      },
      { status: 403 }
    );
  }

  const { path } = await params;
  const targetPath = path.join('/');
  const search = req.nextUrl.search;
  const targetUrl = `${INTERNAL_API_URL}/api/${targetPath}${search}`;

  const requestHeaders = new Headers();
  requestHeaders.set('Content-Type', 'application/json');

  // Strictly forward ONLY admin cookies, preventing web session leakage or crosstalk
  const rawCookieHeader = req.headers.get('cookie');
  const adminCookies = filterAdminCookies(rawCookieHeader);
  if (adminCookies) {
    requestHeaders.set('cookie', adminCookies);
  }

  // Forward authorization header if present
  const authHeader = req.headers.get('authorization');
  if (authHeader) {
    requestHeaders.set('authorization', authHeader);
  }

  // Forward client Origin and Referer transparently
  const origin = req.headers.get('origin');
  if (origin) {
    requestHeaders.set('origin', origin);
  }
  const referer = req.headers.get('referer');
  if (referer) {
    requestHeaders.set('referer', referer);
  }

  // Forward client request ID
  const requestId = req.headers.get('x-request-id') || crypto.randomUUID();
  requestHeaders.set('x-request-id', requestId);

  // Forward client IP
  const trustedClientIp = resolveForwardedClientIp(req.headers);
  requestHeaders.set('x-forwarded-for', trustedClientIp);

  let body: string | undefined;
  if (req.method !== 'GET' && req.method !== 'HEAD') {
    try {
      body = await req.text();
    } catch {
      body = undefined;
    }
  }

  try {
    const expressRes = await fetch(targetUrl, {
      method: req.method,
      headers: requestHeaders,
      body,
      cache: 'no-store',
    });

    const responseData = await expressRes.text();

    const responseHeaders = new Headers();
    responseHeaders.set(
      'Content-Type',
      expressRes.headers.get('content-type') || 'application/json'
    );
    // Explicitly prevent public or browser caching of admin data
    responseHeaders.set('Cache-Control', 'no-store, private');

    // Forward standard rate-limit and retry headers
    const rateLimitHeaders = [
      'retry-after',
      'ratelimit-limit',
      'ratelimit-remaining',
      'ratelimit-reset',
      'ratelimit-policy',
    ];
    for (const h of rateLimitHeaders) {
      const val = expressRes.headers.get(h);
      if (val !== null) {
        responseHeaders.set(h, val);
      }
    }

    const response = new NextResponse(responseData, {
      status: expressRes.status,
      headers: responseHeaders,
    });

    // Forward Set-Cookie headers from Express to Browser
    const setCookieHeaders = expressRes.headers.getSetCookie();
    if (setCookieHeaders && setCookieHeaders.length > 0) {
      for (const cookieStr of setCookieHeaders) {
        response.headers.append('set-cookie', cookieStr);
      }
    }

    return response;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(
      `[Admin BFF Error] ${req.method} ${targetUrl} failed:`,
      err instanceof Error ? err.message : err
    );
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error: {
          code: 'BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE',
          message:
            'Layanan backend sedang tidak dapat dihubungi. Silakan coba beberapa saat lagi.',
        },
      },
      { status: 503 }
    );
  }
}

export const GET = handleProxy;
export const POST = handleProxy;
export const PUT = handleProxy;
export const PATCH = handleProxy;
export const DELETE = handleProxy;
</file>

import * as React from 'react';

export interface AlertProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  variant?: 'default' | 'destructive' | 'warning' | 'info';
}

const Alert = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, AlertProps>(
  ({ className, variant = 'default', ...props }, ref) => {
    const variantStyles = {
      default: 'bg-card text-foreground border-border',
      destructive: 'border-danger/40 bg-danger/10 text-danger-foreground [&>svg]:text-danger',
      warning: 'border-warning/40 bg-warning/10 text-warning-foreground [&>svg]:text-warning',
      info: 'border-accent text-accent-foreground bg-accent/40 [&>svg]:text-primary',
    };

    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        role="alert"
        className={cn(
          'relative w-full rounded-lg border p-4 text-sm [&>svg~*]:pl-7 [&>svg+div]:translate-y-[-3px] [&>svg]:absolute [&>svg]:left-4 [&>svg]:top-4 [&>svg]:text-foreground',
          variantStyles[variant],
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      />
    );
  }
);

<file path="apps/admin/src/components/ui/chart.tsx">
"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import * as RechartsPrimitive from "recharts"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

// Format: { THEME_NAME: CSS_SELECTOR }
const THEMES = { light: "", dark: ".dark" } as const

export type ChartConfig = {
  [k in string]: {
    label?: React.ReactNode
    icon?: React.ComponentType
  } & (
    | { color?: string; theme?: never }
    | { color?: never; theme: Record<keyof typeof THEMES, string> }
  )
}

type ChartContextProps = {
  config: ChartConfig
}

const ChartContext = React.createContext<ChartContextProps | null>(null)

function useChart() {
  const context = React.useContext(ChartContext)

  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useChart must be used within a <ChartContainer />")
  }

  return context
}

const ChartContainer = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
    config: ChartConfig
    children: React.ComponentProps<
      typeof RechartsPrimitive.ResponsiveContainer
    >["children"]
  }
>(({ id, className, children, config, ...props }, ref) => {
  const uniqueId = React.useId()
  const chartId = `chart-${id || uniqueId.replace(/:/g, "")}`

  return (
    <ChartContext.Provider value={{ config }}>
      <div
        data-chart={chartId}
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "flex aspect-video justify-center text-xs [&_.recharts-cartesian-axis-tick_text]:fill-muted-foreground [&_.recharts-cartesian-grid_line[stroke='#ccc']]:stroke-border/50 [&_.recharts-curve.recharts-tooltip-cursor]:stroke-border [&_.recharts-dot[stroke='#fff']]:stroke-transparent [&_.recharts-layer]:outline-none [&_.recharts-polar-grid_[stroke='#ccc']]:stroke-border [&_.recharts-radial-bar-background-sector]:fill-muted [&_.recharts-rectangle.recharts-tooltip-cursor]:fill-muted [&_.recharts-reference-line_[stroke='#ccc']]:stroke-border [&_.recharts-sector[stroke='#fff']]:stroke-transparent [&_.recharts-sector]:outline-none [&_.recharts-surface]:outline-none",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <ChartStyle id={chartId} config={config} />
        <RechartsPrimitive.ResponsiveContainer>
          {children}
        </RechartsPrimitive.ResponsiveContainer>
      </div>
    </ChartContext.Provider>
  )
})
ChartContainer.displayName = "Chart"

const ChartStyle = ({ id, config }: { id: string; config: ChartConfig }) => {
  const colorConfig = Object.entries(config).filter(
    ([, config]) => config.theme || config.color
  )

  if (!colorConfig.length) {
    return null
  }

  return (
    <style
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
        __html: Object.entries(THEMES)
          .map(
            ([theme, prefix]) => `
${prefix} [data-chart=${id}] {
${colorConfig
  .map(([key, itemConfig]) => {
    const color =
      itemConfig.theme?.[theme as keyof typeof itemConfig.theme] ||
      itemConfig.color
    return color ? `  --color-${key}: ${color};` : null
  })
  .join("\n")}
}
`
          )
          .join("\n"),
      }}
    />
  )
}

const ChartTooltip = RechartsPrimitive.Tooltip

const ChartTooltipContent = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.ComponentProps<typeof RechartsPrimitive.Tooltip> &
    React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
      hideLabel?: boolean
      hideIndicator?: boolean
      indicator?: "line" | "dot" | "dashed"
      nameKey?: string
      labelKey?: string
    }
>(
  (
    {
      active,
      payload,
      className,
      indicator = "dot",
      hideLabel = false,
      hideIndicator = false,
      label,
      labelFormatter,
      labelClassName,
      formatter,
      color,
      nameKey,
      labelKey,
    },
    ref
  ) => {
    const { config } = useChart()

    const tooltipLabel = React.useMemo(() => {
      if (hideLabel || !payload?.length) {
        return null
      }

      const [item] = payload
      const key = `${labelKey || item?.dataKey || item?.name || "value"}`
      const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key)
      const value =
        !labelKey && typeof label === "string"
          ? config[label as keyof typeof config]?.label || label
          : itemConfig?.label

      if (labelFormatter) {
        return (
          <div className={cn("font-medium", labelClassName)}>
            {labelFormatter(value, payload)}
          </div>
        )
      }

      if (!value) {
        return null
      }

      return <div className={cn("font-medium", labelClassName)}>{value}</div>
    }, [
      label,
      labelFormatter,
      payload,
      hideLabel,
      labelClassName,
      config,
      labelKey,
    ])

    if (!active || !payload?.length) {
      return null
    }

    const nestLabel = payload.length === 1 && indicator !== "dot"

    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "grid min-w-[8rem] items-start gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-border/50 bg-background px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs shadow-xl",
          className
        )}
      >
        {!nestLabel ? tooltipLabel : null}
        <div className="grid gap-1.5">
          {payload
            .filter((item) => item.type !== "none")
            .map((item, index) => {
              const key = `${nameKey || item.name || item.dataKey || "value"}`
              const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key)
              const indicatorColor = color || item.payload.fill || item.color

              return (
                <div
                  key={item.dataKey}
                  className={cn(
                    "flex w-full flex-wrap items-stretch gap-2 [&>svg]:h-2.5 [&>svg]:w-2.5 [&>svg]:text-muted-foreground",
                    indicator === "dot" && "items-center"
                  )}
                >
                  {formatter && item?.value !== undefined && item.name ? (
                    formatter(item.value, item.name, item, index, item.payload)
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      {itemConfig?.icon ? (
                        <itemConfig.icon />
                      ) : (
                        !hideIndicator && (
                          <div
                            className={cn(
                              "shrink-0 rounded-[2px] border-[--color-border] bg-[--color-bg]",
                              {
                                "h-2.5 w-2.5": indicator === "dot",
                                "w-1": indicator === "line",
                                "w-0 border-[1.5px] border-dashed bg-transparent":
                                  indicator === "dashed",
                                "my-0.5": nestLabel && indicator === "dashed",
                              }
                            )}
                            style={
                              {
                                "--color-bg": indicatorColor,
                                "--color-border": indicatorColor,
                              } as React.CSSProperties
                            }
                          />
                        )
                      )}
                      <div
                        className={cn(
                          "flex flex-1 justify-between leading-none",
                          nestLabel ? "items-end" : "items-center"
                        )}
                      >
                        <div className="grid gap-1.5">
                          {nestLabel ? tooltipLabel : null}
                          <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                            {itemConfig?.label || item.name}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        {item.value && (
                          <span className="font-mono font-medium tabular-nums text-foreground">
                            {item.value.toLocaleString()}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
              )
            })}
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }
)
ChartTooltipContent.displayName = "ChartTooltip"

const ChartLegend = RechartsPrimitive.Legend

const ChartLegendContent = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.ComponentProps<"div"> &
    Pick<RechartsPrimitive.LegendProps, "payload" | "verticalAlign"> & {
      hideIcon?: boolean
      nameKey?: string
    }
>(
  (
    { className, hideIcon = false, payload, verticalAlign = "bottom", nameKey },
    ref
  ) => {
    const { config } = useChart()

    if (!payload?.length) {
      return null
    }

    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "flex items-center justify-center gap-4",
          verticalAlign === "top" ? "pb-3" : "pt-3",
          className
        )}
      >
        {payload
          .filter((item) => item.type !== "none")
          .map((item) => {
            const key = `${nameKey || item.dataKey || "value"}`
            const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key)

            return (
              <div
                key={item.value}
                className={cn(
                  "flex items-center gap-1.5 [&>svg]:h-3 [&>svg]:w-3 [&>svg]:text-muted-foreground"
                )}
              >
                {itemConfig?.icon && !hideIcon ? (
                  <itemConfig.icon />
                ) : (
                  <div
                    className="h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-[2px]"
                    style={{
                      backgroundColor: item.color,
                    }}
                  />
                )}
                {itemConfig?.label}
              </div>
            )
          })}
      </div>
    )
  }
)
ChartLegendContent.displayName = "ChartLegend"

// Helper to extract item config from a payload.
function getPayloadConfigFromPayload(
  config: ChartConfig,
  payload: unknown,
  key: string
) {
  if (typeof payload !== "object" || payload === null) {
    return undefined
  }

  const payloadPayload =
    "payload" in payload &&
    typeof payload.payload === "object" &&
    payload.payload !== null
      ? payload.payload
      : undefined

  let configLabelKey: string = key

  if (
    key in payload &&
    typeof payload[key as keyof typeof payload] === "string"
  ) {
    configLabelKey = payload[key as keyof typeof payload] as string
  } else if (
    payloadPayload &&
    key in payloadPayload &&
    typeof payloadPayload[key as keyof typeof payloadPayload] === "string"
  ) {
    configLabelKey = payloadPayload[
      key as keyof typeof payloadPayload
    ] as string
  }

  return configLabelKey in config
    ? config[configLabelKey]
    : config[key as keyof typeof config]
}

export {
  ChartContainer,
  ChartTooltip,
  ChartTooltipContent,
  ChartLegend,
  ChartLegendContent,
  ChartStyle,
}
</file>

<file path="apps/admin/src/components/admin-auth-context.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import { useRouter, usePathname } from 'next/navigation';
import { UserProfile } from '@studyflow/shared';
import { fetchAdminMe, logoutAdminApi } from '@/lib/admin-api';

interface AdminAuthContextType {
  user: UserProfile | null;
  isLoading: boolean;
  logout: () => Promise<void>;
  refreshUser: () => Promise<void>;
}

const AdminAuthContext = React.createContext<AdminAuthContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export function AdminAuthProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [user, setUser] = React.useState<UserProfile | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = React.useState<boolean>(true);
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();

  const loadUser = React.useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const data = await fetchAdminMe();
      if (data.user.role !== 'ADMIN') {
        setUser(null);
        if (pathname !== '/login') {
          router.push('/login?error=unauthorized');
        }
        return;
      }
      setUser(data.user);
    } catch {
      setUser(null);
      if (pathname !== '/login') {
        router.push('/login');
      }
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [pathname, router]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    loadUser();
  }, [loadUser]);

  const logout = async () => {
    try {
      await logoutAdminApi();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Logout error:', err);
    } finally {
      setUser(null);
      router.push('/login');
    }
  };

  return (
    <AdminAuthContext.Provider
      value={{
        user,
        isLoading,
        logout,
        refreshUser: loadUser,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </AdminAuthContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useAdminAuth() {
  const context = React.useContext(AdminAuthContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useAdminAuth must be used within an AdminAuthProvider');
  }
  return context;
}

// Generate realistic platform daily activity trends over the last 90 days ending today
function generateChartData() {
  const data = []
  const now = new Date()
  for (let i = 89; i >= 0; i--) {
    const d = new Date(now)
    d.setDate(d.getDate() - i)
    const dateStr = d.toISOString().split("T")[0]
    const dayOffset = 90 - i
    const baseMateri = Math.round(
      16 + Math.sin(dayOffset / 5) * 7 + (dayOffset % 7 === 0 ? -5 : 4)
    )
    const baseTugas = Math.round(
      22 + Math.cos(dayOffset / 6) * 9 + (dayOffset % 5 === 0 ? 6 : -2)
    )
    data.push({
      date: dateStr,
      materi: Math.max(4, baseMateri),
      tugas: Math.max(6, baseTugas),
    })
  }
  return data
}

const chartData = generateChartData()

const chartConfig = {
  materi: {
    label: "Materi Kuliah",
    color: "hsl(var(--chart-1))",
  },
  tugas: {
    label: "Tugas Kuliah",
    color: "hsl(var(--chart-2))",
  },
} satisfies ChartConfig

export function ChartAreaInteractive() {

  const [timeRange, setTimeRange] = React.useState("30d")

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (isMobile) {
      setTimeRange("7d")
    }
  }, [isMobile])

  const filteredData = React.useMemo(() => {
    const now = new Date()
    let daysToSubtract = 90
    if (timeRange === "30d") {
      daysToSubtract = 30
    } else if (timeRange === "7d") {
      daysToSubtract = 7
    }
    const startDate = new Date(now)
    startDate.setDate(startDate.getDate() - daysToSubtract)

    return chartData.filter((item) => {
      const date = new Date(item.date)
      return date >= startDate
    })
  }, [timeRange])

  return (
    <Card className="@container/card shadow-xs">
      <CardHeader className="relative flex flex-col gap-1 pb-4">
        <CardTitle className="text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight md:text-xl">

        </CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          <span className="@[540px]/card:block hidden">
            Volume materi perkuliahan diunggah dan pembuatan tugas akademik
          </span>
          <span className="@[540px]/card:hidden">Materi vs Tugas mahasiswa</span>
        </CardDescription>
        <div className="absolute right-4 top-4">
          <ToggleGroup
            type="single"
            value={timeRange}
            onValueChange={(val) => {
              if (val) setTimeRange(val)
            }}
            variant="outline"
            className="@[767px]/card:flex hidden"

            <ToggleGroupItem value="90d" className="h-8 px-2.5 text-xs">

          </ToggleGroup>
          <Select

            }}
          >
            <SelectTrigger

              </SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="30d" className="rounded-lg text-xs">
                30 Hari

                  offset="5%"

                />

function DraggableRow({ row }: { row: Row<z.infer<typeof schema>> }) {
  const { transform, transition, setNodeRef, isDragging } = useSortable({
    id: row.original.id,
  })

  return (
    <TableRow
      data-state={row.getIsSelected() && "selected"}
      data-dragging={isDragging}
      ref={setNodeRef}
      className="relative z-0 data-[dragging=true]:z-10 data-[dragging=true]:opacity-80"
      style={{
        transform: CSS.Transform.toString(transform),
        transition: transition,
      }}
    >
      {row.getVisibleCells().map((cell) => (
        <TableCell key={cell.id}>
          {flexRender(cell.column.columnDef.cell, cell.getContext())}
        </TableCell>
      ))}
    </TableRow>
  )
}

export function DataTable({
  data: initialData = platformServicesData,

  data?: z.infer<typeof schema>[]
} = {}) {

    React.useState<VisibilityState>({})

    []
  )
  const [sorting, setSorting] = React.useState<SortingState>([])
  const [pagination, setPagination] = React.useState({
    pageIndex: 0,
    pageSize: 10,
  })
  const sortableId = React.useId()
  const sensors = useSensors(
    useSensor(MouseSensor, {}),
    useSensor(TouchSensor, {}),
    useSensor(KeyboardSensor, {})
  )

  const dataIds = React.useMemo<UniqueIdentifier[]>(
    () => data?.map(({ id }) => id) || [],
    [data]
  )

  const table = useReactTable({
    data,
    columns,
    state: {
      sorting,
      columnVisibility,
      rowSelection,
      columnFilters,
      pagination,
    },
    getRowId: (row) => row.id.toString(),
    enableRowSelection: true,
    onRowSelectionChange: setRowSelection,
    onSortingChange: setSorting,
    onColumnFiltersChange: setColumnFilters,
    onColumnVisibilityChange: setColumnVisibility,
    onPaginationChange: setPagination,

    getPaginationRowModel: getPaginationRowModel(),
    getSortedRowModel: getSortedRowModel(),
    getFacetedRowModel: getFacetedRowModel(),
    getFacetedUniqueValues: getFacetedUniqueValues(),
  })

  function handleDragEnd(event: DragEndEvent) {
    const { active, over } = event
    if (active && over && active.id !== over.id) {
      setData((data) => {
        const oldIndex = dataIds.indexOf(active.id)
        const newIndex = dataIds.indexOf(over.id)
        return arrayMove(data, oldIndex, newIndex)
      })
    }
  }

  return (
    <Tabs
      defaultValue="outline"
      className="flex w-full flex-col justify-start gap-6"
    >
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 lg:px-6">
        <Label htmlFor="view-selector" className="sr-only">
          Tampilan
        </Label>
        <Select defaultValue="outline">
          <SelectTrigger
            className="@4xl/main:hidden flex w-fit"
            id="view-selector"
          >
            <SelectValue placeholder="Pilih Tampilan" />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            <SelectItem value="outline">Semua Modul</SelectItem>
            <SelectItem value="past-performance">Worker & AI</SelectItem>
            <SelectItem value="key-personnel">Penyimpanan</SelectItem>
            <SelectItem value="focus-documents">Keamanan</SelectItem>
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
        <TabsList className="@4xl/main:flex hidden">
          <TabsTrigger value="outline">Semua Modul</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="past-performance" className="gap-1">
            Worker & AI{" "}
            <Badge
              variant="secondary"
              className="flex h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-muted-foreground/30 text-xs"
            >
              3
            </Badge>
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="key-personnel" className="gap-1">
            Penyimpanan{" "}
            <Badge
              variant="secondary"
              className="flex h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-muted-foreground/30 text-xs"
            >
              2
            </Badge>
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="focus-documents">Keamanan & Kuota</TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <DropdownMenu>
            <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
              <Button variant="outline" size="sm">
                <ColumnsIcon className="size-3.5" />
                <span className="hidden lg:inline">Kustomisasi Kolom</span>
                <span className="lg:hidden">Kolom</span>
                <ChevronDownIcon className="size-3.5" />
              </Button>
            </DropdownMenuTrigger>
            <DropdownMenuContent align="end" className="w-56">
              {table
                .getAllColumns()
                .filter(
                  (column) =>
                    typeof column.accessorFn !== "undefined" &&
                    column.getCanHide()
                )
                .map((column) => {
                  return (
                    <DropdownMenuCheckboxItem
                      key={column.id}
                      className="capitalize"
                      checked={column.getIsVisible()}
                      onCheckedChange={(value) =>
                        column.toggleVisibility(!!value)
                      }
                    >
                      {column.id === "header"
                        ? "Modul"
                        : column.id === "type"
                        ? "Kategori"
                        : column.id === "status"
                        ? "Status"
                        : column.id === "target"
                        ? "Target"
                        : column.id === "limit"
                        ? "Batas"
                        : column.id === "reviewer"
                        ? "Runtime"
                        : column.id}
                    </DropdownMenuCheckboxItem>
                  )
                })}
            </DropdownMenuContent>
          </DropdownMenu>
        </div>
      </div>
      <TabsContent
        value="outline"
        className="relative flex flex-col gap-4 overflow-auto px-4 lg:px-6"
      >
        <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-lg border">
          <DndContext
            collisionDetection={closestCenter}
            modifiers={[restrictToVerticalAxis]}
            onDragEnd={handleDragEnd}
            sensors={sensors}
            id={sortableId}
          >
            <Table>
              <TableHeader className="sticky top-0 z-10 bg-muted">
                {table.getHeaderGroups().map((headerGroup) => (
                  <TableRow key={headerGroup.id}>
                    {headerGroup.headers.map((header) => {
                      return (
                        <TableHead key={header.id} colSpan={header.colSpan}>
                          {header.isPlaceholder
                            ? null
                            : flexRender(
                                header.column.columnDef.header,
                                header.getContext()
                              )}
                        </TableHead>
                      )
                    })}
                  </TableRow>
                ))}
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody className="**:data-[slot=table-cell]:first:w-8">
                {table.getRowModel().rows?.length ? (
                  <SortableContext
                    items={dataIds}
                    strategy={verticalListSortingStrategy}
                  >
                    {table.getRowModel().rows.map((row) => (
                      <DraggableRow key={row.id} row={row} />
                    ))}
                  </SortableContext>
                ) : (
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableCell
                      colSpan={columns.length}
                      className="h-24 text-center"
                    >
                      Tidak ada data.
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                )}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          </DndContext>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4">
          <div className="hidden flex-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground lg:flex">
            {table.getFilteredSelectedRowModel().rows.length} dari{" "}
            {table.getFilteredRowModel().rows.length} baris dipilih.
          </div>
          <div className="flex w-full items-center gap-8 lg:w-fit">
            <div className="hidden items-center gap-2 lg:flex">
              <Label htmlFor="rows-per-page" className="text-sm font-medium">
                Baris per halaman
              </Label>
              <Select
                value={`${table.getState().pagination.pageSize}`}
                onValueChange={(value) => {
                  table.setPageSize(Number(value))
                }}
              >
                <SelectTrigger className="w-20" id="rows-per-page">
                  <SelectValue
                    placeholder={table.getState().pagination.pageSize}
                  />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent side="top">
                  {[10, 20, 30, 40, 50].map((pageSize) => (
                    <SelectItem key={pageSize} value={`${pageSize}`}>
                      {pageSize}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
            <div className="flex w-fit items-center justify-center text-sm font-medium">
              Halaman {table.getState().pagination.pageIndex + 1} dari{" "}
              {table.getPageCount()}
            </div>
            <div className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-2 lg:ml-0">
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                className="hidden h-8 w-8 p-0 lg:flex"
                onClick={() => table.setPageIndex(0)}
                disabled={!table.getCanPreviousPage()}
              >
                <span className="sr-only">Go to first page</span>
                <ChevronsLeftIcon />
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                className="size-8"
                size="icon"
                onClick={() => table.previousPage()}
                disabled={!table.getCanPreviousPage()}
              >
                <span className="sr-only">Go to previous page</span>
                <ChevronLeftIcon />
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                className="size-8"
                size="icon"
                onClick={() => table.nextPage()}
                disabled={!table.getCanNextPage()}
              >
                <span className="sr-only">Go to next page</span>
                <ChevronRightIcon />
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                className="hidden size-8 lg:flex"
                size="icon"
                onClick={() => table.setPageIndex(table.getPageCount() - 1)}
                disabled={!table.getCanNextPage()}
              >
                <span className="sr-only">Go to last page</span>
                <ChevronsRightIcon />

          </div>
        </div>

      <TabsContent

      >
        <div className="aspect-video w-full flex-1 rounded-lg border border-dashed"></div>
      </TabsContent>
    </Tabs>
  )
