<file path="apps/admin/src/components/login-form.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
import { Eye, EyeOff, Loader2, AlertCircle, ShieldAlert } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Alert, AlertDescription, AlertTitle } from '@/components/ui/alert';
import { loginAdminApi, AdminApiError } from '@/lib/admin-api';
import { useAdminAuth } from '@/components/admin-auth-context';

export function LoginForm({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<'form'>) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const from = searchParams.get('from') || '/dashboard';
  const urlError = searchParams.get('error');

  const { refreshUser } = useAdminAuth();

  const [email, setEmail] = React.useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = React.useState('');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = React.useState(false);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = React.useState<string | null>(
    urlError === 'unauthorized'
      ? 'Sesi administrator tidak valid atau akun tidak memiliki hak akses.'
      : null
  );
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = React.useState(false);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMsg(null);
    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      await loginAdminApi({ email, password });
      await refreshUser();
      router.push(from);
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof AdminApiError) {
        setErrorMsg(err.message);
      } else if (err instanceof Error) {
        setErrorMsg(err.message);
      } else {
        setErrorMsg('Terjadi kesalahan saat masuk. Silakan coba lagi.');
      }
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <form className={cn('flex flex-col gap-6', className)} onSubmit={handleSubmit} {...props}>
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2 text-center">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">Masuk ke Akun Admin</h1>
        <p className="text-balance text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          Masukkan email dan kata sandi akun administrator Anda
        </p>
      </div>

      {errorMsg && (
        <Alert variant="destructive" className="py-3">
          <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
          <AlertTitle className="text-xs font-semibold">Gagal Masuk</AlertTitle>
          <AlertDescription className="text-xs leading-relaxed mt-0.5">
            {errorMsg}
          </AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}

      <div className="grid gap-4">
        <div className="grid gap-2">
          <Label htmlFor="email">Email</Label>
          <Input
            id="email"
            type="email"
            placeholder="admin@studyflow.internal"
            value={email}
            onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
            required
            autoComplete="email"
            disabled={isSubmitting}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="grid gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-center">
            <Label htmlFor="password">Kata Sandi</Label>
          </div>
          <div className="relative">
            <Input
              id="password"
              type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
              placeholder="••••••••••••"
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              required
              autoComplete="current-password"
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              className="pr-10"
            />
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
              className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground focus:outline-hidden"
              aria-label={showPassword ? 'Sembunyikan kata sandi' : 'Tampilkan kata sandi'}
              tabIndex={-1}
            >
              {showPassword ? <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <Button type="submit" className="w-full mt-2" disabled={isSubmitting}>
          {isSubmitting ? (
            <>
              <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
              Memverifikasi...
            </>
          ) : (
            'Masuk'
          )}
        </Button>
      </div>

      <div className="rounded-md border border-border/60 bg-muted/40 p-3 text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 font-medium text-foreground mb-0.5">
          <ShieldAlert className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
          Akses Khusus Administrator
        </div>
        Portal ini khusus untuk pengelolaan platform StudyFlow. Akun mahasiswa biasa tidak dapat masuk.
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
</file>

          </CardTitle>

              <CheckSquare className="size-3" />
              Tugas
            </Badge>
          </div>
        </CardHeader>

          <div className="line-clamp-1 flex items-center gap-2 font-medium">
            Tugas perkuliahan mahasiswa <TrendingUpIcon className="size-3.5 text-violet-500" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-muted-foreground">
            Terdistribusi lintas semester
          </div>
        </CardFooter>
      </Card>

      {/* Gagal AI (24 Jam) */}
      <Card className="@container/card">
        <CardHeader className="relative">
          <CardDescription>Pekerjaan AI Gagal (24 Jam)</CardDescription>
          <CardTitle className="@[250px]/card:text-3xl text-2xl font-semibold tabular-nums">
            {isLoading ? (
              <Skeleton className="h-8 w-24" />
            ) : (
              (summary ? summary.failedJobs24h.toLocaleString("id-ID") : "0")
            )}
          </CardTitle>
          <div className="absolute right-4 top-4">
            {hasFailedJobs ? (
              <Badge variant="destructive" className="flex gap-1 rounded-lg text-xs">
                <TrendingDownIcon className="size-3" />
                Perlu Perhatian
              </Badge>
            ) : (
              <Badge
                variant="outline"
                className="flex gap-1 rounded-lg text-xs border-emerald-500/20 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400"
              >
                <TrendingUpIcon className="size-3" />
                Normal
              </Badge>
            )}
          </div>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardFooter className="flex-col items-start gap-1 text-sm">
          <div className="line-clamp-1 flex items-center gap-2 font-medium">
            Kestabilan antrean AI <AlertTriangle className="size-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-muted-foreground">
            {hasFailedJobs
              ? "Terdapat error pada worker ekstraksi"
              : "Seluruh worker berjalan lancar"}
          </div>
        </CardFooter>
      </Card>
    </div>
  )
}

<file path="apps/admin/src/hooks/use-mobile.tsx">
import * as React from "react"

const MOBILE_BREAKPOINT = 768

export function useIsMobile() {
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = React.useState<boolean | undefined>(undefined)

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const mql = window.matchMedia(`(max-width: ${MOBILE_BREAKPOINT - 1}px)`)
    const onChange = () => {
      setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT)
    }
    mql.addEventListener("change", onChange)
    setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT)
    return () => mql.removeEventListener("change", onChange)
  }, [])

  return !!isMobile
}

<file path="apps/admin/src/lib/clientIp.ts">
import { isIP } from 'node:net';

export function resolveForwardedClientIp(headers: Headers): string {
  const trustedHeader = process.env.TRUSTED_CLIENT_IP_HEADER?.trim().toLowerCase();

  // Mode Default: Without trusted ingress, never trust user-supplied headers
  if (!trustedHeader || trustedHeader === 'none') {
    return '127.0.0.1';
  }

  // Trusted Ingress Mode: Read ONLY the single configured header
  const rawValue = headers.get(trustedHeader);
  if (!rawValue) {
    return '127.0.0.1';
  }

  // If header contains comma-separated values (e.g. proxy list), take the client IP (first entry)
  const candidate = rawValue.split(',')[0]?.trim();
  if (candidate && isIP(candidate) !== 0) {
    return candidate;
  }

  // Fallback to safe local address if IP format is invalid or malformed
  return '127.0.0.1';
}

<file path="apps/api/src/middleware/requireAdmin.ts">
import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import { COOKIE_NAMES, ADMIN_COOKIE_NAMES, Role } from '@studyflow/shared';
import { verifyAccessToken } from '../services/token.service.js';
import { prisma } from '@studyflow/database';
import { AppError } from './errorHandler.js';

export interface AuthenticatedAdminUser {
  id: string;
  email: string;
  role: Role;
}

declare global {
  namespace Express {
    interface Request {
      adminUser?: AuthenticatedAdminUser;
    }
  }
}

export async function requireAdmin(
  req: Request,
  _res: Response,
  next: NextFunction
): Promise<void> {
  let token: string | undefined;

  // 1. Check Authorization header
  const authHeader = req.headers.authorization;
  if (authHeader && authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
    token = authHeader.substring(7).trim();
  }

  // 2. Check admin cookies first, fallback to user cookies
  if (!token && req.cookies) {
    token = req.cookies[ADMIN_COOKIE_NAMES.accessToken] || req.cookies[COOKIE_NAMES.accessToken];
  }

  if (!token) {
    const error: AppError = new Error('Autentikasi admin diperlukan. Token tidak ditemukan.');
    error.statusCode = 401;
    error.code = 'UNAUTHORIZED';
    return next(error);
  }

  const payload = verifyAccessToken(token);
  if (!payload) {
    const error: AppError = new Error('Token akses admin tidak valid atau telah kedaluwarsa.');
    error.statusCode = 401;
    error.code = 'INVALID_OR_EXPIRED_TOKEN';
    return next(error);
  }

  // Query database authoritatively for current role and session validity
  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: payload.userId },
    select: { id: true, email: true, role: true, tokenVersion: true },
  });

  if (!user || user.tokenVersion !== payload.tokenVersion) {
    const error: AppError = new Error('Sesi admin telah dicabut atau diubah. Silakan login kembali.');
    error.statusCode = 401;
    error.code = 'SESSION_REVOKED';
    return next(error);
  }

  if (user.role !== 'ADMIN') {
    const error: AppError = new Error('Akses ditolak. Tindakan ini memerlukan hak administrator.');
    error.statusCode = 403;
    error.code = 'FORBIDDEN';
    return next(error);
  }

  req.adminUser = {
    id: user.id,
    email: user.email,
    role: user.role as Role,
  };

  req.user = {
    id: user.id,
    email: user.email,
  };

  next();
}
</file>

<file path="apps/api/src/routes/adminAuth.ts">
import { Router, Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import {
  AdminLoginInputSchema,
  ADMIN_COOKIE_NAMES,
} from '@studyflow/shared';
import {
  loginAdmin,
  rotateAdminRefreshToken,
  logoutAdmin,
} from '../services/admin.service.js';
import {
  setAdminAuthCookies,
  clearAdminAuthCookies,
} from '../services/cookie.service.js';
import { toUserProfile } from '../services/auth.service.js';
import { requireAdmin } from '../middleware/requireAdmin.js';
import { adminLoginRateLimiter } from '../middleware/rateLimiter.js';
import { prisma } from '@studyflow/database';

export const adminAuthRouter = Router();

// POST /api/admin/auth/login
adminAuthRouter.post('/login', adminLoginRateLimiter, async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
  try {
    const parseResult = AdminLoginInputSchema.safeParse(req.body);
    if (!parseResult.success) {
      res.status(400).json({
        error: {
          code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
          message: 'Data login tidak valid',
          details: parseResult.error.flatten().fieldErrors,
        },
      });
      return;
    }

    const { user, accessToken, refreshToken } = await loginAdmin(parseResult.data);
    setAdminAuthCookies(res, accessToken, refreshToken);

    res.status(200).json({
      message: 'Login administrator berhasil',
      user,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    next(err);
  }
});

// POST /api/admin/auth/refresh
adminAuthRouter.post('/refresh', async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
  try {
    const refreshToken = req.cookies?.[ADMIN_COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken];

    if (!refreshToken) {
      res.status(400).json({
        error: {
          code: 'REFRESH_TOKEN_REQUIRED',
          message: 'Refresh token admin tidak ditemukan',
        },
      });
      return;
    }

    const result = await rotateAdminRefreshToken(refreshToken);
    setAdminAuthCookies(res, result.accessToken, result.refreshToken);

    res.status(200).json({
      message: 'Token admin berhasil diperbarui',
      user: result.user,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    next(err);
  }
});

// POST /api/admin/auth/logout
adminAuthRouter.post('/logout', async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
  try {
    const refreshToken = req.cookies?.[ADMIN_COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken];
    await logoutAdmin(refreshToken);
    clearAdminAuthCookies(res);

    res.status(200).json({
      message: 'Logout admin berhasil',
    });
  } catch (err) {
    next(err);
  }
});

// GET /api/admin/auth/me
adminAuthRouter.get('/me', requireAdmin, async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
  try {
    const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { id: req.adminUser!.id },
      include: {
        federatedIdentities: {
          select: { provider: true },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!user) {
      res.status(404).json({
        error: {
          code: 'USER_NOT_FOUND',
          message: 'Pengguna tidak ditemukan',
        },
      });
      return;
    }

    res.status(200).json({
      user: toUserProfile(user, user.federatedIdentities.map((f) => f.provider)),
    });
  } catch (err) {
    next(err);
  }
});
</file>

    if (!parsedBody.success) {
      const error: AppError = new Error(
        parsedBody.error.errors[0]?.message || 'Input sesi jadwal tidak valid'

      error.code = 'VALIDATION_ERROR';

    const result = await createSchedule(req.user!.id, parsedBody.data);
    res.status(201).json(result);
  } catch (err) {
    next(err);
  }
});

      );
      error.statusCode = 400;
      error.code = 'VALIDATION_ERROR';
      return next(error);

    const result = await updateSchedule(req.user!.id, id, parsedBody.data);

  } catch (err) {
    next(err);
  }
});

    res.status(200).json(result);
  } catch (err) {
    next(err);
  }

import readline from 'node:readline';
import { prisma } from '@studyflow/database';

async function main() {
  const args = process.argv.slice(2);
  let email = args.find((arg) => !arg.startsWith('--'));
  const autoConfirm = args.includes('--yes') || args.includes('-y');

  if (!email) {
    const rl = readline.createInterface({
      input: process.stdin,
      output: process.stdout,
    });

    email = await new Promise<string>((resolve) => {
      rl.question('Masukkan email akun yang ingin dipromosikan menjadi ADMIN: ', (ans) => {
        rl.close();
        resolve(ans.trim());
      });
    });
  }

  if (!email) {
    console.error('Error: Email akun tidak boleh kosong.');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  const normalizedEmail = email.toLowerCase().trim();

  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
    where: { email: normalizedEmail },
    select: {
      id: true,
      name: true,
      email: true,
      role: true,
      passwordHash: true,
      createdAt: true,
    },
  });

  if (!user) {
    console.error(`Error: Pengguna dengan email "${normalizedEmail}" tidak ditemukan.`);
    process.exit(1);
  }

  console.log('\n--- TARGET AKUN ---');
  console.log(`ID:           ${user.id}`);
  console.log(`Nama:         ${user.name}`);
  console.log(`Email:        ${user.email}`);
  console.log(`Peran saat ini: ${user.role}`);
  console.log(`Punya Password: ${user.passwordHash ? 'Ya' : 'Tidak (Google/OAuth only)'}`);
  console.log(`Terdaftar:    ${user.createdAt.toISOString()}`);
  console.log('-------------------\n');

  if (!user.passwordHash) {
    console.warn(
      'PERINGATAN: Akun ini tidak memiliki kata sandi lokal (mungkin Google OAuth only).\n' +
        'Login administrator pada tahap ini mewajibkan akun memiliki kata sandi.\n'
    );
  }

  if (user.role === 'ADMIN') {
    console.log(`Akun "${user.email}" sudah berstatus ADMIN.`);
    process.exit(0);
  }

  if (!autoConfirm) {
    const rl = readline.createInterface({
      input: process.stdin,
      output: process.stdout,
    });

    const answer = await new Promise<string>((resolve) => {
      rl.question('Ketik "PROMOSIKAN" untuk mengonfirmasi promosi akun ini menjadi ADMIN: ', (ans) => {
        rl.close();
        resolve(ans.trim());
      });
    });

    if (answer !== 'PROMOSIKAN') {
      console.log('Operasi dibatalkan. Tidak ada perubahan yang dilakukan pada database.');
      process.exit(0);
    }
  }

  await prisma.user.update({
    where: { id: user.id },
    data: { role: 'ADMIN' },
  });

  console.log(`\nBERHASIL! Akun "${user.email}" telah dipromosikan menjadi ADMIN.\n`);
}

main()
  .catch((err) => {
    console.error('Terjadi kesalahan:', err);
    process.exit(1);
  })
  .finally(async () => {
    await prisma.$disconnect();
  });

<file path="apps/api/src/services/assignmentReminder.service.ts">
import { Queue } from 'bullmq';
import { Redis } from 'ioredis';
import { QUEUE_NAMES } from '@studyflow/shared';
import { env } from '../config/env.js';

let reminderQueue: Queue | null = null;
let redisConnection: Redis | null = null;

function getQueueConnection(): Redis {
  if (!redisConnection) {
    redisConnection = new Redis(env.REDIS_URL, {
      maxRetriesPerRequest: null,
      lazyConnect: true,
    });
  }
  return redisConnection;
}

export function getAssignmentReminderQueue(): Queue {
  if (!reminderQueue) {
    reminderQueue = new Queue(QUEUE_NAMES.assignmentReminder, {
      connection: getQueueConnection(),
      defaultJobOptions: {
        attempts: 3,
        backoff: {
          type: 'exponential',
          delay: 5000,
        },
        removeOnComplete: {
          count: 100,
        },
        removeOnFail: {
          count: 200,
        },
      },
    });
  }
  return reminderQueue;
}

/**
 * Schedules a delayed BullMQ reminder job for an assignment.
 * Target send time is exactly 24 hours prior to deadline (H-1).
 * If task is DONE or H-1 is already in the past, no job is scheduled.
 */
export async function scheduleAssignmentReminder(assignment: {
  id: string;
  dueDate: Date;
  status: string;
}): Promise<void> {
  // If assignment is completed, do not schedule
  if (assignment.status === 'DONE') {
    return;
  }

  const nowMs = Date.now();
  const deadlineMs = assignment.dueDate.getTime();
  const targetSendMs = deadlineMs - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

  // Rule: New assignments created after H-1 do not trigger retroactive catchup reminder
  if (targetSendMs <= nowMs) {
    return;
  }

  const delay = targetSendMs - nowMs;
  const jobId = `reminder-${assignment.id}-D_MINUS_1-${deadlineMs}`;

  try {
    const queue = getAssignmentReminderQueue();
    await queue.add(
      'send-assignment-reminder',
      {
        assignmentId: assignment.id,
        reminderType: 'D_MINUS_1',
        deadline: assignment.dueDate.toISOString(),
      },
      {
        jobId,
        delay,
      }
    );
  } catch (err: any) {
    // Graceful logging if queue connection is not available in isolated test environments
    if (env.NODE_ENV !== 'test') {
      console.warn(`[AssignmentReminder] Failed to schedule reminder for ${assignment.id}: ${err?.message}`);
    }
  }
}

<file path="apps/api/src/services/calendar.service.ts">
import { prisma } from '@studyflow/database';
import {
  CalendarQuery,
  CalendarResponse,
  CalendarEvent,
  getLocalComponents,
  localComponentsToUtc,
  parseUserDateInput,
  isValidTimezone,
} from '@studyflow/shared';
import { AppError } from '../middleware/errorHandler.js';

function parseDateParam(
  dateParam: string,
  timezone: string
): { year: number; month: number; day: number; dateStr: string } {
  const d = parseUserDateInput(dateParam, { timezone, defaultToEndOfDay: false });
  const comp = getLocalComponents(d, timezone);
  const dateStr = `${comp.year}-${String(comp.month).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(comp.day).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  return { year: comp.year, month: comp.month, day: comp.day, dateStr };
}

export async function getCalendarData(
  userId: string,
  query: CalendarQuery
): Promise<CalendarResponse> {
  // 1. Dapatkan user dan timezone
  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: userId },
    select: { id: true, timezone: true },
  });

  if (!user) {
    const error: AppError = new Error('Pengguna tidak ditemukan');
    error.statusCode = 404;
    error.code = 'NOT_FOUND';
    throw error;
  }

  const timezone = isValidTimezone(user.timezone) ? user.timezone : 'Asia/Jakarta';

  // 2. Resolusi semester
  let semester;
  if (query.semesterId) {
    semester = await prisma.semester.findFirst({
      where: { id: query.semesterId, userId },
    });
    if (!semester) {
      const error: AppError = new Error('Semester tidak ditemukan');
      error.statusCode = 404;
      error.code = 'NOT_FOUND';
      throw error;
    }
  } else {
    semester = await prisma.semester.findFirst({
      where: { userId, isActive: true },
    });
    if (!semester) {
      // Jika tidak ada yang aktif, cari semester terbaru yang tidak diarsipkan
      semester = await prisma.semester.findFirst({
        where: { userId, archivedAt: null },
        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
      });
    }
  }

  if (!semester) {
    const error: AppError = new Error('Belum ada semester yang dibuat');
    error.statusCode = 404;
    error.code = 'SEMESTER_NOT_FOUND';
    throw error;
  }

  if (semester.archivedAt) {
    const error: AppError = new Error('Semester telah diarsipkan');
    error.statusCode = 400;
    error.code = 'SEMESTER_ARCHIVED';
    throw error;
  }

  // 3. Validasi courseId jika diberikan
  if (query.courseId) {
    const course = await prisma.course.findFirst({
      where: {
        id: query.courseId,
        userId,
        semesterId: semester.id,
      },
    });
    if (!course) {
      const error: AppError = new Error('Mata kuliah tidak ditemukan pada semester ini');
      error.statusCode = 404;
      error.code = 'COURSE_NOT_FOUND';
      throw error;
    }
    if (course.archivedAt) {
      const error: AppError = new Error('Mata kuliah telah diarsipkan');
      error.statusCode = 400;
      error.code = 'COURSE_ARCHIVED';
      throw error;
    }
  }

  // 4. Parse dan validasi rentang tanggal [startDate, endDate)
  const startComp = parseDateParam(query.startDate, timezone);
  const endComp = parseDateParam(query.endDate, timezone);

  const startInstant = localComponentsToUtc(
    startComp.year,
    startComp.month,
    startComp.day,
    0,
    0,
    0,
    timezone
  );
  const endInstant = localComponentsToUtc(
    endComp.year,
    endComp.month,
    endComp.day,
    0,
    0,
    0,
    timezone
  );

  if (endInstant.getTime() <= startInstant.getTime()) {
    const error: AppError = new Error('Tanggal akhir harus setelah tanggal mulai');
    error.statusCode = 400;
    error.code = 'INVALID_RANGE';
    throw error;
  }

  const diffDays = Math.round((endInstant.getTime() - startInstant.getTime()) / (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
  if (diffDays > 60) {
    const error: AppError = new Error('Rentang waktu kalender maksimal 60 hari');
    error.statusCode = 400;
    error.code = 'RANGE_TOO_LARGE';
    throw error;
  }

  const filterType = query.type || 'all';
  const events: CalendarEvent[] = [];

  // 5. Query Jadwal Kuliah & ekspansi mingguan
  if (filterType === 'all' || filterType === 'schedule') {
    const schedules = await prisma.courseSchedule.findMany({
      where: {
        userId,
        ...(query.courseId ? { courseId: query.courseId } : {}),
        course: {
          semesterId: semester.id,
          archivedAt: null,
        },
      },
      include: {
        course: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
            lecturer: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: [{ dayOfWeek: 'asc' }, { startTime: 'asc' }],
    });

    // Generate local calendar days
    let cursor = new Date(startInstant.getTime());
    while (cursor.getTime() < endInstant.getTime()) {
      const comp = getLocalComponents(cursor, timezone);
      const dateStr = `${comp.year}-${String(comp.month).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(comp.day).padStart(2, '0')}`;
      const d = new Date(Date.UTC(comp.year, comp.month - 1, comp.day));
      const jsDay = d.getUTCDay();
      const dayOfWeek = jsDay === 0 ? 7 : jsDay;

      // Temukan jadwal pada hari ini
      const matchingSchedules = schedules.filter((s) => s.dayOfWeek === dayOfWeek);
      for (const s of matchingSchedules) {
        events.push({
          id: `${s.id}-${dateStr}`,
          type: 'SCHEDULE',
          title: s.course.name,
          courseId: s.courseId,
          courseName: s.course.name,
          courseCode: s.course.code,
          date: dateStr,
          scheduleId: s.id,
          dayOfWeek: s.dayOfWeek,
          startTime: s.startTime,
          endTime: s.endTime,
          room: s.room,
          lecturer: s.course.lecturer,
        });
      }

      // Maju ke hari berikutnya dengan aman
      const nextNoon =
        localComponentsToUtc(comp.year, comp.month, comp.day, 12, 0, 0, timezone).getTime() +
        24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
      const nextComp = getLocalComponents(new Date(nextNoon), timezone);
      cursor = localComponentsToUtc(nextComp.year, nextComp.month, nextComp.day, 0, 0, 0, timezone);
    }
  }

  // 6. Query Tugas Kuliah
  if (filterType === 'all' || filterType === 'assignment') {
    const assignments = await prisma.assignment.findMany({
      where: {
        userId,
        dueDate: {
          gte: startInstant,
          lt: endInstant,
        },
        course: {
          semesterId: semester.id,
          archivedAt: null,
          ...(query.courseId ? { id: query.courseId } : {}),
        },
      },
      include: {
        course: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: { dueDate: 'asc' },
    });

    const now = Date.now();
    for (const a of assignments) {
      const comp = getLocalComponents(a.dueDate, timezone);
      const dateStr = `${comp.year}-${String(comp.month).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(comp.day).padStart(2, '0')}`;
      const timeStr = `${String(comp.hour).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(comp.minute).padStart(2, '0')}`;
      const isOverdue = a.status !== 'DONE' && a.dueDate.getTime() < now;

      events.push({
        id: a.id,
        type: 'ASSIGNMENT',
        title: a.title,
        courseId: a.courseId,
        courseName: a.course.name,
        courseCode: a.course.code,
        date: dateStr,
        assignmentId: a.id,
        dueDate: a.dueDate.toISOString(),
        dueTime: timeStr,
        priority: a.priority,
        status: a.status,
        isOverdue,
        description: a.description,
      });
    }
  }

  // 7. Sort events: date ASC -> time ASC -> title ASC
  events.sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.date !== b.date) {
      return a.date.localeCompare(b.date);
    }
    const timeA = a.type === 'SCHEDULE' ? a.startTime || '' : a.dueTime || '';
    const timeB = b.type === 'SCHEDULE' ? b.startTime || '' : b.dueTime || '';
    if (timeA !== timeB) {
      return timeA.localeCompare(timeB);
    }
    return a.title.localeCompare(b.title);
  });

  return {
    events,
    semester: {
      id: semester.id,
      name: semester.name,
      academicYear: semester.academicYear,
      isActive: semester.isActive,
    },
    range: {
      startDate: startComp.dateStr,
      endDate: endComp.dateStr,
    },
    timezone,
    disclaimer:
      'Jadwal kuliah ditampilkan sebagai pola mingguan berulang. Hari libur dan penyesuaian pertemuan belum diperhitungkan.',
  };
}

<file path="apps/api/src/services/loginProtection.service.ts">
import { ipKeyGenerator } from 'express-rate-limit';
import { env } from '../config/env.js';
import { getRateLimitRedisClient, hashAccountIdentifier } from '../middleware/rateLimiter.js';

/**
 * Adaptive CAPTCHA for email/password login.
 *
 * Two independent failure counters (15-minute window):
 * - per account (SHA-256 hashed normalized email; raw email never stored)
 * - per client IP (catches credential stuffing across many emails)
 *
 * CAPTCHA is required when either counter reaches its threshold.
 * Counters are tracked identically for registered and unregistered emails,
 * so the CAPTCHA signal never reveals whether an account exists.
 */

export const ACCOUNT_FAILURE_THRESHOLD = 3;
export const IP_FAILURE_THRESHOLD = 10;
const WINDOW_MS = 15 * 60 * 1000;
const KEY_PREFIX = 'studyflow:rl:login_fail:';

const INCREMENT_LUA = `
local hits = redis.call('INCR', KEYS[1])
if hits == 1 or redis.call('PTTL', KEYS[1]) < 0 then
  redis.call('PEXPIRE', KEYS[1], tonumber(ARGV[1]))
end
return hits
`;

interface FailureKeys {
  account: string | null;
  ip: string;
}

function buildKeys(email: unknown, rawIp: string | undefined): FailureKeys {
  const accountHash = hashAccountIdentifier(email);
  return {
    account: accountHash ? `${KEY_PREFIX}acct:${accountHash}` : null,
    ip: `${KEY_PREFIX}ip:${ipKeyGenerator(rawIp || '127.0.0.1')}`,
  };
}

// ---- Memory store (used when RATE_LIMIT_STORE=memory, e.g. tests) ----
const memoryStore = new Map<string, { count: number; expiresAt: number }>();

function memoryGet(key: string): number {
  const entry = memoryStore.get(key);
  if (!entry) return 0;
  if (entry.expiresAt <= Date.now()) {
    memoryStore.delete(key);
    return 0;
  }
  return entry.count;
}

function memoryIncrement(key: string): number {
  const count = memoryGet(key) + 1;
  const existing = memoryStore.get(key);
  memoryStore.set(key, {
    count,
    expiresAt: existing && count > 1 ? existing.expiresAt : Date.now() + WINDOW_MS,
  });
  return count;
}

export function __resetLoginProtectionMemory(): void {
  memoryStore.clear();
}

function useRedis(): boolean {
  return env.RATE_LIMIT_STORE === 'redis';
}

async function getCounts(keys: FailureKeys): Promise<{ account: number; ip: number }> {
  if (!useRedis()) {
    return { account: keys.account ? memoryGet(keys.account) : 0, ip: memoryGet(keys.ip) };
  }
  const client = getRateLimitRedisClient();
  const [accountRaw, ipRaw] = await Promise.all([
    keys.account ? client.get(keys.account) : Promise.resolve(null),
    client.get(keys.ip),
  ]);
  return { account: Number(accountRaw ?? 0) || 0, ip: Number(ipRaw ?? 0) || 0 };
}

function exceedsThreshold(counts: { account: number; ip: number }): boolean {
  return counts.account >= ACCOUNT_FAILURE_THRESHOLD || counts.ip >= IP_FAILURE_THRESHOLD;
}

/**
 * Returns true when the next login attempt for this email/IP must include a Turnstile token.
 * Fail-closed: if the counter store is unavailable, CAPTCHA is required.
 */
export async function isCaptchaRequiredForLogin(email: unknown, rawIp: string | undefined): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    return exceedsThreshold(await getCounts(buildKeys(email, rawIp)));
  } catch {
    console.error('[LOGIN_PROTECTION] Gagal membaca penghitung login; CAPTCHA diwajibkan (fail-closed).');
    return true;
  }
}

/**
 * Records a failed login attempt for both counters.
 * Returns true when CAPTCHA is now required for subsequent attempts.
 */
export async function recordLoginFailure(email: unknown, rawIp: string | undefined): Promise<boolean> {
  const keys = buildKeys(email, rawIp);
  try {
    if (!useRedis()) {
      const account = keys.account ? memoryIncrement(keys.account) : 0;
      const ip = memoryIncrement(keys.ip);
      return exceedsThreshold({ account, ip });
    }
    const client = getRateLimitRedisClient();
    const windowMs = String(WINDOW_MS);
    const [account, ip] = await Promise.all([
      keys.account ? (client.eval(INCREMENT_LUA, 1, keys.account, windowMs) as Promise<number>) : Promise.resolve(0),
      client.eval(INCREMENT_LUA, 1, keys.ip, windowMs) as Promise<number>,
    ]);
    return exceedsThreshold({ account: Number(account), ip: Number(ip) });
  } catch {
    console.error('[LOGIN_PROTECTION] Gagal mencatat kegagalan login; CAPTCHA diwajibkan (fail-closed).');
    return true;
  }
}

/**
 * Clears only the per-account counter after a successful login.
 * The per-IP counter is intentionally kept so an attacker cannot reset it
 * by logging into their own account between stuffing attempts.
 */
export async function resetAccountLoginFailures(email: unknown): Promise<void> {
  const { account } = buildKeys(email, undefined);
  if (!account) return;
  try {
    if (!useRedis()) {
      memoryStore.delete(account);
      return;
    }
    await getRateLimitRedisClient().del(account);
  } catch {
    console.error('[LOGIN_PROTECTION] Gagal mereset penghitung akun setelah login sukses.');
  }
}
</file>

<file path="apps/api/src/services/pin.service.ts">
import { prisma } from '@studyflow/database';
import {
  SetPinResponse,
  PinnedItemsListResponse,
  PinnedItemDetail,
} from '@studyflow/shared';
import { AppError } from '../middleware/errorHandler.js';

export const MAX_PINNED_ITEMS_PER_USER = 20;

/**
 * Explicitly sets pin status for a Material.
 * Idempotent, safe against concurrent requests, enforces max 20 limit.
 * Never modifies Material.updatedAt.
 */
export async function setMaterialPin(
  userId: string,
  materialId: string,
  pinned: boolean
): Promise<SetPinResponse> {
  const material = await prisma.material.findFirst({
    where: { id: materialId, userId },
    include: {
      course: {
        include: { semester: true },
      },
    },
  });

  if (!material || material.deletedAt) {
    const error: AppError = new Error('Materi tidak ditemukan');
    error.statusCode = 404;
    error.code = 'NOT_FOUND';
    throw error;
  }

  if (material.course?.archivedAt || material.course?.semester?.archivedAt) {
    const error: AppError = new Error(
      'Item tidak dapat disematkan karena mata kuliah atau semester telah diarsipkan'
    );
    error.statusCode = 400;
    error.code = 'ITEM_ARCHIVED';
    throw error;
  }

  return await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    // Acquire row-level lock on user to serialize concurrent pinning operations
    await tx.$queryRaw`SELECT id FROM users WHERE id = ${userId} FOR UPDATE`;

    const existingPin = await tx.pinnedItem.findUnique({
      where: {
        userId_materialId: { userId, materialId },
      },
    });

    if (pinned) {
      if (existingPin) {
        return {
          success: true,
          pinned: true,
          pinnedAt: existingPin.createdAt.toISOString(),
        };
      }

      const count = await tx.pinnedItem.count({
        where: { userId },
      });

      if (count >= MAX_PINNED_ITEMS_PER_USER) {
        const error: AppError = new Error(
          `Batas maksimal item yang disematkan adalah ${MAX_PINNED_ITEMS_PER_USER} item`
        );
        error.statusCode = 400;
        error.code = 'PIN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED';
        throw error;
      }

      const newPin = await tx.pinnedItem.create({
        data: {
          userId,
          type: 'MATERIAL',
          materialId,
        },
      });

      return {
        success: true,
        pinned: true,
        pinnedAt: newPin.createdAt.toISOString(),
      };
    } else {
      if (!existingPin) {
        return {
          success: true,
          pinned: false,
          pinnedAt: null,
        };
      }

      await tx.pinnedItem.delete({
        where: { id: existingPin.id },
      });

      return {
        success: true,
        pinned: false,
        pinnedAt: null,
      };
    }
  });
}

/**
 * Explicitly sets pin status for a Note.
 * Idempotent, safe against concurrent requests, enforces max 20 limit.
 * Never modifies Note.updatedAt.
 */
export async function setNotePin(
  userId: string,
  noteId: string,
  pinned: boolean
): Promise<SetPinResponse> {
  const note = await prisma.note.findFirst({
    where: { id: noteId, userId },
    include: {
      course: {
        include: { semester: true },
      },
    },
  });

  if (!note) {
    const error: AppError = new Error('Catatan tidak ditemukan');
    error.statusCode = 404;
    error.code = 'NOT_FOUND';
    throw error;
  }

  if (note.course?.archivedAt || note.course?.semester?.archivedAt) {
    const error: AppError = new Error(
      'Item tidak dapat disematkan karena mata kuliah atau semester telah diarsipkan'
    );
    error.statusCode = 400;
    error.code = 'ITEM_ARCHIVED';
    throw error;
  }

  return await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    // Acquire row-level lock on user to serialize concurrent pinning operations
    await tx.$queryRaw`SELECT id FROM users WHERE id = ${userId} FOR UPDATE`;

    const existingPin = await tx.pinnedItem.findUnique({
      where: {
        userId_noteId: { userId, noteId },
      },
    });

    if (pinned) {
      if (existingPin) {
        return {
          success: true,
          pinned: true,
          pinnedAt: existingPin.createdAt.toISOString(),
        };
      }

      const count = await tx.pinnedItem.count({
        where: { userId },
      });

      if (count >= MAX_PINNED_ITEMS_PER_USER) {
        const error: AppError = new Error(
          `Batas maksimal item yang disematkan adalah ${MAX_PINNED_ITEMS_PER_USER} item`
        );
        error.statusCode = 400;
        error.code = 'PIN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED';
        throw error;
      }

      const newPin = await tx.pinnedItem.create({
        data: {
          userId,
          type: 'NOTE',
          noteId,
        },
      });

      return {
        success: true,
        pinned: true,
        pinnedAt: newPin.createdAt.toISOString(),
      };
    } else {
      if (!existingPin) {
        return {
          success: true,
          pinned: false,
          pinnedAt: null,
        };
      }

      await tx.pinnedItem.delete({
        where: { id: existingPin.id },
      });

      return {
        success: true,
        pinned: false,
        pinnedAt: null,
      };
    }
  });
}

/**
 * Retrieves pinned items for user, sorted by most recently pinned with deterministic tie-breaker.
 * Filters by semester if specified (materials in semester, notes in semester or general notes).
 * Excludes deleted/archived items.
 */
export async function getPinnedItems(
  userId: string,
  semesterId?: string
): Promise<PinnedItemsListResponse> {
  if (semesterId) {
    const semester = await prisma.semester.findFirst({
      where: { id: semesterId, userId },
    });
    if (!semester || semester.archivedAt) {
      return { items: [], total: 0 };
    }
  }

  const rawPinned = await prisma.pinnedItem.findMany({
    where: { userId },
    orderBy: [{ createdAt: 'desc' }, { id: 'asc' }],
    include: {
      material: {
        include: {
          course: {
            include: { semester: true },
          },
        },
      },
      note: {
        include: {
          course: {
            include: { semester: true },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  });

  const items: PinnedItemDetail[] = [];

  for (const pin of rawPinned) {
    if (pin.type === 'MATERIAL') {
      if (!pin.material || pin.material.deletedAt) continue;
      const course = pin.material.course;
      const semester = course?.semester;
      if (course?.archivedAt || semester?.archivedAt) continue;

      if (semesterId && course?.semesterId !== semesterId) {
        continue;
      }

      items.push({
        id: pin.id,
        type: 'MATERIAL',
        targetId: pin.material.id,
        title: pin.material.title,
        courseId: course?.id ?? null,
        courseName: course?.name ?? null,
        semesterId: course?.semesterId ?? null,
        semesterName: semester?.name ?? null,
        isGeneralNote: false,
        pinnedAt: pin.createdAt.toISOString(),
        materialStatus: pin.material.status,
        pageCount: pin.material.pageCount,
      });
    } else if (pin.type === 'NOTE') {
      if (!pin.note) continue;
      const course = pin.note.course;
      const semester = course?.semester;
      if (course?.archivedAt || semester?.archivedAt) continue;

      const isGeneral = !course || !course.semesterId;
      if (semesterId && !isGeneral && course?.semesterId !== semesterId) {
        continue;
      }

      items.push({
        id: pin.id,
        type: 'NOTE',
        targetId: pin.note.id,
        title: pin.note.title,
        courseId: course?.id ?? null,
        courseName: course?.name ?? null,
        semesterId: course?.semesterId ?? null,
        semesterName: semester?.name ?? null,
        isGeneralNote: isGeneral,
        pinnedAt: pin.createdAt.toISOString(),
      });
    }
  }

  return {
    items,
    total: items.length,
  };
}

<file path="apps/api/src/services/schedule.service.ts">
import { prisma, Prisma } from '@studyflow/database';
import {
  CourseSchedule,
  CourseScheduleConflict,
  CreateCourseScheduleInput,
  UpdateCourseScheduleInput,
  CourseScheduleQuery,
  CourseScheduleResponse,
  CourseScheduleListResponse,
} from '@studyflow/shared';
import { AppError } from '../middleware/errorHandler.js';

export function toCourseScheduleResponse(
  record: {
    id: string;
    userId: string;
    courseId: string;
    dayOfWeek: number;
    startTime: string;
    endTime: string;
    room: string | null;
    createdAt: Date;
    updatedAt: Date;
    course?: {
      id: string;
      name: string;
      code: string | null;
      lecturer: string | null;
      semesterId: string;
    } | null;
  },
  conflicts: CourseScheduleConflict[] = []
): CourseSchedule {
  return {
    id: record.id,
    userId: record.userId,
    courseId: record.courseId,
    dayOfWeek: record.dayOfWeek,
    startTime: record.startTime,
    endTime: record.endTime,
    room: record.room,
    createdAt: record.createdAt.toISOString(),
    updatedAt: record.updatedAt.toISOString(),
    course: record.course
      ? {
          id: record.course.id,
          name: record.course.name,
          code: record.course.code,
          lecturer: record.course.lecturer,
          semesterId: record.course.semesterId,
        }
      : undefined,
    hasConflict: conflicts.length > 0,
    conflicts: conflicts.length > 0 ? conflicts : undefined,
  };
}

/**
 * Mencari konflik waktu dalam semester yang sama dan hari yang sama milik pengguna.
 * Dua sesi bertabrakan jika: (sessionA.startTime < sessionB.endTime) && (sessionA.endTime > sessionB.startTime).
 * Sesi berdampingan (misal 09:00-10:00 dan 10:00-11:00) TIDAK bertabrakan.
 */
export async function findScheduleConflicts(
  userId: string,
  semesterId: string,
  dayOfWeek: number,
  startTime: string,
  endTime: string,
  excludeScheduleId?: string
): Promise<CourseScheduleConflict[]> {
  const candidateSchedules = await prisma.courseSchedule.findMany({
    where: {
      userId,
      dayOfWeek,
      ...(excludeScheduleId ? { id: { not: excludeScheduleId } } : {}),
      course: {
        semesterId,
        archivedAt: null, // Sesi pada mata kuliah yang diarsipkan tidak dianggap konflik aktif
      },
    },
    include: {
      course: {
        select: {
          id: true,
          name: true,
          code: true,
        },
      },
    },
  });

  const conflicts: CourseScheduleConflict[] = [];

  for (const candidate of candidateSchedules) {
    // Overlap condition: startTime < candidate.endTime && endTime > candidate.startTime
    if (startTime < candidate.endTime && endTime > candidate.startTime) {
      conflicts.push({
        id: candidate.id,
        courseId: candidate.courseId,
        courseName: candidate.course.name,
        courseCode: candidate.course.code,
        dayOfWeek: candidate.dayOfWeek,
        startTime: candidate.startTime,
        endTime: candidate.endTime,
        room: candidate.room,
      });
    }
  }

  return conflicts;
}

export async function createSchedule(
  userId: string,
  input: CreateCourseScheduleInput
): Promise<CourseScheduleResponse> {
  // 1. Verifikasi kepemilikan mata kuliah & relasi semester
  const course = await prisma.course.findFirst({
    where: { id: input.courseId, userId },
    include: { semester: true },
  });

  if (!course) {
    const error: AppError = new Error('Mata kuliah tidak ditemukan');
    error.statusCode = 404;
    error.code = 'COURSE_NOT_FOUND';
    throw error;
  }

  // 2. Cegah modifikasi pada mata kuliah atau semester yang diarsipkan
  if (course.archivedAt) {
    const error: AppError = new Error(
      'Mata kuliah telah diarsipkan. Jadwal tidak dapat ditambahkan pada mata kuliah yang diarsipkan.'
    );
    error.statusCode = 400;
    error.code = 'COURSE_ARCHIVED';
    throw error;
  }

  if (course.semester.archivedAt) {
    const error: AppError = new Error(
      'Semester telah diarsipkan. Jadwal tidak dapat ditambahkan pada semester yang diarsipkan.'
    );
    error.statusCode = 400;
    error.code = 'SEMESTER_ARCHIVED';
    throw error;
  }

  // 3. Cegah sesi identik untuk mata kuliah yang sama
  const existingIdentical = await prisma.courseSchedule.findUnique({
    where: {
      courseId_dayOfWeek_startTime_endTime: {
        courseId: input.courseId,
        dayOfWeek: input.dayOfWeek,
        startTime: input.startTime,
        endTime: input.endTime,
      },
    },
  });

  if (existingIdentical) {
    const error: AppError = new Error('Sesi jadwal yang identik sudah ada untuk mata kuliah ini');
    error.statusCode = 409;
    error.code = 'SCHEDULE_DUPLICATE';
    throw error;
  }

  // 4. Simpan sesi jadwal baru
  const created = await prisma.courseSchedule.create({
    data: {
      userId,
      courseId: input.courseId,
      dayOfWeek: input.dayOfWeek,
      startTime: input.startTime,
      endTime: input.endTime,
      room: input.room ?? null,
    },
    include: {
      course: {
        select: {
          id: true,
          name: true,
          code: true,
          lecturer: true,
          semesterId: true,
        },
      },
    },
  });

  // 5. Hitung konflik jadwal (jadwal tetap disimpan meskipun ada konflik)
  const conflicts = await findScheduleConflicts(
    userId,
    course.semesterId,
    input.dayOfWeek,
    input.startTime,
    input.endTime,
    created.id
  );

  return {
    schedule: toCourseScheduleResponse(created, conflicts),
    hasConflict: conflicts.length > 0,
    conflicts,
    message:
      conflicts.length > 0
        ? 'Jadwal berhasil disimpan, namun memiliki benturan waktu dengan jadwal lain.'
        : 'Jadwal berhasil disimpan',
  };
}

export async function listSchedules(
  userId: string,
  query: CourseScheduleQuery
): Promise<CourseScheduleListResponse> {
  const where: Prisma.CourseScheduleWhereInput = {
    userId,
    ...(query.courseId ? { courseId: query.courseId } : {}),
    ...(query.dayOfWeek ? { dayOfWeek: query.dayOfWeek } : {}),
    ...(query.semesterId ? { course: { semesterId: query.semesterId } } : {}),
  };

  const records = await prisma.courseSchedule.findMany({
    where,
    orderBy: [
      { dayOfWeek: 'asc' },
      { startTime: 'asc' },
    ],
    include: {
      course: {
        select: {
          id: true,
          name: true,
          code: true,
          lecturer: true,
          semesterId: true,
        },
      },
    },
  });

  // Hitung konflik untuk setiap jadwal terhadap jadwal lain milik pengguna dalam semester yang sama
  const schedulesWithConflicts: CourseSchedule[] = await Promise.all(
    records.map(async (rec) => {
      const conflicts = await findScheduleConflicts(
        userId,
        rec.course.semesterId,
        rec.dayOfWeek,
        rec.startTime,
        rec.endTime,
        rec.id
      );
      return toCourseScheduleResponse(rec, conflicts);
    })
  );

  return {
    schedules: schedulesWithConflicts,
    total: schedulesWithConflicts.length,
  };
}

export async function getScheduleById(
  userId: string,
  scheduleId: string
): Promise<CourseScheduleResponse> {
  const record = await prisma.courseSchedule.findFirst({
    where: { id: scheduleId, userId },
    include: {
      course: {
        select: {
          id: true,
          name: true,
          code: true,
          lecturer: true,
          semesterId: true,
        },
      },
    },
  });

  if (!record) {
    const error: AppError = new Error('Sesi jadwal tidak ditemukan');
    error.statusCode = 404;
    error.code = 'NOT_FOUND';
    throw error;
  }

  const conflicts = await findScheduleConflicts(
    userId,
    record.course.semesterId,
    record.dayOfWeek,
    record.startTime,
    record.endTime,
    record.id
  );

  return {
    schedule: toCourseScheduleResponse(record, conflicts),
    hasConflict: conflicts.length > 0,
    conflicts,
  };
}

export async function updateSchedule(
  userId: string,
  scheduleId: string,
  input: UpdateCourseScheduleInput
): Promise<CourseScheduleResponse> {
  const existing = await prisma.courseSchedule.findFirst({
    where: { id: scheduleId, userId },
    include: {
      course: {
        include: { semester: true },
      },
    },
  });

  if (!existing) {
    const error: AppError = new Error('Sesi jadwal tidak ditemukan');
    error.statusCode = 404;
    error.code = 'NOT_FOUND';
    throw error;
  }

  if (existing.course.archivedAt) {
    const error: AppError = new Error(
      'Mata kuliah telah diarsipkan. Jadwal pada mata kuliah yang diarsipkan tidak dapat diubah.'
    );
    error.statusCode = 400;
    error.code = 'COURSE_ARCHIVED';
    throw error;
  }

  if (existing.course.semester.archivedAt) {
    const error: AppError = new Error(
      'Semester telah diarsipkan. Jadwal pada semester yang diarsipkan tidak dapat diubah.'
    );
    error.statusCode = 400;
    error.code = 'SEMESTER_ARCHIVED';
    throw error;
  }

  const targetDay = input.dayOfWeek ?? existing.dayOfWeek;
  const targetStartTime = input.startTime ?? existing.startTime;
  const targetEndTime = input.endTime ?? existing.endTime;
  const targetRoom = input.room !== undefined ? input.room : existing.room;

  // Validasi waktu jika salah satu atau keduanya berubah
  if (targetStartTime === targetEndTime) {
    const error: AppError = new Error('Waktu selesai harus lebih besar daripada waktu mulai');
    error.statusCode = 400;
    error.code = 'VALIDATION_ERROR';
    throw error;
  }

  if (targetStartTime > targetEndTime) {
    const error: AppError = new Error(
      'Sesi jadwal lintas tengah malam belum didukung. Harap tentukan waktu mulai dan selesai dalam hari yang sama.'
    );
    error.statusCode = 400;
    error.code = 'VALIDATION_ERROR';
    throw error;
  }

  // Cek duplikasi identik terhadap sesi lain di mata kuliah yang sama
  if (
    targetDay !== existing.dayOfWeek ||
    targetStartTime !== existing.startTime ||
    targetEndTime !== existing.endTime
  ) {
    const duplicate = await prisma.courseSchedule.findFirst({
      where: {
        courseId: existing.courseId,
        dayOfWeek: targetDay,
        startTime: targetStartTime,
        endTime: targetEndTime,
        id: { not: scheduleId },
      },
    });

    if (duplicate) {
      const error: AppError = new Error('Sesi jadwal yang identik sudah ada untuk mata kuliah ini');
      error.statusCode = 409;
      error.code = 'SCHEDULE_DUPLICATE';
      throw error;
    }
  }

  const updated = await prisma.courseSchedule.update({
    where: { id: scheduleId },
    data: {
      dayOfWeek: targetDay,
      startTime: targetStartTime,
      endTime: targetEndTime,
      room: targetRoom,
    },
    include: {
      course: {
        select: {
          id: true,
          name: true,
          code: true,
          lecturer: true,
          semesterId: true,
        },
      },
    },
  });

  const conflicts = await findScheduleConflicts(
    userId,
    existing.course.semesterId,
    targetDay,
    targetStartTime,
    targetEndTime,
    scheduleId
  );

  return {
    schedule: toCourseScheduleResponse(updated, conflicts),
    hasConflict: conflicts.length > 0,
    conflicts,
    message:
      conflicts.length > 0
        ? 'Jadwal berhasil diperbarui, namun memiliki benturan waktu dengan jadwal lain.'
        : 'Jadwal berhasil diperbarui',
  };
}

export async function deleteSchedule(
  userId: string,
  scheduleId: string
): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
  const existing = await prisma.courseSchedule.findFirst({
    where: { id: scheduleId, userId },
    include: {
      course: {
        include: { semester: true },
      },
    },
  });

  if (!existing) {
    const error: AppError = new Error('Sesi jadwal tidak ditemukan');
    error.statusCode = 404;
    error.code = 'NOT_FOUND';
    throw error;
  }

  if (existing.course.archivedAt) {
    const error: AppError = new Error(
      'Mata kuliah telah diarsipkan. Jadwal pada mata kuliah yang diarsipkan tidak dapat dihapus.'
    );
    error.statusCode = 400;
    error.code = 'COURSE_ARCHIVED';
    throw error;
  }

  if (existing.course.semester.archivedAt) {
    const error: AppError = new Error(
      'Semester telah diarsipkan. Jadwal pada semester yang diarsipkan tidak dapat dihapus.'
    );
    error.statusCode = 400;
    error.code = 'SEMESTER_ARCHIVED';
    throw error;
  }

  await prisma.courseSchedule.delete({
    where: { id: scheduleId },
  });

  return {
    success: true,
    message: 'Sesi jadwal berhasil dihapus',
  };
}

<file path="apps/api/src/services/search.service.ts">
import { prisma, Prisma } from '@studyflow/database';
import {
  SearchQuery,
  SearchResponse,
  SearchResultItem,
} from '@studyflow/shared';
import { AppError } from '../middleware/errorHandler.js';

function getRank(
  title: string,
  secondary: string | null | undefined,
  queryLower: string
): number {
  const t = title.toLowerCase();
  const s = secondary ? secondary.toLowerCase() : '';

  // 1. Kecocokan persis
  if (t === queryLower || s === queryLower) return 1;
  // 2. Awalan (prefix)
  if (t.startsWith(queryLower) || (s && s.startsWith(queryLower))) return 2;
  // 3. Kecocokan sebagian
  return 3;
}

function sortSearchResults<T extends { id: string; title: string; secondary?: string | null }>(
  items: T[],
  queryLower: string
): T[] {
  return items.sort((a, b) => {
    const rankA = getRank(a.title, a.secondary, queryLower);
    const rankB = getRank(b.title, b.secondary, queryLower);
    if (rankA !== rankB) return rankA - rankB;

    const cmpTitle = a.title.localeCompare(b.title);
    if (cmpTitle !== 0) return cmpTitle;

    return a.id.localeCompare(b.id);
  });
}

export async function searchGlobal(
  userId: string,
  query: SearchQuery
): Promise<SearchResponse> {
  const trimmedQuery = query.q.trim();
  if (trimmedQuery.length < 2) {
    const error: AppError = new Error('Kata kunci pencarian minimal 2 karakter');
    error.statusCode = 400;
    error.code = 'VALIDATION_ERROR';
    throw error;
  }

  if (trimmedQuery.length > 100) {
    const error: AppError = new Error('Kata kunci pencarian maksimal 100 karakter');
    error.statusCode = 400;
    error.code = 'VALIDATION_ERROR';
    throw error;
  }

  const queryLower = trimmedQuery.toLowerCase();
  const limitPerCategory = query.limit || 5;

  // 1. Resolusi cakupan semester
  let semesterScope: { id: string; name: string; isActive?: boolean };

  if (query.semesterId === 'all') {
    semesterScope = { id: 'all', name: 'Semua Semester' };
  } else if (query.semesterId) {
    const semester = await prisma.semester.findFirst({
      where: { id: query.semesterId, userId },
    });
    if (!semester) {
      const error: AppError = new Error('Semester tidak ditemukan');
      error.statusCode = 404;
      error.code = 'SEMESTER_NOT_FOUND';
      throw error;
    }
    if (semester.archivedAt) {
      const error: AppError = new Error('Semester telah diarsipkan');
      error.statusCode = 400;
      error.code = 'SEMESTER_ARCHIVED';
      throw error;
    }
    semesterScope = {
      id: semester.id,
      name: semester.name,
      isActive: semester.isActive,
    };
  } else {
    // Default: semester aktif milik pengguna
    const activeSemester = await prisma.semester.findFirst({
      where: { userId, isActive: true },
    });
    if (activeSemester) {
      semesterScope = {
        id: activeSemester.id,
        name: activeSemester.name,
        isActive: true,
      };
    } else {
      // Jika tidak ada yang aktif, cari yang terbaru yang tidak diarsipkan
      const latestSemester = await prisma.semester.findFirst({
        where: { userId, archivedAt: null },
        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
      });
      if (latestSemester) {
        semesterScope = {
          id: latestSemester.id,
          name: latestSemester.name,
          isActive: false,
        };
      } else {
        semesterScope = { id: 'all', name: 'Semua Semester' };
      }
    }
  }

  const isAllSemesters = semesterScope.id === 'all';

  // 2. Query Courses (Mata Kuliah)
  const courseWhere: Prisma.CourseWhereInput = {
    userId,
    archivedAt: null,
    ...(isAllSemesters
      ? { semester: { archivedAt: null } }
      : { semesterId: semesterScope.id }),
    OR: [
      { name: { contains: trimmedQuery, mode: 'insensitive' } },
      { code: { contains: trimmedQuery, mode: 'insensitive' } },
    ],
  };

  const [coursesRaw, courseCount] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.course.findMany({
      where: courseWhere,
      select: {
        id: true,
        name: true,
        code: true,
        semesterId: true,
        semester: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
          },
        },
      },
      take: limitPerCategory * 2,
    }),
    prisma.course.count({ where: courseWhere }),
  ]);

  const sortedCourses = sortSearchResults(
    coursesRaw.map((c) => ({
      id: c.id,
      title: c.name,
      secondary: c.code,
      raw: c,
    })),
    queryLower
  ).slice(0, limitPerCategory);

  const courseResults: SearchResultItem[] = sortedCourses.map(({ raw }) => ({
    id: raw.id,
    type: 'COURSE',
    title: raw.name,
    subtitle: raw.code
      ? `${raw.code} • ${raw.semester.name}`
      : raw.semester.name,
    courseId: raw.id,
    courseName: raw.name,
    semesterId: raw.semesterId,
    semesterName: raw.semester.name,
    url: `/courses/${raw.id}`,
    metadata: {
      code: raw.code,
    },
  }));

  // 3. Query Materials (Materi)
  const materialWhere: Prisma.MaterialWhereInput = {
    userId,
    deletedAt: null,
    course: {
      archivedAt: null,
      ...(isAllSemesters
        ? { semester: { archivedAt: null } }
        : { semesterId: semesterScope.id }),
    },
    title: { contains: trimmedQuery, mode: 'insensitive' },
  };

  const [materialsRaw, materialCount] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.material.findMany({
      where: materialWhere,
      select: {
        id: true,
        title: true,
        courseId: true,
        course: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
            semesterId: true,
            semester: {
              select: {
                id: true,
                name: true,
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
      take: limitPerCategory * 2,
    }),
    prisma.material.count({ where: materialWhere }),
  ]);

  const sortedMaterials = sortSearchResults(
    materialsRaw.map((m) => ({
      id: m.id,
      title: m.title,
      secondary: null,
      raw: m,
    })),
    queryLower
  ).slice(0, limitPerCategory);

  const materialResults: SearchResultItem[] = sortedMaterials.map(({ raw }) => ({
    id: raw.id,
    type: 'MATERIAL',
    title: raw.title,
    subtitle: `${raw.course.name} • ${raw.course.semester.name}`,
    courseId: raw.courseId,
    courseName: raw.course.name,
    semesterId: raw.course.semesterId,
    semesterName: raw.course.semester.name,
    url: `/materials/${raw.id}`,
    metadata: {
      code: raw.course.code,
    },
  }));

  // 4. Query Assignments (Tugas)
  const assignmentWhere: Prisma.AssignmentWhereInput = {
    userId,
    course: {
      archivedAt: null,
      ...(isAllSemesters
        ? { semester: { archivedAt: null } }
        : { semesterId: semesterScope.id }),
    },
    title: { contains: trimmedQuery, mode: 'insensitive' },
  };

  const [assignmentsRaw, assignmentCount] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.assignment.findMany({
      where: assignmentWhere,
      select: {
        id: true,
        title: true,
        dueDate: true,
        priority: true,
        status: true,
        courseId: true,
        course: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
            semesterId: true,
            semester: {
              select: {
                id: true,
                name: true,
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
      take: limitPerCategory * 2,
    }),
    prisma.assignment.count({ where: assignmentWhere }),
  ]);

  const now = Date.now();
  const sortedAssignments = sortSearchResults(
    assignmentsRaw.map((a) => ({
      id: a.id,
      title: a.title,
      secondary: null,
      raw: a,
    })),
    queryLower
  ).slice(0, limitPerCategory);

  const assignmentResults: SearchResultItem[] = sortedAssignments.map(({ raw }) => {
    const isOverdue = raw.status !== 'DONE' && raw.dueDate.getTime() < now;
    return {
      id: raw.id,
      type: 'ASSIGNMENT',
      title: raw.title,
      subtitle: `${raw.course.name} • ${raw.course.semester.name}`,
      courseId: raw.courseId,
      courseName: raw.course.name,
      semesterId: raw.course.semesterId,
      semesterName: raw.course.semester.name,
      url: `/assignments?courseId=${raw.courseId}`,
      metadata: {
        code: raw.course.code,
        dueDate: raw.dueDate.toISOString(),
        priority: raw.priority,
        status: raw.status,
        isOverdue,
      },
    };
  });

  // 5. Query Notes (Catatan) - Mencari HANYA title tanpa mengambil content
  const noteWhere: Prisma.NoteWhereInput = {
    userId,
    course: {
      archivedAt: null,
      ...(isAllSemesters
        ? { semester: { archivedAt: null } }
        : { semesterId: semesterScope.id }),
    },
    title: { contains: trimmedQuery, mode: 'insensitive' },
  };

  const [notesRaw, noteCount] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.note.findMany({
      where: noteWhere,
      select: {
        id: true,
        title: true,
        courseId: true,
        course: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
            semesterId: true,
            semester: {
              select: {
                id: true,
                name: true,
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
      take: limitPerCategory * 2,
    }),
    prisma.note.count({ where: noteWhere }),
  ]);

  const sortedNotes = sortSearchResults(
    notesRaw.map((n) => ({
      id: n.id,
      title: n.title,
      secondary: null,
      raw: n,
    })),
    queryLower
  ).slice(0, limitPerCategory);

  const noteResults: SearchResultItem[] = sortedNotes.map(({ raw }) => ({
    id: raw.id,
    type: 'NOTE',
    title: raw.title,
    subtitle: `${raw.course.name} • ${raw.course.semester.name}`,
    courseId: raw.courseId,
    courseName: raw.course.name,
    semesterId: raw.course.semesterId,
    semesterName: raw.course.semester.name,
    url: `/notes/${raw.id}`,
    metadata: {
      code: raw.course.code,
    },
  }));

  const totalCount =
    courseResults.length +
    materialResults.length +
    assignmentResults.length +
    noteResults.length;

  return {
    query: trimmedQuery,
    semesterScope,
    results: {
      courses: courseResults,
      materials: materialResults,
      assignments: assignmentResults,
      notes: noteResults,
    },
    totalCount,
    hasMore: {
      courses: courseCount > courseResults.length,
      materials: materialCount > materialResults.length,
      assignments: assignmentCount > assignmentResults.length,
      notes: noteCount > noteResults.length,
    },
    limitPerCategory,
  };
}

<file path="apps/api/src/services/subtask.service.ts">
import { prisma } from '@studyflow/database';
import {
  AssignmentSubtask,
  CreateSubtaskInput,
  UpdateSubtaskInput,
} from '@studyflow/shared';
import { AppError } from '../middleware/errorHandler.js';

function toSubtaskResponse(raw: {
  id: string;
  assignmentId: string;
  title: string;
  isCompleted: boolean;
  order: number;
  createdAt: Date;
  updatedAt: Date;
}): AssignmentSubtask {
  return {
    id: raw.id,
    assignmentId: raw.assignmentId,
    title: raw.title,
    completed: raw.isCompleted,
    order: raw.order,
    createdAt: raw.createdAt.toISOString(),
    updatedAt: raw.updatedAt.toISOString(),
  };
}

export async function getSubtasks(
  userId: string,
  assignmentId: string
): Promise<AssignmentSubtask[]> {
  const assignment = await prisma.assignment.findFirst({
    where: { id: assignmentId, userId },
  });

  if (!assignment) {
    const error: AppError = new Error('Tugas tidak ditemukan');
    error.statusCode = 404;
    error.code = 'NOT_FOUND';
    throw error;
  }

  const subtasks = await prisma.assignmentSubtask.findMany({
    where: { assignmentId },
    orderBy: [
      { order: 'asc' },
      { createdAt: 'asc' },
      { id: 'asc' },
    ],
  });

  return subtasks.map(toSubtaskResponse);
}

export async function createSubtask(
  userId: string,
  assignmentId: string,
  input: CreateSubtaskInput
): Promise<AssignmentSubtask> {
  const trimmedTitle = input.title?.trim();
  if (!trimmedTitle || trimmedTitle.length < 1) {
    const error: AppError = new Error('Judul subtugas wajib diisi');
    error.statusCode = 400;
    error.code = 'VALIDATION_ERROR';
    throw error;
  }
  if (trimmedTitle.length > 200) {
    const error: AppError = new Error('Judul subtugas maksimal 200 karakter');
    error.statusCode = 400;
    error.code = 'VALIDATION_ERROR';
    throw error;
  }

  return await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    // 1. Lock the parent assignment row to serialize concurrent writes and prevent exceeding 50 items
    const rows = await tx.$queryRaw<
      Array<{ id: string; user_id: string; status: string; course_id: string }>
    >`SELECT id, user_id, status, course_id FROM assignments WHERE id = ${assignmentId} FOR UPDATE`;

    const assignmentRow = rows[0];
    if (!assignmentRow || assignmentRow.user_id !== userId) {
      const error: AppError = new Error('Tugas tidak ditemukan');
      error.statusCode = 404;
      error.code = 'NOT_FOUND';
      throw error;
    }

    // 2. Completed parent task invariant: read-only
    if (assignmentRow.status === 'DONE') {
      const error: AppError = new Error(
        'Tugas telah selesai. Buka kembali tugas untuk mengedit subtugas.'
      );
      error.statusCode = 400;
      error.code = 'ASSIGNMENT_COMPLETED';
      throw error;
    }

    // 3. Archived Course/Semester invariant
    const course = await tx.course.findFirst({
      where: { id: assignmentRow.course_id },
      include: { semester: true },
    });

    if (!course) {
      const error: AppError = new Error('Mata kuliah tidak ditemukan');
      error.statusCode = 404;
      error.code = 'COURSE_NOT_FOUND';
      throw error;
    }

    if (course.archivedAt !== null) {
      const error: AppError = new Error(
        'Tugas pada mata kuliah yang diarsipkan bersifat hanya-baca.'
      );
      error.statusCode = 400;
      error.code = 'COURSE_ARCHIVED';
      throw error;
    }

    if (course.semester.archivedAt !== null) {
      const error: AppError = new Error(
        'Tugas pada semester yang diarsipkan bersifat hanya-baca.'
      );
      error.statusCode = 400;
      error.code = 'SEMESTER_ARCHIVED';
      throw error;
    }

    // 4. Max 50 subtasks per assignment limit
    const count = await tx.assignmentSubtask.count({
      where: { assignmentId },
    });

    if (count >= 50) {
      const error: AppError = new Error(
        'Batas maksimal subtugas per tugas adalah 50 subtugas'
      );
      error.statusCode = 400;
      error.code = 'SUBTASK_LIMIT_EXCEEDED';
      throw error;
    }

    // 5. Stable order calculation
    const lastSubtask = await tx.assignmentSubtask.findFirst({
      where: { assignmentId },
      orderBy: { order: 'desc' },
      select: { order: true },
    });
    const nextOrder = (lastSubtask?.order ?? -1) + 1;

    // 6. Create subtask
    const created = await tx.assignmentSubtask.create({
      data: {
        assignmentId,
        title: trimmedTitle,
        order: nextOrder,
        isCompleted: false,
      },
    });

    return toSubtaskResponse(created);
  });
}

export async function updateSubtask(
  userId: string,
  assignmentId: string,
  subtaskId: string,
  input: UpdateSubtaskInput
): Promise<AssignmentSubtask> {
  const trimmedTitle = input.title !== undefined ? input.title.trim() : undefined;
  if (trimmedTitle !== undefined) {
    if (trimmedTitle.length < 1) {
      const error: AppError = new Error('Judul subtugas wajib diisi');
      error.statusCode = 400;
      error.code = 'VALIDATION_ERROR';
      throw error;
    }
    if (trimmedTitle.length > 200) {
      const error: AppError = new Error('Judul subtugas maksimal 200 karakter');
      error.statusCode = 400;
      error.code = 'VALIDATION_ERROR';
      throw error;
    }
  }

  return await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    // 1. Lock the parent assignment
    const rows = await tx.$queryRaw<
      Array<{ id: string; user_id: string; status: string; course_id: string }>
    >`SELECT id, user_id, status, course_id FROM assignments WHERE id = ${assignmentId} FOR UPDATE`;

    const assignmentRow = rows[0];
    if (!assignmentRow || assignmentRow.user_id !== userId) {
      const error: AppError = new Error('Tugas tidak ditemukan');
      error.statusCode = 404;
      error.code = 'NOT_FOUND';
      throw error;
    }

    // 2. Reject mutation if assignment is DONE
    if (assignmentRow.status === 'DONE') {
      const error: AppError = new Error(
        'Tugas telah selesai. Buka kembali tugas untuk mengedit subtugas.'
      );
      error.statusCode = 400;
      error.code = 'ASSIGNMENT_COMPLETED';
      throw error;
    }

    // 3. Archived Course/Semester invariant
    const course = await tx.course.findFirst({
      where: { id: assignmentRow.course_id },
      include: { semester: true },
    });

    if (!course || course.archivedAt !== null) {
      const error: AppError = new Error(
        'Tugas pada mata kuliah yang diarsipkan bersifat hanya-baca.'
      );
      error.statusCode = 400;
      error.code = 'COURSE_ARCHIVED';
      throw error;
    }

    if (course.semester.archivedAt !== null) {
      const error: AppError = new Error(
        'Tugas pada semester yang diarsipkan bersifat hanya-baca.'
      );
      error.statusCode = 400;
      error.code = 'SEMESTER_ARCHIVED';
      throw error;
    }

    // 4. Verify subtask belongs to this assignment
    const existing = await tx.assignmentSubtask.findFirst({
      where: { id: subtaskId, assignmentId },
    });

    if (!existing) {
      const error: AppError = new Error('Subtugas tidak ditemukan');
      error.statusCode = 404;
      error.code = 'NOT_FOUND';
      throw error;
    }

    const data: { title?: string; isCompleted?: boolean } = {};
    if (trimmedTitle !== undefined) {
      data.title = trimmedTitle;
    }
    if (input.completed !== undefined) {
      data.isCompleted = input.completed;
    }

    const updated = await tx.assignmentSubtask.update({
      where: { id: subtaskId },
      data,
    });

    return toSubtaskResponse(updated);
  });
}

export async function deleteSubtask(
  userId: string,
  assignmentId: string,
  subtaskId: string
): Promise<void> {
  await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    // 1. Lock parent assignment
    const rows = await tx.$queryRaw<
      Array<{ id: string; user_id: string; status: string; course_id: string }>
    >`SELECT id, user_id, status, course_id FROM assignments WHERE id = ${assignmentId} FOR UPDATE`;

    const assignmentRow = rows[0];
    if (!assignmentRow || assignmentRow.user_id !== userId) {
      const error: AppError = new Error('Tugas tidak ditemukan');
      error.statusCode = 404;
      error.code = 'NOT_FOUND';
      throw error;
    }

    // 2. Reject deletion if assignment is DONE
    if (assignmentRow.status === 'DONE') {
      const error: AppError = new Error(
        'Tugas telah selesai. Buka kembali tugas untuk mengedit subtugas.'
      );
      error.statusCode = 400;
      error.code = 'ASSIGNMENT_COMPLETED';
      throw error;
    }

    // 3. Archived checks
    const course = await tx.course.findFirst({
      where: { id: assignmentRow.course_id },
      include: { semester: true },
    });

    if (!course || course.archivedAt !== null) {
      const error: AppError = new Error(
        'Tugas pada mata kuliah yang diarsipkan bersifat hanya-baca.'
      );
      error.statusCode = 400;
      error.code = 'COURSE_ARCHIVED';
      throw error;
    }

    if (course.semester.archivedAt !== null) {
      const error: AppError = new Error(
        'Tugas pada semester yang diarsipkan bersifat hanya-baca.'
      );
      error.statusCode = 400;
      error.code = 'SEMESTER_ARCHIVED';
      throw error;
    }

    // 4. Verify subtask belongs to this assignment
    const existing = await tx.assignmentSubtask.findFirst({
      where: { id: subtaskId, assignmentId },
    });

    if (!existing) {
      const error: AppError = new Error('Subtugas tidak ditemukan');
      error.statusCode = 404;
      error.code = 'NOT_FOUND';
      throw error;
    }

    await tx.assignmentSubtask.delete({
      where: { id: subtaskId },
    });
  });
}
