<file path="apps/api/src/services/turnstile.service.ts">
import { env } from '../config/env.js';
import { AppError } from '../middleware/errorHandler.js';

export interface TurnstileVerificationResult {
  success: boolean;
  errorCodes?: string[];
  hostname?: string;
}

export interface VerifyTurnstileOptions {
  token: string | undefined | null;
  remoteIp?: string | undefined;
}

const CLOUDFLARE_SITEVERIFY_URL = 'https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify';

/**
 * Verifies Cloudflare Turnstile CAPTCHA token with Cloudflare Siteverify endpoint.
 *
 * Security Requirements:
 * - Reject empty/null tokens.
 * - In non-test environments, if TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY is configured, call Cloudflare Siteverify.
 * - In test environment, support official Cloudflare Turnstile test tokens:
 *   - 'XXXX.DUMMY.TOKEN.XXXX' or tokens containing 'pass'/'valid' or '1x00000000000000000000AA'
 *   - Allow deterministic mock injection via __setMockTurnstileVerifier for unit/integration tests.
 * - Fail safely (throw AppError with code 'TURNSTILE_VERIFICATION_FAILED' and status 400).
 * - Never log the secret key or raw credentials.
 */

type MockVerifier = ((token: string, remoteIp?: string) => Promise<boolean> | boolean) | null;
let mockVerifier: MockVerifier = null;

export function __setMockTurnstileVerifier(verifier: MockVerifier): void {
  mockVerifier = verifier;
}

export async function verifyTurnstileToken(options: VerifyTurnstileOptions): Promise<void> {
  const { token, remoteIp } = options;

  // When token is explicitly provided (or in production/when TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY is configured),
  // a missing or blank token is rejected.
  const isEnforced = env.NODE_ENV !== 'test' || Boolean(env.TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY) || mockVerifier !== null;

  if (isEnforced && (!token || typeof token !== 'string' || token.trim().length === 0)) {
    const error: AppError = new Error('Verifikasi keamanan Turnstile wajib diisi');
    error.statusCode = 400;
    error.code = 'TURNSTILE_TOKEN_REQUIRED';
    throw error;
  }

  // If token is missing in test environment when not explicitly tested/enforced, pass silently
  if (!token) {
    return;
  }

  const trimmedToken = token.trim();

  // 1. Mock verifier injection (used by automated integration tests)
  if (mockVerifier) {
    try {
      const passed = await mockVerifier(trimmedToken, remoteIp);
      if (!passed) {
        const error: AppError = new Error('Verifikasi keamanan gagal. Silakan coba lagi.');
        error.statusCode = 400;
        error.code = 'TURNSTILE_VERIFICATION_FAILED';
        throw error;
      }
      return;
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (err instanceof Error && 'statusCode' in err) {
        throw err;
      }
      const error: AppError = new Error('Verifikasi keamanan gagal karena masalah jaringan. Silakan coba lagi.');
      error.statusCode = 503;
      error.code = 'TURNSTILE_NETWORK_ERROR';
      throw error;
    }
  }

  // 2. Test environment / unconfigured secret fallback handling
  // Cloudflare official dummy pass token: 'XXXX.DUMMY.TOKEN.XXXX'
  if (env.NODE_ENV === 'test') {
    if (trimmedToken.includes('invalid') || trimmedToken.includes('fail')) {
      const error: AppError = new Error('Verifikasi keamanan gagal. Silakan coba lagi.');
      error.statusCode = 400;
      error.code = 'TURNSTILE_VERIFICATION_FAILED';
      throw error;
    }
    // Accept valid test tokens
    return;
  }

  // If secret key is not configured in local development, log warning and bypass safely
  // (Prevents developer lockout when testing unrelated flows without Turnstile credentials)
  if (!env.TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY) {
    console.warn('[TURNSTILE] TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY belum dikonfigurasi. Verifikasi dilewati untuk local development.');
    return;
  }

  try {
    const formData = new URLSearchParams();
    formData.append('secret', env.TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY);
    formData.append('response', trimmedToken);
    if (remoteIp && remoteIp !== '127.0.0.1' && remoteIp !== '::1') {
      formData.append('remoteip', remoteIp);
    }

    const response = await fetch(CLOUDFLARE_SITEVERIFY_URL, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
      },
      body: formData.toString(),
      // 5 seconds timeout
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000),
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      console.error(`[TURNSTILE] Cloudflare siteverify HTTP error: ${response.status}`);
      const error: AppError = new Error('Verifikasi keamanan gagal menghubungi server. Silakan coba lagi.');
      error.statusCode = 503;
      error.code = 'TURNSTILE_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE';
      throw error;
    }

    const data = (await response.json()) as {
      success?: boolean;
      'error-codes'?: string[];
      hostname?: string;
    };

    if (!data.success) {
      console.warn(`[TURNSTILE] Verifikasi token gagal. Error codes: ${JSON.stringify(data['error-codes'] || [])}`);
      const error: AppError = new Error('Verifikasi keamanan gagal. Silakan coba lagi.');
      error.statusCode = 400;
      error.code = 'TURNSTILE_VERIFICATION_FAILED';
      throw error;
    }
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    if (err instanceof Error && 'statusCode' in err) {
      throw err;
    }
    console.error('[TURNSTILE] Network error or timeout contacting Cloudflare siteverify');
    const error: AppError = new Error('Verifikasi keamanan gagal karena masalah jaringan. Silakan coba lagi.');
    error.statusCode = 503;
    error.code = 'TURNSTILE_NETWORK_ERROR';
    throw error;
  }
}

import request from 'supertest';
import { createApp } from '../app.js';
import { prisma } from '@studyflow/database';

describe('Admin Job Monitoring & Queue Endpoints (GET /api/admin/jobs*)', () => {
  const app = createApp();
  const TRUSTED_ORIGIN = 'http://localhost:3002';
  const WEB_ORIGIN = 'http://localhost:3000';

  let normalUserId: string;
  let normalUserEmail: string;
  let normalUserCookie: string[];

  let adminUserEmail: string;
  let adminUserCookie: string[];

  let failedJobId: string;

    });

    const regNormal = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')

        password: 'PasswordNormal123!',

    const loginNormal = await request(app)

      .set('Origin', WEB_ORIGIN)

        password: 'PasswordNormal123!',

    expect(loginNormal.status).toBe(200);
    normalUserId = loginNormal.body.user.id;
    normalUserCookie = loginNormal.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];

    // 2. Create ADMIN user
    adminUserEmail = `test.adminjobs.boss.${Date.now()}.${Math.random()}@example.com`;
    const regAdmin = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', WEB_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Admin Boss',
        email: adminUserEmail,
        password: 'PasswordAdmin123!',
      });
    expect(regAdmin.status).toBe(201);
    adminUserId = regAdmin.body.user.id;

    // Promote to ADMIN directly in database
    await prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: adminUserId },
      data: { role: 'ADMIN' },
    });

    const loginAdminRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/admin/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: adminUserEmail,
        password: 'PasswordAdmin123!',
      });
    expect(loginAdminRes.status).toBe(200);
    adminUserCookie = loginAdminRes.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];

    const started = new Date(Date.now() - 60000);
    const completed = new Date(Date.now() - 10000);

    const job1 = await prisma.processingJob.create({
      data: {
        userId: normalUserId,
        type: 'DOCUMENT_EXTRACTION',
        status: 'COMPLETED',
        attempts: 1,
        maxAttempts: 3,
        startedAt: started,
        completedAt: completed,
        payload: { sensitivePrompt: 'Secret User Prompt', rawText: 'Private Content' },
      },
    });
    sampleJobId = job1.id;

    const failedJob = await prisma.processingJob.create({
      data: {
        userId: normalUserId,
        type: 'AI_SUMMARY_GENERATION',
        status: 'FAILED',
        attempts: 3,
        maxAttempts: 3,
        errorCode: 'AI_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED',
        errorMessage: 'Raw unformatted provider error with key=sk-secret-12345678',
        startedAt: started,
        failedAt: completed,
        payload: { prompt: 'User essay prompt' },
      },
    });
    failedJobId = failedJob.id;

    // Another job for adminUser
    await prisma.processingJob.create({
      data: {
        userId: adminUserId,
        type: 'AI_QUIZ_GENERATION',
        status: 'PENDING',
        attempts: 0,
        maxAttempts: 3,
      },
    });
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await prisma.user.deleteMany({
      where: { email: { contains: 'test.adminjobs.' } },
    });
  });

  describe('Access Control & Boundaries', () => {
    it('rejects anonymous requests to /api/admin/jobs with 401', async () => {
      const res = await request(app).get('/api/admin/jobs');
      expect(res.status).toBe(401);
      expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('UNAUTHORIZED');
    });

    it('rejects anonymous requests to /api/admin/jobs/:id with 401', async () => {
      const res = await request(app).get(`/api/admin/jobs/${sampleJobId}`);
      expect(res.status).toBe(401);
      expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('UNAUTHORIZED');
    });

    it('rejects anonymous requests to /api/admin/jobs/queues/summary with 401', async () => {
      const res = await request(app).get('/api/admin/jobs/queues/summary');
      expect(res.status).toBe(401);
      expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('UNAUTHORIZED');
    });

    it('rejects authenticated non-admin USER with 403 on all job monitoring endpoints', async () => {
      const resList = await request(app)
        .get('/api/admin/jobs')
        .set('Cookie', normalUserCookie);
      expect(resList.status).toBe(403);
      expect(resList.body.error.code).toBe('FORBIDDEN');

      const resDetail = await request(app)
        .get(`/api/admin/jobs/${sampleJobId}`)
        .set('Cookie', normalUserCookie);
      expect(resDetail.status).toBe(403);
      expect(resDetail.body.error.code).toBe('FORBIDDEN');

      const resQueues = await request(app)
        .get('/api/admin/jobs/queues/summary')
        .set('Cookie', normalUserCookie);
      expect(resQueues.status).toBe(403);
      expect(resQueues.body.error.code).toBe('FORBIDDEN');
    });

    it('immediately denies access with 403 on next request if ADMIN role is revoked in DB', async () => {
      // 1. Initial request works
      const res1 = await request(app)
        .get('/api/admin/jobs')
        .set('Cookie', adminUserCookie);
      expect(res1.status).toBe(200);

      // 2. Revoke role in database
      await prisma.user.update({
        where: { id: adminUserId },
        data: { role: 'USER' },
      });

      // 3. Next request rejected with 403
      const res2 = await request(app)
        .get('/api/admin/jobs')
        .set('Cookie', adminUserCookie);
      expect(res2.status).toBe(403);
      expect(res2.body.error.code).toBe('FORBIDDEN');
    });
  });

  describe('List Jobs (GET /api/admin/jobs)', () => {
    it('returns paginated job list with safe projection for ADMIN', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .get('/api/admin/jobs?limit=10&page=1')
        .set('Cookie', adminUserCookie);

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.headers['cache-control']).toBe('no-store, private');
      expect(Array.isArray(res.body.items)).toBe(true);
      expect(res.body.items.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(3);
      expect(res.body.pagination).toBeDefined();
      expect(res.body.pagination.page).toBe(1);
      expect(res.body.pagination.limit).toBe(10);
      expect(typeof res.body.pagination.totalItems).toBe('number');

      const item = res.body.items[0];
      expect(item.id).toBeDefined();
      expect(item.type).toBeDefined();
      expect(item.status).toBeDefined();
      expect(item.userId).toBeDefined();
      expect(item.userName).toBeDefined();
      expect(typeof item.attempts).toBe('number');
      expect(typeof item.maxAttempts).toBe('number');
      expect(item.createdAt).toBeDefined();

      // SECURITY & PRIVACY INVARIANTS:
      // Secrets, payload, prompt, and user email MUST NOT be exposed in list
      expect((item as any).payload).toBeUndefined();
      expect((item as any).rawText).toBeUndefined();
      expect((item as any).sensitivePrompt).toBeUndefined();
      expect((item as any).email).toBeUndefined();
      expect((item as any).userEmail).toBeUndefined();
    });

    it('filters jobs accurately by status and type', async () => {
      const resFailed = await request(app)
        .get('/api/admin/jobs?status=FAILED')
        .set('Cookie', adminUserCookie);

      expect(resFailed.status).toBe(200);
      expect(resFailed.body.items.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
      expect(resFailed.body.items.every((j: any) => j.status === 'FAILED')).toBe(true);

      const resExtraction = await request(app)
        .get('/api/admin/jobs?type=DOCUMENT_EXTRACTION')
        .set('Cookie', adminUserCookie);

      expect(resExtraction.status).toBe(200);
      expect(resExtraction.body.items.every((j: any) => j.type === 'DOCUMENT_EXTRACTION')).toBe(true);
    });

    it('filters jobs accurately by userId and jobId', async () => {
      const resUser = await request(app)
        .get(`/api/admin/jobs?userId=${normalUserId}`)
        .set('Cookie', adminUserCookie);

      expect(resUser.status).toBe(200);
      expect(resUser.body.items.length).toBe(2);
      expect(resUser.body.items.every((j: any) => j.userId === normalUserId)).toBe(true);

      const resJob = await request(app)
        .get(`/api/admin/jobs?jobId=${sampleJobId}`)
        .set('Cookie', adminUserCookie);

      expect(resJob.status).toBe(200);
      expect(resJob.body.items.length).toBe(1);
      expect(resJob.body.items[0].id).toBe(sampleJobId);
    });

    it('enforces maximum 90-day date range and validates startDate <= endDate', async () => {
      // 1. startDate > endDate -> 400
      const resReversed = await request(app)
        .get('/api/admin/jobs?startDate=2026-10-15T00:00:00.000Z&endDate=2026-10-10T00:00:00.000Z')
        .set('Cookie', adminUserCookie);

      expect(resReversed.status).toBe(400);
      expect(resReversed.body.error.code).toBe('VALIDATION_ERROR');

      // 2. Range > 90 days -> 400
      const resTooWide = await request(app)
        .get('/api/admin/jobs?startDate=2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z&endDate=2026-06-01T00:00:00.000Z')
        .set('Cookie', adminUserCookie);

      expect(resTooWide.status).toBe(400);
      expect(resTooWide.body.error.code).toBe('VALIDATION_ERROR');
    });
  });

  describe('Detail Job (GET /api/admin/jobs/:id)', () => {
    it('returns 404 for non-existent job ID', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .get('/api/admin/jobs/cuid_non_existent_job_123')
        .set('Cookie', adminUserCookie);

      expect(res.status).toBe(404);
      expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('JOB_NOT_FOUND');
    });

    it('returns safe operational detail for successful completed job', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .get(`/api/admin/jobs/${sampleJobId}`)
        .set('Cookie', adminUserCookie);

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.headers['cache-control']).toBe('no-store, private');
      expect(res.body.id).toBe(sampleJobId);
      expect(res.body.type).toBe('DOCUMENT_EXTRACTION');
      expect(res.body.status).toBe('COMPLETED');
      expect(res.body.userId).toBe(normalUserId);
      expect(res.body.userName).toBe('Mahasiswa Biasa');
      expect(res.body.attempts).toBe(1);
      expect(res.body.maxAttempts).toBe(3);
      expect(typeof res.body.durationMs).toBe('number');
      expect(res.body.durationMs).toBe(50000); // 60000 - 10000 = 50000ms
      expect(res.body.errorCode).toBeNull();
      expect(res.body.safeErrorMessage).toBeNull();

      // Database history preserved even if not present in transient BullMQ memory
      expect(['waiting', 'active', 'delayed', 'completed', 'failed', 'not_found', 'unavailable']).toContain(
        res.body.queueStatus
      );

      // SECURITY CHECK:
      expect((res.body as any).payload).toBeUndefined();
      expect((res.body as any).rawText).toBeUndefined();
      expect((res.body as any).sensitivePrompt).toBeUndefined();
      expect((res.body as any).email).toBeUndefined();
    });

    it('returns safe error explanation for failed job without leaking provider secret or stack trace', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .get(`/api/admin/jobs/${failedJobId}`)
        .set('Cookie', adminUserCookie);

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.body.id).toBe(failedJobId);
      expect(res.body.status).toBe('FAILED');
      expect(res.body.errorCode).toBe('AI_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED');
      // Safe mapped explanation in Indonesian
      expect(res.body.safeErrorMessage).toBe('Batas frekuensi permintaan AI terlampaui (rate limit).');

      // CRITICAL SECURITY: Raw provider error containing secret token MUST NEVER be exposed
      expect((res.body as any).errorMessage).toBeUndefined();
      expect(JSON.stringify(res.body)).not.toContain('sk-secret-12345678');
      expect((res.body as any).payload).toBeUndefined();
    });

    it('does not retrigger jobs or invoke external AI providers on read queries', async () => {
      // Fetching job status 3 times in a row should be completely idempotent and read-only
      const res1 = await request(app).get(`/api/admin/jobs/${sampleJobId}`).set('Cookie', adminUserCookie);
      const res2 = await request(app).get(`/api/admin/jobs/${sampleJobId}`).set('Cookie', adminUserCookie);
      const res3 = await request(app).get(`/api/admin/jobs/${sampleJobId}`).set('Cookie', adminUserCookie);

      expect(res1.body.status).toBe('COMPLETED');
      expect(res2.body.status).toBe('COMPLETED');
      expect(res3.body.status).toBe('COMPLETED');
      expect(res1.body.attempts).toBe(1);
      expect(res3.body.attempts).toBe(1);
    });
  });

  describe('Queues Summary (GET /api/admin/jobs/queues/summary)', () => {
    it('returns structured queue states with retention disclaimer notice', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .get('/api/admin/jobs/queues/summary')
        .set('Cookie', adminUserCookie);

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.headers['cache-control']).toBe('no-store, private');
      expect(Array.isArray(res.body.queues)).toBe(true);
      expect(res.body.queues.length).toBe(2);

      const docQueue = res.body.queues.find((q: any) => q.name.includes('document'));
      expect(docQueue).toBeDefined();
      expect(docQueue.label).toBe('Pemrosesan Dokumen');
      expect(['available', 'unavailable']).toContain(docQueue.status);

      const aiQueue = res.body.queues.find((q: any) => q.name.includes('ai'));
      expect(aiQueue).toBeDefined();
      expect(aiQueue.label).toContain('Generasi AI');
      expect(['available', 'unavailable']).toContain(aiQueue.status);

      // Verify disclaimer note is present
      expect(res.body.retentionNotice).toBeDefined();
      expect(res.body.retentionNotice).toContain('retensi');
      expect(res.body.timestamp).toBeDefined();
    });
  });
});

<file path="apps/api/src/test/assignment.test.ts">
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterAll } from 'vitest';
import request from 'supertest';
import { createApp } from '../app.js';
import { prisma } from '@studyflow/database';

describe('Assignment Endpoints & Invariants', () => {
  const app = createApp();
  const TRUSTED_ORIGIN = 'http://localhost:3000';

  let userAId: string;
  let userBId: string;
  let cookieA: string[];
  let cookieB: string[];
  let semAId: string;
  let semBId: string;
  let courseAId: string;
  let courseBId: string;

  beforeEach(async () => {
    await prisma.user.deleteMany({
      where: { email: { contains: 'test.asg.' } },
    });

    // Create User A with timezone Asia/Jakarta
    const emailA = `test.asg.a.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Assignment User A',
        email: emailA,
        password: 'PasswordSangatKuat123!',
      });
    const loginA = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: emailA,
        password: 'PasswordSangatKuat123!',
      });
    userAId = loginA.body.user.id;
    cookieA = loginA.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];

    // Set User A timezone
    await prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: userAId },
      data: { timezone: 'Asia/Jakarta' },
    });

    const semResA = await request(app)
      .post('/api/semesters')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ name: 'Semester A', academicYear: '2026/2027', isActive: true });
    semAId = semResA.body.semester.id;

    const courseResA = await request(app)
      .post('/api/courses')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        semesterId: semAId,
        name: 'Algoritma & Struktur Data',
        code: 'IF201',
      });
    courseAId = courseResA.body.course.id;

    // Create User B with timezone America/New_York
    const emailB = `test.asg.b.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Assignment User B',
        email: emailB,
        password: 'PasswordSangatKuat123!',
      });
    const loginB = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: emailB,
        password: 'PasswordSangatKuat123!',
      });
    userBId = loginB.body.user.id;
    cookieB = loginB.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];

    await prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: userBId },
      data: { timezone: 'America/New_York' },
    });

    const semResB = await request(app)
      .post('/api/semesters')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB)
      .send({ name: 'Semester B', academicYear: '2026/2027', isActive: true });
    semBId = semResB.body.semester.id;

    const courseResB = await request(app)
      .post('/api/courses')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB)
      .send({
        semesterId: semBId,
        name: 'Jaringan Komputer',
        code: 'IF301',
      });
    courseBId = courseResB.body.course.id;
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await prisma.user.deleteMany({
      where: { email: { contains: 'test.asg.' } },
    });
    await prisma.$disconnect();
  });

  it('creates assignment and defaults date-only input to 23:59:00 in user timezone', async () => {
    // User A timezone is Asia/Jakarta (+07:00).
    // Date "2026-10-15" at 23:59:00 WIB is 2026-10-15T16:59:00.000Z.
    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/assignments')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseAId,
        title: 'Tugas 1: Linked List',
        dueDate: '2026-10-15',
        priority: 'HIGH',
      });

    expect(res.status).toBe(201);
    expect(res.body.assignment.title).toBe('Tugas 1: Linked List');
    expect(res.body.assignment.priority).toBe('HIGH');
    expect(res.body.assignment.status).toBe('TODO');
    expect(res.body.assignment.dueDate).toBe('2026-10-15T16:59:00.000Z');
    expect(res.body.assignment.completedAt).toBeNull();
    expect(res.body.assignment.isOverdue).toBe(false);
  });

  it('rejects invalid or non-existent dates in DST transition', async () => {
    // America/New_York skipped 2026-03-08 02:30:00 (spring forward from 02:00 to 03:00)
    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/assignments')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB)
      .send({
        courseId: courseBId,
        title: 'Tugas DST',
        dueDate: '2026-03-08T02:30:00',
      });

    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('INVALID_DUE_DATE');
  });

  it('handles status transitions and completedAt correctly', async () => {
    const createRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/assignments')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseAId,
        title: 'Tugas Status Transition',
        dueDate: '2026-11-01T17:00:00.000Z',
      });

    const assignmentId = createRes.body.assignment.id;
    expect(createRes.body.assignment.status).toBe('TODO');
    expect(createRes.body.assignment.completedAt).toBeNull();

    // 1. Update to DONE
    const doneRes = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/assignments/${assignmentId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ status: 'DONE' });

    expect(doneRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(doneRes.body.assignment.status).toBe('DONE');
    expect(doneRes.body.assignment.completedAt).not.toBeNull();
    const firstCompletedAt = doneRes.body.assignment.completedAt;

    // 2. Repeat update to DONE -> should retain previous completedAt
    const repeatDoneRes = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/assignments/${assignmentId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ status: 'DONE', title: 'Tugas Status Transition (Updated)' });

    expect(repeatDoneRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(repeatDoneRes.body.assignment.completedAt).toBe(firstCompletedAt);

    // 3. Update to IN_PROGRESS -> should clear completedAt
    const inProgressRes = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/assignments/${assignmentId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ status: 'IN_PROGRESS' });

    expect(inProgressRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(inProgressRes.body.assignment.status).toBe('IN_PROGRESS');
    expect(inProgressRes.body.assignment.completedAt).toBeNull();
  });

  it('computes overdue correctly: past deadline is overdue if not DONE; DONE is never overdue', async () => {
    // Past deadline (year 2020)
    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/assignments')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseAId,
        title: 'Tugas Masa Lalu',
        dueDate: '2020-01-01T12:00:00.000Z',
      });

    expect(res.status).toBe(201);
    expect(res.body.assignment.isOverdue).toBe(true);

    // Marking it DONE clears isOverdue
    const doneRes = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/assignments/${res.body.assignment.id}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ status: 'DONE' });

    expect(doneRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(doneRes.body.assignment.isOverdue).toBe(false);
  });

  it('rejects editing courseId', async () => {
    const createRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/assignments')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseAId,
        title: 'Tugas Course Change',
        dueDate: '2026-11-01T17:00:00.000Z',
      });

    const editRes = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/assignments/${createRes.body.assignment.id}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ courseId: courseBId });

    expect(editRes.status).toBe(400);
    expect(editRes.body.error.code).toBe('CANNOT_CHANGE_COURSE');
  });

  it('editing title preserves UTC deadline', async () => {
    const originalUtc = '2026-12-01T10:00:00.000Z';
    const createRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/assignments')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseAId,
        title: 'Original Title',
        dueDate: originalUtc,
      });

    const editRes = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/assignments/${createRes.body.assignment.id}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ title: 'New Title Without Changing DueDate' });

    expect(editRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(editRes.body.assignment.title).toBe('New Title Without Changing DueDate');
    expect(editRes.body.assignment.dueDate).toBe(originalUtc);
  });

  it('enforces multi-tenant data isolation', async () => {
    // User A creates assignment
    const asgA = await request(app)
      .post('/api/assignments')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseAId,
        title: 'Rahasia User A',
        dueDate: '2026-11-01T17:00:00.000Z',
      });

    // User B tries to read User A assignment -> 404
    const getRes = await request(app)
      .get(`/api/assignments/${asgA.body.assignment.id}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB);
    expect(getRes.status).toBe(404);

    // User B tries to update User A assignment -> 404
    const patchRes = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/assignments/${asgA.body.assignment.id}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB)
      .send({ title: 'Hacked' });
    expect(patchRes.status).toBe(404);

    // User B tries to delete User A assignment -> 404
    const deleteRes = await request(app)
      .delete(`/api/assignments/${asgA.body.assignment.id}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB);
    expect(deleteRes.status).toBe(404);

    // User B tries to create assignment under User A course -> 404 COURSE_NOT_FOUND
    const createBwithACourse = await request(app)
      .post('/api/assignments')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB)
      .send({
        courseId: courseAId,
        title: 'Tugas Ilegal',
        dueDate: '2026-11-01T17:00:00.000Z',
      });
    expect(createBwithACourse.status).toBe(404);
    expect(createBwithACourse.body.error.code).toBe('COURSE_NOT_FOUND');
  });

  it('prevents course deletion if course has assignments and suggests archive', async () => {
    // courseA has assignments
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/assignments')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseAId,
        title: 'Tugas Pencegah Hapus',
        dueDate: '2026-11-01T17:00:00.000Z',
      });

    const deleteCourseRes = await request(app)
      .delete(`/api/courses/${courseAId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);

    expect(deleteCourseRes.status).toBe(409);
    expect(deleteCourseRes.body.error.code).toBe('COURSE_HAS_ASSIGNMENTS');
    expect(deleteCourseRes.body.error.message).toContain('arsip');
  });

  it('enforces read-only invariant on archived courses/semesters', async () => {
    // 1. Create assignment on active course
    const asgRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/assignments')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseAId,
        title: 'Tugas Sebelum Arsip',
        dueDate: '2026-11-01T17:00:00.000Z',
      });
    const assignmentId = asgRes.body.assignment.id;

    // 2. Archive courseA
    await request(app)
      .post(`/api/courses/${courseAId}/archive`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);

    // 3. Attempt to create new assignment on archived course -> 400 COURSE_ARCHIVED
    const newAsgRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/assignments')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseAId,
        title: 'Tugas Baru Di Arsip',
        dueDate: '2026-11-01T17:00:00.000Z',
      });
    expect(newAsgRes.status).toBe(400);
    expect(newAsgRes.body.error.code).toBe('COURSE_ARCHIVED');

    // 4. Attempt to update assignment on archived course -> 400 COURSE_ARCHIVED
    const editRes = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/assignments/${assignmentId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ title: 'Edit Di Arsip' });
    expect(editRes.status).toBe(400);
    expect(editRes.body.error.code).toBe('COURSE_ARCHIVED');

    // 5. Attempt to delete assignment on archived course -> 400 COURSE_ARCHIVED
    const deleteRes = await request(app)
      .delete(`/api/assignments/${assignmentId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);
    expect(deleteRes.status).toBe(400);
    expect(deleteRes.body.error.code).toBe('COURSE_ARCHIVED');

    // 6. Reading assignment on archived course remains allowed (read-only)
    const readRes = await request(app)
      .get(`/api/assignments/${assignmentId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);
    expect(readRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(readRes.body.assignment.title).toBe('Tugas Sebelum Arsip');

    // 7. Unarchive course -> mutations are permitted again
    await request(app)
      .post(`/api/courses/${courseAId}/unarchive`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);

    const reEditRes = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/assignments/${assignmentId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ title: 'Edit Setelah Pulihkan' });
    expect(reEditRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(reEditRes.body.assignment.title).toBe('Edit Setelah Pulihkan');
  });

  it('supports filtering by status, priority, semester, course, overdue and pagination', async () => {
    // Create multiple assignments
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/assignments')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseAId,
        title: 'Tugas Matematika 1',
        dueDate: '2026-11-01',
        priority: 'LOW',
      });

    await request(app)
      .post('/api/assignments')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseAId,
        title: 'Tugas Fisika Dasar',
        dueDate: '2020-01-01T00:00:00.000Z', // overdue
        priority: 'HIGH',
      });

    // Filter by overdue=true
    const overdueList = await request(app)
      .get('/api/assignments?isOverdue=true')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);

    expect(overdueList.status).toBe(200);
    expect(overdueList.body.assignments.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(overdueList.body.assignments.every((it: any) => it.isOverdue)).toBe(true);

    // Search by title
    const searchRes = await request(app)
      .get('/api/assignments?search=Fisika')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);

    expect(searchRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(searchRes.body.assignments.length).toBe(1);
    expect(searchRes.body.assignments[0].title).toBe('Tugas Fisika Dasar');
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterAll } from 'vitest';
import request from 'supertest';
import { createApp } from '../app.js';
import { prisma } from '@studyflow/database';
import { COOKIE_NAMES } from '@studyflow/shared';

describe('Assignment Reminder User Preference API Tests', () => {
  const app = createApp();
  const TRUSTED_ORIGIN = 'http://localhost:3000';

  const cleanUsers = async () => {
    await prisma.assignmentReminderLog.deleteMany({
      where: {
        user: {
          email: { contains: 'pref.reminder.test' },
        },
      },
    });
    await prisma.assignment.deleteMany({
      where: {
        user: {
          email: { contains: 'pref.reminder.test' },
        },
      },
    });
    await prisma.refreshSession.deleteMany({
      where: {
        user: {
          email: { contains: 'pref.reminder.test' },
        },
      },
    });
    await prisma.user.deleteMany({
      where: {
        email: { contains: 'pref.reminder.test' },
      },
    });
  };

  beforeEach(async () => {
    await cleanUsers();
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await cleanUsers();
    await prisma.$disconnect();
  });

  const createLoggedInUser = async (isVerified = false) => {
    const email = `pref.reminder.test.${Date.now()}.${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}@example.com`;
    const password = 'SecurePassword123!';

    const regRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Preference Test User',
        email,
        password,
        timezone: 'Asia/Jakarta',
      });

    expect(regRes.status).toBe(201);
    const userId = regRes.body.user.id;

    if (isVerified) {
      await prisma.user.update({
        where: { id: userId },
        data: { emailVerifiedAt: new Date() },
      });
    }

    const loginRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({ email, password });

    expect(loginRes.status).toBe(200);
    const cookies = loginRes.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];
    const cookieHeader = cookies.map((c) => c.split(';')[0]).join('; ');

    return {
      userId,
      email,
      cookieHeader,
    };
  };

  it('1. Default preferensi pengingat email adalah false untuk akun baru', async () => {
    const { cookieHeader } = await createLoggedInUser(false);

    const meRes = await request(app)
      .get('/api/auth/me')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieHeader);

    expect(meRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(meRes.body.user.reminderEmailDeadline).toBe(false);
  });

  it('2. Menolak pengaktifan pengingat deadline jika email belum diverifikasi (HTTP 400)', async () => {
    const { cookieHeader } = await createLoggedInUser(false); // Unverified

    const updateRes = await request(app)
      .patch('/api/auth/me')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieHeader)
      .send({
        reminderEmailDeadline: true,
      });

    expect(updateRes.status).toBe(400);
    expect(updateRes.body.error.code).toBe('EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED');
    expect(updateRes.body.error.message).toContain('Alamat email harus diverifikasi');

    // Confirm state in DB has not changed
    const meRes = await request(app)
      .get('/api/auth/me')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieHeader);

    expect(meRes.body.user.reminderEmailDeadline).toBe(false);
  });

  it('3. Berhasil mengaktifkan pengingat deadline jika email sudah terverifikasi (HTTP 200)', async () => {
    const { cookieHeader } = await createLoggedInUser(true); // Verified

    const updateRes = await request(app)
      .patch('/api/auth/me')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieHeader)
      .send({
        reminderEmailDeadline: true,
      });

    expect(updateRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(updateRes.body.user.reminderEmailDeadline).toBe(true);

    const meRes = await request(app)
      .get('/api/auth/me')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieHeader);

    expect(meRes.body.user.reminderEmailDeadline).toBe(true);
  });

  it('4. Pengguna dapat menonaktifkan pengingat kapan saja', async () => {
    const { userId, cookieHeader } = await createLoggedInUser(true);

    // Set enabled first
    await prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: userId },
      data: { reminderEmailDeadline: true },
    });

    const updateRes = await request(app)
      .patch('/api/auth/me')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieHeader)
      .send({
        reminderEmailDeadline: false,
      });

    expect(updateRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(updateRes.body.user.reminderEmailDeadline).toBe(false);

    const meRes = await request(app)
      .get('/api/auth/me')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieHeader);

    expect(meRes.body.user.reminderEmailDeadline).toBe(false);
  });
});

<file path="apps/api/src/test/auth.test.ts">
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterAll } from 'vitest';
import request from 'supertest';
import { createApp } from '../app.js';
import { prisma } from '@studyflow/database';
import { COOKIE_NAMES } from '@studyflow/shared';

describe('Express Authentication Endpoints', () => {
  const app = createApp();
  const testEmail = `test.user.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
  const testPassword = 'PasswordSangatKuat123!';
  const TRUSTED_ORIGIN = 'http://localhost:3000';

  beforeEach(async () => {
    // Clean up test users created during test runs
    await prisma.user.deleteMany({
      where: {
        email: { contains: 'test.user.' },
      },
    });
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await prisma.user.deleteMany({
      where: {
        email: { contains: 'test.user.' },
      },
    });
    await prisma.$disconnect();
  });

  it('POST /api/auth/register should create a user and not leak password hash', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Mahasiswa Test',
        email: testEmail,
        password: testPassword,
        timezone: 'Asia/Jakarta',
      });

    expect(res.status).toBe(201);
    expect(res.body.user).toBeDefined();
    expect(res.body.user.email).toBe(testEmail.toLowerCase());
    expect(res.body.user.name).toBe('Mahasiswa Test');
    expect(res.body.user.timezone).toBe('Asia/Jakarta');

    // Never leak passwordHash
    expect(res.body.user.passwordHash).toBeUndefined();
    expect(JSON.stringify(res.body)).not.toContain('passwordHash');
    expect(JSON.stringify(res.body)).not.toContain('password_hash');
  });

  it('POST /api/auth/register should reject duplicate emails case-insensitively', async () => {
    // First register
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'User 1',
        email: testEmail.toLowerCase(),
        password: testPassword,
      });

    // Try registering with uppercase variation
    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'User 2',
        email: testEmail.toUpperCase(),
        password: testPassword,
      });

    expect(res.status).toBe(409);
    expect(res.body.error).toBeDefined();
    expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('EMAIL_ALREADY_EXISTS');
  });

  it('POST /api/auth/register should reject password shorter than 12 characters', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Short Password User',
        email: `short.${Date.now()}@example.com`,
        password: 'short123',
      });

    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.error).toBeDefined();
    expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('VALIDATION_ERROR');
  });

  it('POST /api/auth/login should authenticate valid user and set cookies', async () => {
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Login User',
        email: testEmail,
        password: testPassword,
      });

    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: testEmail,
        password: testPassword,
      });

    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.user).toBeDefined();
    expect(res.body.accessToken).toBeDefined();

    // Check Set-Cookie headers
    const cookies = res.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];
    expect(cookies).toBeDefined();
    const cookieHeaderStr = cookies.join('; ');
    expect(cookieHeaderStr).toContain(COOKIE_NAMES.accessToken);
    expect(cookieHeaderStr).toContain(COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken);
    expect(cookieHeaderStr).toContain('HttpOnly');
  });

  it('POST /api/auth/login should return generic error on invalid password or email', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: 'nonexistent@example.com',
        password: 'WrongPassword123!',
      });

    expect(res.status).toBe(401);
    expect(res.body.error.message).toBe('Email atau password tidak sesuai');
  });

  it('GET /api/auth/me should return 401 without token and 200 with valid token', async () => {
    // Without token
    const resNoToken = await request(app).get('/api/auth/me');
    expect(resNoToken.status).toBe(401);

    // Register & Login
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Me User',
        email: testEmail,
        password: testPassword,
      });

    const loginRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: testEmail,
        password: testPassword,
      });

    const accessToken = loginRes.body.accessToken;

    const resAuth = await request(app)
      .get('/api/auth/me')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${accessToken}`);

    expect(resAuth.status).toBe(200);
    expect(resAuth.body.user.email).toBe(testEmail.toLowerCase());
    expect(resAuth.body.user.name).toBe('Me User');
  });

  it('PATCH /api/auth/me should update profile for authenticated user', async () => {
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Old Name',
        email: testEmail,
        password: testPassword,
      });

    const loginRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: testEmail,
        password: testPassword,
      });

    const updateRes = await request(app)
      .patch('/api/auth/me')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${loginRes.body.accessToken}`)
      .send({
        name: 'New Name',
        timezone: 'Asia/Makassar',
      });

    expect(updateRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(updateRes.body.user.name).toBe('New Name');
    expect(updateRes.body.user.timezone).toBe('Asia/Makassar');
  });

  it('POST /api/auth/refresh should rotate refresh token and support concurrent grace period', async () => {
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Rotate User',
        email: testEmail,
        password: testPassword,
      });

    const loginRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: testEmail,
        password: testPassword,
      });

    const cookies = loginRes.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];
    const refreshCookie = cookies.find((c: string) => c.startsWith(`${COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken}=`));
    const rawRefreshToken = refreshCookie?.split(';')[0]?.split('=')[1];

    expect(rawRefreshToken).toBeDefined();

    // 1. First rotation (Request 1 / Tab 1)
    const refreshRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/refresh')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', [`${COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken}=${rawRefreshToken}`]);

    expect(refreshRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(refreshRes.body.accessToken).toBeDefined();

    // 2. Concurrent request / second tab sending the same old token within grace period (15s)
    const concurrentRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/refresh')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', [`${COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken}=${rawRefreshToken}`]);

    // Grace period allows second tab to obtain an access token without revoking the session family!
    expect(concurrentRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(concurrentRes.body.accessToken).toBeDefined();

    // 3. Replay attack: Simulate token reuse outside grace period (>15s)
    // Manually push revokedAt back to 20 seconds ago in DB
    const tokenHash = (await import('../services/token.service.js')).hashToken(rawRefreshToken!);
    await prisma.refreshSession.updateMany({
      where: { tokenHash },
      data: { revokedAt: new Date(Date.now() - 20_000) },
    });

    const replayRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/refresh')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', [`${COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken}=${rawRefreshToken}`]);

    expect(replayRes.status).toBe(401);
    expect(replayRes.body.error.code).toBe('SESSION_REPLAY_DETECTED');
  });

  it('POST /api/auth/logout should revoke session and clear cookies', async () => {
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Logout User',
        email: testEmail,
        password: testPassword,
      });

    const loginRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: testEmail,
        password: testPassword,
      });

    const cookies = loginRes.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];
    const refreshCookie = cookies.find((c: string) => c.startsWith(`${COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken}=`));
    const rawRefreshToken = refreshCookie?.split(';')[0]?.split('=')[1];

    const logoutRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/logout')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', [`${COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken}=${rawRefreshToken}`]);

    expect(logoutRes.status).toBe(200);

    // After logout, refreshing with that token must fail
    const refreshRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/refresh')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', [`${COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken}=${rawRefreshToken}`]);

    expect(refreshRes.status).toBe(401);
  });

  it('POST /api/auth/change-password should revoke all existing sessions and access tokens', async () => {
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Password User',
        email: testEmail,
        password: testPassword,
      });

    const loginRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: testEmail,
        password: testPassword,
      });

    const oldAccessToken = loginRes.body.accessToken;

    // Change password
    const newPassword = 'PasswordBaruYangKuat456!';
    const changeRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/change-password')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${oldAccessToken}`)
      .send({
        currentPassword: testPassword,
        newPassword,
      });

    expect(changeRes.status).toBe(200);

    // Old access token must now be rejected immediately due to tokenVersion increment
    const meRes = await request(app)
      .get('/api/auth/me')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${oldAccessToken}`);

    expect(meRes.status).toBe(401);
    expect(meRes.body.error.code).toBe('SESSION_REVOKED');

    // Login with new password should succeed
    const newLoginRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: testEmail,
        password: newPassword,
      });

    expect(newLoginRes.status).toBe(200);
  });

  it('POST /api/auth/change-password should reject incorrect current password', async () => {
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Wrong Password User',
        email: testEmail,
        password: testPassword,
      });

    const loginRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: testEmail,
        password: testPassword,
      });

    const accessToken = loginRes.body.accessToken;

    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/change-password')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${accessToken}`)
      .send({
        currentPassword: 'WrongPassword123!',
        newPassword: 'BrandNewSecurePassword123!',
      });

    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('INVALID_CURRENT_PASSWORD');
  });

  it('State-changing requests with forbidden Origin should be rejected with 403', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', 'https://malicious-website.com')
      .send({
        email: testEmail,
        password: testPassword,
      });

    expect(res.status).toBe(403);
    expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('CSRF_ORIGIN_INVALID');
  });

  it('State-changing requests with null Origin should be rejected with 403', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', 'null')
      .send({
        email: testEmail,
        password: testPassword,
      });

    expect(res.status).toBe(403);
    expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('CSRF_ORIGIN_INVALID');
  });

  it('State-changing requests with missing Origin and Referer should be rejected with 403', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .send({
        email: testEmail,
        password: testPassword,
      });

    expect(res.status).toBe(403);
    expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('CSRF_ORIGIN_INVALID');
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterAll } from 'vitest';
import request from 'supertest';
import { createApp } from '../app.js';
import { prisma } from '@studyflow/database';
import { COOKIE_NAMES } from '@studyflow/shared';
import { hashToken } from '../services/token.service.js';

describe('Refresh Token Rotation Concurrency & Security', () => {
  const app = createApp();
  const testEmail = `auth.concurrency.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
  const testPassword = 'PasswordKuatConcurrency123!';
  const TRUSTED_ORIGIN = 'http://localhost:3000';

  beforeEach(async () => {
    await prisma.user.deleteMany({
      where: {
        email: { contains: 'auth.concurrency.' },
      },
    });
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await prisma.user.deleteMany({
      where: {
        email: { contains: 'auth.concurrency.' },
      },
    });
    await prisma.$disconnect();
  });

  async function registerAndLogin(email = testEmail) {
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Concurrent User',
        email,
        password: testPassword,
      });

    const loginRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email,
        password: testPassword,
      });

    const cookies = loginRes.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];
    const refreshCookie = cookies?.find((c: string) => c.startsWith(`${COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken}=`));
    const rawRefreshToken = refreshCookie?.split(';')[0]?.split('=')[1];

    return {
      user: loginRes.body.user,
      accessToken: loginRes.body.accessToken,
      rawRefreshToken: rawRefreshToken!,
    };
  }

  it('1. Two concurrent refresh requests with the same token should create exactly one child session without branching', async () => {
    const { rawRefreshToken } = await registerAndLogin();
    const tokenHash = hashToken(rawRefreshToken);

    // Get the initial session
    const initialSession = await prisma.refreshSession.findUnique({
      where: { tokenHash },
    });
    expect(initialSession).toBeDefined();
    const familyId = initialSession!.familyId;

    // Send two concurrent refresh requests simultaneously
    const [res1, res2] = await Promise.all([
      request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/refresh')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', [`${COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken}=${rawRefreshToken}`]),
      request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/refresh')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', [`${COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken}=${rawRefreshToken}`]),
    ]);

    // Both requests must succeed (one via normal rotation, one via grace period)
    expect(res1.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res2.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res1.body.accessToken).toBeDefined();
    expect(res2.body.accessToken).toBeDefined();

    // Verify session count in family:
    // Exactly 1 parent (now revoked) + exactly 1 child (active).
    // MUST NOT create 2 child sessions!
    const allSessions = await prisma.refreshSession.findMany({
      where: { familyId },
    });
    expect(allSessions.length).toBe(2);

    const activeSessions = allSessions.filter((s) => s.revokedAt === null);
    expect(activeSessions.length).toBe(1);

    const revokedSessions = allSessions.filter((s) => s.revokedAt !== null);
    expect(revokedSessions.length).toBe(1);
    expect(revokedSessions[0].id).toBe(initialSession!.id);
  });

  it('2. Winner request issues new refreshToken cookie; loser request within grace period omits refreshToken cookie without clearing it', async () => {
    const { rawRefreshToken } = await registerAndLogin();

    const [res1, res2] = await Promise.all([
      request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/refresh')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', [`${COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken}=${rawRefreshToken}`]),
      request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/refresh')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', [`${COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken}=${rawRefreshToken}`]),
    ]);

    // Inspect Set-Cookie headers on both responses
    const getRefreshCookie = (res: request.Response) => {
      const setCookies = (res.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[]) || [];
      return setCookies.find((c) => c.startsWith(`${COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken}=`));
    };

    const cookie1 = getRefreshCookie(res1);
    const cookie2 = getRefreshCookie(res2);

    // Exactly one of the requests should set the new refresh token cookie
    // The other request (runner-up during grace period) omits it
    const setsRefreshTokenCount = [cookie1, cookie2].filter((c) => c && !c.includes('Max-Age=0')).length;
    expect(setsRefreshTokenCount).toBe(1);

    // Neither request should have cleared the refresh cookie with Max-Age=0
    expect(cookie1?.includes('Max-Age=0')).toBeFalsy();
    expect(cookie2?.includes('Max-Age=0')).toBeFalsy();
  });

  it('3. Subsequent refresh using the newly generated child token succeeds', async () => {
    const { rawRefreshToken } = await registerAndLogin();

    const refreshRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/refresh')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', [`${COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken}=${rawRefreshToken}`]);

    expect(refreshRes.status).toBe(200);

    const cookies = refreshRes.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];
    const newRefreshCookie = cookies.find((c: string) => c.startsWith(`${COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken}=`));
    const newRawRefreshToken = newRefreshCookie?.split(';')[0]?.split('=')[1];
    expect(newRawRefreshToken).toBeDefined();

    // Use the newly rotated token for another refresh
    const secondRefreshRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/refresh')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', [`${COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken}=${newRawRefreshToken}`]);

    expect(secondRefreshRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(secondRefreshRes.body.accessToken).toBeDefined();
  });

  it('4. Replay attack outside grace window revokes the whole family and returns 401 SESSION_REPLAY_DETECTED', async () => {
    const { rawRefreshToken } = await registerAndLogin();
    const tokenHash = hashToken(rawRefreshToken);

    // Rotate token once
    const firstRefresh = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/refresh')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', [`${COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken}=${rawRefreshToken}`]);
    expect(firstRefresh.status).toBe(200);

    const session = await prisma.refreshSession.findUnique({
      where: { tokenHash },
    });
    const familyId = session!.familyId;

    // Simulate passage of time: set revokedAt to 30 seconds ago (> 15s grace window)
    await prisma.refreshSession.update({
      where: { tokenHash },
      data: {
        revokedAt: new Date(Date.now() - 30000),
      },
    });

    // Attempt to reuse the old revoked token
    const replayRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/refresh')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', [`${COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken}=${rawRefreshToken}`]);

    expect(replayRes.status).toBe(401);
    expect(replayRes.body.error.code).toBe('SESSION_REPLAY_DETECTED');

    // Verify all sessions in the family are now revoked
    const familySessions = await prisma.refreshSession.findMany({
      where: { familyId },
    });
    expect(familySessions.every((s) => s.revokedAt !== null)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('5. Refresh racing with logout leaves zero active sessions in the family', async () => {
    const { rawRefreshToken } = await registerAndLogin();
    const tokenHash = hashToken(rawRefreshToken);

    const initialSession = await prisma.refreshSession.findUnique({
      where: { tokenHash },
    });
    const familyId = initialSession!.familyId;

    // Concurrently trigger refresh and logout with the same token
    const [refreshRes, logoutRes] = await Promise.all([
      request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/refresh')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', [`${COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken}=${rawRefreshToken}`]),
      request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/logout')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', [`${COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken}=${rawRefreshToken}`]),
    ]);

    expect(logoutRes.status).toBe(200);

    // After both complete, regardless of execution order:
    // ALL sessions in the family must be revoked! Zero active sessions!
    const familySessions = await prisma.refreshSession.findMany({
      where: { familyId },
    });
    const activeCount = familySessions.filter((s) => s.revokedAt === null).length;
    expect(activeCount).toBe(0);
  });

  it('6. Password change invalidates all existing sessions and increments tokenVersion', async () => {
    const { user, accessToken, rawRefreshToken } = await registerAndLogin();

    // Change password
    const changeRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/change-password')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${accessToken}`)
      .send({
        currentPassword: testPassword,
        newPassword: 'PasswordBaruSangatKuat456!',
      });

    expect(changeRes.status).toBe(200);

    // 1. Old access token must be rejected (tokenVersion mismatch)
    const meRes = await request(app)
      .get('/api/auth/me')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${accessToken}`);
    expect(meRes.status).toBe(401);
    expect(meRes.body.error.code).toBe('SESSION_REVOKED');

    // 2. Old refresh token must be rejected (session was revoked)
    const refreshRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/refresh')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', [`${COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken}=${rawRefreshToken}`]);
    expect(refreshRes.status).toBe(401);

    // 3. User can login with the new password
    const newLoginRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: testEmail,
        password: 'PasswordBaruSangatKuat456!',
      });
    expect(newLoginRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(newLoginRes.body.accessToken).toBeDefined();
  });

  it('7. Expired refresh token is rejected with SESSION_EXPIRED and marked revoked', async () => {
    const { rawRefreshToken } = await registerAndLogin();
    const tokenHash = hashToken(rawRefreshToken);

    // Manually expire the session in the database
    await prisma.refreshSession.update({
      where: { tokenHash },
      data: {
        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() - 10000), // expired 10 seconds ago
      },
    });

    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/refresh')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', [`${COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken}=${rawRefreshToken}`]);

    expect(res.status).toBe(401);
    expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('SESSION_EXPIRED');

    // Verify session in DB is marked as revoked
    const session = await prisma.refreshSession.findUnique({
      where: { tokenHash },
    });
    expect(session!.revokedAt).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it('8. Concurrency: Refresh racing with password change (Refresh starts first)', async () => {
    const userEmail = `race.refresh.first.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
    const { accessToken: oldAccessToken, rawRefreshToken: oldRefreshToken } = await registerAndLogin(userEmail);

    const newPassword = 'PasswordBaruRacing123!';

    // Launch refresh and change-password with refresh starting immediately
    const refreshPromise = request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/refresh')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', [`${COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken}=${oldRefreshToken}`]);

    // Very slight delay or immediate change-password to create tight race on PostgreSQL
    const changePasswordPromise = request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/change-password')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${oldAccessToken}`)
      .send({
        currentPassword: testPassword,
        newPassword,
      });

    const [refreshRes, changePassRes] = await Promise.all([refreshPromise, changePasswordPromise]);

    // Password change must succeed
    expect(changePassRes.status).toBe(200);

    // If refresh returned a child token (because it completed before or during change-password):
    const newChildRefreshToken = refreshRes.headers['set-cookie']
      ? ((refreshRes.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[])
          .find((c) => c.startsWith(`${COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken}=`))
          ?.split(';')[0]?.split('=')[1])
      : undefined;

    const issuedAccessToken = refreshRes.body.accessToken;

    // A. The old refresh token must be rejected
    const oldRefreshRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/refresh')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', [`${COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken}=${oldRefreshToken}`]);
    expect(oldRefreshRes.status).toBe(401);

    // B. If a child refresh token was issued during the race, it must also be rejected
    if (newChildRefreshToken) {
      const childRefreshRes = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/refresh')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', [`${COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken}=${newChildRefreshToken}`]);
      expect(childRefreshRes.status).toBe(401);
    }

    // C. The old access token must be rejected
    const testOldAccessRes = await request(app)
      .get('/api/auth/me')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${oldAccessToken}`);
    expect(testOldAccessRes.status).toBe(401);
    expect(testOldAccessRes.body.error.code).toBe('SESSION_REVOKED');

    // D. The access token issued by the racing refresh must also be rejected (tokenVersion mismatch)
    if (issuedAccessToken) {
      const testIssuedAccessRes = await request(app)
        .get('/api/auth/me')
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${issuedAccessToken}`);
      expect(testIssuedAccessRes.status).toBe(401);
      expect(testIssuedAccessRes.body.error.code).toBe('SESSION_REVOKED');
    }

    // E. Logging in with the new password must succeed
    const loginRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: userEmail,
        password: newPassword,
      });
    expect(loginRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(loginRes.body.accessToken).toBeDefined();

    // F. Verify DB: All refresh sessions created before/during password change must be revoked
    const dbUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { email: userEmail.toLowerCase() },
      include: { refreshSessions: true },
    });
    expect(dbUser).toBeDefined();
    // Only the session from the new login (step E) can be active
    const activeSessions = dbUser!.refreshSessions.filter((s) => s.revokedAt === null);
    expect(activeSessions.length).toBe(1);
  });

  it('9. Concurrency: Password change racing with refresh (Password change starts first)', async () => {
    const userEmail = `race.pass.first.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
    const { accessToken: oldAccessToken, rawRefreshToken: oldRefreshToken } = await registerAndLogin(userEmail);

    const newPassword = 'PasswordBaruRacingPassFirst123!';

    // Launch change-password and refresh concurrently with change-password scheduled first
    const changePasswordPromise = request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/change-password')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${oldAccessToken}`)
      .send({
        currentPassword: testPassword,
        newPassword,
      });

    const refreshPromise = (async () => {
      // Small pause to let change-password start its execution first
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 5));
      return request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/refresh')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', [`${COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken}=${oldRefreshToken}`]);
    })();

    const [changePassRes, refreshRes] = await Promise.all([changePasswordPromise, refreshPromise]);

    // Password change must succeed
    expect(changePassRes.status).toBe(200);

    // If refresh returned a token before change-password locked the user,
    // that token was issued with the old tokenVersion and must now be dead.
    // If change-password committed first, refresh was rejected with 401.
    const newChildRefreshToken = refreshRes.headers['set-cookie']
      ? ((refreshRes.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[])
          .find((c) => c.startsWith(`${COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken}=`))
          ?.split(';')[0]?.split('=')[1])
      : undefined;

    const issuedAccessToken = refreshRes.body.accessToken;

    // A. Old access token must be rejected
    const testOldAccessRes = await request(app)
      .get('/api/auth/me')
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${oldAccessToken}`);
    expect(testOldAccessRes.status).toBe(401);
    expect(testOldAccessRes.body.error.code).toBe('SESSION_REVOKED');

    // B. Old refresh token must be rejected
    const oldRefreshRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/refresh')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', [`${COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken}=${oldRefreshToken}`]);
    expect(oldRefreshRes.status).toBe(401);

    // C. Any access token issued during the race must be rejected (tokenVersion mismatch)
    if (issuedAccessToken) {
      const testIssuedAccessRes = await request(app)
        .get('/api/auth/me')
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${issuedAccessToken}`);
      expect(testIssuedAccessRes.status).toBe(401);
      expect(testIssuedAccessRes.body.error.code).toBe('SESSION_REVOKED');
    }

    // D. Any child refresh token issued during the race must be rejected
    if (newChildRefreshToken) {
      const childRefreshRes = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/refresh')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', [`${COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken}=${newChildRefreshToken}`]);
      expect(childRefreshRes.status).toBe(401);
    }

    // E. Login with new password must succeed
    const loginRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: userEmail,
        password: newPassword,
      });
    expect(loginRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(loginRes.body.accessToken).toBeDefined();

    // F. Verify DB: All refresh sessions created before/during password change must be revoked
    const dbUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { email: userEmail.toLowerCase() },
      include: { refreshSessions: true },
    });
    expect(dbUser).toBeDefined();
    // Only the session from the new login (step E) can be active
    const activeSessions = dbUser!.refreshSessions.filter((s) => s.revokedAt === null);
    expect(activeSessions.length).toBe(1);
  });

  it('10. Strict Lock Ordering: rotateRefreshToken and changeUserPassword execute concurrently without deadlock', async () => {
    const userEmail = `deadlock.check.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
    const { accessToken, rawRefreshToken } = await registerAndLogin(userEmail);
    const newPassword = 'PasswordBaruDeadlock123!';

    // Launch multiple interleaved operations simultaneously on the same user
    const results = await Promise.allSettled([
      request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/refresh')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', [`${COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken}=${rawRefreshToken}`]),
      request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/change-password')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${accessToken}`)
        .send({
          currentPassword: testPassword,
          newPassword,
        }),
      request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/refresh')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', [`${COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken}=${rawRefreshToken}`]),
      request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/logout')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', [`${COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken}=${rawRefreshToken}`]),
    ]);

    // None of the promises should be rejected due to database lock deadlock (SQL state 40P01)
    results.forEach((r) => {
      expect(r.status).toBe('fulfilled');
      if (r.status === 'fulfilled') {
        expect(r.value.status).not.toBe(500);
      }
    });

    // After all interleaved operations settle, login with new password must work cleanly
    const loginRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: userEmail,
        password: newPassword,
      });
    expect(loginRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(loginRes.body.accessToken).toBeDefined();
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterAll } from 'vitest';
import request from 'supertest';
import { createApp } from '../app.js';
import { prisma } from '@studyflow/database';

describe('Calendar Endpoints & Business Invariants', () => {
  const app = createApp();
  const TRUSTED_ORIGIN = 'http://localhost:3000';

  let userAId: string;
  let userBId: string;
  let cookieA: string[];
  let cookieB: string[];
  let semAId: string;
  let semBId: string;
  let courseA1Id: string;
  let courseA2Id: string;
  let courseBId: string;

  beforeEach(async () => {
    await prisma.user.deleteMany({
      where: { email: { contains: 'test.cal.' } },
    });

    await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Calendar User A',
        email: emailA,
        password: 'PasswordKuat123!',
      });
    const loginA = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: emailA,
        password: 'PasswordKuat123!',
      });
    userAId = loginA.body.user.id;
    cookieA = loginA.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];

    const semResA = await request(app)
      .post('/api/semesters')

    semAId = semResA.body.semester.id;

        code: 'MATH101',
        lecturer: 'Prof. Bambang',

        code: 'PHYS101',

        name: 'Calendar User B',
        email: emailB,

        name: 'Biologi Sel',
