    await prisma.user.deleteMany({
      where: { email: { contains: 'test.cal.' } },
    });
  });

  it('menolak rentang tanggal tidak valid (startDate >= endDate)', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .get('/api/calendar')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .query({
        startDate: '2026-10-15',
        endDate: '2026-10-10',
      });

    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('INVALID_RANGE');
  });

  it('menolak rentang waktu kalender lebih dari 60 hari', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .get('/api/calendar')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .query({
        startDate: '2026-09-01',
        endDate: '2026-11-15', // > 70 hari
      });

    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('RANGE_TOO_LARGE');
  });

  it('menolak akses ke semester atau mata kuliah milik user lain (isolasi tenant)', async () => {
    // User A mencoba query dengan semester milik User B
    const res1 = await request(app)
      .get('/api/calendar')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .query({
        semesterId: semBId,
        startDate: '2026-10-01',
        endDate: '2026-10-15',
      });

    expect(res1.status).toBe(404);

    // User A mencoba query dengan courseId milik User B
    const res2 = await request(app)
      .get('/api/calendar')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .query({
        courseId: courseBId,
        startDate: '2026-10-01',
        endDate: '2026-10-15',
      });

    expect(res2.status).toBe(404);
  });

  it('mengekspansi jadwal berulang mingguan ke tanggal kalender yang sesuai rentang [start, end)', async () => {
    // Buat jadwal kuliah pada hari Rabu (dayOfWeek = 3), 08:00 - 10:00 untuk Kalkulus I
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/schedules')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseA1Id,
        dayOfWeek: 3,
        startTime: '08:00',
        endTime: '10:00',
        room: 'Lab Komputer 1',
      });

    // Rentang: 2026-10-05 (Senin) hingga 2026-10-19 (Senin) -> 2 minggu
    // Hari Rabu jatuh pada: 2026-10-07 dan 2026-10-14
    const res = await request(app)
      .get('/api/calendar')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .query({
        startDate: '2026-10-05',
        endDate: '2026-10-19',
        type: 'schedule',
      });

    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.events).toHaveLength(2);

    expect(res.body.events[0].date).toBe('2026-10-07');
    expect(res.body.events[0].type).toBe('SCHEDULE');
    expect(res.body.events[0].title).toBe('Kalkulus I');
    expect(res.body.events[0].startTime).toBe('08:00');
    expect(res.body.events[0].endTime).toBe('10:00');
    expect(res.body.events[0].room).toBe('Lab Komputer 1');
    expect(res.body.events[0].lecturer).toBe('Prof. Bambang');

    expect(res.body.events[1].date).toBe('2026-10-14');
    expect(res.body.events[1].type).toBe('SCHEDULE');
    expect(res.body.events[1].title).toBe('Kalkulus I');
  });

  it('menggabungkan jadwal kuliah dan tugas, mendukung filter mata kuliah dan tipe', async () => {
    // 1. Jadwal Kalkulus I di hari Senin (dayOfWeek = 1)
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/schedules')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseA1Id,
        dayOfWeek: 1,
        startTime: '10:00',
        endTime: '12:00',
      });

    // 2. Tugas Kalkulus I due pada 2026-10-08 23:59 (Kamis)
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/assignments')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseA1Id,
        title: 'Tugas Limit dan Kontinuitas',
        dueDate: '2026-10-08T16:59:00.000Z', // 23:59 WIB
        priority: 'HIGH',
      });

    // 3. Tugas Fisika Dasar due pada 2026-10-12 14:00 (Senin)
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/assignments')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseA2Id,
        title: 'Laporan Kinematika Gerak',
        dueDate: '2026-10-12T07:00:00.000Z', // 14:00 WIB
        priority: 'MEDIUM',
      });

    // Uji 1: Query all dalam 1 minggu (2026-10-05 sampai 2026-10-12)
    // 2026-10-05 ada jadwal Kalkulus I (Senin)
    // 2026-10-08 ada tugas Kalkulus I (Kamis)
    // 2026-10-12 ada di batas luar [start, end) sehingga tidak masuk
    const resAll = await request(app)
      .get('/api/calendar')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .query({
        startDate: '2026-10-05',
        endDate: '2026-10-12',
        type: 'all',
      });

    expect(resAll.status).toBe(200);
    expect(resAll.body.events).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(resAll.body.events[0].type).toBe('SCHEDULE');
    expect(resAll.body.events[0].title).toBe('Kalkulus I');
    expect(resAll.body.events[1].type).toBe('ASSIGNMENT');
    expect(resAll.body.events[1].title).toBe('Tugas Limit dan Kontinuitas');

    // Uji 2: Filter tipe = 'assignment'
    const resAssignmentsOnly = await request(app)
      .get('/api/calendar')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .query({
        startDate: '2026-10-05',
        endDate: '2026-10-15',
        type: 'assignment',
      });

    expect(resAssignmentsOnly.status).toBe(200);
    expect(resAssignmentsOnly.body.events).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(resAssignmentsOnly.body.events.every((e: any) => e.type === 'ASSIGNMENT')).toBe(true);

    // Uji 3: Filter courseId = courseA1Id
    const resCourseA1Only = await request(app)
      .get('/api/calendar')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .query({
        startDate: '2026-10-05',
        endDate: '2026-10-15',
        courseId: courseA1Id,
        type: 'all',
      });

    expect(resCourseA1Only.status).toBe(200);
    // Tidak boleh mengandung tugas Fisika Dasar
    expect(
      resCourseA1Only.body.events.some((e: any) => e.title === 'Laporan Kinematika Gerak')
    ).toBe(false);
  });

  it('tidak menyertakan tugas atau jadwal dari mata kuliah yang diarsipkan', async () => {
    // Arsipkan courseA2
    await request(app)
      .post(`/api/courses/${courseA2Id}/archive`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);

    const res = await request(app)
      .get('/api/calendar')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .query({
        courseId: courseA2Id,
        startDate: '2026-10-01',
        endDate: '2026-10-15',
      });

    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('COURSE_ARCHIVED');
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterAll } from 'vitest';
import request from 'supertest';
import { createApp } from '../app.js';
import { prisma } from '@studyflow/database';

describe('Course Endpoints & Invariants', () => {
  const app = createApp();
  const TRUSTED_ORIGIN = 'http://localhost:3000';

  let userAId: string;
  let userBId: string;
  let cookieA: string[];
  let cookieB: string[];
  let semAId: string;
  let semBId: string;

  beforeEach(async () => {
    await prisma.user.deleteMany({
      where: { email: { contains: 'test.crs.' } },
    });

    // Create User A & login
    const emailA = `test.crs.a.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Course User A',
        email: emailA,
        password: 'PasswordSangatKuat123!',
      });
    const loginA = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: emailA,
        password: 'PasswordSangatKuat123!',
      });
    userAId = loginA.body.user.id;
    cookieA = loginA.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];

    const semResA = await request(app)
      .post('/api/semesters')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ name: 'Semester A', academicYear: '2026/2027' });
    semAId = semResA.body.semester.id;

    // Create User B & login
    const emailB = `test.crs.b.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Course User B',
        email: emailB,
        password: 'PasswordSangatKuat123!',
      });
    const loginB = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: emailB,
        password: 'PasswordSangatKuat123!',
      });
    userBId = loginB.body.user.id;
    cookieB = loginB.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];

    const semResB = await request(app)
      .post('/api/semesters')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB)
      .send({ name: 'Semester B', academicYear: '2026/2027' });
    semBId = semResB.body.semester.id;
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await prisma.user.deleteMany({
      where: { email: { contains: 'test.crs.' } },
    });
    await prisma.$disconnect();
  });

  it('can create, read, update, archive, unarchive, and delete course', async () => {
    // 1. Create course
    const createRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/courses')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        semesterId: semAId,
        name: 'Struktur Data & Algoritma',
        code: 'IF201',
        lecturer: 'Dr. Budi Santoso',
        description: 'Mata kuliah dasar algoritma',
      });

    expect(createRes.status).toBe(201);
    expect(createRes.body.course.name).toBe('Struktur Data & Algoritma');
    expect(createRes.body.course.code).toBe('IF201');
    expect(createRes.body.course.lecturer).toBe('Dr. Budi Santoso');
    expect(createRes.body.course.description).toBe('Mata kuliah dasar algoritma');
    const courseId = createRes.body.course.id;

    // 2. Read single course
    const getRes = await request(app)
      .get(`/api/courses/${courseId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);
    expect(getRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(getRes.body.course.id).toBe(courseId);

    // 3. Update course
    const updateRes = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/courses/${courseId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        name: 'Struktur Data Lanjut',
        lecturer: 'Prof. Budi Santoso',
      });
    expect(updateRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(updateRes.body.course.name).toBe('Struktur Data Lanjut');
    expect(updateRes.body.course.lecturer).toBe('Prof. Budi Santoso');

    // 4. Archive course
    const archRes = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/courses/${courseId}/archive`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);
    expect(archRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(archRes.body.course.archivedAt).not.toBeNull();

    // 5. Unarchive course
    const unarchRes = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/courses/${courseId}/unarchive`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);
    expect(unarchRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(unarchRes.body.course.archivedAt).toBeNull();

    // 6. Delete course
    const delRes = await request(app)
      .delete(`/api/courses/${courseId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);
    expect(delRes.status).toBe(200);

    // Verify deleted
    const verifyRes = await request(app)
      .get(`/api/courses/${courseId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);
    expect(verifyRes.status).toBe(404);
  });

  it('rejects invalid inputs (short name or long code)', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/courses')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        semesterId: semAId,
        name: 'A', // Too short (< 2)
      });

    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('VALIDATION_ERROR');
  });

  it('cannot create course in an archived semester', async () => {
    // Archive semester A
    await request(app)
      .post(`/api/semesters/${semAId}/archive`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);

    // Try to create course
    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/courses')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        semesterId: semAId,
        name: 'Mata Kuliah di Semester Arsip',
      });

    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('SEMESTER_ARCHIVED');
  });

  it('cross-user isolation: User A cannot create course in User B semester', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/courses')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        semesterId: semBId, // User B's semester!
        name: 'Infiltrated Course',
      });

    expect(res.status).toBe(404);
    expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('SEMESTER_NOT_FOUND');
  });

  it('cross-user isolation: User B cannot view, modify, archive, or delete User A course', async () => {
    // User A creates course
    const createRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/courses')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        semesterId: semAId,
        name: 'Course User A',
      });
    const courseId = createRes.body.course.id;

    // User B tries to view
    const getRes = await request(app)
      .get(`/api/courses/${courseId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB);
    expect(getRes.status).toBe(404);

    // User B tries to update
    const patchRes = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/courses/${courseId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB)
      .send({ name: 'Tampered Name' });
    expect(patchRes.status).toBe(404);

    // User B tries to archive
    const archRes = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/courses/${courseId}/archive`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB);
    expect(archRes.status).toBe(404);

    // User B tries to delete
    const delRes = await request(app)
      .delete(`/api/courses/${courseId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB);
    expect(delRes.status).toBe(404);
  });
});

<file path="apps/api/src/test/emailVerification.test.ts">
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterAll } from 'vitest';
import request from 'supertest';
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import { createApp } from '../app.js';
import { prisma } from '@studyflow/database';
import { COOKIE_NAMES } from '@studyflow/shared';
import {
  __getSentTestEmails,
  __clearSentTestEmails,
  __setMockEmailFailure,
} from '../services/email.service.js';
import { hashPassword } from '../services/password.service.js';
import { __setTestGoogleAuthMock } from '../services/googleAuth.service.js';

describe('Email Verification Integration & Security Tests', () => {
  const app = createApp();
  const TRUSTED_ORIGIN = 'http://localhost:3000';

  const cleanUsers = async () => {
    await prisma.emailVerificationToken.deleteMany({
      where: {
        user: {
          email: { contains: 'verify.' },
        },
      },
    });
    await prisma.passwordResetToken.deleteMany({
      where: {
        user: {
          email: { contains: 'verify.' },
        },
      },
    });
    await prisma.refreshSession.deleteMany({
      where: {
        user: {
          email: { contains: 'verify.' },
        },
      },
    });
    await prisma.federatedIdentity.deleteMany({
      where: {
        user: {
          email: { contains: 'verify.' },
        },
      },
    });
    await prisma.user.deleteMany({
      where: {
        email: { contains: 'verify.' },
      },
    });
  };

  beforeEach(async () => {
    __clearSentTestEmails();
    __setTestGoogleAuthMock(null);
    await cleanUsers();
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    __clearSentTestEmails();
    __setTestGoogleAuthMock(null);
    await cleanUsers();
    await prisma.$disconnect();
  });

  // Helper to register and log in a user with session cookies
  const createLoggedInUser = async (customEmail?: string) => {
    const email = customEmail || `verify.user.${Date.now()}.${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}@example.com`;
    const password = 'SecurePassword123!';

    const regRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Verify Test User',
        email,
        password,
        timezone: 'Asia/Jakarta',
      });

    expect(regRes.status).toBe(201);
    expect(regRes.body.user.emailVerifiedAt).toBeNull();

    const loginRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({ email, password });

    expect(loginRes.status).toBe(200);
    const cookies = loginRes.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];
    const accessTokenCookie = cookies.find((c) => c.startsWith(`${COOKIE_NAMES.accessToken}=`));

    return {
      userId: regRes.body.user.id,
      email,
      cookies,
      accessTokenCookie,
    };
  };

  describe('1. POST /api/auth/verify-email/request', () => {
    it('menolak permintaan jika pengguna belum terautentikasi (401)', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/verify-email/request')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN);

      expect(res.status).toBe(401);
      expect(__getSentTestEmails()).toHaveLength(0);
    });

    it('mengirim email verifikasi ke email akun dan menyimpan hash token di database', async () => {
      const { email, cookies } = await createLoggedInUser();

      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/verify-email/request')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', cookies);

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.body.message).toContain('Email verifikasi telah dikirim');

      const sentEmails = __getSentTestEmails();
      expect(sentEmails).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(sentEmails[0].to).toBe(email);
      expect(sentEmails[0].subject).toContain('Verifikasi Alamat Email');
      expect(sentEmails[0].text).toContain('/verify-email?token=');

      // Verify token in database is hashed
      const tokens = await prisma.emailVerificationToken.findMany({
        where: { email },
      });
      expect(tokens).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(tokens[0].usedAt).toBeNull();
      expect(tokens[0].tokenHash).toHaveLength(64); // SHA-256 hex length
    });

    it('alamat tujuan diambil dari akun bukan input client bebas (tidak ada parameter target email)', async () => {
      const { email, cookies } = await createLoggedInUser();

      // Attempt to spoof target email in body
      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/verify-email/request')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', cookies)
        .send({ email: 'victim@otherdomain.com' });

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);

      // Email MUST still be sent ONLY to the authenticated account's email
      const sentEmails = __getSentTestEmails();
      expect(sentEmails).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(sentEmails[0].to).toBe(email);
      expect(sentEmails[0].to).not.toBe('victim@otherdomain.com');
    });

    it('menerapkan cooldown 60 detik jika meminta ulang terlalu cepat (429)', async () => {
      const { cookies } = await createLoggedInUser();

      // First request succeeds
      const firstRes = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/verify-email/request')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', cookies);
      expect(firstRes.status).toBe(200);

      // Immediate second request hits cooldown
      const secondRes = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/verify-email/request')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', cookies);

      expect(secondRes.status).toBe(429);
      expect(secondRes.body.error.code).toBe('VERIFICATION_COOLDOWN_ACTIVE');
    });

    it('akun yang sudah terverifikasi tidak dikirimi email baru', async () => {
      const { email, cookies, userId } = await createLoggedInUser();

      // Mark account verified directly in db
      await prisma.user.update({
        where: { id: userId },
        data: { emailVerifiedAt: new Date() },
      });

      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/verify-email/request')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', cookies);

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.body.message).toContain('sudah terverifikasi');
      expect(__getSentTestEmails()).toHaveLength(0);
    });

    it('resend membatalkan token sebelumnya yang belum digunakan', async () => {
      const { email, cookies, userId } = await createLoggedInUser();

      // Manually create an older token that is beyond the 60s cooldown
      const oldToken = 'oldtoken'.repeat(8);
      const oldTokenHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(oldToken).digest('hex');
      await prisma.emailVerificationToken.create({
        data: {
          userId,
          email,
          tokenHash: oldTokenHash,
          expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 60 * 1000),
          createdAt: new Date(Date.now() - 70 * 1000), // 70 seconds ago
        },
      });

      // Request new verification email
      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/verify-email/request')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', cookies);

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);

      // Verify old token is marked as usedAt (invalidated)
      const oldTokenRecord = await prisma.emailVerificationToken.findUnique({
        where: { tokenHash: oldTokenHash },
      });
      expect(oldTokenRecord?.usedAt).not.toBeNull();
    });

    it('menangani kegagalan transport email dengan 503 tanpa pesan sukses palsu', async () => {
      const { cookies } = await createLoggedInUser();

      __setMockEmailFailure(new Error('SMTP connection refused'));

      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/verify-email/request')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', cookies);

      expect(res.status).toBe(503);
      expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('EMAIL_SEND_FAILED');
    });
  });

  describe('2. POST /api/auth/verify-email/confirm', () => {
    it('berhasil memverifikasi email dengan token yang valid dan memperbarui emailVerifiedAt', async () => {
      const { email, cookies, userId } = await createLoggedInUser();

      await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/verify-email/request')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', cookies);

      const sentEmails = __getSentTestEmails();
      const match = sentEmails[0].text.match(/token=([a-f0-9]+)/);
      expect(match).not.toBeNull();
      const rawToken = match![1];

      // Confirm verification
      const confirmRes = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/verify-email/confirm')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({ token: rawToken });

      expect(confirmRes.status).toBe(200);
      expect(confirmRes.body.message).toContain('berhasil diverifikasi');
      expect(confirmRes.body.user.emailVerifiedAt).not.toBeNull();

      // Database check
      const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
      expect(user?.emailVerifiedAt).not.toBeNull();

      // Token marked used
      const tokenRecord = await prisma.emailVerificationToken.findFirst({
        where: { userId },
      });
      expect(tokenRecord?.usedAt).not.toBeNull();
    });

    it('menolak token yang tidak ada / invalid (400)', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/verify-email/confirm')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({ token: 'invalidrandomtoken'.repeat(3) });

      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
      expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('TOKEN_INVALID_OR_EXPIRED');
    });

    it('menolak token yang sudah kedaluwarsa (expired) (400)', async () => {
      const { email, userId } = await createLoggedInUser();

      const rawToken = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
      const tokenHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(rawToken).digest('hex');

      await prisma.emailVerificationToken.create({
        data: {
          userId,
          email,
          tokenHash,
          expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() - 1000), // Expired 1 second ago
        },
      });

      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/verify-email/confirm')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({ token: rawToken });

      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
      expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('TOKEN_INVALID_OR_EXPIRED');
    });

    it('menolak replay token yang sudah pernah digunakan (400)', async () => {
      const { cookies, userId } = await createLoggedInUser();

      await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/verify-email/request')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', cookies);

      const rawToken = __getSentTestEmails()[0].text.match(/token=([a-f0-9]+)/)![1];

      // First use succeeds
      const firstRes = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/verify-email/confirm')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({ token: rawToken });
      expect(firstRes.status).toBe(200);

      // Replay attempt fails
      const replayRes = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/verify-email/confirm')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({ token: rawToken });

      expect(replayRes.status).toBe(400);
      expect(replayRes.body.error.code).toBe('TOKEN_INVALID_OR_EXPIRED');
    });

    it('menolak token reset password sebagai token verifikasi email (isolasi token)', async () => {
      const { email, userId } = await createLoggedInUser();

      // Create a password reset token for this user
      const rawResetToken = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
      const resetTokenHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(rawResetToken).digest('hex');

      await prisma.passwordResetToken.create({
        data: {
          userId,
          tokenHash: resetTokenHash,
          expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 60 * 1000),
        },
      });

      // Submit reset token to email verification confirm
      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/verify-email/confirm')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({ token: rawResetToken });

      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
      expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('TOKEN_INVALID_OR_EXPIRED');

      const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
      expect(user?.emailVerifiedAt).toBeNull();
    });

    it('menolak token verifikasi email sebagai token reset password (isolasi dua arah)', async () => {
      const { email, userId } = await createLoggedInUser();

      const rawVerifyToken = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
      const verifyTokenHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(rawVerifyToken).digest('hex');

      await prisma.emailVerificationToken.create({
        data: {
          userId,
          email,
          tokenHash: verifyTokenHash,
          expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 60 * 1000),
        },
      });

      // Submit email verification token to reset-password
      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/reset-password')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({
          token: rawVerifyToken,
          newPassword: 'BrandNewPassword123!',
        });

      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
      expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('TOKEN_INVALID_OR_EXPIRED');
    });

    it('konsumsi token bersamaan (concurrent) hanya menghasilkan satu keberhasilan', async () => {
      const { cookies, userId } = await createLoggedInUser();

      await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/verify-email/request')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', cookies);

      const rawToken = __getSentTestEmails()[0].text.match(/token=([a-f0-9]+)/)![1];

      // Run 2 parallel requests
      const [res1, res2] = await Promise.all([
        request(app)
          .post('/api/auth/verify-email/confirm')
          .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
          .send({ token: rawToken }),
        request(app)
          .post('/api/auth/verify-email/confirm')
          .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
          .send({ token: rawToken }),
      ]);

      const statuses = [res1.status, res2.status].sort();
      expect(statuses).toEqual([200, 400]);
    });

    it('verifikasi email tidak mengubah password, tidak mencabut sesi, dan tidak menerbitkan sesi baru', async () => {
      const { cookies, userId, email } = await createLoggedInUser();

      const userBefore = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
      const passwordHashBefore = userBefore?.passwordHash;
      const tokenVersionBefore = userBefore?.tokenVersion;

      await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/verify-email/request')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', cookies);

      const rawToken = __getSentTestEmails()[0].text.match(/token=([a-f0-9]+)/)![1];

      const confirmRes = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/verify-email/confirm')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({ token: rawToken });

      expect(confirmRes.status).toBe(200);
      // No set-cookie header on confirm
      expect(confirmRes.headers['set-cookie']).toBeUndefined();

      const userAfter = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
      expect(userAfter?.passwordHash).toBe(passwordHashBefore);
      expect(userAfter?.tokenVersion).toBe(tokenVersionBefore);

      // Existing session remains valid
      const meRes = await request(app)
        .get('/api/auth/me')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', cookies);

      expect(meRes.status).toBe(200);
      expect(meRes.body.user.emailVerifiedAt).not.toBeNull();
    });
  });

  describe('3. Google OAuth email verified claim handling', () => {
    it('Google verified diterima dan menandai emailVerifiedAt saat email_verified true dan email cocok', async () => {
      const googleSub = `google-sub-${Date.now()}`;
      const googleEmail = `verify.google.${Date.now()}@example.com`;

      __setTestGoogleAuthMock(async () => ({
        iss: 'https://accounts.google.com',
        sub: googleSub,
        aud: 'test-client-id',
        iat: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),
        exp: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 3600,
        email: googleEmail,
        email_verified: true,
        name: 'Google Verified User',
        nonce: 'valid-test-nonce',
      }));

      const exchangeRes = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/google/exchange')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({
          code: 'mock-auth-code',
          codeVerifier: 'mock-code-verifier',
          nonce: 'valid-test-nonce',
          redirectUri: 'http://localhost:3000/api/auth/google/callback',
          intent: 'login',
        });

      expect(exchangeRes.status).toBe(200);
      expect(exchangeRes.body.user.emailVerifiedAt).not.toBeNull();

      const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email: googleEmail } });
      expect(user?.emailVerifiedAt).not.toBeNull();
    });

    it('Google link menandai akun terverifikasi jika email Google cocok persis dan email_verified true', async () => {
      const { cookies, email, userId } = await createLoggedInUser();

      const googleSub = `google-sub-link-${Date.now()}`;
      __setTestGoogleAuthMock(async () => ({
        iss: 'https://accounts.google.com',
        sub: googleSub,
        aud: 'test-client-id',
        iat: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),
        exp: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 3600,
        email, // Matches exactly
        email_verified: true,
        name: 'Linked User',
        nonce: 'valid-test-nonce',
      }));

      const linkRes = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/google/exchange')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', cookies)
        .send({
          code: 'mock-auth-code',
          codeVerifier: 'mock-code-verifier',
          nonce: 'valid-test-nonce',
          redirectUri: 'http://localhost:3000/api/auth/google/callback',
          intent: 'link',
        });

      expect(linkRes.status).toBe(200);
      expect(linkRes.body.user.emailVerifiedAt).not.toBeNull();

      const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
      expect(user?.emailVerifiedAt).not.toBeNull();
    });
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterAll } from 'vitest';
import request from 'supertest';
import { createApp } from '../app.js';
import { prisma } from '@studyflow/database';
import { COOKIE_NAMES } from '@studyflow/shared';
import { __setTestGoogleAuthMock } from '../services/googleAuth.service.js';

describe('Google OAuth Integration & Security Tests', () => {
  const app = createApp();
  const TRUSTED_ORIGIN = 'http://localhost:3000';

  beforeEach(async () => {
    // Reset test mock before each test
    __setTestGoogleAuthMock(null);

    // Clean up test data
    await prisma.federatedIdentity.deleteMany({
      where: {
        OR: [
          { email: { contains: 'google.test.' } },
          { email: { contains: 'existing.password.' } },
        ],
      },
    });
    await prisma.user.deleteMany({
      where: {
        OR: [
          { email: { contains: 'google.test.' } },
          { email: { contains: 'existing.password.' } },
        ],
      },
    });
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    __setTestGoogleAuthMock(null);
    await prisma.federatedIdentity.deleteMany({
      where: {
        OR: [
          { email: { contains: 'google.test.' } },
          { email: { contains: 'existing.password.' } },
        ],
      },
    });
    await prisma.user.deleteMany({
      where: {
        OR: [
          { email: { contains: 'google.test.' } },
          { email: { contains: 'existing.password.' } },
        ],
      },
    });
    await prisma.$disconnect();
  });

  it('GET /api/auth/google/status should return configured status', async () => {
    const res = await request(app).get('/api/auth/google/status');
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body).toHaveProperty('configured');
    expect(typeof res.body.configured).toBe('boolean');
  });

  it('GET /api/auth/google/url should generate PKCE authorization params with S256 challenge', async () => {
    const res = await request(app).get('/api/auth/google/url');
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.url).toContain('https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth');
    expect(res.body.url).toContain('code_challenge_method=S256');
    expect(res.body.state).toBeDefined();
    expect(res.body.nonce).toBeDefined();
    expect(res.body.codeVerifier).toBeDefined();
  });

  it('Should register new user via Google, issue StudyFlow session, and support re-login with same identity', async () => {
    const mockGoogleSub = `sub_${Date.now()}`;
    const mockEmail = `google.test.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
    const mockNonce = 'test-nonce-123';

    __setTestGoogleAuthMock(async (code) => {
      if (code === 'valid-auth-code') {
        return {
          iss: 'https://accounts.google.com',
          sub: mockGoogleSub,
          aud: 'test-client-id',
          iat: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),
          exp: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 3600,
          email: mockEmail,
          email_verified: true,
          name: 'Mahasiswa Google Baru',
          nonce: mockNonce,
        };
      }
      return null;
    });

    // 1. Initial Google sign-in (Registration)
    const res1 = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/google/exchange')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        code: 'valid-auth-code',
        codeVerifier: 'mock-verifier',
        nonce: mockNonce,
        redirectUri: 'http://localhost:3000/api/auth/google/callback',
        intent: 'login',
      });

    expect(res1.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res1.body.user).toBeDefined();
    expect(res1.body.user.email).toBe(mockEmail);
    expect(res1.body.user.name).toBe('Mahasiswa Google Baru');
    expect(res1.body.user.hasPassword).toBe(false);
    expect(res1.body.user.providers).toContain('google');
    expect(res1.body.accessToken).toBeDefined();

    // Verify Set-Cookie headers for access token and refresh token
    const cookies1 = res1.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];
    expect(cookies1).toBeDefined();
    expect(cookies1.some((c) => c.includes(COOKIE_NAMES.accessToken))).toBe(true);
    expect(cookies1.some((c) => c.includes(COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken))).toBe(true);

    const createdUserId = res1.body.user.id;

    // 2. Subsequent Google sign-in (Re-login) should resolve to the SAME user without duplication
    const res2 = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/google/exchange')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        code: 'valid-auth-code',
        codeVerifier: 'mock-verifier',
        nonce: mockNonce,
        redirectUri: 'http://localhost:3000/api/auth/google/callback',
        intent: 'login',
      });

    expect(res2.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res2.body.user.id).toBe(createdUserId);
    expect(res2.body.user.email).toBe(mockEmail);

    // Verify only ONE user and ONE federated identity exists
    const usersCount = await prisma.user.count({ where: { email: mockEmail } });
    expect(usersCount).toBe(1);

    const identitiesCount = await prisma.federatedIdentity.count({
      where: { provider: 'google', subject: mockGoogleSub },
    });
    expect(identitiesCount).toBe(1);
  });

  it('Should reject automatic merging when email already exists with password', async () => {
    const existingEmail = `existing.password.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
    const password = 'PasswordAman1234!';

    // Register existing user with password
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Existing Password User',
        email: existingEmail,
        password,
      });

    const mockNonce = 'test-nonce-conflict';
    __setTestGoogleAuthMock(async () => ({
      iss: 'https://accounts.google.com',
      sub: `unlinked_sub_${Date.now()}`,
      aud: 'test-client-id',
      iat: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),
      exp: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 3600,
      email: existingEmail,
      email_verified: true,
      name: 'Google Impersonator',
      nonce: mockNonce,
    }));

    // Attempt to login with Google for an unlinked email
    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/google/exchange')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        code: 'any-code',
        codeVerifier: 'any-verifier',
        nonce: mockNonce,
        redirectUri: 'http://localhost:3000/api/auth/google/callback',
        intent: 'login',
      });

    expect(res.status).toBe(409);
    expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('ACCOUNT_NOT_LINKED');
    expect(res.body.error.message).toContain('sudah terdaftar menggunakan password');

    // Verify identity was NOT linked automatically
    const identity = await prisma.federatedIdentity.findFirst({
      where: { email: existingEmail },
    });
    expect(identity).toBeNull();
  });

  it('Should link Google account after re-authentication and reject mismatched email or foreign identity', async () => {
    const userEmail = `existing.password.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
    const password = 'PasswordAman1234!';

    // Register and login user
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'User To Link',
        email: userEmail,
        password,
      });

    const loginRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: userEmail,
        password,
      });

    const userAccessToken = loginRes.body.accessToken;
    expect(userAccessToken).toBeDefined();

    // 1. Re-authentication test with wrong password should fail
    const badReauthRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/google/link/init')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${userAccessToken}`)
      .send({ currentPassword: 'WrongPassword999!' });

    expect(badReauthRes.status).toBe(400);
    expect(badReauthRes.body.error.code).toBe('INVALID_CURRENT_PASSWORD');

    // 2. Re-authentication test with correct password succeeds
    const goodReauthRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/google/link/init')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${userAccessToken}`)
      .send({ currentPassword: password });

    expect(goodReauthRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(goodReauthRes.body.codeVerifier).toBeDefined();

    const googleSub = `link_sub_${Date.now()}`;
    const nonce = 'link-nonce-123';

    // 3. Reject linking if Google email does not match user account email
    __setTestGoogleAuthMock(async () => ({
      iss: 'https://accounts.google.com',
      sub: googleSub,
      aud: 'test-client-id',
      iat: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),
      exp: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 3600,
      email: 'different.email@example.com',
      email_verified: true,
      name: 'Different Email Google',
      nonce,
    }));

    const mismatchRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/google/exchange')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${userAccessToken}`)
      .send({
        code: 'mismatch-code',
        codeVerifier: 'verifier',
        nonce,
        redirectUri: 'http://localhost:3000/api/auth/google/callback',
        intent: 'link',
      });

    expect(mismatchRes.status).toBe(400);
    expect(mismatchRes.body.error.code).toBe('EMAIL_MISMATCH');

    // 4. Successful linking when Google email matches user account email
    __setTestGoogleAuthMock(async () => ({
      iss: 'https://accounts.google.com',
      sub: googleSub,
      aud: 'test-client-id',
      iat: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),
      exp: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 3600,
      email: userEmail,
      email_verified: true,
      name: 'Matching Email Google',
      nonce,
    }));

    const linkSuccessRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/google/exchange')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${userAccessToken}`)
      .send({
        code: 'link-code',
        codeVerifier: 'verifier',
        nonce,
        redirectUri: 'http://localhost:3000/api/auth/google/callback',
        intent: 'link',
      });

    expect(linkSuccessRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(linkSuccessRes.body.user.providers).toContain('google');
    expect(linkSuccessRes.body.user.hasPassword).toBe(true);

    // 5. Subsequent attempt to link the SAME Google identity to a DIFFERENT user is rejected
    const otherEmail = `existing.password.${Date.now()}_other@example.com`;
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Other User',
        email: otherEmail,
        password,
      });

    const otherLogin = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({ email: otherEmail, password });

    const otherToken = otherLogin.body.accessToken;

    __setTestGoogleAuthMock(async () => ({
      iss: 'https://accounts.google.com',
      sub: googleSub, // same sub already linked to first user!
      aud: 'test-client-id',
      iat: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),
      exp: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 3600,
      email: otherEmail,
      email_verified: true,
      name: 'Hijacker',
      nonce,
    }));

    const foreignLinkRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/google/exchange')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${otherToken}`)
      .send({
        code: 'hijack-code',
        codeVerifier: 'verifier',
        nonce,
        redirectUri: 'http://localhost:3000/api/auth/google/callback',
        intent: 'link',
      });

    expect(foreignLinkRes.status).toBe(409);
    expect(foreignLinkRes.body.error.code).toBe('IDENTITY_ALREADY_LINKED');
  });

  it('Should reject invalid nonce, unverified email, or expired/rejected provider code', async () => {
    // 1. Nonce mismatch
    __setTestGoogleAuthMock(async () => ({
      iss: 'https://accounts.google.com',
      sub: 'sub-nonce-test',
      aud: 'test-client-id',
      iat: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),
      exp: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 3600,
      email: 'test@example.com',
      email_verified: true,
      nonce: 'wrong-nonce',
    }));

    const res1 = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/google/exchange')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        code: 'code',
        codeVerifier: 'verifier',
        nonce: 'expected-nonce',
        redirectUri: 'http://localhost:3000/api/auth/google/callback',
        intent: 'login',
      });

    expect(res1.status).toBe(400);
    expect(res1.body.error.code).toBe('OAUTH_NONCE_MISMATCH');

    // 2. Unverified email
    __setTestGoogleAuthMock(async () => ({
      iss: 'https://accounts.google.com',
      sub: 'sub-unverified-test',
      aud: 'test-client-id',
      iat: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),
      exp: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 3600,
      email: 'unverified@example.com',
      email_verified: false,
      nonce: 'valid-nonce',
    }));

    const res2 = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/google/exchange')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        code: 'code',
        codeVerifier: 'verifier',
        nonce: 'valid-nonce',
        redirectUri: 'http://localhost:3000/api/auth/google/callback',
        intent: 'login',
      });

    expect(res2.status).toBe(400);
    expect(res2.body.error.code).toBe('EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED');

    // 3. Provider error (code invalid or expired)
    __setTestGoogleAuthMock(async () => null);

    const res3 = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/google/exchange')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        code: 'expired-or-bad-code',
        codeVerifier: 'verifier',
        nonce: 'valid-nonce',
        redirectUri: 'http://localhost:3000/api/auth/google/callback',
        intent: 'login',
      });

    expect(res3.status).toBe(400);
    expect(res3.body.error.code).toBe('OAUTH_PROVIDER_ERROR');
  });

  it('Google-only user should not crash when attempting password login or password change', async () => {
    const googleEmail = `google.test.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
    const googleSub = `sub_pwdless_${Date.now()}`;
    const nonce = 'pwdless-nonce';

    __setTestGoogleAuthMock(async () => ({
      iss: 'https://accounts.google.com',
      sub: googleSub,
      aud: 'test-client-id',
      iat: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),
      exp: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 3600,
      email: googleEmail,
      email_verified: true,
      name: 'Passwordless User',
      nonce,
    }));

    // Register via Google
    const registerRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/google/exchange')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        code: 'code',
        codeVerifier: 'verifier',
        nonce,
        redirectUri: 'http://localhost:3000/api/auth/google/callback',
        intent: 'login',
      });

    expect(registerRes.status).toBe(200);
    const googleAccessToken = registerRes.body.accessToken;

    // 1. Password login attempt should return generic 401 without crashing
    const loginAttempt = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: googleEmail,
        password: 'RandomPassword123!',
      });

    expect(loginAttempt.status).toBe(401);
    expect(loginAttempt.body.error.code).toBe('INVALID_CREDENTIALS');

    // 2. Change password attempt should gracefully reject without crashing
    const changePwdAttempt = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/change-password')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${googleAccessToken}`)
      .send({
        currentPassword: 'RandomPassword123!',
        newPassword: 'NewStrongPassword123!',
      });

    expect(changePwdAttempt.status).toBe(400);
    expect(changePwdAttempt.body.error.code).toBe('PASSWORD_NOT_SET');
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterAll } from 'vitest';
import request from 'supertest';
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import { createApp } from '../app.js';
import { prisma } from '@studyflow/database';
import { COOKIE_NAMES } from '@studyflow/shared';
import {
  __getSentTestEmails,
  __clearSentTestEmails,
  __setMockEmailFailure,
} from '../services/email.service.js';
import { hashPassword } from '../services/password.service.js';

describe('Password Reset Integration & Security Tests', () => {
  const app = createApp();
  const TRUSTED_ORIGIN = 'http://localhost:3000';

  const cleanUsers = async () => {
    await prisma.passwordResetToken.deleteMany({
      where: {
        user: {
          email: { contains: 'pwreset.' },
        },
      },
    });
    await prisma.refreshSession.deleteMany({
      where: {
        user: {
          email: { contains: 'pwreset.' },
        },
      },
    });
    await prisma.federatedIdentity.deleteMany({
      where: {
        user: {
          email: { contains: 'pwreset.' },
        },
      },
    });
    await prisma.user.deleteMany({
      where: {
        email: { contains: 'pwreset.' },
      },
    });
  };

  beforeEach(async () => {
    __clearSentTestEmails();
    await cleanUsers();
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    __clearSentTestEmails();
    await cleanUsers();
    await prisma.$disconnect();
  });

  describe('1. POST /api/auth/forgot-password', () => {
    it('mengirim email reset untuk akun dengan password lokal dan menyimpan hash token', async () => {
      const email = `pwreset.local.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
      const user = await prisma.user.create({
        data: {
          name: 'Local User',
          email,
          passwordHash: await hashPassword('CurrentValidPassword123!'),
        },
      });

      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/forgot-password')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({ email });

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.body.message).toBe(
        'Jika akun memenuhi syarat, tautan reset password akan dikirim ke email tersebut.'
      );

      // Verify email was sent via mock
      const sentEmails = __getSentTestEmails();
      expect(sentEmails).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(sentEmails[0].to).toBe(email);
      expect(sentEmails[0].subject).toContain('Atur Ulang Kata Sandi');
      expect(sentEmails[0].text).toContain('/reset-password?token=');

      // Verify token in database is hashed (never plain token)
      const urlMatch = sentEmails[0].text.match(/token=([a-f0-9]{64})/);
      expect(urlMatch).not.toBeNull();
      const rawToken = urlMatch![1];
      const tokenHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(rawToken).digest('hex');

      const dbToken = await prisma.passwordResetToken.findUnique({
        where: { tokenHash },
      });
      expect(dbToken).toBeDefined();
      expect(dbToken?.userId).toBe(user.id);
      expect(dbToken?.usedAt).toBeNull();
      expect(new Date(dbToken!.expiresAt).getTime()).toBeGreaterThan(Date.now());
    });

    it('mengembalikan respons identik untuk email yang tidak terdaftar tanpa mengirim email', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/forgot-password')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({ email: 'pwreset.nonexistent@example.com' });

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.body.message).toBe(
        'Jika akun memenuhi syarat, tautan reset password akan dikirim ke email tersebut.'
      );

      expect(__getSentTestEmails()).toHaveLength(0);
    });

    it('mengembalikan respons identik untuk akun Google-only tanpa mengirim email reset', async () => {
      const email = `pwreset.googleonly.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
      const googleUser = await prisma.user.create({
        data: {
          name: 'Google Only User',
          email,
          passwordHash: null,
          federatedIdentities: {
            create: {
              provider: 'google',
              subject: `g-sub-${Date.now()}`,
              email,
            },
          },
        },
      });

      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/forgot-password')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({ email });

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.body.message).toBe(
        'Jika akun memenuhi syarat, tautan reset password akan dikirim ke email tersebut.'
      );

      expect(__getSentTestEmails()).toHaveLength(0);
      const tokens = await prisma.passwordResetToken.findMany({
        where: { userId: googleUser.id },
      });
      expect(tokens).toHaveLength(0);
    });

    it('mengizinkan reset untuk akun password yang juga terhubung ke Google', async () => {
      const email = `pwreset.hybrid.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
      await prisma.user.create({
        data: {
          name: 'Hybrid User',
          email,
          passwordHash: await hashPassword('LocalPass12345!'),
          federatedIdentities: {
            create: {
              provider: 'google',
              subject: `g-hybrid-${Date.now()}`,
              email,
            },
          },
        },
      });

      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/forgot-password')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({ email });

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(__getSentTestEmails()).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(__getSentTestEmails()[0].to).toBe(email);
    });

    it('menerapkan cooldown: pengiriman dalam rentang 60 detik tidak menduplikasi email atau token aktif', async () => {
      const email = `pwreset.cooldown.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
      const user = await prisma.user.create({
        data: {
          name: 'Cooldown User',
          email,
          passwordHash: await hashPassword('LocalPass12345!'),
        },
      });

      // Request 1
      const res1 = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/forgot-password')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({ email });
      expect(res1.status).toBe(200);
      expect(__getSentTestEmails()).toHaveLength(1);

      // Request 2 immediately
      const res2 = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/forgot-password')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({ email });
      expect(res2.status).toBe(200);
      // Masih 1 email terkirim (cooldown mencegah spam)
      expect(__getSentTestEmails()).toHaveLength(1);

      const activeTokens = await prisma.passwordResetToken.findMany({
        where: { userId: user.id, usedAt: null },
      });
      expect(activeTokens).toHaveLength(1);
    });

    it('resend membatalkan token sebelumnya jika dibuat di luar cooldown', async () => {
      const email = `pwreset.resend.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
      const user = await prisma.user.create({
        data: {
          name: 'Resend User',
          email,
          passwordHash: await hashPassword('LocalPass12345!'),
        },
      });

      // Create previous token created 2 minutes ago
      const oldRawToken = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
      const oldTokenHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(oldRawToken).digest('hex');
      const oldToken = await prisma.passwordResetToken.create({
        data: {
          userId: user.id,
          tokenHash: oldTokenHash,
          expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 28 * 60_000),
          createdAt: new Date(Date.now() - 120_000), // 2 minutes ago
        },
      });

      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/forgot-password')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({ email });

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(__getSentTestEmails()).toHaveLength(1);

      // Old token must be invalidated (usedAt not null)
      const refreshedOldToken = await prisma.passwordResetToken.findUnique({
        where: { id: oldToken.id },
      });
      expect(refreshedOldToken?.usedAt).not.toBeNull();

      // Only the new token is active
      const activeTokens = await prisma.passwordResetToken.findMany({
        where: { userId: user.id, usedAt: null },
      });
      expect(activeTokens).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(activeTokens[0].id).not.toBe(oldToken.id);
    });

    it('kegagalan pengiriman email dicatat aman dan tetap mengembalikan pesan generik yang sama', async () => {
      const email = `pwreset.smtpfail.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
      await prisma.user.create({
        data: {
          name: 'SMTP Fail User',
          email,
          passwordHash: await hashPassword('LocalPass12345!'),
        },
      });

      __setMockEmailFailure(new Error('Koneksi SMTP terputus (Mock Error)'));

      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/forgot-password')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({ email });

      // Tetap 200 dengan pesan generik
      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.body.message).toBe(
        'Jika akun memenuhi syarat, tautan reset password akan dikirim ke email tersebut.'
      );
    });
  });

  describe('2. POST /api/auth/reset-password', () => {
    it('berhasil mereset password, membatalkan token, dan mencabut seluruh sesi aktif', async () => {
      const email = `pwreset.consume.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
      const initialPassword = 'OldSecurePassword123!';
      const newPassword = 'NewBrandSecurePassword456!';

      const user = await prisma.user.create({
        data: {
          name: 'Reset Consumer',
          email,
          passwordHash: await hashPassword(initialPassword),
          tokenVersion: 1,
        },
      });

      // Login to obtain active session
      const loginRes = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/login')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({ email, password: initialPassword });
      expect(loginRes.status).toBe(200);
      const cookies = loginRes.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];
      expect(cookies).toBeDefined();

      // Request reset token
      const forgotRes = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/forgot-password')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({ email });
      expect(forgotRes.status).toBe(200);

      const sentEmails = __getSentTestEmails();
      const rawToken = sentEmails[0].text.match(/token=([a-f0-9]{64})/)![1];

      // Submit password reset
      const resetRes = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/reset-password')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({
          token: rawToken,
          newPassword,
        });

      expect(resetRes.status).toBe(200);
      expect(resetRes.body.message).toContain('berhasil diatur ulang');

      // 1. Password lama sekarang harus ditolak
      const oldLogin = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/login')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({ email, password: initialPassword });
      expect(oldLogin.status).toBe(401);

      // 2. Password baru berhasil login
      const newLogin = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/login')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({ email, password: newPassword });
      expect(newLogin.status).toBe(200);

      // 3. Token sekali pakai: percobaan kedua dengan token sama harus ditolak
      const replayRes = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/reset-password')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({
          token: rawToken,
          newPassword: 'AnotherNewPassword789!',
        });
      expect(replayRes.status).toBe(400);
      expect(replayRes.body.error.code).toBe('TOKEN_INVALID_OR_EXPIRED');

      // 4. Sesi lama dicabut: refresh token lama ditolak
      const refreshRes = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/refresh')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', cookies)
        .send();
      expect(refreshRes.status).toBe(401);

      // 5. Token version dinaikkan
      const updatedUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: user.id } });
      expect(updatedUser?.tokenVersion).toBeGreaterThan(1);
    });

    it('menolak token yang kedaluwarsa (>30 menit)', async () => {
      const email = `pwreset.expired.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
      const user = await prisma.user.create({
        data: {
          name: 'Expired Token User',
          email,
          passwordHash: await hashPassword('LocalPass12345!'),
        },
      });

      const rawToken = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
      const tokenHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(rawToken).digest('hex');

      await prisma.passwordResetToken.create({
        data: {
          userId: user.id,
          tokenHash,
          expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() - 1000), // Expired 1 second ago
        },
      });

      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/reset-password')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({
          token: rawToken,
          newPassword: 'BrandNewValidPassword123!',
        });

      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
      expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('TOKEN_INVALID_OR_EXPIRED');
    });

    it('menolak token yang tidak ada / invalid', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/reset-password')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({
          token: 'invalid-nonexistent-token-with-minimum-length-32-chars-12345678',
          newPassword: 'BrandNewValidPassword123!',
        });

      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
      expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('TOKEN_INVALID_OR_EXPIRED');
    });

    it('dua konsumsi token bersamaan (parallel race condition) menghasilkan tepat 1 keberhasilan', async () => {
      const email = `pwreset.race.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
      const user = await prisma.user.create({
        data: {
          name: 'Race User',
          email,
          passwordHash: await hashPassword('InitPass123456!'),
        },
      });

      const rawToken = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
      const tokenHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(rawToken).digest('hex');

      await prisma.passwordResetToken.create({
        data: {
          userId: user.id,
          tokenHash,
          expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 60_000),
        },
      });

      // Send 2 concurrent requests with the identical token
      const [res1, res2] = await Promise.all([
        request(app)
          .post('/api/auth/reset-password')
          .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
          .send({ token: rawToken, newPassword: 'WinnerPassword123!' }),
        request(app)
          .post('/api/auth/reset-password')
          .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
          .send({ token: rawToken, newPassword: 'SecondWinnerPassword123!' }),
      ]);

      const statuses = [res1.status, res2.status].sort();
      // Exactly one request must succeed (200), and the other must be rejected (400)
      expect(statuses).toEqual([200, 400]);

      // Exactly one consumed token
      const token = await prisma.passwordResetToken.findUnique({ where: { tokenHash } });
      expect(token?.usedAt).not.toBeNull();
    });

    it('pengubahan password melalui Settings (change-password) membatalkan token reset yang masih aktif', async () => {
      const email = `pwreset.settings.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
      const initialPass = 'SettingsInitialPassword123!';
      const newSettingsPass = 'SettingsNewPassword456!';

      const user = await prisma.user.create({
        data: {
          name: 'Settings Invalidate User',
          email,
          passwordHash: await hashPassword(initialPass),
        },
      });

      // Login to get access token
      const loginRes = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/login')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({ email, password: initialPass });
      const accessToken = loginRes.body.accessToken;

      // Create an active reset token
      const rawToken = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
      const tokenHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(rawToken).digest('hex');
      await prisma.passwordResetToken.create({
        data: {
          userId: user.id,
          tokenHash,
          expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 60_000),
        },
      });

      // Change password through Settings endpoint
      const changeRes = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/change-password')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Authorization', `Bearer ${accessToken}`)
        .send({
          currentPassword: initialPass,
          newPassword: newSettingsPass,
        });
      expect(changeRes.status).toBe(200);

      // Verify the active reset token was automatically invalidated
      const resetTokenDb = await prisma.passwordResetToken.findUnique({
        where: { tokenHash },
      });
      expect(resetTokenDb?.usedAt).not.toBeNull();

      // Attempting to consume this token now must be rejected
      const resetAttempt = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/reset-password')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({
          token: rawToken,
          newPassword: 'AttemptAfterSettingsPasswordChange123!',
        });
      expect(resetAttempt.status).toBe(400);
      expect(resetAttempt.body.error.code).toBe('TOKEN_INVALID_OR_EXPIRED');
    });
  });
});
