import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import request from 'supertest';
import { createApp } from '../app.js';
import { prisma } from '@studyflow/database';

describe('Pinned Items Endpoints & Business Invariants', () => {
  const app = createApp();
  const TRUSTED_ORIGIN = 'http://localhost:3000';

  let userAId: string;
  let userBId: string;
  let cookieA: string[];
  let cookieB: string[];

  let semA1Id: string;
  let semA2Id: string;
  let courseA1Id: string;
  let courseA2Id: string;

  beforeEach(async () => {
    await prisma.user.deleteMany({
      where: { email: { contains: 'test.pin.' } },
    });

    // 1. Create User A
    const emailA = `test.pin.a.${Date.now()}.${Math.random()}@example.com`;
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Pin User A',
        email: emailA,
        password: 'PasswordKuat123!',
      });

    const loginA = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: emailA,
        password: 'PasswordKuat123!',
      });
    userAId = loginA.body.user.id;
    cookieA = loginA.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];

    // 2. Create User B
    const emailB = `test.pin.b.${Date.now()}.${Math.random()}@example.com`;
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Pin User B',
        email: emailB,
        password: 'PasswordKuat123!',
      });

    const loginB = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: emailB,
        password: 'PasswordKuat123!',
      });
    userBId = loginB.body.user.id;
    cookieB = loginB.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];

    // 3. User A Semesters & Courses
    const semA1Res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/semesters')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ name: 'Semester Gasal', academicYear: '2026/2027', makeActive: true });
    semA1Id = semA1Res.body.semester.id;

    const semA2Res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/semesters')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ name: 'Semester Genap', academicYear: '2026/2027', makeActive: false });
    semA2Id = semA2Res.body.semester.id;

    const crsA1Res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/courses')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ semesterId: semA1Id, name: 'Struktur Data', code: 'CS201' });
    courseA1Id = crsA1Res.body.course.id;

    const crsA2Res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/courses')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ semesterId: semA2Id, name: 'Basis Data', code: 'CS202' });
    courseA2Id = crsA2Res.body.course.id;
  });

  it('1. Pin and unpin material and note successfully, without updating item updatedAt', async () => {
    // Create Material for User A
    const material = await prisma.material.create({
      data: {
        userId: userAId,
        courseId: courseA1Id,
        title: 'Slide Struktur Data 01',
        originalFilename: 'slide-01.pdf',
        storageKey: `materials/${userAId}/slide-01.pdf`,
        bytes: 1024,
        status: 'READY',
      },
    });

    // Create Note for User A
    const note = await prisma.note.create({
      data: {
        userId: userAId,
        courseId: courseA1Id,
        title: 'Ringkasan Tree & Graph',
        content: 'Konten penting',
      },
    });

    const initialMaterialUpdatedAt = material.updatedAt.getTime();
    const initialNoteUpdatedAt = note.updatedAt.getTime();

    // Pin Material
    const pinMatRes = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/materials/${material.id}/pin`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ pinned: true });

    expect(pinMatRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(pinMatRes.body.success).toBe(true);
    expect(pinMatRes.body.pinned).toBe(true);
    expect(pinMatRes.body.pinnedAt).toBeDefined();

    // Pin Note
    const pinNoteRes = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/notes/${note.id}/pin`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ pinned: true });

    expect(pinNoteRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(pinNoteRes.body.success).toBe(true);
    expect(pinNoteRes.body.pinned).toBe(true);

    // Verify updatedAt did not change on Material or Note
    const freshMaterial = await prisma.material.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: material.id } });
    const freshNote = await prisma.note.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: note.id } });
    expect(freshMaterial.updatedAt.getTime()).toBe(initialMaterialUpdatedAt);
    expect(freshNote.updatedAt.getTime()).toBe(initialNoteUpdatedAt);

    // Verify list endpoint includes isPinned
    const matListRes = await request(app)
      .get('/api/materials')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);
    expect(matListRes.status).toBe(200);
    const targetMat = matListRes.body.materials.find((m: any) => m.id === material.id);
    expect(targetMat.isPinned).toBe(true);

    const noteListRes = await request(app)
      .get('/api/notes')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);
    expect(noteListRes.status).toBe(200);
    const targetNote = noteListRes.body.notes.find((n: any) => n.id === note.id);
    expect(targetNote.isPinned).toBe(true);

    // Unpin Material
    const unpinMatRes = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/materials/${material.id}/pin`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ pinned: false });
    expect(unpinMatRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(unpinMatRes.body.pinned).toBe(false);

    // Unpin Note
    const unpinNoteRes = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/notes/${note.id}/pin`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ pinned: false });
    expect(unpinNoteRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(unpinNoteRes.body.pinned).toBe(false);
  });

  it('2. Tenant isolation: cannot pin other user items (404)', async () => {
    // User A material & note
    const material = await prisma.material.create({
      data: {
        userId: userAId,
        courseId: courseA1Id,
        title: 'Private Slide A',
        originalFilename: 'priv.pdf',
        storageKey: `materials/${userAId}/priv.pdf`,
        bytes: 1024,
        status: 'READY',
      },
    });

    const note = await prisma.note.create({
      data: {
        userId: userAId,
        courseId: courseA1Id,
        title: 'Private Note A',
        content: 'Secret',
      },
    });

    // User B tries to pin User A's material
    const resMat = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/materials/${material.id}/pin`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB)
      .send({ pinned: true });
    expect(resMat.status).toBe(404);

    // User B tries to pin User A's note
    const resNote = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/notes/${note.id}/pin`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB)
      .send({ pinned: true });
    expect(resNote.status).toBe(404);
  });

  it('3. Idempotency: repeated requests with same state return success without duplicate entries', async () => {
    const note = await prisma.note.create({
      data: {
        userId: userAId,
        courseId: courseA1Id,
        title: 'Idempotency Note',
      },
    });

    // Pin first time
    const res1 = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/notes/${note.id}/pin`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ pinned: true });
    expect(res1.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res1.body.pinned).toBe(true);

    // Pin second time (same true)
    const res2 = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/notes/${note.id}/pin`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ pinned: true });
    expect(res2.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res2.body.pinned).toBe(true);

    // Verify count in DB is exactly 1
    const count = await prisma.pinnedItem.count({
      where: { userId: userAId, noteId: note.id },
    });
    expect(count).toBe(1);

    // Unpin first time
    const res3 = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/notes/${note.id}/pin`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ pinned: false });
    expect(res3.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res3.body.pinned).toBe(false);

    // Unpin second time
    const res4 = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/notes/${note.id}/pin`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ pinned: false });
    expect(res4.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res4.body.pinned).toBe(false);
  });

  it('4. Maximum 20 combined items per user enforced, even under concurrent requests', async () => {
    // Create 21 notes for User A
    const notes = await Promise.all(
      Array.from({ length: 22 }, (_, i) =>
        prisma.note.create({
          data: {
            userId: userAId,
            courseId: courseA1Id,
            title: `Note Item ${i + 1}`,
          },
        })
      )
    );

    // Pin 19 items sequentially
    for (let i = 0; i < 19; i++) {
      const res = await request(app)
        .patch(`/api/notes/${notes[i].id}/pin`)
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', cookieA)
        .send({ pinned: true });
      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    }

    // Attempt to pin 3 items simultaneously (parallel requests for slots 20, 21, 22)
    const parallelResponses = await Promise.all([
      request(app)
        .patch(`/api/notes/${notes[19].id}/pin`)
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', cookieA)
        .send({ pinned: true }),
      request(app)
        .patch(`/api/notes/${notes[20].id}/pin`)
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', cookieA)
        .send({ pinned: true }),
      request(app)
        .patch(`/api/notes/${notes[21].id}/pin`)
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', cookieA)
        .send({ pinned: true }),
    ]);

    const successes = parallelResponses.filter((r) => r.status === 200);
    const failures = parallelResponses.filter((r) => r.status === 400);

    // Exactly 1 can take the 20th slot; the other 2 must fail with PIN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
    expect(successes.length).toBe(1);
    expect(failures.length).toBe(2);
    expect(failures[0].body.error.code).toBe('PIN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED');

    // Total pinned items in DB must be exactly 20
    const totalCount = await prisma.pinnedItem.count({ where: { userId: userAId } });
    expect(totalCount).toBe(20);
  });

  it('5. Dashboard pinned endpoint filters by semester and preserves general notes', async () => {
    // Material in Semester 1
    const matSem1 = await prisma.material.create({
      data: {
        userId: userAId,
        courseId: courseA1Id,
        title: 'Materi Sem 1',
        originalFilename: 'sem1.pdf',
        storageKey: `materials/${userAId}/sem1.pdf`,
        bytes: 1024,
        status: 'READY',
      },
    });

    // Material in Semester 2
    const matSem2 = await prisma.material.create({
      data: {
        userId: userAId,
        courseId: courseA2Id,
        title: 'Materi Sem 2',
        originalFilename: 'sem2.pdf',
        storageKey: `materials/${userAId}/sem2.pdf`,
        bytes: 1024,
        status: 'READY',
      },
    });

    // Note in Semester 1
    const noteSem1 = await prisma.note.create({
      data: {
        userId: userAId,
        courseId: courseA1Id,
        title: 'Catatan Sem 1',
      },
    });

    // Pin all three
    await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/materials/${matSem1.id}/pin`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ pinned: true });

    await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/materials/${matSem2.id}/pin`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ pinned: true });

    await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/notes/${noteSem1.id}/pin`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ pinned: true });

    // Request dashboard pinned with semesterId = semA1Id
    const resSem1 = await request(app)
      .get(`/api/dashboard/pinned?semesterId=${semA1Id}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);

    expect(resSem1.status).toBe(200);
    expect(resSem1.body.items).toBeDefined();
    const titles = resSem1.body.items.map((i: any) => i.title);
    expect(titles).toContain('Materi Sem 1');
    expect(titles).toContain('Catatan Sem 1');
    expect(titles).not.toContain('Materi Sem 2');

    // Request dashboard pinned without semesterId: returns all non-archived pinned items
    const resAll = await request(app)
      .get('/api/dashboard/pinned')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);

    expect(resAll.status).toBe(200);
    expect(resAll.body.items.length).toBe(3);
  });

  it('6. Deletion and archiving rules: deleted materials and archived courses are excluded', async () => {
    const mat = await prisma.material.create({
      data: {
        userId: userAId,
        courseId: courseA1Id,
        title: 'Materi Akan Dihapus',
        originalFilename: 'del.pdf',
        storageKey: `materials/${userAId}/del.pdf`,
        bytes: 1024,
        status: 'READY',
      },
    });

    // Pin it
    await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/materials/${mat.id}/pin`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ pinned: true });

    // Soft delete material
    await prisma.material.update({
      where: { id: mat.id },
      data: { deletedAt: new Date() },
    });

    // Query dashboard pinned: should NOT contain soft-deleted material
    const resDashboard = await request(app)
      .get('/api/dashboard/pinned')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);
    expect(resDashboard.status).toBe(200);
    const found = resDashboard.body.items.find((i: any) => i.targetId === mat.id);
    expect(found).toBeUndefined();

    // Trying to pin a soft-deleted material returns 404
    const resRePin = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/materials/${mat.id}/pin`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ pinned: true });
    expect(resRePin.status).toBe(404);
  });
});

<file path="apps/api/src/test/quizConcurrency.test.ts">
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import request from 'supertest';
import { createApp } from '../app.js';
import { prisma } from '@studyflow/database';
import {
  startOrResumeQuizAttempt,
  saveQuizDraftAnswers,
  submitQuizAttempt,
  getQuizAttemptResult,
} from '../services/learning.service.js';

describe('Quiz Attempt Concurrency & Idempotency Tests', () => {
  const app = createApp();
  const TRUSTED_ORIGIN = 'http://localhost:3000';

  let userAId: string;
  let userBId: string;
  let cookieA: string[];
  let cookieB: string[];
  let semAId: string;
  let courseAId: string;
  let materialAId: string;
  let quizAId: string;
  let q1Id: string;
  let q2Id: string;

  beforeEach(async () => {
    await prisma.user.deleteMany({
      where: { email: { contains: 'test.quizconcurrency.' } },
    });

    // Create User A
    const emailA = `test.quizconcurrency.a.${Date.now()}.${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}@example.com`;
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Quiz Concurrency User A',
        email: emailA,
        password: 'PasswordSangatKuat123!',
      });
    const loginA = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: emailA,
        password: 'PasswordSangatKuat123!',
      });
    userAId = loginA.body.user.id;
    cookieA = loginA.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];

    // Create User B
    const emailB = `test.quizconcurrency.b.${Date.now()}.${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}@example.com`;
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Quiz Concurrency User B',
        email: emailB,
        password: 'PasswordSangatKuat123!',
      });
    const loginB = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: emailB,
        password: 'PasswordSangatKuat123!',
      });
    userBId = loginB.body.user.id;
    cookieB = loginB.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];

    // Create Semester & Course for User A
    const semResA = await request(app)
      .post('/api/semesters')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ name: 'Semester Ganjil 2026', academicYear: '2026/2027' });
    semAId = semResA.body.semester.id;

    const courseResA = await request(app)
      .post('/api/courses')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ semesterId: semAId, name: 'Struktur Data & Algoritma', code: 'IF2110' });
    courseAId = courseResA.body.course.id;

    // Create READY Material with extracted pages for User A
    const mat = await prisma.material.create({
      data: {
        userId: userAId,
        courseId: courseAId,
        title: 'Materi Pohon Biner Uji Konkurensi',
        originalFilename: 'binary-tree-concurrency.pdf',
        storageKey: `materials/${userAId}/concurrency-tree.pdf`,
        mimeType: 'application/pdf',
        bytes: 18000,
        pageCount: 3,
        status: 'READY',
      },
    });
    materialAId = mat.id;

    await prisma.materialPage.createMany({
      data: [
        {
          materialId: materialAId,
          pageNumber: 1,
          extractedText: 'Pohon biner adalah struktur data berhierarki dengan maksimal dua anak per simpul.',
          characterCount: 80,
        },
        {
          materialId: materialAId,
          pageNumber: 2,
          extractedText: 'Operasi penelusuran pohon biner meliputi preorder, inorder, dan postorder.',
          characterCount: 75,
        },
      ],
    });

    // Create a READY Quiz with 2 deterministic questions
    const quiz = await prisma.quiz.create({
      data: {
        userId: userAId,
        materialId: materialAId,
        title: 'Kuis Pohon Biner Konkurensi',
        targetCount: 2,
        status: 'READY',
        questions: {
          create: [
            {
              question: 'Berapa jumlah anak maksimal simpul pada pohon biner?',
              options: ['1 anak', '2 anak', '3 anak', 'Tidak terbatas'],
              correctIndex: 1, // '2 anak'
              explanation: 'Sesuai definisi, setiap simpul memiliki maksimal 2 anak.',
              pageReferences: [1],
              orderIndex: 0,
            },
            {
              question: 'Penelusuran manakah yang memproses simpul akar di awal?',
              options: ['Preorder', 'Inorder', 'Postorder', 'Levelorder'],
              correctIndex: 0, // 'Preorder'
              explanation: 'Preorder memproses akar terlebih dahulu, kemudian anak kiri dan kanan.',
              pageReferences: [2],
              orderIndex: 1,
            },
          ],
        },
      },
      include: { questions: { orderBy: { orderIndex: 'asc' } } },
    });

    quizAId = quiz.id;
    q1Id = quiz.questions[0].id;
    q2Id = quiz.questions[1].id;
  });

  it('1. Dua submit bersamaan dengan jawaban berbeda: hasil final berasal dari satu submission, tanpa campuran jawaban/skor', async () => {
    // Start attempt
    const startRes = await startOrResumeQuizAttempt(userAId, quizAId);
    const attemptId = startRes.attemptId;

    // Submission 1: both correct (Q1: 1, Q2: 0) -> score 100
    const sub1Answers = [
      { questionId: q1Id, selectedIndex: 1 },
      { questionId: q2Id, selectedIndex: 0 },
    ];

    // Submission 2: both wrong (Q1: 0, Q2: 1) -> score 0
    const sub2Answers = [
      { questionId: q1Id, selectedIndex: 0 },
      { questionId: q2Id, selectedIndex: 1 },
    ];

    // Fire both submit calls simultaneously
    const [result1, result2] = await Promise.all([
      submitQuizAttempt(userAId, attemptId, sub1Answers),
      submitQuizAttempt(userAId, attemptId, sub2Answers),
    ]);

    // Both results MUST be identical because the second submission unblocks, sees submittedAt, and returns the first result
    expect(result1.score).toBe(result2.score);
    expect(result1.submittedAt).toBe(result2.submittedAt);
    expect([0, 100]).toContain(result1.score);

    // Assert that the questions and userSelectedIndex are completely identical across both responses
    for (let i = 0; i < result1.questions.length; i++) {
      expect(result1.questions[i].userSelectedIndex).toBe(result2.questions[i].userSelectedIndex);
      expect(result1.questions[i].isCorrect).toBe(result2.questions[i].isCorrect);
    }

    // Inspect database: quiz_attempt_answers MUST have exactly 2 rows (no duplicates, no mixing)
    const dbAnswers = await prisma.quizAttemptAnswer.findMany({
      where: { attemptId },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' },
    });
    expect(dbAnswers).toHaveLength(2);

    // Verify DB attempt row matches the returned score
    const dbAttempt = await prisma.quizAttempt.findUnique({
      where: { id: attemptId },
    });
    expect(dbAttempt?.score).toBe(result1.score);
    expect(dbAttempt?.submittedAt).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it('2. Submit ulang setelah selesai: hasil tetap sama dan tidak ada jawaban duplikat', async () => {
    const startRes = await startOrResumeQuizAttempt(userAId, quizAId);
    const attemptId = startRes.attemptId;

    // First submission: Q1 correct (1), Q2 wrong (1) -> score 50
    const initialSubmit = await submitQuizAttempt(userAId, attemptId, [
      { questionId: q1Id, selectedIndex: 1 },
      { questionId: q2Id, selectedIndex: 1 },
    ]);
    expect(initialSubmit.score).toBe(50);
    expect(initialSubmit.correctAnswersCount).toBe(1);

    // Attempt second submission with different answers (e.g. Q1: 0, Q2: 0)
    const secondSubmit = await submitQuizAttempt(userAId, attemptId, [
      { questionId: q1Id, selectedIndex: 0 },
      { questionId: q2Id, selectedIndex: 0 },
    ]);

    // Second submit must return the original score 50 without overwriting
    expect(secondSubmit.score).toBe(50);
    expect(secondSubmit.correctAnswersCount).toBe(1);
    expect(secondSubmit.submittedAt).toBe(initialSubmit.submittedAt);

    // DB answers still exactly 2, with Q1=1 and Q2=1
    const dbAnswers = await prisma.quizAttemptAnswer.findMany({
      where: { attemptId },
    });
    expect(dbAnswers).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(dbAnswers.find((a) => a.questionId === q1Id)?.selectedIndex).toBe(1);
    expect(dbAnswers.find((a) => a.questionId === q2Id)?.selectedIndex).toBe(1);
  });

  it('3. Save draft bersamaan dengan submit: setelah submit selesai, jawaban dan skor tetap konsisten', async () => {
    const startRes = await startOrResumeQuizAttempt(userAId, quizAId);
    const attemptId = startRes.attemptId;

    const draftAnswers = [
      { questionId: q1Id, selectedIndex: 2 },
      { questionId: q2Id, selectedIndex: 3 },
    ];

    const submitAnswers = [
      { questionId: q1Id, selectedIndex: 1 },
      { questionId: q2Id, selectedIndex: 0 },
    ];

    // Fire draft and submit simultaneously
    const results = await Promise.allSettled([
      saveQuizDraftAnswers(userAId, attemptId, draftAnswers),
      submitQuizAttempt(userAId, attemptId, submitAnswers),
    ]);

    // Submit MUST have succeeded
    const submitResult = results[1];
    expect(submitResult.status).toBe('fulfilled');

    // Retrieve attempt evaluation from DB
    const finalResult = await getQuizAttemptResult(userAId, attemptId);

    // The finalized database state must strictly reflect the submitted answers and score 100
    expect(finalResult.score).toBe(100);
    expect(finalResult.correctAnswersCount).toBe(2);

    const q1Final = finalResult.questions.find((q) => q.id === q1Id);
    const q2Final = finalResult.questions.find((q) => q.id === q2Id);
    expect(q1Final?.userSelectedIndex).toBe(1);
    expect(q2Final?.userSelectedIndex).toBe(0);

    // DB answers must NOT have draft values (2 or 3)
    const dbAnswers = await prisma.quizAttemptAnswer.findMany({
      where: { attemptId },
    });
    expect(dbAnswers.find((a) => a.questionId === q1Id)?.selectedIndex).toBe(1);
    expect(dbAnswers.find((a) => a.questionId === q2Id)?.selectedIndex).toBe(0);
  });

  it('4. Save draft setelah submit: ditolak dan tidak mengubah hasil', async () => {
    const startRes = await startOrResumeQuizAttempt(userAId, quizAId);
    const attemptId = startRes.attemptId;

    // Submit attempt with Q1: 1, Q2: 0 (score 100)
    await submitQuizAttempt(userAId, attemptId, [
      { questionId: q1Id, selectedIndex: 1 },
      { questionId: q2Id, selectedIndex: 0 },
    ]);

    // Subsequent draft must be rejected with 400 ATTEMPT_ALREADY_SUBMITTED
    await expect(
      saveQuizDraftAnswers(userAId, attemptId, [
        { questionId: q1Id, selectedIndex: 3 },
      ])
    ).rejects.toMatchObject({
      statusCode: 400,
      code: 'ATTEMPT_ALREADY_SUBMITTED',
    });

    // In DB, answer for Q1 must still be 1, never mutated to 3
    const dbAnswer = await prisma.quizAttemptAnswer.findUnique({
      where: { attemptId_questionId: { attemptId, questionId: q1Id } },
    });
    expect(dbAnswer?.selectedIndex).toBe(1);
  });

  it('5. Dua start/resume bersamaan: tidak menciptakan attempt aktif ganda', async () => {
    // Both calls fire simultaneously on a quiz with no existing attempt
    const [attemptA, attemptB] = await Promise.all([
      startOrResumeQuizAttempt(userAId, quizAId),
      startOrResumeQuizAttempt(userAId, quizAId),
    ]);

    // Both must return the EXACT SAME attempt ID
    expect(attemptA.attemptId).toBe(attemptB.attemptId);

    // In DB: exactly ONE active attempt exists for this user and quiz
    const activeAttempts = await prisma.quizAttempt.findMany({
      where: {
        quizId: quizAId,
        userId: userAId,
        submittedAt: null,
      },
    });
    expect(activeAttempts).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('6. Pengguna lain tidak dapat membaca atau mengubah attempt', async () => {
    const startRes = await startOrResumeQuizAttempt(userAId, quizAId);
    const attemptId = startRes.attemptId;

    // User B tries to start attempt on User A's quiz
    await expect(startOrResumeQuizAttempt(userBId, quizAId)).rejects.toMatchObject({
      statusCode: 403,
      code: 'FORBIDDEN',
    });

    // User B tries to save draft on User A's attempt
    await expect(
      saveQuizDraftAnswers(userBId, attemptId, [{ questionId: q1Id, selectedIndex: 1 }])
    ).rejects.toMatchObject({
      statusCode: 403,
      code: 'FORBIDDEN',
    });

    // User B tries to submit User A's attempt
    await expect(
      submitQuizAttempt(userBId, attemptId, [{ questionId: q1Id, selectedIndex: 1 }])
    ).rejects.toMatchObject({
      statusCode: 403,
      code: 'FORBIDDEN',
    });

    // User B tries to view User A's attempt result
    await expect(getQuizAttemptResult(userBId, attemptId)).rejects.toMatchObject({
      statusCode: 403,
      code: 'FORBIDDEN',
    });
  });

  it('7. Respons sebelum submit tidak mengandung kunci jawaban/pembahasan', async () => {
    const startRes = await startOrResumeQuizAttempt(userAId, quizAId);

    // Verify all returned questions have NO correctIndex or explanation
    for (const q of startRes.questions) {
      expect((q as any).correctIndex).toBeUndefined();
      expect((q as any).explanation).toBeUndefined();
      expect(q.options).toHaveLength(4);
    }

    // Viewing attempt result before submission is strictly rejected
    await expect(getQuizAttemptResult(userAId, startRes.attemptId)).rejects.toMatchObject({
      statusCode: 400,
      code: 'ATTEMPT_NOT_SUBMITTED',
    });
  });

  it('8. Retake yang sah tetap berfungsi', async () => {
    // 1. Complete Attempt 1
    const attempt1 = await startOrResumeQuizAttempt(userAId, quizAId);
    const submit1 = await submitQuizAttempt(userAId, attempt1.attemptId, [
      { questionId: q1Id, selectedIndex: 1 },
      { questionId: q2Id, selectedIndex: 1 }, // Q2 wrong
    ]);
    expect(submit1.score).toBe(50);

    // 2. User retakes quiz: startOrResumeQuizAttempt creates Attempt 2
    const attempt2 = await startOrResumeQuizAttempt(userAId, quizAId);
    expect(attempt2.attemptId).not.toBe(attempt1.attemptId);
    expect(attempt2.existingAnswers).toEqual({});

    // 3. Complete Attempt 2: both correct
    const submit2 = await submitQuizAttempt(userAId, attempt2.attemptId, [
      { questionId: q1Id, selectedIndex: 1 },
      { questionId: q2Id, selectedIndex: 0 },
    ]);
    expect(submit2.score).toBe(100);

    // Both attempts exist in DB with their distinct scores
    const allUserAttempts = await prisma.quizAttempt.findMany({
      where: { quizId: quizAId, userId: userAId },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' },
    });
    expect(allUserAttempts).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(allUserAttempts[0].id).toBe(attempt1.attemptId);
    expect(allUserAttempts[0].score).toBe(50);
    expect(allUserAttempts[1].id).toBe(attempt2.attemptId);
    expect(allUserAttempts[1].score).toBe(100);
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach, afterAll } from 'vitest';
import request from 'supertest';
import express, { Express } from 'express';
import { Redis } from 'ioredis';
import rateLimit, { ipKeyGenerator } from 'express-rate-limit';
import { createApp } from '../app.js';
import { env } from '../config/env.js';
import {
  RedisRateLimitStore,
  createRateLimitStore,
  hashAccountIdentifier,
} from '../middleware/rateLimiter.js';
import { COOKIE_NAMES } from '@studyflow/shared';

describe('Auth Client Identification & Rate Limiting (Browser -> BFF -> API)', () => {
  const TRUSTED_ORIGIN = 'http://localhost:3000';
  let redis: Redis;

  beforeEach(() => {
    redis = new Redis(env.REDIS_URL, {
      maxRetriesPerRequest: 1,
      connectTimeout: 2000,
      lazyConnect: false,
    });
  });

  afterEach(async () => {
    // Clean up test keys with isolated prefix
    const keys = await redis.keys('test:rl:*');
    if (keys.length > 0) {
      await redis.del(...keys);
    }
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    if (redis) {
      await redis.quit();
    }
  });

  it('1. Dua klien berbeda melalui BFF tidak menggunakan satu bucket IP BFF', async () => {
    // App with trust proxy = 'loopback' (local BFF proxy IP 127.0.0.1 is trusted to provide client IP in X-Forwarded-For)
    const app = express();
    app.set('trust proxy', 'loopback');
    app.use(express.json());

    const testStore = new RedisRateLimitStore(redis, 'test:rl:bff:');
    const limiter = rateLimit({
      windowMs: 5000,
      max: 2, // limit 2 requests per IP
      standardHeaders: true,
      legacyHeaders: false,
      store: testStore,
      keyGenerator: (req) => ipKeyGenerator(req.ip || '127.0.0.1'),
    });

    app.post('/api/auth/register', limiter, (req, res) => res.json({ ok: true }));

    // Client A (IP 203.0.113.10) sends 2 requests via BFF
    const resA1 = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('X-Forwarded-For', '203.0.113.10');
    const resA2 = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('X-Forwarded-For', '203.0.113.10');

    expect(resA1.status).toBe(200);
    expect(resA2.status).toBe(200);

    // Client A 3rd request hits 429
    const resA3 = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('X-Forwarded-For', '203.0.113.10');
    expect(resA3.status).toBe(429);

    // Client B (IP 198.51.100.20) sends request via BFF -> MUST NOT be blocked by Client A's bucket!
    const resB1 = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('X-Forwarded-For', '198.51.100.20');
    expect(resB1.status).toBe(200);
  });

  it('2. Klien yang sama tetap terkena batas walau request ditangani instance API berbeda (Shared Redis Store)', async () => {
    // Both instances share the exact same Redis namespace prefix
    const testStore1 = new RedisRateLimitStore(redis, 'test:rl:multi-instance:');
    const testStore2 = new RedisRateLimitStore(redis, 'test:rl:multi-instance:');

    // Instance 1
    const app1 = express();
    app1.set('trust proxy', 'loopback');
    app1.use(rateLimit({
      windowMs: 5000,
      max: 2,
      store: testStore1,
      keyGenerator: (req) => ipKeyGenerator(req.ip || '127.0.0.1'),
    }));
    app1.get('/test', (req, res) => res.json({ instance: 1 }));

    // Instance 2 (shares the exact same Redis store)
    const app2 = express();
    app2.set('trust proxy', 'loopback');
    app2.use(rateLimit({
      windowMs: 5000,
      max: 2,
      store: testStore2,
      keyGenerator: (req) => ipKeyGenerator(req.ip || '127.0.0.1'),
    }));
    app2.get('/test', (req, res) => res.json({ instance: 2 }));

    // Request 1 hits Instance 1
    const res1 = await request(app1)
      .get('/test')
      .set('X-Forwarded-For', '192.0.2.1');
    expect(res1.status).toBe(200);

    // Request 2 hits Instance 2
    const res2 = await request(app2)
      .get('/test')
      .set('X-Forwarded-For', '192.0.2.1');
    expect(res2.status).toBe(200);

    // Request 3 hits Instance 1 -> Exceeded limit across both instances!
    const res3 = await request(app1)
      .get('/test')
      .set('X-Forwarded-For', '192.0.2.1');
    expect(res3.status).toBe(429);
  });

  it('3. Request langsung dari sumber tidak terpercaya tidak dapat memalsukan identitas dengan header palsu', async () => {
    // When trust proxy is disabled ('false') or direct from untrusted client:
    const directApp = express();
    directApp.set('trust proxy', false); // Direct exposure to internet / untrusted

    const testStore = new RedisRateLimitStore(redis, 'test:rl:untrusted:');
    directApp.use(rateLimit({
      windowMs: 5000,
      max: 2,
      store: testStore,
      keyGenerator: (req) => ipKeyGenerator(req.ip || '127.0.0.1'),
    }));
    directApp.get('/test', (req, res) => res.json({ ip: req.ip }));

    // Client attempts to spoof IP by changing X-Forwarded-For on each request
    const res1 = await request(directApp)
      .get('/test')
      .set('X-Forwarded-For', '1.1.1.1');
    const res2 = await request(directApp)
      .get('/test')
      .set('X-Forwarded-For', '2.2.2.2');
    const res3 = await request(directApp)
      .get('/test')
      .set('X-Forwarded-For', '3.3.3.3');

    // Because trust proxy is false, Express uses the socket remote address,
    // IGNORING the forged X-Forwarded-For!
    expect(res1.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res2.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res3.status).toBe(429); // 3rd attempt is blocked regardless of forged headers
  });

  it('4. Pembatasan akun mengikuti normalisasi (Case-insensitive & whitespace trimmed) tanpa membeberkan email mentah', async () => {
    const rawEmail1 = '  Mahasiswa.Keren@Kampus.AC.ID  ';
    const rawEmail2 = 'mahasiswa.keren@kampus.ac.id';

    const hash1 = hashAccountIdentifier(rawEmail1);
    const hash2 = hashAccountIdentifier(rawEmail2);

    // Normalized hashes must match exactly
    expect(hash1).toBe(hash2);
    expect(hash1).toBeDefined();

    // Raw email is NEVER present in the hash/key
    expect(hash1).not.toContain('mahasiswa');
    expect(hash1).not.toContain('kampus');
    expect(hash1!.length).toBe(16);

    // Account limiter test
    const app = express();
    app.use(express.json());
    const testStore = new RedisRateLimitStore(redis, 'test:rl:account:');

    app.post('/api/auth/login', rateLimit({
      windowMs: 5000,
      max: 2,
      store: testStore,
      keyGenerator: (req) => {
        const hash = hashAccountIdentifier(req.body?.email);
        return hash ? `acct:${hash}` : 'ip:unknown';
      },
      message: { error: { code: 'TOO_MANY_REQUESTS' } },
    }), (req, res) => res.json({ ok: true }));

    // Attempt 1 with uppercase & whitespace
    const res1 = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .send({ email: rawEmail1, password: 'WrongPassword1!' });
    expect(res1.status).toBe(200);

    // Attempt 2 with lowercase
    const res2 = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .send({ email: rawEmail2, password: 'WrongPassword2!' });
    expect(res2.status).toBe(200);

    // Attempt 3 is throttled because both target the same normalized account
    const res3 = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .send({ email: rawEmail1, password: 'WrongPassword3!' });
    expect(res3.status).toBe(429);
    expect(res3.body.error.code).toBe('TOO_MANY_REQUESTS');
  });

  it('5. Respons 429 menyertakan Retry-After dan header rate limit standar', async () => {
    const app = express();
    const testStore = new RedisRateLimitStore(redis, 'test:rl:headers:');

    app.get('/test', rateLimit({
      windowMs: 10_000,
      max: 1,
      standardHeaders: true,
      legacyHeaders: false,
      store: testStore,
      keyGenerator: (req) => ipKeyGenerator(req.ip || '127.0.0.1'),
    }), (req, res) => res.send('OK'));

    await request(app).get('/test');
    const res429 = await request(app).get('/test');

    expect(res429.status).toBe(429);
    expect(res429.headers['retry-after']).toBeDefined();
    expect(Number(res429.headers['retry-after'])).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(res429.headers['ratelimit-limit']).toBe('1');
    expect(res429.headers['ratelimit-remaining']).toBe('0');
    expect(res429.headers['ratelimit-reset']).toBeDefined();
  });

  it('6. Kegagalan store mengikuti kebijakan fail-closed (503 RATE_LIMITER_UNAVAILABLE)', async () => {
    class BrokenStore {
      init() {}
      async increment() {
        throw new Error('Redis connection refused or crashed');
      }
      async decrement() {}
      async resetKey() {}
    }

    const app = express();
    app.use(rateLimit({
      windowMs: 5000,
      max: 5,
      store: new BrokenStore(),
      passOnStoreError: false,
    }));
    app.get('/test', (req, res) => res.json({ ok: true }));

    // Centralized error handler
    app.use((err: unknown, _req: express.Request, res: express.Response, _next: express.NextFunction) => {
      res.status(503).json({
        error: {
          code: 'RATE_LIMITER_UNAVAILABLE',
          message: 'Layanan rate limiter sedang tidak tersedia. Permintaan ditolak demi keamanan.',
        },
      });
    });

    const res = await request(app).get('/test');
    expect(res.status).toBe(503);
    expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('RATE_LIMITER_UNAVAILABLE');
  });

  it('7. CSRF, Origin check, dan Cookie autentikasi tetap berfungsi dengan rate limiter aktif', async () => {
    const fullApp = createApp();

    // Valid registration request with trusted Origin and cookies
    const regRes = await request(fullApp)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Rate Limit Auth User',
        email: `ratelimit.auth.${Date.now()}@example.com`,
        password: 'PasswordSangatKuat123!',
      });
    expect(regRes.status).toBe(201);

    // CSRF forbidden origin must still be rejected with 403
    const csrfRes = await request(fullApp)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', 'http://malicious-site.com')
      .send({
        email: 'test@example.com',
        password: 'Password123!',
      });
    expect(csrfRes.status).toBe(403);
    expect(csrfRes.body.error.code).toBe('CSRF_ORIGIN_INVALID');
  });

  it('8. Increment RedisRateLimitStore menetapkan TTL secara atomik via Lua script', async () => {
    const store = new RedisRateLimitStore(redis, 'test:rl:atomic:');
    store.init({ windowMs: 10_000 });

    const testKey = `client-${Date.now()}`;
    const fullKey = `test:rl:atomic:${testKey}`;

    // 1. Initial increment on empty key
    const info1 = await store.increment(testKey);
    expect(info1.totalHits).toBe(1);
    expect(info1.resetTime.getTime()).toBeGreaterThan(Date.now());

    // Verify key in Redis has a valid positive millisecond TTL immediately (atomic execution)
    const redisPttl1 = await redis.pttl(fullKey);
    expect(redisPttl1).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(redisPttl1).toBeLessThanOrEqual(10_000);

    // 2. Second increment preserves TTL and increments count
    const info2 = await store.increment(testKey);
    expect(info2.totalHits).toBe(2);
    const redisPttl2 = await redis.pttl(fullKey);
    expect(redisPttl2).toBeGreaterThan(0);

    // 3. Defensive behavior: If a key exists without TTL (simulating corrupted state),
    // calling increment automatically fixes the TTL
    const legacyKey = `legacy-no-ttl-${Date.now()}`;
    const legacyFullKey = `test:rl:atomic:${legacyKey}`;
    await redis.set(legacyFullKey, '5'); // No TTL set (pttl == -1)

    const initialPttl = await redis.pttl(legacyFullKey);
    expect(initialPttl).toBe(-1);

    const legacyInfo = await store.increment(legacyKey);
    expect(legacyInfo.totalHits).toBe(6);

    // Redis key now has an assigned TTL!
    const fixedPttl = await redis.pttl(legacyFullKey);
    expect(fixedPttl).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(fixedPttl).toBeLessThanOrEqual(10_000);

    // 4. Decrement and Reset
    await store.decrement(testKey);
    const afterDecrVal = await redis.get(fullKey);
    expect(Number(afterDecrVal)).toBe(1);

    await store.resetKey(testKey);
    const exists = await redis.exists(fullKey);
    expect(exists).toBe(0);
  });

  it('9. Mode default: Request peramban dengan header IP spoofing tidak dapat memanipulasi identitas backend', async () => {
    // In default mode without trusted ingress:
    // BFF maps all incoming requests to '127.0.0.1' (ignoring user-sent headers).
    // Express with trust proxy = 'loopback' receives requests from BFF.
    const app = express();
    app.set('trust proxy', 'loopback');

    const testStore = new RedisRateLimitStore(redis, 'test:rl:spoof-defense:');
    app.use(rateLimit({
      windowMs: 5000,
      max: 2, // limit 2 requests per IP
      store: testStore,
      keyGenerator: (req) => ipKeyGenerator(req.ip || '127.0.0.1'),
    }));
    app.post('/api/auth/register', (req, res) => res.json({ ok: true, ip: req.ip }));

    // Attacker sends request 1 with forged X-Real-IP and CF-Connecting-IP via BFF (BFF forwards 127.0.0.1)
    const res1 = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('X-Forwarded-For', '127.0.0.1'); // Normalized by BFF in default mode
    expect(res1.status).toBe(200);

    // Attacker sends request 2 attempting to spoof another IP
    const res2 = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('X-Forwarded-For', '127.0.0.1'); // Normalized by BFF in default mode
    expect(res2.status).toBe(200);

    // Attacker sends request 3: Despite trying different spoofed IPs at the browser level,
    // both requests entered the same 127.0.0.1 bucket and the 3rd request is blocked!
    const res3 = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('X-Forwarded-For', '127.0.0.1');
    expect(res3.status).toBe(429);
  });
});

import request from 'supertest';

import { prisma } from '@studyflow/database';

describe('Course Schedule Endpoints & Invariants', () => {
  const app = createApp();
  const TRUSTED_ORIGIN = 'http://localhost:3000';

  let userAId: string;

  let cookieA: string[];
  let cookieB: string[];
  let semA1Id: string;
  let semA2Id: string;
  let semBId: string;

  let courseA2Id: string;
  let courseAInSem2Id: string;
  let courseBId: string;

  beforeEach(async () => {

  it('3. Validasi hari, jam, waktu selesai > mulai, penolakan lintas tengah malam, dan penolakan sesi identik', async () => {

      .post('/api/schedules')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseA1Id,
        dayOfWeek: 8,
        startTime: '08:00',
        endTime: '09:40',
      });
    expect(resInvalidDay.status).toBe(400);

    // 3.2 Format waktu invalid ditolak
    const resInvalidTime = await request(app)
      .post('/api/schedules')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseA1Id,
        dayOfWeek: 1,
        startTime: '8:00', // harus 08:00
        endTime: '09:40',
      });
    expect(resInvalidTime.status).toBe(400);

    // 3.3 Waktu selesai sama dengan waktu mulai ditolak
    const resEqualTime = await request(app)
      .post('/api/schedules')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseA1Id,
        dayOfWeek: 1,
        startTime: '08:00',
        endTime: '08:00',
      });
    expect(resEqualTime.status).toBe(400);
    expect(resEqualTime.body.error.message).toContain('Waktu selesai harus lebih besar daripada waktu mulai');

    // 3.4 Sesi lintas tengah malam (startTime > endTime) ditolak dengan pesan yang jelas
    const resMidnightCross = await request(app)
      .post('/api/schedules')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseA1Id,
        dayOfWeek: 1,
        startTime: '23:00',
        endTime: '01:00',
      });
    expect(resMidnightCross.status).toBe(400);
    expect(resMidnightCross.body.error.message).toContain('Sesi jadwal lintas tengah malam belum didukung');

    // 3.5 Penolakan sesi identik untuk mata kuliah yang sama
    const firstSession = await request(app)
      .post('/api/schedules')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseA1Id,
        dayOfWeek: 2,
        startTime: '10:00',
        endTime: '12:00',
      });
    expect(firstSession.status).toBe(201);

    const duplicateSession = await request(app)
      .post('/api/schedules')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseA1Id,
        dayOfWeek: 2,
        startTime: '10:00',
        endTime: '12:00',
      });
    expect(duplicateSession.status).toBe(409);
    expect(duplicateSession.body.error.code).toBe('SCHEDULE_DUPLICATE');
  });

  it('4. Multi-tenant isolation: User B tidak dapat mengakses atau memodifikasi jadwal User A', async () => {
    // User A membuat jadwal
    const resA = await request(app)
      .post('/api/schedules')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseA1Id,
        dayOfWeek: 1,
        startTime: '08:00',
        endTime: '09:40',
        room: 'Ruang A',
      });
    expect(resA.status).toBe(201);
    const scheduleAId = resA.body.schedule.id;

    // User B mencoba membuat jadwal untuk mata kuliah User A -> ditolak 404 (tidak ditemukan kepemilikan)
    const crossCreate = await request(app)
      .post('/api/schedules')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB)
      .send({
        courseId: courseA1Id,
        dayOfWeek: 1,
        startTime: '08:00',
        endTime: '09:40',
      });
    expect(crossCreate.status).toBe(404);

    // User B mencoba membaca jadwal User A -> ditolak 404
    const crossGet = await request(app)
      .get(`/api/schedules/${scheduleAId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB);
    expect(crossGet.status).toBe(404);

    // User B mencoba mengedit jadwal User A -> ditolak 404
    const crossPatch = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/schedules/${scheduleAId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB)
      .send({ room: 'Ruang Diretas' });
    expect(crossPatch.status).toBe(404);

    // User B mencoba menghapus jadwal User A -> ditolak 404
    const crossDelete = await request(app)
      .delete(`/api/schedules/${scheduleAId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB);
    expect(crossDelete.status).toBe(404);

    // Daftar jadwal User B tetap kosong
    const listB = await request(app)
      .get('/api/schedules')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB);
    expect(listB.body.schedules).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('5. Deteksi konflik waktu: overlap terdeteksi, waktu berdampingan bukan konflik, edit sesi sendiri tidak konflik, dan beda semester bukan konflik', async () => {
    // 5.1 Jadwal awal Course A1: Senin (hari 1), 08:00 - 10:00 (di Semester 1)
    const resSession1 = await request(app)
      .post('/api/schedules')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseA1Id,
        dayOfWeek: 1,
        startTime: '08:00',
        endTime: '10:00',
        room: 'R.101',
      });
    expect(resSession1.status).toBe(201);
    expect(resSession1.body.hasConflict).toBe(false);
    const session1Id = resSession1.body.schedule.id;

    // 5.2 Waktu berdampingan: Course A2 pada Senin 10:00 - 12:00 -> BUKAN konflik!
    const resAdjacent = await request(app)
      .post('/api/schedules')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseA2Id,
        dayOfWeek: 1,
        startTime: '10:00',
        endTime: '12:00',
        room: 'R.102',
      });
    expect(resAdjacent.status).toBe(201);
    expect(resAdjacent.body.hasConflict).toBe(false);
    expect(resAdjacent.body.conflicts).toHaveLength(0);

    // 5.3 Jadwal tumpang tindih (Overlap): Senin 09:00 - 11:00 (bertabrakan dengan 08:00-10:00 dan 10:00-12:00)
    // Jadwal tetap boleh disimpan (status 201), tetapi metadata konflik terisi
    const resOverlapping = await request(app)
      .post('/api/schedules')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseA2Id,
        dayOfWeek: 1,
        startTime: '09:00',
        endTime: '11:00',
        room: 'R.Overlap',
      });
    expect(resOverlapping.status).toBe(201);
    expect(resOverlapping.body.hasConflict).toBe(true);
    expect(resOverlapping.body.conflicts.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(resOverlapping.body.conflicts.some((c: any) => c.id === session1Id)).toBe(true);

    // 5.4 Edit sesi sendiri: Mengubah ruangan sesi 1 tidak boleh menjadikannya konflik dengan dirinya sendiri
    const resPatchSelf = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/schedules/${session1Id}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        room: 'R.101 Baru',
      });
    expect(resPatchSelf.status).toBe(200);
    // Konflik sesi 1 hanya dengan sesi overlap (bukan dengan session1Id)
    expect(resPatchSelf.body.conflicts.every((c: any) => c.id !== session1Id)).toBe(true);

    // 5.5 Jadwal di SEMESTER BERBEDA tidak dianggap konflik
    // Tambah jadwal di Semester 2 pada hari Senin 08:00 - 10:00 (jam yang sama dengan Semester 1)
    const resSem2 = await request(app)
      .post('/api/schedules')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseAInSem2Id, // di Semester 2
        dayOfWeek: 1,
        startTime: '08:00',
        endTime: '10:00',
      });
    expect(resSem2.status).toBe(201);
    // Tidak bentrok dengan sesi Semester 1 karena beda semester!
    expect(resSem2.body.hasConflict).toBe(false);
  });

  it('6. Perilaku semester / mata kuliah diarsipkan: menolak penambahan, pengeditan, dan penghapusan jadwal', async () => {
    // Buat jadwal pada mata kuliah aktif terlebih dahulu
    const initRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/schedules')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseA1Id,
        dayOfWeek: 4,
        startTime: '08:00',
        endTime: '10:00',
      });
    expect(initRes.status).toBe(201);
    const scheduleId = initRes.body.schedule.id;

    // Arsipkan mata kuliah A1
    const archRes = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/courses/${courseA1Id}/archive`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);
    expect(archRes.status).toBe(200);

    // Menambah jadwal baru pada mata kuliah arsip ditolak 400
    const addOnArchived = await request(app)
      .post('/api/schedules')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseA1Id,
        dayOfWeek: 5,
        startTime: '08:00',
        endTime: '10:00',
      });
    expect(addOnArchived.status).toBe(400);
    expect(addOnArchived.body.error.code).toBe('COURSE_ARCHIVED');

    // Mengedit jadwal pada mata kuliah arsip ditolak 400
    const editOnArchived = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/schedules/${scheduleId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        room: 'Ruang Tidak Boleh Edit',
      });
    expect(editOnArchived.status).toBe(400);
    expect(editOnArchived.body.error.code).toBe('COURSE_ARCHIVED');

    // Menghapus jadwal pada mata kuliah arsip ditolak 400
    const deleteOnArchived = await request(app)
      .delete(`/api/schedules/${scheduleId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);
    expect(deleteOnArchived.status).toBe(400);
    expect(deleteOnArchived.body.error.code).toBe('COURSE_ARCHIVED');
  });

  it('7. Data mata kuliah lama tetap dapat dibaca secara normal dan kompatibel', async () => {
    // Verifikasi endpoint /api/courses dan /api/courses/:id tetap mengembalikan mata kuliah dengan utuh
    const getCourseRes = await request(app)
      .get(`/api/courses/${courseA1Id}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);

    expect(getCourseRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(getCourseRes.body.course.name).toBe('Algoritma & Pemrograman');
    expect(getCourseRes.body.course.code).toBe('CS101');
    expect(getCourseRes.body.course.lecturer).toBe('Dr. Indah Permata');
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterAll } from 'vitest';
import request from 'supertest';
import { createApp } from '../app.js';
import { prisma } from '@studyflow/database';

describe('Global Search Endpoints & Business Invariants', () => {
  const app = createApp();
  const TRUSTED_ORIGIN = 'http://localhost:3000';

  let userAId: string;
  let userBId: string;
  let cookieA: string[];
  let cookieB: string[];
  let semA1Id: string;
  let semA2Id: string;
  let semBId: string;
  let courseA1Id: string;
  let courseA2Id: string;
  let courseBId: string;

  beforeEach(async () => {
    await prisma.user.deleteMany({
      where: { email: { contains: 'test.srch.' } },
    });

    // 1. Buat User A & Semester 1 (Aktif)
    const emailA = `test.srch.a.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Search User A',
        email: emailA,
        password: 'PasswordKuat123!',
      });
    const loginA = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: emailA,
        password: 'PasswordKuat123!',
      });
    userAId = loginA.body.user.id;
    cookieA = loginA.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];

    const semResA1 = await request(app)
      .post('/api/semesters')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ name: 'Semester Gasal 2026', academicYear: '2026/2027', makeActive: true });
    semA1Id = semResA1.body.semester.id;

    // Semester 2 (Non-aktif) untuk User A
    const semResA2 = await request(app)
      .post('/api/semesters')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ name: 'Semester Genap 2027', academicYear: '2026/2027', makeActive: false });
    semA2Id = semResA2.body.semester.id;

    // Course A1 di Semester 1: "Kalkulus I", code: "CS101"
    const crsResA1 = await request(app)
      .post('/api/courses')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        semesterId: semA1Id,
        name: 'Kalkulus I',
        code: 'CS101',
      });
    courseA1Id = crsResA1.body.course.id;

    // Course A2 di Semester 2: "Kalkulus Lanjut", code: "CS201"
    const crsResA2 = await request(app)
      .post('/api/courses')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        semesterId: semA2Id,
        name: 'Kalkulus Lanjut',
        code: 'CS201',
      });
    courseA2Id = crsResA2.body.course.id;

    // 2. Buat User B & Semester B (untuk uji isolasi tenant)
    const emailB = `test.srch.b.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Search User B',
        email: emailB,
        password: 'PasswordKuat123!',
      });
    const loginB = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: emailB,
        password: 'PasswordKuat123!',
      });
    userBId = loginB.body.user.id;
    cookieB = loginB.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];

    const semResB = await request(app)
      .post('/api/semesters')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB)
      .send({ name: 'Semester B', academicYear: '2026/2027', makeActive: true });
    semBId = semResB.body.semester.id;

    const crsResB = await request(app)
      .post('/api/courses')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB)
      .send({
        semesterId: semBId,
        name: 'Kalkulus Khusus B',
      });
    courseBId = crsResB.body.course.id;
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await prisma.user.deleteMany({
      where: { email: { contains: 'test.srch.' } },
    });
  });

  it('menolak query pencarian yang kurang dari 2 karakter atau lebih dari 100 karakter', async () => {
    // Kurang dari 2 karakter
    const resShort = await request(app)
      .get('/api/search')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .query({ q: 'a' });

    expect(resShort.status).toBe(400);
    expect(resShort.body.error.code).toBe('VALIDATION_ERROR');

    // Kosong / whitespace
    const resBlank = await request(app)
      .get('/api/search')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .query({ q: '   ' });

    expect(resBlank.status).toBe(400);
    expect(resBlank.body.error.code).toBe('VALIDATION_ERROR');

    // Lebih dari 100 karakter
    const longQuery = 'a'.repeat(101);
    const resLong = await request(app)
      .get('/api/search')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .query({ q: longQuery });

    expect(resLong.status).toBe(400);
    expect(resLong.body.error.code).toBe('VALIDATION_ERROR');
  });

  it('menjaga isolasi tenant: tidak menemukan data milik pengguna lain', async () => {
    // User B punya "Kalkulus Khusus B"
    const res = await request(app)
      .get('/api/search')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .query({ q: 'Khusus B', semesterId: 'all' });

    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.totalCount).toBe(0);
    expect(res.body.results.courses).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('menolak query dengan semesterId milik user lain atau semester diarsipkan', async () => {
    // User A query dengan semester User B
    const resTenant = await request(app)
      .get('/api/search')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .query({ q: 'Kalkulus', semesterId: semBId });

    expect(resTenant.status).toBe(404);
    expect(resTenant.body.error.code).toBe('SEMESTER_NOT_FOUND');

    // User A mengarsipkan semA2
    await request(app)
      .post(`/api/semesters/${semA2Id}/archive`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);

    const resArchived = await request(app)
      .get('/api/search')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .query({ q: 'Kalkulus', semesterId: semA2Id });

    expect(resArchived.status).toBe(400);
    expect(resArchived.body.error.code).toBe('SEMESTER_ARCHIVED');
  });

  it('mencari pada semester aktif secara default dan mendukung opsi "Semua Semester"', async () => {
    // Default (semester aktif = semA1): hanya menemukan "Kalkulus I", tidak menemukan "Kalkulus Lanjut" (semA2)
    const resDefault = await request(app)
      .get('/api/search')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .query({ q: 'kalkulus' }); // Case-insensitive test

    expect(resDefault.status).toBe(200);
    expect(resDefault.body.semesterScope.id).toBe(semA1Id);
    expect(resDefault.body.results.courses).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(resDefault.body.results.courses[0].title).toBe('Kalkulus I');

    // Opsi semesterId='all': menemukan kedua mata kuliah di kedua semester
    const resAll = await request(app)
      .get('/api/search')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .query({ q: 'kalkulus', semesterId: 'all' });

    expect(resAll.status).toBe(200);
    expect(resAll.body.semesterScope.id).toBe('all');
    expect(resAll.body.results.courses).toHaveLength(2);
    const titles = resAll.body.results.courses.map((c: any) => c.title);
    expect(titles).toContain('Kalkulus I');
    expect(titles).toContain('Kalkulus Lanjut');
  });

  it('mencocokkan kode mata kuliah secara case-insensitive', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .get('/api/search')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .query({ q: 'cs101' });

    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.results.courses).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(res.body.results.courses[0].title).toBe('Kalkulus I');
    expect(res.body.results.courses[0].metadata.code).toBe('CS101');
  });

  it('mengelompokkan hasil ke dalam kategori (Mata Kuliah, Materi, Tugas, Catatan) dan tidak menyertakan konten catatan/PDF', async () => {
    // Buat Materi, Tugas, dan Catatan di courseA1
    await prisma.material.create({
      data: {
        userId: userAId,
        courseId: courseA1Id,
        title: 'Materi Limit dan Fungsi Kalkulus',
        originalFilename: 'limit.pdf',
        storageKey: `test/limit-${Date.now()}.pdf`,
        bytes: 1024,
      },
    });

    await request(app)
      .post('/api/assignments')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseA1Id,
        title: 'Tugas Kalkulus Minggu 1',
        dueDate: '2026-10-20T16:59:00.000Z',
        priority: 'HIGH',
      });

    await request(app)
      .post('/api/notes')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseA1Id,
        title: 'Catatan Kuliah Kalkulus Dasar',
        content: 'Rahasia internal rumus limit trigonometri yang panjang',
      });

    const res = await request(app)
      .get('/api/search')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .query({ q: 'kalkulus' });

    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.results.courses).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(res.body.results.materials).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(res.body.results.assignments).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(res.body.results.notes).toHaveLength(1);

    expect(res.body.results.materials[0].title).toBe('Materi Limit dan Fungsi Kalkulus');
    expect(res.body.results.materials[0].url).toMatch(/^\/materials\//);

    expect(res.body.results.assignments[0].title).toBe('Tugas Kalkulus Minggu 1');
    expect(res.body.results.assignments[0].url).toContain(`/assignments?courseId=${courseA1Id}`);

    expect(res.body.results.notes[0].title).toBe('Catatan Kuliah Kalkulus Dasar');
    expect(res.body.results.notes[0].url).toMatch(/^\/notes\//);

    // Verifikasi: Konten catatan tidak dibocorkan dalam respons
    expect((res.body.results.notes[0] as any).content).toBeUndefined();
    expect(JSON.stringify(res.body)).not.toContain('Rahasia internal rumus');
  });

  it('mengurutkan hasil secara deterministik: exact match -> prefix -> substring', async () => {
    // Tambahkan 3 tugas dengan variasi nama
    // 1. "Kalkulus" (exact)
    // 2. "Kalkulus Diferensial" (prefix)
    // 3. "Belajar Soal Kalkulus" (substring)
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/assignments')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseA1Id,
        title: 'Belajar Soal Kalkulus',
        dueDate: '2026-10-25T16:59:00.000Z',
      });

    await request(app)
      .post('/api/assignments')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseA1Id,
        title: 'Kalkulus',
        dueDate: '2026-10-25T16:59:00.000Z',
      });

    await request(app)
      .post('/api/assignments')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseA1Id,
        title: 'Kalkulus Diferensial',
        dueDate: '2026-10-25T16:59:00.000Z',
      });

    const res = await request(app)
      .get('/api/search')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .query({ q: 'kalkulus' });

    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    const assignmentTitles = res.body.results.assignments.map((a: any) => a.title);

    // Exact match "Kalkulus" harus di urutan pertama
    expect(assignmentTitles[0]).toBe('Kalkulus');
    // Prefix "Kalkulus Diferensial" harus di urutan kedua
    expect(assignmentTitles[1]).toBe('Kalkulus Diferensial');
    // Substring "Belajar Soal Kalkulus" harus di urutan ketiga
    expect(assignmentTitles[2]).toBe('Belajar Soal Kalkulus');
  });

  it('tidak menampilkan materi yang telah dihapus (soft-deleted)', async () => {
    const mat = await prisma.material.create({
      data: {
        userId: userAId,
        courseId: courseA1Id,
        title: 'Materi Dihapus Kalkulus',
        originalFilename: 'deleted.pdf',
        storageKey: `test/deleted-${Date.now()}.pdf`,
        bytes: 512,
        deletedAt: new Date(),
      },
    });

    const res = await request(app)
      .get('/api/search')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .query({ q: 'Dihapus Kalkulus' });

    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.results.materials).toHaveLength(0);
  });
});

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterAll } from 'vitest';
import request from 'supertest';
import { createApp } from '../app.js';
import { prisma } from '@studyflow/database';
import { COOKIE_NAMES } from '@studyflow/shared';

describe('Semester Endpoints & Invariants', () => {
  const app = createApp();
  const TRUSTED_ORIGIN = 'http://localhost:3000';

  let userAId: string;
  let userBId: string;
  let cookieA: string[];
  let cookieB: string[];

  beforeEach(async () => {
    // Clean test data via User cascade
    await prisma.user.deleteMany({
      where: { email: { contains: 'test.sem.' } },
    });

    const emailA = `test.sem.a.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'User A',
        email: emailA,
        password: 'PasswordSangatKuat123!',
      });
    const loginA = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: emailA,
        password: 'PasswordSangatKuat123!',
      });
    userAId = loginA.body.user.id;
    cookieA = loginA.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];

    const emailB = `test.sem.b.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'User B',
        email: emailB,
        password: 'PasswordSangatKuat123!',
      });
    const loginB = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: emailB,
        password: 'PasswordSangatKuat123!',
      });
    userBId = loginB.body.user.id;
    cookieB = loginB.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await prisma.user.deleteMany({
      where: { email: { contains: 'test.sem.' } },
    });
    await prisma.$disconnect();
  });

  it('first semester created should automatically become active', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/semesters')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        name: 'Semester Ganjil 2026/2027',
        academicYear: '2026/2027',
        makeActive: false, // Explicitly false, but first semester must become active
      });

    expect(res.status).toBe(201);
    expect(res.body.semester.isActive).toBe(true);
    expect(res.body.semester.name).toBe('Semester Ganjil 2026/2027');
    expect(res.body.semester.academicYear).toBe('2026/2027');
  });

  it('creating second semester with makeActive=true should deactivate the first semester', async () => {
    // 1st semester
    const res1 = await request(app)
      .post('/api/semesters')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        name: 'Semester 1',
        academicYear: '2026/2027',
        makeActive: true,
      });
    expect(res1.status).toBe(201);
    expect(res1.body.semester.isActive).toBe(true);
    const sem1Id = res1.body.semester.id;

    // 2nd semester
    const res2 = await request(app)
      .post('/api/semesters')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        name: 'Semester 2',
        academicYear: '2026/2027',
        makeActive: true,
      });
    expect(res2.status).toBe(201);
    expect(res2.body.semester.isActive).toBe(true);

    // Verify sem1 is now inactive
    const checkSem1 = await request(app)
      .get(`/api/semesters/${sem1Id}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);
    expect(checkSem1.status).toBe(200);
    expect(checkSem1.body.semester.isActive).toBe(false);
  });

  it('POST /api/semesters/:id/activate should switch active semester atomically', async () => {
    const res1 = await request(app)
      .post('/api/semesters')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ name: 'Semester 1', academicYear: '2026/2027' });
    const sem1Id = res1.body.semester.id;

    const res2 = await request(app)
      .post('/api/semesters')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ name: 'Semester 2', academicYear: '2026/2027', makeActive: true });
    const sem2Id = res2.body.semester.id;

    // Reactivate Semester 1
    const actRes = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/semesters/${sem1Id}/activate`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);

    expect(actRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(actRes.body.semester.isActive).toBe(true);

    // Semester 2 must be inactive
    const check2 = await request(app)
      .get(`/api/semesters/${sem2Id}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);
    expect(check2.body.semester.isActive).toBe(false);
  });

  it('archiving an active semester clears active flag, and cannot activate archived semester', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/semesters')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ name: 'Semester Aktif', academicYear: '2026/2027' });
    const semId = res.body.semester.id;
    expect(res.body.semester.isActive).toBe(true);

    // Archive
    const archRes = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/semesters/${semId}/archive`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);
    expect(archRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(archRes.body.semester.archivedAt).not.toBeNull();
    expect(archRes.body.semester.isActive).toBe(false);

    // Try to activate archived semester -> MUST FAIL
    const actArchRes = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/semesters/${semId}/activate`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);
    expect(actArchRes.status).toBe(400);
    expect(actArchRes.body.error.code).toBe('SEMESTER_ARCHIVED');

    // Unarchive
    const unarchRes = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/semesters/${semId}/unarchive`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);
    expect(unarchRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(unarchRes.body.semester.archivedAt).toBeNull();
  });

  it('cannot delete semester that still has courses', async () => {
    const semRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/semesters')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ name: 'Semester Berisi', academicYear: '2026/2027' });
    const semId = semRes.body.semester.id;

    // Create course in this semester
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/courses')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        semesterId: semId,
        name: 'Pemrograman Web',
        code: 'IF101',
      });

    // Attempt delete
    const delRes = await request(app)
      .delete(`/api/semesters/${semId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);

    expect(delRes.status).toBe(409);
    expect(delRes.body.error.code).toBe('SEMESTER_HAS_COURSES');

    // Verify still exists
    const check = await request(app)
      .get(`/api/semesters/${semId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);
    expect(check.status).toBe(200);
  });

  it('cross-user isolation: User B cannot view, modify, or delete User A semester', async () => {
    const semRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/semesters')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ name: 'Semester Rahasia User A', academicYear: '2026/2027' });
    const semId = semRes.body.semester.id;

    // User B attempts to read
    const getRes = await request(app)
      .get(`/api/semesters/${semId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB);
    expect(getRes.status).toBe(404);

    // User B attempts to edit
    const patchRes = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/semesters/${semId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB)
      .send({ name: 'Hacked Name' });
    expect(patchRes.status).toBe(404);

    // User B attempts to activate
    const actRes = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/semesters/${semId}/activate`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB);
    expect(actRes.status).toBe(404);

    // User B attempts to delete
    const delRes = await request(app)
      .delete(`/api/semesters/${semId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB);
    expect(delRes.status).toBe(404);
  });
});
