<file path="apps/api/src/test/subtask.test.ts">
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import request from 'supertest';
import { createApp } from '../app.js';
import { prisma } from '@studyflow/database';

describe('Assignment Subtasks Endpoints & Invariants', () => {
  const app = createApp();
  const TRUSTED_ORIGIN = 'http://localhost:3000';

  let userAId: string;
  let userBId: string;
  let cookieA: string[];
  let cookieB: string[];

  let semAId: string;
  let courseAId: string;
  let assignmentAId: string;

  beforeEach(async () => {
    // Clean up test users
    await prisma.user.deleteMany({
      where: { email: { contains: 'test.subtask.' } },
    });

    // 1. Create User A
    const emailA = `test.subtask.a.${Date.now()}.${Math.random()}@example.com`;
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Subtask User A',
        email: emailA,
        password: 'PasswordKuat123!',
      });

    const loginA = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: emailA,
        password: 'PasswordKuat123!',
      });

    cookieA = loginA.headers['set-cookie'];
    userAId = loginA.body.user.id;

    // 2. Create User B
    const emailB = `test.subtask.b.${Date.now()}.${Math.random()}@example.com`;
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Subtask User B',
        email: emailB,
        password: 'PasswordKuat123!',
      });

    const loginB = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: emailB,
        password: 'PasswordKuat123!',
      });

    cookieB = loginB.headers['set-cookie'];
    userBId = loginB.body.user.id;

    // 3. Create Semester & Course for User A
    const sem = await prisma.semester.create({
      data: {
        userId: userAId,
        name: 'Semester 1',
        academicYear: '2026/2027',
        isActive: true,
      },
    });
    semAId = sem.id;

    const course = await prisma.course.create({
      data: {
        userId: userAId,
        semesterId: semAId,
        name: 'Struktur Data',
        code: 'CS101',
      },
    });
    courseAId = course.id;

    // 4. Create Assignment for User A
    const asg = await prisma.assignment.create({
      data: {
        userId: userAId,
        courseId: courseAId,
        title: 'Tugas Linked List',
        dueDate: new Date(Date.now() + 86400000 * 3),
        status: 'TODO',
      },
    });
    assignmentAId = asg.id;
  });

  it('1. CRUD subtugas: tambah, ambil, perbarui judul, ubah status selesai, dan hapus', async () => {
    // Create subtask
    const resCreate = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/assignments/${assignmentAId}/subtasks`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ title: 'Rancang Node struct' });

    expect(resCreate.status).toBe(201);
    expect(resCreate.body.subtask).toBeDefined();
    expect(resCreate.body.subtask.title).toBe('Rancang Node struct');
    expect(resCreate.body.subtask.completed).toBe(false);
    expect(resCreate.body.subtask.order).toBe(0);
    const subtaskId = resCreate.body.subtask.id;

    // Get subtasks
    const resGet = await request(app)
      .get(`/api/assignments/${assignmentAId}/subtasks`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);

    expect(resGet.status).toBe(200);
    expect(resGet.body.subtasks.length).toBe(1);
    expect(resGet.body.subtasks[0].id).toBe(subtaskId);

    // Update title
    const resEdit = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/assignments/${assignmentAId}/subtasks/${subtaskId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ title: 'Rancang Node struct & pointer' });

    expect(resEdit.status).toBe(200);
    expect(resEdit.body.subtask.title).toBe('Rancang Node struct & pointer');

    // Update status to completed
    const resCheck = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/assignments/${assignmentAId}/subtasks/${subtaskId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ completed: true });

    expect(resCheck.status).toBe(200);
    expect(resCheck.body.subtask.completed).toBe(true);

    // Delete subtask
    const resDel = await request(app)
      .delete(`/api/assignments/${assignmentAId}/subtasks/${subtaskId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);

    expect(resDel.status).toBe(200);

    // Confirm deleted
    const resAfterDel = await request(app)
      .get(`/api/assignments/${assignmentAId}/subtasks`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);

    expect(resAfterDel.body.subtasks.length).toBe(0);
  });

  it('2. Validasi judul (min 1, max 200, trimmed) dan batas maksimal 50 subtugas per tugas', async () => {
    // Empty title rejected
    const resEmpty = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/assignments/${assignmentAId}/subtasks`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ title: '   ' });

    expect(resEmpty.status).toBe(400);

    // Too long title rejected
    const resLong = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/assignments/${assignmentAId}/subtasks`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ title: 'a'.repeat(201) });

    expect(resLong.status).toBe(400);

    // Insert 50 subtasks
    const subtaskData = Array.from({ length: 50 }, (_, i) => ({
      assignmentId: assignmentAId,
      title: `Subtugas ${i + 1}`,
      order: i,
    }));
    await prisma.assignmentSubtask.createMany({ data: subtaskData });

    // 51st subtask must be rejected
    const resOver = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/assignments/${assignmentAId}/subtasks`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ title: 'Subtugas ke-51' });

    expect(resOver.status).toBe(400);
    expect(resOver.body.error.message).toContain('50');

    // Concurrent parallel attempt to add when at limit
    const parallelRequests = await Promise.all([
      request(app)
        .post(`/api/assignments/${assignmentAId}/subtasks`)
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', cookieA)
        .send({ title: 'Parallel 1' }),
      request(app)
        .post(`/api/assignments/${assignmentAId}/subtasks`)
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', cookieA)
        .send({ title: 'Parallel 2' }),
    ]);

    expect(parallelRequests[0].status).toBe(400);
    expect(parallelRequests[1].status).toBe(400);

    const count = await prisma.assignmentSubtask.count({ where: { assignmentId: assignmentAId } });
    expect(count).toBe(50);
  });

  it('3. Isolasi antar pengguna dan kecocokan subtask dengan tugas induk (404)', async () => {
    // Create subtask under user A
    const sub = await prisma.assignmentSubtask.create({
      data: {
        assignmentId: assignmentAId,
        title: 'Rahasia User A',
        order: 0,
      },
    });

    // User B tries to view User A's subtasks -> 404
    const resViewB = await request(app)
      .get(`/api/assignments/${assignmentAId}/subtasks`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB);
    expect(resViewB.status).toBe(404);

    // User B tries to update User A's subtask -> 404
    const resUpdateB = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/assignments/${assignmentAId}/subtasks/${sub.id}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB)
      .send({ completed: true });
    expect(resUpdateB.status).toBe(404);

    // User B tries to delete User A's subtask -> 404
    const resDeleteB = await request(app)
      .delete(`/api/assignments/${assignmentAId}/subtasks/${sub.id}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB);
    expect(resDeleteB.status).toBe(404);

    // User A provides mismatched assignmentId -> 404
    const otherAsg = await prisma.assignment.create({
      data: {
        userId: userAId,
        courseId: courseAId,
        title: 'Tugas Lain',
        dueDate: new Date(),
      },
    });

    const resMismatch = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/assignments/${otherAsg.id}/subtasks/${sub.id}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ completed: true });
    expect(resMismatch.status).toBe(404);
  });

  it('4. Request status berulang tetap idempotent', async () => {
    const sub = await prisma.assignmentSubtask.create({
      data: {
        assignmentId: assignmentAId,
        title: 'Uji Idempoten',
        isCompleted: false,
        order: 0,
      },
    });

    // Set to true
    const res1 = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/assignments/${assignmentAId}/subtasks/${sub.id}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ completed: true });
    expect(res1.body.subtask.completed).toBe(true);

    // Set to true again (must not flip to false!)
    const res2 = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/assignments/${assignmentAId}/subtasks/${sub.id}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ completed: true });
    expect(res2.body.subtask.completed).toBe(true);
  });

  it('5. Mutasi ditolak saat tugas induk telah selesai (DONE) atau terarsip', async () => {
    const sub = await prisma.assignmentSubtask.create({
      data: {
        assignmentId: assignmentAId,
        title: 'Langkah Awal',
        order: 0,
      },
    });

    // Mark parent assignment as DONE
    await prisma.assignment.update({
      where: { id: assignmentAId },
      data: { status: 'DONE', completedAt: new Date() },
    });

    // Attempt to add subtask -> rejected 400
    const resAdd = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/assignments/${assignmentAId}/subtasks`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ title: 'Subtugas baru saat selesai' });
    expect(resAdd.status).toBe(400);
    expect(resAdd.body.error.message).toContain('selesai');

    // Attempt to edit subtask -> rejected 400
    const resEdit = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/assignments/${assignmentAId}/subtasks/${sub.id}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ completed: true });
    expect(resEdit.status).toBe(400);

    // Attempt to delete subtask -> rejected 400
    const resDelete = await request(app)
      .delete(`/api/assignments/${assignmentAId}/subtasks/${sub.id}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);
    expect(resDelete.status).toBe(400);

    // Reopen assignment
    await prisma.assignment.update({
      where: { id: assignmentAId },
      data: { status: 'TODO', completedAt: null },
    });

    // Archive course
    await prisma.course.update({
      where: { id: courseAId },
      data: { archivedAt: new Date() },
    });

    // Attempt to add subtask on archived course -> rejected 400
    const resArchived = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/assignments/${assignmentAId}/subtasks`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ title: 'Subtugas pada mata kuliah arsip' });
    expect(resArchived.status).toBe(400);
  });

  it('6. Semua subtugas selesai TIDAK otomatis menyelesaikan induk; status subtugas tidak mengubah firstCompletedAt', async () => {
    const sub1 = await prisma.assignmentSubtask.create({
      data: { assignmentId: assignmentAId, title: 'Step 1', isCompleted: false, order: 0 },
    });
    const sub2 = await prisma.assignmentSubtask.create({
      data: { assignmentId: assignmentAId, title: 'Step 2', isCompleted: false, order: 1 },
    });

    // Complete all subtasks
    await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/assignments/${assignmentAId}/subtasks/${sub1.id}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ completed: true });

    await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/assignments/${assignmentAId}/subtasks/${sub2.id}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ completed: true });

    // Verify parent assignment is STILL TODO and firstCompletedAt is NULL
    const asg = await prisma.assignment.findUnique({
      where: { id: assignmentAId },
    });
    expect(asg?.status).toBe('TODO');
    expect(asg?.completedAt).toBeNull();
    expect(asg?.firstCompletedAt).toBeNull();

    // Verify subtaskCount in listAssignments
    const resList = await request(app)
      .get('/api/assignments')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);
    const listed = resList.body.assignments.find((a: any) => a.id === assignmentAId);
    expect(listed.subtaskCount).toEqual({ total: 2, completed: 2 });
  });

  it('7. Penghapusan tugas induk membersihkan semua subtugas (cascade delete)', async () => {
    await prisma.assignmentSubtask.createMany({
      data: [
        { assignmentId: assignmentAId, title: 'Subtask 1', order: 0 },
        { assignmentId: assignmentAId, title: 'Subtask 2', order: 1 },
      ],
    });

    expect(await prisma.assignmentSubtask.count({ where: { assignmentId: assignmentAId } })).toBe(2);

    // Delete parent assignment
    const resDel = await request(app)
      .delete(`/api/assignments/${assignmentAId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);
    expect(resDel.status).toBe(200);

    // Verify subtasks are deleted
    const countAfter = await prisma.assignmentSubtask.count({
      where: { assignmentId: assignmentAId },
    });
    expect(countAfter).toBe(0);
  });
});

<file path="apps/api/src/test/summary.test.ts">
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
import request from 'supertest';
import { createApp } from '../app.js';
import { prisma } from '@studyflow/database';

describe('Material AI Summary Endpoints & Quota Verification', () => {
  const app = createApp();
  const TRUSTED_ORIGIN = 'http://localhost:3000';

  let userAId: string;
  let userBId: string;
  let cookieA: string[];
  let cookieB: string[];
  let semAId: string;
  let courseAId: string;
  let readyMaterialAId: string;

  beforeEach(async () => {
    await prisma.user.deleteMany({
      where: { email: { contains: 'test.summary.' } },
    });

    // Create User A
    const emailA = `test.summary.a.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Summary User A',
        email: emailA,
        password: 'PasswordSangatKuat123!',
      });
    const loginA = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: emailA,
        password: 'PasswordSangatKuat123!',
      });
    userAId = loginA.body.user.id;
    cookieA = loginA.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];

    // Create User B
    const emailB = `test.summary.b.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Summary User B',
        email: emailB,
        password: 'PasswordSangatKuat123!',
      });
    const loginB = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: emailB,
        password: 'PasswordSangatKuat123!',
      });
    userBId = loginB.body.user.id;
    cookieB = loginB.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];

    // Create Semester & Course for User A
    const semResA = await request(app)
      .post('/api/semesters')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ name: 'Semester Ganjil 2026', academicYear: '2026/2027' });
    semAId = semResA.body.semester.id;

    const courseResA = await request(app)
      .post('/api/courses')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ semesterId: semAId, name: 'Kecerdasan Buatan', code: 'IF3110' });
    courseAId = courseResA.body.course.id;

    // Create a READY Material with extracted pages for User A
    const mat = await prisma.material.create({
      data: {
        userId: userAId,
        courseId: courseAId,
        title: 'Materi Kuliah AI Bab 1',
        originalFilename: 'kuliah-ai-bab1.pdf',
        storageKey: `materials/${userAId}/test-ai.pdf`,
        mimeType: 'application/pdf',
        bytes: 15000,
        pageCount: 2,
        status: 'READY',
      },
    });
    readyMaterialAId = mat.id;

    await prisma.materialPage.createMany({
      data: [
        {
          materialId: readyMaterialAId,
          pageNumber: 1,
          extractedText:
            'Kecerdasan Buatan adalah bidang ilmu komputer yang menekankan penciptaan mesin cerdas.',
          characterCount: 88,
        },
        {
          materialId: readyMaterialAId,
          pageNumber: 2,
          extractedText:
            'Aplikasi AI mencakup pengolahan bahasa alami, visi komputer, dan sistem pakar.',
          characterCount: 80,
        },
      ],
    });
  });

  it('GET /api/materials/usage/ai should return initial AI quota status', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .get('/api/materials/usage/ai')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);

    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.quota).toBeDefined();
    expect(res.body.quota.dailyLimit).toBe(20);
    expect(res.body.quota.dailyUsed).toBe(0);
    expect(res.body.quota.dailyRemaining).toBe(20);
    expect(res.body.quota.activeJobsLimit).toBe(2);
    expect(res.body.quota.activeJobsCount).toBe(0);
  });

  it('POST /api/materials/:id/summary should enqueue summary generation and reserve quota', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/materials/${readyMaterialAId}/summary`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({});

    expect(res.status).toBe(202);
    expect(res.body.jobId).toBeDefined();
    expect(res.body.summary).toBeDefined();
    expect(res.body.summary.status).toBe('QUEUED');
    expect(res.body.summary.materialId).toBe(readyMaterialAId);

    // Verify database state: AiUsage incremented
    const usage = await prisma.aiUsage.findUnique({
      where: { userId: userAId },
    });
    expect(usage?.dailyGenerationCount).toBe(1);
    expect(usage?.activeJobsCount).toBe(1);

    // Verify OutboxEvent created
    const outbox = await prisma.outboxEvent.findFirst({
      where: { eventType: 'AI_SUMMARY_REQUESTED', aggregateId: res.body.jobId },
    });
    expect(outbox).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it('POST /api/materials/:id/summary duplicate request should not reserve duplicate quota', async () => {
    // First request
    const res1 = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/materials/${readyMaterialAId}/summary`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({});
    expect(res1.status).toBe(202);

    // Second request while first is still QUEUED (duplicate click)
    const res2 = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/materials/${readyMaterialAId}/summary`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({});
    expect(res2.status).toBe(202);
    expect(res2.body.jobId).toBe(res1.body.jobId);

    // Verify daily count is still 1, NOT 2
    const usage = await prisma.aiUsage.findUnique({
      where: { userId: userAId },
    });
    expect(usage?.dailyGenerationCount).toBe(1);
    expect(usage?.activeJobsCount).toBe(1);
  });

  it('POST /api/materials/:id/summary should reject if material belongs to another user', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/materials/${readyMaterialAId}/summary`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB)
      .send({});

    expect(res.status).toBe(403);
  });

  it('POST /api/materials/:id/summary should reject if course is archived', async () => {
    await prisma.course.update({
      where: { id: courseAId },
      data: { archivedAt: new Date() },
    });

    const res = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/materials/${readyMaterialAId}/summary`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({});

    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('COURSE_ARCHIVED');
  });

  it('POST /api/materials/:id/summary should reject if material is not READY', async () => {
    const unreadyMat = await prisma.material.create({
      data: {
        userId: userAId,
        courseId: courseAId,
        title: 'Unready Material',
        originalFilename: 'unready.pdf',
        storageKey: `materials/${userAId}/unready.pdf`,
        mimeType: 'application/pdf',
        bytes: 5000,
        status: 'PROCESSING',
      },
    });

    const res = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/materials/${unreadyMat.id}/summary`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({});

    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('MATERIAL_NOT_READY');
  });

  it('POST /api/materials/:id/summary should enforce daily quota limit (20)', async () => {
    // Seed user usage to dailyLimit = 20
    await prisma.aiUsage.upsert({
      where: { userId: userAId },
      create: {
        userId: userAId,
        dailyGenerationCount: 20,
        activeJobsCount: 0,
      },
      update: {
        dailyGenerationCount: 20,
        activeJobsCount: 0,
      },
    });

    const res = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/materials/${readyMaterialAId}/summary`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({});

    expect(res.status).toBe(429);
    expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('AI_DAILY_QUOTA_EXCEEDED');
  });

  it('POST /api/materials/:id/summary should enforce max concurrent jobs limit (2)', async () => {
    // Seed user usage to activeJobsCount = 2
    await prisma.aiUsage.upsert({
      where: { userId: userAId },
      create: {
        userId: userAId,
        dailyGenerationCount: 5,
        activeJobsCount: 2,
      },
      update: {
        dailyGenerationCount: 5,
        activeJobsCount: 2,
      },
    });

    const res = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/materials/${readyMaterialAId}/summary`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({});

    expect(res.status).toBe(429);
    expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('AI_CONCURRENT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED');
  });

  it('POST /api/materials/:id/summary parallel requests (double-click) should result in exactly 1 job and 1 quota reservation', async () => {
    // Fire 5 concurrent requests on the same material simultaneously
    const responses = await Promise.all([
      request(app).post(`/api/materials/${readyMaterialAId}/summary`).set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN).set('Cookie', cookieA).send({}),
      request(app).post(`/api/materials/${readyMaterialAId}/summary`).set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN).set('Cookie', cookieA).send({}),
      request(app).post(`/api/materials/${readyMaterialAId}/summary`).set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN).set('Cookie', cookieA).send({}),
      request(app).post(`/api/materials/${readyMaterialAId}/summary`).set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN).set('Cookie', cookieA).send({}),
      request(app).post(`/api/materials/${readyMaterialAId}/summary`).set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN).set('Cookie', cookieA).send({}),
    ]);

    // All should return 202 Accepted (idempotent response)
    for (const res of responses) {
      expect(res.status).toBe(202);
      expect(res.body.jobId).toBe(responses[0].body.jobId);
    }

    // AiUsage should only have 1 generation and 1 active job
    const usage = await prisma.aiUsage.findUnique({ where: { userId: userAId } });
    expect(usage?.dailyGenerationCount).toBe(1);
    expect(usage?.activeJobsCount).toBe(1);

    // Only 1 ProcessingJob should exist
    const jobs = await prisma.processingJob.findMany({
      where: { materialId: readyMaterialAId, type: 'AI_SUMMARY_GENERATION' },
    });
    expect(jobs.length).toBe(1);
  });

  it('POST /api/materials/:id/summary should enforce concurrent active jobs limit (2) under parallel load', async () => {
    // Create 4 distinct READY materials for User A
    const matIds: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 1; i <= 4; i++) {
      const mat = await prisma.material.create({
        data: {
          userId: userAId,
          courseId: courseAId,
          title: `Concurrent Test Material ${i}`,
          originalFilename: `mat-${i}.pdf`,
          storageKey: `materials/${userAId}/mat-${i}.pdf`,
          mimeType: 'application/pdf',
          bytes: 10000,
          pageCount: 1,
          status: 'READY',
        },
      });
      await prisma.materialPage.create({
        data: {
          materialId: mat.id,
          pageNumber: 1,
          extractedText: `Isi materi uji konkurensi ${i} untuk pengujian batas paralel sistem.`,
          characterCount: 65,
        },
      });
      matIds.push(mat.id);
    }

    // Fire 4 parallel requests for the 4 distinct materials
    const responses = await Promise.all(
      matIds.map((id) =>
        request(app)
          .post(`/api/materials/${id}/summary`)
          .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
          .set('Cookie', cookieA)
          .send({})
      )
    );

    const successResponses = responses.filter((r) => r.status === 202);
    const limitResponses = responses.filter((r) => r.status === 429);

    // Exactly 2 must succeed and 2 must receive AI_CONCURRENT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
    expect(successResponses.length).toBe(2);
    expect(limitResponses.length).toBe(2);
    for (const r of limitResponses) {
      expect(r.body.error.code).toBe('AI_CONCURRENT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED');
    }

    // Database activeJobsCount must be exactly 2
    const usage = await prisma.aiUsage.findUnique({ where: { userId: userAId } });
    expect(usage?.activeJobsCount).toBe(2);
  });

  it('POST /api/materials/:id/summary should reject upfront with 400 DOCUMENT_TOO_LARGE when material exceeds bounds', async () => {
    const largeMat = await prisma.material.create({
      data: {
        userId: userAId,
        courseId: courseAId,
        title: 'Buku Ajar 150 Halaman',
        originalFilename: 'huge-book.pdf',
        storageKey: `materials/${userAId}/huge.pdf`,
        mimeType: 'application/pdf',
        bytes: 5000000,
        pageCount: 105, // > 100 pages
        status: 'READY',
      },
    });

    const res = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/materials/${largeMat.id}/summary`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({});

    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('DOCUMENT_TOO_LARGE');
  });

  it('POST /api/materials/:id/summary should reject upfront with 400 DOCUMENT_TOO_LARGE when a single page exceeds 40,000 characters', async () => {
    const matWithHugePage = await prisma.material.create({
      data: {
        userId: userAId,
        courseId: courseAId,
        title: 'Materi Satu Halaman 45rb Karakter',
        originalFilename: 'huge-page.pdf',
        storageKey: `materials/${userAId}/huge-page.pdf`,
        mimeType: 'application/pdf',
        bytes: 60000,
        pageCount: 1,
        status: 'READY',
      },
    });

    await prisma.materialPage.create({
      data: {
        materialId: matWithHugePage.id,
        pageNumber: 1,
        extractedText: 'A'.repeat(45000),
        characterCount: 45000,
      },
    });

    const res = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/materials/${matWithHugePage.id}/summary`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({});

    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('DOCUMENT_TOO_LARGE');
    expect(res.body.error.message).toContain('Halaman 1');
    expect(res.body.error.message).toContain('40.000');
  });

  it('POST /api/materials/:id/summary should reject upfront with 400 DOCUMENT_TOO_LARGE when total characters exceed 120,000 characters', async () => {
    const matOverLimit = await prisma.material.create({
      data: {
        userId: userAId,
        courseId: courseAId,
        title: 'Materi Total 130rb Karakter',
        originalFilename: 'huge-total.pdf',
        storageKey: `materials/${userAId}/huge-total.pdf`,
        mimeType: 'application/pdf',
        bytes: 140000,
        pageCount: 4,
        status: 'READY',
      },
    });

    await prisma.materialPage.createMany({
      data: [
        { materialId: matOverLimit.id, pageNumber: 1, extractedText: 'A'.repeat(35000), characterCount: 35000 },

        { materialId: matOverLimit.id, pageNumber: 3, extractedText: 'C'.repeat(35000), characterCount: 35000 },
        { materialId: matOverLimit.id, pageNumber: 4, extractedText: 'D'.repeat(35000), characterCount: 35000 },
      ],
    });

    const res = await request(app)
      .post(`/api/materials/${matOverLimit.id}/summary`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({});

    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('DOCUMENT_TOO_LARGE');
    expect(res.body.error.message).toContain('120.000');
  });

  it('GET /api/materials/:id/summary should return summary and quota', async () => {
    await prisma.materialSummary.create({
      data: {
        userId: userAId,
        materialId: readyMaterialAId,
        status: 'READY',
        title: 'Ringkasan Kecerdasan Buatan',
        overview: 'Overview testing',
        keyConcepts: [{ concept: 'C1', explanation: 'E1', pageReferences: [1] }],
        sections: [{ heading: 'S1', content: 'Cont1', pageReferences: [1] }],
        keyTerms: [{ term: 'T1', definition: 'D1', pageReferences: [1] }],
        sourcePageCount: 2,
        sourceCharacterCount: 168,

    const res = await request(app)
      .get(`/api/materials/${readyMaterialAId}/summary`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);

    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.body.summary).toBeDefined();
    expect(res.body.summary.status).toBe('READY');
    expect(res.body.summary.title).toBe('Ringkasan Kecerdasan Buatan');
    expect(res.body.quota).toBeDefined();

<file path="apps/api/src/test/turnstile.test.ts">
import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterAll } from 'vitest';
import request from 'supertest';
import { createApp } from '../app.js';
import { prisma } from '@studyflow/database';
import { __setMockTurnstileVerifier } from '../services/turnstile.service.js';
import { __getSentTestEmails, __clearSentTestEmails } from '../services/email.service.js';
import { hashPassword } from '../services/password.service.js';
import { __resetLoginProtectionMemory } from '../services/loginProtection.service.js';

describe('Cloudflare Turnstile Protection Tests', () => {
  const app = createApp();
  const TRUSTED_ORIGIN = 'http://localhost:3000';

  const cleanUsers = async () => {
    await prisma.passwordResetToken.deleteMany({
      where: {
        user: {
          email: { contains: 'turnstile.' },
        },
      },
    });
    await prisma.refreshSession.deleteMany({
      where: {
        user: {
          email: { contains: 'turnstile.' },
        },
      },
    });
    await prisma.user.deleteMany({
      where: {
        email: { contains: 'turnstile.' },
      },
    });
  };

  beforeEach(async () => {
    process.env.TEST_ENFORCE_TURNSTILE = 'true';
    __setMockTurnstileVerifier(null);
    __clearSentTestEmails();
    await cleanUsers();
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    delete process.env.TEST_ENFORCE_TURNSTILE;
    __setMockTurnstileVerifier(null);
    __clearSentTestEmails();
    await cleanUsers();
    await prisma.$disconnect();
  });

  describe('1. POST /api/auth/register with Turnstile', () => {
    it('menolak registrasi jika turnstileToken tidak dikirim (validation error)', async () => {
      const email = `turnstile.missing.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/register')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({
          name: 'No Token User',
          email,
          password: 'SecurePassword123!',
          timezone: 'Asia/Jakarta',
          // turnstileToken omitted
        });

      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
      expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('TURNSTILE_TOKEN_REQUIRED');

      // User tidak boleh dibuat di database
      const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email } });
      expect(user).toBeNull();
    });

    it('menolak registrasi jika turnstileToken kosong / whitespace', async () => {
      const email = `turnstile.empty.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/register')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({
          name: 'Empty Token User',
          email,
          password: 'SecurePassword123!',
          timezone: 'Asia/Jakarta',
          turnstileToken: '   ',
        });

      expect(res.status).toBe(400);

      const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email } });
      expect(user).toBeNull();
    });

    it('menolak registrasi dan tidak membuat user jika verifikasi Turnstile gagal', async () => {
      const email = `turnstile.failed.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
      __setMockTurnstileVerifier(() => false);

      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/register')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({
          name: 'Failed Turnstile User',
          email,
          password: 'SecurePassword123!',
          timezone: 'Asia/Jakarta',
          turnstileToken: 'mock-invalid-token',
        });

      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
      expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('TURNSTILE_VERIFICATION_FAILED');
      expect(res.body.error.message).toBe('Verifikasi keamanan gagal. Silakan coba lagi.');

      // Memastikan user tidak dibuat
      const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email } });
      expect(user).toBeNull();
    });

    it('berhasil membuat user jika verifikasi Turnstile valid', async () => {
      const email = `turnstile.success.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
      __setMockTurnstileVerifier(() => true);

      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/register')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({
          name: 'Success Turnstile User',
          email,
          password: 'SecurePassword123!',
          timezone: 'Asia/Jakarta',
          turnstileToken: 'valid-turnstile-token-12345',
        });

      expect(res.status).toBe(201);
      expect(res.body.user).toBeDefined();
      expect(res.body.user.email).toBe(email);

      const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email } });
      expect(user).toBeDefined();
    });
  });

  describe('2. POST /api/auth/forgot-password with Turnstile', () => {
    it('menolak forgot password jika turnstileToken tidak dikirim', async () => {
      const email = `turnstile.forgot.missing.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/forgot-password')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({ email });

      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
      expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('TURNSTILE_TOKEN_REQUIRED');

      expect(__getSentTestEmails()).toHaveLength(0);
    });

    it('menolak forgot password dan tidak mengirim email jika Turnstile gagal', async () => {
      const email = `turnstile.forgot.fail.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
      await prisma.user.create({
        data: {
          name: 'Target User',
          email,
          passwordHash: await hashPassword('LocalPass12345!'),
        },
      });

      __setMockTurnstileVerifier(() => false);

      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/forgot-password')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({
          email,
          turnstileToken: 'invalid-turnstile-token',
        });

      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
      expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('TURNSTILE_VERIFICATION_FAILED');

      // Email tidak boleh terkirim
      expect(__getSentTestEmails()).toHaveLength(0);

      // Token reset tidak boleh dibuat
      const tokens = await prisma.passwordResetToken.findMany({
        where: { user: { email } },
      });
      expect(tokens).toHaveLength(0);
    });

    it('berhasil memproses forgot password jika Turnstile valid', async () => {
      const email = `turnstile.forgot.ok.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
      await prisma.user.create({
        data: {
          name: 'Target User',
          email,
          passwordHash: await hashPassword('LocalPass12345!'),
        },
      });

      __setMockTurnstileVerifier(() => true);

      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/forgot-password')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({
          email,
          turnstileToken: 'valid-turnstile-token',
        });

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.body.message).toContain('Jika akun memenuhi syarat');
      expect(__getSentTestEmails()).toHaveLength(1);
    });
  });

  describe('3. Error & Network Failure Resilience', () => {
    it('menangani error network/service saat verifikasi Cloudflare dengan 503 yang aman', async () => {
      const email = `turnstile.network.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
      __setMockTurnstileVerifier(() => {
        throw new Error('Cloudflare network unreachable');
      });

      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/register')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .send({
          name: 'Network Error User',
          email,
          password: 'SecurePassword123!',
          timezone: 'Asia/Jakarta',
          turnstileToken: 'valid-token',
        });

      expect(res.status).toBe(503);
      expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('TURNSTILE_NETWORK_ERROR');
      expect(res.body.error.message).toContain('masalah jaringan');
    });
  });

  describe('4. Adaptive CAPTCHA for Login', () => {
    const validPassword = 'SecurePassword123!';
    let ipCounter = 0;
    // Unique client IP per test (trusted via loopback BFF proxy) so counters stay isolated
    const nextIp = () => `203.0.113.${(ipCounter += 1)}`;

    const createLoginUser = async () => {
      const email = `turnstile.login.${Date.now()}.${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}@example.com`;
      await prisma.user.create({
        data: { name: 'Login Turnstile User', email, passwordHash: await hashPassword(validPassword) },
      });
      return email;
    };

    const login = (ip: string, body: Record<string, string>) =>
      request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/login')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('X-Forwarded-For', ip)
        .send(body);

    beforeEach(() => {
      __resetLoginProtectionMemory();
    });

    it('login normal tanpa CAPTCHA berhasil bila belum ada kegagalan', async () => {
      const email = await createLoginUser();
      const res = await login(nextIp(), { email, password: validPassword });
      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    });

    it('ambang per akun: CAPTCHA wajib setelah 3 kali gagal, lalu sukses dengan token valid', async () => {
      const email = await createLoginUser();
      const ip = nextIp();

      for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i += 1) {
        const res = await login(ip, { email, password: 'WrongPassword123!' });
        expect(res.status).toBe(401);
        expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('INVALID_CREDENTIALS');
        expect(res.body.error.details?.requireCaptcha).toBe(i >= 3);
      }

      // Password benar tanpa token ditolak sebelum password diperiksa, tanpa sesi
      const blocked = await login(ip, { email, password: validPassword });
      expect(blocked.status).toBe(400);
      expect(blocked.body.error.code).toBe('TURNSTILE_TOKEN_REQUIRED');
      expect(blocked.body.error.details?.requireCaptcha).toBe(true);
      expect(blocked.headers['set-cookie']).toBeUndefined();

      // Ambang akun berlaku juga dari IP lain
      const otherIp = await login(nextIp(), { email, password: validPassword });
      expect(otherIp.status).toBe(400);
      expect(otherIp.body.error.code).toBe('TURNSTILE_TOKEN_REQUIRED');

      // Token tidak valid ditolak
      __setMockTurnstileVerifier(() => false);
      const invalid = await login(ip, { email, password: validPassword, turnstileToken: 'mock-invalid-token' });
      expect(invalid.status).toBe(400);
      expect(invalid.body.error.code).toBe('TURNSTILE_VERIFICATION_FAILED');
      expect(invalid.headers['set-cookie']).toBeUndefined();

      // Token valid + password benar berhasil
      __setMockTurnstileVerifier(() => true);
      const ok = await login(ip, { email, password: validPassword, turnstileToken: 'valid-turnstile-token' });
      expect(ok.status).toBe(200);
      expect(ok.body.user.email).toBe(email);
    });

    it('login sukses mereset penghitung akun, tetapi tidak mereset penghitung IP', async () => {
      const victim = await createLoginUser();
      const attacker = await createLoginUser();
      const ip = nextIp();

      // 2 kegagalan untuk akun victim (di bawah ambang akun)
      for (let i = 0; i < 2; i += 1) {
        await login(ip, { email: victim, password: 'WrongPassword123!' });
      }

      // Login sukses akun victim mereset penghitung akun victim
      const ok = await login(ip, { email: victim, password: validPassword });
      expect(ok.status).toBe(200);
      const afterReset = await login(ip, { email: victim, password: 'WrongPassword123!' });
      expect(afterReset.body.error.details?.requireCaptcha).toBe(false);

      // 7 kegagalan lagi dengan email acak dari IP yang sama -> total 10 kegagalan IP
      for (let i = 0; i < 7; i += 1) {
        await login(ip, { email: `turnstile.spray.${i}.${Date.now()}@example.com`, password: 'WrongPassword123!' });
      }

      // Login sukses akun milik penyerang tidak boleh mereset penghitung IP
      __setMockTurnstileVerifier(() => true);
      const attackerOwn = await login(ip, { email: attacker, password: validPassword, turnstileToken: 'valid-token' });
      expect(attackerOwn.status).toBe(200);

      const stillBlocked = await login(ip, { email: victim, password: validPassword });
      expect(stillBlocked.status).toBe(400);
      expect(stillBlocked.body.error.code).toBe('TURNSTILE_TOKEN_REQUIRED');
    });

    it('ambang per IP: credential stuffing lintas banyak email memicu CAPTCHA setelah 10 kegagalan', async () => {
      const ip = nextIp();
      for (let i = 1; i <= 10; i += 1) {
        const res = await login(ip, {
          email: `turnstile.stuff.${i}.${Date.now()}@example.com`,
          password: 'WrongPassword123!',
        });
        expect(res.status).toBe(401);
        // Setiap email hanya gagal 1x, jadi hanya ambang IP yang memicu CAPTCHA
        expect(res.body.error.details?.requireCaptcha).toBe(i >= 10);
      }

      const fresh = await createLoginUser();
      const res = await login(ip, { email: fresh, password: validPassword });
      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
      expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('TURNSTILE_TOKEN_REQUIRED');

      // IP lain tidak terpengaruh
      const otherIp = await login(nextIp(), { email: fresh, password: validPassword });
      expect(otherIp.status).toBe(200);
    });

    it('sinyal CAPTCHA identik untuk email terdaftar dan tidak terdaftar (tanpa enumerasi akun)', async () => {
      const registered = await createLoginUser();
      const unregistered = `turnstile.ghost.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
      const ipA = nextIp();
      const ipB = nextIp();

      for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i += 1) {
        const a = await login(ipA, { email: registered, password: 'WrongPassword123!' });
        const b = await login(ipB, { email: unregistered, password: 'WrongPassword123!' });
        expect(a.status).toBe(b.status);
        expect(a.body.error.code).toBe(b.body.error.code);
        expect(a.body.error.message).toBe(b.body.error.message);
        expect(a.body.error.details).toEqual(b.body.error.details);
      }

      const a = await login(ipA, { email: registered, password: 'Anything123!' });
      const b = await login(ipB, { email: unregistered, password: 'Anything123!' });
      expect(a.status).toBe(400);
      expect(b.status).toBe(400);
      expect(a.body.error.code).toBe(b.body.error.code);
      expect(a.body.error.message).toBe(b.body.error.message);
      expect(a.body.error.details).toEqual(b.body.error.details);
    });
  });
});

import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

/**
 * Pengujian E2E Redesign Tahap 17:
 * - Registrasi form validation
 * - Login gagal (password salah) lalu berhasil
 * - Pengaturan Profil: Retensi input saat PATCH gagal (500) & Sinkronisasi header nama/avatar saat sukses
 * - Keamanan Akun: Ganti password salah menghasilkan error inline, ganti password sukses mengikuti alur logout/login ulang
 */

test.describe('Auth & Settings Redesign Flow', () => {
  const originalPassword = 'InitialPassword123!';
  const updatedPassword = 'NewStrongPassword123!';

  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    page.on('pageerror', (err) => console.error('[BROWSER EXCEPTION]:', err));
  });

  async function registerAndLogin(page: any, name: string, email: string, password: string) {
    await page.goto('/register');
    await page.fill('#name', name);
    await page.fill('#email', email);
    await page.fill('#password', password);
    await page.click('button:has-text("Buat Akun")');
    await page.waitForURL('**/login?registered=true', { timeout: 15000 });

    await page.fill('#email', email);
    await page.fill('#password', password);
    await page.click('button:has-text("Masuk")');
    await page.waitForURL('**/dashboard', { timeout: 20000 });
  }

  test('1. Validasi Register & Login gagal lalu berhasil dengan retensi email', async ({ page }) => {
    test.setTimeout(60000);
    const testEmail1 = `auth-test1-${Date.now()}@studyflow.test`;

    // 1. Validasi Form Registrasi
    await page.goto('/register');
    await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Daftar Akun StudyFlow' })).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // Submit kosong untuk memicu validasi Zod client-side
    await page.click('button:has-text("Buat Akun")');
    await expect(page.locator('#name-error')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('#email-error')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('#password-error')).toBeVisible();

    // Isi formulir pendaftaran valid
    await page.fill('#name', 'Mahasiswa Penguji');
    await page.fill('#email', testEmail1);
    await page.fill('#password', originalPassword);

    // Uji toggle password di halaman register
    const toggleRegPwd = page.locator('button[aria-label="Tampilkan password"]');
    await expect(toggleRegPwd).toBeVisible();
    await toggleRegPwd.click();
    await expect(page.locator('#password')).toHaveAttribute('type', 'text');
    await page.locator('button[aria-label="Sembunyikan password"]').click();
    await expect(page.locator('#password')).toHaveAttribute('type', 'password');

    // Submit registrasi
    await page.click('button:has-text("Buat Akun")');

    // Verifikasi pengalihan ke /login?registered=true
    await page.waitForURL('**/login?registered=true', { timeout: 15000 });
    await expect(page.locator('text=Pendaftaran Berhasil')).toBeVisible();

    // 2. Login Gagal (Password Salah)
    await page.fill('#email', testEmail1);
    await page.fill('#password', 'WrongPassword123!');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Masuk")');

    // Verifikasi alert error dari server muncul dan nilai email tetap utuh
    await expect(page.locator('[role="alert"]:has-text("Gagal Masuk")')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
    await expect(page.locator('#email')).toHaveValue(testEmail1);

    // 3. Login Berhasil
    await page.fill('#password', originalPassword);
    await page.click('button:has-text("Masuk")');
    await page.waitForURL('**/dashboard', { timeout: 20000 });
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/.*dashboard/);
  });

  test('2. Pengaturan Profil: Retensi input saat server gagal 500 & Sinkronisasi header saat berhasil', async ({ page }) => {
    test.setTimeout(60000);
    const testEmail2 = `auth-test2-${Date.now()}@studyflow.test`;

    // Daftarkan dan login user terisolasi
    await registerAndLogin(page, 'User Profil Awal', testEmail2, originalPassword);

    // Buka Halaman Pengaturan
    await page.goto('/settings');
    await expect(page.locator('h1:has-text("Pengaturan Akun")')).toBeVisible();

    // Verifikasi email bersifat read-only / disabled
    const emailInput = page.locator('#profile-email');
    await expect(emailInput).toBeDisabled();
    await expect(emailInput).toHaveValue(testEmail2);

    // Ubah nama profil
    const nameInput = page.locator('#profile-name');
    await nameInput.fill('Nama Gagal Simpan');

    // Mock kegagalan server HTTP 500 pada update profile
    await page.route('**/api/auth/me', async (route) => {
      if (route.request().method() === 'PATCH') {
        await route.fulfill({
          status: 500,
          contentType: 'application/json',
          body: JSON.stringify({ error: { message: 'Simulasi kegagalan server profil 500' } }),
        });
      } else {
        await route.continue();
      }
    });

    await page.click('button:has-text("Simpan Profil")');

    // Verifikasi pesan error muncul dan input nama TETAP dipertahankan
    await expect(page.locator('[role="alert"]:has-text("Simulasi kegagalan server profil 500")')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
    await expect(nameInput).toHaveValue('Nama Gagal Simpan');

    // Unroute mock failure
    await page.unroute('**/api/auth/me');

    // Simpan profil berhasil dengan nama baru
    const updatedName = 'Bima Mahasiswa Berprestasi';
    await nameInput.fill(updatedName);
    await page.click('button:has-text("Simpan Profil")');

    // Verifikasi alert sukses muncul
    await expect(page.locator('text=Profil dan zona waktu berhasil diperbarui.')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // Verifikasi sinkronisasi nama dan avatar di header secara instan
    const headerAccountTrigger = page.locator(`button[aria-label="Menu akun untuk ${updatedName}"]`);
    await expect(headerAccountTrigger).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
    await expect(headerAccountTrigger.getByText(updatedName)).toBeVisible();
  });

  test('3. Keamanan Akun: Ganti password salah gagal inline, ganti password sukses mencabut sesi dan login ulang', async ({ page }) => {
    test.setTimeout(60000);
    const testEmail3 = `auth-test3-${Date.now()}@studyflow.test`;

    // Daftarkan dan login user terisolasi
    await registerAndLogin(page, 'User Password Test', testEmail3, originalPassword);

    // Buka Halaman Pengaturan
    await page.goto('/settings');
    await expect(page.locator('h1:has-text("Pengaturan Akun")')).toBeVisible();

    // 1. Uji ganti password dengan password saat ini yang salah
    await page.fill('#currentPassword', 'PasswordLamaSalah123!');
    await page.fill('#newPassword', updatedPassword);
    await page.fill('#confirmPassword', updatedPassword);
    await page.click('button:has-text("Ganti Password")');

    // Verifikasi pesan error muncul di form tanpa menutup halaman
    await expect(page.locator('[role="alert"]:has-text("Password saat ini tidak sesuai")')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // 2. Uji ganti password dengan data yang benar
    await page.fill('#currentPassword', originalPassword);
    await page.fill('#newPassword', updatedPassword);
    await page.fill('#confirmPassword', updatedPassword);
    await page.click('button:has-text("Ganti Password")');

    // Verifikasi pesan sukses muncul dan diarahkan ke login
    await expect(page.locator('text=Password berhasil diubah')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
    await page.waitForURL('**/login', { timeout: 15000 });

    // 3. Verifikasi login dengan password lama DITOLAK
    await page.fill('#email', testEmail3);
    await page.fill('#password', originalPassword);
    await page.click('button:has-text("Masuk")');
    await expect(page.locator('[role="alert"]:has-text("Gagal Masuk")')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // 4. Verifikasi login dengan password baru BERHASIL
    await page.fill('#password', updatedPassword);
    await page.click('button:has-text("Masuk")');
    await page.waitForURL('**/dashboard', { timeout: 20000 });
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/.*dashboard/);
  });
});

test.use({ screenshot: 'off' });

test.describe('Courses & Semesters Management Flow', () => {
  const testPassword = 'TestPassword123!';

  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    page.on('pageerror', (err) => console.error('[BROWSER EXCEPTION]:', err));
  });

  async function registerAndLogin(page: any) {
    const userEmail = `course-sem-${Date.now()}-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000000)}@studyflow.test`;
    await page.goto('/register');
    await page.fill('#name', 'Course Sem Tester');
    await page.fill('#email', userEmail);
    await page.fill('#password', testPassword);
    await page.click('button:has-text("Buat Akun")');
    await page.waitForURL('**/login?registered=true', { timeout: 15000 });

    await page.fill('#email', userEmail);
    await page.fill('#password', testPassword);
    await page.click('button:has-text("Masuk")');
    await page.waitForURL('**/dashboard', { timeout: 20000 });
  }

  test('1. Retensi input saat pembuatan semester & mata kuliah gagal HTTP 500', async ({ page }) => {

    await page.fill('#create-sem-year', semYear);

        await route.fulfill({
          status: 500,
          contentType: 'application/json',

        });
      } else {
        await route.continue();
      }
    });

    await page.locator('div[role="dialog"] button:has-text("Simpan Semester")').click();

    // Verifikasi dialog tetap terbuka, alert error muncul, dan input tetap utuh

    await expect(page.locator('#create-sem-year')).toHaveValue(semYear);

    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]')).not.toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    await page.click('button:has-text("Tambah mata kuliah")');

    const courseName = 'Algoritma Pemrograman Lanjut';
    const courseCode = 'IF220';
    const courseLecturer = 'Dr. Handoko';
    await page.fill('#create-course-name', courseName);
    await page.fill('#create-course-code', courseCode);
    await page.fill('#create-course-lecturer', courseLecturer);

      if (route.request().method() === 'POST') {
        await route.fulfill({
          status: 500,
          contentType: 'application/json',
          body: JSON.stringify({ error: { message: 'Server database error saat simpan mata kuliah' } }),
        });
      } else {
        await route.continue();
      }
    });

    await page.locator('div[role="dialog"] button:has-text("Simpan Mata Kuliah")').click();

    // Verifikasi dialog tetap terbuka, alert error muncul, dan nilai input dipertahankan
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"] [role="alert"]')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
    await expect(page.locator('#create-course-name')).toHaveValue(courseName);
    await expect(page.locator('#create-course-code')).toHaveValue(courseCode);
    await expect(page.locator('#create-course-lecturer')).toHaveValue(courseLecturer);

    // Unroute mock dan coba simpan kembali
    await page.unroute('**/api/courses');
    await page.locator('div[role="dialog"] button:has-text("Simpan Mata Kuliah")').click();
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]')).not.toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText(courseName)).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
  });

  test('2. Aktivasi semester: penolakan kegagalan & sinkronisasi sidebar saat berhasil', async ({ page }) => {
    test.setTimeout(60000);
    await registerAndLogin(page);

    // 1. Buat Semester 1 (Aktif)
    await page.goto('/semesters');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Tambah Semester")');
    await page.fill('#create-sem-name', 'Semester Gasal 2026');
    await page.fill('#create-sem-year', '2026/2027');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Simpan Semester")');
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText('Semester Gasal 2026')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // 2. Buat Semester 2 (Non-aktif)
    await page.click('button:has-text("Tambah Semester")');
    await page.fill('#create-sem-name', 'Semester Genap 2027');
    await page.fill('#create-sem-year', '2026/2027');
    // Jangan centang makeActive
    await page.click('button:has-text("Simpan Semester")');
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText('Semester Genap 2027')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // Verifikasi Semester 2 memiliki status Non-aktif dan ada tombol "Jadikan Aktif"
    const sem2Row = page.locator('tr:has-text("Semester Genap 2027")');
    await expect(sem2Row.getByText('Non-aktif').filter({ visible: true })).toBeVisible();
    const activateBtn = sem2Row.locator('button:has-text("Jadikan Aktif")').filter({ visible: true });
    await expect(activateBtn).toBeVisible();

    // 3. Simulasikan kegagalan aktivasi semester (HTTP 500)
    await page.route('**/api/semesters/*/activate', async (route) => {
      await route.fulfill({
        status: 500,
        contentType: 'application/json',
        body: JSON.stringify({ error: { message: 'Gagal mengaktifkan semester di backend.' } }),
      });
    });

    await activateBtn.click();

    // Verifikasi error alert muncul dan status Semester 2 TETAP Non-aktif
    await expect(page.locator('[role="alert"]:has-text("Gagal mengaktifkan semester")')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
    await expect(sem2Row.getByText('Non-aktif', { exact: true }).filter({ visible: true })).toBeVisible();

    // Unroute mock failure
    await page.unroute('**/api/semesters/*/activate');

    // 4. Aktivasi berhasil
    await activateBtn.click();

    // Verifikasi Semester 2 kini berstatus Aktif
    await expect(sem2Row.getByText('Aktif', { exact: true }).filter({ visible: true })).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // 5. Verifikasi sinkronisasi selector semester di sidebar
    const sidebarSelector = page.locator('button[aria-label="Pilih semester aktif"]');
    await expect(sidebarSelector.getByText('Semester Genap 2027')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
  });

  test('3. Konfirmasi aksi destruktif: dialog hapus mata kuliah dan semester menyebutkan nama spesifik', async ({ page }) => {
    test.setTimeout(60000);
    await registerAndLogin(page);

    // 1. Buat Semester
    await page.goto('/semesters');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Tambah Semester")');
    const semName = 'Semester Basis Data';
    await page.fill('#create-sem-name', semName);
    await page.fill('#create-sem-year', '2026/2027');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Simpan Semester")');
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText(semName)).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // 2. Buat Mata Kuliah
    await page.goto('/courses');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Tambah mata kuliah")');
    const courseName = 'Sistem Manajemen Basis Data';
    await page.fill('#create-course-name', courseName);
    await page.click('button:has-text("Simpan Mata Kuliah")');
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText(courseName)).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // 3. Uji Konfirmasi Dialog Hapus Mata Kuliah

import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test.describe('E2E: Date Picker Basic (Shadcn Popover + Calendar)', () => {
  const testEmail = `datepicker.test.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
  const testPassword = 'Password123456!';
  const testName = 'Mahasiswa Test DatePicker';

    await page.fill('#name', testName);
    await page.fill('#email', testEmail);

    await page.waitForURL('**/dashboard', { timeout: 15000 });

    // 2. Buat Semester aktif & Mata Kuliah
    await page.click('button:has-text("Kelola semester")');
    await expect(page.locator('text=Daftar Semester')).toBeVisible();
    await page.click('button:has-text("Tambah semester")');
    await page.fill('input#name', 'Semester Ganjil 2026/2027');
    await page.fill('input#academicYear', '2026/2027');
    await page.check('input#makeActive');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Simpan Semester")');
    await expect(page.locator('text=Semester Ganjil 2026/2027')).toBeVisible();

    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
    await page.click('a[href="/courses"], button:has-text("Mata Kuliah")');
    await page.waitForURL('**/courses');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Tambah mata kuliah")');
    await page.fill('input#course-name', 'Pemrograman Lanjut');
    await page.fill('input#course-code', 'IF2101');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Simpan Mata Kuliah")');
    await expect(page.locator('text=Pemrograman Lanjut')).toBeVisible();
  });

  test('menguji interaksi Date Picker Basic: buka kalender, pilih tanggal, format Indonesia, tutup otomatis, dan simpan form', async ({ page }) => {
    // Buka halaman tugas
    await page.click('a[href="/assignments"], button:has-text("Tugas")');
    await page.waitForURL('**/assignments');
    await expect(page.locator('text=Belum ada tugas kuliah')).toBeVisible();

    // Buka Dialog Tambah Tugas Baru
    await page.click('button:has-text("Tambah tugas")');
    await expect(page.locator('text=Tambah Tugas Baru')).toBeVisible();

    // Periksa trigger Date Picker awal
    const datePickerTrigger = page.locator('#create-due');
    await expect(datePickerTrigger).toBeVisible();
    await expect(datePickerTrigger).toContainText('Pilih tanggal');

    // Input jam terpisah memiliki nilai default 23:59 atau kosong
    const timeInput = page.locator('#create-due-time');
    await expect(timeInput).toBeVisible();

    // 1. Uji Validasi Required: Submit tanpa tanggal gagal dengan error semantik
    await page.fill('#create-title', 'Tugas Uji Validasi');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Simpan Tugas")');
    await expect(page.locator('text=Tenggat waktu wajib diisi')).toBeVisible();

    // 2. Buka Date Picker Popover di dalam Dialog
    await datePickerTrigger.click();
    const calendarSlot = page.locator('[data-slot="calendar"]');
    await expect(calendarSlot).toBeVisible();

    // Pilih tanggal 20
    const day20Button = calendarSlot.locator('button:not([disabled])').getByText('20', { exact: true }).first();
    await day20Button.click();

    // Popover kalender harus otomatis menutup setelah tanggal dipilih
    await expect(calendarSlot).not.toBeVisible();

    // Trigger harus menampilkan tanggal dalam format Bahasa Indonesia (misal: "20 [Bulan] [Tahun]")
    await expect(datePickerTrigger).toContainText('20');
    await expect(datePickerTrigger).not.toContainText('Pilih tanggal');

    // 3. Ubah jam pada input waktu terpisah
    await timeInput.fill('15:30');
    await expect(timeInput).toHaveValue('15:30');

    // 4. Simpan tugas
    await page.click('button:has-text("Simpan Tugas")');
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText('Tugas Uji Validasi')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // 5. Uji Edit Nilai Existing: Buka modal edit
    await page.click('button[aria-label*="Aksi untuk Tugas Uji Validasi"]');
    await page.click('div[role="menuitem"]:has-text("Edit tugas")');
    await expect(page.locator('text=Edit Tugas')).toBeVisible();

    // Trigger edit harus menampilkan tanggal tersimpan
    const editDueTrigger = page.locator('#edit-due');
    await expect(editDueTrigger).toBeVisible();
    await expect(editDueTrigger).toContainText('20');

    // Input jam terpisah pada edit harus menampilkan jam tersimpan (15:30)
    const editTimeInput = page.locator('#edit-due-time');
    await expect(editTimeInput).toHaveValue('15:30');

    // Buka kalender pada mode edit -> harus memuat bulan dari tanggal tersimpan
    await editDueTrigger.click();
    await expect(page.locator('[data-slot="calendar"]')).toBeVisible();

    // Ganti ke tanggal 22
    const day22Button = page.locator('[data-slot="calendar"] button:not([disabled])').getByText('22', { exact: true }).first();
    await day22Button.click();
    await expect(page.locator('[data-slot="calendar"]')).not.toBeVisible();
    await expect(editDueTrigger).toContainText('22');

    // Simpan perubahan
    await page.click('button:has-text("Simpan Perubahan")');
    await expect(page.locator('text=Edit Tugas')).not.toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText('Tugas Uji Validasi')).toBeVisible();
  });
});

import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

/**
 * Pengujian E2E Redesign Tahap 18:
 * 1. Landing page public state (Guest): Navbar CTA, Hero <h1>, navigasi section, kontrol tema, ketiadaan artefak milestone/infrastruktur.
 * 2. DOM Horizontal Overflow check (Desktop 1280px & Mobile 375px).

 * 4. Pengaturan Akun: Verifikasi label "Email" dan ketiadaan klaim "terverifikasi".
 */

test.describe('Landing Page & Settings Verification Flow', () => {
  const testPassword = 'InitialPassword123!';

  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    page.on('pageerror', (err) => console.error('[BROWSER EXCEPTION]:', err));
  });

  async function registerAndLogin(page: any, name: string, email: string) {
    await page.goto('/register');
    await page.fill('#name', name);
    await page.fill('#email', email);
    await page.fill('#password', testPassword);
    await page.click('button:has-text("Buat Akun")');
    await page.waitForURL('**/login?registered=true', { timeout: 15000 });

    await page.fill('#email', email);
    await page.fill('#password', testPassword);
    await page.click('button:has-text("Masuk")');
    await page.waitForURL('**/dashboard', { timeout: 20000 });
  }

  test('1. Landing page publik untuk tamu: Navbar, Hero H1, Fitur, Cara Kerja, dan bebas artefak pengembangan', async ({ page }) => {
    test.setTimeout(45000);

    await page.goto('/');

    // 1. Verifikasi Heading Utama tunggal (H1)
    const h1 = page.locator('h1');
    await expect(h1).toHaveCount(1);
    await expect(h1).toHaveText('Materi, tugas, dan catatan kuliah lebih teratur.');

    // 2. Verifikasi CTA Tamu di Navbar dan Hero
    await expect(page.locator('header a[href="/login"] button:has-text("Masuk")')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('header a[href="/register"] button:has-text("Daftar")')).toBeVisible();

    const heroPrimaryCta = page.locator('main a[href="/register"] button:has-text("Mulai Belajar Sekarang")');
    await expect(heroPrimaryCta).toBeVisible();

    // 3. Verifikasi Navigasi Section
    await expect(page.locator('#fitur')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('#cara-kerja')).toBeVisible();

    // 4. Verifikasi Kontrol Tema dapat berinteraksi
    const themeRadio = page.locator('header input[type="radio"], header button[role="radio"]').first();
    if (await themeRadio.isVisible()) {
      await expect(themeRadio).toBeEnabled();
    }

    // 5. Verifikasi bebas dari artefak pengembangan lama
    await expect(page.locator('text=Milestone 2')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.locator('text=Next.js BFF Adapter')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.locator('text=Port 3000')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.locator('text=Port 4000')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.locator('text=Milestone 3')).toHaveCount(0);
  });

  test('2. DOM overflow check pada viewport Desktop (1280px) dan Mobile (375px)', async ({ page }) => {
    test.setTimeout(45000);

    // Desktop Viewport
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1280, height: 800 });
    await page.goto('/');
    const hasDesktopOverflow = await page.evaluate(() => {
      return document.documentElement.scrollWidth > window.innerWidth;
    });
    expect(hasDesktopOverflow).toBe(false);

    // Mobile Viewport (375px)
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 375, height: 667 });
    await page.goto('/');
    const hasMobileOverflow = await page.evaluate(() => {
      return document.documentElement.scrollWidth > window.innerWidth;
    });
    expect(hasMobileOverflow).toBe(false);
  });

  test('3. Landing page untuk pengguna yang sudah login: Navigasi mengarah ke Dashboard', async ({ page }) => {
    test.setTimeout(60000);
    const testEmail3 = `landing-test3-${Date.now()}@studyflow.test`;

    // Registrasi & login user
    await registerAndLogin(page, 'Mahasiswa Penguji Landing', testEmail3);

    // Buka kembali halaman beranda publik
    await page.goto('/');

    // Verifikasi tombol di Navbar kini berupa Dashboard
    await expect(page.locator('header a[href="/dashboard"] button:has-text("Dashboard")')).toBeVisible();

    // Verifikasi tombol di Hero kini mengarahkan ke Dashboard
    await expect(page.locator('main a[href="/dashboard"] button:has-text("Buka Dashboard Belajar")')).toBeVisible();
  });

  test('4. Pengaturan Akun: Label Email bersih dan klaim "terverifikasi" tidak muncul', async ({ page }) => {
    test.setTimeout(60000);
    const testEmail4 = `landing-test4-${Date.now()}@studyflow.test`;

    // Registrasi & login user
    await registerAndLogin(page, 'Mahasiswa Penguji Settings', testEmail4);

    // Buka pengaturan akun dengan user yang sudah login
    await page.goto('/settings');
    await expect(page.locator('h1:has-text("Pengaturan Akun")')).toBeVisible();

    // Verifikasi label email adalah 'Email'
    const emailLabel = page.locator('label[for="profile-email"]');
    await expect(emailLabel).toHaveText('Email');

    // Verifikasi input email disabled/read-only
    const emailInput = page.locator('#profile-email');
    await expect(emailInput).toBeDisabled();

    // Verifikasi klaim 'terverifikasi' TIDAK ada di dalam kartu profil
    const profileCard = page.locator('.space-y-4').first();
    await expect(profileCard.locator('text=terverifikasi')).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.locator('text=Akun Terverifikasi')).toHaveCount(0);
  });

test.describe('Notes List & Dialog Management Flow', () => {

  test('Daftar catatan: Onboarding, input retention form, search, batalkan hapus, dan hapus catatan', async ({ page }) => {
    test.setTimeout(60000);
    await registerAndLogin(page);
    await setupSemesterAndCourse(page);

    // 1. Kunjungi Halaman Catatan
    await page.goto('/notes');
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/notes/);

    // Verifikasi Header & Konteks Semester
    await expect(page.locator('h1')).toHaveText('Catatan');
    await expect(page.locator('main').getByText('Semester Ganjil OS (2026/2027)')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
    await expect(page.locator('main').getByText('0 catatan terdaftar')).toBeVisible();

    // Verifikasi Empty Onboarding
    await expect(page.locator('text=Belum ada catatan belajar')).toBeVisible();

    // 2. Tambah Catatan 1 & Verifikasi Input Retention
    await page.click('button:has-text("Buat catatan")');
    await expect(page.locator('text=Buat Catatan Baru')).toBeVisible();

    // Coba submit tanpa judul untuk menguji retensi input & pesan error
    await page.fill('#create-note-content', 'Catatan penting mengenai starvation dan deadlock.');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Buat & Buka Editor")');
    await expect(page.locator('text=Judul catatan wajib diisi')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('#create-note-content')).toHaveValue('Catatan penting mengenai starvation dan deadlock.');

    // Lengkapi judul dan buat catatan
    await page.fill('#create-note-title', 'Catatan Deadlock dan Concurrency');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Buat & Buka Editor")');
    await page.waitForURL('**/notes/**', { timeout: 15000 });

    // 3. Tambah Catatan 2
    await page.goto('/notes');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Buat catatan")');
    await page.fill('#create-note-title', 'Catatan Manajemen Memori Virtual');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Buat & Buka Editor")');
    await page.waitForURL('**/notes/**', { timeout: 15000 });

    // 4. Verifikasi Tampilan di Daftar Catatan
    await page.goto('/notes');
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText('Catatan Deadlock dan Concurrency')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText('Catatan Manajemen Memori Virtual')).toBeVisible();

    // 5. Pencarian & Reset Filter
    await page.fill('input[placeholder="Cari judul catatan..."]', 'Deadlock');
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText('Catatan Deadlock dan Concurrency')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText('Catatan Manajemen Memori Virtual')).not.toBeVisible();

    await page.click('button:has-text("Hapus filter")');
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText('Catatan Deadlock dan Concurrency')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText('Catatan Manajemen Memori Virtual')).toBeVisible();

    // 6. Dialog Hapus Catatan (Batal & Eksekusi Hapus)
    const secondRow = page.locator('tr').filter({ hasText: 'Catatan Manajemen Memori Virtual' });
    await secondRow.locator('button[aria-label*="Menu aksi"]').click();
    await page.click('text=Hapus catatan');

    // Dialog hapus terbuka dan menyebutkan judul catatan
    await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Hapus Catatan' })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('text=Apakah Anda yakin ingin menghapus catatan')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]').getByText('Catatan Manajemen Memori Virtual')).toBeVisible();

    // Batalkan hapus
    await page.click('button:has-text("Batal")');
    await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Hapus Catatan' })).not.toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText('Catatan Manajemen Memori Virtual')).toBeVisible();

    // Buka kembali dialog dan konfirmasi Hapus
    await secondRow.locator('button[aria-label*="Menu aksi"]').click();
    await page.click('text=Hapus catatan');
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Hapus Catatan' }).click();

    // Verifikasi catatan terhapus
    await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Hapus Catatan' })).not.toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText('Catatan Manajemen Memori Virtual')).not.toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText('Catatan Deadlock dan Concurrency')).toBeVisible();
  });
});
