    await expect(page.getByText('08:00 – 10:00').first()).toBeVisible();

    // Hapus sesi jadwal via dropdown menu
    const updatedCard = page.locator('.group').filter({ hasText: 'Lab Riset 303' }).first();
    await updatedCard.locator('button[aria-label^="Menu aksi jadwal"]').click();
    await page.click('text=Hapus Sesi');
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]')).toBeVisible();

    // Dialog konfirmasi menyebut nama mata kuliah, hari, dan rentang waktu
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]')).toContainText(course1Name);
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]')).toContainText('Senin');
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]')).toContainText('08:00 – 10:00');

    await page.locator('div[role="dialog"] button:has-text("Hapus Jadwal")').click();
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]')).not.toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // Kembali ke empty state
    await expect(page.getByText('Belum Ada Jadwal Kuliah')).toBeVisible();
  });

  test('2. Retensi isian formulir jadwal saat request pembuatan gagal HTTP 500', async ({ page }) => {
    test.setTimeout(60000);
    await registerAndLogin(page);
    await setupSemesterAndCourses(page);

    await page.goto('/schedule');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Tambah jadwal")');
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]')).toBeVisible();

    await page.selectOption('#schedule-day', '2'); // Selasa
    await page.fill('#schedule-start-time', '10:00');
    await page.fill('#schedule-end-time', '11:40');
    await page.fill('#schedule-room', 'Ruang Teori 404');

    // Mock failure HTTP 500
    await page.route('**/api/schedules', async (route) => {
      if (route.request().method() === 'POST') {
        await route.fulfill({
          status: 500,
          contentType: 'application/json',
          body: JSON.stringify({ error: { message: 'Gagal menyimpan jadwal karena kendala basis data' } }),
        });
      } else {
        await route.continue();
      }
    });

    await page.locator('div[role="dialog"] button:has-text("Simpan Jadwal")').click();

    // Verifikasi alert error muncul, dialog tidak tertutup, dan isian tidak hilang
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"] [role="alert"]')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
    await expect(page.locator('#schedule-day')).toHaveValue('2');
    await expect(page.locator('#schedule-start-time')).toHaveValue('10:00');
    await expect(page.locator('#schedule-end-time')).toHaveValue('11:40');
    await expect(page.locator('#schedule-room')).toHaveValue('Ruang Teori 404');

    // Unroute dan simpan kembali dengan normal
    await page.unroute('**/api/schedules');
    await page.locator('div[role="dialog"] button:has-text("Simpan Jadwal")').click();
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]')).not.toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
    await expect(page.getByText('Ruang Teori 404').first()).toBeVisible();
  });

  test('3. Deteksi konflik waktu non-blocking & visibilitas konflik saat filter aktif', async ({ page }) => {
    test.setTimeout(75000);
    await registerAndLogin(page);
    const { course1Name, course2Name } = await setupSemesterAndCourses(page);

    await page.goto('/schedule');

    // 1. Tambah sesi 1: Course 1 pada Selasa 10:00 - 11:40
    await page.click('button:has-text("Tambah jadwal")');
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]')).toBeVisible();
    const course1Val = await page.locator('#schedule-course option', { hasText: course1Name }).getAttribute('value');
    await page.selectOption('#schedule-course', course1Val!);
    await page.selectOption('#schedule-day', '2'); // Selasa
    await page.fill('#schedule-start-time', '10:00');
    await page.fill('#schedule-end-time', '11:40');
    await page.fill('#schedule-room', 'Lab A');
    await page.locator('div[role="dialog"] button:has-text("Simpan Jadwal")').click();
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]')).not.toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // 2. Tambah sesi 2: Course 2 pada Selasa 11:00 - 12:40 (Bertabrakan 11:00-11:40)
    await page.click('button:has-text("Tambah jadwal")');
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]')).toBeVisible();
    const course2Val = await page.locator('#schedule-course option', { hasText: course2Name }).getAttribute('value');
    await page.selectOption('#schedule-course', course2Val!);
    await page.selectOption('#schedule-day', '2'); // Selasa
    await page.fill('#schedule-start-time', '11:00');
    await page.fill('#schedule-end-time', '12:40');
    await page.fill('#schedule-room', 'Lab B');
    await page.locator('div[role="dialog"] button:has-text("Simpan Jadwal")').click();
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]')).not.toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // Banner konflik non-blocking muncul
    await expect(page.getByText('Jadwal disimpan, tetapi waktunya bertabrakan')).toBeVisible();

    // Kedua sesi tetap tersimpan dan keduanya menampilkan indikator benturan
    await expect(page.getByText('Lab A').first()).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByText('Lab B').first()).toBeVisible();
    const conflictBadges = page.locator('text=Benturan Waktu');
    await expect(conflictBadges.first()).toBeVisible();

    // 3. Uji filter mata kuliah: Pilih Course 2 saja
    const filter2Val = await page.locator('#course-filter option', { hasText: course2Name }).getAttribute('value');
    await page.selectOption('#course-filter', filter2Val!);

    // Sesi Course 1 (Lab A) disembunyikan oleh filter
    await expect(page.getByText('Lab A')).not.toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByText('Lab B').first()).toBeVisible();

    // Badge konflik pada Course 2 tetap terlihat dan menyebut tabrakan dengan Course 1
    await expect(page.locator('text=Benturan Waktu').first()).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByText(course1Name).first()).toBeVisible();

    // Reset filter
    await page.click('button:has-text("Reset Filter")');
    await expect(page.getByText('Lab A').first()).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByText('Lab B').first()).toBeVisible();
  });

    // Sesi muncul di daftar jadwal detail mata kuliah
    await expect(page.getByText('Rabu')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByText('13:00 – 14:40')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByText('Ruang Teori 505')).toBeVisible();

    // Klik tombol tautan "Buka di Jadwal Mingguan"
    await page.click('a:has-text("Buka di Jadwal Mingguan")');
    await page.waitForURL('**/schedule?courseId=**', { timeout: 15000 });

    // Filter mata kuliah di halaman jadwal harus sudah terisi course1
    await expect(page.locator('#course-filter')).not.toHaveValue('all');
    await expect(page.getByText('Ruang Teori 505').first()).toBeVisible();
  });

  test('5. Agenda mobile menampilkan selector hari yang nyaman & timezone pengguna', async ({ page }) => {
    test.setTimeout(60000);
    // Atur viewport mobile 375x667
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 375, height: 667 });

    await registerAndLogin(page);
    await setupSemesterAndCourses(page);

    // Tambah jadwal Kamis (4) jam 09:00 - 10:40
    await page.goto('/schedule');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Tambah jadwal")');
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]')).toBeVisible();

    await page.selectOption('#schedule-day', '4'); // Kamis
    await page.fill('#schedule-start-time', '09:00');
    await page.fill('#schedule-end-time', '10:40');
    await page.fill('#schedule-room', 'Mobile Room 1');
    await page.locator('div[role="dialog"] button:has-text("Simpan Jadwal")').click();
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]')).not.toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // Pada mobile, selector hari muncul (Sen, Sel, Rab, Kam, Jum, Sab, Min)
    const kamisTab = page.locator('button[aria-label*="Kamis"]').first();
    await expect(kamisTab).toBeVisible();

    // Klik tab hari Kamis
    await kamisTab.click();
    await expect(page.locator('.lg\\:hidden').getByText('Mobile Room 1')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('.lg\\:hidden').getByText('09:00 – 10:40')).toBeVisible();

    // Klik tab hari Jumat (kosong)
    const jumatTab = page.locator('button[aria-label*="Jumat"]').first();
    await jumatTab.click();
    await expect(page.locator('.lg\\:hidden').getByText('Tidak ada jadwal kuliah pada hari Jumat')).toBeVisible();

    // Periksa bahwa tidak ada horizontal overflow pada viewport mobile
    const scrollWidth = await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth);
    const clientWidth = await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.clientWidth);
    expect(scrollWidth).toBeLessThanOrEqual(clientWidth + 2); // Margin toleransi 2px
  });

  test('6. Widget "Jadwal Hari Ini" di Dashboard: Menampilkan sesi hari ini, status waktu, dan tautan detail/jadwal', async ({ page }) => {
    test.setTimeout(75000);
    await registerAndLogin(page);
    const { course1Name } = await setupSemesterAndCourses(page);

    // Cari hari ini berdasarkan timezone pengguna (Asia/Jakarta)
    const now = new Date();
    const weekdayStr = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone: 'Asia/Jakarta', weekday: 'short' }).format(now);
    const dayMap: Record<string, number> = { Mon: 1, Tue: 2, Wed: 3, Thu: 4, Fri: 5, Sat: 6, Sun: 7 };
    const todayDayOfWeek = dayMap[weekdayStr] || 1;

    // Hitung jam sekarang dalam format HH:mm di Asia/Jakarta
    const timeFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', {
      timeZone: 'Asia/Jakarta',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
      hour12: false,
    });
    const currentTimeStr = timeFormatter.format(now);

    // Tambah sesi hari ini di /schedule
    await page.goto('/schedule');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Tambah jadwal")');
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]')).toBeVisible();

    const course1Val = await page.locator('#schedule-course option', { hasText: course1Name }).getAttribute('value');
    await page.selectOption('#schedule-course', course1Val!);
    await page.selectOption('#schedule-day', String(todayDayOfWeek));
    await page.fill('#schedule-start-time', '06:00');
    await page.fill('#schedule-end-time', '07:30');
    await page.fill('#schedule-room', 'Ruang Teori 101');
    await page.locator('div[role="dialog"] button:has-text("Simpan Jadwal")').click();
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]')).not.toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // Pergi ke /dashboard
    await page.goto('/dashboard');
    const widget = page.locator('[data-testid="today-schedule-widget"]');
    await expect(widget).toBeVisible();

    // Verifikasi judul widget & tautan "Lihat jadwal"
    await expect(widget.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Jadwal Hari Ini' })).toBeVisible();
    const lihatJadwalLink = widget.locator('a:has-text("Lihat jadwal")');
    await expect(lihatJadwalLink).toBeVisible();
    await expect(lihatJadwalLink).toHaveAttribute('href', '/schedule');

    // Verifikasi sesi ditampilkan di widget
    await expect(widget.getByText('Ruang Teori 101')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(widget.getByText('06:00 – 07:30')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(widget.getByText(course1Name)).toBeVisible();

    // Verifikasi tautan mata kuliah mengarah ke /courses/[id]
    const courseLink = widget.locator(`a:has-text("${course1Name}")`);
    await expect(courseLink).toBeVisible();
    const href = await courseLink.getAttribute('href');
    expect(href).toMatch(/^\/courses\/[a-z0-9_-]+$/i);

    // Verifikasi status waktu dengan teks semantik (Selesai, Akan datang, atau Berlangsung)
    if (currentTimeStr >= '07:30') {
      await expect(widget.getByText('Selesai')).toBeVisible();
    } else if (currentTimeStr < '06:00') {
      await expect(widget.getByText('Akan datang')).toBeVisible();
    } else {
      await expect(widget.getByText('Berlangsung')).toBeVisible();
    }
  });

  test('7. Widget Dashboard: Menangani empty state ("Tidak ada kelas hari ini") dan error state terisolasi dengan coba lagi', async ({ page }) => {
    test.setTimeout(75000);
    await registerAndLogin(page);
    await setupSemesterAndCourses(page);

    // Buka /dashboard sebelum ada jadwal apa pun
    await page.goto('/dashboard');
    const widget = page.locator('[data-testid="today-schedule-widget"]');
    await expect(widget).toBeVisible();

    // Empty state "Tidak ada kelas hari ini"
    await expect(widget.getByText(/Tidak ada kelas hari ini/i)).toBeVisible();
    await expect(widget.locator('a:has-text("Buka Jadwal Lengkap")')).toBeVisible();

    // Simulasikan error API schedules terisolasi
    await page.route('**/api/schedules*', (route) => {
      route.fulfill({
        status: 500,
        contentType: 'application/json',
        body: JSON.stringify({
          error: {
            code: 'INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR',
            message: 'Simulasi kegagalan server jadwal',
          },
        }),
      });
    });

    // Reload halaman dashboard
    await page.reload();

    // Widget menampilkan alert error mandiri
    await expect(widget.getByText('Gagal Memuat Jadwal')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(widget.getByText('Simulasi kegagalan server jadwal')).toBeVisible();
    const retryBtn = widget.getByRole('button', { name: /Coba lagi/i });
    await expect(retryBtn).toBeVisible();

    // Elemen dashboard lain (Header, statistik, tugas, materi) tetap aman dan tidak error
    await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Dashboard' })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByText('Materi terbaru')).toBeVisible();

    // Unroute untuk mengembalikan API normal
    await page.unroute('**/api/schedules*');

    // Klik coba lagi di widget jadwal
    await retryBtn.click();

    // Widget pulih ke empty state normal tanpa reload halaman
    await expect(widget.getByText(/Tidak ada kelas hari ini/i)).toBeVisible();
    await expect(widget.getByText('Gagal Memuat Jadwal')).not.toBeVisible();
  });

  test('8. Verifikasi pergantian semester: Widget jadwal hari ini memuat data semester baru dan mengabaikan semester lama', async ({ page }) => {
    test.setTimeout(85000);
    await registerAndLogin(page);

    // Cari hari ini
    const now = new Date();
    const weekdayStr = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone: 'Asia/Jakarta', weekday: 'short' }).format(now);
    const dayMap: Record<string, number> = { Mon: 1, Tue: 2, Wed: 3, Thu: 4, Fri: 5, Sat: 6, Sun: 7 };
    const todayDayOfWeek = dayMap[weekdayStr] || 1;

    // 1. Semester 1 (Aktif pertama kali)
    await page.goto('/semesters');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Tambah Semester")');
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]')).toBeVisible();
    const sem1Name = `Semester A ${Date.now()}`;

    await page.fill('#create-sem-year', '2026/2027');

    await page.click('button:has-text("Tambah mata kuliah")');
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]')).toBeVisible();
    const courseSem1 = 'Fisika Dasar 1';
    await page.fill('#create-course-name', courseSem1);
    await page.fill('#create-course-code', 'FS101');

    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]')).not.toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // Buat jadwal untuk Semester 1 di hari ini
    await page.goto('/schedule');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Tambah jadwal")');

    const course1Val = await page.locator('#schedule-course option', { hasText: courseSem1 }).getAttribute('value');

    await page.selectOption('#schedule-day', String(todayDayOfWeek));

    await page.click('button:has-text("Tambah mata kuliah")');
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]')).toBeVisible();
    const courseSem2 = 'Kimia Dasar 2';
    await page.fill('#create-course-name', courseSem2);
    await page.fill('#create-course-code', 'KM102');

      await page.selectOption('#create-course-sem', sem2Option);

    await page.locator('div[role="dialog"] button:has-text("Simpan Mata Kuliah")').click();

    await page.click('button:has-text("Tambah jadwal")');

    await page.fill('#schedule-start-time', '10:00');
    await page.fill('#schedule-end-time', '11:40');
    await page.fill('#schedule-room', 'Ruang Kimia 2');
    await page.locator('div[role="dialog"] button:has-text("Simpan Jadwal")').click();
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]')).not.toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // 3. Verifikasi di Dashboard: Sesi Semester 2 (Kimia Dasar 2) tampil, dan Semester 1 (Fisika Dasar 1) TIDAK tampil
    await page.goto('/dashboard');
    await expect(widget.getByText(courseSem2)).toBeVisible();
    await expect(widget.getByText('Ruang Kimia 2')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(widget.getByText(courseSem1)).not.toBeVisible();
    await expect(widget.getByText('Ruang Fisika 1')).not.toBeVisible();

    // 4. Verifikasi di /schedule: Semester aktif adalah Semester 2, hanya sesi Semester 2 yang tampil
    await page.goto('/schedule');
    await expect(page.getByText(sem2Name).first()).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByText('Ruang Kimia 2').first()).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByText('Ruang Fisika 1')).not.toBeVisible();
  });

  test('9. Race condition guard: Respons semester lama yang sengaja ditunda tidak menimpa data semester baru', async ({ page }) => {
    test.setTimeout(85000);
    await registerAndLogin(page);

    // Buat Semester 1 dan Semester 2
    await page.goto('/semesters');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Tambah Semester")');
    const sem1Name = `Semester Early ${Date.now()}`;
    await page.fill('#create-sem-name', sem1Name);
    await page.fill('#create-sem-year', '2026/2027');
    await page.locator('div[role="dialog"] button:has-text("Simpan Semester")').click();
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]')).not.toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    await page.click('button:has-text("Tambah Semester")');
    const sem2Name = `Semester Late ${Date.now()}`;
    await page.fill('#create-sem-name', sem2Name);
    await page.fill('#create-sem-year', '2027/2028');
    await page.locator('div[role="dialog"] button:has-text("Simpan Semester")').click();
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]')).not.toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // Tambah Course 1 di Semester 1
    await page.goto('/courses');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Tambah mata kuliah")');
    const course1 = 'Matematika Diskrit 1';
    await page.fill('#create-course-name', course1);
    const sem1Opt = await page.locator('#create-course-sem option', { hasText: sem1Name }).getAttribute('value');
    await page.selectOption('#create-course-sem', sem1Opt!);
    await page.locator('div[role="dialog"] button:has-text("Simpan Mata Kuliah")').click();
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]')).not.toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // Tambah Course 2 di Semester 2
    await page.click('button:has-text("Tambah mata kuliah")');
    const course2 = 'Kalkulus Lanjut 2';
    await page.fill('#create-course-name', course2);
    const sem2Opt = await page.locator('#create-course-sem option', { hasText: sem2Name }).getAttribute('value');
    await page.selectOption('#create-course-sem', sem2Opt!);
    await page.locator('div[role="dialog"] button:has-text("Simpan Mata Kuliah")').click();
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]')).not.toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // Buat Jadwal untuk Semester 1 (Hari Rabu / 3)
    await page.goto('/schedule');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Tambah jadwal")');
    const c1Opt = await page.locator('#schedule-course option', { hasText: course1 }).getAttribute('value');
    await page.selectOption('#schedule-course', c1Opt!);
    await page.selectOption('#schedule-day', '3'); // Rabu
    await page.fill('#schedule-start-time', '08:00');
    await page.fill('#schedule-end-time', '09:40');
    await page.fill('#schedule-room', 'Lab Diskrit 1');
    await page.locator('div[role="dialog"] button:has-text("Simpan Jadwal")').click();
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]')).not.toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // Aktifkan Semester 2
    await page.goto('/semesters');
    const sem2Row = page.locator('tr, li').filter({ hasText: sem2Name }).first();
    const actBtn = sem2Row.locator('button:has-text("Jadikan Aktif")');
    await actBtn.click();
    await expect(actBtn).not.toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // Buat Jadwal untuk Semester 2 (Hari Rabu / 3)
    await page.goto('/schedule');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Tambah jadwal")');
    const c2Opt = await page.locator('#schedule-course option', { hasText: course2 }).getAttribute('value');
    await page.selectOption('#schedule-course', c2Opt!);
    await page.selectOption('#schedule-day', '3'); // Rabu
    await page.fill('#schedule-start-time', '13:00');
    await page.fill('#schedule-end-time', '14:40');
    await page.fill('#schedule-room', 'Lab Kalkulus 2');
    await page.locator('div[role="dialog"] button:has-text("Simpan Jadwal")').click();
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]')).not.toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // Simulasikan race condition:
    // Tahan request schedules untuk Semester 1
    let releaseSem1: (() => void) | null = null;
    const holdPromise = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
      releaseSem1 = resolve;
    });

    await page.route(`**/api/schedules*semesterId=${sem1Opt}*`, async (route) => {
      await holdPromise;
      await route.continue();
    });

    // Pemicu: Dispatch event pergantian ke Semester 1 (yang ditahan jaringannya)
    await page.evaluate((sId) => {
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('studyflow:semester-changed', { detail: { semesterId: sId } }));
    }, sem1Opt);

    // Segera dispatch event pergantian ke Semester 2 (yang berjalan cepat tanpa ditahan)
    await page.evaluate((sId) => {
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('studyflow:semester-changed', { detail: { semesterId: sId } }));
    }, sem2Opt);

    // Tunggu data Semester 2 tampil
    await expect(page.getByText('Lab Kalkulus 2').first()).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // Sekarang lepas request Semester 1 yang tertahan tadi
    releaseSem1!();
    await page.waitForTimeout(600);

    // Verifikasi: Data Semester 2 HARUS TETAP TAMPIL. Data Semester 1 TIDAK MENIMPA data Semester 2!
    await expect(page.getByText('Lab Kalkulus 2').first()).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByText('Lab Diskrit 1')).not.toBeVisible();
  });

  test('10. Widget Jadwal Hari Ini: Pergantian hari terkontrol dan perubahan timezone profil memperbarui widget terpasang', async ({ page }) => {
    test.setTimeout(85000);
    await registerAndLogin(page);
    const { course1Name, course2Name } = await setupSemesterAndCourses(page);

    // Tambah 1 jadwal hari Senin (1) jam 08:00 - 10:00 (Ruang Senin A)
    await page.goto('/schedule');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Tambah jadwal")');
    const c1Val = await page.locator('#schedule-course option', { hasText: course1Name }).getAttribute('value');
    await page.selectOption('#schedule-course', c1Val!);
    await page.selectOption('#schedule-day', '1'); // Senin
    await page.fill('#schedule-start-time', '08:00');
    await page.fill('#schedule-end-time', '10:00');
    await page.fill('#schedule-room', 'Ruang Senin A');
    await page.locator('div[role="dialog"] button:has-text("Simpan Jadwal")').click();
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]')).not.toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // Tambah 1 jadwal hari Selasa (2) jam 13:00 - 15:00 (Ruang Selasa B)
    await page.click('button:has-text("Tambah jadwal")');
    const c2Val = await page.locator('#schedule-course option', { hasText: course2Name }).getAttribute('value');
    await page.selectOption('#schedule-course', c2Val!);
    await page.selectOption('#schedule-day', '2'); // Selasa
    await page.fill('#schedule-start-time', '13:00');
    await page.fill('#schedule-end-time', '15:00');
    await page.fill('#schedule-room', 'Ruang Selasa B');
    await page.locator('div[role="dialog"] button:has-text("Simpan Jadwal")').click();
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]')).not.toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // Atur jam terkontrol pada Minggu malam: 2026-10-11T23:59:00+07:00 (Minggu)
    await page.clock.install({ time: new Date('2026-10-11T23:59:00+07:00') });
    await page.goto('/dashboard');
    const widget = page.locator('[data-testid="today-schedule-widget"]');
    await expect(widget).toBeVisible();

    // Di hari Minggu, tidak ada kelas
    await expect(widget.getByText(/Tidak ada kelas hari ini \(Minggu\)/i)).toBeVisible();

    // 1. Majukan waktu 70 detik (melewati interval 60 detik dan melewati tengah malam ke Senin 00:00:10 WIB)
    await page.clock.fastForward(70000);

    // Widget secara reaktif mendeteksi pergantian hari tanpa reload halaman
    await expect(widget.getByText('Ruang Senin A')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
    await expect(widget.getByText('08:00 – 10:00')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(widget.getByText('Akan datang')).toBeVisible();

    // 2. Majukan waktu ke jam 08:30 Senin (sesi sedang berlangsung)
    await page.clock.fastForward(8.5 * 3600 * 1000);
    await expect(widget.getByText('Berlangsung')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // 3. Majukan waktu ke jam 10:30 Senin (sesi selesai)
    await page.clock.fastForward(2 * 3600 * 1000);
    await expect(widget.getByText('Selesai')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // 4. Majukan waktu melewati tengah malam lagi ke Selasa siang (13:30 Selasa)
    // Dari Senin 10:30 ke Selasa 13:30 = 27 jam = 27 * 3600 * 1000 ms
    await page.clock.fastForward(27 * 3600 * 1000);

    // Widget secara reaktif memuat jadwal hari Selasa (Ruang Selasa B) dan status Berlangsung
    await expect(widget.getByText('Ruang Selasa B')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
    await expect(widget.getByText('13:00 – 15:00')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(widget.getByText('Berlangsung')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(widget.getByText('Ruang Senin A')).not.toBeVisible();

    // 5. Perubahan timezone profil pengguna memperbarui widget yang sedang terpasang:
    // Pada jam 13:30 WIB Selasa, jika profil diubah ke America/New_York (UTC-4),
    // jam lokal New York adalah 02:30 Selasa.
    // Karena 02:30 < 13:00, status Ruang Selasa B berubah dari "Berlangsung" menjadi "Akan datang"!
    await page.route('**/api/auth/me*', (route) => {
      route.fulfill({
        status: 200,
        contentType: 'application/json',
        body: JSON.stringify({
          user: {
            id: 'mock-user-tz',
            name: 'Schedule Tester',
            email: 'sched-tz@studyflow.test',
            timezone: 'America/New_York',
          },
        }),
      });
    });

    await page.evaluate(() => {
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('studyflow:profile-updated'));
    });

    // Status waktu pada widget yang sedang terpasang langsung tersinkronkan
    await expect(widget.getByText('Akan datang')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
  });
});

<file path="apps/web/src/app/(auth)/reset-password/page.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import { z } from 'zod';
import {
  ArrowLeft,
  Loader2,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertCircle,
  Lock,
  Eye,
  EyeOff,
  KeyRound,
  ShieldAlert,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { apiResetPassword } from '@/lib/auth-client';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import {
  Card,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
  CardDescription,
  CardContent,
  CardFooter,
} from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Alert, AlertTitle, AlertDescription } from '@/components/ui/alert';

const ResetPasswordFormSchema = z
  .object({
    newPassword: z
      .string()
      .min(12, 'Kata sandi baru minimal 12 karakter (disarankan kombinasi kata/passphrase)')
      .max(128, 'Kata sandi baru maksimal 128 karakter'),
    confirmPassword: z.string().min(1, 'Konfirmasi kata sandi wajib diisi'),
  })
  .refine((data) => data.newPassword === data.confirmPassword, {
    message: 'Konfirmasi kata sandi tidak cocok dengan kata sandi baru',
    path: ['confirmPassword'],
  });

type ResetPasswordFormValues = z.infer<typeof ResetPasswordFormSchema>;

function ResetPasswordForm(): React.JSX.Element {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const token = searchParams.get('token') || '';

  const [serverError, setServerError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = React.useState(false);
  const [showConfirmPassword, setShowConfirmPassword] = React.useState(false);

  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    formState: { errors, isSubmitting },
  } = useForm<ResetPasswordFormValues>({
    resolver: zodResolver(ResetPasswordFormSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      newPassword: '',
      confirmPassword: '',
    },
  });

  const onSubmit = async (data: ResetPasswordFormValues) => {
    setServerError(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);

    if (!token || token.trim().length < 32) {
      setServerError('Token reset tidak valid atau tidak ditemukan pada URL.');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const res = await apiResetPassword(token.trim(), data.newPassword);
      setSuccessMessage(
        res.message || 'Kata sandi Anda berhasil diperbarui. Silakan masuk menggunakan kata sandi baru.'
      );
    } catch (err: any) {
      setServerError(
        err.message || 'Tautan reset tidak valid atau telah kedaluwarsa. Silakan minta tautan baru.'
      );
    }
  };

  // If token is completely missing from query string
  if (!token) {
    return (
      <Card className="w-full">
        <CardHeader className="space-y-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-destructive mb-1">
            <ShieldAlert className="h-6 w-6" />
            <CardTitle className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight">
              Tautan Tidak Valid
            </CardTitle>
          </div>
          <CardDescription className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Tautan pengaturan ulang kata sandi tidak lengkap atau token verifikasi tidak ditemukan.
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4">
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
            <AlertDescription className="text-xs sm:text-sm">
              Pastikan Anda menyalin URL secara lengkap dari email atau ajukan permintaan baru jika tautan sebelumnya terpotong.
            </AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        </CardContent>
        <CardFooter className="flex flex-col gap-3">
          <Link href="/forgot-password" className="block w-full">
            <Button className="w-full h-10">Minta Tautan Baru</Button>
          </Link>
          <Link
            href="/login"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground font-medium transition-colors"
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            <span>Kembali ke Halaman Masuk</span>
          </Link>
        </CardFooter>
      </Card>
    );
  }

  // Success state
  if (successMessage) {
    return (
      <Card className="w-full">
        <CardHeader className="space-y-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 mb-1">
            <CheckCircle2 className="h-6 w-6" />
            <CardTitle className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">
              Kata Sandi Diperbarui
            </CardTitle>
          </div>
          <CardDescription className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {successMessage}
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-3">
          <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/20 p-4 text-xs text-muted-foreground space-y-1.5">
            <p className="font-semibold text-foreground">Sesi lama dinonaktifkan:</p>
            <p>
              Seluruh sesi login sebelumnya di perangkat lain telah dicabut demi keamanan akun Anda.
            </p>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
        <CardFooter className="pt-2">
          <Link href="/login" className="block w-full">
            <Button className="w-full h-10 font-semibold">
              Masuk Sekarang
            </Button>
          </Link>
        </CardFooter>
      </Card>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Card className="w-full">
      <CardHeader className="space-y-1">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
          <div className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary/10 text-primary">
            <KeyRound className="h-4 w-4" />
          </div>
          <CardTitle className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">
            Atur Kata Sandi Baru
          </CardTitle>
        </div>
        <CardDescription className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          Masukkan kata sandi baru untuk akun Anda. Minimal 12 karakter.
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>

      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} noValidate>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4">
          {serverError && (
            <Alert variant="destructive" role="alert" className="space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
                <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                <AlertDescription className="text-xs sm:text-sm break-words">
                  {serverError}
                </AlertDescription>
              </div>
              <div className="pt-1">
                <Link
                  href="/forgot-password"
                  className="text-xs font-semibold underline hover:opacity-90 inline-block"
                >
                  Minta tautan reset baru &rarr;
                </Link>
              </div>
            </Alert>
          )}

          {/* New Password Field */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="newPassword" className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
              Kata Sandi Baru
            </Label>
            <div className="relative">
              <Input
                id="newPassword"
                type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                autoComplete="new-password"
                placeholder="Minimal 12 karakter"
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.newPassword)}
                aria-describedby={errors.newPassword ? 'new-password-error' : undefined}
                className="h-10 text-sm pl-10 pr-10"
                {...register('newPassword')}
              />
              <Lock className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground pointer-events-none" />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowPassword((prev) => !prev)}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground p-1 rounded-sm focus:outline-hidden focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
                aria-label={showPassword ? 'Sembunyikan kata sandi' : 'Tampilkan kata sandi'}
              >
                {showPassword ? <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />}
              </button>
            </div>
            {errors.newPassword && (
              <p id="new-password-error" className="text-xs font-medium text-destructive">
                {errors.newPassword.message}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Confirm Password Field */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="confirmPassword" className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
              Konfirmasi Kata Sandi Baru
            </Label>
            <div className="relative">
              <Input
                id="confirmPassword"
                type={showConfirmPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                autoComplete="new-password"
                placeholder="Ulangi kata sandi baru"
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.confirmPassword)}
                aria-describedby={errors.confirmPassword ? 'confirm-password-error' : undefined}
                className="h-10 text-sm pl-10 pr-10"
                {...register('confirmPassword')}
              />
              <Lock className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground pointer-events-none" />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowConfirmPassword((prev) => !prev)}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground p-1 rounded-sm focus:outline-hidden focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
                aria-label={
                  showConfirmPassword
                    ? 'Sembunyikan konfirmasi kata sandi'
                    : 'Tampilkan konfirmasi kata sandi'
                }
              >
                {showConfirmPassword ? <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />}
              </button>
            </div>
            {errors.confirmPassword && (
              <p id="confirm-password-error" className="text-xs font-medium text-destructive">
                {errors.confirmPassword.message}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        </CardContent>

        <CardFooter className="flex flex-col gap-3">
          <Button
            type="submit"
            disabled={isSubmitting}
            className="w-full h-10 font-semibold"
          >
            {isSubmitting ? (
              <>
                <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                <span>Menyimpan kata sandi...</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              'Simpan Kata Sandi Baru'
            )}
          </Button>

          <div className="text-center">
            <Link
              href="/login"
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground font-medium transition-colors"
            >
              <ArrowLeft className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              <span>Batal dan kembali ke Masuk</span>
            </Link>
          </div>
        </CardFooter>
      </form>
    </Card>
  );
}

export default function ResetPasswordPage(): React.JSX.Element {
  return (
    <React.Suspense
      fallback={
        <Card className="w-full">
          <CardHeader className="space-y-2">
            <div className="h-6 w-48 bg-muted rounded-md animate-pulse" />
            <div className="h-4 w-64 bg-muted rounded-md animate-pulse" />
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="py-8 flex justify-center">
            <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      }
    >
      <ResetPasswordForm />
    </React.Suspense>
  );
}

<file path="apps/web/src/app/(auth)/verify-email/verify-email-client.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
import {
  ArrowLeft,
  Loader2,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertCircle,
  MailCheck,
  ShieldCheck,
  LayoutDashboard,
  LogIn,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { apiConfirmEmailVerification, getCurrentUser } from '@/lib/auth-client';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import {
  Card,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
  CardDescription,
  CardContent,
  CardFooter,
} from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Alert, AlertTitle, AlertDescription } from '@/components/ui/alert';

function VerifyEmailForm(): React.JSX.Element {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const token = searchParams.get('token') || '';

  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = React.useState(false);
  const [serverError, setServerError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isLoggedIn, setIsLoggedIn] = React.useState<boolean | null>(null);

  // Check login status on mount to customize navigation buttons
  React.useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    getCurrentUser()
      .then((user) => {
        if (isMounted) setIsLoggedIn(Boolean(user));
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (isMounted) setIsLoggedIn(false);
      });

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, []);

  const handleConfirmVerification = async () => {
    if (!token) {
      setServerError('Token verifikasi tidak ditemukan dalam tautan.');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setServerError(null);

    try {
      const res = await apiConfirmEmailVerification(token);
      setSuccessMessage(res.message || 'Alamat email berhasil diverifikasi!');

      // Notify other components if logged in
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && res.user) {
        window.dispatchEvent(
          new CustomEvent('studyflow:profile-updated', { detail: res.user })
        );
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setServerError(
        err.message || 'Tautan verifikasi tidak valid atau telah kedaluwarsa. Silakan minta tautan baru.'
      );
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Card className="w-full border-border bg-card shadow-xs">
      <CardHeader className="space-y-1.5 pb-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-primary font-semibold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider">
          <ShieldCheck className="h-4 w-4" />
          <span>Keamanan Akun</span>
        </div>
        <CardTitle className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">
          Verifikasi Alamat Email
        </CardTitle>
        <CardDescription className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
          Konfirmasikan kepemilikan alamat email akun StudyFlow Anda.
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>

      <CardContent className="space-y-4 pt-0">
        {/* Success State */}
        {successMessage ? (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <Alert className="border-emerald-500/40 bg-emerald-50/50 dark:bg-emerald-950/20 text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-300">
              <CheckCircle2 className="h-5 w-5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
              <AlertTitle className="text-sm font-semibold">Verifikasi Berhasil</AlertTitle>
              <AlertDescription className="text-xs sm:text-sm mt-1">
                {successMessage} Alamat email akun Anda kini telah terverifikasi resmi.
              </AlertDescription>
            </Alert>

            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2 pt-2">
              {isLoggedIn ? (
                <Button asChild className="w-full gap-2">
                  <Link href="/dashboard">
                    <LayoutDashboard className="h-4 w-4" />
                    <span>Kembali ke Dashboard</span>
                  </Link>
                </Button>
              ) : (
                <Button asChild className="w-full gap-2">
                  <Link href="/login">
                    <LogIn className="h-4 w-4" />
                    <span>Masuk ke Akun Anda</span>
                  </Link>
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : !token ? (
          /* Missing Token State */
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <Alert variant="destructive">
              <AlertCircle className="h-5 w-5" />
              <AlertTitle className="text-sm font-semibold">Tautan Tidak Lengkap</AlertTitle>
              <AlertDescription className="text-xs sm:text-sm mt-1">
                Tautan verifikasi tidak memiliki parameter token. Pastikan Anda membuka tautan lengkap yang dikirimkan ke email Anda.
              </AlertDescription>
            </Alert>

            <div className="pt-2 flex flex-col gap-2">
              <Button asChild variant="outline" className="w-full gap-2">
                <Link href={isLoggedIn ? '/settings' : '/login'}>
                  <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
                  <span>{isLoggedIn ? 'Kembali ke Pengaturan' : 'Kembali ke Halaman Masuk'}</span>
                </Link>
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          /* Ready to Confirm State */
          <div className="space-y-4">
            {serverError && (
              <Alert variant="destructive">
                <AlertCircle className="h-5 w-5" />
                <AlertTitle className="text-sm font-semibold">Verifikasi Gagal</AlertTitle>
                <AlertDescription className="text-xs sm:text-sm mt-1">
                  {serverError}
                </AlertDescription>
              </Alert>
            )}

            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-muted/20 p-4 text-xs sm:text-sm text-muted-foreground space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-medium text-foreground">
                <MailCheck className="h-4 w-4 text-primary shrink-0" />
                <span>Konfirmasi Verifikasi Email</span>
              </div>
              <p>
                Klik tombol di bawah ini untuk memverifikasi alamat email akun Anda. Proses ini akan mengikat status terverifikasi secara permanen tanpa mengganti password atau mengganggu sesi yang sedang aktif.
              </p>
            </div>

            <Button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleConfirmVerification}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              className="w-full h-10 font-semibold gap-2"
            >
              {isSubmitting ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin shrink-0" />
                  <span>Memverifikasi Email...</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
                  <span>Konfirmasi Verifikasi Email</span>
                </>
              )}
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}
      </CardContent>

      <CardFooter className="flex flex-col space-y-3 pt-0 border-t border-border mt-2">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between w-full pt-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          <Link
            href={isLoggedIn ? '/dashboard' : '/login'}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 hover:text-foreground transition-colors font-medium"
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            <span>{isLoggedIn ? 'Kembali ke Dashboard' : 'Kembali ke Halaman Masuk'}</span>
          </Link>
          {isLoggedIn && (
            <Link
              href="/settings"
              className="hover:text-foreground transition-colors font-medium"
            >
              Pengaturan Akun
            </Link>
          )}
        </div>
      </CardFooter>
    </Card>
  );
}

export default function VerifyEmailClient(): React.JSX.Element {
  return (
    <React.Suspense
      fallback={
        <Card className="w-full border-border bg-card shadow-xs">
          <CardHeader className="space-y-1">
            <CardTitle className="text-xl">Memuat Verifikasi...</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>Menyiapkan token verifikasi...</CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="h-32 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Loader2 className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      }
    >
      <VerifyEmailForm />
    </React.Suspense>
  );
}
</file>

import * as React from 'react';

<file path="apps/web/src/app/(dashboard)/calendar/page.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
import {
  CalendarDays,
  CalendarClock,
  ListTodo,
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  RotateCcw,
  Globe,
  Filter,
  Info,
  AlertCircle,
  Plus,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  Semester,
  Course,
  UserProfile,
  CalendarEvent,
  CalendarFilterType,
} from '@studyflow/shared';
import { listSemesters } from '@/lib/semester-client';
import { listCourses } from '@/lib/course-client';
import { getProfile } from '@/lib/auth-client';
import { getCalendarData } from '@/lib/calendar-client';
import {
  getTodayDateString,
  getMonthGridRange,
  getWeekRange,
  formatMonthHeader,
  formatWeekHeader,
  parseDateString,
  formatTimezoneBadge,
} from '@/lib/calendar-utils';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { NativeSelect } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tabs';
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';
import { Alert, AlertDescription, AlertTitle } from '@/components/ui/alert';
import { MonthView } from '@/components/calendar/month-view';
import { WeekView } from '@/components/calendar/week-view';
import { AgendaView } from '@/components/calendar/agenda-view';
import { EventDetailDialog } from '@/components/calendar/event-detail-dialog';
import { DayEventsDialog } from '@/components/calendar/day-events-dialog';

type CalendarViewMode = 'month' | 'week' | 'agenda';

export default function CalendarPage(): React.JSX.Element {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const querySemesterId = searchParams.get('semesterId');
  const queryCourseId = searchParams.get('courseId');

  // User Profile & Timezone
  const [userProfile, setUserProfile] = React.useState<UserProfile | null>(null);
  const timezone = userProfile?.timezone || 'Asia/Jakarta';

  // Semester & Courses
  const [semesters, setSemesters] = React.useState<Semester[]>([]);
  const [activeSemester, setActiveSemester] = React.useState<Semester | null>(null);
  const [courses, setCourses] = React.useState<Course[]>([]);

  // Filters
  const [selectedCourseFilter, setSelectedCourseFilter] = React.useState<string>(
    queryCourseId || 'all'
  );
  const [selectedTypeFilter, setSelectedTypeFilter] = React.useState<CalendarFilterType>('all');

  // View Mode: Desktop default 'month', Mobile default 'agenda'
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = React.useState<CalendarViewMode>('month');

  // Anchor Date State
  const [currentYear, setCurrentYear] = React.useState<number>(() => new Date().getFullYear());
  const [currentMonth, setCurrentMonth] = React.useState<number>(() => new Date().getMonth() + 1); // 1-12
  const [currentDateStr, setCurrentDateStr] = React.useState<string>(() =>
    getTodayDateString('Asia/Jakarta')
  );

  // Events & Loading State
  const [events, setEvents] = React.useState<CalendarEvent[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = React.useState(true);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  // Modal dialog states
  const [selectedEvent, setSelectedEvent] = React.useState<CalendarEvent | null>(null);
  const [dayEventsDate, setDayEventsDate] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [dayEventsList, setDayEventsList] = React.useState<CalendarEvent[]>([]);

  // Request race-condition guard
  const fetchRequestIdRef = React.useRef(0);
  const abortControllerRef = React.useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  // 1. Deteksi viewport mobile saat pertama kali render untuk mengatur default view
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth < 768) {
      setViewMode('agenda');
    }
  }, []);

  // 2. Load User Profile & Timezone
  React.useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    getProfile()
      .then((profile) => {
        if (!isMounted || !profile) return;
        setUserProfile(profile);
        const todayTz = getTodayDateString(profile.timezone || 'Asia/Jakarta');
        const parsed = parseDateString(todayTz);
        setCurrentDateStr(todayTz);
        setCurrentYear(parsed.year);
        setCurrentMonth(parsed.month);
      })
      .catch(() => {});

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, []);

  // 3. Load Semesters & Sync Active Semester
  React.useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    async function loadSemesters() {
      try {
        const res = await listSemesters('all');
        if (!isMounted) return;
        setSemesters(res.semesters);
        const matched = querySemesterId
          ? res.semesters.find((s) => s.id === querySemesterId) || res.activeSemester
          : res.activeSemester;
        setActiveSemester(matched);
      } catch (err: any) {
        if (!isMounted) return;
        setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Gagal memuat semester');
      }
    }

    loadSemesters();

    const handleSemesterChange = () => {
      listSemesters('all')
        .then((res) => {
          if (!isMounted) return;
          setSemesters(res.semesters);
          setActiveSemester(res.activeSemester);
        })
        .catch(console.error);
    };

    window.addEventListener('studyflow:semester-changed', handleSemesterChange);
    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
      window.removeEventListener('studyflow:semester-changed', handleSemesterChange);
    };
  }, [querySemesterId]);

  // 4. Load Courses when activeSemester changes
  React.useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    if (!activeSemester) {
      setCourses([]);
      return;
    }

    listCourses({ semesterId: activeSemester.id })
      .then((res) => {
        if (!isMounted) return;
        // Hanya tampilkan mata kuliah yang tidak diarsipkan
        setCourses(res.courses.filter((c) => !c.archivedAt));
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        console.error('Failed to load courses for calendar:', err);
      });

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [activeSemester]);

  // 5. Hitung Rentang Tanggal berdasarkan View Mode aktif
  const currentRange = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (viewMode === 'month' || viewMode === 'agenda') {
      return getMonthGridRange(currentYear, currentMonth);
    } else {
      return getWeekRange(currentDateStr);
    }
  }, [viewMode, currentYear, currentMonth, currentDateStr]);

  // 6. Fetch Kalender Data dengan AbortController & Sequence Guard
  const fetchCalendar = React.useCallback(
    async (targetSemester: Semester | null) => {
      if (!targetSemester) {
        setEvents([]);
        setIsLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      // Batalkan request yang sedang berjalan sebelumnya
      if (abortControllerRef.current) {
        abortControllerRef.current.abort();
      }
      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortControllerRef.current = controller;

      const requestId = ++fetchRequestIdRef.current;
      setIsLoading(true);
      setErrorMessage(null);

      try {
        const data = await getCalendarData(
          {
            semesterId: targetSemester.id,
            courseId: selectedCourseFilter !== 'all' ? selectedCourseFilter : undefined,
            type: selectedTypeFilter,
            startDate: currentRange.startDate,
            endDate: currentRange.endDate,
          },
          controller.signal
        );

        if (requestId === fetchRequestIdRef.current) {
          setEvents(data.events);
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        if (err.name === 'AbortError') return;
        if (requestId === fetchRequestIdRef.current) {
          setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Gagal memuat agenda kalender');
        }
      } finally {
        if (requestId === fetchRequestIdRef.current) {
          setIsLoading(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [currentRange, selectedCourseFilter, selectedTypeFilter]
  );

  React.useEffect(() => {
    fetchCalendar(activeSemester);
  }, [fetchCalendar, activeSemester]);

  // 7. Navigasi Periode (Sebelumnya, Berikutnya, Hari Ini)
  const handlePreviousPeriod = () => {
    if (viewMode === 'month' || viewMode === 'agenda') {
      if (currentMonth === 1) {
        setCurrentMonth(12);
        setCurrentYear((prev) => prev - 1);
      } else {
        setCurrentMonth((prev) => prev - 1);
      }
    } else {
      // Minggu sebelumnya (-7 hari)
      const { year, month, day } = parseDateString(currentDateStr);
      const d = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day - 7));
      const newDateStr = `${d.getUTCFullYear()}-${String(d.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(d.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
      setCurrentDateStr(newDateStr);
      setCurrentYear(d.getUTCFullYear());
      setCurrentMonth(d.getUTCMonth() + 1);
    }
  };

  const handleNextPeriod = () => {
    if (viewMode === 'month' || viewMode === 'agenda') {
      if (currentMonth === 12) {
        setCurrentMonth(1);
        setCurrentYear((prev) => prev + 1);
      } else {
        setCurrentMonth((prev) => prev + 1);
      }
    } else {
      // Minggu berikutnya (+7 hari)
      const { year, month, day } = parseDateString(currentDateStr);
      const d = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day + 7));
      const newDateStr = `${d.getUTCFullYear()}-${String(d.getUTCMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(d.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
      setCurrentDateStr(newDateStr);
      setCurrentYear(d.getUTCFullYear());
      setCurrentMonth(d.getUTCMonth() + 1);
    }
  };

  const handleTodayPeriod = () => {
    const todayTz = getTodayDateString(timezone);
    const parsed = parseDateString(todayTz);
    setCurrentDateStr(todayTz);
    setCurrentYear(parsed.year);
    setCurrentMonth(parsed.month);
  };

  const todayDateStr = React.useMemo(() => getTodayDateString(timezone), [timezone]);

  // Label Header Periode
  const periodTitle = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (viewMode === 'month' || viewMode === 'agenda') {
      return formatMonthHeader(currentYear, currentMonth);
    } else {
      const days = currentRange.days;
      return formatWeekHeader(days[0]!, days[days.length - 1]!);
    }
  }, [viewMode, currentYear, currentMonth, currentRange]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-7xl mx-auto pb-12">
      {/* 1. Header Halaman */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-foreground">
              Kalender
            </h1>
            <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs gap-1.5 font-medium bg-muted/50">
              <Globe className="h-3 w-3 text-primary" />
              {formatTimezoneBadge(timezone)}
            </Badge>
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
            Jadwal perkuliahan mingguan dan batas waktu tugas kuliah dalam satu tampilan terpadu.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Action button link ke penambahan jadwal / tugas */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Button asChild variant="outline" size="sm" className="gap-1.5">
            <Link href="/schedule">
              <CalendarClock className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">Kelola</span> Jadwal
            </Link>
          </Button>
          <Button asChild size="sm" className="gap-1.5">
            <Link href="/assignments">
              <ListTodo className="h-4 w-4" />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">Kelola</span> Tugas
            </Link>
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2. Disclaimer Penjelasan Jadwal Berulang */}
      <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-lg border border-primary/20 bg-primary/5 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        <Info className="h-4 w-4 text-primary shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        <span>
          Jadwal kuliah ditampilkan sebagai pola mingguan berulang pada semester terpilih. Hari libur nasional dan penyesuaian pertemuan tatap muka belum diperhitungkan.
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* 3. Toolbar Kontrol, Filter, dan Navigasi Periode */}
      <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-4 p-4 rounded-xl border bg-card shadow-xs">
        {/* Kiri: Navigasi Periode (< > Hari Ini) & Label Bulan/Minggu */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3 flex-wrap">
          <div className="flex items-center border rounded-lg bg-background p-0.5 shadow-2xs">
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="icon"
              onClick={handlePreviousPeriod}
              title="Periode sebelumnya"
              className="h-8 w-8"
            >
              <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"
              onClick={handleTodayPeriod}
              className="h-8 px-2.5 text-xs font-semibold"
            >
              Hari ini
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="icon"
              onClick={handleNextPeriod}
              title="Periode berikutnya"
              className="h-8 w-8"
            >
              <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
            </Button>
          </div>

          <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-foreground min-w-[140px]">
            {periodTitle}
          </h2>
        </div>

        {/* Kanan: Filter Semester, Mata Kuliah, Tipe, & View Mode Switcher */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
          {/* Semester Selector */}
          <div className="w-[170px] sm:w-[190px]">
            <NativeSelect
              aria-label="Pilih Semester"
              value={activeSemester?.id || ''}
              onChange={(e) => {
                const found = semesters.find((s) => s.id === e.target.value);
                if (found) setActiveSemester(found);
              }}
              className="h-9 text-xs font-medium"
            >
              {semesters.map((s) => (
                <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>
                  {s.name} {s.isActive ? '(Aktif)' : ''}
                </option>
              ))}
            </NativeSelect>
          </div>

          {/* Course Filter */}
          <div className="w-[160px] sm:w-[180px]">
            <NativeSelect
              aria-label="Filter Mata Kuliah"
              value={selectedCourseFilter}
              onChange={(e) => setSelectedCourseFilter(e.target.value)}
              className="h-9 text-xs font-medium"
            >
              <option value="all">Semua Mata Kuliah</option>
              {courses.map((c) => (
                <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                  {c.name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </NativeSelect>
          </div>

          {/* Type Filter */}
          <div className="w-[120px]">
            <NativeSelect
              aria-label="Filter Tipe Acara"
              value={selectedTypeFilter}
              onChange={(e) => setSelectedTypeFilter(e.target.value as CalendarFilterType)}
              className="h-9 text-xs font-medium"
            >
              <option value="all">Semua Tipe</option>
              <option value="schedule">Kuliah Saja</option>
              <option value="assignment">Tugas Saja</option>
            </NativeSelect>
          </div>

          {/* View Mode Toggle (Tabs) */}
          <Tabs
            value={viewMode}
            onValueChange={(val) => setViewMode(val as CalendarViewMode)}
            className="hidden sm:inline-flex"
          >
            <TabsList className="h-9 p-0.5">
              <TabsTrigger value="month" className="text-xs px-2.5 h-8">
                Bulan
              </TabsTrigger>
              <TabsTrigger value="week" className="text-xs px-2.5 h-8">
                Minggu
              </TabsTrigger>
              <TabsTrigger value="agenda" className="text-xs px-2.5 h-8">
                Agenda
              </TabsTrigger>
            </TabsList>
          </Tabs>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 4. Error Banner */}
      {errorMessage && (
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
          <AlertTitle>Terjadi Kesalahan</AlertTitle>
          <AlertDescription className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <span>{errorMessage}</span>
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => fetchCalendar(activeSemester)}
              className="h-7 text-xs gap-1"
            >
              <RotateCcw className="h-3 w-3" />
              Coba Lagi
            </Button>
          </AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}

      {/* 5. Konten Kalender Berdasarkan View Mode */}
      {isLoading ? (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-2">
            {Array.from({ length: 7 }).map((_, i) => (
              <Skeleton key={i} className="h-8 w-full rounded" />
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-2">
            {Array.from({ length: 28 }).map((_, i) => (
              <Skeleton key={i} className="h-24 w-full rounded" />
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : !activeSemester ? (
        <div className="border rounded-xl p-8 bg-card text-center space-y-3">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-base text-foreground">Belum Ada Semester</h3>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground max-w-sm mx-auto">
            Anda belum memiliki semester. Silakan buat semester terlebih dahulu di halaman Kelola Semester.
          </p>
          <Button asChild size="sm">
            <Link href="/semesters">Kelola Semester</Link>
          </Button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          {viewMode === 'month' && (
            <div className="hidden sm:block">
              <MonthView
                days={currentRange.days}
                activeMonth={currentMonth}
                activeYear={currentYear}
                todayDateStr={todayDateStr}
                events={events}
                onSelectEvent={(ev) => setSelectedEvent(ev)}
                onOpenDayEvents={(date, list) => {
                  setDayEventsDate(date);
                  setDayEventsList(list);
                }}
              />
            </div>
          )}

          {viewMode === 'week' && (
            <div className="hidden sm:block">
              <WeekView
                days={currentRange.days}
                todayDateStr={todayDateStr}
                events={events}
                onSelectEvent={(ev) => setSelectedEvent(ev)}
              />
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Agenda view: selalu tampil pada mobile atau saat mode agenda aktif */}
          <div className={viewMode === 'agenda' ? 'block' : 'sm:hidden'}>
            <AgendaView
              events={events}
              todayDateStr={todayDateStr}
              onSelectEvent={(ev) => setSelectedEvent(ev)}
              hasSemester={Boolean(activeSemester)}
              hasCourses={courses.length > 0}
            />
          </div>
        </>
      )}

      {/* 6. Modals */}
      <EventDetailDialog
        event={selectedEvent}
        isOpen={Boolean(selectedEvent)}
        onClose={() => setSelectedEvent(null)}
        timezone={timezone}
      />

      <DayEventsDialog
        dateStr={dayEventsDate}
        events={dayEventsList}
        isOpen={Boolean(dayEventsDate)}
        onClose={() => setDayEventsDate(null)}
        onSelectEvent={(ev) => setSelectedEvent(ev)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

  Info,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  Course,
  Semester,
  UserProfile,
  CourseSchedule,

  DAY_NAMES_ID,
  getDayNameId,
} from '@studyflow/shared';

function getCurrentDayOfWeekInTimezone(timezone: string): number {
  try {
    const formatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
      timeZone: timezone,
      weekday: 'short',
    });
    const weekdayStr = formatter.format(new Date());
    const dayMap: Record<string, number> = {
      Mon: 1,
      Tue: 2,
      Wed: 3,
      Thu: 4,
      Fri: 5,
      Sat: 6,
      Sun: 7,
    };
    return dayMap[weekdayStr] || 1;
  } catch {
    return 1;
  }
}

export default function SchedulePage(): React.JSX.Element {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const initialCourseId = searchParams.get('courseId') || 'all';
  const querySemesterId = searchParams.get('semesterId');

  const [semesters, setSemesters] = React.useState<Semester[]>([]);
  const [activeSemester, setActiveSemester] = React.useState<Semester | null>(null);
  const [userProfile, setUserProfile] = React.useState<UserProfile | null>(null);

  const [courses, setCourses] = React.useState<Course[]>([]);
  const [schedules, setSchedules] = React.useState<CourseSchedule[]>([]);

  // Filters
  const [selectedCourseFilter, setSelectedCourseFilter] = React.useState<string>(initialCourseId);

  // Mobile selected day (1..7, default based on user timezone)
  const [mobileSelectedDay, setMobileSelectedDay] = React.useState<number>(1);

  // Loading & Error States
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = React.useState(true);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  // Success / Conflict Banner from dialog action
  const [statusBanner, setStatusBanner] = React.useState<{
    type: 'success' | 'warning';
    message: string;
    conflicts?: CourseScheduleConflict[];
  } | null>(null);

  // Dialog States
  const [isCreateOpen, setIsCreateOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const [editingSchedule, setEditingSchedule] = React.useState<CourseSchedule | null>(null);
  const [deletingSchedule, setDeletingSchedule] = React.useState<CourseSchedule | null>(null);

  // Race condition guard
  const fetchRequestIdRef = React.useRef(0);

  const timezone = userProfile?.timezone || 'Asia/Jakarta';

  // 1. Initial Load: Profile & Semesters
  React.useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    async function init() {
      try {
        const [profile, semData] = await Promise.all([
          getProfile().catch(() => null),
          listSemesters('all'),
        ]);
        if (!isMounted) return;
        if (profile) {
          setUserProfile(profile);
          const currentDay = getCurrentDayOfWeekInTimezone(profile.timezone || 'Asia/Jakarta');
          setMobileSelectedDay(currentDay);
        }
        setSemesters(semData.semesters);
        const resolvedSemester = querySemesterId
          ? semData.semesters.find((s) => s.id === querySemesterId) || semData.activeSemester
          : semData.activeSemester;
        setActiveSemester(resolvedSemester);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to load initial schedule context:', err);
      }
    }
    init();

    const handleSemesterChange = () => {
      listSemesters('all')
        .then((semData) => {
          if (!isMounted) return;
          setSemesters(semData.semesters);
          setActiveSemester(semData.activeSemester);
        })
        .catch(console.error);
    };

    window.addEventListener('studyflow:semester-changed', handleSemesterChange);
    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
      window.removeEventListener('studyflow:semester-changed', handleSemesterChange);
    };
  }, [querySemesterId]);

  // 2. Fetch Schedules & Courses for active semester
  const fetchScheduleData = React.useCallback(async (targetSemester: Semester | null) => {
    if (!targetSemester) {
      setCourses([]);
      setSchedules([]);
      setIsLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    const currentRequestId = ++fetchRequestIdRef.current;
    setIsLoading(true);
    setErrorMsg(null);

    try {
      const [crsRes, schRes] = await Promise.all([
        listCourses({ semesterId: targetSemester.id, isArchived: false }),
        listSchedules({ semesterId: targetSemester.id }),
      ]);

      // Guard against race conditions: ignore response if a newer request was dispatched
      if (currentRequestId === fetchRequestIdRef.current) {
        setCourses(crsRes.courses);
        setSchedules(schRes.schedules);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (currentRequestId === fetchRequestIdRef.current) {
        setErrorMsg(err.message || 'Gagal memuat jadwal kuliah');
      }
    } finally {
      if (currentRequestId === fetchRequestIdRef.current) {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }, []);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    fetchScheduleData(activeSemester);
  }, [activeSemester, fetchScheduleData]);

  // Synchronize initial courseId from query param if available
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (initialCourseId && initialCourseId !== 'all') {
      setSelectedCourseFilter(initialCourseId);
    }
  }, [initialCourseId]);

  // Filter schedules by selected course
  const filteredSchedules = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (selectedCourseFilter === 'all') return schedules;
    return schedules.filter((s) => s.courseId === selectedCourseFilter);
  }, [schedules, selectedCourseFilter]);

  // Group schedules by day of week (1..7)
  const schedulesByDay = React.useMemo(() => {
    const map: Record<number, CourseSchedule[]> = {
      1: [],
      2: [],
      3: [],
      4: [],
      5: [],
      6: [],
      7: [],
    };
    for (const item of filteredSchedules) {
      if (map[item.dayOfWeek]) {
        map[item.dayOfWeek].push(item);
      }
    }
    // Sort each day by startTime ascending
    for (let day = 1; day <= 7; day++) {
      map[day].sort((a, b) => a.startTime.localeCompare(b.startTime));
    }
    return map;
  }, [filteredSchedules]);

  // Handler Dialog Callbacks
  const handleCreateSuccess = (
    newSchedule: CourseSchedule,
    hasConflict: boolean,
    conflicts?: CourseScheduleConflict[]
  ) => {
    fetchScheduleData(activeSemester);
    if (hasConflict && conflicts && conflicts.length > 0) {
      const conflictNames = conflicts.map((c) => `${c.courseName} (${c.startTime}–${c.endTime})`).join(', ');
      setStatusBanner({
        type: 'warning',
        message: `Jadwal disimpan, tetapi waktunya bertabrakan dengan: ${conflictNames}.`,
        conflicts,
      });
    } else {
      setStatusBanner({
        type: 'success',
        message: 'Jadwal perkuliahan berhasil ditambahkan.',
      });
    }
  };

  const handleEditSuccess = (
    updatedSchedule: CourseSchedule,
    hasConflict: boolean,
    conflicts?: CourseScheduleConflict[]
  ) => {
    fetchScheduleData(activeSemester);
    if (hasConflict && conflicts && conflicts.length > 0) {
      const conflictNames = conflicts.map((c) => `${c.courseName} (${c.startTime}–${c.endTime})`).join(', ');
      setStatusBanner({
        type: 'warning',
        message: `Jadwal diperbarui, tetapi waktunya bertabrakan dengan: ${conflictNames}.`,
        conflicts,
      });
    } else {
      setStatusBanner({
        type: 'success',
        message: 'Jadwal perkuliahan berhasil diperbarui.',
      });
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteSuccess = () => {
    fetchScheduleData(activeSemester);
    setStatusBanner({
      type: 'success',
      message: 'Jadwal perkuliahan berhasil dihapus.',
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* 1. Header Ringkas */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between border-b border-border pb-4">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground sm:text-3xl">
              Jadwal Kuliah
            </h1>
            {activeSemester ? (
              <Badge variant="outline" className="font-medium text-xs">
                {activeSemester.name}
              </Badge>
            ) : (
              <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                Belum Ada Semester Aktif
              </Badge>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <Clock className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground/70" />
              <span>Sesi mingguan berulang</span>
            </span>
            <span>&bull;</span>
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <Globe className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground/70" />
              <span>Zona Waktu: <strong className="text-foreground font-medium">{timezone}</strong></span>
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* CTA Tambah Jadwal */}
        <div>
          <Button
            onClick={() => {
              setStatusBanner(null);
              setIsCreateOpen(true);
            }}
            disabled={!activeSemester || courses.length === 0}
            size="standard"
            className="gap-1.5 w-full sm:w-auto font-medium"
          >
            <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
            <span>Tambah Jadwal</span>
          </Button>

      </div>

      {/* 2. Status / Conflict Feedback Banner */}
      {statusBanner && (

          className={statusBanner.type === 'success' ? 'border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-100' : ''}
        >
          {statusBanner.type === 'warning' ? (
            <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4" />
          ) : (
            <Info className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
          )}
          <div className="flex-1">
            <AlertTitle className="text-sm font-semibold">
              {statusBanner.type === 'warning' ? 'Peringatan Benturan Jadwal' : 'Berhasil'}
            </AlertTitle>
            <AlertDescription className="text-xs leading-relaxed mt-0.5">
              {statusBanner.message}
            </AlertDescription>

          <button

      {/* 3. Toolbar: Filter Mata Kuliah */}

          <div className="mx-auto flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary/10 text-primary">
            <CalendarClock className="h-6 w-6" />
          </div>
          <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">
            Belum Ada Jadwal Kuliah

              >
