                <span>Tambah Jadwal Pertama</span>
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* E. Empty State: Filter Tidak Menemukan Jadwal */}
      {!isLoading && !errorMsg && activeSemester && schedules.length > 0 && filteredSchedules.length === 0 && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-border p-8 text-center bg-card space-y-3">
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
            Tidak ada sesi jadwal untuk mata kuliah yang dipilih.
          </p>
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => setSelectedCourseFilter('all')}
            className="text-xs"
          >
            Tampilkan Semua Jadwal
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* F. TAMPILAN JADWAL TERISI */}
      {!isLoading && !errorMsg && activeSemester && filteredSchedules.length > 0 && (
        <div>
          {/* F.1 TAMPILAN DESKTOP (Grid Mingguan Senin–Minggu) */}
          <div className="hidden lg:grid grid-cols-7 gap-3 items-start">
            {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7].map((dayNum) => {
              const dayItems = schedulesByDay[dayNum] || [];
              const isWeekend = dayNum === 6 || dayNum === 7;
              const isCurrentDay = getCurrentDayOfWeekInTimezone(timezone) === dayNum;

              return (
                <div
                  key={dayNum}
                  className={`rounded-xl border ${
                    isCurrentDay
                      ? 'border-primary/50 bg-primary/[0.02] shadow-xs'
                      : 'border-border bg-card'
                  } flex flex-col min-h-[380px]`}
                >
                  {/* Day Column Header */}
                  <div
                    className={`p-3 border-b border-border flex items-center justify-between ${
                      isCurrentDay ? 'bg-primary/10 text-primary' : 'bg-muted/30 text-foreground'
                    } rounded-t-xl`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
                      <span className="font-bold text-sm tracking-tight truncate">
                        {getDayNameId(dayNum)}
                      </span>
                      {isCurrentDay && (
                        <Badge variant="default" className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0 h-4">
                          Hari Ini
                        </Badge>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground">
                      {dayItems.length}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Day Column Items */}
                  <div className="p-2.5 space-y-2.5 flex-1">
                    {dayItems.length === 0 ? (
                      <div className="h-32 flex items-center justify-center text-center p-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground/60">
                        {isWeekend ? 'Tidak ada kelas' : 'Kosong'}
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      dayItems.map((item) => (
                        <ScheduleCard
                          key={item.id}
                          schedule={item}
                          onEdit={() => setEditingSchedule(item)}
                          onDelete={() => setDeletingSchedule(item)}
                        />
                      ))
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          {/* F.2 TAMPILAN MOBILE (< 1024px: Agenda Harian Responsif) */}
          <div className="lg:hidden space-y-4">
            {/* Horizontal Day Selector (Touch Target >= 44x44px) */}
            <div className="flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto pb-2 scrollbar-none">
              {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7].map((dayNum) => {
                const count = schedulesByDay[dayNum]?.length || 0;
                const isSelected = mobileSelectedDay === dayNum;
                const isToday = getCurrentDayOfWeekInTimezone(timezone) === dayNum;

                return (
                  <button
                    key={dayNum}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setMobileSelectedDay(dayNum)}
                    className={`flex-1 min-w-[56px] min-h-[44px] px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg border text-center transition-colors flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-0.5 touch-manipulation ${
                      isSelected
                        ? 'border-primary bg-primary text-primary-foreground font-semibold shadow-xs'
                        : 'border-border bg-card text-foreground hover:bg-muted'
                    }`}
                    aria-label={`Pilih hari ${getDayNameId(dayNum)}, ${count} sesi jadwal`}
                  >
                    <span className="text-xs truncate">{getDayNameId(dayNum).substring(0, 3)}</span>
                    <span
                      className={`text-[10px] px-1 rounded-full ${
                        isSelected ? 'bg-primary-foreground/20 text-primary-foreground' : 'text-muted-foreground'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {count}
                    </span>
                    {isToday && (
                      <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 mt-0.5" title="Hari ini" />
                    )}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            {/* Selected Day Agenda Header */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-1">
              <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-foreground">
                Jadwal Hari {getDayNameId(mobileSelectedDay)}
              </h2>
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {schedulesByDay[mobileSelectedDay]?.length || 0} Sesi Perkuliahan
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* List Sesi Hari Terpilih */}
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {(schedulesByDay[mobileSelectedDay] || []).length === 0 ? (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border p-6 text-center bg-muted/10 space-y-1">
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
                    Tidak ada jadwal kuliah pada hari {getDayNameId(mobileSelectedDay)}.
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    Gunakan waktu luang untuk mempelajari materi atau mengerjakan tugas.
                  </p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                schedulesByDay[mobileSelectedDay].map((item) => (
                  <ScheduleCard
                    key={item.id}
                    schedule={item}
                    isMobileView
                    onEdit={() => setEditingSchedule(item)}
                    onDelete={() => setDeletingSchedule(item)}
                  />
                ))
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 5. Dialogs */}
      <CreateScheduleDialog
        open={isCreateOpen}
        onOpenChange={setIsCreateOpen}
        courses={courses}
        onSuccess={handleCreateSuccess}
      />

      <EditScheduleDialog
        open={Boolean(editingSchedule)}
        onOpenChange={(open) => !open && setEditingSchedule(null)}
        schedule={editingSchedule}
        onSuccess={handleEditSuccess}
      />

      <DeleteScheduleDialog
        open={Boolean(deletingSchedule)}
        onOpenChange={(open) => !open && setDeletingSchedule(null)}
        schedule={deletingSchedule}
        onSuccess={handleDeleteSuccess}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

// Subkomponen Kartu Jadwal
interface ScheduleCardProps {
  schedule: CourseSchedule;
  isMobileView?: boolean;
  onEdit: () => void;
  onDelete: () => void;
}

function ScheduleCard({
  schedule,
  isMobileView,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
}: ScheduleCardProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const hasConflict = schedule.hasConflict;
  const course = schedule.course;

  return (
    <div
      className={`rounded-lg border ${
        hasConflict
          ? 'border-destructive/60 bg-destructive/[0.04]'
          : 'border-border/80 bg-background/80 hover:border-border'
      } p-3 transition-colors space-y-2 relative group shadow-2xs`}
    >
      {/* Top: Waktu & Aksi Dropdown */}
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-1.5">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-mono text-xs font-bold text-foreground">
          <Clock className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-primary shrink-0" />
          <span>
            {schedule.startTime} – {schedule.endTime}
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Dropdown Menu Tiga Titik */}
        <DropdownMenu>
          <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="icon"
              className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground relative after:absolute after:-inset-2 sm:after:hidden touch-manipulation"
              aria-label={`Menu aksi jadwal ${course?.name || ''}`}
            >
              <MoreVertical className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </Button>
          </DropdownMenuTrigger>
          <DropdownMenuContent align="end" className="w-36">
            <DropdownMenuItem onClick={onEdit} className="text-xs gap-2 cursor-pointer">
              <Pencil className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              <span>Edit Sesi</span>
            </DropdownMenuItem>
            <DropdownMenuSeparator />
            <DropdownMenuItem
              onClick={onDelete}
              className="text-xs gap-2 text-destructive focus:text-destructive cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              <span>Hapus Sesi</span>
            </DropdownMenuItem>
          </DropdownMenuContent>
        </DropdownMenu>
      </div>

      {/* Info Mata Kuliah */}
      <div className="space-y-0.5">
        <Link
          href={`/courses/${schedule.courseId}`}
          className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold text-foreground hover:text-primary transition-colors line-clamp-2 block"
        >
          {course?.name || 'Mata Kuliah'}
        </Link>
        {course?.code && (
          <p className="font-mono text-[11px] text-muted-foreground truncate">
            {course.code}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Dosen & Ruangan */}
      <div className="space-y-1 pt-1 border-t border-border/50 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
        {course?.lecturer && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 truncate">
            <User className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground/70" />
            <span className="truncate">{course.lecturer}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {schedule.room && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 truncate font-medium text-foreground/90">
            <MapPin className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0 text-primary" />
            <span className="truncate">{schedule.room}</span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Peringatan Benturan Waktu (Accessible Text & Icon) */}
      {hasConflict && (
        <div className="pt-1.5">
          <div className="rounded-md bg-destructive/10 border border-destructive/30 p-2 text-[11px] text-destructive space-y-1">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-semibold">
              <AlertTriangle className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" />
              <span>Benturan Waktu</span>

              <p className="text-[10px] text-destructive/90 leading-tight">
                Tabrakan dengan:{' '}
                {schedule.conflicts.map((c) => c.courseName).join(', ')}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

<file path="apps/web/src/app/api/assignments/[[...path]]/route.ts">
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';

const INTERNAL_API_URL =
  process.env.INTERNAL_API_URL ||
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ||
  'http://localhost:4000';

const STATE_CHANGING_METHODS = new Set(['POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE']);

function validateCsrfOrigin(req: NextRequest): { valid: boolean; reason?: string } {
  if (!STATE_CHANGING_METHODS.has(req.method)) {
    return { valid: true };
  }

  const origin = req.headers.get('origin');
  const referer = req.headers.get('referer');
  const trustedOrigin = req.nextUrl.origin;

  if (origin === 'null') {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'Origin null tidak diizinkan' };
  }

  let requestOrigin: string | null = null;
  if (origin) {
    requestOrigin = origin;
  } else if (referer) {
    try {
      const url = new URL(referer);
      requestOrigin = url.origin;
    } catch {
      requestOrigin = null;
    }
  }

  if (!requestOrigin) {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'Header Origin atau Referer wajib ada untuk request ini' };
  }

  if (requestOrigin !== trustedOrigin) {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'Origin tidak diizinkan atau CSRF terdeteksi' };
  }

  return { valid: true };
}

async function handleProxy(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ path?: string[] }> }) {
  const csrfCheck = validateCsrfOrigin(req);
  if (!csrfCheck.valid) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error: {
          code: 'CSRF_ORIGIN_INVALID',
          message: csrfCheck.reason || 'Permintaan ditolak: CSRF terdeteksi',
        },
      },
      { status: 403 }
    );
  }

  const { path } = await params;
  const subPath = path && path.length > 0 ? path.join('/') : '';
  const search = req.nextUrl.search;
  const targetUrl = `${INTERNAL_API_URL}/api/assignments${subPath ? `/${subPath}` : ''}${search}`;

  const requestHeaders = new Headers();
  requestHeaders.set('Content-Type', 'application/json');

  const cookieHeader = req.headers.get('cookie');
  if (cookieHeader) {
    requestHeaders.set('cookie', cookieHeader);
  }

  const authHeader = req.headers.get('authorization');
  if (authHeader) {
    requestHeaders.set('authorization', authHeader);
  }

  const origin = req.headers.get('origin');
  if (origin) {
    requestHeaders.set('origin', origin);
  }
  const referer = req.headers.get('referer');
  if (referer) {
    requestHeaders.set('referer', referer);
  }

  const requestId = req.headers.get('x-request-id') || crypto.randomUUID();
  requestHeaders.set('x-request-id', requestId);

  let body: string | undefined;
  if (req.method !== 'GET' && req.method !== 'HEAD') {
    try {
      body = await req.text();
    } catch {
      body = undefined;
    }
  }

  try {
    const expressRes = await fetch(targetUrl, {
      method: req.method,
      headers: requestHeaders,
      body,
      cache: 'no-store',
    });

    const responseData = await expressRes.text();

    const response = new NextResponse(responseData, {
      status: expressRes.status,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': expressRes.headers.get('content-type') || 'application/json',
      },
    });

    const setCookieHeaders = expressRes.headers.getSetCookie();
    if (setCookieHeaders && setCookieHeaders.length > 0) {
      for (const cookieStr of setCookieHeaders) {
        response.headers.append('set-cookie', cookieStr);
      }
    }

    return response;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`[BFF Proxy Error] ${req.method} ${targetUrl} failed:`, err instanceof Error ? err.message : err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error: {
          code: 'BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE',
          message: 'Layanan backend sedang tidak dapat dihubungi. Silakan coba beberapa saat lagi.',
        },
      },
      { status: 503 }
    );
  }
}

export const GET = handleProxy;
export const POST = handleProxy;
export const PATCH = handleProxy;
export const DELETE = handleProxy;
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/app/api/auth/google/callback/route.ts">
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { COOKIE_NAMES, OAuthTransactionCookieSchema, OAuthTransactionCookie } from '@studyflow/shared';
import { getSafeReturnUrl } from '@/lib/auth-client';

const INTERNAL_API_URL =
  process.env.INTERNAL_API_URL ||
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ||
  'http://localhost:4000';

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const searchParams = req.nextUrl.searchParams;
  const code = searchParams.get('code');
  const state = searchParams.get('state');
  const errorParam = searchParams.get('error');

  // 1. Read transient transaction cookie
  const txCookieRaw = req.cookies.get(COOKIE_NAMES.oauthTx)?.value;

  // Prepare a base response helper that ensures transaction cookie is always cleared
  const clearCookieOptions = {
    path: '/',
    maxAge: 0,
    httpOnly: true,
    sameSite: 'lax' as const,
    secure: req.nextUrl.protocol === 'https:' || process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
  };

  if (!txCookieRaw) {
    const errorMsg = 'Sesi transaksi login kedaluwarsa atau tidak ditemukan. Silakan coba kembali.';
    const res = NextResponse.redirect(
      new URL(`/login?error=${encodeURIComponent(errorMsg)}`, req.nextUrl.origin)
    );
    res.cookies.set(COOKIE_NAMES.oauthTx, '', clearCookieOptions);
    return res;
  }

  let tx: OAuthTransactionCookie;
  try {
    const parsedJson = JSON.parse(txCookieRaw);
    const parsed = OAuthTransactionCookieSchema.safeParse(parsedJson);
    if (!parsed.success) {
      throw new Error('Skema transaksi tidak valid');
    }
    tx = parsed.data;
  } catch {
    const errorMsg = 'Data transaksi OAuth rusak atau tidak valid. Silakan coba kembali.';
    const res = NextResponse.redirect(
      new URL(`/login?error=${encodeURIComponent(errorMsg)}`, req.nextUrl.origin)
    );
    res.cookies.set(COOKIE_NAMES.oauthTx, '', clearCookieOptions);
    return res;
  }

  const errorRedirectBase = tx.intent === 'link' ? '/settings' : '/login';

  // 2. Handle provider cancellation or denial (e.g. error=access_denied)
  if (errorParam) {
    const isCancelled = errorParam === 'access_denied';
    const message = isCancelled
      ? 'Otorisasi masuk dengan Google dibatalkan.'
      : 'Terjadi kesalahan saat otorisasi dengan akun Google.';
    const res = NextResponse.redirect(
      new URL(`${errorRedirectBase}?error=${encodeURIComponent(message)}`, req.nextUrl.origin)
    );
    res.cookies.set(COOKIE_NAMES.oauthTx, '', clearCookieOptions);
    return res;
  }

  // 3. Handle missing code or state
  if (!code || !state) {
    const message = 'Parameter otorisasi Google tidak lengkap.';
    const res = NextResponse.redirect(
      new URL(`${errorRedirectBase}?error=${encodeURIComponent(message)}`, req.nextUrl.origin)
    );
    res.cookies.set(COOKIE_NAMES.oauthTx, '', clearCookieOptions);
    return res;
  }

  // 4. Validate State (Anti-CSRF Protection)
  if (state !== tx.state) {
    const message = 'State transaksi tidak cocok. Permintaan ditolak demi keamanan (CSRF terdeteksi).';
    const res = NextResponse.redirect(
      new URL(`${errorRedirectBase}?error=${encodeURIComponent(message)}`, req.nextUrl.origin)
    );
    res.cookies.set(COOKIE_NAMES.oauthTx, '', clearCookieOptions);
    return res;
  }

  // 5. Exchange code via Express API
  const callbackRedirectUri = `${req.nextUrl.origin}/api/auth/google/callback`;

  const requestHeaders = new Headers();
  requestHeaders.set('Content-Type', 'application/json');
  requestHeaders.set('Origin', req.nextUrl.origin);

  // Forward existing auth cookies from browser to Express (necessary for linking intent)
  const cookieHeader = req.headers.get('cookie');
  if (cookieHeader) {
    requestHeaders.set('cookie', cookieHeader);
  }

  try {
    const expressRes = await fetch(`${INTERNAL_API_URL}/api/auth/google/exchange`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: requestHeaders,
      body: JSON.stringify({
        code,
        codeVerifier: tx.codeVerifier,
        nonce: tx.nonce,
        redirectUri: callbackRedirectUri,
        intent: tx.intent,
      }),
      cache: 'no-store',
    });

    if (!expressRes.ok) {
      const errorData = (await expressRes.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
        error?: { message?: string; code?: string };
      };
      const errorMessage =
        errorData.error?.message || 'Gagal menyelesaikan autentikasi dengan akun Google.';

      const res = NextResponse.redirect(
        new URL(`${errorRedirectBase}?error=${encodeURIComponent(errorMessage)}`, req.nextUrl.origin)
      );
      res.cookies.set(COOKIE_NAMES.oauthTx, '', clearCookieOptions);
      return res;
    }

    // 6. Handle Success Redirect
    const successTarget =
      tx.intent === 'link'
        ? `${req.nextUrl.origin}/settings?google=linked`
        : `${req.nextUrl.origin}${getSafeReturnUrl(tx.returnUrl, '/dashboard')}`;

    const response = NextResponse.redirect(new URL(successTarget));

    // Clear the transaction cookie atomically
    response.cookies.set(COOKIE_NAMES.oauthTx, '', clearCookieOptions);

    // Forward Set-Cookie headers from Express to browser (access token, refresh token)
    const setCookieHeaders =
      typeof expressRes.headers.getSetCookie === 'function'
        ? expressRes.headers.getSetCookie()
        : [];
    if (setCookieHeaders && setCookieHeaders.length > 0) {
      for (const cookieStr of setCookieHeaders) {
        response.headers.append('set-cookie', cookieStr);
      }
    }

    return response;
  } catch {
    const message = 'Gagal menghubungi server aplikasi saat menyelesaikan login Google.';
    const res = NextResponse.redirect(
      new URL(`${errorRedirectBase}?error=${encodeURIComponent(message)}`, req.nextUrl.origin)
    );
    res.cookies.set(COOKIE_NAMES.oauthTx, '', clearCookieOptions);
    return res;
  }
}

<file path="apps/web/src/app/api/auth/google/link/route.ts">
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { COOKIE_NAMES } from '@studyflow/shared';

const INTERNAL_API_URL =
  process.env.INTERNAL_API_URL ||
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ||
  'http://localhost:4000';

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  // Validate CSRF / Origin
  const origin = req.headers.get('origin');
  if (origin !== req.nextUrl.origin) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: { message: 'Origin tidak diizinkan atau CSRF terdeteksi' } },
      { status: 403 }
    );
  }

  let body: { currentPassword?: string };
  try {
    body = await req.json();
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: { message: 'Body request tidak valid' } },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  const requestHeaders = new Headers();
  requestHeaders.set('Content-Type', 'application/json');
  requestHeaders.set('Origin', req.nextUrl.origin);

  // Forward cookies from browser to Express (authentication session)
  const cookieHeader = req.headers.get('cookie');
  if (cookieHeader) {
    requestHeaders.set('cookie', cookieHeader);
  }

  try {
    const apiRes = await fetch(`${INTERNAL_API_URL}/api/auth/google/link/init`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: requestHeaders,
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
      cache: 'no-store',
    });

    const data = await apiRes.json();
    if (!apiRes.ok) {
      return NextResponse.json(data, { status: apiRes.status });
    }

    const { url, state, nonce, codeVerifier, userId } = data as {
      url: string;
      state: string;
      nonce: string;
      codeVerifier: string;
      userId: string;
    };

    // Store transient linking transaction in secure HttpOnly cookie
    const txData = JSON.stringify({
      state,
      nonce,
      codeVerifier,
      returnUrl: '/settings',
      intent: 'link',
      userId,
      createdAt: Date.now(),
    });

    const isSecure = req.nextUrl.protocol === 'https:' || process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production';

    const response = NextResponse.json({ url });
    response.cookies.set(COOKIE_NAMES.oauthTx, txData, {
      httpOnly: true,
      secure: isSecure,
      sameSite: 'lax',
      path: '/',
      maxAge: 600, // 10 minutes
    });

    return response;
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: { message: 'Gagal menghubungi server untuk memulai pengaitan Google' } },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

<file path="apps/web/src/app/api/auth/google/route.ts">
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { COOKIE_NAMES } from '@studyflow/shared';
import { getSafeReturnUrl } from '@/lib/auth-client';

const INTERNAL_API_URL =
  process.env.INTERNAL_API_URL ||
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ||
  'http://localhost:4000';

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const searchParams = req.nextUrl.searchParams;
  const rawReturnUrl = searchParams.get('returnUrl');
  const returnUrl = getSafeReturnUrl(rawReturnUrl, '/dashboard');

  try {
    const callbackRedirectUri = `${req.nextUrl.origin}/api/auth/google/callback`;

    // Request fresh OAuth URL & PKCE challenge from Express API
    const targetUrl = new URL(`${INTERNAL_API_URL}/api/auth/google/url`);
    targetUrl.searchParams.set('redirectUri', callbackRedirectUri);

    const apiRes = await fetch(targetUrl.toString(), {
      method: 'GET',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      },
      cache: 'no-store',
    });

    if (!apiRes.ok) {
      const errorData = await apiRes.json().catch(() => ({}));
      const message = errorData.error?.message || 'Layanan Google OAuth sedang tidak tersedia';
      return NextResponse.redirect(
        new URL(`/login?error=${encodeURIComponent(message)}`, req.nextUrl.origin)
      );
    }

    const { url, state, nonce, codeVerifier } = (await apiRes.json()) as {
      url: string;
      state: string;
      nonce: string;
      codeVerifier: string;
    };

    // Store transient OAuth transaction state in secure HttpOnly cookie
    const txData = JSON.stringify({
      state,
      nonce,
      codeVerifier,
      returnUrl,
      intent: 'login',
      createdAt: Date.now(),
    });

    const isSecure = req.nextUrl.protocol === 'https:' || process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production';

    const response = NextResponse.redirect(url);
    response.cookies.set(COOKIE_NAMES.oauthTx, txData, {
      httpOnly: true,
      secure: isSecure,
      sameSite: 'lax', // Required so cookie is attached upon GET redirection from Google
      path: '/',
      maxAge: 600, // 10 minutes
    });

    return response;
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.redirect(
      new URL('/login?error=oauth_init_failed', req.nextUrl.origin)
    );
  }
}

<file path="apps/web/src/app/api/calendar/[[...path]]/route.ts">

<file path="apps/web/src/app/api/courses/[[...path]]/route.ts">
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';

const INTERNAL_API_URL =
  process.env.INTERNAL_API_URL ||
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ||
  'http://localhost:4000';

const STATE_CHANGING_METHODS = new Set(['POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE']);

function validateCsrfOrigin(req: NextRequest): { valid: boolean; reason?: string } {
  if (!STATE_CHANGING_METHODS.has(req.method)) {
    return { valid: true };
  }

  const origin = req.headers.get('origin');
  const referer = req.headers.get('referer');
  const trustedOrigin = req.nextUrl.origin;

  // 1. Explicitly reject null origin
  if (origin === 'null') {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'Origin null tidak diizinkan' };
  }

  let requestOrigin: string | null = null;

  if (origin) {
    requestOrigin = origin;
  } else if (referer) {
    try {
      const url = new URL(referer);
      requestOrigin = url.origin;
    } catch {
      requestOrigin = null;
    }
  }

  // 2. Reject missing Origin & Referer on mutations
  if (!requestOrigin) {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'Header Origin atau Referer wajib ada untuk request ini' };
  }

  // 3. Reject foreign/attacker origins
  if (requestOrigin !== trustedOrigin) {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'Origin tidak diizinkan atau CSRF terdeteksi' };
  }

  return { valid: true };
}

async function handleProxy(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ path?: string[] }> }) {
  // Validate Origin/CSRF before proxying state-changing requests
  const csrfCheck = validateCsrfOrigin(req);
  if (!csrfCheck.valid) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error: {
          code: 'CSRF_ORIGIN_INVALID',
          message: csrfCheck.reason || 'Permintaan ditolak: CSRF terdeteksi',
        },
      },
      { status: 403 }
    );
  }

  const { path } = await params;
  const subPath = path && path.length > 0 ? path.join('/') : '';
  const search = req.nextUrl.search;
  const targetUrl = `${INTERNAL_API_URL}/api/courses${subPath ? `/${subPath}` : ''}${search}`;

  const requestHeaders = new Headers();
  requestHeaders.set('Content-Type', 'application/json');

  // Forward cookies from browser to Express
  const cookieHeader = req.headers.get('cookie');
  if (cookieHeader) {
    requestHeaders.set('cookie', cookieHeader);
  }

  // Forward authorization header if present
  const authHeader = req.headers.get('authorization');
  if (authHeader) {
    requestHeaders.set('authorization', authHeader);
  }

  // Forward client Origin and Referer transparently
  const origin = req.headers.get('origin');
  if (origin) {
    requestHeaders.set('origin', origin);
  }
  const referer = req.headers.get('referer');
  if (referer) {
    requestHeaders.set('referer', referer);
  }

  // Forward client request ID
  const requestId = req.headers.get('x-request-id') || crypto.randomUUID();
  requestHeaders.set('x-request-id', requestId);

  let body: string | undefined;
  if (req.method !== 'GET' && req.method !== 'HEAD') {
    try {
      body = await req.text();
    } catch {
      body = undefined;
    }
  }

  try {
    const expressRes = await fetch(targetUrl, {
      method: req.method,
      headers: requestHeaders,
      body,
      cache: 'no-store',
    });

    const responseData = await expressRes.text();

    const response = new NextResponse(responseData, {
      status: expressRes.status,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': expressRes.headers.get('content-type') || 'application/json',
      },
    });

    // Forward Set-Cookie headers if any
    const setCookieHeaders = expressRes.headers.getSetCookie();
    if (setCookieHeaders && setCookieHeaders.length > 0) {
      for (const cookieStr of setCookieHeaders) {
        response.headers.append('set-cookie', cookieStr);
      }
    }

    return response;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`[BFF Proxy Error] ${req.method} ${targetUrl} failed:`, err instanceof Error ? err.message : err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error: {
          code: 'BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE',
          message: 'Layanan backend sedang tidak dapat dihubungi. Silakan coba beberapa saat lagi.',
        },
      },
      { status: 503 }
    );
  }
}

export const GET = handleProxy;
export const POST = handleProxy;
export const PATCH = handleProxy;
export const DELETE = handleProxy;

  requestHeaders.set('Content-Type', 'application/json');

  const cookieHeader = req.headers.get('cookie');
  if (cookieHeader) {
    requestHeaders.set('cookie', cookieHeader);
  }

  const authHeader = req.headers.get('authorization');
  if (authHeader) {
    requestHeaders.set('authorization', authHeader);
  }

  const origin = req.headers.get('origin');
  if (origin) {
    requestHeaders.set('origin', origin);
  }
  const referer = req.headers.get('referer');
  if (referer) {
    requestHeaders.set('referer', referer);
  }

  const requestId = req.headers.get('x-request-id') || crypto.randomUUID();
  requestHeaders.set('x-request-id', requestId);

  let body: string | undefined;
  if (req.method !== 'GET' && req.method !== 'HEAD') {
    try {
      body = await req.text();
    } catch {
      body = undefined;
    }
  }

  try {
    const expressRes = await fetch(targetUrl, {
      method: req.method,
      headers: requestHeaders,
      body,
      cache: 'no-store',
    });

    const responseData = await expressRes.text();

    const response = new NextResponse(responseData, {
      status: expressRes.status,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': expressRes.headers.get('content-type') || 'application/json',
      },
    });

    const setCookieHeaders = expressRes.headers.getSetCookie();
    if (setCookieHeaders && setCookieHeaders.length > 0) {
      for (const cookieStr of setCookieHeaders) {
        response.headers.append('set-cookie', cookieStr);
      }
    }

    return response;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`[BFF Proxy Error] ${req.method} ${targetUrl} failed:`, err instanceof Error ? err.message : err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error: {
          code: 'BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE',
          message: 'Layanan backend sedang tidak dapat dihubungi. Silakan coba beberapa saat lagi.',
        },
      },
      { status: 503 }
    );
  }
}

<file path="apps/web/src/app/api/schedules/[[...path]]/route.ts">
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';

const INTERNAL_API_URL =
  process.env.INTERNAL_API_URL ||
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ||
  'http://localhost:4000';

const STATE_CHANGING_METHODS = new Set(['POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE']);

function validateCsrfOrigin(req: NextRequest): { valid: boolean; reason?: string } {
  if (!STATE_CHANGING_METHODS.has(req.method)) {
    return { valid: true };
  }

  const origin = req.headers.get('origin');
  const referer = req.headers.get('referer');
  const trustedOrigin = req.nextUrl.origin;

  // 1. Explicitly reject null origin
  if (origin === 'null') {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'Origin null tidak diizinkan' };
  }

  let requestOrigin: string | null = null;

  if (origin) {
    requestOrigin = origin;
  } else if (referer) {
    try {
      const url = new URL(referer);
      requestOrigin = url.origin;
    } catch {
      requestOrigin = null;
    }
  }

  // 2. Reject missing Origin & Referer on mutations
  if (!requestOrigin) {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'Header Origin atau Referer wajib ada untuk request ini' };
  }

  // 3. Reject foreign/attacker origins
  if (requestOrigin !== trustedOrigin) {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'Origin tidak diizinkan atau CSRF terdeteksi' };
  }

  return { valid: true };
}

async function handleProxy(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ path?: string[] }> }) {
  // Validate Origin/CSRF before proxying state-changing requests
  const csrfCheck = validateCsrfOrigin(req);
  if (!csrfCheck.valid) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error: {
          code: 'CSRF_ORIGIN_INVALID',
          message: csrfCheck.reason || 'Permintaan ditolak: CSRF terdeteksi',
        },
      },
      { status: 403 }
    );
  }

  const { path } = await params;
  const subPath = path && path.length > 0 ? path.join('/') : '';
  const search = req.nextUrl.search;
  const targetUrl = `${INTERNAL_API_URL}/api/schedules${subPath ? `/${subPath}` : ''}${search}`;

  const requestHeaders = new Headers();
  requestHeaders.set('Content-Type', 'application/json');

  // Forward cookies from browser to Express
  const cookieHeader = req.headers.get('cookie');
  if (cookieHeader) {
    requestHeaders.set('cookie', cookieHeader);
  }

  // Forward authorization header if present
  const authHeader = req.headers.get('authorization');
  if (authHeader) {
    requestHeaders.set('authorization', authHeader);
  }

  // Forward client Origin and Referer transparently
  const origin = req.headers.get('origin');
  if (origin) {
    requestHeaders.set('origin', origin);
  }
  const referer = req.headers.get('referer');
  if (referer) {
    requestHeaders.set('referer', referer);
  }

  // Forward client request ID
  const requestId = req.headers.get('x-request-id') || crypto.randomUUID();
  requestHeaders.set('x-request-id', requestId);

  let body: string | undefined;
  if (req.method !== 'GET' && req.method !== 'HEAD') {
    try {
      body = await req.text();
    } catch {
      body = undefined;
    }
  }

  try {
    const expressRes = await fetch(targetUrl, {
      method: req.method,
      headers: requestHeaders,
      body,
      cache: 'no-store',
    });

    const responseData = await expressRes.text();

    const response = new NextResponse(responseData, {
      status: expressRes.status,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': expressRes.headers.get('content-type') || 'application/json',
      },
    });

    // Forward Set-Cookie headers if any
    const setCookieHeaders = expressRes.headers.getSetCookie();
    if (setCookieHeaders && setCookieHeaders.length > 0) {
      for (const cookieStr of setCookieHeaders) {
        response.headers.append('set-cookie', cookieStr);
      }
    }

    return response;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`[BFF Proxy Error] ${req.method} ${targetUrl} failed:`, err instanceof Error ? err.message : err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error: {
          code: 'BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE',
          message: 'Layanan backend sedang tidak dapat dihubungi. Silakan coba beberapa saat lagi.',
        },
      },
      { status: 503 }
    );
  }
}

export const GET = handleProxy;
export const POST = handleProxy;
export const PATCH = handleProxy;
export const DELETE = handleProxy;
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/components/assignments/assignment-subtask-checklist.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import { AssignmentSubtask } from '@studyflow/shared';
import {
  listSubtasks,
  createSubtask,
  updateSubtask,
  deleteSubtask,
} from '@/lib/subtask-client';
import { Checkbox } from '@/components/ui/checkbox';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from '@/components/ui/alert';
import {
  Plus,
  Pencil,
  Trash2,
  Check,
  X,
  Loader2,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle2,
  Info,
} from 'lucide-react';

export interface AssignmentSubtaskChecklistProps {
  assignmentId: string;
  isParentDone: boolean;
  isArchived: boolean;
  onCountChange?: (count: { total: number; completed: number }) => void;
}

export function AssignmentSubtaskChecklist({
  assignmentId,
  isParentDone,
  isArchived,
  onCountChange,
}: AssignmentSubtaskChecklistProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const [subtasks, setSubtasks] = React.useState<AssignmentSubtask[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = React.useState(true);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  // Quick add state
  const [newTitle, setNewTitle] = React.useState('');
  const [isAdding, setIsAdding] = React.useState(false);

  // Editing state
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [editingTitle, setEditingTitle] = React.useState('');
  const [isSavingEdit, setIsSavingEdit] = React.useState(false);

  // Per-item pending state
  const [pendingIds, setPendingIds] = React.useState<Set<string>>(new Set());

  // Confirm delete state (inline confirmation)
  const [confirmDeleteId, setConfirmDeleteId] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  // Race condition guard for fetching
  const fetchRequestIdRef = React.useRef(0);

  // Fetch subtasks
  const fetchItems = React.useCallback(async () => {
    const currentRequestId = ++fetchRequestIdRef.current;
    setIsLoading(true);
    setErrorMsg(null);

    try {
      const items = await listSubtasks(assignmentId);
      if (currentRequestId === fetchRequestIdRef.current) {
        setSubtasks(items);
        const total = items.length;
        const completed = items.filter((s) => s.completed).length;
        onCountChange?.({ total, completed });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (currentRequestId === fetchRequestIdRef.current) {
        setErrorMsg(err.message || 'Gagal memuat subtugas');
      }
    } finally {
      if (currentRequestId === fetchRequestIdRef.current) {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }, [assignmentId, onCountChange]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    fetchItems();
  }, [fetchItems]);

  const total = subtasks.length;
  const completed = subtasks.filter((s) => s.completed).length;
  const progressPercent = total > 0 ? Math.round((completed / total) * 100) : 0;

  // Toggle completion with optimistic update & rollback
  const handleToggle = async (sub: AssignmentSubtask) => {
    if (isParentDone || isArchived || pendingIds.has(sub.id)) return;

    const nextCompleted = !sub.completed;
    setErrorMsg(null);
    setPendingIds((prev) => new Set(prev).add(sub.id));

    // Optimistic update
    const previousSubtasks = [...subtasks];
    const updated = subtasks.map((item) =>
      item.id === sub.id ? { ...item, completed: nextCompleted } : item
    );
    setSubtasks(updated);
    onCountChange?.({
      total: updated.length,
      completed: updated.filter((s) => s.completed).length,
    });

    try {
      const res = await updateSubtask(assignmentId, sub.id, { completed: nextCompleted });
      setSubtasks((prev) =>
        prev.map((item) => (item.id === sub.id ? res : item))
      );
    } catch (err: any) {
      // Rollback
      setSubtasks(previousSubtasks);
      onCountChange?.({
        total: previousSubtasks.length,
        completed: previousSubtasks.filter((s) => s.completed).length,
      });
      setErrorMsg(err.message || 'Gagal memperbarui status subtugas');
    } finally {
      setPendingIds((prev) => {
        const next = new Set(prev);
        next.delete(sub.id);
        return next;
      });
    }
  };

  // Add subtask
  const handleAdd = async (e?: React.FormEvent) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    if (isParentDone || isArchived || isAdding) return;

    const trimmed = newTitle.trim();
    if (!trimmed) return;
    if (total >= 50) {
      setErrorMsg('Batas maksimal subtugas per tugas adalah 50 subtugas');
      return;
    }

    setIsAdding(true);
    setErrorMsg(null);

    try {
      const created = await createSubtask(assignmentId, { title: trimmed });
      setNewTitle('');
      const updated = [...subtasks, created];
      setSubtasks(updated);
      onCountChange?.({
        total: updated.length,
        completed: updated.filter((s) => s.completed).length,
      });
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMsg(err.message || 'Gagal menambahkan subtugas');
      // newTitle is intentionally retained on failure
    } finally {
      setIsAdding(false);
    }
  };

  // Start editing
  const startEdit = (sub: AssignmentSubtask) => {
    if (isParentDone || isArchived) return;
    setEditingId(sub.id);
    setEditingTitle(sub.title);
    setErrorMsg(null);
  };

  // Cancel editing
  const cancelEdit = () => {
    setEditingId(null);
    setEditingTitle('');
  };

  // Save editing
  const handleSaveEdit = async (sub: AssignmentSubtask) => {
    const trimmed = editingTitle.trim();
    if (!trimmed) {
      setErrorMsg('Judul subtugas tidak boleh kosong');
      return;
    }
    if (trimmed === sub.title) {
      cancelEdit();
      return;
    }

    setIsSavingEdit(true);
    setErrorMsg(null);

    try {
      const res = await updateSubtask(assignmentId, sub.id, { title: trimmed });
      setSubtasks((prev) =>
        prev.map((item) => (item.id === sub.id ? res : item))
      );
      cancelEdit();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMsg(err.message || 'Gagal mengubah judul subtugas');
    } finally {
      setIsSavingEdit(false);
    }
  };

  // Delete subtask
  const handleDelete = async (subId: string) => {
    if (isParentDone || isArchived) return;
    setPendingIds((prev) => new Set(prev).add(subId));
    setErrorMsg(null);
    setConfirmDeleteId(null);

    const previousSubtasks = [...subtasks];
    const updated = subtasks.filter((s) => s.id !== subId);
    setSubtasks(updated);
    onCountChange?.({
      total: updated.length,
      completed: updated.filter((s) => s.completed).length,
    });

    try {
      await deleteSubtask(assignmentId, subId);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setSubtasks(previousSubtasks);
      onCountChange?.({
        total: previousSubtasks.length,
        completed: previousSubtasks.filter((s) => s.completed).length,
      });
      setErrorMsg(err.message || 'Gagal menghapus subtugas');
    } finally {
      setPendingIds((prev) => {
        const next = new Set(prev);
        next.delete(subId);
        return next;
      });
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3 pt-2">
      {/* Header and Progress */}
      <div className="space-y-1.5">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
          <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">
            Checklist Subtugas
          </span>
          {total > 0 && (
            <span className="text-muted-foreground font-medium">
              {completed} dari {total} langkah selesai ({progressPercent}%)
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        {total > 0 && (
          <div
            role="progressbar"
            aria-valuenow={progressPercent}
            aria-valuemin={0}
            aria-valuemax={100}
            className="h-1.5 w-full bg-muted rounded-full overflow-hidden"
          >
            <div
              className={`h-full transition-all duration-300 ${
                progressPercent === 100 ? 'bg-emerald-500' : 'bg-primary'
              }`}
              style={{ width: `${progressPercent}%` }}
            />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Read-Only Notice when parent task is completed */}
      {isParentDone && (
        <Alert variant="default" className="py-2 bg-muted/50 border-muted">
          <Info className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
          <AlertDescription className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            Tugas ini telah selesai. Buka kembali tugas untuk mengedit atau menambah subtugas.
          </AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}

      {/* Error Message */}
      {errorMsg && (
        <Alert variant="destructive" className="py-2">
          <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
          <AlertDescription className="text-xs">{errorMsg}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}

      {/* Subtasks List */}
      {isLoading ? (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-4 text-xs text-muted-foreground gap-2">
          <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin text-primary" />
          <span>Memuat checklist...</span>
        </div>
      ) : subtasks.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="text-center py-3 px-4 border border-dashed rounded-lg bg-muted/20 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          Belum ada subtugas. Tambahkan langkah pekerjaan untuk memecah tugas ini.
        </div>
      ) : (
        <ul className="space-y-1.5 max-h-56 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
          {subtasks.map((sub) => {
            const isPending = pendingIds.has(sub.id);
            const isEditing = editingId === sub.id;
            const isConfirmingDelete = confirmDeleteId === sub.id;

            return (
              <li
                key={sub.id}
                className={`flex items-center gap-2 p-2 rounded-lg border text-xs transition-colors ${
                  sub.completed
                    ? 'bg-muted/30 border-muted/50'
                    : 'bg-card border-border hover:bg-muted/20'
                }`}
              >
                {/* Checkbox */}
                <div className="shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center">
                  {isPending ? (
                    <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin text-primary" />
                  ) : (
                    <Checkbox
                      id={`subtask-check-${sub.id}`}
                      checked={sub.completed}
                      disabled={isParentDone || isArchived || isPending}
                      onCheckedChange={() => handleToggle(sub)}
                      aria-label={
                        sub.completed
                          ? `Tandai "${sub.title}" belum selesai`
                          : `Tandai "${sub.title}" selesai`
                      }
                      className="data-[state=checked]:bg-emerald-600 data-[state=checked]:border-emerald-600"
                    />
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Title / Inline Edit */}
                {isEditing ? (
                  <div className="flex-1 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Input
                      value={editingTitle}
                      onChange={(e) => setEditingTitle(e.target.value)}
                      onKeyDown={(e) => {
                        if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                          e.preventDefault();
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleSaveEdit(sub);
                        } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                          e.preventDefault();
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          cancelEdit();
                        }
                      }}
                      disabled={isSavingEdit}
                      className="h-7 text-xs py-1 px-2"
                      autoFocus
                      maxLength={200}
                    />
                    <Button
                      type="button"
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="icon-sm"
                      onClick={() => handleSaveEdit(sub)}
                      disabled={isSavingEdit}
                      className="h-7 w-7 text-emerald-600 hover:text-emerald-700"
                      title="Simpan perubahan"
                      aria-label="Simpan perubahan"
                    >
                      {isSavingEdit ? (
                        <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                      ) : (
                        <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      )}
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      type="button"
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="icon-sm"
                      onClick={cancelEdit}
                      disabled={isSavingEdit}
                      className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
                      title="Batal"
                      aria-label="Batal"
                    >
                      <X className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <span
                      onClick={() => {
                        if (!isParentDone && !isArchived) startEdit(sub);
                      }}
                      className={`block break-words cursor-pointer select-none ${
                        sub.completed
                          ? 'line-through text-muted-foreground'
                          : 'text-foreground'
                      }`}
                      title={!isParentDone && !isArchived ? 'Klik untuk mengedit' : undefined}
                    >
                      {sub.title}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Actions (Edit / Delete) */}
                {!isEditing && !isParentDone && !isArchived && (
                  <div className="shrink-0 flex items-center gap-0.5">
                    {isConfirmingDelete ? (
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-destructive/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-destructive/20 text-[11px]">
                        <span className="text-destructive font-medium">Hapus?</span>
                        <Button
                          type="button"
                          variant="destructive"
                          size="icon-sm"
                          onClick={() => handleDelete(sub.id)}
                          className="h-5 w-5 p-0"
                          title="Ya, hapus"
                          aria-label="Ya, hapus"
                        >
                          <Check className="h-3 w-3" />
                        </Button>
                        <Button
                          type="button"
                          variant="ghost"
                          size="icon-sm"
                          onClick={() => setConfirmDeleteId(null)}
                          className="h-5 w-5 p-0 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
                          title="Batal"
                          aria-label="Batal"
                        >
                          <X className="h-3 w-3" />
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <Button
                          type="button"
                          variant="ghost"
                          size="icon-sm"
                          onClick={() => startEdit(sub)}
                          className="h-6 w-6 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
                          title="Edit subtugas"
                          aria-label={`Edit subtugas "${sub.title}"`}
                        >
                          <Pencil className="h-3 w-3" />
                        </Button>
                        <Button
                          type="button"
                          variant="ghost"
                          size="icon-sm"
                          onClick={() => setConfirmDeleteId(sub.id)}
                          className="h-6 w-6 text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive"
                          title="Hapus subtugas"
                          aria-label={`Hapus subtugas "${sub.title}"`}
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="h-3 w-3" />
                        </Button>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      )}

      {/* Quick Add Form (Hidden when task is completed) */}
      {!isParentDone && !isArchived && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 pt-1">
          <Input
            value={newTitle}
            onChange={(e) => setNewTitle(e.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
                handleAdd();
              }
            }}
            placeholder="Tambah subtugas baru... (tekan Enter)"
            disabled={isAdding || total >= 50}
            maxLength={200}
            className="h-8 text-xs flex-1"
          />
          <Button
            type="button"
            size="sm"
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault();
              e.stopPropagation();
              handleAdd();
            }}
            disabled={!newTitle.trim() || isAdding || total >= 50}
            className="h-8 px-2.5 gap-1 shrink-0 text-xs"
          >
            {isAdding ? (
              <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
            ) : (
              <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            )}
            <span>Tambah</span>
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import * as React from 'react';

export function GoogleLogo({ className = 'h-4 w-4' }: { className?: string }): React.JSX.Element {
  return (
    <svg
      className={className}
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width="18"

      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"

        fill="#4285F4"
      />
      <path
        d="M12 23c2.97 0 5.46-.98 7.28-2.66l-3.57-2.77c-.98.66-2.23 1.06-3.71 1.06-2.86 0-5.29-1.93-6.16-4.53H2.18v2.84C3.99 20.53 7.7 23 12 23z"
        fill="#34A853"
      />
      <path
        d="M5.84 14.09c-.22-.66-.35-1.36-.35-2.09s.13-1.43.35-2.09V7.06H2.18C1.43 8.55 1 10.22 1 12s.43 3.45 1.18 4.94l2.85-2.22.81-.63z"
        fill="#FBBC05"
      />
      <path
        d="M12 5.38c1.62 0 3.06.56 4.21 1.64l3.15-3.15C17.45 2.09 14.97 1 12 1 7.7 1 3.99 3.47 2.18 7.06l3.66 2.84c.87-2.6 3.3-4.52 6.16-4.52z"
        fill="#EA4335"
      />
    </svg>
  );
}

export interface GoogleSignInButtonProps {
  returnUrl?: string | null;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export function GoogleSignInButton({
  returnUrl,
  disabled = false,
}: GoogleSignInButtonProps): React.JSX.Element | null {
  const [isConfigured, setIsConfigured] = React.useState<boolean | null>(null);
  const [isRedirecting, setIsRedirecting] = React.useState(false);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    getGoogleAuthStatus()
      .then((configured) => {
        if (isMounted) setIsConfigured(configured);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (isMounted) setIsConfigured(false);
      });

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, []);

  // When Google auth is not configured, hide the button gracefully
  if (isConfigured === false) {
    return null;
  }

  const handleGoogleClick = () => {
    if (isRedirecting || disabled) return;
    setIsRedirecting(true);

    const targetUrl = new URL('/api/auth/google', window.location.origin);
    if (returnUrl) {
      targetUrl.searchParams.set('returnUrl', returnUrl);
    }

    window.location.href = targetUrl.toString();
  };

  return (
    <Button
      type="button"
      variant="outline"
      onClick={handleGoogleClick}
      disabled={disabled || isRedirecting || isConfigured === null}
      className="w-full h-10 font-medium gap-2.5 bg-background hover:bg-muted/50 border-border text-foreground transition-colors"
      aria-label="Lanjutkan dengan Google"
    >
      {isRedirecting ? (
        <>
          <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin shrink-0 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
          <span>Menghubungkan ke Google...</span>
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          <GoogleLogo />
          <span>Lanjutkan dengan Google</span>
        </>
      )}
    </Button>
  );
}

<file path="apps/web/src/components/auth/turnstile-widget.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import { useTheme } from 'next-themes';

declare global {
  interface Window {
    turnstile?: {
      render: (
        container: string | HTMLElement,
        options: {
          sitekey: string;
          callback?: (token: string) => void;
          'error-callback'?: (errorCode: string) => void;
          'expired-callback'?: () => void;
          theme?: 'light' | 'dark' | 'auto';
          size?: 'normal' | 'compact' | 'flexible';
          action?: string;
        }
      ) => string;
      reset: (widgetId: string) => void;
      remove: (widgetId: string) => void;
    };
    onloadTurnstileCallback?: () => void;
  }
}

export interface TurnstileWidgetProps {
  onVerify: (token: string) => void;
  onExpire?: () => void;
  onError?: (error?: string) => void;
  action?: string;
  className?: string;
}

export interface TurnstileWidgetHandle {
  reset: () => void;
}

export const TurnstileWidget = React.forwardRef<TurnstileWidgetHandle, TurnstileWidgetProps>(
  ({ onVerify, onExpire, onError, action, className }, ref) => {
    const containerRef = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const widgetIdRef = React.useRef<string | null>(null);
    const { resolvedTheme } = useTheme();

    const siteKey =
      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY ||
      // Cloudflare official always-pass testing key fallback
      '1x00000000000000000000AA';

    // Store callbacks in ref to prevent stale closures and avoid re-rendering turnstile
    const onVerifyRef = React.useRef(onVerify);
    onVerifyRef.current = onVerify;

    const onExpireRef = React.useRef(onExpire);
    onExpireRef.current = onExpire;

    const onErrorRef = React.useRef(onError);
    onErrorRef.current = onError;

    const resetWidget = React.useCallback(() => {
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.turnstile && widgetIdRef.current) {
        try {
          window.turnstile.reset(widgetIdRef.current);
        } catch {
          // ignore reset error
        }
      }
    }, []);

    React.useImperativeHandle(
      ref,
      () => ({
        reset: resetWidget,
      }),
      [resetWidget]
    );

    React.useEffect(() => {
      let isMounted = true;

      const renderWidget = () => {
        if (!containerRef.current || !window.turnstile || !isMounted) return;

        // Clean up previous widget if exists
        if (widgetIdRef.current) {
          try {
            window.turnstile.remove(widgetIdRef.current);
          } catch {
            // ignore
          }
          widgetIdRef.current = null;
        }

        try {
          const id = window.turnstile.render(containerRef.current, {
            sitekey: siteKey,
            theme: resolvedTheme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light',
            action,
            size: 'normal',
            callback: (token: string) => {
              if (isMounted) {
                onVerifyRef.current?.(token);
              }
            },
            'expired-callback': () => {
              if (isMounted) {
                onExpireRef.current?.();
              }
            },
            'error-callback': () => {
              if (isMounted) {
                onErrorRef.current?.('Verifikasi keamanan gagal. Silakan coba lagi.');
              }
            },
          });
          widgetIdRef.current = id;
        } catch (e) {
          console.error('[Turnstile Render Error]', e);
        }
      };

      // Ensure Cloudflare Turnstile script is loaded
      const scriptId = 'cf-turnstile-script';
      let script = document.getElementById(scriptId) as HTMLScriptElement | null;

      if (!script) {
        script = document.createElement('script');
        script.id = scriptId;
        script.src = 'https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/api.js?render=explicit';
        script.async = true;
        script.defer = true;
        script.onload = () => {
          if (isMounted) {
            renderWidget();
          }
        };
        document.head.appendChild(script);
      } else if (window.turnstile) {
        renderWidget();
      } else {
        script.addEventListener('load', renderWidget);
      }

      return () => {
        isMounted = false;
        if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.turnstile && widgetIdRef.current) {
          try {
            window.turnstile.remove(widgetIdRef.current);
          } catch {
            // ignore
          }
          widgetIdRef.current = null;
        }
      };
    }, [siteKey, resolvedTheme, action]);

    return (
      <div className={`flex justify-center items-center my-2 min-h-[65px] ${className || ''}`}>
        <div ref={containerRef} data-testid="turnstile-widget" />
      </div>
    );
  }
);

TurnstileWidget.displayName = 'TurnstileWidget';
</file>

interface AgendaViewProps {
  events: CalendarEvent[];
  todayDateStr: string;
  onSelectEvent: (event: CalendarEvent) => void;
  hasSemester: boolean;
  hasCourses: boolean;
}

export function AgendaView({
  events,
  todayDateStr,
  onSelectEvent,
  hasSemester,
  hasCourses,
}: AgendaViewProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const groupedEvents = React.useMemo(() => groupEventsByDate(events), [events]);
  const sortedDates = React.useMemo(() => Object.keys(groupedEvents).sort(), [groupedEvents]);

  if (sortedDates.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full border rounded-xl p-8 bg-card text-center space-y-4">
        <div className="mx-auto w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-muted flex items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground">
          <CalendarDays className="h-6 w-6" />
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-base text-foreground">
            Tidak Ada Agenda pada Periode Ini
          </h3>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground max-w-md mx-auto">
            {!hasSemester
              ? 'Anda belum memiliki semester aktif. Buat atau aktifkan semester terlebih dahulu.'
              : !hasCourses
              ? 'Anda belum memiliki mata kuliah pada semester ini. Tambahkan mata kuliah untuk mulai mengatur jadwal dan tugas.'
              : 'Tidak ada jadwal perkuliahan atau tugas yang jatuh pada rentang waktu yang sedang dilihat.'}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2 pt-2">
          {!hasSemester ? (
            <Button asChild size="sm">
              <Link href="/semesters">Kelola Semester</Link>
            </Button>
          ) : !hasCourses ? (
            <Button asChild size="sm">
              <Link href="/courses">Tambah Mata Kuliah</Link>
            </Button>
          ) : (
            <>
              <Button asChild variant="outline" size="sm" className="gap-1.5">
                <Link href="/schedule">
                  <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  Tambah Jadwal
                </Link>
              </Button>
              <Button asChild size="sm" className="gap-1.5">
                <Link href="/assignments">
                  <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  Tambah Tugas
                </Link>
              </Button>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 w-full">
      {sortedDates.map((dateStr) => {
        const isToday = dateStr === todayDateStr;
        const dayEvents = groupedEvents[dateStr] || [];

        return (
          <div key={dateStr} className="space-y-3">
            {/* Header Tanggal */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 pb-1 border-b">
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground">
                {formatAgendaDateHeader(dateStr)}
              </h3>
              {isToday && (
                <Badge variant="default" className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0 font-semibold shadow-xs">
                  Hari Ini
                </Badge>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* List Agenda */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2.5">
              {dayEvents.map((event) => {
                const isSchedule = event.type === 'SCHEDULE';
                return (
                  <button
                    key={event.id}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => onSelectEvent(event)}
                    className={cn(
                      'w-full text-left p-3.5 sm:p-4 rounded-xl border bg-card hover:bg-accent/40 transition-all shadow-xs flex flex-col gap-2 group focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary',
                      isSchedule
                        ? 'border-l-4 border-l-primary'
                        : event.isOverdue
                        ? 'border-l-4 border-l-destructive'
                        : event.status === 'DONE'
                        ? 'border-l-4 border-l-muted-foreground/40'
                        : 'border-l-4 border-l-amber-500'
                    )}
                  >
                    {/* Top Row: Type Badge + Time */}
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 flex-wrap">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        {isSchedule ? (
                          <Badge
                            variant="outline"
                            className="bg-primary/10 text-primary border-primary/20 text-xs gap-1 font-semibold"
                          >
                            <CalendarClock className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                            Kuliah
                          </Badge>
                        ) : (
                          <Badge
                            variant="outline"
                            className="bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 border-amber-500/20 text-xs gap-1 font-semibold"
                          >
                            <ListTodo className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                            Tugas
                          </Badge>
                        )}
                        {event.courseCode && (
                          <span className="text-xs font-mono text-muted-foreground bg-muted px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">
                            {event.courseCode}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      <span className="text-xs font-mono text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1 font-medium">
                        <Clock className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        {isSchedule ? `${event.startTime} – ${event.endTime}` : `Tenggat: ${event.dueTime}`}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    {/* Middle Row: Title + Course */}
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="font-bold text-sm sm:text-base text-foreground group-hover:text-primary transition-colors">
                        {event.title}
                      </h4>
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-medium mt-0.5">
                        {event.courseName}
                      </p>
                    </div>

                    {/* Bottom Row: Metadata (Room / Status / Priority) */}
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-1 border-t border-border/40 text-xs text-muted-foreground flex-wrap">
                      {isSchedule ? (
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                          {event.room && (
                            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                              <MapPin className="h-3 w-3 text-primary" />
                              {event.room}
                            </span>
                          )}
                          {event.lecturer && (
                            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                              <User className="h-3 w-3 text-primary" />
                              {event.lecturer}
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          {event.priority && (
                            <span>
                              Prioritas:{' '}
                              <strong>
                                {event.priority === 'HIGH'
                                  ? 'Tinggi'
                                  : event.priority === 'MEDIUM'
                                  ? 'Sedang'
                                  : 'Rendah'}
                              </strong>
                            </span>
                          )}
                          {event.isOverdue && (
                            <span className="text-destructive font-semibold flex items-center gap-1">
                              <AlertCircle className="h-3 w-3" />
                              Terlewat
                            </span>
                          )}
                          {event.status === 'DONE' && (
                            <span className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1">
                              <CheckCircle2 className="h-3 w-3" />
                              Selesai
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="apps/web/src/components/calendar/day-events-dialog.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import {
  CalendarClock,
  ListTodo,
  Clock,
  ChevronRight,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { CalendarEvent } from '@studyflow/shared';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { formatAgendaDateHeader } from '@/lib/calendar-utils';

interface DayEventsDialogProps {
  dateStr: string | null;
  events: CalendarEvent[];
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSelectEvent: (event: CalendarEvent) => void;
}

export function DayEventsDialog({
  dateStr,
  events,
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onSelectEvent,
}: DayEventsDialogProps): React.JSX.Element {
  if (!dateStr) return <></>;

  const formattedDate = formatAgendaDateHeader(dateStr);

  return (
    <Dialog open={isOpen} onOpenChange={(open) => !open && onClose()}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-md">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle className="text-lg font-bold">Agenda Harian</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground/80">
            {formattedDate}
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className="space-y-2 max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto py-2 pr-1">
          {events.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="text-center py-6 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Tidak ada jadwal atau tugas pada tanggal ini.
            </div>
          ) : (
            events.map((event) => {
              const isSchedule = event.type === 'SCHEDULE';
              return (
                <button
                  key={event.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    onClose();
                    onSelectEvent(event);
                  }}
                  className="w-full text-left p-3 rounded-lg border bg-card hover:bg-accent/50 transition-colors flex items-center justify-between gap-3 group focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary"

                  <div className="space-y-1 min-w-0">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">

                          Tugas
                        </Badge>
                      )}
                      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1 font-mono">
                        <Clock className="h-3 w-3" />
                        {isSchedule ? `${event.startTime} - ${event.endTime}` : event.dueTime}

                    </div>

                      {event.title}

                      {event.courseName}
                      {event.room && ` • ${event.room}`}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground group-hover:text-foreground shrink-0 transition-transform group-hover:translate-x-0.5" />
                </button>
              );
            })
          )}
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );

          </div>

                  ? `Setiap ${getDayNameId(event.dayOfWeek || 1)} (${formattedDate})`
                  : formattedDate}

                    Pukul {event.startTime} – {event.endTime} ({timezone})
                  </span>

                  <span>
                    Tenggat pukul {event.dueTime} ({timezone})
                  </span>
