'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import { CalendarClock, ListTodo, Clock, Plus } from 'lucide-react';
import { CalendarEvent } from '@studyflow/shared';
import {
  SHORT_DAY_NAMES,
  parseDateString,
  groupEventsByDate,
} from '@/lib/calendar-utils';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';

interface MonthViewProps {
  days: string[]; // List of YYYY-MM-DD strings for the grid
  activeMonth: number; // 1-12
  activeYear: number;
  todayDateStr: string;
  events: CalendarEvent[];
  onSelectEvent: (event: CalendarEvent) => void;
  onOpenDayEvents: (dateStr: string, events: CalendarEvent[]) => void;
}

const MAX_VISIBLE_EVENTS = 3;

export function MonthView({
  days,
  activeMonth,
  activeYear,
  todayDateStr,
  events,
  onSelectEvent,
  onOpenDayEvents,
}: MonthViewProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const groupedEvents = React.useMemo(() => groupEventsByDate(events), [events]);

  return (
    <div className="w-full border rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-card shadow-sm">
      {/* 7-column Day Name Headers (Senin – Minggu) */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-7 border-b bg-muted/60 text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground text-center">
        {SHORT_DAY_NAMES.map((name, index) => (
          <div
            key={name}
            className={cn(
              'py-2.5 px-1 truncate border-r last:border-r-0',
              index >= 5 && 'text-amber-600/80 dark:text-amber-400/80' // Akhir pekan
            )}
          >
            {name}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Grid of days */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-7 auto-rows-fr divide-y divide-border/60">
        {days.map((dateStr, index) => {
          const { year, month, day } = parseDateString(dateStr);
          const isCurrentMonth = month === activeMonth && year === activeYear;
          const isToday = dateStr === todayDateStr;
          const dayEvents = groupedEvents[dateStr] || [];
          const visibleEvents = dayEvents.slice(0, MAX_VISIBLE_EVENTS);
          const remainingCount = dayEvents.length - MAX_VISIBLE_EVENTS;

          return (
            <div
              key={dateStr}
              className={cn(
                'min-h-[110px] p-1.5 flex flex-col justify-between border-r last:border-r-0 transition-colors',
                !isCurrentMonth ? 'bg-muted/30 text-muted-foreground/50' : 'bg-card text-foreground',
                isToday && 'bg-primary/5 dark:bg-primary/10'
              )}
            >
              {/* Header: Tanggal & Indikator Hari Ini */}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1 px-1">
                <span
                  className={cn(
                    'text-xs font-semibold inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-full h-6 w-6',
                    isToday
                      ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground font-bold shadow-xs'
                      : !isCurrentMonth
                      ? 'text-muted-foreground/60'
                      : 'text-foreground'
                  )}
                >
                  {day}
                </span>

                {dayEvents.length > 0 && (
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-muted-foreground hidden sm:inline">
                    {dayEvents.length}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Event Chips List */}
              <div className="flex-1 space-y-1 overflow-hidden">
                {visibleEvents.map((event) => {
                  const isSchedule = event.type === 'SCHEDULE';
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={event.id}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => onSelectEvent(event)}
                      title={`${event.title} (${isSchedule ? `${event.startTime} - ${event.endTime}` : `Tenggat ${event.dueTime}`})`}
                      className={cn(
                        'w-full text-left rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-medium truncate flex items-center gap-1 transition-all border focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary',
                        isSchedule
                          ? 'bg-primary/10 text-primary border-primary/20 hover:bg-primary/20'
                          : event.isOverdue
                          ? 'bg-destructive/10 text-destructive border-destructive/20 hover:bg-destructive/20'
                          : event.status === 'DONE'
                          ? 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground border-border hover:bg-muted/80 line-through'
                          : 'bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 border-amber-500/20 hover:bg-amber-500/20'
                      )}
                    >
                      {isSchedule ? (
                        <CalendarClock className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0" />
                      ) : (
                        <ListTodo className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0" />
                      )}
                      <span className="shrink-0 font-mono text-[10px]">
                        {isSchedule ? event.startTime : event.dueTime}
                      </span>
                      <span className="truncate">{event.title}</span>
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>

              {/* "+N lainnya" button */}
              {remainingCount > 0 && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onOpenDayEvents(dateStr, dayEvents)}
                  className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-primary hover:text-primary/80 font-semibold px-1 py-0.5 rounded hover:bg-primary/10 text-left transition-colors flex items-center gap-0.5"
                >
                  <Plus className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />
                  {remainingCount} lainnya
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

<file path="apps/web/src/components/dashboard/dashboard-charts.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import {
  Area,
  AreaChart,
  Bar,
  BarChart,
  CartesianGrid,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
} from 'recharts';
import {
  Activity,
  BookOpen,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertCircle,
  HelpCircle,
  ArrowRight,
  Loader2,
  RefreshCw,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  DashboardChartsResponse,
  DashboardChartPeriod,
  ActivityBucket,
} from '@studyflow/shared';
import { getDashboardCharts } from '@/lib/dashboard-client';
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/card';
import {
  ChartContainer,
  ChartLegend,
  ChartLegendContent,
  ChartTooltip,
  ChartTooltipContent,
  type ChartConfig,
} from '@/components/ui/chart';
import {
  RadixSelect as Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Alert, AlertDescription, AlertTitle } from '@/components/ui/alert';
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';

const activityChartConfig = {
  tasksCompleted: {
    label: 'Tugas selesai',
    color: 'var(--chart-1)',
  },
  quizzesCompleted: {
    label: 'Kuis selesai',
    color: 'var(--chart-2)',
  },
} satisfies ChartConfig;

const workloadChartConfig = {
  pendingTasks: {
    label: 'Tugas belum selesai',
    color: 'var(--chart-4)',
  },
} satisfies ChartConfig;

interface DashboardChartsProps {
  activeSemesterId?: string | null;
  refreshTrigger?: number;
}

export function DashboardCharts({
  activeSemesterId,
  refreshTrigger = 0,
}: DashboardChartsProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [period, setPeriod] = React.useState<DashboardChartPeriod>('30d');
  const [chartsData, setChartsData] = React.useState<DashboardChartsResponse | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = React.useState(true);
  const [isRefreshing, setIsRefreshing] = React.useState(false);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showAccessibleTable, setShowAccessibleTable] = React.useState(false);
  const [prefersReducedMotion, setPrefersReducedMotion] = React.useState(false);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    const mediaQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
    setPrefersReducedMotion(mediaQuery.matches);
    const handler = (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => setPrefersReducedMotion(e.matches);
    mediaQuery.addEventListener('change', handler);
    return () => mediaQuery.removeEventListener('change', handler);
  }, []);

  const fetchIdRef = React.useRef(0);

  const loadCharts = React.useCallback(
    async (silent = false) => {
      const currentRequestId = ++fetchIdRef.current;
      if (silent) {
        setIsRefreshing(true);
      } else {
        setIsLoading(true);
      }
      setErrorMsg(null);

      try {
        const data = await getDashboardCharts({
          period,
          semesterId: activeSemesterId || undefined,
        });
        if (currentRequestId === fetchIdRef.current) {
          setChartsData(data);
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        if (currentRequestId === fetchIdRef.current) {
          setErrorMsg(err.message || 'Gagal memuat data grafik dashboard.');
        }
      } finally {
        if (currentRequestId === fetchIdRef.current) {
          setIsLoading(false);
          setIsRefreshing(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [period, activeSemesterId]
  );

  React.useEffect(() => {
    loadCharts(false);
  }, [loadCharts, refreshTrigger]);

  // Semester change listener
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleSemesterChange = () => {
      loadCharts(true);
    };
    window.addEventListener('studyflow:semester-changed', handleSemesterChange);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('studyflow:semester-changed', handleSemesterChange);
    };
  }, [loadCharts]);

  const handleBarClick = (courseId: string) => {
    if (courseId) {
      router.push(`/assignments?courseId=${encodeURIComponent(courseId)}`);
    }
  };

  // 1. Error state (terisolasi, tidak memblokir widget dashboard lain)
  if (errorMsg) {
    return (
      <Card className="rounded-xl border border-destructive/20 bg-card p-6 shadow-xs">
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
          <AlertTitle>Gagal memuat grafik aktivitas</AlertTitle>
          <AlertDescription className="flex items-center justify-between mt-1">
            <span className="text-sm">{errorMsg}</span>
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => loadCharts(false)}
              className="h-8 gap-1.5 text-xs shrink-0"
            >
              <RefreshCw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              <span>Coba lagi</span>
            </Button>
          </AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      </Card>
    );
  }

  // 2. Loading Skeleton
  if (isLoading && !chartsData) {
    return (
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:gap-6 w-full">
        <Card className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-5 shadow-xs">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-border">
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <Skeleton className="h-5 w-40" />
              <Skeleton className="h-3.5 w-56" />
            </div>
            <Skeleton className="h-9 w-32 rounded-lg" />
          </div>
          <div className="pt-6">
            <Skeleton className="h-[250px] w-full rounded-lg" />
          </div>
        </Card>
        <Card className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-5 shadow-xs">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-border">
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <Skeleton className="h-5 w-36" />
              <Skeleton className="h-3.5 w-48" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="pt-6">
            <Skeleton className="h-[250px] w-full rounded-lg" />
          </div>
        </Card>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const activity = chartsData?.activityChart;
  const workload = chartsData?.workloadChart;

  const totalActivities =
    (activity?.totalTasksCompleted || 0) + (activity?.totalQuizzesCompleted || 0);

  // Hitung tinggi chart beban tugas dinamis agar tidak memotong mata kuliah
  const courseCount = workload?.items.length || 0;
  const workloadChartHeight = Math.max(220, Math.min(courseCount * 44 + 40, 480));

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4 sm:space-y-6">
      {/* Tombol aksesibilitas untuk melihat tabel angka */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-end">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setShowAccessibleTable((prev) => !prev)}
          className="text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground underline transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          aria-expanded={showAccessibleTable}
        >
          {showAccessibleTable ? 'Sembunyikan tabel ringkasan angka' : 'Tampilkan tabel ringkasan angka'}
        </button>
      </div>

      {showAccessibleTable && chartsData && (
        <Card className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-4 sm:p-5 shadow-xs">
          <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground mb-2">
            Tabel Ringkasan Aktivitas Belajar ({chartsData.semesterName || 'Semester Aktif'})
          </h3>
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-left text-xs border-collapse">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-border text-muted-foreground">
                  <th className="py-2 pr-4 font-medium">Periode</th>
                  <th className="py-2 px-4 font-medium text-right">Tugas Selesai</th>
                  <th className="py-2 px-4 font-medium text-right">Kuis Selesai</th>
                  <th className="py-2 pl-4 font-medium text-right">Total Aktivitas</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-border/60">
                {activity?.items.map((item: ActivityBucket) => (
                  <tr key={item.date} className="hover:bg-muted/30">
                    <td className="py-2 pr-4 text-foreground font-medium">{item.fullDateLabel}</td>
                    <td className="py-2 px-4 text-right tabular-nums">{item.tasksCompleted}</td>
                    <td className="py-2 px-4 text-right tabular-nums">{item.quizzesCompleted}</td>
                    <td className="py-2 pl-4 text-right font-semibold tabular-nums">
                      {item.tasksCompleted + item.quizzesCompleted}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </Card>
      )}

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:gap-6 w-full">
        {/* =========================================================================
            CHART 1: AKTIVITAS BELAJAR (INTERACTIVE AREA CHART)
           ========================================================================= */}
        <Card className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-card shadow-xs flex flex-col justify-between">
          <div>
            <CardHeader className="flex flex-col gap-2 space-y-0 border-b border-border py-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between sm:py-4.5">
              <div className="grid flex-1 gap-1">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Activity className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                  <CardTitle className="text-base sm:text-lg font-semibold text-foreground">
                    Aktivitas Belajar
                  </CardTitle>
                  {isRefreshing && <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin text-primary ml-1" />}
                </div>
                <CardDescription className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  {period === '7d'
                    ? '7 hari terakhir'
                    : period === '30d'
                    ? '30 hari terakhir'
                    : '3 bulan terakhir (mingguan)'}
                  {' • '}
                  <span className="font-medium text-foreground">
                    {totalActivities} aktivitas selesai
                  </span>
                </CardDescription>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Select
                  value={period}
                  onValueChange={(val) => setPeriod(val as DashboardChartPeriod)}
                >
                  <SelectTrigger
                    className="w-[140px] sm:w-[150px] h-9 text-xs rounded-lg"
                    aria-label="Pilih periode aktivitas belajar"
                  >
                    <SelectValue placeholder="30 hari terakhir" />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent className="rounded-xl">
                    <SelectItem value="7d" className="rounded-lg text-xs">
                      7 hari terakhir
                    </SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem value="30d" className="rounded-lg text-xs">
                      30 hari terakhir
                    </SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem value="3m" className="rounded-lg text-xs">
                      3 bulan terakhir
                    </SelectItem>
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>
            </CardHeader>

            <CardContent className="px-2 pt-4 sm:px-5 sm:pt-5">
              {!activity || activity.items.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-12 text-center text-muted-foreground">
                  <Activity className="h-8 w-8 text-muted-foreground/50 mb-2" />
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
                    Belum ada riwayat aktivitas belajar
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5 max-w-xs">
                    Selesaikan tugas kuliah atau kerjakan kuis materi untuk mencatat kemajuan belajar.
                  </p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <ChartContainer
                  config={activityChartConfig}
                  className="aspect-auto h-[240px] sm:h-[280px] w-full"
                >
                  <AreaChart data={activity.items} margin={{ top: 8, right: 12, left: -16, bottom: 0 }}>
                    <defs>
                      <linearGradient id="fillTasksCompleted" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                        <stop offset="5%" stopColor="var(--chart-1)" stopOpacity={0.4} />
                        <stop offset="95%" stopColor="var(--chart-1)" stopOpacity={0.0} />
                      </linearGradient>
                      <linearGradient id="fillQuizzesCompleted" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                        <stop offset="5%" stopColor="var(--chart-2)" stopOpacity={0.4} />
                        <stop offset="95%" stopColor="var(--chart-2)" stopOpacity={0.0} />
                      </linearGradient>
                    </defs>
                    <CartesianGrid vertical={false} strokeDasharray="3 3" />
                    <XAxis
                      dataKey="label"
                      tickLine={false}
                      axisLine={false}
                      tickMargin={8}
                      minTickGap={24}
                    />
                    <YAxis
                      allowDecimals={false}
                      tickLine={false}
                      axisLine={false}
                      tickMargin={4}
                      domain={[0, 'auto']}
                    />
                    <ChartTooltip
                      cursor={{ stroke: 'var(--border)', strokeWidth: 1, strokeDasharray: '3 3' }}
                      content={
                        <ChartTooltipContent
                          labelFormatter={(_, payload) => {
                            const item = payload?.[0]?.payload;
                            return item?.fullDateLabel || '';
                          }}
                          indicator="dot"
                        />
                      }
                    />
                    <Area
                      dataKey="tasksCompleted"
                      name="Tugas selesai"
                      type="monotone"
                      fill="url(#fillTasksCompleted)"
                      fillOpacity={0.8}
                      stroke="var(--chart-1)"
                      strokeWidth={2}
                      isAnimationActive={!prefersReducedMotion}
                    />
                    <Area
                      dataKey="quizzesCompleted"
                      name="Kuis selesai"
                      type="monotone"
                      fill="url(#fillQuizzesCompleted)"
                      fillOpacity={0.8}
                      stroke="var(--chart-2)"
                      strokeWidth={2}
                      isAnimationActive={!prefersReducedMotion}
                    />
                    <ChartLegend content={<ChartLegendContent />} />
                  </AreaChart>
                </ChartContainer>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </div>

          <div className="px-4 py-2.5 sm:px-5 border-t border-border/80 bg-muted/20 rounded-b-xl">
            <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <HelpCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground/80" />
              <span>
                Satu tugas dihitung maksimal 1x pada penyelesaian pertama. Kuis dihitung per attempt yang disubmit final.
              </span>
            </p>
          </div>
        </Card>

        {/* =========================================================================
            CHART 2: BEBAN TUGAS PER MATA KULIAH (HORIZONTAL BAR CHART)
           ========================================================================= */}
        <Card className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-card shadow-xs flex flex-col justify-between">
          <div>
            <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between pb-3.5 border-b border-border py-4 sm:py-4.5">
              <div className="grid gap-1">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <BookOpen className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                  <CardTitle className="text-base sm:text-lg font-semibold text-foreground">
                    Beban Tugas
                  </CardTitle>
                </div>
                <CardDescription className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  Jumlah tugas belum selesai per mata kuliah semester ini
                  {' • '}
                  <span className="font-medium text-foreground">
                    {workload?.totalPendingTasks || 0} tugas tersisa
                  </span>
                </CardDescription>
              </div>

              <Button
                variant="ghost"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => router.push('/assignments')}
                className="h-8 px-2 text-xs gap-1 text-primary hover:text-primary"
              >
                <span>Kelola tugas</span>
                <ArrowRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              </Button>
            </CardHeader>

            <CardContent className="px-2 pt-4 sm:px-5 sm:pt-5">
              {!workload || workload.items.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-12 text-center text-muted-foreground">
                  <BookOpen className="h-8 w-8 text-muted-foreground/50 mb-2" />
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
                    Belum ada mata kuliah aktif di semester ini
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5 max-w-xs">
                    Tambahkan mata kuliah untuk mulai melacak tugas dan materi perkuliahan.
                  </p>
                </div>
              ) : workload.totalPendingTasks === 0 ? (
                <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-12 text-center text-muted-foreground">
                  <div className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-success/20 text-success-foreground mb-2">
                    <CheckCircle2 className="h-5 w-5" />
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">
                    Semua tugas selesai!
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5 max-w-xs">
                    Tidak ada tugas pending atau tertunda pada seluruh mata kuliah di semester ini.
                  </p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="overflow-y-auto max-h-[360px] pr-1">
                  <ChartContainer
                    config={workloadChartConfig}
                    className="w-full"
                    style={{ height: `${workloadChartHeight}px` }}
                  >
                    <BarChart
                      data={workload.items}
                      layout="vertical"
                      margin={{ top: 8, right: 24, left: 10, bottom: 8 }}
                    >
                      <CartesianGrid horizontal={false} strokeDasharray="3 3" />
                      <XAxis
                        type="number"
                        allowDecimals={false}
                        tickLine={false}
                        axisLine={false}
                        domain={[0, 'auto']}
                      />
                      <YAxis
                        type="category"
                        dataKey="courseName"
                        tickLine={false}
                        axisLine={false}
                        width={160}
                        tick={({ x, y, payload }: any) => {
                          const text = String(payload?.value || '');
                          const truncated =
                            text.length > 24 ? `${text.slice(0, 23)}…` : text;
                          return (
                            <g transform={`translate(${x},${y})`}>
                              <text
                                x={-8}
                                y={3}
                                textAnchor="end"
                                className="text-[11px] fill-foreground font-medium hover:fill-primary cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                              >
                                <title>{text}</title>
                                {truncated}
                              </text>
                            </g>
                          );
                        }}
                      />
                      <ChartTooltip
                        cursor={{ fill: 'var(--muted)', opacity: 0.3 }}
                        content={
                          <ChartTooltipContent
                            formatter={(value, name, item) => (
                              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 w-full">
                                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                                  {item?.payload?.courseName}
                                </span>
                                <span className="font-semibold text-xs tabular-nums text-foreground">
                                  {value} tugas
                                </span>
                              </div>
                            )}
                            indicator="dot"
                          />
                        }
                      />
                      <Bar
                        dataKey="pendingTasks"
                        name="Tugas belum selesai"
                        fill="var(--chart-4)"
                        radius={[0, 4, 4, 0]}
                        maxBarSize={22}
                        className="cursor-pointer hover:opacity-85 transition-opacity"
                        onClick={(entry: any) => {
                          const courseId = entry?.courseId || entry?.payload?.courseId;
                          if (courseId) handleBarClick(courseId);
                        }}
                      />
                    </BarChart>
                  </ChartContainer>
                </div>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </div>

          <div className="px-4 py-2.5 sm:px-5 border-t border-border/80 bg-muted/20 rounded-b-xl flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            <span className="truncate">
              Klik pada bar mata kuliah untuk membuka daftar tugas terkait.
            </span>
            <span className="font-medium shrink-0 ml-2">Urutan beban terbanyak</span>
          </div>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/components/dashboard/pinned-items-modal.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import {
  Pin,
  FileText,
  Edit3,
  ExternalLink,
  Loader2,
  AlertCircle,
  PinOff,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { PinnedItemDetail, formatUserDateTime } from '@studyflow/shared';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from '@/components/ui/alert';

interface PinnedItemsModalProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  items: PinnedItemDetail[];
  onUnpinItem: (item: PinnedItemDetail) => Promise<void>;
  unpinningId: string | null;
  timezone?: string;
}

export function PinnedItemsModal({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  items,
  onUnpinItem,
  unpinningId,
  timezone = 'Asia/Jakarta',
}: PinnedItemsModalProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const [localError, setLocalError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleUnpin = async (item: PinnedItemDetail) => {
    setLocalError(null);
    try {
      await onUnpinItem(item);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setLocalError(err.message || 'Gagal melepas sematan item');
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-xl max-h-[85vh] flex flex-col p-0 gap-0 overflow-hidden">
        <DialogHeader className="p-5 sm:p-6 pb-3 border-b border-border">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary/10 text-primary">
              <Pin className="h-4 w-4 fill-current" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <DialogTitle className="text-base sm:text-lg font-semibold text-foreground">
                Semua Item Disematkan
              </DialogTitle>
              <DialogDescription className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                Daftar lengkap materi dan catatan penting yang Anda sematkan ({items.length} item)
              </DialogDescription>
            </div>
          </div>
        </DialogHeader>

        {localError && (
          <div className="px-5 pt-3">
            <Alert variant="destructive" className="py-2 text-xs">
              <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
              <AlertDescription>{localError}</AlertDescription>
            </Alert>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-5 sm:p-6 space-y-2.5 divide-y divide-border/60">
          {items.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="py-8 text-center text-muted-foreground">
              <PinOff className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground/50 mx-auto mb-2" />
              <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">Belum ada item yang disematkan</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                Sematkan materi atau catatan dari halaman masing-masing.
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            items.map((item) => {
              const isUnpinning = unpinningId === item.id;
              const href =
                item.type === 'MATERIAL'
                  ? `/materials/${item.targetId}`
                  : `/notes/${item.targetId}`;

              return (
                <div
                  key={item.id}
                  className="pt-2.5 first:pt-0 flex items-start justify-between gap-3 group"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <div className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground group-hover:text-primary transition-colors">
                      {item.type === 'MATERIAL' ? (
                        <FileText className="h-4 w-4" />
                      ) : (
                        <Edit3 className="h-4 w-4" />
                      )}
                    </div>

                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <Link
                        href={href}
                        onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
                        className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground hover:text-primary transition-colors block truncate"
                        title={item.title}
                      >
                        {item.title}
                      </Link>

                      <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        <Badge
                          variant={item.type === 'MATERIAL' ? 'secondary' : 'outline'}
                          className="text-[10px] py-0 px-1.5 font-normal"
                        >
                          {item.type === 'MATERIAL' ? 'Materi' : 'Catatan'}
                        </Badge>

                        {item.isGeneralNote ? (
                          <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] py-0 px-1.5 text-muted-foreground">
                            Catatan Umum
                          </Badge>
                        ) : item.courseName ? (
                          <span className="truncate max-w-[180px] font-medium text-foreground/80">
                            {item.courseName}
                          </span>
                        ) : null}

                        <span>•</span>
                        <span className="text-[11px]">
                          Disematkan {formatUserDateTime(item.pinnedAt, timezone)}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0 self-center">
                    <Button
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="sm"
                      asChild
                      className="h-8 px-2 text-xs"
                      onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
                    >
                      <Link href={href}>
                        <span>Buka</span>
                        <ExternalLink className="ml-1 h-3 w-3" />
                      </Link>
                    </Button>

                    <Button
                      variant="outline"
                      size="sm"
                      onClick={() => handleUnpin(item)}
                      disabled={isUnpinning}
                      className="h-8 px-2.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive hover:border-destructive/40"
                      title="Lepas sematan"
                      aria-label={`Lepas sematan untuk ${item.title}`}
                    >
                      {isUnpinning ? (
                        <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                      ) : (
                        <PinOff className="h-3.5 w-3.5 mr-1 text-muted-foreground" />
                      )}
                      <span>Lepas</span>
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })
          )}
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/components/dashboard/pinned-items-widget.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import {
  Pin,
  FileText,
  Edit3,
  ArrowRight,
  RefreshCw,
  AlertCircle,
  PinOff,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { PinnedItemDetail, formatUserDateTime } from '@studyflow/shared';
import { listPinnedItems, pinMaterial, pinNote } from '@/lib/pin-client';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from '@/components/ui/alert';
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';
import { PinnedItemsModal } from './pinned-items-modal';

interface PinnedItemsWidgetProps {
  activeSemesterId?: string | null;
  timezone?: string;
  className?: string;
}

export function PinnedItemsWidget({
  activeSemesterId,
  timezone = 'Asia/Jakarta',
  className = '',
}: PinnedItemsWidgetProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const [items, setItems] = React.useState<PinnedItemDetail[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = React.useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const [unpinningId, setUnpinningId] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  // Guard against race condition on semester switches
  const fetchRequestIdRef = React.useRef(0);

  const loadPinnedItems = React.useCallback(async () => {
    const requestId = ++fetchRequestIdRef.current;
    setIsLoading(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const data = await listPinnedItems(activeSemesterId || undefined);
      // Discard stale responses if a newer semester fetch was triggered
      if (requestId === fetchRequestIdRef.current) {
        setItems(data.items);
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (requestId === fetchRequestIdRef.current) {
        setError(err.message || 'Gagal memuat item yang disematkan');
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }, [activeSemesterId]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    loadPinnedItems();
  }, [loadPinnedItems]);

  const handleUnpin = async (item: PinnedItemDetail) => {
    setUnpinningId(item.id);
    try {
      if (item.type === 'MATERIAL') {
        await pinMaterial(item.targetId, false);
      } else {
        await pinNote(item.targetId, false);
      }
      setItems((prev) => prev.filter((i) => i.id !== item.id));
    } finally {
      setUnpinningId(null);
    }
  };

  const displayedItems = items.slice(0, 6);

  return (
    <div
      className={`rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-xs flex flex-col justify-between w-full ${className}`}
    >
      <div>
        {/* Header Widget */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3.5 border-b border-border">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Pin className="h-4 w-4 text-primary fill-primary" />
            <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">Disematkan</h2>
            {items.length > 0 && (
              <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs ml-1 font-medium">
                {items.length}
              </Badge>
            )}
          </div>

          {items.length > 6 && (
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(true)}
              className="text-xs h-7 px-2.5"
            >
              Tampilkan semua ({items.length})
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Content View */}
        <div className="mt-2.5">
          {isLoading ? (
            <div className="space-y-3 py-2">
              {Array.from({ length: 3 }).map((_, i) => (
                <div key={i} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 py-2">
                  <div className="space-y-1.5 flex-1">
                    <Skeleton className="h-4 w-3/4" />
                    <Skeleton className="h-3 w-1/2" />
                  </div>
                  <Skeleton className="h-7 w-14" />
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : error ? (
            <Alert variant="destructive" className="my-2 py-3 text-xs">
              <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between w-full">
                <AlertDescription>{error}</AlertDescription>
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={loadPinnedItems}
                  className="h-7 px-2 text-xs ml-2 gap-1 bg-background text-foreground"
                >
                  <RefreshCw className="h-3 w-3" />
                  <span>Coba lagi</span>
                </Button>
              </div>
            </Alert>
          ) : items.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-5 sm:py-6 text-center text-muted-foreground">
              <PinOff className="h-5 w-5 text-muted-foreground/60 mb-1.5" />
              <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
                Belum ada materi atau catatan disematkan
              </p>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5 max-w-sm">
                Sematkan materi atau catatan penting agar langsung dapat diakses dari dashboard.
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="divide-y divide-border/60">
              {displayedItems.map((item) => {
                const href =
                  item.type === 'MATERIAL'
                    ? `/materials/${item.targetId}`
                    : `/notes/${item.targetId}`;

                return (
                  <div
                    key={item.id}
                    className="py-2.5 first:pt-1 last:pb-1 flex items-start justify-between gap-2.5 group"
                  >
                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 pr-1">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground shrink-0">
                          {item.type === 'MATERIAL' ? (
                            <FileText className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                          ) : (
                            <Edit3 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                          )}
                        </span>
                        <Link
                          href={href}
                          className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground hover:text-primary transition-colors block truncate"
                          title={item.title}
                        >
                          {item.title}
                        </Link>
                      </div>

                      <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        <Badge
                          variant={item.type === 'MATERIAL' ? 'secondary' : 'outline'}
                          className="text-[10px] py-0 px-1 font-normal"
                        >
                          {item.type === 'MATERIAL' ? 'Materi' : 'Catatan'}
                        </Badge>

                        {item.isGeneralNote ? (
                          <Badge
                            variant="outline"
                            className="text-[10px] py-0 px-1 text-muted-foreground"
                          >
                            Catatan Umum
                          </Badge>
                        ) : item.courseName ? (
                          <span className="truncate max-w-[160px] sm:max-w-[240px] font-medium text-foreground/80">
                            {item.courseName}
                          </span>
                        ) : null}

                        <span>•</span>
                        <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground/80">
                          {formatUserDateTime(item.pinnedAt, timezone)}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <Button
                      asChild
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="sm"
                      className="h-7 px-2 text-xs shrink-0 self-center"
                    >
                      <Link href={href}>
                        Buka
                        <ArrowRight className="ml-1 h-3 w-3" />
                      </Link>
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Footer Link if <= 6 but has items */}
      {!isLoading && !error && items.length > 0 && items.length <= 6 && (
        <div className="mt-3 pt-2.5 border-t border-border">
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(true)}
            className="w-full justify-between text-xs px-2 h-8 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
          >
            <span>Kelola Sematan ({items.length})</span>
            <ArrowRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Full Modal */}
      <PinnedItemsModal
        open={isModalOpen}
        onOpenChange={setIsModalOpen}
        items={items}
        onUnpinItem={handleUnpin}
        unpinningId={unpinningId}
        timezone={timezone}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/components/materials/material-pdf-viewer.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import {
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  ZoomIn,
  ZoomOut,
  Download,
  ExternalLink,
  RefreshCw,
  AlertCircle,
  Loader2,
  FileText,
  Maximize2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/card';

interface MaterialPdfViewerProps {
  materialTitle: string;
  previewUrl: string | null;
  totalPages: number;
  currentPage: number;
  onPageChange: (page: number) => void;
  zoom: number;
  onZoomChange: (zoom: number) => void;
  isLoading: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  onRefreshSignedUrl: () => void;
  onDownload: () => void;
  highlightedPage?: number | null;
}

export function MaterialPdfViewer({
  materialTitle,
  previewUrl,
  totalPages,
  currentPage,
  onPageChange,
  zoom,
  onZoomChange,
  isLoading,
  error,
  onRefreshSignedUrl,
  onDownload,
  highlightedPage,
}: MaterialPdfViewerProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const [pageInput, setPageInput] = React.useState<string>(String(currentPage));

  React.useEffect(() => {
    setPageInput(String(currentPage));
  }, [currentPage]);

  const handlePageInputCommit = () => {
    const val = parseInt(pageInput, 10);
    if (!isNaN(val) && val >= 1 && val <= totalPages) {
      onPageChange(val);
    } else {
      setPageInput(String(currentPage));
    }
  };

  const handleOpenInNewTab = () => {
    if (previewUrl) {
      window.open(previewUrl, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
    }
  };

  if (error) {
    return (
      <Card className="border border-border/80 bg-card p-6 sm:p-10 text-center">
        <div className="mx-auto flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">
          <AlertCircle className="h-6 w-6" />
        </div>
        <h4 className="mt-3 text-base font-semibold text-foreground">
          Pratinjau Dokumen Belum Dapat Ditampilkan
        </h4>
        <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs sm:text-sm text-muted-foreground max-w-md mx-auto leading-relaxed">
          {error}
        </p>
        <div className="mt-5 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2.5">
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="standard"
            onClick={onRefreshSignedUrl}
            className="gap-1.5 text-xs"
          >
            <RefreshCw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            <span>Muat Ulang Tautan</span>
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="default"
            size="standard"
            onClick={onDownload}
            className="gap-1.5 text-xs"
          >
            <Download className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            <span>Unduh Berkas Langsung</span>
          </Button>
        </div>
      </Card>
    );
  }

  if (!previewUrl && !isLoading) {
    return (
      <Card className="border border-dashed border-border bg-card/60 p-8 sm:p-12 text-center">
        <div className="mx-auto flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-muted text-muted-foreground">
          <FileText className="h-5 w-5" />
        </div>
        <h4 className="mt-3 text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">
          Pratinjau Dokumen Sedang Dipersiapkan
        </h4>
        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground max-w-md mx-auto">
          Klik tombol di bawah untuk memuat tautan pratinjau dokumen PDF yang aman.
        </p>
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          size="standard"
          onClick={onRefreshSignedUrl}
          className="mt-4 gap-1.5 text-xs"
        >
          <RefreshCw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          <span>Muat Pratinjau</span>
        </Button>
      </Card>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2.5">
      {/* Banner informasi saat melompat ke halaman sumber */}
      {highlightedPage && (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-lg border border-primary/30 bg-primary/5 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs text-primary animate-in fade-in duration-200">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="flex h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-primary" />
            <span>
              Menampilkan sumber rujukan: <strong>Halaman {highlightedPage}</strong>
            </span>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={() => onPageChange(highlightedPage)}
            className="text-[11px] underline hover:opacity-80 font-medium"
          >
            Fokus halaman
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Frame Reader Utama */}
      <Card className="overflow-hidden border border-border bg-card shadow-xs">
        {/* Toolbar Kontrol Pembaca */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-border bg-muted/30 px-3 py-2 text-xs">
          {/* Sisi Kiri: Navigasi Halaman */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="icon-sm"
              disabled={currentPage <= 1 || isLoading}
              onClick={() => onPageChange(Math.max(1, currentPage - 1))}
              className="h-8 w-8 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
              title="Halaman Sebelumnya"
              aria-label="Halaman Sebelumnya"
            >
              <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
            </Button>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-1 font-medium text-muted-foreground text-xs">
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">Hal</span>
              <input
                type="number"
                min={1}
                max={totalPages}
                value={pageInput}
                onChange={(e) => setPageInput(e.target.value)}
                onBlur={handlePageInputCommit}
                onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && handlePageInputCommit()}
                className="w-12 h-7 text-center rounded-md border border-input bg-background text-foreground text-xs font-semibold focus-visible:outline-hidden focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-primary"
                aria-label="Nomor halaman PDF saat ini"
              />
              <span>/ {totalPages}</span>
            </div>

            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="icon-sm"
              disabled={currentPage >= totalPages || isLoading}
              onClick={() => onPageChange(Math.min(totalPages, currentPage + 1))}
              className="h-8 w-8 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
              title="Halaman Selanjutnya"
              aria-label="Halaman Selanjutnya"
            >
              <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
            </Button>
          </div>

          {/* Sisi Tengah: Kontrol Pembesaran (Zoom) */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="icon-sm"
              onClick={() => onZoomChange(Math.max(50, zoom - 15))}
              disabled={zoom <= 50 || isLoading}
              className="h-8 w-8 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
              title="Perkecil Tampilan"
              aria-label="Perkecil Zoom"
            >
              <ZoomOut className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </Button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onZoomChange(100)}
              className="h-7 px-2 text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors rounded hover:bg-accent"
              title="Kembalikan ke 100%"
              aria-label="Reset zoom ke 100%"
            >
              {zoom}%
            </button>

            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="icon-sm"
              onClick={() => onZoomChange(Math.min(200, zoom + 15))}
              disabled={zoom >= 200 || isLoading}
              className="h-8 w-8 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
              title="Perbesar Tampilan"
              aria-label="Perbesar Zoom"
            >
              <ZoomIn className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </Button>
          </div>

          {/* Sisi Kanan: Quick Actions */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 ml-auto sm:ml-0">
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"
              onClick={onRefreshSignedUrl}
              className="h-8 px-2 text-xs gap-1 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
              title="Perbarui tautan jika kedaluwarsa"
              aria-label="Perbarui tautan dokumen"
            >
              <RefreshCw className="h-3 w-3" />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">Perbarui</span>
            </Button>

            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"
              onClick={handleOpenInNewTab}
              className="h-8 px-2 text-xs gap-1 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
              title="Buka dokumen di tab baru browser"
              aria-label="Buka dokumen di tab baru"
            >
              <ExternalLink className="h-3 w-3" />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">Tab Baru</span>
            </Button>

            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={onDownload}
              className="h-8 px-2.5 text-xs gap-1.5"
              aria-label="Unduh berkas asli"
            >
              <Download className="h-3 w-3" />
              <span>Unduh</span>
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Viewport Iframe PDF */}
        <div className="relative h-[620px] sm:h-[800px] lg:h-[860px] w-full bg-muted/15">
          {isLoading && (
            <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-background/60 backdrop-blur-xs z-10 gap-2">
              <Loader2 className="h-7 w-7 animate-spin text-primary" />
              <span className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">
                Memuat pratinjau halaman...
              </span>
            </div>
          )}

          {previewUrl && (
            <iframe
              key={`${previewUrl}-${currentPage}-${zoom}`}
              src={`${previewUrl}#page=${currentPage}&zoom=${zoom}`}
              className="h-full w-full border-none"
              title={`Pratinjau PDF: ${materialTitle}`}
            />
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Footer Ringkas */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-border bg-muted/20 px-3.5 py-2 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
          <span className="truncate max-w-[280px] sm:max-w-none">
            Pratinjau dokumen PDF terenkripsi aman.
          </span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleOpenInNewTab}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-medium text-primary hover:underline shrink-0 ml-2"
          >
            <Maximize2 className="h-3 w-3" />
            <span>Layar Penuh</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/components/materials/material-summary-tab.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import {
  Sparkles,
  Copy,
  Check,
  RefreshCw,
  AlertCircle,
  Loader2,
  Info,
  BookOpen,
  ArrowRight,
  FileText,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  MaterialSummary,
  AiQuotaStatus,
  KeyConcept,
  SummarySection,
  KeyTerm,
} from '@studyflow/shared';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/card';

interface MaterialSummaryTabProps {
  summary: MaterialSummary | null;
  quota: AiQuotaStatus | null;
  isGenerating: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  isArchived: boolean;
  onGenerate: (regenerate?: boolean) => void;
  onOpenRegenerateDialog: () => void;
  onJumpToPage: (pageNumber: number) => void;
  onCopySummary: () => void;
  copiedSummary: boolean;
}

export function MaterialSummaryTab({
  summary,
  quota,
  isGenerating,
  error,
  isArchived,
  onGenerate,
  onOpenRegenerateDialog,
  onJumpToPage,
  onCopySummary,
  copiedSummary,
}: MaterialSummaryTabProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const isWorking =
    summary?.status === 'QUEUED' ||
    summary?.status === 'PROCESSING' ||
    isGenerating;

  // 1. Error Banner
  const renderError = error && (
    <div
      role="alert"
      className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/10 p-3.5 text-xs text-destructive"
    >
      <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
      <span className="leading-relaxed">{error}</span>
    </div>
  );

  // 2. State In-Progress (Queue / Processing)
  if (isWorking) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-4">
        {renderError}
        <Card className="border border-border bg-card p-8 sm:p-12 text-center shadow-xs">
          <div className="mx-auto flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary/10 text-primary">
            <Loader2 className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin" />
          </div>
          <h3 className="mt-4 text-base font-semibold text-foreground">
            Menyusun Ringkasan Dokumen...
          </h3>
          <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs sm:text-sm text-muted-foreground max-w-md mx-auto leading-relaxed">
            Model AI sedang membaca seluruh teks materi perkuliahan untuk mengekstrak konsep kunci, struktur pembahasan, dan istilah penting dengan rujukan halaman.
          </p>
          <div className="mt-4 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-border bg-muted/40 px-3.5 py-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-primary animate-pulse" />
            <span>Memproses di antrean sistem</span>
          </div>
        </Card>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // 3. State Ready (Summary Tersedia)
  if (summary?.status === 'READY') {
    const keyConcepts = (summary.keyConcepts as KeyConcept[]) || [];
    const sections = (summary.sections as SummarySection[]) || [];
    const keyTerms = (summary.keyTerms as KeyTerm[]) || [];

    return (
      <div className="space-y-6">
        {renderError}

        {/* Disclaimer Keandalan AI */}
        <div className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-lg border border-amber-500/20 bg-amber-500/5 p-3.5 text-xs text-foreground">
          <Info className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 mt-0.5" />
          <p className="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
            Ringkasan disusun otomatis oleh asisten belajar AI. Gunakan tombol referensi halaman (mis. <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">Hal. 4</span>) untuk memverifikasi materi langsung pada dokumen PDF aslinya.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Header Ringkasan & Toolbar Aksi */}
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between border-b border-border pb-4">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
              <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">
                {summary.title || 'Ringkasan Materi'}
              </h2>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              <span>{summary.sourcePageCount} halaman dianalisis</span>
              {quota && (
                <>
                  <span>•</span>
                  <span>Sisa kuota harian: {quota.dailyRemaining}/{quota.dailyLimit}</span>
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="standard"
              onClick={onCopySummary}
              className="gap-1.5 text-xs"
              aria-label="Salin seluruh isi ringkasan"
            >
              {copiedSummary ? (
                <>
                  <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                  <span>Tersalin</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Copy className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  <span>Salin Teks</span>
                </>
              )}
            </Button>

            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="standard"
              onClick={onOpenRegenerateDialog}
              disabled={isArchived || Boolean(quota && quota.dailyRemaining <= 0)}
              className="gap-1.5 text-xs text-primary hover:text-primary"
              aria-label="Buat ulang ringkasan dengan AI"
            >
              <RefreshCw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              <span>Regenerasi</span>
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Konten Ringkasan Bergaya Buku / Catatan Akademik */}
        <div className="max-w-3xl space-y-8 text-foreground">
          {/* Section 1: Ringkasan Utama */}
          {summary.overview && (
            <section className="space-y-2">
              <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
                Ringkasan Utama
              </h3>
              <p className="text-sm sm:text-base leading-relaxed text-foreground/90 whitespace-pre-line">
                {summary.overview}
              </p>
            </section>
          )}

          {/* Section 2: Konsep Kunci */}
          {keyConcepts.length > 0 && (
            <section className="space-y-3">
              <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
                Konsep Kunci
              </h3>
              <div className="divide-y divide-border/60 border-t border-b border-border/60">
                {keyConcepts.map((item, idx) => (
                  <div key={idx} className="py-3.5 space-y-1.5">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-2">
                      <h4 className="font-semibold text-sm sm:text-base text-foreground">
                        {item.concept}
                      </h4>
                      {item.pageReferences && item.pageReferences.length > 0 && (
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                          {item.pageReferences.map((pg) => (
                            <button
                              key={pg}
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => onJumpToPage(pg)}
                              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-accent px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-accent-foreground hover:bg-primary hover:text-primary-foreground transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                              title={`Buka halaman ${pg} di dokumen PDF`}
                              aria-label={`Buka halaman ${pg} di dokumen PDF untuk konsep ${item.concept}`}
                            >
                              <span>Hal. {pg}</span>
                              <ArrowRight className="h-3 w-3" />
                            </button>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
                      {item.explanation}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </section>
          )}

          {/* Section 3: Struktur & Bagian Materi */}
          {sections.length > 0 && (
            <section className="space-y-4">
              <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
                Struktur & Bagian Materi
              </h3>
              <div className="space-y-5">
                {sections.map((sec, idx) => (
                  <div key={idx} className="space-y-1.5">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-2">
                      <h4 className="font-semibold text-sm sm:text-base text-foreground">
                        {sec.heading}
                      </h4>
                      {sec.pageReferences && sec.pageReferences.length > 0 && (
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                          {sec.pageReferences.map((pg) => (
                            <button
                              key={pg}
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => onJumpToPage(pg)}
                              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-muted px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground hover:bg-primary hover:text-primary-foreground transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                              title={`Lihat pembahasan di halaman ${pg}`}
                              aria-label={`Lihat bagian ${sec.heading} di halaman ${pg}`}
                            >
                              <span>Hal. {pg}</span>
                            </button>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-line">
                      {sec.content}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </section>
          )}

          {/* Section 4: Istilah & Glosarium Penting */}
          {keyTerms.length > 0 && (
            <section className="space-y-3">
              <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
                Istilah Penting
              </h3>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2.5">
                {keyTerms.map((t, idx) => (
                  <div
                    key={idx}
                    className="rounded-lg border border-border/70 bg-card p-3 space-y-1 hover:border-primary/40 transition-colors"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                      <span className="font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
                        {t.term}
                      </span>
                      {t.pageReferences && t.pageReferences.length > 0 && (
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                          {t.pageReferences.map((pg) => (
                            <button
                              key={pg}
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => onJumpToPage(pg)}
                              className="text-[11px] text-primary hover:underline font-medium"
                              title={`Buka halaman ${pg}`}
                              aria-label={`Buka halaman ${pg} untuk istilah ${t.term}`}
                            >
                              Hal. {pg}
                            </button>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
                      {t.definition}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </section>
          )}

          {/* Section 5: Catatan / Batasan Materi */}
          {summary.limitations && (
            <div className="rounded-lg border border-border/80 bg-muted/20 p-3.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground space-y-1">
              <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">Catatan Tambahan:</span>
              <p className="leading-relaxed">{summary.limitations}</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // 4. State Gagal (Failed)
  if (summary?.status === 'FAILED') {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-4">
        {renderError}
        <Card className="border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 p-6 sm:p-10 text-center shadow-xs">
          <div className="mx-auto flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-destructive/10 text-destructive">
            <AlertCircle className="h-6 w-6" />
          </div>
          <h3 className="mt-3 text-base font-semibold text-destructive">
            Gagal Membuat Ringkasan AI
          </h3>
          <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs sm:text-sm text-muted-foreground max-w-md mx-auto leading-relaxed">
            {summary.errorMessage ||
              'Terjadi kendala saat memproses ringkasan dengan layanan AI. Kuota harian Anda tidak terpotong untuk percobaan yang gagal.'}
          </p>
          <div className="mt-5 flex justify-center">
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="standard"
              onClick={() => onGenerate(false)}
              disabled={isGenerating || Boolean(quota && quota.dailyRemaining <= 0)}
              className="gap-1.5 text-xs"
            >
              <RefreshCw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              <span>Coba Buat Lagi</span>
            </Button>
          </div>
        </Card>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // 5. State Belum Dibuat (Initial Onboarding)
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {renderError}
      <Card className="border border-dashed border-border bg-card/60 p-8 sm:p-12 text-center shadow-xs">
        <div className="mx-auto flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary/10 text-primary">
          <Sparkles className="h-6 w-6 text-primary" />
        </div>

        <div className="mt-3 space-y-1.5 max-w-md mx-auto">
          <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">
            Ringkas Materi Ini dengan AI
          </h3>
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
            Dapatkan intisari materi perkuliahan secara otomatis: rangkuman bab utama, konsep kunci, dan glosarium istilah penting yang tertaut langsung ke nomor halaman dokumen PDF.
          </p>
        </div>

        {quota && (
          <div className="mt-4 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-border bg-muted/40 px-3.5 py-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground font-medium">
            <span>Sisa kuota harian:</span>
            <span className="font-bold text-foreground">
              {quota.dailyRemaining} / {quota.dailyLimit}
            </span>
            <span>ringkasan</span>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="mt-6 flex justify-center">
          <Button
            size="standard"
            onClick={() => onGenerate(false)}
            disabled={
              isGenerating ||
              isArchived ||
              Boolean(quota && quota.dailyRemaining <= 0)
            }
            className="gap-2 text-xs shadow-xs"
          >
            {isGenerating ? (
              <>
                <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                <span>Menyiapkan Antrean...</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4" />
                <span>Buat Ringkasan AI Sekarang</span>
              </>
            )}
          </Button>
        </div>

        {isArchived && (
          <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-warning">
            Materi ini berada dalam semester atau mata kuliah yang diarsipkan sehingga tidak dapat menghasilkan ringkasan baru.
          </p>
        )}

        {quota && quota.dailyRemaining <= 0 && (
          <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-destructive">
            Batas kuota ringkasan AI harian Anda telah habis hari ini dan akan diperbarui besok.
          </p>
        )}
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
