<file path="apps/web/src/components/notes/markdown-renderer.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';

interface MarkdownRendererProps {
  content: string;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * Escapes characters to prevent raw HTML execution
 */
function escapeHtml(text: string): string {
  return text
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
}

/**
 * Validates link URL for safety (only allows http, https, or mailto)
 */
function isSafeUrl(url: string): boolean {
  const trimmed = url.trim().toLowerCase();
  return (
    trimmed.startsWith('https://') ||
    trimmed.startsWith('http://') ||
    trimmed.startsWith('mailto:')
  );
}

/**
 * Parses inline markdown: bold, italic, code, links, image placeholders
 */
function renderInline(text: string): React.ReactNode[] {
  const elements: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  let remaining = text;
  let key = 0;

  while (remaining.length > 0) {
    // 1. Image placeholder: ![alt](url) -> display safe placeholder without fetching external URL
    const imgMatch = /^!\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]*)\)/.exec(remaining);
    if (imgMatch) {
      const alt = imgMatch[1] || 'Gambar';
      elements.push(
        <span
          key={`img-${key++}`}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 my-0.5 text-xs font-mono rounded bg-muted text-muted-foreground border border-border"
          title="Pratinjau gambar eksternal dinonaktifkan demi privasi dan keamanan"
        >
          🖼️ [Gambar: {alt}]
        </span>
      );
      remaining = remaining.slice(imgMatch[0].length);
      continue;
    }

    // 2. Link: [text](url) -> safe external link with rel="noopener noreferrer"
    const linkMatch = /^\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)/.exec(remaining);
    if (linkMatch) {
      const linkText = linkMatch[1]!;
      const url = linkMatch[2]!.trim();
      if (isSafeUrl(url)) {
        elements.push(
          <a
            key={`a-${key++}`}
            href={url}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            className="text-primary underline font-medium hover:text-primary/80 transition-colors"
          >
            {linkText}
          </a>
        );
      } else {
        // Disallowed protocol (e.g. javascript:)
        elements.push(
          <span key={`unsafe-${key++}`} className="line-through text-danger">
            {linkText}
          </span>
        );
      }
      remaining = remaining.slice(linkMatch[0].length);
      continue;
    }

    // 3. Inline code: `code`
    const codeMatch = /^`([^`]+)`/.exec(remaining);
    if (codeMatch) {
      elements.push(
        <code
          key={`code-${key++}`}
          className="rounded bg-muted px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-foreground border border-border"
        >
          {codeMatch[1]}
        </code>
      );
      remaining = remaining.slice(codeMatch[0].length);
      continue;
    }

    // 4. Bold + Italic: ***text***
    const boldItalicMatch = /^\*\*\*([^*]+)\*\*\*/.exec(remaining);
    if (boldItalicMatch) {
      elements.push(
        <strong key={`bi-${key++}`} className="font-bold italic">
          {boldItalicMatch[1]}
        </strong>
      );
      remaining = remaining.slice(boldItalicMatch[0].length);
      continue;
    }

    // 5. Bold: **text**
    const boldMatch = /^\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/.exec(remaining);
    if (boldMatch) {
      elements.push(
        <strong key={`b-${key++}`} className="font-semibold text-foreground">
          {boldMatch[1]}
        </strong>
      );
      remaining = remaining.slice(boldMatch[0].length);
      continue;
    }

    // 6. Italic: *text* or _text_
    const italicMatch = /^(\*([^*]+)\*|_([^_]+)_)/.exec(remaining);
    if (italicMatch) {
      const italicText = italicMatch[2] || italicMatch[3];
      elements.push(
        <em key={`em-${key++}`} className="italic">
          {italicText}
        </em>
      );
      remaining = remaining.slice(italicMatch[0].length);
      continue;
    }

    // 7. Strikethrough: ~~text~~
    const strikeMatch = /^~~([^~]+)~~/.exec(remaining);
    if (strikeMatch) {
      elements.push(
        <span key={`strike-${key++}`} className="line-through text-muted-foreground">
          {strikeMatch[1]}
        </span>
      );
      remaining = remaining.slice(strikeMatch[0].length);
      continue;
    }

    // Regular character (or escaped bracket/asterisk)
    const nextSpecialIndex = remaining.search(/[!\[`*_~]/);
    if (nextSpecialIndex === -1) {
      elements.push(remaining);
      break;
    } else if (nextSpecialIndex > 0) {
      elements.push(remaining.slice(0, nextSpecialIndex));
      remaining = remaining.slice(nextSpecialIndex);
    } else {
      // First character is special but didn't match a full token
      elements.push(remaining[0]);
      remaining = remaining.slice(1);
    }
  }

  return elements;
}

export function SafeMarkdownRenderer({ content, className = '' }: MarkdownRendererProps): React.JSX.Element {
  if (!content || !content.trim()) {
    return (
      <div className={`text-muted-foreground italic text-sm ${className}`}>
        Belum ada konten catatan.
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Split lines while preserving blocks
  const lines = content.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').split('\n');
  const nodes: React.ReactNode[] = [];

  let inCodeBlock = false;
  let codeBlockLines: string[] = [];
  let codeBlockLang = '';

  let inList: 'ul' | 'ol' | null = null;
  let listItems: React.ReactNode[] = [];

  const flushList = () => {
    if (inList === 'ul') {
      nodes.push(
        <ul key={`ul-${nodes.length}`} className="my-3 ml-6 list-disc space-y-1 text-sm text-foreground">
          {listItems}
        </ul>
      );
    } else if (inList === 'ol') {
      nodes.push(
        <ol key={`ol-${nodes.length}`} className="my-3 ml-6 list-decimal space-y-1 text-sm text-foreground">
          {listItems}
        </ol>
      );
    }
    inList = null;
    listItems = [];
  };

  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const rawLine = lines[i]!;

    // Code block toggle (```)
    if (rawLine.trim().startsWith('```')) {
      if (inCodeBlock) {
        // End of code block
        nodes.push(
          <div key={`code-block-${nodes.length}`} className="my-4 overflow-x-auto rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/60 p-4">
            {codeBlockLang && (
              <div className="mb-2 text-xs font-mono text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold">
                {codeBlockLang}
              </div>
            )}
            <pre className="font-mono text-xs text-foreground leading-relaxed">
              <code>{codeBlockLines.join('\n')}</code>
            </pre>
          </div>
        );
        inCodeBlock = false;
        codeBlockLines = [];
        codeBlockLang = '';
      } else {
        flushList();
        inCodeBlock = true;
        codeBlockLang = rawLine.trim().replace(/^```/, '').trim();
      }
      continue;
    }

    if (inCodeBlock) {
      codeBlockLines.push(rawLine);
      continue;
    }

    const trimmed = rawLine.trim();

    // Empty line
    if (!trimmed) {
      flushList();
      continue;
    }

    // Horizontal Rule (--- or ***)
    if (/^(\*{3,}|-{3,}|_{3,})$/.test(trimmed)) {
      flushList();
      nodes.push(<hr key={`hr-${nodes.length}`} className="my-6 border-t border-border" />);
      continue;
    }

    // Headings
    if (trimmed.startsWith('# ')) {
      flushList();
      nodes.push(
        <h1 key={`h1-${nodes.length}`} className="mt-6 mb-3 text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground border-b border-border pb-1">
          {renderInline(trimmed.slice(2))}
        </h1>
      );
      continue;
    }
    if (trimmed.startsWith('## ')) {
      flushList();
      nodes.push(
        <h2 key={`h2-${nodes.length}`} className="mt-5 mb-2.5 text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-foreground border-b border-border pb-1">
          {renderInline(trimmed.slice(3))}
        </h2>
      );
      continue;
    }
    if (trimmed.startsWith('### ')) {
      flushList();
      nodes.push(
        <h3 key={`h3-${nodes.length}`} className="mt-4 mb-2 text-lg font-semibold text-foreground">
          {renderInline(trimmed.slice(4))}
        </h3>
      );
      continue;
    }
    if (trimmed.startsWith('#### ')) {
      flushList();
      nodes.push(
        <h4 key={`h4-${nodes.length}`} className="mt-3 mb-1.5 text-base font-semibold text-foreground">
          {renderInline(trimmed.slice(5))}
        </h4>
      );
      continue;
    }
    if (trimmed.startsWith('##### ')) {
      flushList();
      nodes.push(
        <h5 key={`h5-${nodes.length}`} className="mt-3 mb-1 text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">
          {renderInline(trimmed.slice(6))}
        </h5>
      );
      continue;
    }
    if (trimmed.startsWith('###### ')) {
      flushList();
      nodes.push(
        <h6 key={`h6-${nodes.length}`} className="mt-2 mb-1 text-xs font-semibold uppercase text-muted-foreground">
          {renderInline(trimmed.slice(7))}
        </h6>
      );
      continue;
    }

    // Blockquote
    if (trimmed.startsWith('>')) {
      flushList();
      const quoteText = trimmed.replace(/^>\s?/, '');
      nodes.push(
        <blockquote
          key={`quote-${nodes.length}`}
          className="my-3 border-l-4 border-primary pl-4 italic text-sm text-muted-foreground"
        >
          {renderInline(quoteText)}
        </blockquote>
      );
      continue;
    }

    // Unordered List (- or * or +)
    const ulMatch = /^[-*+]\s+(.*)$/.exec(trimmed);
    if (ulMatch) {
      if (inList !== 'ul') {
        flushList();
        inList = 'ul';
      }
      listItems.push(
        <li key={`li-${listItems.length}`} className="leading-relaxed">
          {renderInline(ulMatch[1]!)}
        </li>
      );
      continue;
    }

    // Ordered List (1. 2.)
    const olMatch = /^(\d+)\.\s+(.*)$/.exec(trimmed);
    if (olMatch) {
      if (inList !== 'ol') {
        flushList();
        inList = 'ol';
      }
      listItems.push(
        <li key={`li-${listItems.length}`} className="leading-relaxed">
          {renderInline(olMatch[2]!)}
        </li>
      );
      continue;
    }

    // Normal Paragraph
    flushList();
    nodes.push(
      <p key={`p-${nodes.length}`} className="my-2.5 text-sm leading-relaxed text-foreground">
        {renderInline(rawLine)}
      </p>
    );
  }

  // Clean up any remaining block
  flushList();
  if (inCodeBlock && codeBlockLines.length > 0) {
    nodes.push(
      <div key={`code-block-unclosed-${nodes.length}`} className="my-4 overflow-x-auto rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/60 p-4">
        <pre className="font-mono text-xs text-foreground leading-relaxed">
          <code>{codeBlockLines.join('\n')}</code>
        </pre>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className={`prose prose-sm dark:prose-invert max-w-none break-words ${className}`}>
      {nodes}
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/components/schedules/create-schedule-dialog.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import {
  Course,
  CourseSchedule,
  CourseScheduleConflict,
  CreateCourseScheduleInput,
  DAY_NAMES_ID,
  getDayNameId,
} from '@studyflow/shared';
import { createSchedule } from '@/lib/schedule-client';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { NativeSelect } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Alert, AlertDescription, AlertTitle } from '@/components/ui/alert';
import { AlertCircle, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';

export interface CreateScheduleDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  courses: Course[];
  preselectedCourseId?: string;
  onSuccess: (
    newSchedule: CourseSchedule,
    hasConflict: boolean,
    conflicts?: CourseScheduleConflict[]
  ) => void;
}

export function CreateScheduleDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  courses,
  preselectedCourseId,
  onSuccess,
}: CreateScheduleDialogProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const [courseId, setCourseId] = React.useState('');
  const [dayOfWeek, setDayOfWeek] = React.useState('1');
  const [startTime, setStartTime] = React.useState('08:00');
  const [endTime, setEndTime] = React.useState('09:40');
  const [room, setRoom] = React.useState('');
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = React.useState(false);

  const wasOpenRef = React.useRef(false);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (open && !wasOpenRef.current) {
      setErrorMsg(null);
      if (preselectedCourseId) {
        setCourseId(preselectedCourseId);
      } else if (courses.length > 0) {
        setCourseId(courses[0].id);
      } else {
        setCourseId('');
      }
      setDayOfWeek('1');
      setStartTime('08:00');
      setEndTime('09:40');
      setRoom('');
    }
    wasOpenRef.current = open;
  }, [open, preselectedCourseId, courses]);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMsg(null);

    const selectedCourseId = preselectedCourseId || courseId;
    if (!selectedCourseId) {
      setErrorMsg('Silakan pilih mata kuliah');
      return;
    }

    if (!startTime) {
      setErrorMsg('Waktu mulai wajib diisi');
      return;
    }
    if (!endTime) {
      setErrorMsg('Waktu selesai wajib diisi');
      return;
    }

    if (startTime === endTime) {
      setErrorMsg('Waktu selesai harus lebih besar daripada waktu mulai');
      return;
    }

    if (startTime > endTime) {
      setErrorMsg(
        'Sesi jadwal lintas tengah malam belum didukung. Harap tentukan waktu mulai dan selesai dalam hari yang sama.'
      );
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const input: CreateCourseScheduleInput = {
        courseId: selectedCourseId,
        dayOfWeek: parseInt(dayOfWeek, 10),
        startTime,
        endTime,
        room: room.trim() || null,
      };

      const res = await createSchedule(input);
      onOpenChange(false);
      onSuccess(res.schedule, res.hasConflict, res.conflicts);
    } catch (err: any) {
      // Retain user input on failure
      setErrorMsg(err.message || 'Gagal menambahkan jadwal kuliah');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const dayOptions = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7].map((dayNum) => ({
    value: String(dayNum),
    label: getDayNameId(dayNum),
  }));

  const selectedCourse = courses.find((c) => c.id === (preselectedCourseId || courseId));

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-[480px] max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Tambah Jadwal Kuliah</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Masukkan jadwal perkuliahan mingguan untuk mata kuliah aktif.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4 pt-2">
          {errorMsg && (
            <Alert variant="destructive">
              <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
              <AlertTitle>Gagal Menyimpan Jadwal</AlertTitle>
              <AlertDescription className="text-xs break-words">{errorMsg}</AlertDescription>
            </Alert>
          )}

          {/* Pemilihan Mata Kuliah */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="schedule-course" className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
              Mata Kuliah <span className="text-destructive">*</span>
            </Label>
            {preselectedCourseId ? (
              <Input
                id="schedule-course"
                disabled
                value={
                  selectedCourse
                    ? `${selectedCourse.name}${selectedCourse.code ? ` (${selectedCourse.code})` : ''}`
                    : 'Mata Kuliah Terpilih'
                }
                className="h-9 bg-muted/40 font-medium"
              />
            ) : (
              <NativeSelect
                id="schedule-course"
                value={courseId}
                onChange={(e) => setCourseId(e.target.value)}
                disabled={isSubmitting || courses.length === 0}
                className="h-9"
                required
              >
                {courses.length === 0 ? (
                  <option value="" disabled>
                    Belum ada mata kuliah aktif di semester ini
                  </option>
                ) : (
                  courses.map((crs) => (
                    <option key={crs.id} value={crs.id}>
                      {crs.name}
                      {crs.code ? ` (${crs.code})` : ''}
                    </option>
                  ))
                )}
              </NativeSelect>
            )}
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
              Semester mengikuti semester mata kuliah terpilih secara otomatis.
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Hari */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="schedule-day" className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
              Hari Perkuliahan <span className="text-destructive">*</span>
            </Label>
            <NativeSelect
              id="schedule-day"
              value={dayOfWeek}
              onChange={(e) => setDayOfWeek(e.target.value)}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              className="h-9"
              required
            >
              {dayOptions.map((opt) => (
                <option key={opt.value} value={opt.value}>
                  {opt.label}
                </option>
              ))}
            </NativeSelect>
          </div>

          {/* Rentang Jam (Mulai & Selesai) */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="schedule-start-time" className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
                Waktu Mulai <span className="text-destructive">*</span>
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="schedule-start-time"
                type="time"
                value={startTime}
                onChange={(e) => setStartTime(e.target.value)}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                className="h-9"
                required
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="schedule-end-time" className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
                Waktu Selesai <span className="text-destructive">*</span>
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="schedule-end-time"
                type="time"
                value={endTime}
                onChange={(e) => setEndTime(e.target.value)}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                className="h-9"
                required
              />
            </div>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            Waktu lokal mingguan berulang (24 jam). Sesi harus selesai di hari yang sama.
          </p>

          {/* Ruangan / Lokasi */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="schedule-room" className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
              Ruangan / Lokasi <span className="text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">(Opsional)</span>
            </Label>
            <Input
              id="schedule-room"
              placeholder="Contoh: Lab Komputer 3, R.204, atau Daring"
              value={room}
              onChange={(e) => setRoom(e.target.value)}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              maxLength={100}
              className="h-9"
            />
          </div>

          <DialogFooter className="pt-3 flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row gap-2 sm:justify-end">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="standard"
              onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            >
              Batal
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="submit"
              variant="default"
              size="standard"
              disabled={isSubmitting || (!preselectedCourseId && courses.length === 0)}
              className="gap-1.5"
            >
              {isSubmitting ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin shrink-0" />
                  <span>Menyimpan...</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <span>Simpan Jadwal</span>
              )}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

<file path="apps/web/src/components/schedules/delete-schedule-dialog.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import { CourseSchedule, getDayNameId } from '@studyflow/shared';
import { deleteSchedule } from '@/lib/schedule-client';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from '@/components/ui/alert';
import { AlertCircle, AlertTriangle, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';

export interface DeleteScheduleDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  schedule: CourseSchedule | null;
  onSuccess: (deletedId: string) => void;
}

export function DeleteScheduleDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  schedule,
  onSuccess,
}: DeleteScheduleDialogProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isDeleting, setIsDeleting] = React.useState(false);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setErrorMsg(null);
    }
  }, [open]);

  if (!schedule) {
    return <></>;
  }

  const courseTitle = schedule.course?.name || 'Mata Kuliah';
  const dayName = getDayNameId(schedule.dayOfWeek);

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    setErrorMsg(null);
    setIsDeleting(true);

    try {
      await deleteSchedule(schedule.id);
      onOpenChange(false);
      onSuccess(schedule.id);
    } catch (err: any) {
      // Dialog remains open on failure with error message displayed
      setErrorMsg(err.message || 'Gagal menghapus jadwal kuliah');
    } finally {
      setIsDeleting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-[420px]">
        <DialogHeader>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-destructive/10 text-destructive">
              <AlertTriangle className="h-5 w-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <DialogTitle>Hapus Jadwal Kuliah</DialogTitle>
              <DialogDescription className="mt-0.5">
                Konfirmasi penghapusan sesi perkuliahan.
              </DialogDescription>
            </div>
          </div>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className="space-y-3 pt-2">
          {errorMsg && (
            <Alert variant="destructive">
              <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
              <AlertDescription className="text-xs break-words">{errorMsg}</AlertDescription>
            </Alert>
          )}

          <p className="text-sm text-foreground leading-relaxed">
            Apakah Anda yakin ingin menghapus jadwal untuk mata kuliah{' '}
            <strong className="font-semibold text-foreground">
              {courseTitle}
              {schedule.course?.code ? ` (${schedule.course.code})` : ''}
            </strong>{' '}
            pada hari <span className="font-semibold">{dayName}</span> pukul{' '}
            <span className="font-semibold">{schedule.startTime} – {schedule.endTime}</span>
            {schedule.room ? ` di ${schedule.room}` : ''}?
          </p>

          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground bg-muted/40 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-border">
            Tindakan ini hanya menghapus sesi jadwal waktu ini dan tidak akan menghapus data mata kuliah, materi, atau tugas Anda.
          </p>
        </div>

        <DialogFooter className="pt-3 flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row gap-2 sm:justify-end">
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="outline"
            size="standard"
            onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
            disabled={isDeleting}
          >
            Batal
          </Button>
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="destructive"
            size="standard"
            onClick={handleDelete}
            disabled={isDeleting}
            className="gap-1.5"
          >
            {isDeleting ? (
              <>
                <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin shrink-0" />
                <span>Menghapus...</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <span>Ya, Hapus Jadwal</span>
            )}
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

<file path="apps/web/src/components/schedules/edit-schedule-dialog.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import {
  CourseSchedule,
  CourseScheduleConflict,
  UpdateCourseScheduleInput,
  getDayNameId,
} from '@studyflow/shared';
import { updateSchedule } from '@/lib/schedule-client';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { NativeSelect } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Alert, AlertDescription, AlertTitle } from '@/components/ui/alert';
import { AlertCircle, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';

export interface EditScheduleDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  schedule: CourseSchedule | null;
  onSuccess: (
    updatedSchedule: CourseSchedule,
    hasConflict: boolean,
    conflicts?: CourseScheduleConflict[]
  ) => void;
}

export function EditScheduleDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  schedule,
  onSuccess,
}: EditScheduleDialogProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const [dayOfWeek, setDayOfWeek] = React.useState('1');
  const [startTime, setStartTime] = React.useState('08:00');
  const [endTime, setEndTime] = React.useState('09:40');
  const [room, setRoom] = React.useState('');
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = React.useState(false);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (schedule && open) {
      setErrorMsg(null);
      setDayOfWeek(String(schedule.dayOfWeek));
      setStartTime(schedule.startTime);
      setEndTime(schedule.endTime);
      setRoom(schedule.room || '');
    }
  }, [schedule, open]);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!schedule) return;
    setErrorMsg(null);

    if (!startTime) {
      setErrorMsg('Waktu mulai wajib diisi');
      return;
    }
    if (!endTime) {
      setErrorMsg('Waktu selesai wajib diisi');
      return;
    }

    if (startTime === endTime) {
      setErrorMsg('Waktu selesai harus lebih besar daripada waktu mulai');
      return;
    }

    if (startTime > endTime) {
      setErrorMsg(
        'Sesi jadwal lintas tengah malam belum didukung. Harap tentukan waktu mulai dan selesai dalam hari yang sama.'
      );
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const input: UpdateCourseScheduleInput = {
        dayOfWeek: parseInt(dayOfWeek, 10),
        startTime,
        endTime,
        room: room.trim() || null,
      };

      const res = await updateSchedule(schedule.id, input);
      onOpenChange(false);
      onSuccess(res.schedule, res.hasConflict, res.conflicts);
    } catch (err: any) {
      // Retain user input on failure
      setErrorMsg(err.message || 'Gagal memperbarui jadwal kuliah');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const dayOptions = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7].map((dayNum) => ({
    value: String(dayNum),
    label: getDayNameId(dayNum),
  }));

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-[480px] max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Edit Jadwal Kuliah</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Perbarui waktu atau ruangan perkuliahan untuk mata kuliah ini.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4 pt-2">
          {errorMsg && (
            <Alert variant="destructive">
              <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
              <AlertTitle>Gagal Menyimpan Perubahan</AlertTitle>
              <AlertDescription className="text-xs break-words">{errorMsg}</AlertDescription>
            </Alert>
          )}

          {/* Mata Kuliah (Informasi Tetap) */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="edit-schedule-course" className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
              Mata Kuliah
            </Label>
            <Input
              id="edit-schedule-course"
              disabled
              value={
                schedule?.course
                  ? `${schedule.course.name}${schedule.course.code ? ` (${schedule.course.code})` : ''}`
                  : 'Mata Kuliah'
              }
              className="h-9 bg-muted/40 font-medium"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Hari */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="edit-schedule-day" className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
              Hari Perkuliahan <span className="text-destructive">*</span>
            </Label>
            <NativeSelect
              id="edit-schedule-day"
              value={dayOfWeek}
              onChange={(e) => setDayOfWeek(e.target.value)}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              className="h-9"
              required
            >
              {dayOptions.map((opt) => (
                <option key={opt.value} value={opt.value}>
                  {opt.label}
                </option>
              ))}
            </NativeSelect>
          </div>

          {/* Rentang Jam (Mulai & Selesai) */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="edit-schedule-start-time" className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
                Waktu Mulai <span className="text-destructive">*</span>
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="edit-schedule-start-time"
                type="time"
                value={startTime}
                onChange={(e) => setStartTime(e.target.value)}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                className="h-9"
                required
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="edit-schedule-end-time" className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
                Waktu Selesai <span className="text-destructive">*</span>
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="edit-schedule-end-time"
                type="time"
                value={endTime}
                onChange={(e) => setEndTime(e.target.value)}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                className="h-9"
                required
              />
            </div>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            Waktu lokal mingguan berulang (24 jam). Sesi harus selesai di hari yang sama.
          </p>

          {/* Ruangan / Lokasi */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="edit-schedule-room" className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
              Ruangan / Lokasi <span className="text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">(Opsional)</span>
            </Label>
            <Input
              id="edit-schedule-room"
              placeholder="Contoh: Lab Komputer 3, R.204, atau Daring"
              value={room}
              onChange={(e) => setRoom(e.target.value)}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              maxLength={100}
              className="h-9"
            />
          </div>

          <DialogFooter className="pt-3 flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row gap-2 sm:justify-end">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="standard"
              onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            >
              Batal
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="submit"
              variant="default"
              size="standard"
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              className="gap-1.5"
            >
              {isSubmitting ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin shrink-0" />
                  <span>Menyimpan...</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <span>Simpan Perubahan</span>
              )}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

<file path="apps/web/src/components/search/global-search-dialog.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import {
  Search,
  BookOpen,
  Files,
  ListTodo,
  FileText,
  Loader2,
  AlertCircle,
  RotateCcw,
  X,
  CalendarRange,
  ArrowRight,
  Clock,
  AlertTriangle,
  CheckCircle2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  Semester,
  SearchResultItem,
  SearchResponse,
} from '@studyflow/shared';
import { listSemesters } from '@/lib/semester-client';
import { searchGlobalClient } from '@/lib/search-client';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

interface GlobalSearchDialogProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export function GlobalSearchDialog({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
}: GlobalSearchDialogProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const router = useRouter();

  // Search query & scope
  const [query, setQuery] = React.useState('');
  const [semesterScope, setSemesterScope] = React.useState<string>('active'); // 'active' or 'all'
  const [semesters, setSemesters] = React.useState<Semester[]>([]);
  const [activeSemester, setActiveSemester] = React.useState<Semester | null>(null);

  // Results & async states
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = React.useState(false);
  const [searchResponse, setSearchResponse] = React.useState<SearchResponse | null>(null);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  // Keyboard navigation index in flattened results
  const [selectedIndex, setSelectedIndex] = React.useState<number>(0);

  // Request race condition guards
  const fetchRequestIdRef = React.useRef(0);
  const abortControllerRef = React.useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const inputRef = React.useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  const resultsContainerRef = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

  // 1. Load active semester and available semesters
  const loadSemesterContext = React.useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await listSemesters('all');
      setSemesters(res.semesters);
      setActiveSemester(res.activeSemester);
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  }, []);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      loadSemesterContext();
    }
  }, [isOpen, loadSemesterContext]);

  // Listen to semester changes from elsewhere
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleSemesterChange = () => {
      loadSemesterContext();
    };
    window.addEventListener('studyflow:semester-changed', handleSemesterChange);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('studyflow:semester-changed', handleSemesterChange);
    };
  }, [loadSemesterContext]);

  // Reset state when dialog closes (no persistent cross-session caching)
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) {
      setQuery('');
      setSearchResponse(null);
      setErrorMessage(null);
      setIsLoading(false);
      setSelectedIndex(0);
      if (abortControllerRef.current) {
        abortControllerRef.current.abort();
      }
    } else {
      // Autofocus input
      setTimeout(() => {
        inputRef.current?.focus();
      }, 50);
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  // 2. Perform debounced search (300ms)
  const performSearch = React.useCallback(
    async (q: string, scope: string, targetActiveSem: Semester | null) => {
      const trimmed = q.trim();
      if (trimmed.length < 2) {
        setSearchResponse(null);
        setIsLoading(false);
        setErrorMessage(null);
        return;
      }

      // Cancel previous in-flight request
      if (abortControllerRef.current) {
        abortControllerRef.current.abort();
      }
      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortControllerRef.current = controller;

      const requestId = ++fetchRequestIdRef.current;
      setIsLoading(true);
      setErrorMessage(null);

      try {
        const semesterParam =
          scope === 'all'
            ? 'all'
            : targetActiveSem
            ? targetActiveSem.id
            : undefined;

        const data = await searchGlobalClient(
          {
            q: trimmed,
            semesterId: semesterParam,
            limit: 5,
          },
          controller.signal
        );

        if (requestId === fetchRequestIdRef.current) {
          setSearchResponse(data);
          setSelectedIndex(0);
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        if (err.name === 'AbortError') return;
        if (requestId === fetchRequestIdRef.current) {
          setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Gagal memuat hasil pencarian');
        }
      } finally {
        if (requestId === fetchRequestIdRef.current) {
          setIsLoading(false);
        }
      }
    },
    []
  );

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      performSearch(query, semesterScope, activeSemester);
    }, 300);

    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, [query, semesterScope, activeSemester, performSearch]);

  // Flattened results for keyboard navigation
  const flattenedItems = React.useMemo<SearchResultItem[]>(() => {
    if (!searchResponse) return [];
    return [
      ...searchResponse.results.courses,
      ...searchResponse.results.materials,
      ...searchResponse.results.assignments,
      ...searchResponse.results.notes,
    ];
  }, [searchResponse]);

  // 3. Handle navigation to an item
  const handleSelectItem = React.useCallback(
    (item: SearchResultItem) => {
      onClose();
      router.push(item.url);
    },
    [onClose, router]
  );

  // 4. Keyboard navigation (ArrowDown, ArrowUp, Enter)
  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (flattenedItems.length === 0) return;

    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setSelectedIndex((prev) => (prev + 1) % flattenedItems.length);
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setSelectedIndex((prev) => (prev - 1 + flattenedItems.length) % flattenedItems.length);
    } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      const current = flattenedItems[selectedIndex];
      if (current) {
        handleSelectItem(current);
      }
    }
  };

  // Scroll active item into view
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (resultsContainerRef.current) {
      const activeEl = resultsContainerRef.current.querySelector('[data-selected="true"]');
      if (activeEl) {
        activeEl.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
      }
    }
  }, [selectedIndex]);

  let cumulativeIndex = 0;

  return (
    <Dialog open={isOpen} onOpenChange={(open) => !open && onClose()}>
      <DialogContent
        className="max-w-2xl w-[95vw] sm:w-full p-0 gap-0 overflow-hidden border shadow-2xl rounded-2xl bg-card"
        aria-describedby={undefined}
      >
        <DialogTitle className="sr-only">Pencarian Global StudyFlow</DialogTitle>

        {/* Input & Search Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 px-4 py-3 border-b bg-muted/20">
          <Search className="h-5 w-5 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
          <input
            ref={inputRef}
            type="search"
            role="searchbox"
            aria-label="Cari mata kuliah, materi, tugas, dan catatan"
            placeholder="Cari mata kuliah, materi, tugas, atau catatan..."
            value={query}
            onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
            className="w-full bg-transparent text-sm sm:text-base font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground/70 focus:outline-hidden text-foreground"
            autoComplete="off"
            autoCorrect="off"
            spellCheck={false}
          />

          {isLoading && (
            <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
          )}

          {query.length > 0 && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setQuery('');
                inputRef.current?.focus();
              }}
              className="p-1 rounded-md text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted transition-colors"
              title="Bersihkan input"
            >
              <X className="h-4 w-4" />
            </button>
          )}

          {/* Scope Toggle: Semester Aktif vs Semua Semester */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0 pl-1 border-l border-border/80">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() =>
                setSemesterScope((prev) => (prev === 'active' ? 'all' : 'active'))
              }
              className={cn(
                'text-xs font-semibold px-2 py-1 rounded-md transition-colors flex items-center gap-1 border',
                semesterScope === 'all'
                  ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground border-primary'
                  : 'bg-muted/80 text-foreground border-border hover:bg-muted'
              )}
              title={
                semesterScope === 'all'
                  ? 'Cakupan: Semua semester. Klik untuk beralih ke semester aktif.'
                  : `Cakupan: ${activeSemester?.name || 'Semester Aktif'}. Klik untuk beralih ke semua semester.`
              }
            >
              <CalendarRange className="h-3 w-3" />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">
                {semesterScope === 'all' ? 'Semua Semester' : activeSemester?.name || 'Semester Aktif'}
              </span>
              <span className="sm:hidden">
                {semesterScope === 'all' ? 'Semua' : 'Aktif'}
              </span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Content Body */}
        <div
          ref={resultsContainerRef}
          className="max-h-[60vh] sm:max-h-[420px] overflow-y-auto p-2 space-y-4"
        >
          {/* Error Message */}
          {errorMessage && (
            <div className="p-4 rounded-xl border border-destructive/20 bg-destructive/10 text-destructive text-sm flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
                <span>{errorMessage}</span>
              </div>
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => performSearch(query, semesterScope, activeSemester)}
                className="h-7 text-xs gap-1"
              >
                <RotateCcw className="h-3 w-3" />
                Coba Lagi
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Empty Query Prompt */}
          {query.trim().length === 0 && (
            <div className="py-10 text-center space-y-2 text-muted-foreground">
              <Search className="h-8 w-8 mx-auto opacity-40" />
              <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground/80">
                Ketik nama materi, tugas, catatan, atau mata kuliah
              </p>
              <p className="text-xs max-w-xs mx-auto text-muted-foreground/70">
                Pencarian mencocokkan judul materi, tugas, catatan, serta nama dan kode mata kuliah secara instan.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Query Too Short Prompt (< 2 chars) */}
          {query.trim().length === 1 && (
            <div className="py-8 text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              Ketik minimal 2 karakter untuk mulai mencari...
            </div>
          )}

          {/* No Results State */}
          {!isLoading &&
            query.trim().length >= 2 &&
            searchResponse &&
            flattenedItems.length === 0 && (
              <div className="py-10 text-center space-y-3 text-muted-foreground">
                <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
                  Tidak ada hasil untuk &ldquo;<span className="text-primary font-semibold">{query}</span>&rdquo;
                </p>
                <p className="text-xs max-w-sm mx-auto">
                  {semesterScope !== 'all' ? (
                    <>
                      Tidak ditemukan pada {searchResponse.semesterScope.name}. Coba beralih ke{' '}
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setSemesterScope('all')}
                        className="text-primary underline font-semibold hover:text-primary/80"
                      >
                        Semua Semester
                      </button>{' '}
                      atau periksa ejaan kata kunci.
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    'Periksa kembali ejaan kata kunci Anda atau coba kata kunci yang lebih umum.'
                  )}
                </p>
              </div>
            )}

          {/* Categorized Results */}
          {searchResponse && flattenedItems.length > 0 && (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {/* Category: Mata Kuliah */}
              {searchResponse.results.courses.length > 0 && (
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <div className="px-2 py-1 flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <BookOpen className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-primary" />
                      Mata Kuliah
                    </span>
                    {searchResponse.hasMore.courses && (
                      <span className="text-[10px] lowercase font-normal opacity-70">
                        (5 teratas)
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    {searchResponse.results.courses.map((item) => {
                      const itemIdx = cumulativeIndex++;
                      const isSelected = itemIdx === selectedIndex;
                      return (
                        <button
                          key={item.id}
                          type="button"
                          data-selected={isSelected}
                          onClick={() => handleSelectItem(item)}
                          onMouseEnter={() => setSelectedIndex(itemIdx)}
                          className={cn(
                            'w-full text-left px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl transition-colors flex items-center justify-between gap-3 group text-sm',
                            isSelected
                              ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground font-semibold shadow-xs'
                              : 'hover:bg-muted/60 text-foreground'
                          )}
                        >
                          <div className="min-w-0">
                            <div className="font-semibold truncate">{item.title}</div>
                            <div
                              className={cn(
                                'text-xs truncate font-normal mt-0.5',
                                isSelected ? 'text-primary-foreground/80' : 'text-muted-foreground'
                              )}
                            >
                              {item.subtitle}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <ArrowRight
                            className={cn(
                              'h-4 w-4 shrink-0 transition-transform group-hover:translate-x-0.5',
                              isSelected ? 'text-primary-foreground' : 'text-muted-foreground/60'
                            )}
                          />
                        </button>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Category: Materi */}
              {searchResponse.results.materials.length > 0 && (
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <div className="px-2 py-1 flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <Files className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-blue-500" />
                      Materi
                    </span>
                    {searchResponse.hasMore.materials && (
                      <span className="text-[10px] lowercase font-normal opacity-70">
                        (5 teratas)
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    {searchResponse.results.materials.map((item) => {
                      const itemIdx = cumulativeIndex++;
                      const isSelected = itemIdx === selectedIndex;
                      return (
                        <button
                          key={item.id}
                          type="button"
                          data-selected={isSelected}
                          onClick={() => handleSelectItem(item)}
                          onMouseEnter={() => setSelectedIndex(itemIdx)}
                          className={cn(
                            'w-full text-left px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl transition-colors flex items-center justify-between gap-3 group text-sm',
                            isSelected
                              ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground font-semibold shadow-xs'
                              : 'hover:bg-muted/60 text-foreground'
                          )}
                        >
                          <div className="min-w-0">
                            <div className="font-semibold truncate">{item.title}</div>
                            <div
                              className={cn(
                                'text-xs truncate font-normal mt-0.5',
                                isSelected ? 'text-primary-foreground/80' : 'text-muted-foreground'
                              )}
                            >
                              {item.subtitle}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <ArrowRight
                            className={cn(
                              'h-4 w-4 shrink-0 transition-transform group-hover:translate-x-0.5',
                              isSelected ? 'text-primary-foreground' : 'text-muted-foreground/60'
                            )}
                          />
                        </button>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Category: Tugas */}
              {searchResponse.results.assignments.length > 0 && (
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <div className="px-2 py-1 flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <ListTodo className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-amber-500" />
                      Tugas Kuliah
                    </span>
                    {searchResponse.hasMore.assignments && (
                      <span className="text-[10px] lowercase font-normal opacity-70">
                        (5 teratas)
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    {searchResponse.results.assignments.map((item) => {
                      const itemIdx = cumulativeIndex++;
                      const isSelected = itemIdx === selectedIndex;
                      return (
                        <button
                          key={item.id}
                          type="button"
                          data-selected={isSelected}
                          onClick={() => handleSelectItem(item)}
                          onMouseEnter={() => setSelectedIndex(itemIdx)}
                          className={cn(
                            'w-full text-left px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl transition-colors flex items-center justify-between gap-3 group text-sm',
                            isSelected
                              ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground font-semibold shadow-xs'
                              : 'hover:bg-muted/60 text-foreground'
                          )}
                        >
                          <div className="min-w-0">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                              <span className="font-semibold truncate">{item.title}</span>
                              {item.metadata?.isOverdue && (
                                <Badge variant="danger" className="text-[10px] py-0 px-1.5 h-4">
                                  Terlewat
                                </Badge>
                              )}
                              {item.metadata?.status === 'DONE' && (
                                <Badge variant="success" className="text-[10px] py-0 px-1.5 h-4">
                                  Selesai
                                </Badge>
                              )}
                            </div>
                            <div
                              className={cn(
                                'text-xs truncate font-normal mt-0.5',
                                isSelected ? 'text-primary-foreground/80' : 'text-muted-foreground'
                              )}
                            >
                              {item.subtitle}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <ArrowRight
                            className={cn(
                              'h-4 w-4 shrink-0 transition-transform group-hover:translate-x-0.5',
                              isSelected ? 'text-primary-foreground' : 'text-muted-foreground/60'
                            )}
                          />
                        </button>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Category: Catatan */}
              {searchResponse.results.notes.length > 0 && (
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <div className="px-2 py-1 flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <FileText className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-500" />
                      Catatan
                    </span>
                    {searchResponse.hasMore.notes && (
                      <span className="text-[10px] lowercase font-normal opacity-70">
                        (5 teratas)
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    {searchResponse.results.notes.map((item) => {
                      const itemIdx = cumulativeIndex++;
                      const isSelected = itemIdx === selectedIndex;
                      return (
                        <button
                          key={item.id}
                          type="button"
                          data-selected={isSelected}
                          onClick={() => handleSelectItem(item)}
                          onMouseEnter={() => setSelectedIndex(itemIdx)}
                          className={cn(
                            'w-full text-left px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl transition-colors flex items-center justify-between gap-3 group text-sm',
                            isSelected
                              ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground font-semibold shadow-xs'
                              : 'hover:bg-muted/60 text-foreground'
                          )}
                        >
                          <div className="min-w-0">
                            <div className="font-semibold truncate">{item.title}</div>
                            <div
                              className={cn(
                                'text-xs truncate font-normal mt-0.5',
                                isSelected ? 'text-primary-foreground/80' : 'text-muted-foreground'
                              )}
                            >
                              {item.subtitle}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <ArrowRight
                            className={cn(
                              'h-4 w-4 shrink-0 transition-transform group-hover:translate-x-0.5',
                              isSelected ? 'text-primary-foreground' : 'text-muted-foreground/60'
                            )}
                          />
                        </button>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Footer with keyboard shortcuts hints */}
        <div className="px-4 py-2.5 bg-muted/40 border-t flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <kbd className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-muted border font-mono text-[10px]">↑</kbd>
              <kbd className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-muted border font-mono text-[10px]">↓</kbd>
              <span>pilih</span>
            </span>
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <kbd className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-muted border font-mono text-[10px]">↵</kbd>
              <span>buka</span>
            </span>
          </div>
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <kbd className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-muted border font-mono text-[10px]">ESC</kbd>
            <span>tutup</span>
          </span>
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

import * as React from 'react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export interface AlertProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  variant?: 'default' | 'destructive' | 'warning' | 'info';
}

const Alert = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, AlertProps>(
  ({ className, variant = 'default', ...props }, ref) => {
    const variantStyles = {
      default: 'bg-card text-foreground border-border',
      destructive: 'border-danger/40 bg-danger/10 text-danger-foreground [&>svg]:text-danger',
      warning: 'border-warning/40 bg-warning/10 text-warning-foreground [&>svg]:text-warning',
      info: 'border-accent text-accent-foreground bg-accent/40 [&>svg]:text-primary',
    };

    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        role="alert"
        className={cn(
          'relative w-full rounded-lg border p-4 text-sm [&>svg~*]:pl-7 [&>svg+div]:translate-y-[-3px] [&>svg]:absolute [&>svg]:left-4 [&>svg]:top-4 [&>svg]:text-foreground',
          variantStyles[variant],
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      />
    );
  }
);
Alert.displayName = 'Alert';

const AlertTitle = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLParagraphElement,
  React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLHeadingElement>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <h5
    ref={ref}
    className={cn('mb-1 font-semibold leading-none tracking-tight', className)}
    {...props}
  />
));
AlertTitle.displayName = 'AlertTitle';

const AlertDescription = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLParagraphElement,
  React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLParagraphElement>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <div
    ref={ref}
    className={cn('text-sm [&_p]:leading-relaxed', className)}
    {...props}
  />
));
AlertDescription.displayName = 'AlertDescription';

export { Alert, AlertTitle, AlertDescription };

import * as React from 'react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export interface BadgeProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  variant?: 'default' | 'secondary' | 'outline' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger';
}

function Badge({
  className,
  variant = 'default',
  ...props
}: BadgeProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const variantStyles = {
    default: 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground border-transparent',
    secondary: 'bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground border-transparent',
    outline: 'border-border text-foreground',
    success: 'bg-success text-success-foreground border-transparent',
    warning: 'bg-warning text-warning-foreground border-transparent',
    danger: 'bg-danger text-danger-foreground border-transparent',
  };

  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        'inline-flex items-center rounded-md border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors',
        variantStyles[variant],
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

export { Badge };

        ),
        dropdown_root: cn(
          'relative rounded-md border border-input bg-card shadow-xs has-focus:border-primary has-focus:ring-2 has-focus:ring-ring',
          defaultClassNames.dropdown_root
        ),
        dropdown: cn(
          'absolute inset-0 cursor-pointer bg-popover opacity-0',
          defaultClassNames.dropdown
        ),
        caption_label: cn(
          'select-none font-semibold text-sm text-foreground capitalize',
          captionLayout !== 'label' &&
            'flex h-8 items-center gap-1 rounded-md pl-2 pr-1 font-medium [&>svg]:h-3.5 [&>svg]:w-3.5 [&>svg]:text-muted-foreground',
          defaultClassNames.caption_label
        ),
        month_grid: cn('w-full border-collapse space-y-1', defaultClassNames.month_grid),
        weekdays: cn('flex', defaultClassNames.weekdays),
        weekday: cn(
          'text-muted-foreground flex-1 select-none text-[0.8rem] font-medium text-center py-1',
          defaultClassNames.weekday
        ),
        week: cn('mt-1 flex w-full', defaultClassNames.week),
        day: cn(
          'group/day relative aspect-square h-full w-full select-none p-0 text-center',
          defaultClassNames.day
        ),
        today: cn(
          'font-semibold text-primary',
          defaultClassNames.today
        ),
        outside: cn(
          'text-muted-foreground/40 aria-selected:text-muted-foreground/40',
          defaultClassNames.outside
        ),
        disabled: cn(
          'text-muted-foreground/30 opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed',
          defaultClassNames.disabled
        ),
        hidden: cn('invisible', defaultClassNames.hidden),
        ...classNames,
      }}
      components={{
        Root: ({ className, rootRef, ...rootProps }) => (
          <div
            data-slot="calendar"
            ref={rootRef}
            className={cn(className)}
            {...rootProps}
          />
        ),
        Chevron: ({ className, orientation, ...chevronProps }) => {
          if (orientation === 'left') {
            return (
              <ChevronLeftIcon className={cn('h-4 w-4', className)} {...chevronProps} />
            );
          }
          if (orientation === 'right') {
            return (
              <ChevronRightIcon className={cn('h-4 w-4', className)} {...chevronProps} />
            );
          }
          return (
            <ChevronDownIcon className={cn('h-4 w-4', className)} {...chevronProps} />
          );
        },
        DayButton: CalendarDayButton,
        ...components,
      }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

function CalendarDayButton({
  className,
  day,
  modifiers,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DayButton>) {
  const defaultClassNames = getDefaultClassNames();

  const ref = React.useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (modifiers.focused) ref.current?.focus();
  }, [modifiers.focused]);

  return (
    <Button
      ref={ref}
      type="button"
      variant="ghost"
      size="icon"
      data-day={day.date.toLocaleDateString()}
      data-selected={modifiers.selected}
      className={cn(
        'h-9 w-9 p-0 font-normal rounded-lg text-sm transition-colors text-foreground hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground touch-manipulation',
        modifiers.selected &&
          'bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary-hover hover:text-primary-foreground font-semibold shadow-xs',
        modifiers.today &&
          !modifiers.selected &&
          'border border-primary/40 text-primary font-semibold',
        defaultClassNames.day,
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

export { Calendar, CalendarDayButton };

<file path="apps/web/src/components/ui/chart.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import * as RechartsPrimitive from 'recharts';

import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

// Format: { THEME_NAME: CSS_SELECTOR }
const THEMES = { light: '', dark: '.dark' } as const;

export type ChartConfig = {
  [k in string]: {
    label?: React.ReactNode;
    icon?: React.ComponentType;
  } & (
    | { color?: string; theme?: never }
    | { color?: never; theme: Record<keyof typeof THEMES, string> }
  );
};

type ChartContextProps = {
  config: ChartConfig;
};

const ChartContext = React.createContext<ChartContextProps | null>(null);

function useChart() {
  const context = React.useContext(ChartContext);

  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useChart must be used within a <ChartContainer />');
  }

  return context;
}

const ChartContainer = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.ComponentProps<'div'> & {
    config: ChartConfig;
    children: React.ComponentProps<
      typeof RechartsPrimitive.ResponsiveContainer
    >['children'];
  }
>(({ id, className, children, config, ...props }, ref) => {
  const uniqueId = React.useId();
  const chartId = `chart-${id || uniqueId.replace(/:/g, '')}`;

  return (
    <ChartContext.Provider value={{ config }}>
      <div
        data-slot="chart"
        data-chart={chartId}
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          "flex aspect-video justify-center text-xs [&_.recharts-cartesian-axis-tick_text]:fill-muted-foreground [&_.recharts-cartesian-grid_line[stroke='#ccc']]:stroke-border/50 [&_.recharts-curve.recharts-tooltip-cursor]:stroke-border [&_.recharts-dot[stroke='#fff']]:stroke-transparent [&_.recharts-layer]:outline-none [&_.recharts-polar-grid_[stroke='#ccc']]:stroke-border [&_.recharts-radial-bar-background-sector]:fill-muted [&_.recharts-rectangle.recharts-tooltip-cursor]:fill-muted [&_.recharts-reference-line-line]:stroke-border [&_.comp-wrapper]:w-full [&_.recharts-surface]:overflow-visible",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <ChartStyle id={chartId} config={config} />
        <RechartsPrimitive.ResponsiveContainer>
          {children}
        </RechartsPrimitive.ResponsiveContainer>
      </div>
    </ChartContext.Provider>
  );
});
ChartContainer.displayName = 'Chart';

const ChartStyle = ({ id, config }: { id: string; config: ChartConfig }) => {
  const colorConfig = Object.entries(config).filter(
    ([, itemConfig]) => itemConfig.theme || itemConfig.color
  );

  if (!colorConfig.length) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <style
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
        __html: Object.entries(THEMES)
          .map(
            ([theme, prefix]) => `
${prefix} [data-chart=${id}] {
${colorConfig
  .map(([key, itemConfig]) => {
    const color =
      itemConfig.theme?.[theme as keyof typeof itemConfig.theme] ||
      itemConfig.color;
    return color ? `  --color-${key}: ${color};` : null;
  })
  .filter(Boolean)
  .join('\n')}
}
`
          )
          .join('\n'),
      }}
    />
  );
};

const ChartTooltip = RechartsPrimitive.Tooltip;

export type ChartTooltipPayloadEntry = {
  dataKey?: string | number;
  name?: string | number;
  value?: number | string;
  payload?: any;
  color?: string;
  fill?: string;
};

export interface ChartTooltipContentProps
  extends React.ComponentProps<'div'> {
  active?: boolean;
  payload?: ChartTooltipPayloadEntry[];
  label?: string | number;
  labelFormatter?: (
    label: any,
    payload: ChartTooltipPayloadEntry[]
  ) => React.ReactNode;
  labelClassName?: string;
  formatter?: (
    value: any,
    name: any,
    item: ChartTooltipPayloadEntry,
    index: number,
    payload: any
  ) => React.ReactNode;
  indicator?: 'line' | 'dot' | 'dashed';
  hideLabel?: boolean;
  hideIndicator?: boolean;
  color?: string;
  nameKey?: string;
  labelKey?: string;
}

const ChartTooltipContent = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  ChartTooltipContentProps
>(
  (
    {
      active,
      payload,
      className,
      indicator = 'dot',
      hideLabel = false,
      hideIndicator = false,
      label,
      labelFormatter,
      labelClassName,
      formatter,
      color,
      nameKey,
      labelKey,
    },
    ref
  ) => {
    const { config } = useChart();

    const tooltipLabel = React.useMemo(() => {
      if (hideLabel || !payload?.length) {
        return null;
      }

      const [item] = payload;
      const key = `${labelKey || item?.dataKey || item?.name || 'value'}`;
      const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key);
      const value =
        !label && typeof label === 'string'
          ? config[label]?.label || label
          : item?.payload?.[labelKey as string] || label;

      if (labelFormatter) {
        return (
          <div className={cn('font-medium', labelClassName)}>
            {labelFormatter(value, payload)}
          </div>
        );
      }

      if (!value) {
        return null;
      }

      return <div className={cn('font-medium', labelClassName)}>{value}</div>;
    }, [
      label,
      labelFormatter,
      payload,
      hideLabel,
      labelClassName,
      config,
      labelKey,
    ]);

    if (!active || !payload?.length) {
      return null;
    }

    const nestLabel = payload.length === 1 && indicator !== 'dot';

    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          'grid min-w-[8rem] items-start gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-border/50 bg-background px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs shadow-xl',
          className
        )}
      >
        {!nestLabel ? tooltipLabel : null}
        <div className="grid gap-1.5">
          {payload.map((item, index) => {
            const key = `${nameKey || item.name || item.dataKey || 'value'}`;
            const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key);
            const indicatorColor = color || item.payload?.fill || item.color;

            return (
              <div
                key={item.dataKey || index}
                className={cn(
                  'flex w-full flex-wrap items-stretch gap-2 [&>svg]:h-2.5 [&>svg]:w-2.5 [&>svg]:text-muted-foreground',
                  indicator === 'dot' && 'items-center'
                )}
              >
                {formatter && item?.value !== undefined && item.name ? (
                  formatter(item.value, item.name, item, index, item.payload)
                ) : (
                  <>
                    {itemConfig?.icon ? (
                      <itemConfig.icon />
                    ) : (
                      !hideIndicator && (
                        <div
                          className={cn(
                            'shrink-0 rounded-[2px] border-[--color-border] bg-[--color-bg]',
                            {
                              'h-2.5 w-2.5': indicator === 'dot',
                              'w-1': indicator === 'line',
                              'w-0 border-[1.5px] border-dashed bg-transparent':
                                indicator === 'dashed',
                              'my-0.5': nestLabel && indicator === 'dashed',
                            }
                          )}
                          style={
                            {
                              '--color-bg': indicatorColor,
                              '--color-border': indicatorColor,
                            } as React.CSSProperties
                          }
                        />
                      )
                    )}
                    <div
                      className={cn(
                        'flex flex-1 justify-between leading-none',
                        nestLabel ? 'items-end' : 'items-center'
                      )}
                    >
                      <div className="grid gap-1.5">
                        {nestLabel ? tooltipLabel : null}
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                          {itemConfig?.label || item.name}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      {item.value !== undefined && (
                        <span className="font-mono font-medium tabular-nums text-foreground">
                          {item.value.toLocaleString()}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }
);
ChartTooltipContent.displayName = 'ChartTooltip';

const ChartLegend = RechartsPrimitive.Legend;

export interface ChartLegendPayloadEntry {
  value?: any;
  dataKey?: any;
  color?: string;
  payload?: any;
}

export interface ChartLegendContentProps
  extends React.ComponentProps<'div'> {
  payload?: ChartLegendPayloadEntry[];
  verticalAlign?: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'middle';
  hideIcon?: boolean;
  nameKey?: string;
}

const ChartLegendContent = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  ChartLegendContentProps
>(
  (
    { className, hideIcon = false, payload, verticalAlign = 'bottom', nameKey },
    ref
  ) => {
    const { config } = useChart();

    if (!payload?.length) {
      return null;
    }

    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn(
          'flex items-center justify-center gap-4',
          verticalAlign === 'top' ? 'pb-3' : 'pt-3',
          className
        )}
      >
        {payload.map((item) => {
          const key = `${nameKey || item.dataKey || 'value'}`;
          const itemConfig = getPayloadConfigFromPayload(config, item, key);

          return (
            <div
              key={item.value}
              className={cn(
                'flex items-center gap-1.5 [&>svg]:h-3 [&>svg]:w-3 [&>svg]:text-muted-foreground'
              )}
            >
              {itemConfig?.icon && !hideIcon ? (
                <itemConfig.icon />
              ) : (
                <div
                  className="h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-[2px]"
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: item.color,
                  }}
                />
              )}
              {itemConfig?.label}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    );
  }
);
ChartLegendContent.displayName = 'ChartLegend';

// Helper to extract item config from config object.
function getPayloadConfigFromPayload(
  config: ChartConfig,
  payload: unknown,
  key: string
) {
  if (typeof payload !== 'object' || payload === null) {
    return undefined;
  }

  const payloadPayload =
    'payload' in payload &&
    typeof payload.payload === 'object' &&
    payload.payload !== null
      ? (payload.payload as Record<string, unknown>)
      : undefined;

  let configLabelKey: string = key;

  if (
    key in payload &&
    typeof payload[key as keyof typeof payload] === 'string'
  ) {
    configLabelKey = payload[key as keyof typeof payload] as string;
  } else if (
    payloadPayload &&
    key in payloadPayload &&
    typeof payloadPayload[key as keyof typeof payloadPayload] === 'string'
  ) {
    configLabelKey = payloadPayload[
      key as keyof typeof payloadPayload
    ] as string;
  }

  return configLabelKey in config
    ? config[configLabelKey]
    : config[key as keyof typeof config];
}

export {
  ChartContainer,
  ChartTooltip,
  ChartTooltipContent,
  ChartLegend,
  ChartLegendContent,
  ChartStyle,
};

        type="button"

<file path="apps/web/src/lib/calendar-client.ts">
import {
  CalendarQuery,
  CalendarResponse,
} from '@studyflow/shared';
import { authFetch } from './auth-client';

export async function getCalendarData(
  query: CalendarQuery,
  signal?: AbortSignal
): Promise<CalendarResponse> {
  const searchParams = new URLSearchParams();
  searchParams.set('startDate', query.startDate);
  searchParams.set('endDate', query.endDate);
  if (query.semesterId) searchParams.set('semesterId', query.semesterId);
  if (query.courseId) searchParams.set('courseId', query.courseId);
  if (query.type) searchParams.set('type', query.type);

  const res = await authFetch(`/api/calendar?${searchParams.toString()}`, {
    signal,
  });

  if (!res.ok) {
    const errorData = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
    throw new Error(errorData.error?.message || 'Gagal memuat data kalender akademik');
  }

  return res.json();
}
