import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterAll } from 'vitest';
import request from 'supertest';
import { createApp } from '../app.js';
import { prisma } from '@studyflow/database';

describe('Note Endpoints & Invariants', () => {
  const app = createApp();
  const TRUSTED_ORIGIN = 'http://localhost:3000';

  let userAId: string;
  let userBId: string;
  let cookieA: string[];
  let cookieB: string[];
  let semAId: string;
  let semBId: string;
  let courseAId: string;
  let courseBId: string;

  beforeEach(async () => {
    await prisma.user.deleteMany({
      where: { email: { contains: 'test.not.' } },
    });

    // Create User A
    const emailA = `test.not.a.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Note User A',
        email: emailA,
        password: 'PasswordSangatKuat123!',
      });
    const loginA = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: emailA,
        password: 'PasswordSangatKuat123!',
      });
    userAId = loginA.body.user.id;
    cookieA = loginA.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];

    const semResA = await request(app)
      .post('/api/semesters')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ name: 'Semester A', academicYear: '2026/2027', isActive: true });
    semAId = semResA.body.semester.id;

    const courseResA = await request(app)
      .post('/api/courses')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        semesterId: semAId,
        name: 'Sistem Operasi',
        code: 'IF202',
      });
    courseAId = courseResA.body.course.id;

    // Create User B
    const emailB = `test.not.b.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Note User B',
        email: emailB,
        password: 'PasswordSangatKuat123!',
      });
    const loginB = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: emailB,
        password: 'PasswordSangatKuat123!',
      });
    userBId = loginB.body.user.id;
    cookieB = loginB.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];

    const semResB = await request(app)
      .post('/api/semesters')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB)
      .send({ name: 'Semester B', academicYear: '2026/2027', isActive: true });
    semBId = semResB.body.semester.id;

    const courseResB = await request(app)
      .post('/api/courses')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB)
      .send({
        semesterId: semBId,
        name: 'Basis Data',
        code: 'IF203',
      });
    courseBId = courseResB.body.course.id;
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await prisma.user.deleteMany({
      where: { email: { contains: 'test.not.' } },
    });
    await prisma.$disconnect();
  });

  it('creates a note with empty content and retrieves it', async () => {
    const res = await request(app)
      .post('/api/notes')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseAId,
        title: 'Catatan Pertemuan 1',
        content: '',
      });

    expect(res.status).toBe(201);
    expect(res.body.note.title).toBe('Catatan Pertemuan 1');
    expect(res.body.note.content).toBe('');
    expect(res.body.note.version).toBe(1);

    const getRes = await request(app)
      .get(`/api/notes/${res.body.note.id}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);

    expect(getRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(getRes.body.note.title).toBe('Catatan Pertemuan 1');
    expect(getRes.body.note.content).toBe('');
    expect(getRes.body.note.version).toBe(1);
  });

  it('manages version increments and rejects conflicting concurrent edits with 409', async () => {
    // 1. Create note (version 1)
    const createRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/notes')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseAId,
        title: 'Catatan Concurrency',
        content: '# Bab 1\nPengantar proses.',
      });

    const noteId = createRes.body.note.id;
    expect(createRes.body.note.version).toBe(1);

    // 2. Tab A edits with version = 1 -> succeeds, version becomes 2
    const editTabARes = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/notes/${noteId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        version: 1,
        content: '# Bab 1\nPengantar proses dan thread oleh Tab A.',
      });

    expect(editTabARes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(editTabARes.body.note.version).toBe(2);

    // 3. Tab B (which still holds version 1) attempts to save -> 409 NOTE_VERSION_CONFLICT
    const editTabBRes = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/notes/${noteId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        version: 1,
        content: '# Bab 1\nTab B mencoba menimpa!',
      });

    expect(editTabBRes.status).toBe(409);
    expect(editTabBRes.body.error.code).toBe('NOTE_VERSION_CONFLICT');

    // 4. Tab B fetches current note, reconciles, and submits with version = 2
    const editTabBRetryRes = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/notes/${noteId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        version: 2,
        content: '# Bab 1\nTab B rekonsiliasi berhasil.',
      });

    expect(editTabBRetryRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(editTabBRetryRes.body.note.version).toBe(3);
  });

  it('handles truly simultaneous concurrent updates: exactly one succeeds and one receives 409', async () => {
    // 1. Create note with version 1
    const createRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/notes')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseAId,
        title: 'Catatan Konkurensi Paralel',
        content: 'Konten awal v1',
      });

    const noteId = createRes.body.note.id;
    expect(createRes.body.note.version).toBe(1);

    // 2. Fire two requests simultaneously with version = 1
    const [res1, res2] = await Promise.all([
      request(app)
        .patch(`/api/notes/${noteId}`)
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', cookieA)
        .send({
          version: 1,
          content: 'Konten dari Tab 1',
        }),
      request(app)
        .patch(`/api/notes/${noteId}`)
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
        .set('Cookie', cookieA)
        .send({
          version: 1,
          content: 'Konten dari Tab 2',
        }),
    ]);

    const statuses = [res1.status, res2.status].sort();
    expect(statuses).toEqual([200, 409]);

    const successRes = res1.status === 200 ? res1 : res2;
    const conflictRes = res1.status === 409 ? res1 : res2;

    expect(successRes.body.note.version).toBe(2);
    expect(conflictRes.body.error.code).toBe('NOTE_VERSION_CONFLICT');
    expect(conflictRes.body.error.currentVersion).toBe(2);

    // 3. Verify final state in DB: version incremented exactly once (2), content matches the successful request
    const fetchRes = await request(app)
      .get(`/api/notes/${noteId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);

    expect(fetchRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(fetchRes.body.note.version).toBe(2);
    expect(fetchRes.body.note.content).toBe(successRes.body.note.content);
  });

  it('rejects editing courseId', async () => {
    const createRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/notes')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseAId,
        title: 'Catatan Test Course Change',
      });

    const editRes = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/notes/${createRes.body.note.id}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ courseId: courseBId });

    expect(editRes.status).toBe(400);
    expect(editRes.body.error.code).toBe('CANNOT_CHANGE_COURSE');
  });

  it('enforces multi-tenant data isolation', async () => {
    // User A creates note
    const noteA = await request(app)
      .post('/api/notes')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseAId,
        title: 'Rahasia Catatan User A',
        content: 'Konten rahasia A',
      });

    // User B tries to read User A note -> 404
    const getRes = await request(app)
      .get(`/api/notes/${noteA.body.note.id}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB);
    expect(getRes.status).toBe(404);

    // User B tries to update User A note -> 404
    const patchRes = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/notes/${noteA.body.note.id}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB)
      .send({ title: 'Hacked', version: 1 });
    expect(patchRes.status).toBe(404);

    // User B tries to delete User A note -> 404
    const deleteRes = await request(app)
      .delete(`/api/notes/${noteA.body.note.id}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB);
    expect(deleteRes.status).toBe(404);

    // User B tries to create note under User A course -> 404 COURSE_NOT_FOUND
    const createBwithACourse = await request(app)
      .post('/api/notes')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieB)
      .send({
        courseId: courseAId,
        title: 'Catatan Ilegal',
      });
    expect(createBwithACourse.status).toBe(404);
    expect(createBwithACourse.body.error.code).toBe('COURSE_NOT_FOUND');
  });

  it('prevents course deletion if course has notes and suggests archive', async () => {
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/notes')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseAId,
        title: 'Catatan Penghalang Hapus',
        content: 'Isi catatan',
      });

    const deleteCourseRes = await request(app)
      .delete(`/api/courses/${courseAId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);

    expect(deleteCourseRes.status).toBe(409);
    expect(deleteCourseRes.body.error.code).toBe('COURSE_HAS_NOTES');
    expect(deleteCourseRes.body.error.message).toContain('arsip');
  });

  it('enforces read-only invariant on archived courses/semesters', async () => {
    // 1. Create note on active course
    const noteRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/notes')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseAId,
        title: 'Catatan Sebelum Arsip',
        content: 'Konten penting',
      });
    const noteId = noteRes.body.note.id;

    // 2. Archive courseA
    await request(app)
      .post(`/api/courses/${courseAId}/archive`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);

    // 3. Attempt to create new note on archived course -> 400 COURSE_ARCHIVED
    const newNoteRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/notes')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseAId,
        title: 'Catatan Baru Di Arsip',
      });
    expect(newNoteRes.status).toBe(400);
    expect(newNoteRes.body.error.code).toBe('COURSE_ARCHIVED');

    // 4. Attempt to update note on archived course -> 400 COURSE_ARCHIVED
    const editRes = await request(app)
      .patch(`/api/notes/${noteId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({ title: 'Edit Di Arsip', version: 1 });
    expect(editRes.status).toBe(400);
    expect(editRes.body.error.code).toBe('COURSE_ARCHIVED');

    // 5. Attempt to delete note on archived course -> 400 COURSE_ARCHIVED
    const deleteRes = await request(app)
      .delete(`/api/notes/${noteId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);
    expect(deleteRes.status).toBe(400);
    expect(deleteRes.body.error.code).toBe('COURSE_ARCHIVED');

    // 6. Reading note on archived course remains allowed (read-only)
    const readRes = await request(app)
      .get(`/api/notes/${noteId}`)
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);
    expect(readRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(readRes.body.note.title).toBe('Catatan Sebelum Arsip');
  });

  it('supports list without full content, search by title, and course/semester filters', async () => {
    await request(app)
      .post('/api/notes')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA)
      .send({
        courseId: courseAId,
        title: 'Catatan Teori Graph',
        content: 'Isi yang sangat panjang tidak perlu diunduh pada list view...',
      });

    const listRes = await request(app)
      .get('/api/notes?search=Graph')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .set('Cookie', cookieA);

    expect(listRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(listRes.body.notes.length).toBe(1);
    expect(listRes.body.notes[0].title).toBe('Catatan Teori Graph');
    // Note list items do not include the full content
    expect((listRes.body.notes[0] as any).content).toBeUndefined();
  });
});

import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test.use({ screenshot: 'off' });

test.describe('Assignments Redesign & Interactions Flow', () => {
  const testPassword = 'TestPassword123!';

  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    page.on('pageerror', (err) => console.error('[BROWSER EXCEPTION]:', err));
  });

  async function registerAndLogin(page: any) {
    const userEmail = `asg-flow-${Date.now()}-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000000)}@studyflow.test`;
    await page.goto('/register');
    await page.fill('#name', 'Assignment Tester');
    await page.fill('#email', userEmail);
    await page.fill('#password', testPassword);
    await page.click('button:has-text("Buat Akun")');
    await page.waitForURL('**/login?registered=true', { timeout: 15000 });

    await page.fill('#email', userEmail);
    await page.fill('#password', testPassword);
    await page.click('button:has-text("Masuk")');
    await page.waitForURL('**/dashboard', { timeout: 20000 });
  }

  async function setupSemesterAndCourse(page: any) {
    // 1. Semester
    await page.goto('/semesters');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Tambah Semester")');
    await page.fill('#create-sem-name', 'Semester Ganjil Asg');
    await page.fill('#create-sem-year', '2026/2027');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Simpan Semester")');
    await expect(page.locator('main').getByText('Semester Ganjil Asg')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // 2. Course
    await page.goto('/courses');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Tambah Mata Kuliah")');
    await page.selectOption('#create-course-sem', { index: 1 });
    await page.fill('#create-course-name', 'Algoritma & Struktur Data');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Simpan Mata Kuliah")');
    await expect(page.locator('main').getByText('Algoritma & Struktur Data')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
  }

  test('Alur lengkap: Tambah tugas, input retention, edit, status toggle, rollback error, search/filter, dan hapus tugas', async ({ page }) => {
    test.setTimeout(60000);
    await registerAndLogin(page);
    await setupSemesterAndCourse(page);

    // 1. Masuk ke halaman Tugas
    await page.goto('/assignments');
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/assignments/);

    // Verifikasi Header & Konteks Semester
    await expect(page.locator('h1')).toHaveText('Tugas');
    await expect(page.locator('main').getByText('Semester Ganjil Asg (2026/2027)')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
    await expect(page.locator('main').getByText('0 tugas terdaftar')).toBeVisible();

    // Verifikasi Empty Onboarding
    await expect(page.locator('text=Belum ada tugas kuliah')).toBeVisible();

    // 2. Tambah Tugas & Validasi Input Retention
    await page.click('button:has-text("Tambah tugas")');
    await expect(page.locator('text=Tambah Tugas Baru')).toBeVisible();

    // Coba submit dengan judul terlalu pendek (1 karakter) untuk menguji retensi input & error message
    await page.fill('#create-title', 'A');
    await page.click('#create-due');
    await page.locator('[data-slot="calendar"] button:not([disabled])').getByText('20', { exact: true }).first().click();
    await page.fill('#create-due-time', '23:59');
    await page.fill('#create-desc', 'Catatan penting mengenai kompleksitas algoritma.');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Simpan Tugas")');

    // Pesan error muncul dan form tidak di-reset
    await expect(page.locator('text=Judul tugas minimal 2 karakter')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('#create-due')).toContainText('20');
    await expect(page.locator('#create-due-time')).toHaveValue('23:59');
    await expect(page.locator('#create-desc')).toHaveValue('Catatan penting mengenai kompleksitas algoritma.');

    // Perbaiki judul tugas dan simpan
    await page.fill('#create-title', 'Tugas 1: Analisis Kompleksitas Waktu');
    await page.click('#create-priority');
    await page.click('[role="option"]:has-text("Tinggi")');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Simpan Tugas")');

    // Dialog tertutup dan item tugas muncul di tabel
    await expect(page.locator('text=Tambah Tugas Baru')).not.toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText('Tugas 1: Analisis Kompleksitas Waktu')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText('Tinggi')).toBeVisible();

    // 3. Edit Tugas
    // Buka menu aksi dropdown MoreVertical
    await page.click('table button[aria-label*="Menu aksi"]');
    await page.click('text=Edit tugas');

    // Dialog edit tugas terbuka
    await expect(page.locator('text=Edit Tugas')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('#edit-title')).toHaveValue('Tugas 1: Analisis Kompleksitas Waktu');

    // Ubah judul dan prioritas
    await page.fill('#edit-title', 'Tugas 1: Analisis Kompleksitas & Memori');
    await page.click('#edit-priority');
    await page.click('[role="option"]:has-text("Sedang")');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Simpan Perubahan")');

    // Verifikasi pembaruan di tabel
    await expect(page.locator('text=Edit Tugas')).not.toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText('Tugas 1: Analisis Kompleksitas & Memori')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText('Sedang')).toBeVisible();

    // 4. Toggle Status Tugas & Rollback pada Error Mutasi
    // Centang checkbox untuk menandai selesai
    const taskCheckbox = page.locator('table button[role="checkbox"]').first();
    await taskCheckbox.click();
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText('Selesai', { exact: true })).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // Uncheck kembali ke TODO
    await taskCheckbox.click();
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText('Mendatang')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // Uji kegagalan mutasi server: route mock 500 error
    await page.route('**/api/assignments/**', async (route) => {
      if (route.request().method() === 'PATCH') {
        await route.fulfill({
          status: 500,
          contentType: 'application/json',
          body: JSON.stringify({ error: { message: 'Koneksi jaringan server terputus saat update.' } }),
        });
      } else {
        await route.continue();
      }
    });

    // Klik checkbox saat server error
    await taskCheckbox.click();
    // Verifikasi alert error tampil dan rollback status ke TODO ("Mendatang")
    await expect(page.locator('text=Aksi tugas belum berhasil')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText('Mendatang')).toBeVisible();

    // Hapus mock route untuk interaksi selanjutnya
    await page.unroute('**/api/assignments/**');
    // Tutup error alert
    await page.click('button:has-text("Tutup")');

    // 5. Pencarian & Filter
    // Tambah tugas kedua
    await page.click('button:has-text("Tambah tugas")');
    await page.fill('#create-title', 'Tugas 2: Struktur Data Heap');
    await page.click('#create-due');
    await page.locator('[data-slot="calendar"] button:not([disabled])').getByText('25', { exact: true }).first().click();
    await page.selectOption('#create-priority', 'LOW');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Simpan Tugas")');
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText('Tugas 2: Struktur Data Heap')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // Cari tugas 2
    await page.fill('input[placeholder="Cari judul tugas..."]', 'Heap');
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText('Tugas 2: Struktur Data Heap')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText('Tugas 1: Analisis Kompleksitas & Memori')).not.toBeVisible();

    // Klik tombol Hapus filter
    await page.click('button:has-text("Hapus filter")');
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText('Tugas 1: Analisis Kompleksitas & Memori')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText('Tugas 2: Struktur Data Heap')).toBeVisible();

    // Cari dengan kata kunci yang tidak ada -> Empty filter view
    await page.fill('input[placeholder="Cari judul tugas..."]', 'KataKunciTidakDitemukan123');
    await expect(page.locator('text=Tidak ada tugas yang cocok')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
    await page.click('button:has-text("Hapus filter")');
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText('Tugas 1: Analisis Kompleksitas & Memori')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // 6. Dialog Hapus Tugas (Batal & Konfirmasi Destruktif)
    // Cari baris tugas kedua untuk dihapus
    const secondTaskRow = page.locator('tr').filter({ hasText: 'Tugas 2: Struktur Data Heap' });
    await secondTaskRow.locator('button[aria-label*="Menu aksi"]').click();
    await page.click('text=Hapus tugas');

    // Dialog hapus terbuka dan menyebutkan judul tugas
    await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Hapus Tugas' })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('text=Apakah Anda yakin ingin menghapus tugas')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]').getByText('Tugas 2: Struktur Data Heap')).toBeVisible();

    // Klik Batal terlebih dahulu
    await page.click('button:has-text("Batal")');
    await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Hapus Tugas' })).not.toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText('Tugas 2: Struktur Data Heap')).toBeVisible();

    // Buka lagi dialog dan konfirmasi Hapus
    await secondTaskRow.locator('button[aria-label*="Menu aksi"]').click();
    await page.click('text=Hapus tugas');
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Hapus Tugas' }).click();

    // Verifikasi dialog tertutup dan tugas kedua terhapus dari daftar
    await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Hapus Tugas' })).not.toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText('Tugas 2: Struktur Data Heap')).not.toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText('Tugas 1: Analisis Kompleksitas & Memori')).toBeVisible();
  });
});

test.describe('StudyFlow Flashcard and Quiz Functional Verification (Stage 13)', () => {
  test('Verify Flashcard study player, Quiz attempt, tab switching retention, draft save failure retention, and review', async ({

    await page.locator('div[role="tabpanel"]:not([hidden]) button:has-text("Sudah Paham")').click();
    await expect(page.locator('text=Kartu 2 dari')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
    await expect(page.locator('text=1 Paham')).toBeVisible();

    // 6d. Uji Navigasi Stepper "Sebelumnya" & "Selanjutnya"
    await page.locator('div[role="tabpanel"]:not([hidden]) button:has-text("Sebelumnya")').click();
    await expect(page.locator('text=Kartu 1 dari')).toBeVisible();
    await page.locator('div[role="tabpanel"]:not([hidden]) button:has-text("Selanjutnya")').click();
    await expect(page.locator('text=Kartu 2 dari')).toBeVisible();

    // =========================================================================
    // 7. UJI TAB KUIS & RETENSI JAWABAN SAAT GANTI TAB
    // =========================================================================
    await page.click('button[role="tab"]:has-text("Kuis")');

    // 7a. Verifikasi Empty State & Buat Kuis Baru
    await expect(page.locator('text=Belum Ada Kuis')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
    await page.locator('div[role="tabpanel"]:not([hidden]) button:has-text("Buat Kuis Sekarang")').click();
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"] h2:has-text("Buat Kuis dengan AI")')).toBeVisible();
    await page.click('button:has-text("Mulai Pembuatan")');
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]')).not.toBeVisible();

    // Tunggu Kuis siap & Tampilkan Halaman Pengantar (Landing Screen)
    await expect(page.locator('button:has-text("Mulai Kerjakan Kuis")')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 45000 });
    await page.click('button:has-text("Mulai Kerjakan Kuis")');

    // 7b. Verifikasi Runner Pengerjaan Soal 1
    await expect(page.locator('text=Soal 1 dari 5')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 15000 });
    await expect(page.locator('text=0 / 5 Terjawab')).toBeVisible();

    // Pilih opsi radio pertama (A)
    const optionA = page.locator('div[aria-label^="Pilihan jawaban"] button[role="radio"]').first();
    await optionA.click();

    // Verifikasi semantik radio terpilih dan progres terupdate
    await expect(optionA).toHaveAttribute('aria-checked', 'true');
    await expect(page.locator('text=1 / 5 Terjawab')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // Tunggu konfirmasi draft tersimpan dari server
    await expect(page.locator('text=Tersimpan')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 15000 });

    // 7c. VERIFIKASI RETENSI JAWABAN: GANTI KE TAB LAIN LALU KEMBALI
    // Berpindah ke tab "Dokumen PDF"
    await page.click('button[role="tab"]:has-text("Dokumen PDF")');
    await expect(page.locator('iframe[title^="Pratinjau PDF"]')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // Kembali ke tab "Kuis"
    await page.click('button[role="tab"]:has-text("Kuis")');

    // Verifikasi jawaban soal 1 TETAP TERPILIH dan progres TETAP 1 / 5 Terjawab
    await expect(page.locator('text=Soal 1 dari 5')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('text=1 / 5 Terjawab')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(optionA).toHaveAttribute('aria-checked', 'true');

    // =========================================================================
    // 8. UJI KEGAGALAN PENYIMPANAN DRAFT YANG MEMPERTAHANKAN JAWABAN & RETRY
    // =========================================================================
    // Pindah ke Soal 2
    await page.locator('div[role="tabpanel"]:not([hidden]) button:has-text("Selanjutnya")').click();
    await expect(page.locator('text=Soal 2 dari 5')).toBeVisible();

    // Intercept endpoint PATCH draft answers untuk mensimulasikan kegagalan jaringan
    let simulateFailure = true;
    await page.route('**/api/attempts/*/answers', async (route) => {
      if (simulateFailure && route.request().method() === 'PATCH') {
        simulateFailure = false;
        await route.abort('failed');
      } else {
        await route.continue();
      }
    });

    // Pilih opsi B (indeks 1) pada Soal 2 saat server error disimulasikan
    const optionB = page.locator('div[aria-label^="Pilihan jawaban"] button[role="radio"]').nth(1);
    await optionB.click();

    // Verifikasi indikator error / retry muncul
    await expect(
      page.locator('text=Gagal simpan (Coba lagi)').or(page.locator('text=Gagal menyimpan draft'))
    ).toBeVisible({ timeout: 15000 });

    // Verifikasi jawaban pilihan B TETAP DIPERTAHANKAN (tidak ter-reset)
    await expect(optionB).toHaveAttribute('aria-checked', 'true');
    await expect(page.locator('text=2 / 5 Terjawab')).toBeVisible();

    // Hapus intercept route dan lakukan retry simpan
    await page.unroute('**/api/attempts/*/answers');
    const retryBtn = page.locator('button:has-text("Gagal simpan (Coba lagi)"), button:has-text("Coba Lagi")').first();
    await retryBtn.click();

    // Verifikasi draft berhasil tersimpan setelah retry
    await expect(page.locator('text=Tersimpan')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 15000 });

    // Jawab sisa soal (3, 4, 5) menggunakan kisi nomor soal
    // Soal 3
    await page.locator('button[title^="Buka soal 3"]').click();
    await page.locator('div[aria-label^="Pilihan jawaban"] button[role="radio"]').first().click();

    // Soal 4

      path: path.join(screenshotsDir, 'material-upload-dialog-mobile-dark.png'),
    });

    // Dialog Mobile 375px Light
    await setTheme('light');
    await page.screenshot({
      path: path.join(screenshotsDir, 'material-upload-dialog-mobile-light.png'),
    });

    // =========================================================================
    // 6. VERIFIKASI RETENSI INPUT SAAT UPLOAD GAGAL & RETRY SUKSES TERISOLASI
    // =========================================================================
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 900 });
    await page.click('#upload-course');
    await page.locator('[role="option"]').first().click();
    const longTitle =
      'Modul Perkuliahan Komprehensif Protokol Jaringan Komputer, TCP/IP, dan Model OSI Layer';
    await page.fill('#upload-title', longTitle);

    const fileChooserPromise = page.waitForEvent('filechooser');

    // Verifikasi bahwa nama file dan mata kuliah muncul di dropzone
    await expect(page.locator('text=sample.pdf')).toBeVisible();

    // 6a. Uji kegagalan upload: gagalkan inisiasi upload sekali untuk memverifikasi retensi input
    let failUploadOnce = true;
    await page.route('**/api/materials/initiate-upload', async (route) => {
      if (failUploadOnce && route.request().method() === 'POST') {
        failUploadOnce = false;
        await route.abort('failed');
      } else {
        await route.continue();
      }
    });

    // Submit saat simulasi error aktif
    await page.locator('div[role="dialog"] button:has-text("Unggah Materi")').click();

    // Verifikasi error alert muncul dan input form TETAP DIPERTAHANKAN (tidak terhapus)
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"] [role="alert"]')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
    await expect(page.locator('#upload-title')).toHaveValue(longTitle);
    await expect(page.locator('#upload-course')).not.toHaveText('Pilih mata kuliah...');
    await expect(page.locator('text=sample.pdf')).toBeVisible();

    // Unroute untuk retry normal
    await page.unroute('**/api/materials/initiate-upload');

    // 6b. Retry submit tanpa mengisi ulang formulir
    await page.locator('div[role="dialog"] button:has-text("Unggah Materi")').click();
    await expect(page.locator('text=File berhasil diterima')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 20000 });

    // Tunggu dialog menutup otomatis dan tabel materi muncul
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]')).not.toBeVisible({ timeout: 15000 });
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText('Siap dipelajari')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 45000 });

    // Tambah materi kedua untuk variasi daftar
    await page.click('button:has-text("Unggah materi")');
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"] h2:has-text("Unggah Materi PDF")')).toBeVisible();
    await page.click('#upload-course');
    await page.locator('[role="option"]').first().click();
    await page.fill('#upload-title', 'Slide Presentasi Arsitektur DNS dan Routing BGP');
    const fileChooser2Promise = page.waitForEvent('filechooser');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Pilih Berkas PDF")');
    const fileChooser2 = await fileChooser2Promise;
    await fileChooser2.setFiles(path.resolve('apps/web/e2e/fixtures/sample.pdf'));
    await page.locator('div[role="dialog"] button:has-text("Unggah Materi")').click();
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="dialog"]')).not.toBeVisible({ timeout: 15000 });
    await expect(page.locator('table').getByText('Slide Presentasi Arsitektur DNS')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 45000 });

    // =========================================================================
    // 7. SCREENSHOT: DAFTAR MATERI TERISI (DESKTOP & MOBILE, LIGHT & DARK)
    // =========================================================================

    // Desktop Light (1440x900)
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 900 });
    await setTheme('light');
    await page.screenshot({
      path: path.join(screenshotsDir, 'materials-desktop-light.png'),
      fullPage: true,
    });

    // Desktop Dark (1440x900)
    await setTheme('dark');
    await page.screenshot({

<file path="apps/web/e2e/note-navigation.spec.ts">
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test.use({ screenshot: 'off' });

test.describe('Note Editor Unsaved Changes & Navigation Guard', () => {
  const testPassword = 'TestPassword123!';

  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    page.on('pageerror', (err) => console.error('[BROWSER EXCEPTION]:', err));
  });

  // Helper register and login with unique user per test
  async function registerAndLogin(page: any) {
    const userEmail = `note-nav-${Date.now()}-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000000)}@studyflow.test`;
    await page.goto('/register');
    await page.fill('#name', 'Note Guard Tester');
    await page.fill('#email', userEmail);
    await page.fill('#password', testPassword);
    await page.click('button:has-text("Buat Akun")');
    await page.waitForURL('**/login?registered=true', { timeout: 15000 });

    await page.fill('#email', userEmail);
    await page.fill('#password', testPassword);
    await page.click('button:has-text("Masuk")');
    await page.waitForURL('**/dashboard', { timeout: 20000 });
  }

  // Setup semester, course, and initial note
  async function setupNote(page: any) {
    // 1. Semester
    await page.goto('/semesters');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Tambah Semester")');
    await page.fill('#create-sem-name', 'Semester Nav Guard');
    await page.fill('#create-sem-year', '2026/2027');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Simpan Semester")');
    await expect(page.locator('text=Semester Nav Guard')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // 2. Course
    await page.goto('/courses');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Tambah Mata Kuliah")');
    await page.selectOption('#create-course-sem', { index: 1 });
    await page.fill('#create-course-name', 'Logika Komputasi');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Simpan Mata Kuliah")');
    await expect(page.locator('text=Logika Komputasi')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // 3. Note
    await page.goto('/notes');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Buat Catatan")');
    await page.fill('#create-note-title', 'Catatan Proposisi');
    await page.selectOption('#create-note-course', { index: 1 });
    await page.fill('#create-note-content', 'Konten awal catatan');
    await page.click('button:has-text("Buat & Buka Editor")');
    await page.waitForURL('**/notes/**', { timeout: 15000 });
    await expect(page.locator('input[placeholder="Judul Catatan..."]')).toHaveValue('Catatan Proposisi');
  }

  test('1. Browser Back/Forward navigation guard: anti-loop, retain state on stay, and clean unmount', async ({ page }) => {
    await registerAndLogin(page);
    await setupNote(page);

    // Bangun urutan navigasi eksplisit: Dashboard -> Daftar Catatan -> Editor
    await page.goto('/dashboard');
    await page.waitForURL('**/dashboard', { timeout: 10000 });
    expect(new URL(page.url()).pathname).toBe('/dashboard');

    await page.click('a[href="/notes"]');
    await page.waitForURL('**/notes', { timeout: 10000 });
    expect(new URL(page.url()).pathname).toBe('/notes');

    await page.click('text=Catatan Proposisi');
    await page.waitForURL('**/notes/**', { timeout: 10000 });
    const noteUrl = page.url();
    expect(new URL(noteUrl).pathname).toMatch(/^\/notes\/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/);

    // Pastikan status awal tersimpan
    await expect(page.locator('text=Tersimpan')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 5000 });

    // 1. Ketik perubahan (dirty)
    const textarea = page.locator('textarea');
    await textarea.fill('Konten dirty browser back test');
    await expect(page.locator('text=Belum disimpan')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 5000 });

    // 2. Tekan Browser Back
    await page.goBack();

    // Dialog konfirmasi harus muncul
    const dialog = page.locator('[data-testid="unsaved-changes-dialog"]');
    await expect(dialog).toBeVisible({ timeout: 5000 });

    // 3. Opsi "Tetap mengedit"
    await page.click('[data-testid="confirm-stay-and-edit"]');
    await expect(dialog).not.toBeVisible();

    // Verifikasi URL, isi editor, dan posisi navigasi dipertahankan
    expect(page.url()).toBe(noteUrl);
    await expect(textarea).toHaveValue('Konten dirty browser back test');
    await expect(page.locator('text=Belum disimpan')).toBeVisible();

    // 4. Ulangi Browser Back (verifikasi tidak loop atau menumpuk sentinel)
    await page.goBack();
    await expect(dialog).toBeVisible({ timeout: 5000 });

    // 5. Opsi "Buang perubahan dan lanjutkan" -> harus menuju halaman tujuan yang tepat (/notes)
    await page.click('[data-testid="confirm-discard-and-leave"]');
    await page.waitForURL('**/notes', { timeout: 10000 });
    expect(new URL(page.url()).pathname).toBe('/notes');

    // 6. Buktikan posisi history: Back dari /notes harus menuju /dashboard
    await page.goBack();
    await page.waitForURL('**/dashboard', { timeout: 10000 });
    expect(new URL(page.url()).pathname).toBe('/dashboard');

    // 7. Verifikasi listener dan sentinel bersih saat editor ditinggalkan
    // Berada di /dashboard, navigasi ke /courses tidak memunculkan dialog guard catatan
    await page.click('a[href="/courses"]');
    await page.waitForURL('**/courses', { timeout: 10000 });
    await expect(dialog).not.toBeVisible();
  });

  test('2. "Simpan dan lanjutkan" tidak berpindah dan tulisan tetap utuh saat API update gagal HTTP 500', async ({ page }) => {
    await registerAndLogin(page);
    await setupNote(page);

    const noteUrl = page.url();

    // Ketik perubahan
    const textarea = page.locator('textarea');
    await textarea.fill('Perubahan penting yang akan menemui server error 500');
    await expect(page.locator('text=Belum disimpan')).toBeVisible();

    // Intercept API PATCH untuk menyimulasikan server failure 500
    await page.route('**/api/notes/*', async (route) => {
      if (route.request().method() === 'PATCH') {
        await route.fulfill({
          status: 500,
          contentType: 'application/json',
          body: JSON.stringify({
            error: {
              code: 'INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR',
              message: 'Gagal menghubungi database server cluster',
            },
          }),
        });
      } else {
        await route.continue();
      }
    });

    // Coba navigasi ke Dashboard melalui link
    await page.click('a[href="/dashboard"]');

    // Dialog muncul
    const dialog = page.locator('[data-testid="unsaved-changes-dialog"]');
    await expect(dialog).toBeVisible({ timeout: 5000 });

    // Klik "Simpan dan lanjutkan"
    await page.click('[data-testid="confirm-save-and-leave"]');

    // Dialog tertutup, TIDAK BERPINDAH, dan error ditampilkan
    await expect(dialog).not.toBeVisible();
    expect(page.url()).toBe(noteUrl);
    await expect(page.locator('text=Gagal menghubungi database server cluster')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 5000 });

    // Tulisan lokal di textarea TETAP UTUH!
    await expect(textarea).toHaveValue('Perubahan penting yang akan menemui server error 500');
  });

  test('3. Tunda respons save lalu ketik perubahan in-flight: perubahan tidak hilang dan tidak berpindah jika masih dirty', async ({ page }) => {
    await registerAndLogin(page);
    await setupNote(page);

    const noteUrl = page.url();

    const textarea = page.locator('textarea');
    await textarea.fill('Teks Dasar Awal');
    await expect(page.locator('text=Belum disimpan')).toBeVisible();

    // Delay response save 1200ms
    await page.route('**/api/notes/*', async (route) => {
      if (route.request().method() === 'PATCH') {
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1200));
        await route.continue();
      } else {
        await route.continue();
      }
    });

    // Klik tombol kembali di UI
    await page.click('a[aria-label="Kembali ke daftar catatan"], a[href="/notes"]');

    const dialog = page.locator('[data-testid="unsaved-changes-dialog"]');
    await expect(dialog).toBeVisible({ timeout: 5000 });

    // Klik "Simpan dan lanjutkan"
    await page.click('[data-testid="confirm-save-and-leave"]');

    // Saat proses menyimpan sedang in-flight, ketik teks tambahan baru di textarea
    await expect(page.locator('text=Menyimpan dan melanjutkan…')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 2000 });
    await textarea.pressSequentially(' + Tambahan Karakter Saat Simpan Berlangsung!');

    // Tunggu request selesai
    // Karena masih ada perubahan yang belum tersimpan saat request selesai, sistem TIDAK BOLEH berpindah!
    await expect(dialog).not.toBeVisible();
    expect(page.url()).toBe(noteUrl);

    // Status harus tetap dirty
    await expect(page.locator('text=Belum disimpan')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 5000 });

    // Seluruh teks (termasuk karakter in-flight) tidak hilang dan tetap utuh di textarea
    await expect(textarea).toHaveValue('Teks Dasar Awal + Tambahan Karakter Saat Simpan Berlangsung!');
  });

  test('4. Konflik versi mempertahankan tulisan lokal dan menampilkan banner konflik', async ({ page, request }) => {
    await registerAndLogin(page);
    await setupNote(page);

    const noteUrl = page.url();
    const noteId = noteUrl.split('/notes/')[1].split('?')[0];

    // Ketik tulisan lokal baru di browser
    const textarea = page.locator('textarea');
    await textarea.fill('Tulisan lokal penting di Tab A');
    await expect(page.locator('text=Belum disimpan')).toBeVisible();

    // Lakukan update dari sesi eksternal (mensimulasikan Tab B yang berhasil menyimpan versi 2)
    const cookies = await page.context().cookies();
    const cookieHeader = cookies.map((c) => `${c.name}=${c.value}`).join('; ');

    const patchRes = await request.patch(`http://localhost:4100/api/notes/${noteId}`, {
      headers: {
        Cookie: cookieHeader,
        Origin: 'http://localhost:3100',
      },
      data: {
        version: 1,
        content: 'Konten yang disimpan oleh Tab B di server',
      },
    });
    expect(patchRes.status()).toBe(200);

    // Sekarang klik "Simpan" di editor browser (yang masih mengira version = 1)
    await page.click('button:has-text("Simpan")');

    // Harus muncul banner konflik versi
    await expect(page.locator('text=Konflik Versi Catatan')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // Tulisan lokal pengguna di textarea HARUS TETAP UTUH!
    await expect(textarea).toHaveValue('Tulisan lokal penting di Tab A');
  });
});

'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import { ArrowLeft, Loader2, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle, Mail, Info } from 'lucide-react';
import { ForgotPasswordInput, ForgotPasswordInputSchema } from '@studyflow/shared';
import { apiForgotPassword } from '@/lib/auth-client';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import {
  Card,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
  CardDescription,
  CardContent,
  CardFooter,
} from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Alert, AlertTitle, AlertDescription } from '@/components/ui/alert';
import { TurnstileWidget, TurnstileWidgetHandle } from '@/components/auth/turnstile-widget';

export default function ForgotPasswordPage(): React.JSX.Element {
  const [serverError, setServerError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [turnstileToken, setTurnstileToken] = React.useState<string>('');
  const turnstileRef = React.useRef<TurnstileWidgetHandle>(null);

  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    setValue,
    formState: { errors, isSubmitting },
  } = useForm<ForgotPasswordInput>({
    resolver: zodResolver(ForgotPasswordInputSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      email: '',
      turnstileToken: '',
    },
  });

  const handleTurnstileVerify = (token: string) => {
    setTurnstileToken(token);
    setValue('turnstileToken', token, { shouldValidate: true });
    setServerError(null);
  };

  const handleTurnstileExpire = () => {
    setTurnstileToken('');
    setValue('turnstileToken', '', { shouldValidate: true });
  };

  const onSubmit = async (data: ForgotPasswordInput) => {
    setServerError(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);
    try {
      const res = await apiForgotPassword(data.email, data.turnstileToken);
      setSuccessMessage(res.message);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setServerError(err.message || 'Gagal mengirim permintaan reset kata sandi.');
      // Reset Turnstile token on failure
      setTurnstileToken('');
      setValue('turnstileToken', '');
      turnstileRef.current?.reset();
    }
  };

  return (
    <Card className="w-full">
      <CardHeader className="space-y-1">
        <CardTitle className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">
          Lupa Kata Sandi
        </CardTitle>
        <CardDescription className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          Masukkan alamat email akun StudyFlow Anda untuk menerima tautan pengaturan ulang kata sandi.
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>

      {successMessage ? (
        <CardContent className="space-y-4">
          <Alert
            variant="default"
            className="border-emerald-500/40 bg-emerald-50/50 dark:bg-emerald-950/20 text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-300"
          >
            <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
            <AlertTitle className="font-semibold text-sm">Permintaan Dikirim</AlertTitle>
            <AlertDescription className="text-xs sm:text-sm">
              {successMessage}
            </AlertDescription>
          </Alert>

          <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/20 p-4 text-xs text-muted-foreground space-y-2">
            <p className="font-medium text-foreground">Langkah Selanjutnya:</p>
            <ul className="list-disc list-inside space-y-1">
              <li>Periksa kotak masuk (inbox) atau folder spam pada email Anda.</li>
              <li>Tautan reset hanya berlaku selama <strong>30 menit</strong> sejak dibuat.</li>
              <li>Jika email tidak kunjung tiba, pastikan Anda mendaftar dengan email dan password lokal.</li>
            </ul>
          </div>

          <div className="pt-2">
            <Link href="/login" className="block w-full">
              <Button variant="outline" className="w-full h-10 gap-2">
                <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
                <span>Kembali ke Halaman Masuk</span>
              </Button>
            </Link>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      ) : (
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} noValidate>
          <CardContent className="space-y-4">
            {serverError && (
              <Alert variant="destructive" role="alert">
                <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
                <AlertDescription className="text-xs sm:text-sm break-words">
                  {serverError}
                </AlertDescription>
              </Alert>
            )}

            {/* Email Field */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="email" className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
                Alamat Email
              </Label>
              <div className="relative">
                <Input
                  id="email"
                  type="email"
                  autoComplete="email"
                  placeholder="nama@kampus.ac.id"
                  disabled={isSubmitting}
                  aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.email)}
                  aria-describedby={errors.email ? 'email-error' : undefined}
                  className="h-10 text-sm pl-10"
                  {...register('email')}
                />
                <Mail className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground pointer-events-none" />
              </div>
              {errors.email && (
                <p id="email-error" className="text-xs font-medium text-destructive">
                  {errors.email.message}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Google Notice */}
            <div className="rounded-lg border border-border/60 bg-muted/30 p-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground flex items-start gap-2.5">
              <Info className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <p>
                Daftar menggunakan Google? Anda tidak memiliki kata sandi lokal.{' '}
                <Link href="/login" className="text-primary font-semibold hover:underline">
                  Gunakan Lanjutkan dengan Google
                </Link>{' '}
                pada halaman masuk.
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Cloudflare Turnstile Verification Widget */}
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <TurnstileWidget
                ref={turnstileRef}
                action="forgot_password"
                onVerify={handleTurnstileVerify}
                onExpire={handleTurnstileExpire}
                onError={(err) => setServerError(err || 'Verifikasi keamanan gagal. Silakan coba lagi.')}
              />
              {errors.turnstileToken && (
                <p className="text-center text-xs font-medium text-destructive">
                  {errors.turnstileToken.message}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
          </CardContent>

          <CardFooter className="flex flex-col gap-3">
            <Button
              type="submit"
              disabled={isSubmitting || !turnstileToken}
              className="w-full h-10 font-semibold"
            >
              {isSubmitting ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                  <span>Mengirim tautan...</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                'Kirim Tautan Reset'
              )}
            </Button>

            <div className="text-center">
              <Link
                href="/login"
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground font-medium transition-colors"
              >
                <ArrowLeft className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                <span>Batal dan kembali ke Masuk</span>
              </Link>
            </div>
          </CardFooter>
        </form>
      )}
    </Card>
  );
}

<file path="apps/web/src/components/dashboard/today-schedule-widget.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import {
  CalendarClock,
  Clock,
  MapPin,
  ArrowRight,
  RefreshCw,
  AlertTriangle,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle2,
  CircleDot,
  CalendarCheck2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  CourseSchedule,
  CourseScheduleConflict,
  getDayNameId,
} from '@studyflow/shared';
import { listSchedules } from '@/lib/schedule-client';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';
import { Alert, AlertDescription, AlertTitle } from '@/components/ui/alert';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export interface TodayScheduleWidgetProps {
  activeSemesterId?: string | null;
  activeSemesterName?: string | null;
  timezone: string;
  className?: string;
}

export type ScheduleTimeStatus = 'UPCOMING' | 'ONGOING' | 'COMPLETED';

/**
 * Menghitung hari, jam-menit, dan tanggal saat ini berdasarkan zona waktu pengguna.
 */
export function getNowInTimezone(timezone: string): {
  dayOfWeek: number;
  currentTime: string;
  dateKey: string;
} {
  try {
    const now = new Date();
    const weekdayStr = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
      timeZone: timezone,
      weekday: 'short',
    }).format(now);

    const dayMap: Record<string, number> = {
      Mon: 1,
      Tue: 2,
      Wed: 3,
      Thu: 4,
      Fri: 5,
      Sat: 6,
      Sun: 7,
    };
    const dayOfWeek = dayMap[weekdayStr] || 1;

    const timeFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', {
      timeZone: timezone,
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
      hour12: false,
    });
    const currentTime = timeFormatter.format(now);

    const dateFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {
      timeZone: timezone,
      year: 'numeric',
      month: '2-digit',
      day: '2-digit',
    });
    const dateKey = dateFormatter.format(now);

    return { dayOfWeek, currentTime, dateKey };
  } catch {
    const now = new Date();
    const dayOfWeek = now.getDay() === 0 ? 7 : now.getDay();
    const currentTime = `${String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(
      now.getMinutes()
    ).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    const dateKey = now.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    return { dayOfWeek, currentTime, dateKey };
  }
}

/**
 * Menentukan status waktu sesi lokal:
 * - UPCOMING: waktu sekarang sebelum mulai (now < startTime)
 * - ONGOING: mulai <= sekarang < selesai (startTime <= now < endTime)
 * - COMPLETED: sekarang >= selesai (now >= endTime)
 */
export function getScheduleTimeStatus(
  startTime: string,
  endTime: string,
  currentTime: string
): ScheduleTimeStatus {
  if (currentTime < startTime) {
    return 'UPCOMING';
  }
  if (currentTime >= endTime) {
    return 'COMPLETED';
  }
  return 'ONGOING';
}

export function TodayScheduleWidget({
  activeSemesterId,
  activeSemesterName,
  timezone,
  className,
}: TodayScheduleWidgetProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const [schedules, setSchedules] = React.useState<CourseSchedule[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = React.useState(true);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  // Time tracking states
  const [isMounted, setIsMounted] = React.useState(false);
  const [currentTime, setCurrentTime] = React.useState('00:00');
  const [currentDayOfWeek, setCurrentDayOfWeek] = React.useState(1);
  const [currentDateKey, setCurrentDateKey] = React.useState('');

  // Race condition guard for semester fetches
  const fetchRequestIdRef = React.useRef(0);

  // 1. Fetch jadwal hari ini untuk semester aktif
  const fetchTodaySchedules = React.useCallback(
    async (semId?: string | null, targetDay?: number) => {
      if (!semId) {
        setSchedules([]);
        setIsLoading(false);
        setErrorMsg(null);
        return;
      }

      const reqId = ++fetchRequestIdRef.current;
      setIsLoading(true);
      setErrorMsg(null);

      try {
        const day = targetDay ?? getNowInTimezone(timezone).dayOfWeek;
        const res = await listSchedules({ semesterId: semId, dayOfWeek: day });

        // Abaikan respons terlambat dari semester sebelumnya
        if (reqId === fetchRequestIdRef.current) {
          // Urutkan berdasarkan waktu mulai (asc)
          const sorted = [...res.schedules].sort((a, b) =>
            a.startTime.localeCompare(b.startTime)
          );
          setSchedules(sorted);
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        if (reqId === fetchRequestIdRef.current) {
          setErrorMsg(err.message || 'Gagal memuat jadwal hari ini.');
        }
      } finally {
        if (reqId === fetchRequestIdRef.current) {
          setIsLoading(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [timezone]
  );

  // 2. Sinkronisasi waktu dan muat jadwal saat semester aktif atau timezone berubah
  React.useEffect(() => {
    setIsMounted(true);
    const nowInfo = getNowInTimezone(timezone);
    setCurrentTime(nowInfo.currentTime);
    setCurrentDayOfWeek(nowInfo.dayOfWeek);
    setCurrentDateKey(nowInfo.dateKey);

    if (activeSemesterId) {
      fetchTodaySchedules(activeSemesterId, nowInfo.dayOfWeek);
    } else {
      setSchedules([]);
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [timezone, activeSemesterId, fetchTodaySchedules]);

  // 2b. Listener langsung terhadap event pergantian semester global
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleSemesterChange = (e: Event) => {
      const customEvent = e as CustomEvent<{ semesterId?: string }>;
      const newSemId = customEvent.detail?.semesterId;
      if (newSemId) {
        const nowInfo = getNowInTimezone(timezone);
        fetchTodaySchedules(newSemId, nowInfo.dayOfWeek);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('studyflow:semester-changed', handleSemesterChange);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('studyflow:semester-changed', handleSemesterChange);
    };
  }, [timezone, fetchTodaySchedules]);

  // 4. Timer lokal 1 menit & Listener pergantian hari / visibility change
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!isMounted) return;

    const checkTimeAndDate = () => {
      const nowInfo = getNowInTimezone(timezone);
      setCurrentTime(nowInfo.currentTime);

      // Jika tanggal/hari berganti menurut zona waktu pengguna, perbarui daftar hari ini
      if (nowInfo.dateKey !== currentDateKey || nowInfo.dayOfWeek !== currentDayOfWeek) {
        setCurrentDateKey(nowInfo.dateKey);
        setCurrentDayOfWeek(nowInfo.dayOfWeek);
        if (activeSemesterId) {
          fetchTodaySchedules(activeSemesterId, nowInfo.dayOfWeek);
        }
      }
    };

    // Jalankan timer per menit tanpa request API per menit
    const intervalId = window.setInterval(checkTimeAndDate, 60000);

    // Saat tab browser kembali aktif, sinkronkan waktu lokal
    const handleVisibilityChange = () => {
      if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
        checkTimeAndDate();
      }
    };
    const handleWindowFocus = () => {
      checkTimeAndDate();
    };

    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);
    window.addEventListener('focus', handleWindowFocus);

    return () => {
      window.clearInterval(intervalId);
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);
      window.removeEventListener('focus', handleWindowFocus);
    };
  }, [
    isMounted,
    timezone,
    currentDateKey,
    currentDayOfWeek,
    activeSemesterId,
    fetchTodaySchedules,
  ]);

  const dayName = isMounted ? getDayNameId(currentDayOfWeek) : 'Hari Ini';

  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-xs flex flex-col justify-between",
        className
      )}
      data-testid="today-schedule-widget"
    >
      <div className="flex flex-col flex-1">
        {/* Header Widget */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3.5 border-b border-border">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
            <CalendarClock className="h-4 w-4 text-primary shrink-0" />
            <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground truncate">
              Jadwal Hari Ini
            </h2>
            {isMounted && !isLoading && schedules.length > 0 && (
              <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs shrink-0 font-medium ml-0.5">
                {schedules.length}
              </Badge>
            )}
          </div>
          <Button asChild variant="ghost" size="sm" className="h-8 px-2 text-xs shrink-0">
            <Link href="/schedule" className="gap-1">
              <span>Lihat jadwal</span>
              <ArrowRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </Link>
          </Button>
        </div>

        {/* Content Section */}
        <div className="mt-3 flex-1 flex flex-col justify-center">
          {/* A. Loading State */}
          {isLoading && (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {[1, 2].map((idx) => (
                <div
                  key={idx}
                  className="rounded-lg border border-border/70 p-3 bg-muted/20 space-y-2"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <Skeleton className="h-4 w-28" />
                    <Skeleton className="h-5 w-20 rounded-md" />
                  </div>
                  <Skeleton className="h-4 w-40" />
                  <Skeleton className="h-3 w-24" />
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* B. Error State Terisolasi */}
          {!isLoading && errorMsg && (
            <Alert variant="destructive" className="py-3">
              <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
              <AlertTitle className="text-xs font-semibold">Gagal Memuat Jadwal</AlertTitle>
              <AlertDescription className="text-xs mt-1 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <span>{errorMsg}</span>
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => fetchTodaySchedules(activeSemesterId, currentDayOfWeek)}
                  className="h-7 px-2 text-xs w-fit"
                >
                  <RefreshCw className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
                  <span>Coba lagi</span>
                </Button>
              </AlertDescription>
            </Alert>
          )}

          {/* C. Belum Ada Semester Aktif */}
          {!isLoading && !errorMsg && !activeSemesterId && (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-5 text-center text-muted-foreground">
              <CalendarClock className="h-6 w-6 text-muted-foreground/60 mb-2" />
              <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
                Belum ada semester aktif
              </p>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5 max-w-xs">
                Aktifkan semester akademik untuk menampilkan jadwal kuliah hari ini.
              </p>
              <Button asChild size="sm" variant="outline" className="mt-3 text-xs h-8">
                <Link href="/semesters">Pilih Semester</Link>
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* D. Empty State: Tidak Ada Kelas Hari Ini */}
          {!isLoading && !errorMsg && activeSemesterId && schedules.length === 0 && (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-6 sm:py-8 my-auto text-center text-muted-foreground">
              <div className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary/10 text-primary mb-2">
                <CalendarCheck2 className="h-4.5 w-4.5" />
              </div>
              <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
                Tidak ada kelas hari ini ({dayName})
              </p>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5 max-w-xs leading-relaxed">
                Gunakan waktu luang untuk mempelajari materi atau menyelesaikan tugas kuliah.
              </p>
              <Button asChild size="sm" variant="outline" className="mt-3 text-xs h-8">
                <Link href="/schedule">Buka Jadwal Lengkap</Link>
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* E. List Sesi Jadwal Hari Ini */}
          {!isLoading && !errorMsg && activeSemesterId && schedules.length > 0 && (
            <div className="space-y-2.5">
              {schedules.map((sched) => {
                const status = isMounted
                  ? getScheduleTimeStatus(sched.startTime, sched.endTime, currentTime)
                  : 'UPCOMING';
                const hasConflict = sched.hasConflict;

                return (
                  <div
                    key={sched.id}
                    className={`rounded-lg border p-3 transition-colors space-y-1.5 ${
                      status === 'ONGOING'
                        ? 'border-primary/60 bg-primary/5 shadow-2xs'
                        : hasConflict
                        ? 'border-destructive/40 bg-destructive/[0.03]'
                        : 'border-border/80 bg-muted/15 hover:bg-muted/30'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {/* Waktu & Status Badge */}
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-mono text-xs font-bold text-foreground">
                        <Clock
                          className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 ${
                            status === 'ONGOING' ? 'text-primary' : 'text-muted-foreground'
                          }`}
                        />
                        <span>
                          {sched.startTime} – {sched.endTime}
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      {/* Status Waktu dengan teks & ikon semantik */}
                      {status === 'ONGOING' ? (
                        <Badge
                          variant="default"
                          className="text-[11px] py-0 px-2 gap-1 font-semibold bg-primary text-primary-foreground"
                        >
                          <CircleDot className="h-3 w-3 animate-pulse" />
                          <span>Berlangsung</span>
                        </Badge>
                      ) : status === 'COMPLETED' ? (
                        <Badge
                          variant="secondary"
                          className="text-[11px] py-0 px-2 gap-1 font-normal text-muted-foreground bg-muted"
                        >
                          <CheckCircle2 className="h-3 w-3 text-muted-foreground" />
                          <span>Selesai</span>
                        </Badge>
                      ) : (
                        <Badge
                          variant="outline"
                          className="text-[11px] py-0 px-2 gap-1 font-normal text-muted-foreground border-border"
                        >
                          <Clock className="h-3 w-3 text-muted-foreground" />
                          <span>Akan datang</span>
                        </Badge>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {/* Nama Mata Kuliah (Bisa diklik untuk melihat detail) */}
                    <div>
                      <Link
                        href={`/courses/${sched.courseId}`}
                        className={`text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold transition-colors block truncate ${
                          status === 'COMPLETED'
                            ? 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground'
                            : 'text-foreground hover:text-primary'
                        }`}
                        title={sched.course?.name || 'Mata Kuliah'}
                      >
                        {sched.course?.name || 'Mata Kuliah'}
                      </Link>
                      {sched.course?.code && (
                        <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                          {sched.course.code}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {/* Ruangan */}
                    {sched.room ? (
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground pt-0.5">
                        <MapPin className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0 text-primary" />
                        <span className="truncate font-medium text-foreground/80">
                          {sched.room}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground italic pt-0.5">
                        Ruangan belum ditentukan
                      </p>
                    )}

                    {/* Benturan Waktu jika terdeteksi */}
                    {hasConflict && sched.conflicts && sched.conflicts.length > 0 && (
                      <div className="rounded border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/10 p-1.5 text-[11px] text-destructive flex items-start gap-1.5 mt-1">
                        <AlertTriangle className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                        <span className="leading-tight">
                          Benturan dengan: {sched.conflicts.map((c) => c.courseName).join(', ')}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import * as React from 'react';
import {

import { MaterialStatus } from '@studyflow/shared';

interface MaterialStatusBadgeProps {

  errorCode?: string | null;
  errorMessage?: string | null;
  className?: string;
}

export function MaterialStatusBadge({
  status,
  errorCode,
  errorMessage,
  className = '',
}: MaterialStatusBadgeProps): React.JSX.Element {
  switch (status) {
    case 'UPLOADING':
      return (
        <Badge
          variant="outline"
          className={`gap-1.5 border-primary/40 bg-primary/10 text-primary ${className}`}
        >
          <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
          <span>Mengunggah…</span>
        </Badge>
      );

    case 'QUEUED':
      return (
        <Badge
          variant="secondary"
          className={`gap-1.5 bg-muted text-muted-foreground ${className}`}
        >
          <Clock3 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          <span>Dalam antrean</span>
        </Badge>
      );

    case 'PROCESSING':
      return (
        <Badge
          variant="outline"
          className={`gap-1.5 border-primary/40 bg-primary/10 text-primary ${className}`}
        >
          <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
          <span>Membaca isi PDF…</span>
        </Badge>
      );

    case 'READY':
      return (
        <Badge
          variant="success"
          className={`gap-1.5 ${className}`}
        >
          <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          <span>Siap dipelajari</span>
        </Badge>
      );

    case 'FAILED':
      return (
        <Badge
          variant="danger"
          className={`gap-1.5 ${className}`}
          title={errorMessage || errorCode || 'Gagal diproses'}
        >
          <AlertCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          <span>
            {errorCode === 'SCANNED_PDF_NO_TEXT'
              ? 'Scan gambar (tanpa teks)'
              : errorCode === 'EXCEEDS_PAGE_LIMIT'
              ? 'Melebihi 100 hal.'
              : errorCode === 'FILE_ENCRYPTED'
              ? 'Terenkripsi'
              : errorCode === 'FILE_TOO_LARGE'
              ? 'Melebihi 20 MB'
              : 'Gagal diproses'}
          </span>
        </Badge>
      );

    default:
      return (
        <Badge variant="outline" className={`gap-1.5 ${className}`}>
          <FileText className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          <span>{status}</span>
        </Badge>
      );
  }
}

import * as React from 'react';
import { Slot } from '@radix-ui/react-slot';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export interface ButtonProps
  extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  asChild?: boolean;
  variant?: 'default' | 'destructive' | 'outline' | 'secondary' | 'ghost' | 'link';
  size?: 'default' | 'standard' | 'sm' | 'lg' | 'icon' | 'icon-sm';
}

const Button = React.forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ButtonProps>(
  ({ className, variant = 'default', size = 'default', asChild = false, ...props }, ref) => {
    const Comp = asChild ? Slot : 'button';

    const variantStyles = {
      default: 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary-hover shadow-xs',
      destructive: 'bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:opacity-90 shadow-xs',
      outline: 'border border-border bg-card hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground',
      secondary: 'bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80',
      ghost: 'hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground',
      link: 'text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline',
    };

    const sizeStyles = {
      default: 'h-11 px-4 py-2 text-sm rounded-lg min-h-[44px]',
      standard: 'h-9 px-3.5 py-1.5 text-sm rounded-lg min-h-[36px]',
      sm: 'h-8 rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 text-xs min-h-[32px]',
      lg: 'h-11 rounded-lg px-6 text-sm min-h-[44px]',
      icon: 'h-9 w-9 rounded-lg p-0',
      'icon-sm': 'h-8 w-8 rounded-md p-0',
    };

    return (
      <Comp
        className={cn(
          'inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-hidden focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 touch-manipulation',
          variantStyles[variant],
          sizeStyles[size],
          className
        )}
        ref={ref}
        {...props}
      />
    );
  }
);
Button.displayName = 'Button';

export { Button };
