<file path="apps/web/src/components/ui/date-picker.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import { format } from 'date-fns';
import { id } from 'date-fns/locale';
import { ChevronDownIcon } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Calendar } from '@/components/ui/calendar';
import {
  Popover,
  PopoverContent,
  PopoverTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/popover';

/**
 * Parses a date string or Date object into a local Date instance without UTC drift.
 * Specifically converts "YYYY-MM-DD" to local midnight (year, month - 1, day).
 */
export function parseLocalDate(value: Date | string | null | undefined): Date | undefined {
  if (!value) return undefined;
  if (value instanceof Date) {
    return isNaN(value.getTime()) ? undefined : value;
  }
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    const trimmed = value.trim();
    if (!trimmed) return undefined;
    const match = trimmed.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/);
    if (match) {
      const y = parseInt(match[1]!, 10);
      const m = parseInt(match[2]!, 10) - 1;
      const d = parseInt(match[3]!, 10);
      return new Date(y, m, d);
    }
    const parsed = new Date(trimmed);
    return isNaN(parsed.getTime()) ? undefined : parsed;
  }
  return undefined;
}

/**
 * Formats a local Date to "YYYY-MM-DD" string without UTC conversion shift.
 */
export function formatLocalDate(date: Date): string {
  const y = date.getFullYear();
  const m = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const d = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
}

/**
 * Formats a local Date for Indonesian UI display (e.g. "12 Oktober 2026").
 */
export function formatDisplayDate(date: Date | string | null | undefined): string {
  const d = parseLocalDate(date);
  if (!d) return '';
  try {
    return format(d, 'd MMMM yyyy', { locale: id });
  } catch {
    return '';
  }
}

export interface DatePickerProps {
  value?: Date | string | null;
  onChange?: (date: Date | undefined, dateString: string | undefined) => void;
  placeholder?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  required?: boolean;
  allowClear?: boolean;
  minDate?: Date | string;
  maxDate?: Date | string;
  id?: string;
  name?: string;
  className?: string;
  triggerClassName?: string;
  hasError?: boolean;
  'aria-label'?: string;
  'aria-labelledby'?: string;
  'aria-describedby'?: string;
}

/**
 * Reusable Basic Date Picker matching shadcn/ui Radix Popover + Calendar composition.
 * - Single date selection with month navigation
 * - Indonesian locale (e.g. "12 Oktober 2026")
 * - Closes popover upon selection
 * - Retains month of stored date upon opening
 * - Optional clear button
 * - Form control sizing (h-11) and semantic design tokens
 * - Dialog and keyboard accessible
 */
export function DatePicker({
  value,
  onChange,
  placeholder = 'Pilih tanggal',
  disabled = false,
  required = false,
  allowClear = true,
  minDate,
  maxDate,
  id: elementId,
  name,
  className,
  triggerClassName,
  hasError = false,
  'aria-label': ariaLabel,
  'aria-labelledby': ariaLabelledBy,
  'aria-describedby': ariaDescribedBy,
}: DatePickerProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const dateValue = React.useMemo(() => parseLocalDate(value), [value]);

  const min = React.useMemo(() => parseLocalDate(minDate), [minDate]);
  const max = React.useMemo(() => parseLocalDate(maxDate), [maxDate]);

  // Saat dibuka untuk edit, tampilkan bulan dari tanggal tersimpan
  const [currentMonth, setCurrentMonth] = React.useState<Date | undefined>(
    dateValue || new Date()
  );

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setCurrentMonth(dateValue || new Date());
    }
  }, [open, dateValue]);

  const handleSelect = (selected: Date | undefined) => {
    if (onChange) {
      const dateString = selected ? formatLocalDate(selected) : undefined;
      onChange(selected, dateString);
    }
    // Tutup popover setelah memilih tanggal
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const isDateDisabled = React.useCallback(
    (day: Date) => {
      if (min && day < min) return true;
      if (max && day > max) return true;
      return false;
    },
    [min, max]
  );

  // Rentang dropdown bulan/tahun: eksplisit agar tenggat beberapa tahun ke depan tetap dapat dipilih.
  const { startMonth, endMonth } = React.useMemo(() => {
    const now = new Date();
    const base = dateValue ?? now;
    const start = min ?? new Date(Math.min(base.getFullYear(), now.getFullYear()) - 5, 0);
    const end = max ?? new Date(Math.max(base.getFullYear(), now.getFullYear()) + 10, 11);
    return { startMonth: start, endMonth: end };
  }, [dateValue, min, max]);

  const displayString = dateValue ? formatDisplayDate(dateValue) : '';

  const popoverContentId = React.useId();

  return (
    <div className={cn('relative inline-flex w-full', className)}>
      <Popover open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
        <PopoverTrigger asChild>
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="outline"
            role="combobox"
            id={elementId}
            name={name}
            disabled={disabled}
            aria-label={ariaLabel ? `${ariaLabel}${displayString ? `: ${displayString}` : ''}` : undefined}
            aria-labelledby={ariaLabelledBy}
            aria-describedby={ariaDescribedBy}
            aria-haspopup="dialog"
            aria-expanded={open}
            aria-controls={open ? popoverContentId : undefined}
            aria-required={required}
            aria-invalid={hasError}
            className={cn(
              'w-full justify-between border-input px-3.5 text-left text-base font-normal shadow-xs sm:text-sm focus-visible:border-primary',
              !dateValue && 'text-muted-foreground',
              hasError && 'border-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive/30',
              triggerClassName
            )}
          >
            <span className="truncate">{displayString || placeholder}</span>
            <ChevronDownIcon className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
          </Button>
        </PopoverTrigger>

        <PopoverContent
          id={popoverContentId}
          className="z-[60] w-auto overflow-hidden p-0"
          align="start"
          sideOffset={4}
        >
          <Calendar
            mode="single"
            selected={dateValue}
            onSelect={handleSelect}
            captionLayout="dropdown"
            month={currentMonth}
            onMonthChange={setCurrentMonth}
            startMonth={startMonth}
            endMonth={endMonth}
            locale={id}
            disabled={isDateDisabled}
            autoFocus
          />
          {dateValue && allowClear && (
            <div className="border-t border-border p-2 flex justify-end bg-card/50">
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="ghost"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => handleSelect(undefined)}
                className="h-7 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
              >
                Kosongkan tanggal
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
        </PopoverContent>
      </Popover>
    </div>
  );
}

export interface DateTimePickerProps {
  value?: string; // "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm" or "YYYY-MM-DD"
  onChange?: (value: string) => void;
  id?: string;
  dateId?: string;
  timeId?: string;
  name?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  required?: boolean;
  allowClear?: boolean;
  hasError?: boolean;
  placeholder?: string;
  defaultTime?: string; // default "23:59"
  timezone?: string;
  className?: string;
  'aria-describedby'?: string;
}

/**
 * DateTimePicker component combining DatePicker Basic with a dedicated time input.
 * - Used to replace datetime-local inputs
 * - Preserves existing time values
 * - Seamlessly outputs "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm"
 * - Maintains timezone integrity
 */
export function DateTimePicker({
  value = '',
  onChange,
  id,
  dateId,
  timeId,
  name,
  disabled = false,
  required = false,
  allowClear = true,
  hasError = false,
  placeholder = 'Pilih tanggal',
  defaultTime = '23:59',
  timezone,
  className,
  'aria-describedby': ariaDescribedBy,
}: DateTimePickerProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const { datePart, timePart } = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (!value || typeof value !== 'string') {
      return { datePart: '', timePart: '' };
    }
    const trimmed = value.trim();
    if (trimmed.includes('T')) {
      const [d, t] = trimmed.split('T');
      return { datePart: d || '', timePart: (t || '').slice(0, 5) };
    }
    if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(trimmed)) {
      return { datePart: trimmed, timePart: '' };
    }
    return { datePart: '', timePart: '' };
  }, [value]);

  const [localTime, setLocalTime] = React.useState(timePart || defaultTime);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (timePart) {
      setLocalTime(timePart);
    }
  }, [timePart]);

  const handleDateChange = (_date: Date | undefined, dateStr: string | undefined) => {
    if (!dateStr) {
      onChange?.('');
      return;
    }
    const timeToApply = timePart || localTime || defaultTime;
    onChange?.(`${dateStr}T${timeToApply}`);
  };

  const handleTimeChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const newTime = e.target.value;
    setLocalTime(newTime);
    if (!datePart) return;
    onChange?.(newTime ? `${datePart}T${newTime}` : `${datePart}T${defaultTime}`);
  };

  const primaryDateId = dateId || id;
  const primaryTimeId = timeId || (id ? `${id}-time` : undefined);

  return (
    <div className={cn('flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-end', className)}>
      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-1.5">
        <Label htmlFor={primaryDateId} className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">
          Tanggal
        </Label>
        <DatePicker
          id={primaryDateId}
          name={name ? `${name}_date` : undefined}
          value={datePart}
          onChange={handleDateChange}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          disabled={disabled}
          required={required}
          allowClear={allowClear && !required}
          hasError={hasError}
          aria-describedby={ariaDescribedBy}
        />
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 sm:w-32">
        <Label htmlFor={primaryTimeId} className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">
          Jam
        </Label>
        <Input
          id={primaryTimeId}
          name={name ? `${name}_time` : undefined}
          type="time"
          value={timePart || localTime}
          onChange={handleTimeChange}
          disabled={disabled}
          aria-describedby={ariaDescribedBy}
          className={cn(
            'h-11 bg-card cursor-pointer dark:[color-scheme:dark]',
            hasError && 'border-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive/30'
          )}
        />
      </div>

<file path="apps/web/src/components/ui/sidebar.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import { Slot } from '@radix-ui/react-slot';
import { PanelLeft } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import {
  Sheet,
  SheetContent,
  SheetDescription,
  SheetHeader,
  SheetTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/sheet';
import {
  Tooltip,
  TooltipContent,
  TooltipProvider,
  TooltipTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/tooltip';
import { Separator } from '@/components/ui/separator';

const SIDEBAR_WIDTH = '15rem'; // 240px
const SIDEBAR_WIDTH_ICON = '4.5rem'; // ~72px (enough for 44px icon target)

type SidebarContext = {
  state: 'expanded' | 'collapsed';
  open: boolean;
  setOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
  openMobile: boolean;
  setOpenMobile: (open: boolean) => void;
  isMobile: boolean;
  toggleSidebar: () => void;
};

const SidebarContext = React.createContext<SidebarContext | null>(null);

export function useSidebar() {
  const context = React.useContext(SidebarContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useSidebar must be used within a SidebarProvider');
  }
  return context;
}

export function SidebarProvider({
  defaultOpen = true,
  open: openProp,
  onOpenChange: setOpenProp,
  className,
  style,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<'div'> & {
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  open?: boolean;
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const [openState, setOpenState] = React.useState(defaultOpen);
  const open = openProp ?? openState;
  const setOpen = React.useCallback(
    (value: boolean | ((value: boolean) => boolean)) => {
      const openStateValue = typeof value === 'function' ? value(open) : value;
      if (setOpenProp) {
        setOpenProp(openStateValue);
      } else {
        setOpenState(openStateValue);
      }
    },
    [setOpenProp, open]
  );

  const [openMobile, setOpenMobile] = React.useState(false);
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = React.useState(false);

  // Per DESIGN.md section 7.3:
  // < 1024px: Mobile & Tablet Drawer
  // >= 1024px: Desktop Permanent Collapsible Sidebar
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const mql = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 1023px)');
    const onChange = () => {
      setIsMobile(mql.matches);
    };
    mql.addEventListener('change', onChange);
    setIsMobile(mql.matches);
    return () => mql.removeEventListener('change', onChange);
  }, []);

  const toggleSidebar = React.useCallback(() => {
    if (isMobile) {
      setOpenMobile((prev) => !prev);
    } else {
      setOpen((prev) => !prev);
    }
  }, [isMobile, setOpen]);

  // Keyboard shortcut: Ctrl+B or Cmd+B to toggle sidebar on desktop
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (
        (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey) &&
        event.key.toLowerCase() === 'b' &&
        !event.shiftKey &&
        !event.altKey
      ) {
        event.preventDefault();
        toggleSidebar();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [toggleSidebar]);

  const state = open ? 'expanded' : 'collapsed';

  const contextValue = React.useMemo<SidebarContext>(
    () => ({
      state,
      open,
      setOpen,
      isMobile,
      openMobile,
      setOpenMobile,
      toggleSidebar,
    }),
    [state, open, setOpen, isMobile, openMobile, toggleSidebar]
  );

  return (
    <SidebarContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
      <TooltipProvider delayDuration={0}>
        <div
          style={
            {
              '--sidebar-width': SIDEBAR_WIDTH,
              '--sidebar-width-icon': SIDEBAR_WIDTH_ICON,
              ...style,
            } as React.CSSProperties
          }
          className={cn(
            'group/sidebar-wrapper flex min-h-svh w-full bg-background',
            className
          )}
          {...props}
        >
          {children}
        </div>
      </TooltipProvider>
    </SidebarContext.Provider>
  );
}

export const Sidebar = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.ComponentProps<'div'> & {
    side?: 'left' | 'right';
    variant?: 'sidebar' | 'floating' | 'inset';
    collapsible?: 'offcanvas' | 'icon' | 'none';
  }
>(
  (
    {
      side = 'left',
      variant = 'sidebar',
      collapsible = 'icon',
      className,
      children,
      ...props
    },
    ref
  ) => {
    const { isMobile, state, openMobile, setOpenMobile } = useSidebar();

    // On mobile / tablet (< 1024px), render inside accessible Sheet drawer
    if (isMobile) {
      return (
        <Sheet open={openMobile} onOpenChange={setOpenMobile} {...props}>
          <SheetContent
            side={side}
            className="w-[280px] p-0 bg-sidebar text-sidebar-foreground flex flex-col border-r border-sidebar-border"
          >
            <SheetHeader className="sr-only">
              <SheetTitle>Navigasi Utama</SheetTitle>
              <SheetDescription>Menu navigasi perkuliahan StudyFlow</SheetDescription>
            </SheetHeader>
            <div data-sidebar="sidebar" className="flex h-full w-full flex-col">{children}</div>
          </SheetContent>
        </Sheet>
      );
    }

    // On desktop (>= 1024px), render permanent collapsible sidebar
    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        data-sidebar="sidebar"
        className={cn(
          'group peer hidden lg:block text-sidebar-foreground transition-[width] duration-200 ease-in-out shrink-0 select-none',
          state === 'collapsed' ? 'w-[var(--sidebar-width-icon)]' : 'w-[var(--sidebar-width)]',
          className
        )}
        data-state={state}
        data-collapsible={state === 'collapsed' ? collapsible : ''}
        data-variant={variant}
        data-side={side}
      >
        <div
          className={cn(
            'fixed inset-y-0 z-30 hidden lg:flex h-svh flex-col border-r border-sidebar-border bg-sidebar transition-[width] duration-200 ease-in-out',
            state === 'collapsed'
              ? 'w-[var(--sidebar-width-icon)]'
              : 'w-[var(--sidebar-width)]'
          )}
        >
          <div className="flex h-full w-full flex-col">{children}</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }
);
Sidebar.displayName = 'Sidebar';

'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export interface TabsContextValue {
  value: string;
  onValueChange: (value: string) => void;
}

const TabsContext = React.createContext<TabsContextValue | null>(null);

export interface TabsProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  value: string;
  onValueChange: (value: string) => void;
}

export function Tabs({
  value,
  onValueChange,
  className,
  children,
  ...props
}: TabsProps): React.JSX.Element {
  return (
    <TabsContext.Provider value={{ value, onValueChange }}>
      <div className={cn('w-full', className)} {...props}>
        {children}
      </div>
    </TabsContext.Provider>
  );
}

export interface TabsListProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {}

export function TabsList({ className, children, ...props }: TabsListProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const listRef = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!listRef.current) return;
    const tabs = Array.from(
      listRef.current.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('[role="tab"]:not([disabled])')
    );
    const currentIndex = tabs.findIndex((t) => t === document.activeElement);

    if (currentIndex === -1) return;

    let targetIndex = currentIndex;
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      targetIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % tabs.length;
      e.preventDefault();
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      targetIndex = (currentIndex - 1 + tabs.length) % tabs.length;
      e.preventDefault();
    } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
      targetIndex = 0;
      e.preventDefault();
    } else if (e.key === 'End') {
      targetIndex = tabs.length - 1;
      e.preventDefault();
    }

    if (targetIndex !== currentIndex && tabs[targetIndex]) {
      tabs[targetIndex]!.focus();
      tabs[targetIndex]!.click();
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      ref={listRef}
      role="tablist"
      onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
      className={cn(
        'inline-flex h-10 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-muted p-1 text-muted-foreground',
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

export interface TabsTriggerProps extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  value: string;
}

export function TabsTrigger({
  value,
  className,
  children,
  disabled,
  ...props
}: TabsTriggerProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const context = React.useContext(TabsContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('TabsTrigger must be used within Tabs');
  }

  const isSelected = context.value === value;

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      role="tab"
      aria-selected={isSelected}
      tabIndex={isSelected ? 0 : -1}
      disabled={disabled}
      onClick={() => context.onValueChange(value)}
      className={cn(
        'inline-flex items-center justify-center whitespace-nowrap rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium ring-offset-background transition-all focus-visible:outline-hidden focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer',
        isSelected
          ? 'bg-background text-foreground shadow-xs font-semibold'
          : 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground',
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

export interface TabsContentProps extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  value: string;
  forceMount?: boolean;
}

export function TabsContent({
  value,
  forceMount,
  className,
  children,
  ...props
}: TabsContentProps): React.JSX.Element | null {
  const context = React.useContext(TabsContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('TabsContent must be used within Tabs');
  }

  const isSelected = context.value === value;
  if (!isSelected && !forceMount) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div
      role="tabpanel"
      tabIndex={0}
      hidden={!isSelected}
      className={cn(
        'mt-2 ring-offset-background focus-visible:outline-hidden focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2',
        !isSelected && 'hidden',
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

  userId: z.string().trim().max(100).optional(),
  jobId: z.string().trim().max(100).optional(),
  startDate: z.string().datetime().optional(),
  endDate: z.string().datetime().optional(),
  sortBy: z.enum(['createdAt', 'startedAt', 'completedAt']).default('createdAt'),
  sortOrder: z.enum(['asc', 'desc']).default('desc'),
});
export type AdminJobListQuery = z.infer<typeof AdminJobListQuerySchema>;

export const AdminJobListResponseSchema = z.object({
  items: z.array(AdminJobListItemSchema),
  pagination: z.object({
    page: z.number().int(),
    limit: z.number().int(),
    totalItems: z.number().int(),
    totalPages: z.number().int(),
    hasNext: z.boolean(),
    hasPrev: z.boolean(),
  }),
});
export type AdminJobListResponse = z.infer<typeof AdminJobListResponseSchema>;

export const AdminJobDetailSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string(),
  type: AdminJobTypeEnum,
  status: AdminJobStatusEnum,
  queueStatus: AdminQueueStatusEnum,
  queueName: z.string().nullable(),
  userId: z.string(),
  userName: z.string(),
  materialId: z.string().nullable(),
  attempts: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
  maxAttempts: z.number().int().positive(),
  errorCode: z.string().nullable(),
  safeErrorMessage: z.string().nullable(),
  durationMs: z.number().int().nonnegative().nullable(),
  createdAt: z.string().datetime(),
  startedAt: z.string().datetime().nullable(),
  completedAt: z.string().datetime().nullable(),
  failedAt: z.string().datetime().nullable(),
});
export type AdminJobDetail = z.infer<typeof AdminJobDetailSchema>;

export const AdminQueueCountsSchema = z.object({
  waiting: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
  active: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
  delayed: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
  failed: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
});
export type AdminQueueCounts = z.infer<typeof AdminQueueCountsSchema>;

export const AdminQueueSummaryItemSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string(),
  label: z.string(),
  status: z.enum(['available', 'unavailable']),
  counts: AdminQueueCountsSchema.nullable(),
  retentionNote: z.string(),
});
export type AdminQueueSummaryItem = z.infer<typeof AdminQueueSummaryItemSchema>;

export const AdminQueuesSummaryResponseSchema = z.object({
  queues: z.array(AdminQueueSummaryItemSchema),
  redisStatus: z.enum(['connected', 'unavailable']),
  retentionNotice: z.string(),
  timestamp: z.string().datetime(),
});
export type AdminQueuesSummaryResponse = z.infer<typeof AdminQueuesSummaryResponseSchema>;

'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useSearchParams, useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import {
  Search,
  Users,
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  RefreshCw,
  AlertCircle,
  X,
  ArrowUpDown,
  MoreHorizontal,
  Copy,
  Check,
  Eye,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from '@/components/ui/table';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';
import { Alert, AlertDescription, AlertTitle } from '@/components/ui/alert';

  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,

  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,

  SelectValue,

function UsersTableSkeleton() {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <Skeleton className="h-10 w-full sm:max-w-sm" />
        <Skeleton className="h-9 w-32 self-end sm:self-auto" />
      </div>
      <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-card shadow-xs overflow-hidden">
        <div className="p-4 space-y-3">
          {Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, idx) => (
            <Skeleton key={idx} className="h-10 w-full" />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function AdminUsersContent() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();

  // Initialize from searchParams
  const initialSearch = searchParams.get('search') || '';
  const initialPage = Math.max(1, parseInt(searchParams.get('page') || '1', 10) || 1);
  const initialLimit = [10, 20, 50].includes(Number(searchParams.get('limit')))
    ? Number(searchParams.get('limit'))
    : 20;
  const initialSortBy = (['createdAt', 'name', 'email'].includes(searchParams.get('sortBy') || '')
    ? searchParams.get('sortBy')
    : 'createdAt') as 'createdAt' | 'name' | 'email';
  const initialSortOrder = (['asc', 'desc'].includes(searchParams.get('sortOrder') || '')
    ? searchParams.get('sortOrder')
    : 'desc') as 'asc' | 'desc';

  const [data, setData] = React.useState<AdminUserListResponse | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = React.useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  // Filter & Pagination state
  const [search, setSearch] = React.useState(initialSearch);
  const [debouncedSearch, setDebouncedSearch] = React.useState(initialSearch);
  const [page, setPage] = React.useState(initialPage);
  const [limit, setLimit] = React.useState(initialLimit);
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = React.useState<'createdAt' | 'name' | 'email'>(initialSortBy);
  const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = React.useState<'asc' | 'desc'>(initialSortOrder);

  // Copy feedback state
  const [copiedKey, setCopiedKey] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleCopy = (text: string, key: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedKey(key);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setCopiedKey((curr) => (curr === key ? null : curr));
    }, 2000);
  };

  // Debounce search input by 300ms
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handler = setTimeout(() => {
      const trimmed = search.trim();
      setDebouncedSearch((prev) => {
        if (prev !== trimmed) {
          setPage(1);
        }
        return trimmed;
      });
    }, 300);
    return () => clearTimeout(handler);
  }, [search]);

  // Sync URL search params
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    if (page > 1) params.set('page', String(page));
    if (limit !== 20) params.set('limit', String(limit));
    if (debouncedSearch) params.set('search', debouncedSearch);
    if (sortBy !== 'createdAt') params.set('sortBy', sortBy);
    if (sortOrder !== 'desc') params.set('sortOrder', sortOrder);

    const queryString = params.toString();
    const targetUrl = queryString ? `/users?${queryString}` : '/users';
    window.history.replaceState(null, '', targetUrl);
  }, [page, limit, debouncedSearch, sortBy, sortOrder]);

  // Current query string to pass to detail link for preserving back context
  const currentQueryString = React.useMemo(() => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    if (page > 1) params.set('page', String(page));
    if (limit !== 20) params.set('limit', String(limit));
    if (debouncedSearch) params.set('search', debouncedSearch);
    if (sortBy !== 'createdAt') params.set('sortBy', sortBy);
    if (sortOrder !== 'desc') params.set('sortOrder', sortOrder);
    return params.toString();
  }, [page, limit, debouncedSearch, sortBy, sortOrder]);

  // Fetch users when parameters change, ignoring stale responses
  React.useEffect(() => {
    let isCancelled = false;
    setIsLoading(true);
    setError(null);

    fetchAdminUsers({
      page,
      limit,
      search: debouncedSearch || undefined,
      sortBy,
      sortOrder,
    })
      .then((res) => {
        if (!isCancelled) {
          setData(res);
        }
      })
      .catch((err: any) => {
        if (!isCancelled) {
          setError(err.message || 'Gagal memuat daftar pengguna');
        }
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!isCancelled) {
          setIsLoading(false);
        }
      });

    return () => {
      isCancelled = true;
    };
  }, [page, limit, debouncedSearch, sortBy, sortOrder]);

  const toggleSort = (field: 'createdAt' | 'name' | 'email') => {
    if (sortBy === field) {
      setSortOrder(sortOrder === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc');
    } else {
      setSortBy(field);
      setSortOrder('desc');
    }
  };

  const handleRetry = () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    fetchAdminUsers({
      page,
      limit,
      search: debouncedSearch || undefined,
      sortBy,
      sortOrder,
    })
      .then((res) => setData(res))
      .catch((err: any) => setError(err.message || 'Gagal memuat daftar pengguna'))
      .finally(() => setIsLoading(false));
  };

  const totalPages = data?.pagination.totalPages || 1;
  const totalItems = data?.pagination.totalItems || 0;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-6 p-4 md:p-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto w-full">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground md:text-3xl">
            Daftar Pengguna
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
            Lihat daftar akun mahasiswa dan administrator yang terdaftar pada StudyFlow.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            onClick={handleRetry}
            disabled={isLoading}
            className="gap-2"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`h-4 w-4 ${isLoading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
            Segarkan
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
          <AlertTitle>Terjadi Kesalahan</AlertTitle>
          <AlertDescription className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <span>{error}</span>
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={handleRetry}
              className="bg-card text-foreground"
            >
              Coba Lagi
            </Button>
          </AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}

      {/* Search and Limit Controls */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="relative w-full sm:max-w-sm">
          <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
          <Input
            placeholder="Cari nama atau email..."
            value={search}
            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
            maxLength={100}
            className="pl-9 pr-9"
          />
          {search && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setSearch('')}
              className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
              aria-label="Bersihkan pencarian"
            >
              <X className="h-4 w-4" />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-end sm:self-auto text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          <span>Tampilkan:</span>
          <Select
            value={String(limit)}
            onValueChange={(val: string) => {
              setLimit(Number(val));
              setPage(1);
            }}
          >
            <SelectTrigger className="w-20 h-9">
              <SelectValue placeholder={String(limit)} />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              <SelectItem value="10">10</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="20">20</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="50">50</SelectItem>
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
          <span>baris</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Users Table */}
      <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-card shadow-xs overflow-hidden">
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <Table>
            <TableHeader>
              <TableRow className="bg-muted/40">
                <TableHead className="w-[280px]">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => toggleSort('name')}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold text-foreground hover:text-primary"
                  >
                    Nama
                    <ArrowUpDown className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  </button>
                </TableHead>
                <TableHead className="min-w-[240px]">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => toggleSort('email')}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold text-foreground hover:text-primary"
                  >
                    Email
                    <ArrowUpDown className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  </button>
                </TableHead>
                <TableHead className="w-[120px]">Peran</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="w-[160px]">Status Verifikasi</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="w-[180px]">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => toggleSort('createdAt')}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold text-foreground hover:text-primary"
                  >
                    Bergabung
                    <ArrowUpDown className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  </button>
                </TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right w-[90px]">Aksi</TableHead>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              {isLoading ? (
                Array.from({ length: 5 }).map((_, idx) => (
                  <TableRow key={idx}>
                    <TableCell>
                      <Skeleton className="h-4 w-36" />
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      <Skeleton className="h-4 w-48" />
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      <Skeleton className="h-5 w-16 rounded-full" />
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      <Skeleton className="h-5 w-24 rounded-full" />

                    <TableCell>

                              className="cursor-pointer"

          <div>
            Menampilkan{' '}
            <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">
              {data && data.items.length > 0 ? (page - 1) * limit + 1 : 0}
            </span>{' '}
            hingga{' '}
            <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">
              {data ? Math.min(page * limit, totalItems) : 0}
            </span>{' '}
            dari{' '}
            <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">
              {totalItems.toLocaleString('id-ID')}
            </span>{' '}
            pengguna
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-end sm:self-auto">
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
              disabled={page <= 1 || isLoading}
              className="h-8 px-2.5 gap-1"
            >
              <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
              <span>Sebelumnya</span>
            </Button>
            <span className="px-2 font-medium text-foreground">
              {page} / {totalPages}
            </span>
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => setPage((p) => Math.min(totalPages, p + 1))}
              disabled={page >= totalPages || isLoading}
              className="h-8 px-2.5 gap-1"
            >
              <span>Berikutnya</span>
              <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function AdminUsersPage() {
  return (
    <React.Suspense fallback={<UsersTableSkeleton />}>
      <AdminUsersContent />
    </React.Suspense>
  );
}

<file path="apps/admin/src/components/ui/button.tsx">
import * as React from "react"
import { Slot } from "@radix-ui/react-slot"
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

const buttonVariants = cva(
  "inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md text-sm font-medium ring-offset-background transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:size-4 [&_svg]:shrink-0",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90",
        destructive:
          "bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90",
        outline:
          "border border-input bg-background hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground",
        secondary:
          "bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80",
        ghost: "hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground",
        link: "text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline",
      },
      size: {
        default: "h-10 px-4 py-2",
        sm: "h-9 rounded-md px-3",
        lg: "h-11 rounded-md px-8",
        icon: "h-10 w-10",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
      size: "default",
    },
  }
)

export interface ButtonProps
  extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>,
    VariantProps<typeof buttonVariants> {
  asChild?: boolean
}

const Button = React.forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ButtonProps>(
  ({ className, variant, size, asChild = false, ...props }, ref) => {
    const Comp = asChild ? Slot : "button"
    return (
      <Comp
        className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size, className }))}
        ref={ref}
        {...props}
      />
    )
  }
)
Button.displayName = "Button"

export { Button, buttonVariants }
</file>

import * as React from 'react';

import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';

import {

  SheetContent,

import {

  TooltipProvider,
  TooltipTrigger,

import { Separator } from '@/components/ui/separator';

const SIDEBAR_WIDTH = '16rem'; // 256px
const SIDEBAR_WIDTH_ICON = '3.5rem'; // 56px

type SidebarContext = {
  state: 'expanded' | 'collapsed';
  open: boolean;
  setOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
  openMobile: boolean;
  setOpenMobile: (open: boolean) => void;
  isMobile: boolean;
  toggleSidebar: () => void;
};

const SidebarContext = React.createContext<SidebarContext | null>(null);

export function useSidebar() {
  const context = React.useContext(SidebarContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useSidebar must be used within a SidebarProvider');
  }
  return context;
}

export function SidebarProvider({
  defaultOpen = true,
  open: openProp,
  onOpenChange: setOpenProp,
  className,
  style,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<'div'> & {
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  open?: boolean;
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const [openState, setOpenState] = React.useState(defaultOpen);
  const open = openProp ?? openState;
  const setOpen = React.useCallback(
    (value: boolean | ((value: boolean) => boolean)) => {
      const openStateValue = typeof value === 'function' ? value(open) : value;
      if (setOpenProp) {
        setOpenProp(openStateValue);
      } else {
        setOpenState(openStateValue);
      }
    },
    [setOpenProp, open]
  );

  const [openMobile, setOpenMobile] = React.useState(false);
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = React.useState(false);

  // Per DESIGN.md section 7.3:
  // < 1024px: Mobile & Tablet Drawer
  // >= 1024px: Desktop Permanent Collapsible Sidebar
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const mql = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 1023px)');
    const onChange = () => {
      setIsMobile(mql.matches);
    };
    mql.addEventListener('change', onChange);
    setIsMobile(mql.matches);
    return () => mql.removeEventListener('change', onChange);
  }, []);

  const toggleSidebar = React.useCallback(() => {
    if (isMobile) {
      setOpenMobile((prev) => !prev);
    } else {
      setOpen((prev) => !prev);
    }
  }, [isMobile, setOpen]);

  // Keyboard shortcut: Ctrl+B or Cmd+B to toggle sidebar on desktop
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (
        event.key === 'b' &&
        (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey) &&
        !event.shiftKey &&
        !event.altKey
      ) {
        event.preventDefault();
        toggleSidebar();
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [toggleSidebar]);

  const state = open ? 'expanded' : 'collapsed';

  const contextValue = React.useMemo<SidebarContext>(
    () => ({
      state,
      open,
      setOpen,
      openMobile,
      setOpenMobile,
      isMobile,
      toggleSidebar,
    }),
    [state, open, setOpen, openMobile, setOpenMobile, isMobile, toggleSidebar]
  );

  return (
    <SidebarContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
      <TooltipProvider delayDuration={0}>
        <div
          data-slot="sidebar-wrapper"
          style={
            {
              '--sidebar-width': SIDEBAR_WIDTH,
              '--sidebar-width-icon': SIDEBAR_WIDTH_ICON,
              ...style,
            } as React.CSSProperties
          }
          className={cn(
            'group/sidebar-wrapper flex min-h-svh w-full bg-background',
            className
          )}
          {...props}
        >
          {children}
        </div>
      </TooltipProvider>
    </SidebarContext.Provider>
  );
}

export const Sidebar = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLDivElement,
  React.ComponentProps<'div'> & {
    side?: 'left' | 'right';
    variant?: 'sidebar' | 'floating' | 'inset';
    collapsible?: 'offcanvas' | 'icon' | 'none';
  }
>(
  (
    {
      side = 'left',
      variant = 'sidebar',
      collapsible = 'icon',
      className,
      children,
      ...props
    },
    ref
  ) => {
    const { isMobile, state, openMobile, setOpenMobile } = useSidebar();

    // On mobile / tablet (< 1024px), render inside accessible Sheet drawer
    if (isMobile) {
      return (
        <Sheet open={openMobile} onOpenChange={setOpenMobile} {...props}>
          <SheetContent
            side={side}
            className="w-[280px] p-0 bg-sidebar text-sidebar-foreground flex flex-col border-r border-sidebar-border"
          >
            <SheetHeader className="sr-only">
              <SheetTitle>Navigasi Utama</SheetTitle>
              <SheetDescription>Menu navigasi administrator StudyFlow</SheetDescription>
            </SheetHeader>
            <div data-sidebar="sidebar" className="flex h-full w-full flex-col">{children}</div>
          </SheetContent>
        </Sheet>
      );
    }

    // On desktop (>= 1024px), render permanent collapsible sidebar
    return (
      <div
        ref={ref}
        data-sidebar="sidebar"
        className={cn(
          'group peer hidden lg:block text-sidebar-foreground transition-[width] duration-200 ease-in-out shrink-0 select-none',
          state === 'collapsed' ? 'w-[var(--sidebar-width-icon)]' : 'w-[var(--sidebar-width)]',
          className
        )}
        data-state={state}
        data-collapsible={state === 'collapsed' ? collapsible : ''}
        data-variant={variant}
        data-side={side}
      >
        <div
          className={cn(
            'fixed inset-y-0 z-30 hidden lg:flex h-svh flex-col border-r border-sidebar-border bg-sidebar transition-[width] duration-200 ease-in-out',
            state === 'collapsed'
              ? 'w-[var(--sidebar-width-icon)]'
              : 'w-[var(--sidebar-width)]'
          )}
        >
          <div className="flex h-full w-full flex-col">{children}</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }
);
Sidebar.displayName = 'Sidebar';

export const SidebarTrigger = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof Button>,
  React.ComponentProps<typeof Button>
>(({ className, onClick, ...props }, ref) => {
  const { toggleSidebar } = useSidebar();

  return (
    <Button
      ref={ref}
      variant="ghost"
      size="icon"
      className={cn('h-9 w-9 text-foreground hover:bg-muted focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring', className)}
      onClick={(event) => {
        onClick?.(event);
        toggleSidebar();
      }}
      aria-label="Alihkan navigasi sidebar"
      title="Alihkan navigasi sidebar (Ctrl+B)"
      {...props}
    >
      <PanelLeft className="h-5 w-5" />
    </Button>
  );
});
SidebarTrigger.displayName = 'SidebarTrigger';

export const SidebarMenuButton = React.forwardRef<
  HTMLButtonElement,
  React.ComponentProps<'button'> & {
    asChild?: boolean;
    isActive?: boolean;
    tooltip?: string | React.ComponentProps<typeof TooltipContent>;
    size?: 'default' | 'sm' | 'lg';
  }
>(
  (
    {
      asChild = false,
      isActive = false,
      tooltip,
      size = 'default',
      className,
      children,
      ...props
    },
    ref
  ) => {
    const { isMobile, state } = useSidebar();
    const Comp = asChild ? Slot : 'button';

    const button = (
      <Comp
        ref={ref}
        data-sidebar="menu-button"
        data-size={size}
        data-active={isActive}
        className={cn(
          'peer/menu-button flex w-full items-center gap-3 overflow-hidden rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-left text-sm font-medium outline-hidden transition-colors hover:bg-sidebar-accent hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-sidebar-ring disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&>svg]:size-4 [&>svg]:shrink-0',
          'group-data-[collapsible=icon]:justify-center group-data-[collapsible=icon]:px-0 group-data-[collapsible=icon]:h-9 group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-9 group-data-[collapsible=icon]:mx-auto group-data-[collapsible=icon]:[&>span]:hidden',
          'group-data-[state=collapsed]:justify-center group-data-[state=collapsed]:px-0 group-data-[state=collapsed]:h-9 group-data-[state=collapsed]:w-9 group-data-[state=collapsed]:mx-auto group-data-[state=collapsed]:[&>span]:hidden',
          isActive
            ? 'bg-sidebar-accent text-sidebar-accent-foreground font-semibold shadow-xs'
            : 'text-sidebar-foreground',
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
      </Comp>
    );

    if (!tooltip) {
      return button;
    }

    const tooltipProps =
      typeof tooltip === 'string'
        ? { children: tooltip }
        : tooltip;

    return (
      <Tooltip>
        <TooltipTrigger asChild>{button}</TooltipTrigger>
        <TooltipContent
          side="right"
          align="center"
          hidden={state !== 'collapsed' || isMobile}
          {...tooltipProps}
        />
      </Tooltip>
    );
  }
);
SidebarMenuButton.displayName = 'SidebarMenuButton';

<file path="apps/api/src/services/admin.service.ts">
import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import { prisma } from '@studyflow/database';
import type {
  AdminLoginInput,
  AdminSummary,
  AdminUserListQuery,
  AdminUserListResponse,
  AdminUserDetail,
  AdminJobListQuery,
  AdminJobListResponse,
  AdminJobDetail,
  AdminJobType,
  AdminJobStatus,
  AdminQueueStatus,
  AdminQueueSummaryItem,
  AdminQueuesSummaryResponse,
  UserProfile,
  Role,
} from '@studyflow/shared';
import { QUEUE_NAMES } from '@studyflow/shared';
import { getDocumentProcessingQueue, getAiGenerationQueue } from './outbox.service.js';
import { verifyPassword } from './password.service.js';
import {
  createAccessToken,
  generateRandomToken,
  hashToken,
  getRefreshTokenExpiryDate,
} from './token.service.js';
import { toUserProfile, rotateRefreshToken, logoutUser } from './auth.service.js';
import { AppError } from '../middleware/errorHandler.js';

export async function loginAdmin(input: AdminLoginInput): Promise<{
  user: UserProfile;
  accessToken: string;
  refreshToken: string;
}> {
  const normalizedEmail = input.email.toLowerCase().trim();

  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
    where: { email: normalizedEmail },
    include: {
      federatedIdentities: {
        select: { provider: true },
      },
    },
  });

  if (!user || !user.passwordHash) {
    const error: AppError = new Error('Email atau password tidak sesuai');
    error.statusCode = 401;
    error.code = 'INVALID_CREDENTIALS';
    throw error;
  }

  const isPasswordValid = await verifyPassword(input.password, user.passwordHash);
  if (!isPasswordValid) {
    const error: AppError = new Error('Email atau password tidak sesuai');
    error.statusCode = 401;
    error.code = 'INVALID_CREDENTIALS';
    throw error;
  }

  if (user.role !== 'ADMIN') {
    const error: AppError = new Error('Akses ditolak. Akun ini tidak memiliki hak administrator.');
    error.statusCode = 403;
    error.code = 'FORBIDDEN';
    throw error;
  }

  const familyId = crypto.randomUUID();
  const rawRefreshToken = generateRandomToken();
  const tokenHash = hashToken(rawRefreshToken);
  const expiresAt = getRefreshTokenExpiryDate();

  await prisma.refreshSession.create({
    data: {
      userId: user.id,
      familyId,
      tokenHash,
      expiresAt,
    },
  });

  const accessToken = createAccessToken({
    userId: user.id,
    email: user.email,
    tokenVersion: user.tokenVersion,
  });

  return {
    user: toUserProfile(user, user.federatedIdentities.map((f) => f.provider)),
    accessToken,
    refreshToken: rawRefreshToken,
  };
}

export async function rotateAdminRefreshToken(rawRefreshToken: string): Promise<{
  user: UserProfile;
  accessToken: string;
  refreshToken?: string;
}> {
  const result = await rotateRefreshToken(rawRefreshToken, { allowAdmin: true });
  if (result.user.role !== 'ADMIN') {
    const error: AppError = new Error('Akses ditolak. Akun ini tidak memiliki hak administrator.');
    error.statusCode = 403;
    error.code = 'FORBIDDEN';
    throw error;
  }
  return result;
}

export async function logoutAdmin(rawRefreshToken?: string): Promise<void> {
  if (rawRefreshToken) {
    await logoutUser(rawRefreshToken);
  }
}

export async function getAdminSummary(): Promise<AdminSummary> {
  const oneDayAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);

  const [totalUsers, totalMaterials, totalAssignments, failedJobs24h] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.user.count(),
    prisma.material.count({ where: { deletedAt: null } }),
    prisma.assignment.count(),
    prisma.processingJob.count({
      where: {
        status: 'FAILED',
        createdAt: { gte: oneDayAgo },
      },
    }),
  ]);

  return {
    totalUsers,
    totalMaterials,
    totalAssignments,
    failedJobs24h,
    calculatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
}

export async function listAdminUsers(query: AdminUserListQuery): Promise<AdminUserListResponse> {
  const page = query.page || 1;
  const limit = query.limit || 20;
  const search = query.search?.trim();
  const sortBy = query.sortBy || 'createdAt';
  const sortOrder = query.sortOrder || 'desc';

  const where: any = {};
  if (search && search.length > 0) {
    where.OR = [
      { name: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
      { email: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
    ];
  }

  const [totalItems, users] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.user.count({ where }),
    prisma.user.findMany({
      where,
      select: {
        id: true,
        name: true,
        email: true,
        role: true,
        emailVerifiedAt: true,
        createdAt: true,
      },
      skip: (page - 1) * limit,
      take: limit,
      orderBy: { [sortBy]: sortOrder },
    }),
  ]);

  return {
    items: users.map((u) => ({
      id: u.id,
      name: u.name,
      email: u.email,
      role: u.role as Role,
      emailVerifiedAt: u.emailVerifiedAt ? u.emailVerifiedAt.toISOString() : null,
      createdAt: u.createdAt.toISOString(),
    })),
    pagination: {
      page,
      limit,
      totalItems,
      totalPages: Math.ceil(totalItems / limit) || 1,
      hasNext: page * limit < totalItems,
      hasPrev: page > 1,
    },
  };
}

function formatStorageBytes(bytes: bigint | number): string {
  const num = typeof bytes === 'bigint' ? Number(bytes) : bytes;
  if (num === 0) return '0 B';
  const k = 1024;
  const sizes = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB'];
  const i = Math.floor(Math.log(num) / Math.log(k));
  const val = parseFloat((num / Math.pow(k, i)).toFixed(1));
  return `${val} ${sizes[i]}`;
}

export async function getAdminUserDetail(userId: string): Promise<AdminUserDetail> {
  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: userId },
    select: {
      id: true,
      name: true,
      email: true,
      role: true,
      timezone: true,
      emailVerifiedAt: true,
      createdAt: true,
      passwordHash: true,
      federatedIdentities: {
        select: {
          provider: true,
        },
      },
    },
  });

  if (!user) {
    const error: AppError = new Error('Pengguna tidak ditemukan');
    error.statusCode = 404;
    error.code = 'USER_NOT_FOUND';
    throw error;
  }

  // Efficient aggregate queries in parallel
  const [semesters, courses, materials, assignments, notes, storageRecord] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.semester.count({ where: { userId } }),
    prisma.course.count({ where: { userId } }),
    prisma.material.count({ where: { userId, deletedAt: null } }),
    prisma.assignment.count({ where: { userId } }),
    prisma.note.count({ where: { userId } }),
    prisma.storageUsage.findUnique({
      where: { userId },
      select: { usedBytes: true },
    }),
  ]);

  const hasPassword = Boolean(user.passwordHash);
  const hasGoogle = user.federatedIdentities.some((f) => f.provider === 'google');
  const methods: ('password' | 'google')[] = [];
  if (hasPassword) methods.push('password');
  if (hasGoogle) methods.push('google');

  let storageUsage = null;
  if (storageRecord) {
    const usedBytesNum = Number(storageRecord.usedBytes);
    storageUsage = {
      usedBytes: usedBytesNum,
      formatted: formatStorageBytes(storageRecord.usedBytes),
    };
  }

  return {
    id: user.id,
    name: user.name,
    email: user.email,
    role: user.role as Role,
    timezone: user.timezone,
    emailVerifiedAt: user.emailVerifiedAt ? user.emailVerifiedAt.toISOString() : null,
    createdAt: user.createdAt.toISOString(),
    authMethods: {
      hasPassword,
      hasGoogle,
      methods,
    },
    usageSummary: {
      semesters,
      courses,
      materials,
      assignments,
      notes,
      storageUsage,
    },
  };
}

export function formatSafeErrorMessage(errorCode: string | null): string | null {

    AI_SAFETY_BLOCKED: 'Konten dokumen terblokir oleh filter keamanan penyedia AI.',
    AI_EMPTY_RESPONSE: 'Model AI memberikan respon kosong.',
    AI_INVALID_OUTPUT: 'Keluaran dari model AI tidak memenuhi skema yang diharapkan.',

export function calculateDurationMs(
  startedAt: Date | null,
  completedAt: Date | null,
  failedAt: Date | null
): number | null {
  if (!startedAt) return null;
  const finishedAt = completedAt || failedAt;
  if (!finishedAt) return null;
  const diff = finishedAt.getTime() - startedAt.getTime();
  return diff >= 0 ? diff : null;
}

export async function listAdminJobs(query: AdminJobListQuery): Promise<AdminJobListResponse> {
  const page = query.page || 1;
  const limit = query.limit || 20;
  const { type, status, userId, jobId, startDate, endDate, sortBy = 'createdAt', sortOrder = 'desc' } = query;

  if (startDate && endDate) {
    const start = new Date(startDate).getTime();
    const end = new Date(endDate).getTime();
    if (start > end) {
      const error: AppError = new Error('Rentang tanggal tidak valid: startDate harus lebih awal dari endDate');
      error.statusCode = 400;
      error.code = 'VALIDATION_ERROR';
      throw error;
    }
    const maxRangeMs = 90 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // 90 days max
    if (end - start > maxRangeMs) {
      const error: AppError = new Error('Rentang tanggal pencarian maksimal adalah 90 hari');
      error.statusCode = 400;
      error.code = 'VALIDATION_ERROR';
      throw error;
    }
  }

  const where: any = {};
  if (type) where.type = type;
  if (status) where.status = status;
  if (userId) where.userId = userId;
  if (jobId) where.id = jobId;

  if (startDate || endDate) {
    where.createdAt = {};
    if (startDate) where.createdAt.gte = new Date(startDate);
    if (endDate) where.createdAt.lte = new Date(endDate);
  }

  const [totalItems, jobs] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.processingJob.count({ where }),
    prisma.processingJob.findMany({
      where,
      select: {
        id: true,
        type: true,
        status: true,
        userId: true,
        materialId: true,
        attempts: true,
        maxAttempts: true,
        errorCode: true,
        startedAt: true,
        completedAt: true,
        failedAt: true,
        createdAt: true,
        user: {
          select: {
            name: true,
          },
        },
      },
      skip: (page - 1) * limit,
      take: limit,
      orderBy: { [sortBy]: sortOrder },
    }),
  ]);

  return {
    items: jobs.map((job) => ({
      id: job.id,
      type: job.type as AdminJobType,
      status: job.status as AdminJobStatus,
      userId: job.userId,
      userName: job.user?.name || 'Pengguna Tidak Dikenal',
      materialId: job.materialId,
      attempts: job.attempts,
      maxAttempts: job.maxAttempts,
      errorCode: job.errorCode,
      safeErrorMessage: formatSafeErrorMessage(job.errorCode),
      durationMs: calculateDurationMs(job.startedAt, job.completedAt, job.failedAt),
      createdAt: job.createdAt.toISOString(),
      startedAt: job.startedAt ? job.startedAt.toISOString() : null,
      completedAt: job.completedAt ? job.completedAt.toISOString() : null,
      failedAt: job.failedAt ? job.failedAt.toISOString() : null,
    })),
    pagination: {
      page,
      limit,
      totalItems,
      totalPages: Math.ceil(totalItems / limit) || 1,
      hasNext: page * limit < totalItems,
      hasPrev: page > 1,
    },
  };
}

export async function getAdminJobDetail(jobId: string): Promise<AdminJobDetail> {
  const job = await prisma.processingJob.findUnique({
    where: { id: jobId },
    select: {
      id: true,
      type: true,
      status: true,
      userId: true,
      materialId: true,
      attempts: true,
      maxAttempts: true,
      errorCode: true,
      startedAt: true,
      completedAt: true,
      failedAt: true,
      createdAt: true,
      user: {
        select: {
          name: true,
        },
      },
    },
  });

  if (!job) {
    const error: AppError = new Error('Pekerjaan tidak ditemukan');
    error.statusCode = 404;
    error.code = 'JOB_NOT_FOUND';
    throw error;
  }

  let queueStatus: AdminQueueStatus = 'unavailable';
  let queueName: string | null = null;

  try {
    const isDoc = job.type === 'DOCUMENT_EXTRACTION' || job.type === 'DOCUMENT_CLEANUP';
    const queue = isDoc ? getDocumentProcessingQueue() : getAiGenerationQueue();
    queueName = queue.name;

    const bullJob = await Promise.race([
      queue.getJob(jobId),
      new Promise<null>((_, reject) => setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Queue timeout')), 2000)),
    ]);

    if (bullJob) {
      const state = await bullJob.getState();
      if (['waiting', 'active', 'delayed', 'completed', 'failed'].includes(state)) {
        queueStatus = state as AdminQueueStatus;
      } else {
        queueStatus = 'active';
      }
    } else {
      queueStatus = 'not_found';
    }
  } catch {
    queueStatus = 'unavailable';
  }

  return {
    id: job.id,
    type: job.type as AdminJobType,
    status: job.status as AdminJobStatus,
    queueStatus,
    queueName,
    userId: job.userId,
    userName: job.user?.name || 'Pengguna Tidak Dikenal',
    materialId: job.materialId,
    attempts: job.attempts,
    maxAttempts: job.maxAttempts,
    errorCode: job.errorCode,
    safeErrorMessage: formatSafeErrorMessage(job.errorCode),
    durationMs: calculateDurationMs(job.startedAt, job.completedAt, job.failedAt),
    createdAt: job.createdAt.toISOString(),
    startedAt: job.startedAt ? job.startedAt.toISOString() : null,
    completedAt: job.completedAt ? job.completedAt.toISOString() : null,
    failedAt: job.failedAt ? job.failedAt.toISOString() : null,
  };
}

export async function getAdminQueuesSummary(): Promise<AdminQueuesSummaryResponse> {
  const queuesConfig = [
    {
      name: QUEUE_NAMES.documentProcessing,
      label: 'Pemrosesan Dokumen',
      getQueue: getDocumentProcessingQueue,
      retentionNote: 'Menyimpan hingga 100 job sukses dan 200 job gagal terbaru.',
    },
    {
      name: QUEUE_NAMES.aiGeneration,
      label: 'Generasi AI (Ringkasan, Flashcard, Kuis)',
      getQueue: getAiGenerationQueue,
      retentionNote: 'Menyimpan hingga 100 job sukses dan 200 job gagal terbaru.',
    },
  ];

  let anyConnected = false;
  const queuesSummary: AdminQueueSummaryItem[] = [];

  for (const cfg of queuesConfig) {
    try {
      const q = cfg.getQueue();
      const counts = await Promise.race([
        q.getJobCounts('waiting', 'active', 'delayed', 'failed'),
        new Promise<never>((_, reject) => setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Redis timeout')), 2000)),
      ]);

      anyConnected = true;
      queuesSummary.push({
        name: cfg.name,
        label: cfg.label,
        status: 'available',
        counts: {
          waiting: counts.waiting || 0,
          active: counts.active || 0,
          delayed: counts.delayed || 0,
          failed: counts.failed || 0,
        },
        retentionNote: cfg.retentionNote,
      });
    } catch {
      queuesSummary.push({
        name: cfg.name,
        label: cfg.label,
        status: 'unavailable',
        counts: null,
        retentionNote: cfg.retentionNote,
      });
    }
  }

  return {
    queues: queuesSummary,
    redisStatus: anyConnected ? 'connected' : 'unavailable',
    retentionNotice:
      'Angka antrean mencerminkan kondisi memori saat ini pada BullMQ Redis dan dibatasi oleh kebijakan retensi. Gunakan riwayat database untuk data jangka panjang yang permanen.',
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
}

import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import { OAuth2Client, TokenPayload } from 'google-auth-library';
import { prisma, Prisma } from '@studyflow/database';
import { GoogleExchangeInput, UserProfile } from '@studyflow/shared';
import { env } from '../config/env.js';
import { AppError } from '../middleware/errorHandler.js';
import {
  createAccessToken,
  generateRandomToken,
  hashToken,
  getRefreshTokenExpiryDate,
} from './token.service.js';
import { toUserProfile } from './auth.service.js';

export function isGoogleConfigured(): boolean {
  return Boolean(env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID && env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET);
}

export interface GoogleAuthUrlResult {
  url: string;
  state: string;
  nonce: string;
  codeVerifier: string;
}

export function generateGoogleAuthUrl(options?: {
  prompt?: 'select_account' | 'consent';
  redirectUri?: string;
}): GoogleAuthUrlResult {
  if (!isGoogleConfigured() && env.NODE_ENV !== 'test') {
    const error: AppError = new Error('Google OAuth belum dikonfigurasi pada server');
    error.statusCode = 503;
    error.code = 'GOOGLE_AUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED';
    throw error;
  }

  const state = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
  const nonce = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
  const codeVerifier = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('base64url');

  const codeChallenge = crypto
    .createHash('sha256')
    .update(codeVerifier)
    .digest('base64url');

  const redirectUri = options?.redirectUri || env.GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI;

  const url = new URL('https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth');
  url.searchParams.set('client_id', env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID || 'mock-google-client-id');
  url.searchParams.set('redirect_uri', redirectUri);
  url.searchParams.set('response_type', 'code');
  url.searchParams.set('scope', 'openid email profile');
  url.searchParams.set('state', state);
  url.searchParams.set('nonce', nonce);
  url.searchParams.set('code_challenge', codeChallenge);
  url.searchParams.set('code_challenge_method', 'S256');
  url.searchParams.set('access_type', 'online');
  url.searchParams.set('prompt', options?.prompt || 'select_account');

  return {
    url: url.toString(),
    state,
    nonce,
    codeVerifier,
  };
}

// Deterministic mock holder for testing (never active in production)
let testMockPayload:
  | ((code: string, codeVerifier: string) => Promise<TokenPayload | null> | TokenPayload | null)
  | null = null;

export function __setTestGoogleAuthMock(
  mock: ((code: string, codeVerifier: string) => Promise<TokenPayload | null> | TokenPayload | null) | null
): void {
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'test') {
    throw new Error('Test mock can only be configured in test environment');
  }
  testMockPayload = mock;
}

export interface GoogleAuthExchangeResult {
  user: UserProfile;
  accessToken?: string;
  refreshToken?: string;
  message: string;
}

export async function exchangeGoogleCode(
  input: GoogleExchangeInput,
  currentUserId?: string
): Promise<GoogleAuthExchangeResult> {
  let verifiedPayload: TokenPayload;

  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'test' && testMockPayload) {
    const mock = await testMockPayload(input.code, input.codeVerifier);
    if (!mock) {
      const error: AppError = new Error('Kode otorisasi Google tidak valid atau ditolak oleh provider');
      error.statusCode = 400;
      error.code = 'OAUTH_PROVIDER_ERROR';
      throw error;
    }
    verifiedPayload = mock;
  } else {
    if (!isGoogleConfigured()) {
      const error: AppError = new Error('Google OAuth belum dikonfigurasi pada server');
      error.statusCode = 503;
      error.code = 'GOOGLE_AUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED';
      throw error;
    }

    // Exchange authorization code for tokens via Google Token Endpoint
    let tokenRes: Response;
    try {
      tokenRes = await fetch('https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
        },
        body: new URLSearchParams({
          code: input.code,
          client_id: env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID,
          client_secret: env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET,
          redirect_uri: input.redirectUri,
          grant_type: 'authorization_code',
          code_verifier: input.codeVerifier,
        }),
      });
    } catch {
      const error: AppError = new Error('Gagal menghubungi layanan Google OAuth');
      error.statusCode = 502;
      error.code = 'OAUTH_NETWORK_ERROR';
      throw error;
    }

    if (!tokenRes.ok) {
      const error: AppError = new Error('Kode otorisasi Google tidak valid atau kedaluwarsa');
      error.statusCode = 400;
      error.code = 'OAUTH_CODE_EXCHANGE_FAILED';
      throw error;
    }

    const tokenData = (await tokenRes.json()) as { id_token?: string; access_token?: string };
    if (!tokenData.id_token) {
      const error: AppError = new Error('ID Token Google tidak ditemukan dalam respon pertukaran');
      error.statusCode = 400;
      error.code = 'ID_TOKEN_MISSING';
      throw error;
    }

    // Verify ID Token signature, issuer, audience, and expiry with Google Auth Library
    try {
      const client = new OAuth2Client(env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID);
      const ticket = await client.verifyIdToken({
        idToken: tokenData.id_token,
        audience: env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID,
      });
      const payload = ticket.getPayload();
      if (!payload) {
        throw new Error('Payload token kosong');
      }
      verifiedPayload = payload;
    } catch {
      const error: AppError = new Error('ID Token Google tidak valid atau tanda tangan digital gagal diverifikasi');
      error.statusCode = 401;
      error.code = 'INVALID_ID_TOKEN';
      throw error;
    }
  }

  // 1. Validate Nonce (ID Token Replay Protection)
  if (verifiedPayload.nonce && verifiedPayload.nonce !== input.nonce) {
    const error: AppError = new Error('Nonce ID token Google tidak sesuai dengan transaksi');
    error.statusCode = 400;
    error.code = 'OAUTH_NONCE_MISMATCH';
    throw error;
  }

  // 2. Validate email verification status
  if (!verifiedPayload.email_verified) {
    const error: AppError = new Error('Email akun Google belum terverifikasi');
    error.statusCode = 400;
    error.code = 'EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED';
    throw error;
  }

  const googleSub = verifiedPayload.sub;
  const rawEmail = verifiedPayload.email;
  if (!googleSub || !rawEmail) {
    const error: AppError = new Error('Identitas akun Google tidak lengkap');
    error.statusCode = 400;
    error.code = 'INVALID_IDENTITY_PAYLOAD';
    throw error;
  }

  const googleEmail = rawEmail.toLowerCase().trim();
  const googleName = verifiedPayload.name?.trim() || 'Pengguna Google';

  // 3. Handle Linking Intent (from Settings by an existing authenticated user)
  if (input.intent === 'link') {
    if (!currentUserId) {
      const error: AppError = new Error('Sesi autentikasi diperlukan untuk menghubungkan akun Google');
      error.statusCode = 401;
      error.code = 'UNAUTHORIZED';
      throw error;
    }

    const currentUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { id: currentUserId },
      include: {
        federatedIdentities: true,
      },
    });

    if (!currentUser) {
      const error: AppError = new Error('Pengguna tidak ditemukan');
      error.statusCode = 404;
      error.code = 'USER_NOT_FOUND';
      throw error;
    }

    // Email matching verification: Google email must match the StudyFlow account email
    if (googleEmail !== currentUser.email.toLowerCase().trim()) {
      const error: AppError = new Error(
        `Alamat email Google (${googleEmail}) berbeda dengan email akun StudyFlow Anda (${currentUser.email}). Email harus sama untuk menghubungkan akun.`
      );
      error.statusCode = 400;
      error.code = 'EMAIL_MISMATCH';
      throw error;
    }

    // Check if this Google identity is already connected
    const existingIdentity = await prisma.federatedIdentity.findUnique({
      where: {
        provider_subject: {
          provider: 'google',
          subject: googleSub,
        },
      },
    });

    if (existingIdentity) {
      if (existingIdentity.userId !== currentUser.id) {
        const error: AppError = new Error('Akun Google ini sudah terhubung ke akun StudyFlow yang lain');
        error.statusCode = 409;
        error.code = 'IDENTITY_ALREADY_LINKED';
        throw error;
      }

      // Already linked to the same user
      const providers = Array.from(
        new Set([...currentUser.federatedIdentities.map((f) => f.provider), 'google'])
      );
      return {
        user: toUserProfile(currentUser, providers),
        message: 'Akun Google sudah terhubung dengan akun StudyFlow Anda',
      };
    }

    // Create the federated identity link
    await prisma.federatedIdentity.create({
      data: {
        userId: currentUser.id,
        provider: 'google',
        subject: googleSub,
        email: googleEmail,
      },
    });

    // If user's email was not verified yet, but Google claims email_verified and email matches, mark verified
    let updatedCurrentUser = currentUser;
    if (!currentUser.emailVerifiedAt && verifiedPayload.email_verified && googleEmail === currentUser.email.toLowerCase().trim()) {
      updatedCurrentUser = await prisma.user.update({
        where: { id: currentUser.id },
        data: { emailVerifiedAt: new Date() },
        include: { federatedIdentities: true },
      });
    }

    const providers = Array.from(
      new Set([...currentUser.federatedIdentities.map((f) => f.provider), 'google'])
    );

    return {
      user: toUserProfile(updatedCurrentUser, providers),
      message: 'Akun Google berhasil dihubungkan ke akun StudyFlow Anda',
    };
  }

  // 4. Handle Login/Register Intent
  // Step 4A: Check if the Google identity (provider, subject) is already linked
  const existingIdentity = await prisma.federatedIdentity.findUnique({
    where: {
      provider_subject: {
        provider: 'google',
        subject: googleSub,
      },
    },
    include: {
      user: {
        include: {
          federatedIdentities: true,
        },
      },
    },
  });

  if (existingIdentity) {
    const user = existingIdentity.user;

    // Strict separation: Reject ADMIN users from logging into the student web portal
    if (user.role === 'ADMIN') {
      const error: AppError = new Error(
        'Akun administrator tidak diizinkan masuk ke portal mahasiswa. Silakan masuk melalui portal administrator.'
      );
      error.statusCode = 403;
      error.code = 'ADMIN_PORTAL_ONLY';
      throw error;
    }

    const providers = user.federatedIdentities.map((f) => f.provider);

    // Issue StudyFlow application session
    const familyId = crypto.randomUUID();
    const rawRefreshToken = generateRandomToken();
    const tokenHash = hashToken(rawRefreshToken);
    const expiresAt = getRefreshTokenExpiryDate();

    await prisma.refreshSession.create({
      data: {
        userId: user.id,
        familyId,
        tokenHash,
        expiresAt,
      },
    });

    const accessToken = createAccessToken({
      userId: user.id,
      email: user.email,
      role: user.role,
      tokenVersion: user.tokenVersion,
    });

    return {
      user: toUserProfile(user, providers),
      accessToken,
      refreshToken: rawRefreshToken,
      message: 'Masuk dengan Google berhasil',
    };
  }

  // Step 4B: If the Google identity is NOT yet linked, check if a User exists with this email
  const existingUserByEmail = await prisma.user.findUnique({
    where: { email: googleEmail },
  });

  if (existingUserByEmail) {
    // DO NOT automatically merge accounts! Require user to log in and link from Settings.
    const error: AppError = new Error(
      `Email ${googleEmail} sudah terdaftar menggunakan password. Silakan masuk dengan email dan password Anda terlebih dahulu, lalu hubungkan akun Google melalui menu Pengaturan.`
    );
    error.statusCode = 409;
    error.code = 'ACCOUNT_NOT_LINKED';
    throw error;
  }

  // Step 4C: If no user exists with this email, register a new StudyFlow account without local password
  let newUser: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    email: string;
    passwordHash: string | null;
    timezone: string;
    role: 'USER' | 'ADMIN';
    tokenVersion: number;
    createdAt: Date;
    updatedAt: Date;
  };

  try {
    newUser = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      const created = await tx.user.create({
        data: {
          name: googleName,
          email: googleEmail,
          passwordHash: null,
          timezone: 'Asia/Jakarta',
          emailVerifiedAt: verifiedPayload.email_verified && googleEmail === rawEmail.toLowerCase().trim() ? new Date() : null,
        },
      });

      await tx.federatedIdentity.create({
        data: {
          userId: created.id,
          provider: 'google',
          subject: googleSub,
          email: googleEmail,
        },
      });

      return created;
    });
  } catch (err) {
    // Handle concurrent duplicate insertion
    if (err instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError && err.code === 'P2002') {
      const error: AppError = new Error('Akun Google ini sedang diproses atau sudah terdaftar.');
      error.statusCode = 409;
      error.code = 'CONCURRENT_CREATION_CONFLICT';
      throw error;
    }
    throw err;
  }

  // Issue StudyFlow application session for the newly created account
  const familyId = crypto.randomUUID();
  const rawRefreshToken = generateRandomToken();
  const tokenHash = hashToken(rawRefreshToken);
  const expiresAt = getRefreshTokenExpiryDate();

  await prisma.refreshSession.create({
    data: {
      userId: newUser.id,
      familyId,
      tokenHash,
      expiresAt,
    },
  });

  const accessToken = createAccessToken({
    userId: newUser.id,
    email: newUser.email,
    role: newUser.role,
    tokenVersion: newUser.tokenVersion,
  });

  return {
    user: toUserProfile(newUser, ['google']),
    accessToken,
    refreshToken: rawRefreshToken,
    message: 'Akun StudyFlow berhasil dibuat melalui Google',
  };
}
