import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterAll } from 'vitest';
import request from 'supertest';
import { createApp } from '../app.js';
import { prisma } from '@studyflow/database';
import { ADMIN_COOKIE_NAMES, COOKIE_NAMES } from '@studyflow/shared';

describe('Admin Endpoints & Authorization Invariants', () => {
  const app = createApp();
  const TRUSTED_ORIGIN = 'http://localhost:3002';
  const WEB_ORIGIN = 'http://localhost:3000';

  let normalUserId: string;
  let normalUserEmail: string;
  let normalUserCookie: string[];

  let adminUserId: string;
  let adminUserEmail: string;
  let adminUserCookie: string[];

  beforeEach(async () => {
    await prisma.user.deleteMany({
      where: { email: { contains: 'test.admin.' } },
    });

    // 1. Create Normal USER
    normalUserEmail = `test.admin.user.${Date.now()}.${Math.random()}@example.com`;
    const regNormal = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', WEB_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Normal User',
        email: normalUserEmail,
        password: 'PasswordNormal123!',
      });
    expect(regNormal.status).toBe(201);

    const loginNormal = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', WEB_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: normalUserEmail,
        password: 'PasswordNormal123!',
      });
    expect(loginNormal.status).toBe(200);
    normalUserId = loginNormal.body.user.id;
    normalUserCookie = loginNormal.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];

    // 2. Create ADMIN user (registered as normal, then promoted in DB)
    adminUserEmail = `test.admin.boss.${Date.now()}.${Math.random()}@example.com`;
    const regAdmin = await request(app)
      .post('/api/auth/register')
      .set('Origin', WEB_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        name: 'Boss Admin',
        email: adminUserEmail,
        password: 'PasswordAdmin123!',
      });
    expect(regAdmin.status).toBe(201);
    adminUserId = regAdmin.body.user.id;

    // Promote to ADMIN directly in database (authoritative source)
    await prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: adminUserId },
      data: { role: 'ADMIN' },
    });

    const loginAdminRes = await request(app)
      .post('/api/admin/auth/login')
      .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)
      .send({
        email: adminUserEmail,
        password: 'PasswordAdmin123!',
      });
    expect(loginAdminRes.status).toBe(200);
    expect(loginAdminRes.body.user.role).toBe('ADMIN');
    adminUserCookie = loginAdminRes.headers['set-cookie'] as unknown as string[];
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await prisma.user.deleteMany({
      where: { email: { contains: 'test.admin.' } },
    });
  });

  describe('Access Control & Boundaries', () => {
    it('rejects anonymous request to /api/admin/summary with 401', async () => {
      const res = await request(app).get('/api/admin/summary');
      expect(res.status).toBe(401);
      expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('UNAUTHORIZED');
    });

    it('rejects anonymous request to /api/admin/users with 401', async () => {
      const res = await request(app).get('/api/admin/users');
      expect(res.status).toBe(401);
      expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('UNAUTHORIZED');
    });

    it('rejects authenticated non-admin USER with 403 on /api/admin/summary', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .get('/api/admin/summary')
        .set('Cookie', normalUserCookie);
      expect(res.status).toBe(403);
      expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('FORBIDDEN');
    });

    it('rejects authenticated non-admin USER with 403 on /api/admin/users', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)
        .get('/api/admin/users')
        .set('Cookie', normalUserCookie);
      expect(res.status).toBe(403);
      expect(res.body.error.code).toBe('FORBIDDEN');
    });

    it('allows ADMIN to access summary and users', async () => {
      const summaryRes = await request(app)
        .get('/api/admin/summary')
        .set('Cookie', adminUserCookie);
      expect(summaryRes.status).toBe(200);
      expect(typeof summaryRes.body.totalUsers).toBe('number');
      expect(typeof summaryRes.body.totalMaterials).toBe('number');
      expect(typeof summaryRes.body.totalAssignments).toBe('number');
      expect(typeof summaryRes.body.failedJobs24h).toBe('number');

      const usersRes = await request(app)
        .get('/api/admin/users')
        .set('Cookie', adminUserCookie);
      expect(usersRes.status).toBe(200);
      expect(Array.isArray(usersRes.body.items)).toBe(true);
      expect(usersRes.body.pagination).toBeDefined();
    });

    it('immediately denies access with 403 on next request if role is revoked in DB', async () => {
      // 1. Initial request works
      const res1 = await request(app)
        .get('/api/admin/summary')
        .set('Cookie', adminUserCookie);
      expect(res1.status).toBe(200);

      // 2. Revoke role in database
      await prisma.user.update({
        where: { id: adminUserId },
        data: { role: 'USER' },
      });

      // 3. Next request with same cookie must be rejected immediately with 403
      const res2 = await request(app)
        .get('/api/admin/summary')
        .set('Cookie', adminUserCookie);
      expect(res2.status).toBe(403);
      expect(res2.body.error.code).toBe('FORBIDDEN');
    });

    it('does NOT allow public registration to inject ADMIN role', async () => {
      const attackerEmail = `test.admin.hacker.${Date.now()}@example.com`;
      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/auth/register')
        .set('Origin', WEB_ORIGIN)
        .send({
          name: 'Hacker',
          email: attackerEmail,
          password: 'PasswordHacker123!',
          role: 'ADMIN', // malicious input injection
        } as any);

      expect(res.status).toBe(201);
      expect(res.body.user.role).toBe('USER');

      // Verify in DB
      const userInDb = await prisma.user.findUnique({
        where: { email: attackerEmail },
        select: { role: true },
      });
      expect(userInDb?.role).toBe('USER');
    });
  });

    it('rejects admin login for non-admin user with 403 and sets no admin cookies', async () => {
      const res = await request(app)

        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)

          email: adminUserEmail,
          password: 'PasswordAdmin123!',
        });

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      const cookies = (res.headers['set-cookie'] || []) as string[];
      expect(cookies.some((c) => c.includes(ADMIN_COOKIE_NAMES.accessToken))).toBe(true);
      expect(cookies.some((c) => c.includes(ADMIN_COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken))).toBe(true);
      // Ensure web cookies are NOT set
      expect(cookies.some((c) => c.includes(`${COOKIE_NAMES.accessToken}=`))).toBe(false);
    });

    it('returns admin profile on /api/admin/auth/me', async () => {

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.body.user.email).toBe(adminUserEmail);
      expect(res.body.user.role).toBe('ADMIN');
    });

    it('refreshes admin token successfully and rotates session', async () => {
      const refreshCookie = adminUserCookie.find((c) =>
        c.includes(ADMIN_COOKIE_NAMES.refreshToken)
      );
      expect(refreshCookie).toBeDefined();

      const res = await request(app)
        .post('/api/admin/auth/refresh')
        .set('Origin', TRUSTED_ORIGIN)

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      expect(res.body.user.role).toBe('ADMIN');
      const newCookies = (res.headers['set-cookie'] || []) as string[];
      expect(newCookies.some((c) => c.includes(ADMIN_COOKIE_NAMES.accessToken))).toBe(true);
    });

    it('rejects ADMIN user from logging into student portal (/api/auth/login) with 403', async () => {

      // STRICT PROJECTION: Secrets MUST NEVER be exposed

      expect((res.body as any).password_hash).toBeUndefined();
      expect((res.body as any).tokenVersion).toBeUndefined();

    it('accurately reports Google OAuth in authMethods when present', async () => {

      const res = await request(app)

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);

      expect(res.body.authMethods.hasGoogle).toBe(true);
      expect(res.body.authMethods.methods).toContain('password');
      expect(res.body.authMethods.methods).toContain('google');
      // Ensure raw federated identity details (e.g. subject) are not exposed
      expect((res.body as any).subject).toBeUndefined();
    });

    it('accurately aggregates user usage metrics and respects active materials scoping', async () => {
      // 1. Create semester and course
      const semester = await prisma.semester.create({
        data: {
          userId: normalUserId,
          name: 'Semester 1 Test',
          academicYear: '2025/2026',
          isActive: true,
        },
      });

      const course = await prisma.course.create({
        data: {
          userId: normalUserId,
          semesterId: semester.id,
          name: 'Kalkulus I Test',
        },
      });

      // 2. Create 1 active material and 1 soft-deleted material
      await prisma.material.create({
        data: {
          userId: normalUserId,
          courseId: course.id,
          title: 'Materi Aktif',
          originalFilename: 'materi_aktif.pdf',
          storageKey: `test/aktif_${Date.now()}.pdf`,
          bytes: 1048576, // 1 MB
          status: 'READY',
        },
      });

      await prisma.material.create({
        data: {
          userId: normalUserId,
          courseId: course.id,
          title: 'Materi Terhapus',
          originalFilename: 'materi_terhapus.pdf',
          storageKey: `test/terhapus_${Date.now()}.pdf`,
          bytes: 1048576,
          status: 'READY',
          deletedAt: new Date(),
        },
      });

      // 3. Create assignment
      await prisma.assignment.create({
        data: {
          userId: normalUserId,
          courseId: course.id,
          title: 'Tugas Kuliah Test',
          dueDate: new Date(Date.now() + 86400000),
        },
      });

      // 4. Create note
      await prisma.note.create({
        data: {
          userId: normalUserId,
          courseId: course.id,
          title: 'Catatan Kuliah Test',
          content: 'Catatan pribadi belajar kalkulus',
        },
      });

      // 5. Create storage usage record (10.5 MB)
      await prisma.storageUsage.upsert({
        where: { userId: normalUserId },
        create: {
          userId: normalUserId,
          usedBytes: BigInt(11010048), // ~10.5 MB
        },
        update: {
          usedBytes: BigInt(11010048),
        },
      });

      // Request user detail
      const res = await request(app)
        .get(`/api/admin/users/${normalUserId}`)
        .set('Cookie', adminUserCookie);

      expect(res.status).toBe(200);
      const usage = res.body.usageSummary;
      expect(usage.semesters).toBe(1);
      expect(usage.courses).toBe(1);
      // Soft-deleted material MUST NOT be included
      expect(usage.materials).toBe(1);
      expect(usage.assignments).toBe(1);
      expect(usage.notes).toBe(1);
      expect(usage.storageUsage).toBeDefined();
      expect(usage.storageUsage.usedBytes).toBe(11010048);
      expect(usage.storageUsage.formatted).toBe('10.5 MB');

      // Verify privacy: no note text, no material file URLs, no assignment content leaked
      expect((res.body as any).content).toBeUndefined();
      expect((res.body as any).notesList).toBeUndefined();
      expect((res.body as any).materialsList).toBeUndefined();
    });

    it('enforces tenant isolation: another user metrics do not bleed into target user summary', async () => {
      // Admin should have 0 semesters/courses in their summary
      const adminRes = await request(app)
        .get(`/api/admin/users/${adminUserId}`)
        .set('Cookie', adminUserCookie);

      expect(adminRes.status).toBe(200);
      expect(adminRes.body.usageSummary.semesters).toBe(0);
      expect(adminRes.body.usageSummary.courses).toBe(0);
      expect(adminRes.body.usageSummary.materials).toBe(0);
      expect(adminRes.body.usageSummary.assignments).toBe(0);
      expect(adminRes.body.usageSummary.notes).toBe(0);
      expect(adminRes.body.usageSummary.storageUsage).toBeNull();
    });
  });
});

<file path="apps/web/src/app/api/auth/[...path]/route.ts">
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { resolveForwardedClientIp } from '@/lib/clientIp';

const INTERNAL_API_URL =
  process.env.INTERNAL_API_URL ||
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ||
  'http://localhost:4000';

const STATE_CHANGING_METHODS = new Set(['POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE']);

function validateCsrfOrigin(req: NextRequest): { valid: boolean; reason?: string } {
  if (!STATE_CHANGING_METHODS.has(req.method)) {
    return { valid: true };
  }

  const origin = req.headers.get('origin');
  const referer = req.headers.get('referer');
  const trustedOrigin = req.nextUrl.origin;

  // 1. Explicitly reject null origin
  if (origin === 'null') {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'Origin null tidak diizinkan' };
  }

  let requestOrigin: string | null = null;

  if (origin) {
    requestOrigin = origin;
  } else if (referer) {
    try {
      const url = new URL(referer);
      requestOrigin = url.origin;
    } catch {
      requestOrigin = null;
    }
  }

  // 2. Reject missing Origin & Referer on mutations
  if (!requestOrigin) {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'Header Origin atau Referer wajib ada untuk request ini' };
  }

  // 3. Reject foreign/attacker origins
  if (requestOrigin !== trustedOrigin) {
    return { valid: false, reason: 'Origin tidak diizinkan atau CSRF terdeteksi' };
  }

  return { valid: true };
}

async function handleProxy(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ path: string[] }> }) {
  // Validate Origin/CSRF before proxying state-changing requests
  const csrfCheck = validateCsrfOrigin(req);
  if (!csrfCheck.valid) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error: {
          code: 'CSRF_ORIGIN_INVALID',
          message: csrfCheck.reason || 'Permintaan ditolak: CSRF terdeteksi',
        },
      },
      { status: 403 }
    );
  }

  const { path } = await params;
  const targetPath = path.join('/');
  const targetUrl = `${INTERNAL_API_URL}/api/auth/${targetPath}`;

  const requestHeaders = new Headers();
  requestHeaders.set('Content-Type', 'application/json');

  // Forward cookies from browser to Express
  const cookieHeader = req.headers.get('cookie');
  if (cookieHeader) {
    requestHeaders.set('cookie', cookieHeader);
  }

  // Forward authorization header if present
  const authHeader = req.headers.get('authorization');
  if (authHeader) {
    requestHeaders.set('authorization', authHeader);
  }

  // Forward client Origin and Referer transparently WITHOUT forging/overwriting foreign origins
  const origin = req.headers.get('origin');
  if (origin) {
    requestHeaders.set('origin', origin);
  }
  const referer = req.headers.get('referer');
  if (referer) {
    requestHeaders.set('referer', referer);
  }

  // Forward client request ID
  const requestId = req.headers.get('x-request-id') || crypto.randomUUID();
  requestHeaders.set('x-request-id', requestId);

  // Forward client IP using explicit trusted ingress configuration
  const trustedClientIp = resolveForwardedClientIp(req.headers);
  requestHeaders.set('x-forwarded-for', trustedClientIp);

  let body: string | undefined;
  if (req.method !== 'GET' && req.method !== 'HEAD') {
    try {
      body = await req.text();
    } catch {
      body = undefined;
    }
  }

  try {
    const expressRes = await fetch(targetUrl, {
      method: req.method,
      headers: requestHeaders,
      body,
      cache: 'no-store',
    });

    const responseData = await expressRes.text();

    const responseHeaders = new Headers();
    responseHeaders.set('Content-Type', expressRes.headers.get('content-type') || 'application/json');

    // Forward standard rate-limit and retry headers to allow client handling (e.g. 429)
    const rateLimitHeaders = [
      'retry-after',
      'ratelimit-limit',
      'ratelimit-remaining',
      'ratelimit-reset',
      'ratelimit-policy',
    ];
    for (const h of rateLimitHeaders) {
      const val = expressRes.headers.get(h);
      if (val !== null) {
        responseHeaders.set(h, val);
      }
    }

    const response = new NextResponse(responseData, {
      status: expressRes.status,
      headers: responseHeaders,
    });

    // Forward Set-Cookie headers from Express to Browser
    const setCookieHeaders = expressRes.headers.getSetCookie();
    if (setCookieHeaders && setCookieHeaders.length > 0) {
      for (const cookieStr of setCookieHeaders) {
        response.headers.append('set-cookie', cookieStr);
      }
    }

    return response;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`[BFF Proxy Error] ${req.method} ${targetUrl} failed:`, err instanceof Error ? err.message : err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error: {
          code: 'BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE',
          message: 'Layanan backend sedang tidak dapat dihubungi. Silakan coba beberapa saat lagi.',
        },
      },
      { status: 503 }
    );
  }
}

export const GET = handleProxy;
export const POST = handleProxy;
export const PATCH = handleProxy;
export const DELETE = handleProxy;
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/components/assignments/delete-task-dialog.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import { Assignment } from '@studyflow/shared';
import { deleteAssignment } from '@/lib/assignment-client';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from '@/components/ui/alert';
import { AlertCircle, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';

export interface DeleteTaskDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  assignment: Assignment | null;
  onSuccess: () => void;
}

export function DeleteTaskDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  assignment,
  onSuccess,
}: DeleteTaskDialogProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = React.useState(false);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setErrorMsg(null);
    }
  }, [open]);

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!assignment) return;
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setErrorMsg(null);
    try {
      await deleteAssignment(assignment.id);
      onOpenChange(false);
      onSuccess();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMsg(err.message || 'Gagal menghapus tugas.');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-[420px]">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Hapus Tugas</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Apakah Anda yakin ingin menghapus tugas{' '}
            <strong className="text-foreground break-words">{assignment?.title}</strong>? Tindakan ini tidak dapat dibatalkan dan tugas akan dihapus secara permanen.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        {errorMsg && (
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
            <AlertDescription>{errorMsg}</AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        )}

        <DialogFooter className="pt-2 flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row gap-2 sm:justify-end">
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="standard"
            onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
            disabled={isSubmitting}
          >
            Batal
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="destructive"
            size="standard"
            onClick={handleDelete}
            disabled={isSubmitting}
          >
            {isSubmitting ? (
              <>
                <Loader2 className="mr-1.5 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                Menghapus...
              </>
            ) : (

'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import { Course } from '@studyflow/shared';
import { deleteCourse } from '@/lib/course-client';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from '@/components/ui/alert';
import { AlertCircle, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';

export interface DeleteCourseDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  course: Course | null;
  onSuccess: () => void;
}

export function DeleteCourseDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  course,
  onSuccess,
}: DeleteCourseDialogProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = React.useState(false);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setErrorMsg(null);
    }
  }, [open]);

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!course) return;
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setErrorMsg(null);
    try {
      await deleteCourse(course.id);
      onOpenChange(false);
      onSuccess();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMsg(err.message || 'Gagal menghapus mata kuliah.');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-[440px] max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Hapus Mata Kuliah</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Apakah Anda yakin ingin menghapus mata kuliah{' '}
            <strong className="text-foreground break-words">{course?.name}</strong>? Tindakan ini tidak dapat dibatalkan.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        {errorMsg && (
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
            <AlertDescription>{errorMsg}</AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        )}

        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground bg-muted/40 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-border">
          Catatan: Sistem menolak penghapusan jika mata kuliah masih memiliki materi, tugas, atau catatan aktif. Pastikan data terkait telah dibersihkan terlebih dahulu, atau gunakan opsi arsip jika semester telah selesai.
        </p>

        <DialogFooter className="pt-2 flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row gap-2 sm:justify-end">
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="outline"
            size="standard"
            onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
            disabled={isSubmitting}
          >
            Batal
          </Button>
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="destructive"
            size="standard"
            onClick={handleDelete}
            disabled={isSubmitting}
          >
            {isSubmitting ? (
              <>
                <Loader2 className="mr-1.5 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                Menghapus...
              </>
            ) : (
              'Hapus Mata Kuliah'
            )}
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );

<file path="apps/web/src/components/courses/edit-course-dialog.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import { Course, UpdateCourseInput } from '@studyflow/shared';
import { updateCourse } from '@/lib/course-client';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from '@/components/ui/alert';
import { AlertCircle, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';

export interface EditCourseDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  course: Course | null;
  onSuccess: (updatedCourse: Course) => void;
}

export function EditCourseDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  course,
  onSuccess,
}: EditCourseDialogProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const [name, setName] = React.useState('');
  const [code, setCode] = React.useState('');
  const [lecturer, setLecturer] = React.useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = React.useState('');
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = React.useState(false);

  const lastCourseIdRef = React.useRef<string | null>(null);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (open && course && lastCourseIdRef.current !== course.id) {
      setErrorMsg(null);
      setName(course.name || '');
      setCode(course.code || '');
      setLecturer(course.lecturer || '');
      setDescription(course.description || '');
      lastCourseIdRef.current = course.id;
    } else if (!open) {
      lastCourseIdRef.current = null;
    }
  }, [open, course]);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!course) return;
    setErrorMsg(null);

    if (!name.trim()) {
      setErrorMsg('Nama mata kuliah wajib diisi');
      return;
    }
    if (name.trim().length < 2) {
      setErrorMsg('Nama mata kuliah minimal 2 karakter');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const input: UpdateCourseInput = {
        name: name.trim(),
        code: code.trim() || null,
        lecturer: lecturer.trim() || null,
        description: description.trim() || null,
      };
      const updated = await updateCourse(course.id, input);
      onOpenChange(false);
      onSuccess(updated);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMsg(err.message || 'Gagal memperbarui mata kuliah');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-[480px] max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Edit Mata Kuliah</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Perbarui detail informasi mata kuliah{' '}
            <strong className="text-foreground">{course?.name}</strong>.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        {errorMsg && (
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
            <AlertDescription>{errorMsg}</AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        )}

        <form noValidate onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="edit-course-name">Nama Mata Kuliah *</Label>
            <Input
              id="edit-course-name"
              placeholder="Contoh: Algoritma & Pemrograman"
              value={name}
              onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="edit-course-code">Kode Mata Kuliah</Label>
              <Input
                id="edit-course-code"
                placeholder="Contoh: IF210"
                value={code}
                onChange={(e) => setCode(e.target.value)}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="edit-course-lecturer">Dosen Pengampu</Label>
              <Input
                id="edit-course-lecturer"
                placeholder="Contoh: Dr. Budi"
                value={lecturer}
                onChange={(e) => setLecturer(e.target.value)}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="edit-course-desc">Deskripsi</Label>
            <Textarea
              id="edit-course-desc"
              placeholder="Catatan mengenai silabus, ruang kelas, atau jadwal..."
              value={description}
              onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              rows={3}
            />
          </div>

          <DialogFooter className="pt-2 flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row gap-2 sm:justify-end">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="standard"
              onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            >
              Batal
            </Button>
            <Button type="submit" size="standard" disabled={isSubmitting}>
              {isSubmitting ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="mr-1.5 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                  Memperbarui...
                </>
              ) : (
                'Simpan Perubahan'
              )}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

<file path="apps/web/src/components/layout/sidebar-semester-selector.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import {
  CalendarRange,
  ChevronsUpDown,
  Check,
  Plus,
  Loader2,
  AlertCircle,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Semester } from '@studyflow/shared';
import { listSemesters, activateSemester } from '@/lib/semester-client';
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuLabel,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
} from '@/components/ui/dropdown-menu';
import { Tooltip, TooltipTrigger, TooltipContent } from '@/components/ui/tooltip';

interface SidebarSemesterSelectorProps {
  isCollapsed: boolean;
  onNavigate?: () => void;
}

export function SidebarSemesterSelector({
  isCollapsed,
  onNavigate,
}: SidebarSemesterSelectorProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [semesters, setSemesters] = React.useState<Semester[]>([]);
  const [activeSemester, setActiveSemester] = React.useState<Semester | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = React.useState(true);
  const [isActivating, setIsActivating] = React.useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  const loadData = React.useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await listSemesters('all');
      setSemesters(res.semesters);
      setActiveSemester(res.activeSemester);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Gagal memuat daftar semester.');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, [loadData]);

  // Listen to semester changes triggered from other components (e.g. Semesters management page)
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleSemesterChange = () => {
      loadData();
    };
    window.addEventListener('studyflow:semester-changed', handleSemesterChange);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('studyflow:semester-changed', handleSemesterChange);
    };
  }, [loadData]);

  const handleSelectSemester = async (sem: Semester) => {
    if (sem.isActive) {
      return;
    }

    if (sem.archivedAt) {
      setErrorMessage('Semester yang diarsipkan tidak dapat diaktifkan.');
      return;
    }

    setIsActivating(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);

    try {
      await activateSemester(sem.id);
      setActiveSemester(sem);
      setSemesters((prev) =>
        prev.map((s) => ({
          ...s,
          isActive: s.id === sem.id,
        }))
      );

      // 1. Dispatch custom event to notify all active client views to reload data
      window.dispatchEvent(
        new CustomEvent('studyflow:semester-changed', {
          detail: { semesterId: sem.id },
        })
      );

      // 2. Trigger Next.js server component refresh
      router.refresh();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(
        err.message || 'Gagal mengubah semester aktif. Silakan coba lagi.'
      );
    } finally {
      setIsActivating(false);
    }
  };

  // View when sidebar is collapsed (Desktop Icon-only mode)
  if (isCollapsed) {
    return (
      <div className="flex justify-center py-2 px-1">
        <DropdownMenu>
          <Tooltip>
            <TooltipTrigger asChild>
              <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  aria-label={
                    activeSemester
                      ? `Semester Aktif: ${activeSemester.name} (${activeSemester.academicYear})`
                      : 'Pilih Semester Aktif'
                  }
                  className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-sidebar-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-sidebar-accent hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground focus-visible:outline-hidden focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-sidebar-ring"
                >
                  <CalendarRange className="h-5 w-5" />
                </button>
              </DropdownMenuTrigger>
            </TooltipTrigger>
            <TooltipContent side="right" align="center">
              {activeSemester ? (
                <div>
                  <p className="font-semibold text-xs">{activeSemester.name}</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{activeSemester.academicYear}</p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                'Pilih Semester Aktif'
              )}
            </TooltipContent>
          </Tooltip>

          <DropdownMenuContent side="right" align="start" className="w-64">
            <DropdownMenuLabel>Pilih Semester Aktif</DropdownMenuLabel>
            <DropdownMenuSeparator />
            {semesters.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="p-3 text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                <p>Belum ada semester</p>
                <Link
                  href="/semesters"
                  onClick={onNavigate}
                  className="mt-1.5 inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-medium text-primary hover:underline"
                >
                  <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Tambah Semester
                </Link>
              </div>
            ) : (
              semesters.map((sem) => {
                const isArchived = Boolean(sem.archivedAt);
                return (
                  <DropdownMenuItem
                    key={sem.id}
                    disabled={isArchived || isActivating || sem.isActive}
                    onClick={() => handleSelectSemester(sem)}
                    className="flex items-center justify-between py-2 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 pr-2">
                      <p className={`truncate text-xs ${sem.isActive ? 'font-semibold text-primary' : ''}`}>
                        {sem.name}
                      </p>
                      <p className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        {sem.academicYear} {isArchived ? '(Arsip)' : ''}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    {sem.isActive && <Check className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-primary" />}
                  </DropdownMenuItem>
                );
              })
            )}
            <DropdownMenuSeparator />
            <DropdownMenuItem asChild>
              <Link
                href="/semesters"
                onClick={onNavigate}
                className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer text-xs font-medium text-primary"
              >
                <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
                <span>Kelola / Tambah Semester</span>
              </Link>
            </DropdownMenuItem>
          </DropdownMenuContent>
        </DropdownMenu>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // View when sidebar is expanded or in mobile drawer
  return (
    <div className="px-3 py-2 border-b border-sidebar-border">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5 px-0.5">
        <span className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
          Semester Aktif
        </span>
        <Link
          href="/semesters"
          onClick={onNavigate}
          className="text-xs text-primary hover:underline font-medium"
        >
          Kelola
        </Link>
      </div>

      <DropdownMenu>
        <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={isActivating}
            aria-label="Pilih semester aktif"
            className="w-full flex items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-lg border border-sidebar-border bg-sidebar-accent/40 px-3 py-2 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-sidebar-accent focus-visible:outline-hidden focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-sidebar-ring disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              {isLoading ? (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 py-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin text-primary" />
                  <span>Memuat semester...</span>
                </div>
              ) : isActivating ? (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 py-0.5 text-xs text-primary">
                  <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                  <span>Mengaktifkan...</span>
                </div>
              ) : activeSemester ? (
                <div>
                  <p className="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-sidebar-foreground leading-tight">
                    {activeSemester.name}
                  </p>
                  <p className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground leading-tight mt-0.5">
                    {activeSemester.academicYear}
                  </p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Belum ada semester aktif</span>
              )}
            </div>
            <ChevronsUpDown className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground opacity-70" />
          </button>
        </DropdownMenuTrigger>

        <DropdownMenuContent align="start" className="w-[256px]">
          <DropdownMenuLabel>Pilih Semester Aktif</DropdownMenuLabel>
          <DropdownMenuSeparator />

          {semesters.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-3 text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              <p>Belum ada semester.</p>
              <Link
                href="/semesters"
                onClick={onNavigate}
                className="mt-1.5 inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-medium text-primary hover:underline"
              >
                <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Tambah Semester
              </Link>
            </div>
          ) : (
            semesters.map((sem) => {
              const isArchived = Boolean(sem.archivedAt);
              return (
                <DropdownMenuItem
                  key={sem.id}
                  disabled={isArchived || isActivating || sem.isActive}
                  onClick={() => handleSelectSemester(sem)}
                  className={`flex items-center justify-between py-2 cursor-pointer ${
                    sem.isActive ? 'bg-primary/10 text-primary font-semibold' : ''
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 pr-2">
                    <p className={`truncate text-xs ${sem.isActive ? 'font-semibold text-primary' : 'text-foreground'}`}>
                      {sem.name}
                    </p>
                    <p className="truncate text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                      {sem.academicYear} {isArchived ? '(Arsip)' : ''}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  {sem.isActive && <Check className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-primary" />}
                </DropdownMenuItem>
              );
            })
          )}

          <DropdownMenuSeparator />
          <DropdownMenuItem asChild>
            <Link
              href="/semesters"
              onClick={onNavigate}
              className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer text-xs font-medium text-primary"
            >
              <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
              <span>Kelola / Tambah Semester</span>
            </Link>
          </DropdownMenuItem>
        </DropdownMenuContent>
      </DropdownMenu>

      {/* Visible Error Notification */}
      {errorMessage && (
        <div
          role="alert"
          className="mt-2 flex items-start justify-between gap-1.5 rounded-md border border-danger/30 bg-danger/10 p-2 text-xs text-danger"
        >
          <div className="flex items-start gap-1.5">

            <span className="leading-tight">{errorMessage}</span>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setErrorMessage(null)}
            className="text-danger/70 hover:text-danger"
            aria-label="Tutup pesan error"
          >
            <X className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
