<file path="apps/web/src/components/materials/material-flashcard-tab.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import {
  Layers,
  Sparkles,
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  RotateCw,
  CheckCircle,
  HelpCircle,
  FileText,
  AlertCircle,
  Loader2,
  Eye,
  EyeOff,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { FlashcardSet, Flashcard } from '@studyflow/shared';
import {
  getMaterialFlashcards,
  generateFlashcards,
  updateFlashcardMastery,
} from '@/lib/learning-client';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/card';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';

interface MaterialFlashcardTabProps {
  materialId: string;
  isArchived?: boolean;
  onNavigateToPage?: (pageNumber: number) => void;
}

export function MaterialFlashcardTab({
  materialId,
  isArchived = false,
  onNavigateToPage,
}: MaterialFlashcardTabProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const [sets, setSets] = React.useState<FlashcardSet[]>([]);
  const [selectedSet, setSelectedSet] = React.useState<FlashcardSet | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = React.useState(true);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  // Dialog pembuatan flashcard baru
  const [isGenerateDialogOpen, setIsGenerateDialogOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const [targetCount, setTargetCount] = React.useState<5 | 10 | 20>(10);
  const [isSubmittingGen, setIsSubmittingGen] = React.useState(false);

  // Status pembelajaran kartu saat ini
  const [currentIndex, setCurrentIndex] = React.useState(0);
  const [isFlipped, setIsFlipped] = React.useState(false);
  const [isUpdatingMastery, setIsUpdatingMastery] = React.useState(false);
  const [masteryError, setMasteryError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  const loadSets = React.useCallback(async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);
    try {
      const res = await getMaterialFlashcards(materialId);
      setSets(res.sets);
      if (res.sets.length > 0) {
        setSelectedSet((prev) => {
          if (!prev) return res.sets[0];
          const matched = res.sets.find((s) => s.id === prev.id);
          return matched || res.sets[0];
        });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Failed to load flashcard sets:', err);
      // Jangan hilangkan set yang sudah ada jika refresh sementara gagal
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Gagal memuat flashcards');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [materialId]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    loadSets();
  }, [loadSets]);

  // Polling untuk status job AI background (QUEUED atau PROCESSING)
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const hasActiveJob = sets.some(
      (s) => s.status === 'QUEUED' || s.status === 'PROCESSING'
    );
    if (!hasActiveJob) return;

    const interval = setInterval(async () => {
      try {
        const res = await getMaterialFlashcards(materialId);
        setSets(res.sets);
        if (selectedSet) {
          const updated = res.sets.find((s) => s.id === selectedSet.id);
          if (updated) setSelectedSet(updated);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Flashcard polling error:', err);
      }
    }, 3000);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [sets, materialId, selectedSet]);

  const handleRequestGeneration = async () => {
    setIsSubmittingGen(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);
    try {
      await generateFlashcards(materialId, targetCount);
      setIsGenerateDialogOpen(false);
      await loadSets();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Gagal meminta pembuatan flashcards');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmittingGen(false);
    }
  };

  const handleUpdateMastery = async (cardId: string, status: 'NEED_REVIEW' | 'MASTERED') => {
    if (!selectedSet || !selectedSet.cards) return;
    setIsUpdatingMastery(true);
    setMasteryError(null);
    try {
      const updatedCard = await updateFlashcardMastery(cardId, status);
      setSelectedSet((prev) => {
        if (!prev || !prev.cards) return prev;
        return {
          ...prev,
          cards: prev.cards.map((c) => (c.id === cardId ? updatedCard : c)),
        };
      });
      // Pindah ke kartu berikutnya secara otomatis jika belum di ujung
      if (currentIndex < selectedSet.cards.length - 1) {
        setCurrentIndex((i) => i + 1);
        setIsFlipped(false);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setMasteryError(err.message || 'Gagal memperbarui status pemahaman');
    } finally {
      setIsUpdatingMastery(false);
    }
  };

  const cards: Flashcard[] = selectedSet?.cards || [];
  const currentCard: Flashcard | undefined = cards[currentIndex];

  const masteredCount = cards.filter((c) => c.masteryStatus === 'MASTERED').length;
  const reviewCount = cards.filter((c) => c.masteryStatus === 'NEED_REVIEW').length;

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-20 text-muted-foreground">
        <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-primary" />
        <p className="mt-3 text-sm font-medium">Memuat flashcard materi...</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* 1. Header Toolbar Flashcards */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-border pb-4">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Layers className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
            <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-foreground">Flashcards Materi</h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
            Latih pemahaman konsep dan istilah kunci materi kuliah dengan kartu belajar interaktif.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {sets.length > 0 && (
            <select
              value={selectedSet?.id || ''}
              onChange={(e) => {
                const found = sets.find((s) => s.id === e.target.value);
                if (found) {
                  setSelectedSet(found);
                  setCurrentIndex(0);
                  setIsFlipped(false);
                }
              }}
              className="h-9 rounded-lg border border-border bg-background px-3 text-xs font-medium text-foreground focus-visible:outline-hidden focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-primary"
              aria-label="Pilih set flashcard"
            >
              {sets.map((s) => (
                <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>
                  {s.title} ({s.cards?.length || s.cardCount} kartu)
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          )}

          <Button
            size="standard"
            onClick={() => setIsGenerateDialogOpen(true)}
            disabled={isArchived}
            className="gap-1.5 text-xs h-9"
          >
            <Sparkles className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            <span>Buat Flashcard Baru</span>
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {errorMessage && (
        <div
          role="alert"
          className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/10 p-3.5 text-xs text-destructive"
        >
          <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{errorMessage}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Case 1: Belum Ada Flashcard (Empty Onboarding) */}
      {sets.length === 0 ? (
        <Card className="p-10 sm:p-14 text-center bg-card border-dashed border-border shadow-xs">
          <div className="mx-auto flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary/10 text-primary">
            <Layers className="h-6 w-6" />
          </div>
          <h3 className="mt-4 text-base font-semibold text-foreground">Belum Ada Flashcard</h3>
          <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs sm:text-sm text-muted-foreground max-w-md mx-auto leading-relaxed">
            Hasilkan set flashcard dari materi kuliah ini dengan bantuan AI untuk melatih daya ingat dan pemahaman konsep secara terarah.
          </p>
          <Button
            size="standard"
            onClick={() => setIsGenerateDialogOpen(true)}
            disabled={isArchived}
            className="mt-5 gap-2 text-xs"
          >
            <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4" />
            <span>Buat Flashcard Sekarang</span>
          </Button>
        </Card>
      ) : selectedSet?.status === 'QUEUED' || selectedSet?.status === 'PROCESSING' ? (
        /* Case 2: Dalam Proses Generasi AI */
        <Card className="p-10 sm:p-14 text-center bg-card border border-border shadow-xs">
          <div className="mx-auto flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary/10 text-primary">
            <Loader2 className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin" />
          </div>
          <h3 className="mt-4 text-base font-semibold text-foreground">Menyusun Flashcard AI...</h3>
          <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs sm:text-sm text-muted-foreground max-w-md mx-auto leading-relaxed">
            AI sedang menganalisis teks materi dan merancang pasangan pertanyaan serta jawaban lengkap dengan rujukan halaman dokumen PDF.
          </p>
          <div className="mt-4 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-border bg-muted/40 px-3.5 py-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-primary animate-pulse" />
            <span>Memproses di antrean background worker</span>
          </div>
        </Card>
      ) : selectedSet?.status === 'FAILED' ? (
        /* Case 3: Gagal Generasi AI */
        <Card className="border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 p-8 sm:p-10 text-center shadow-xs">
          <div className="mx-auto flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-destructive/10 text-destructive">
            <AlertCircle className="h-6 w-6" />
          </div>
          <h3 className="mt-3 text-base font-semibold text-destructive">Gagal Membuat Flashcard</h3>
          <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs sm:text-sm text-muted-foreground max-w-md mx-auto leading-relaxed">
            {selectedSet.errorMessage || 'Terjadi kendala saat menganalisis berkas materi dengan AI.'}
          </p>
          <Button
            size="standard"
            variant="outline"
            onClick={() => setIsGenerateDialogOpen(true)}
            className="mt-5 gap-1.5 text-xs"
          >
            <RotateCw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            <span>Coba Buat Ulang</span>
          </Button>
        </Card>
      ) : cards.length > 0 && currentCard ? (
        /* Case 4: Flashcard Study Player */
        <div className="space-y-4 max-w-2xl mx-auto">
          {/* Bar Info & Statistik Progres */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground px-1">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">
                Kartu {currentIndex + 1} dari {cards.length}
              </span>
              <span>•</span>
              <span className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-medium">
                {masteredCount} Paham
              </span>
              <span>•</span>
              <span className="text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 font-medium">
                {reviewCount} Perlu Diulang
              </span>
            </div>

            {currentCard.pageReferences && currentCard.pageReferences.length > 0 && onNavigateToPage && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onNavigateToPage(currentCard.pageReferences[0])}
                className="hover:text-primary transition-colors flex items-center gap-1 underline underline-offset-2 text-xs text-primary font-medium"
                title={`Buka halaman ${currentCard.pageReferences.join(', ')} di pembaca PDF`}
              >
                <FileText className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                <span>Lihat Hal. {currentCard.pageReferences.join(', ')}</span>
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Kartu Belajar Interaktif */}
          <div
            role="region"
            aria-label={`Kartu belajar ${currentIndex + 1} dari ${cards.length}`}
            onClick={() => setIsFlipped(!isFlipped)}
            tabIndex={0}
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') {
                e.preventDefault();
                setIsFlipped(!isFlipped);
              }
            }}
            className={`min-h-[260px] sm:min-h-[300px] w-full rounded-xl border p-6 sm:p-8 flex flex-col justify-between cursor-pointer select-none transition-colors duration-150 motion-reduce:transition-none shadow-xs ${
              isFlipped
                ? 'border-primary/40 bg-primary/5 hover:border-primary/60 dark:bg-primary/10'
                : 'border-border bg-card hover:border-muted-foreground/30'
            }`}
          >
            {/* Header Sisi Kartu */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
              <span>{isFlipped ? 'Jawaban / Penjelasan' : 'Pertanyaan / Istilah'}</span>
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 normal-case font-normal text-muted-foreground">
                <RotateCw className="h-3 w-3" />
                <span>Klik untuk membalik</span>
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Isi Teks Utama (Jawaban Panjang Terbaca Tuntas) */}
            <div className="my-auto py-5 max-h-[360px] overflow-y-auto px-1">
              <p className="text-base sm:text-lg font-semibold text-foreground text-center leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap break-words">
                {isFlipped ? currentCard.back : currentCard.front}
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Footer Sisi Kartu */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-muted-foreground border-t border-border/40 pt-3">
              <div>
                {currentCard.masteryStatus === 'MASTERED' ? (
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-medium text-xs">
                    <CheckCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Sudah paham
                  </span>
                ) : currentCard.masteryStatus === 'NEED_REVIEW' ? (
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 font-medium text-xs">
                    <HelpCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Perlu diulang
                  </span>
                ) : (
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">Belum ditandai</span>
                )}
              </div>

              <span className="text-[11px] hidden sm:inline">Tekan Spasi atau klik kartu</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Tombol Balik Kartu Eksplisit */}
          <div className="flex justify-center">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="standard"
              onClick={() => setIsFlipped(!isFlipped)}
              className="gap-2 text-xs min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-[36px] w-full sm:w-auto"
            >
              {isFlipped ? (
                <>
                  <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" />
                  <span>Sembunyikan Jawaban</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />
                  <span>Tampilkan Jawaban</span>
                </>
              )}
            </Button>
          </div>

          {masteryError && (
            <div
              role="alert"
              className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/10 p-3 text-xs text-destructive"
            >
              <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
              <span>{masteryError}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Tombol Penilaian Pemahaman Pribadi */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 pt-1">
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="standard"
              onClick={() => handleUpdateMastery(currentCard.id, 'NEED_REVIEW')}
              disabled={isUpdatingMastery || isArchived}
              className="flex-1 gap-1.5 text-xs text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 border-amber-500/30 hover:bg-amber-500/10 min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-[36px]"
            >
              <HelpCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
              <span>Perlu Diulang</span>
            </Button>

            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="standard"
              onClick={() => handleUpdateMastery(currentCard.id, 'MASTERED')}
              disabled={isUpdatingMastery || isArchived}
              className="flex-1 gap-1.5 text-xs text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/30 hover:bg-emerald-500/10 min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-[36px]"
            >
              <CheckCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
              <span>Sudah Paham</span>
            </Button>
          </div>

          {/* Navigasi Stepper Sebelumnya & Selanjutnya */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-4 border-t border-border">
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="standard"
              onClick={() => {
                if (currentIndex > 0) {
                  setCurrentIndex((i) => i - 1);
                  setIsFlipped(false);
                }
              }}
              disabled={currentIndex === 0}
              className="gap-1.5 text-xs min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-[36px]"
            >
              <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
              <span>Sebelumnya</span>
            </Button>

            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
              {currentIndex + 1} / {cards.length}
            </span>

            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="standard"
              onClick={() => {
                if (currentIndex < cards.length - 1) {
                  setCurrentIndex((i) => i + 1);
                  setIsFlipped(false);
                }
              }}
              disabled={currentIndex === cards.length - 1}
              className="gap-1.5 text-xs min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-[36px]"
            >
              <span>Selanjutnya</span>
              <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {/* Dialog Konfigurasi Pembuatan Flashcard AI */}
      <Dialog open={isGenerateDialogOpen} onOpenChange={setIsGenerateDialogOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-[420px] p-5 sm:p-6">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle className="text-base font-bold text-foreground">
              Buat Flashcard dengan AI
            </DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription className="text-xs text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mt-1">
              Pilih jumlah kartu yang ingin dibuat dari materi perkuliahan ini.
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>

          <div className="py-4 space-y-3">
            <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">Jumlah Kartu Belajar</label>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
              {[5, 10, 20].map((count) => (
                <button
                  key={count}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setTargetCount(count as 5 | 10 | 20)}
                  className={`rounded-xl border p-3.5 text-center transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    targetCount === count
                      ? 'border-primary bg-primary/10 text-primary font-bold shadow-xs'
                      : 'border-border bg-card text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40'
                  }`}
                >
                  <span className="text-base sm:text-lg">{count}</span>
                  <span className="block text-[11px] font-normal text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                    Kartu
                  </span>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed pt-1">
              Pembuatan flashcard menggunakan kuota AI harian Anda. Kartu dilengkapi rujukan halaman PDF asli untuk memverifikasi materi.
            </p>
          </div>

          <DialogFooter className="flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row gap-2 sm:justify-end">
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="standard"
              onClick={() => setIsGenerateDialogOpen(false)}
              disabled={isSubmittingGen}
            >
              Batal
            </Button>
            <Button
              size="standard"
              onClick={handleRequestGeneration}
              disabled={isSubmittingGen}
              className="gap-2"
            >
              {isSubmittingGen ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                  <span>Memproses...</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4" />
                  <span>Mulai Pembuatan</span>
                </>
              )}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/components/materials/material-quiz-tab.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import {
  HelpCircle,
  Sparkles,
  CheckCircle2,
  XCircle,
  RotateCcw,
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  FileText,
  AlertCircle,
  Loader2,
  Award,
  Check,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  Quiz,
  QuizAttemptResponse,
  StartQuizAttemptResponse,
} from '@studyflow/shared';
import {
  getMaterialQuizzes,
  generateQuiz,
  startQuizAttempt,
  saveQuizDraftAnswers,
  submitQuizAttempt,
} from '@/lib/learning-client';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/card';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';

interface MaterialQuizTabProps {
  materialId: string;
  isArchived?: boolean;
  onNavigateToPage?: (pageNumber: number) => void;
}

export function MaterialQuizTab({
  materialId,
  isArchived = false,
  onNavigateToPage,
}: MaterialQuizTabProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const [quizzes, setQuizzes] = React.useState<Quiz[]>([]);
  const [selectedQuiz, setSelectedQuiz] = React.useState<Quiz | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = React.useState(true);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  // Dialog konfigurasi pembuatan kuis baru
  const [isGenerateDialogOpen, setIsGenerateDialogOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const [targetCount, setTargetCount] = React.useState<5 | 10>(5);
  const [isSubmittingGen, setIsSubmittingGen] = React.useState(false);

  // Status pengerjaan kuis yang sedang aktif (Active Attempt)
  const [activeAttempt, setActiveAttempt] = React.useState<StartQuizAttemptResponse | null>(null);
  const [userAnswers, setUserAnswers] = React.useState<Record<string, number>>({});
  const [currentQuestionIndex, setCurrentQuestionIndex] = React.useState(0);
  const [isStartingAttempt, setIsStartingAttempt] = React.useState(false);
  const [isSubmittingAttempt, setIsSubmittingAttempt] = React.useState(false);

  // Status penyimpanan draft jawaban (idle, saving, saved, error)
  const [draftSaveStatus, setDraftSaveStatus] = React.useState<'idle' | 'saving' | 'saved' | 'error'>('idle');
  const [draftSaveError, setDraftSaveError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  // Dialog konfirmasi submit kuis
  const [isSubmitConfirmOpen, setIsSubmitConfirmOpen] = React.useState(false);

  // Hasil pengerjaan kuis yang sudah dinilai (Completed Attempt Review)
  const [completedAttempt, setCompletedAttempt] = React.useState<QuizAttemptResponse | null>(null);

  const loadQuizzes = React.useCallback(async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);
    try {
      const res = await getMaterialQuizzes(materialId);
      setQuizzes(res.quizzes);
      if (res.quizzes.length > 0) {
        setSelectedQuiz((prev) => {
          if (!prev) return res.quizzes[0];
          const found = res.quizzes.find((q) => q.id === prev.id);
          return found || res.quizzes[0];
        });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Failed to load quizzes:', err);
      // Jangan hapus daftar kuis yang sudah ada jika hanya terjadi kegagalan refresh sementara
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Gagal memuat kuis');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [materialId]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    loadQuizzes();
  }, [loadQuizzes]);

  // Polling untuk status job AI background (QUEUED atau PROCESSING)
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const hasActiveJob = quizzes.some(
      (q) => q.status === 'QUEUED' || q.status === 'PROCESSING'
    );
    if (!hasActiveJob) return;

    const interval = setInterval(async () => {
      try {
        const res = await getMaterialQuizzes(materialId);
        setQuizzes(res.quizzes);
        if (selectedQuiz) {
          const updated = res.quizzes.find((q) => q.id === selectedQuiz.id);
          if (updated) setSelectedQuiz(updated);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Quiz polling error:', err);
      }
    }, 3000);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [quizzes, materialId, selectedQuiz]);

  const handleRequestGeneration = async () => {
    setIsSubmittingGen(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);
    try {
      await generateQuiz(materialId, targetCount);
      setIsGenerateDialogOpen(false);
      await loadQuizzes();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Gagal meminta pembuatan kuis');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmittingGen(false);
    }
  };

  const handleStartAttempt = async (quizId: string) => {
    setIsStartingAttempt(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setCompletedAttempt(null);
    try {
      const attemptRes = await startQuizAttempt(quizId);
      setActiveAttempt(attemptRes);
      // Restore jawaban yang sudah tersimpan sebelumnya jika ada
      setUserAnswers(attemptRes.existingAnswers || {});
      setCurrentQuestionIndex(0);
      setDraftSaveStatus(attemptRes.existingAnswers && Object.keys(attemptRes.existingAnswers).length > 0 ? 'saved' : 'idle');
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Gagal memulai kuis');
    } finally {
      setIsStartingAttempt(false);
    }
  };

  const persistDraftAnswer = async (attemptId: string, questionId: string, optionIndex: number) => {
    setDraftSaveStatus('saving');
    setDraftSaveError(null);
    try {
      await saveQuizDraftAnswers(attemptId, [
        { questionId, selectedIndex: optionIndex },
      ]);
      setDraftSaveStatus('saved');
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Failed to save draft answer:', err);
      setDraftSaveStatus('error');
      setDraftSaveError(err.message || 'Gagal menyimpan draft jawaban ke server.');
    }
  };

  const handleSelectOption = (questionId: string, optionIndex: number) => {
    setUserAnswers((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [questionId]: optionIndex,
    }));

    if (activeAttempt) {
      persistDraftAnswer(activeAttempt.attemptId, questionId, optionIndex);
    }
  };

  const handleRetrySaveDraft = () => {
    if (!activeAttempt) return;
    const currentQId = activeAttempt.questions[currentQuestionIndex]?.id;
    if (currentQId && userAnswers[currentQId] !== undefined) {
      persistDraftAnswer(activeAttempt.attemptId, currentQId, userAnswers[currentQId]);
    }
  };

  const handleConfirmSubmit = async () => {
    if (!activeAttempt) return;
    setIsSubmittingAttempt(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);
    try {
      const formattedAnswers = activeAttempt.questions.map((q) => ({
        questionId: q.id,
        selectedIndex: userAnswers[q.id] !== undefined ? userAnswers[q.id] : null,
      }));

      const result = await submitQuizAttempt(activeAttempt.attemptId, formattedAnswers);
      setCompletedAttempt(result);
      setActiveAttempt(null);
      setIsSubmitConfirmOpen(false);
    } catch (err: any) {
      // Pertahankan seluruh jawaban pengguna saat submit gagal
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Gagal mengirimkan jawaban kuis. Silakan coba kirim ulang.');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmittingAttempt(false);
    }
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-20 text-muted-foreground">
        <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-primary" />
        <p className="mt-3 text-sm font-medium">Memuat kuis materi...</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const answeredCount = Object.keys(userAnswers).length;
  const totalInAttempt = activeAttempt?.questions.length || 0;
  const unansweredCount = totalInAttempt - answeredCount;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* 1. Header Toolbar Kuis */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-border pb-4">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <HelpCircle className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
            <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-foreground">Kuis Pemahaman Materi</h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
            Uji kesiapan dan pemahaman konsep dengan soal pilihan ganda otomatis dan pembahasan berbasis rujukan dokumen PDF.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {quizzes.length > 0 && !activeAttempt && !completedAttempt && (
            <select
              value={selectedQuiz?.id || ''}
              onChange={(e) => {
                const found = quizzes.find((q) => q.id === e.target.value);
                if (found) {
                  setSelectedQuiz(found);
                }
              }}
              className="h-9 rounded-lg border border-border bg-background px-3 text-xs font-medium text-foreground focus-visible:outline-hidden focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-primary"
              aria-label="Pilih set kuis"
            >
              {quizzes.map((q) => (
                <option key={q.id} value={q.id}>
                  {q.title} ({q.questionCount || q.targetCount} soal)
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          )}

          {!activeAttempt && (
            <Button
              size="standard"
              onClick={() => setIsGenerateDialogOpen(true)}
              disabled={isArchived}
              className="gap-1.5 text-xs h-9"
            >
              <Sparkles className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              <span>Buat Kuis Baru</span>
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {errorMessage && (
        <div
          role="alert"
          className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/10 p-3.5 text-xs text-destructive"
        >
          <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{errorMessage}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Case 1: Belum Ada Kuis (Empty State) */}
      {quizzes.length === 0 ? (
        <Card className="p-10 sm:p-14 text-center bg-card border-dashed border-border shadow-xs">
          <div className="mx-auto flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary/10 text-primary">
            <HelpCircle className="h-6 w-6" />
          </div>
          <h3 className="mt-4 text-base font-semibold text-foreground">Belum Ada Kuis</h3>
          <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs sm:text-sm text-muted-foreground max-w-md mx-auto leading-relaxed">
            Hasilkan kuis pilihan ganda dari isi materi perkuliahan untuk menguji pemahaman konsep dan kesiapan ujian secara mandiri.
          </p>
          <Button
            size="standard"
            onClick={() => setIsGenerateDialogOpen(true)}
            disabled={isArchived}
            className="mt-5 gap-2 text-xs"
          >
            <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4" />
            <span>Buat Kuis Sekarang</span>
          </Button>
        </Card>
      ) : selectedQuiz?.status === 'QUEUED' || selectedQuiz?.status === 'PROCESSING' ? (
        /* Case 2: Dalam Proses Generasi AI */
        <Card className="p-10 sm:p-14 text-center bg-card border border-border shadow-xs">
          <div className="mx-auto flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary/10 text-primary">
            <Loader2 className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin" />
          </div>
          <h3 className="mt-4 text-base font-semibold text-foreground">Menyusun Soal Kuis AI...</h3>
          <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs sm:text-sm text-muted-foreground max-w-md mx-auto leading-relaxed">
            AI sedang menganalisis isi materi perkuliahan dan merancang soal pilihan ganda yang mendalam lengkap dengan rujukan pembahasan.
          </p>
          <div className="mt-4 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-border bg-muted/40 px-3.5 py-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-primary animate-pulse" />
            <span>Memproses di antrean background worker</span>
          </div>
        </Card>
      ) : completedAttempt ? (
        /* Case 3: Hasil Kuis & Review Pembahasan */
        <div className="space-y-6 max-w-2xl mx-auto">
          {/* Banner Nilai & Hasil */}
          <Card className="p-6 sm:p-8 text-center border-border bg-card shadow-xs">
            <div className="mx-auto flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary/10 text-primary">
              <Award className="h-6 w-6" />
            </div>
            <h3 className="mt-3 text-lg font-bold text-foreground">Hasil Pengerjaan Kuis</h3>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              Evaluasi jawaban dihitung otomatis oleh sistem pada server.
            </p>

            <div className="mt-5 flex items-center justify-center gap-8 py-3 px-6 rounded-xl bg-muted/30 border border-border w-fit mx-auto">
              <div>
                <span className="text-3xl font-extrabold text-primary">
                  {completedAttempt.score}
                </span>
                <span className="block text-[11px] font-medium text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                  Nilai (0-100)
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="h-8 w-px bg-border" />
              <div>
                <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
                  {completedAttempt.correctAnswersCount} / {completedAttempt.totalQuestions}
                </span>
                <span className="block text-[11px] font-medium text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                  Jawaban Benar
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-3">
              <Button
                size="standard"
                variant="outline"
                onClick={() => {
                  setCompletedAttempt(null);
                  if (selectedQuiz) handleStartAttempt(selectedQuiz.id);
                }}
                disabled={isArchived}
                className="gap-2 text-xs min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-[36px]"
              >
                <RotateCcw className="h-4 w-4" />
                <span>Ulangi Kuis</span>
              </Button>
              <Button
                size="standard"
                variant="ghost"
                onClick={() => setCompletedAttempt(null)}
                className="text-xs min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-[36px]"
              >
                Kembali ke Beranda Kuis
              </Button>
            </div>
          </Card>

          {/* Daftar Review Pembahasan & Referensi */}
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="border-b border-border pb-2">
              <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground">Pembahasan & Referensi Materi</h4>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                Tinjau kunci jawaban, pilihan yang Anda buat, dan rujukan halaman PDF asli.
              </p>
            </div>

            {completedAttempt.questions.map((q, idx) => {
              const isCorrect = q.isCorrect;
              return (
                <Card
                  key={q.id}
                  className={`p-5 sm:p-6 border shadow-xs transition-colors ${
                    isCorrect
                      ? 'border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-500/5'
                      : 'border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                      <span className="flex h-5 w-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-muted text-[11px] font-bold text-foreground mt-0.5">
                        {idx + 1}
                      </span>
                      <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold text-foreground leading-snug">
                        {q.question}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    {isCorrect ? (
                      <span className="shrink-0 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                        <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                        <span>Benar</span>
                      </span>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="shrink-0 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-destructive">
                        <XCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
                        <span>Salah</span>
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {/* Daftar Opsi Jawaban */}
                  <div className="mt-4 space-y-2">
                    {q.options.map((opt, optIdx) => {
                      const isOptionCorrect = optIdx === q.correctIndex;
                      const isUserChoice = optIdx === q.userSelectedIndex;

                      let optClass = 'border-border bg-card text-foreground';
                      let statusBadge = null;

                      if (isOptionCorrect && isUserChoice) {
                        optClass = 'border-emerald-500/60 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 font-semibold';
                        statusBadge = (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                            <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                            <span>Pilihan Anda (Benar)</span>
                          </span>
                        );
                      } else if (isOptionCorrect) {
                        optClass = 'border-emerald-500/60 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 font-semibold';
                        statusBadge = (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                            <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                            <span>Kunci Jawaban</span>
                          </span>
                        );
                      } else if (isUserChoice && !isCorrect) {
                        optClass = 'border-destructive/60 bg-destructive/10 text-destructive font-semibold';
                        statusBadge = (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-destructive">
                            <XCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                            <span>Pilihan Anda (Salah)</span>
                          </span>
                        );
                      }

                      return (
                        <div
                          key={optIdx}
                          className={`flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs sm:text-sm ${optClass}`}
                        >
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                            <span className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground font-bold">
                              {String.fromCharCode(65 + optIdx)}.
                            </span>
                            <span className="break-words">{opt}</span>
                          </div>
                          {statusBadge && <div className="ml-2 shrink-0">{statusBadge}</div>}
                        </div>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>

                  {/* Kotak Pembahasan & Rujukan Halaman PDF */}
                  <div className="mt-4 rounded-lg border border-border bg-background/80 p-3.5 text-xs space-y-2">
                    <p className="font-semibold text-foreground text-xs">Pembahasan:</p>
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed text-xs">
                      {q.explanation}
                    </p>
                    {q.pageReferences && q.pageReferences.length > 0 && onNavigateToPage && (
                      <div className="pt-1">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => onNavigateToPage(q.pageReferences[0])}
                          className="hover:text-primary transition-colors inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-primary underline underline-offset-2 text-xs font-semibold"
                          title={`Buka halaman ${q.pageReferences.join(', ')} di pembaca PDF`}
                        >
                          <FileText className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                          <span>Buka Referensi Halaman {q.pageReferences.join(', ')}</span>
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </Card>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : activeAttempt ? (
        /* Case 4: Runner Pengerjaan Kuis Aktif (Active Attempt) */
        <div className="space-y-5 max-w-2xl mx-auto">
          {/* Header Progres Soal & Status Draft */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground px-1">
            <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">
              Soal {currentQuestionIndex + 1} dari {activeAttempt.questions.length}
            </span>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              {draftSaveStatus === 'saving' ? (
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-muted-foreground text-[11px]">
                  <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin text-primary" />
                  <span>Menyimpan jawaban...</span>
                </span>
              ) : draftSaveStatus === 'saved' ? (
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 text-[11px] font-medium">
                  <Check className="h-3 w-3" />
                  <span>Tersimpan</span>
                </span>
              ) : draftSaveStatus === 'error' ? (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleRetrySaveDraft}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-destructive text-[11px] font-semibold hover:underline"
                  title="Klik untuk mencoba simpan kembali"
                >
                  <AlertCircle className="h-3 w-3" />
                  <span>Gagal simpan (Coba lagi)</span>
                </button>
              ) : null}

              <span className="text-primary font-bold">
                {answeredCount} / {activeAttempt.questions.length} Terjawab
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Garis Bar Progres */}
          <div className="h-1.5 w-full rounded-full bg-muted overflow-hidden">
            <div
              className="h-full bg-primary transition-all duration-200"
              style={{
                width: `${((currentQuestionIndex + 1) / activeAttempt.questions.length) * 100}%`,
              }}
            />
          </div>

          {draftSaveError && (
            <div
              role="alert"
              className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-lg border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/10 p-3 text-xs text-destructive"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
                <span>{draftSaveError}</span>
              </div>
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                onClick={handleRetrySaveDraft}
                className="h-7 text-xs px-2 shrink-0"
              >
                Coba Lagi
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Kartu Pertanyaan Aktif */}
          {activeAttempt.questions[currentQuestionIndex] && (
            <Card className="p-6 sm:p-7 space-y-5 bg-card border-border shadow-xs">
              <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                <span className="flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary/10 text-xs font-bold text-primary mt-0.5">
                  {currentQuestionIndex + 1}
                </span>
                <p className="text-sm sm:text-base font-semibold text-foreground leading-relaxed">
                  {activeAttempt.questions[currentQuestionIndex].question}
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* Daftar Pilihan Radio Semantik */}
              <div
                role="radiogroup"
                aria-label={`Pilihan jawaban untuk soal ${currentQuestionIndex + 1}`}
                className="space-y-2.5 pt-1"
              >
                {activeAttempt.questions[currentQuestionIndex].options.map((option, optIdx) => {
                  const currentQId = activeAttempt.questions[currentQuestionIndex].id;
                  const isSelected = userAnswers[currentQId] === optIdx;

                  return (
                    <button
                      key={optIdx}
                      type="button"
                      role="radio"
                      aria-checked={isSelected}
                      tabIndex={0}
                      onClick={() => handleSelectOption(currentQId, optIdx)}
                      onKeyDown={(e) => {
                        if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') {
                          e.preventDefault();
                          handleSelectOption(currentQId, optIdx);
                        }
                      }}
                      className={`w-full flex items-center gap-3.5 rounded-xl border p-3.5 sm:p-4 text-left text-xs sm:text-sm transition-all cursor-pointer min-h-[44px] ${
                        isSelected
                          ? 'border-primary bg-primary/10 text-foreground font-semibold ring-1 ring-primary shadow-xs'
                          : 'border-border bg-card text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <span
                        className={`flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border text-xs font-bold transition-colors ${
                          isSelected
                            ? 'border-primary bg-primary text-primary-foreground'
                            : 'border-border text-muted-foreground bg-muted/30'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {String.fromCharCode(65 + optIdx)}
                      </span>
                      <span className="break-words flex-1 leading-relaxed">{option}</span>
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>

              {/* Navigasi Soal Bawah */}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-5 border-t border-border">
                <Button
                  variant="ghost"
                  size="standard"
                  onClick={() => setCurrentQuestionIndex((i) => Math.max(0, i - 1))}
                  disabled={currentQuestionIndex === 0}
                  className="gap-1.5 text-xs min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-[36px]"
                >
                  <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
                  <span>Sebelumnya</span>
                </Button>

                {currentQuestionIndex < activeAttempt.questions.length - 1 ? (
                  <Button
                    size="standard"
                    onClick={() => setCurrentQuestionIndex((i) => i + 1)}
                    className="gap-1.5 text-xs min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-[36px]"
                  >
                    <span>Selanjutnya</span>
                    <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
                  </Button>
                ) : (
                  <Button
                    size="standard"
                    onClick={() => setIsSubmitConfirmOpen(true)}
                    className="gap-1.5 text-xs bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-[36px]"
                  >
                    <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                    <span>Selesai & Kumpulkan</span>
                  </Button>
                )}
              </div>
            </Card>
          )}

          {/* Kisi Lompat Nomor Soal (Grid Indicator) */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2 pt-2">
            {activeAttempt.questions.map((q, idx) => {
              const isAnswered = userAnswers[q.id] !== undefined;
              const isCurrent = idx === currentQuestionIndex;

              return (
                <button
                  key={q.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setCurrentQuestionIndex(idx)}
                  className={`h-8 w-8 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer min-h-[36px] min-w-[36px] flex items-center justify-center ${
                    isCurrent
                      ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-2 ring-offset-background'
                      : isAnswered
                      ? 'bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40 hover:bg-emerald-500/25'
                      : 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted/80'
                  }`}
                  title={`Buka soal ${idx + 1}${isAnswered ? ' (Sudah dijawab)' : ' (Belum dijawab)'}`}
                >
                  {idx + 1}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : selectedQuiz ? (
        /* Case 5: Halaman Pengantar Kuis (Landing Screen) */
        <Card className="p-8 sm:p-12 text-center bg-card max-w-xl mx-auto space-y-4 border-border shadow-xs">
          <div className="mx-auto flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary/10 text-primary">
            <HelpCircle className="h-6 w-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">{selectedQuiz.title}</h3>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {selectedQuiz.questionCount || selectedQuiz.targetCount} Soal Pilihan Ganda • Pembahasan Lengkap
            </p>
          </div>

          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed max-w-md mx-auto">
            Jawab soal pilihan ganda satu per satu. Jawaban sementara tersimpan otomatis di server sehingga Anda dapat melanjutkan kapan saja sebelum mengumpulkan.
          </p>

          <div className="pt-2">
            <Button
              size="standard"
              onClick={() => handleStartAttempt(selectedQuiz.id)}
              disabled={isStartingAttempt || isArchived}
              className="gap-2 px-6 text-xs h-10"
            >
              {isStartingAttempt ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                  <span>Mempersiapkan Soal...</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <span>Mulai Kerjakan Kuis</span>
              )}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </Card>
      ) : null}

      {/* Dialog Konfirmasi Submit Kuis */}
      <Dialog open={isSubmitConfirmOpen} onOpenChange={setIsSubmitConfirmOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-[420px] p-5 sm:p-6">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle className="text-base font-bold text-foreground">
              Kumpulkan Jawaban Kuis?
            </DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription className="text-xs text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mt-1">
              {unansweredCount > 0 ? (
                <span className="text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 font-semibold block">
                  Perhatian: Terdapat {unansweredCount} soal yang belum Anda jawab.
                </span>
              ) : (
                <span>Seluruh pertanyaan telah Anda jawab.</span>
              )}
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>

          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground py-2 leading-relaxed">
            Apakah Anda yakin ingin menyelesaikan kuis ini sekarang? Nilai akhir dan pembahasan rujukan materi akan langsung dievaluasi oleh sistem.
          </p>

          <DialogFooter className="flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row gap-2 sm:justify-end">
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="standard"
              onClick={() => setIsSubmitConfirmOpen(false)}
              disabled={isSubmittingAttempt}
            >
              Periksa Kembali
            </Button>
            <Button
              size="standard"
              onClick={handleConfirmSubmit}
              disabled={isSubmittingAttempt}
              className="gap-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white"
            >
              {isSubmittingAttempt ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                  <span>Menilai...</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <span>Ya, Kumpulkan Jawaban</span>
              )}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* Dialog Konfigurasi Pembuatan Kuis AI */}
      <Dialog open={isGenerateDialogOpen} onOpenChange={setIsGenerateDialogOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-[420px] p-5 sm:p-6">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle className="text-base font-bold text-foreground">
              Buat Kuis dengan AI
            </DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription className="text-xs text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mt-1">
              Pilih jumlah soal pilihan ganda yang ingin dibuat dari materi perkuliahan ini.
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>

          <div className="py-4 space-y-3">
            <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">Jumlah Soal</label>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              {[5, 10].map((count) => (
                <button
                  key={count}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setTargetCount(count as 5 | 10)}
                  className={`rounded-xl border p-3.5 text-center transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    targetCount === count
                      ? 'border-primary bg-primary/10 text-primary font-bold shadow-xs'
                      : 'border-border bg-card text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40'
                  }`}
                >
                  <span className="text-base sm:text-lg">{count}</span>
                  <span className="block text-[11px] font-normal text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                    Soal Pilihan Ganda
                  </span>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed pt-1">
              Pembuatan kuis menggunakan kuota AI harian Anda. Setiap soal memiliki 4 opsi jawaban dan dilengkapi rujukan pembahasan ke dokumen PDF asli.
            </p>
          </div>

          <DialogFooter className="flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row gap-2 sm:justify-end">
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="standard"
              onClick={() => setIsGenerateDialogOpen(false)}
              disabled={isSubmittingGen}
            >
              Batal
            </Button>
            <Button
              size="standard"
              onClick={handleRequestGeneration}
              disabled={isSubmittingGen}
              className="gap-2"
            >
              {isSubmittingGen ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                  <span>Memproses...</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4" />
                  <span>Mulai Pembuatan</span>
                </>
              )}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}

  DialogFooter,

export interface DeleteNoteDialogProps {

  note: NoteListItem | null;
  onSuccess: () => void;
}

export function DeleteNoteDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  note,
  onSuccess,
}: DeleteNoteDialogProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

            disabled={isSubmitting}
          >
            Batal

          <Button
            variant="destructive"
            size="standard"
            onClick={handleDelete}
            disabled={isSubmitting}

                <Loader2 className="mr-1.5 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />

<file path="apps/web/src/components/semesters/create-semester-dialog.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import { Loader2, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { CreateSemesterInput } from '@studyflow/shared';
import { createSemester } from '@/lib/semester-client';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from '@/components/ui/alert';

interface CreateSemesterDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  onSuccess: () => Promise<void> | void;
}

export function CreateSemesterDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  onSuccess,
}: CreateSemesterDialogProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const [name, setName] = React.useState('');
  const [academicYear, setAcademicYear] = React.useState('');
  const [makeActive, setMakeActive] = React.useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = React.useState(false);

  const wasOpenRef = React.useRef(false);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (open && !wasOpenRef.current) {
      setName('');
      setAcademicYear('');
      setMakeActive(false);
      setError(null);
    }
    wasOpenRef.current = open;
  }, [open]);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);

    const trimmedName = name.trim();
    const trimmedYear = academicYear.trim();

    if (!trimmedName || trimmedName.length < 2) {
      setError('Nama semester wajib diisi minimal 2 karakter.');
      return;
    }
    if (!trimmedYear || trimmedYear.length < 4) {
      setError('Tahun ajaran wajib diisi minimal 4 karakter (contoh: 2026/2027).');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const payload: CreateSemesterInput = {
        name: trimmedName,
        academicYear: trimmedYear,
        makeActive,
      };

      await createSemester(payload);
      await onSuccess();
      onOpenChange(false);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || 'Gagal membuat semester baru. Silakan coba lagi.');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-[480px] max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
        <form noValidate onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>Tambah Semester Baru</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              Masukkan periode perkuliahan untuk mengorganisasi mata kuliah dan jadwal belajar Anda.
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>

          {error && (
            <Alert variant="destructive">
              <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
              <AlertDescription>{error}</AlertDescription>
            </Alert>
          )}

          <div className="space-y-3.5">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="create-sem-name">
                Nama Semester <span className="text-danger">*</span>
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="create-sem-name"
                placeholder="Contoh: Semester Ganjil 2026/2027"
                value={name}
                onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                autoFocus
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="create-sem-year">
                Tahun Ajaran <span className="text-danger">*</span>
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="create-sem-year"
                placeholder="Contoh: 2026/2027"
                value={academicYear}
                onChange={(e) => setAcademicYear(e.target.value)}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
              />
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pt-1">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                id="create-sem-active"
                checked={makeActive}
                onChange={(e) => setMakeActive(e.target.checked)}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                className="h-4 w-4 rounded-sm border-input text-primary focus:ring-primary"
              />
              <Label htmlFor="create-sem-active" className="cursor-pointer text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">
                Jadikan semester aktif saat ini
              </Label>
            </div>
          </div>

          <DialogFooter className="pt-2 flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row gap-2 sm:justify-end">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="standard"
              onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            >
              Batal
            </Button>
            <Button type="submit" size="standard" disabled={isSubmitting}>
              {isSubmitting ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="mr-1.5 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                  Menyimpan...
                </>
              ) : (
                'Simpan Semester'
              )}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import { Loader2, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { Semester, UpdateSemesterInput } from '@studyflow/shared';
import { updateSemester } from '@/lib/semester-client';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from '@/components/ui/alert';

interface EditSemesterDialogProps {
  semester: Semester | null;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  onSuccess: () => Promise<void> | void;
}

export function EditSemesterDialog({
  semester,
  onOpenChange,
  onSuccess,
}: EditSemesterDialogProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const [name, setName] = React.useState('');
  const [academicYear, setAcademicYear] = React.useState('');
  const [error, setError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = React.useState(false);

  const lastSemesterIdRef = React.useRef<string | null>(null);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (semester && lastSemesterIdRef.current !== semester.id) {
      setName(semester.name);
      setAcademicYear(semester.academicYear);
      setError(null);
      lastSemesterIdRef.current = semester.id;
    } else if (!semester) {
      lastSemesterIdRef.current = null;
    }
  }, [semester]);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!semester) return;

    setError(null);
    const trimmedName = name.trim();
    const trimmedYear = academicYear.trim();

    if (!trimmedName || trimmedName.length < 2) {
      setError('Nama semester wajib diisi minimal 2 karakter.');
      return;
    }
    if (!trimmedYear || trimmedYear.length < 4) {
      setError('Tahun ajaran wajib diisi minimal 4 karakter (contoh: 2026/2027).');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const payload: UpdateSemesterInput = {
        name: trimmedName,
        academicYear: trimmedYear,
      };

      await updateSemester(semester.id, payload);
      await onSuccess();
      onOpenChange(false);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || 'Gagal memperbarui semester. Silakan coba lagi.');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={Boolean(semester)} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-[480px] max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
        <form noValidate onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>Edit Semester</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              Perbarui nama dan tahun ajaran untuk semester ini.
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>

          {error && (
            <Alert variant="destructive">
              <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
              <AlertDescription>{error}</AlertDescription>
            </Alert>
          )}

          <div className="space-y-3.5">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="edit-sem-name">
                Nama Semester <span className="text-danger">*</span>
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="edit-sem-name"
                value={name}
                onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                autoFocus
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="edit-sem-year">
                Tahun Ajaran <span className="text-danger">*</span>
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="edit-sem-year"
                value={academicYear}
                onChange={(e) => setAcademicYear(e.target.value)}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <DialogFooter className="pt-2 flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row gap-2 sm:justify-end">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="standard"
              onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            >
              Batal
            </Button>
            <Button type="submit" size="standard" disabled={isSubmitting}>

                  <Loader2 className="mr-1.5 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                  Memperbarui...
                </>
              ) : (
                'Simpan Perubahan'
              )}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );

'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import * as DialogPrimitive from '@radix-ui/react-dialog';
import { X } from 'lucide-react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const Dialog = DialogPrimitive.Root;
const DialogTrigger = DialogPrimitive.Trigger;
const DialogPortal = DialogPrimitive.Portal;
const DialogClose = DialogPrimitive.Close;

const DialogOverlay = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof DialogPrimitive.Overlay>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof DialogPrimitive.Overlay>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <DialogPrimitive.Overlay
    ref={ref}
    className={cn(
      'fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs transition-opacity data-[state=open]:animate-in data-[state=closed]:animate-out data-[state=closed]:fade-out-0 data-[state=open]:fade-in-0',
      className
    )}
    {...props}
  />
));
DialogOverlay.displayName = DialogPrimitive.Overlay.displayName;

const DialogContent = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof DialogPrimitive.Content>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof DialogPrimitive.Content>
>(({ className, children, ...props }, ref) => (
  <DialogPortal>
    <DialogOverlay />
    <DialogPrimitive.Content
      ref={ref}
      className={cn(
        'fixed left-[50%] top-[50%] z-50 grid w-full max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] sm:max-w-[520px] max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto [scrollbar-width:none] [-ms-overflow-style:none] [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden translate-x-[-50%] translate-y-[-50%] gap-4 border border-border bg-card p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-lg duration-200 data-[state=open]:animate-in data-[state=closed]:animate-out data-[state=closed]:fade-out-0 data-[state=open]:fade-in-0 data-[state=closed]:zoom-out-95 data-[state=open]:zoom-in-95 data-[state=closed]:slide-out-to-left-1/2 data-[state=closed]:slide-out-to-top-[48%] data-[state=open]:slide-in-from-left-1/2 data-[state=open]:slide-in-from-top-[48%] rounded-xl',
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
      <DialogPrimitive.Close
        className="absolute right-4 top-4 rounded-sm opacity-70 ring-offset-background transition-opacity hover:opacity-100 focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring focus:ring-offset-2 disabled:pointer-events-none text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
        aria-label="Tutup dialog"
      >
        <X className="h-5 w-5" />
      </DialogPrimitive.Close>
    </DialogPrimitive.Content>
  </DialogPortal>
));
DialogContent.displayName = DialogPrimitive.Content.displayName;

const DialogHeader = ({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>) => (
  <div
    className={cn('flex flex-col space-y-1.5 text-center sm:text-left', className)}
    {...props}
  />
);
DialogHeader.displayName = 'DialogHeader';

const DialogFooter = ({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>) => (
  <div
    className={cn(
      'flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row sm:justify-end sm:space-x-2 gap-2 mt-4',
      className
    )}
    {...props}
  />
);
DialogFooter.displayName = 'DialogFooter';

const DialogTitle = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof DialogPrimitive.Title>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof DialogPrimitive.Title>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <DialogPrimitive.Title
    ref={ref}
    className={cn('text-lg font-semibold leading-none tracking-tight text-foreground', className)}
    {...props}
  />
));
DialogTitle.displayName = DialogPrimitive.Title.displayName;

const DialogDescription = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof DialogPrimitive.Description>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof DialogPrimitive.Description>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <DialogPrimitive.Description
    ref={ref}
    className={cn('text-sm text-muted-foreground', className)}
    {...props}
  />
));
DialogDescription.displayName = DialogPrimitive.Description.displayName;

export {
  Dialog,
  DialogPortal,
  DialogOverlay,
  DialogClose,
  DialogTrigger,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
};

  React.ElementRef<typeof SelectPrimitive.Trigger>,

    error?: boolean;
  }

    {children}

    <ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4" />

SelectScrollDownButton.displayName =
  SelectPrimitive.ScrollDownButton.displayName;

const SelectContent = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof SelectPrimitive.Content>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof SelectPrimitive.Content>
>(({ className, children, position = 'popper', ...props }, ref) => (
  <SelectPrimitive.Portal>
    <SelectPrimitive.Content
      ref={ref}
      className={cn(
        'relative z-[70] max-h-96 min-w-[8rem] overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-border bg-popover text-popover-foreground shadow-lg origin-[var(--radix-select-content-transform-origin)] data-[state=open]:animate-in data-[state=closed]:animate-out data-[state=closed]:fade-out-0 data-[state=open]:fade-in-0 data-[state=closed]:zoom-out-95 data-[state=open]:zoom-in-95 duration-150 ease-out',
        position === 'popper' &&
          'data-[side=bottom]:translate-y-1.5 data-[side=left]:-translate-x-1.5 data-[side=right]:translate-x-1.5 data-[side=top]:-translate-y-1.5',
        className
      )}
      position={position}
      {...props}
    >
      <SelectScrollUpButton />
      <SelectPrimitive.Viewport
        className={cn(
          'p-1.5',
          position === 'popper' &&
            'h-[var(--radix-select-trigger-height)] w-full min-w-[var(--radix-select-trigger-width)]'
        )}
      >
        {children}
      </SelectPrimitive.Viewport>
      <SelectScrollDownButton />
    </SelectPrimitive.Content>
  </SelectPrimitive.Portal>
));
SelectContent.displayName = SelectPrimitive.Content.displayName;

const SelectLabel = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof SelectPrimitive.Label>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof SelectPrimitive.Label>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <SelectPrimitive.Label
    ref={ref}
    className={cn('px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground', className)}
    {...props}
  />
));
SelectLabel.displayName = SelectPrimitive.Label.displayName;

const SelectItem = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof SelectPrimitive.Item>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof SelectPrimitive.Item>
>(({ className, children, ...props }, ref) => (
  <SelectPrimitive.Item
    ref={ref}
    className={cn(
      'relative flex w-full cursor-pointer select-none items-center rounded-lg py-2.5 pl-3 pr-8 text-sm outline-hidden transition-colors hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground focus:bg-accent focus:text-accent-foreground data-[disabled]:pointer-events-none data-[disabled]:opacity-50',
      className
    )}
    {...props}
  >
    <span className="absolute right-2.5 flex h-3.5 w-3.5 items-center justify-center">
      <SelectPrimitive.ItemIndicator>
        <Check className="h-4 w-4 text-primary stroke-[2.5]" />
      </SelectPrimitive.ItemIndicator>

    <SelectPrimitive.ItemText>{children}</SelectPrimitive.ItemText>

SelectItem.displayName = SelectPrimitive.Item.displayName;

const SelectSeparator = React.forwardRef<
  React.ElementRef<typeof SelectPrimitive.Separator>,
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof SelectPrimitive.Separator>
>(({ className, ...props }, ref) => (
  <SelectPrimitive.Separator
    ref={ref}
    className={cn('-mx-1 my-1 h-px bg-border', className)}
    {...props}
  />
));
SelectSeparator.displayName = SelectPrimitive.Separator.displayName;

export interface SelectProps extends React.SelectHTMLAttributes<HTMLSelectElement> {
  error?: boolean;
}

const Select = React.forwardRef<HTMLSelectElement, SelectProps>(
  ({ className, error, children, ...props }, ref) => {
    return (
      <div className="relative w-full">
        <select
          ref={ref}
          className={cn(
            'flex h-11 w-full appearance-none rounded-lg border bg-background px-3.5 py-2 pr-10 text-sm text-foreground shadow-xs transition-colors focus-visible:outline-hidden focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50',
