<file path="apps/web/src/components/courses/create-course-dialog.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import { Course, CreateCourseInput, Semester } from '@studyflow/shared';
import { createCourse } from '@/lib/course-client';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import {
  RadixSelect as Select,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from '@/components/ui/alert';
import { AlertCircle, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';

export interface CreateCourseDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  semesters: Semester[];
  activeSemesterId?: string;
  onSuccess: (newCourse: Course) => void;
}

export function CreateCourseDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  semesters,
  activeSemesterId,
  onSuccess,
}: CreateCourseDialogProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const [semesterId, setSemesterId] = React.useState('');
  const [name, setName] = React.useState('');
  const [code, setCode] = React.useState('');
  const [lecturer, setLecturer] = React.useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = React.useState('');
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = React.useState(false);

  const nonArchivedSemesters = React.useMemo(
    () => semesters.filter((s) => !s.archivedAt),
    [semesters]
  );

  const wasOpenRef = React.useRef(false);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (open && !wasOpenRef.current) {
      setErrorMsg(null);
      setName('');
      setCode('');
      setLecturer('');
      setDescription('');
      if (activeSemesterId) {
        setSemesterId(activeSemesterId);
      } else if (nonArchivedSemesters.length > 0) {
        setSemesterId(nonArchivedSemesters[0].id);
      } else {
        setSemesterId('');
      }
    }
    wasOpenRef.current = open;
  }, [open, activeSemesterId, nonArchivedSemesters]);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMsg(null);

    if (!semesterId) {
      setErrorMsg('Silakan pilih semester untuk mata kuliah ini');
      return;
    }
    if (!name.trim()) {
      setErrorMsg('Nama mata kuliah wajib diisi');
      return;
    }
    if (name.trim().length < 2) {
      setErrorMsg('Nama mata kuliah minimal 2 karakter');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const input: CreateCourseInput = {
        semesterId,
        name: name.trim(),
        code: code.trim() || null,
        lecturer: lecturer.trim() || null,
        description: description.trim() || null,
      };
      const created = await createCourse(input);
      onOpenChange(false);
      onSuccess(created);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMsg(err.message || 'Gagal menambahkan mata kuliah baru');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-[480px] max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Tambah Mata Kuliah</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Lengkapi informasi mata kuliah baru yang ingin Anda pelajari.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        {errorMsg && (
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
            <AlertDescription>{errorMsg}</AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        )}

        <form noValidate onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="create-course-sem">Semester *</Label>
            <Select
              value={semesterId || undefined}
              onValueChange={(val) => setSemesterId(val)}
              disabled={isSubmitting || nonArchivedSemesters.length === 0}
            >
              <SelectTrigger id="create-course-sem" className="w-full">
                <SelectValue placeholder="Pilih semester" />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {nonArchivedSemesters.map((s) => (
                  <SelectItem key={s.id} value={s.id}>
                    {s.name} ({s.academicYear}){s.isActive ? ' — Aktif' : ''}
                  </SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
            {nonArchivedSemesters.length === 0 && (
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">
                Belum ada semester aktif. Buat semester terlebih dahulu di menu Semester.
              </p>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="create-course-name">Nama Mata Kuliah *</Label>
            <Input
              id="create-course-name"
              placeholder="Contoh: Algoritma & Pemrograman"
              value={name}
              onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="create-course-code">Kode (Opsional)</Label>
              <Input
                id="create-course-code"
                placeholder="Contoh: IF210"
                value={code}
                onChange={(e) => setCode(e.target.value)}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="create-course-lecturer">Dosen (Opsional)</Label>
              <Input
                id="create-course-lecturer"
                placeholder="Contoh: Dr. Budi"
                value={lecturer}
                onChange={(e) => setLecturer(e.target.value)}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="create-course-desc">Deskripsi (Opsional)</Label>
            <Textarea
              id="create-course-desc"
              placeholder="Catatan mengenai silabus, ruang kelas, atau jadwal..."
              value={description}
              onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              rows={3}
            />
          </div>

          <DialogFooter className="pt-2 flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row gap-2 sm:justify-end">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="standard"
              onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            >
              Batal
            </Button>
            <Button type="submit" size="standard" disabled={isSubmitting}>
              {isSubmitting ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="mr-1.5 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                  Menyimpan...
                </>
              ) : (
                'Simpan Mata Kuliah'
              )}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

<file path="apps/web/src/components/materials/material-upload-dialog.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import {
  Upload,
  FileText,
  AlertCircle,
  Loader2,
  CheckCircle2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Course, FILE_UPLOAD_LIMITS } from '@studyflow/shared';
import { initiateUpload, finalizeUpload } from '@/lib/material-client';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import {
  RadixSelect as Select,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from '@/components/ui/alert';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';

interface MaterialUploadDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  courses: Course[];
  initialCourseId?: string;
  onSuccess: (materialId: string, jobId: string) => void;
}

type UploadStep = 'IDLE' | 'TRANSFERRING' | 'FINALIZING' | 'SUCCESS' | 'ERROR';

export function MaterialUploadDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  courses,
  initialCourseId,
  onSuccess,
}: MaterialUploadDialogProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const [courseId, setCourseId] = React.useState(initialCourseId || '');
  const [title, setTitle] = React.useState('');
  const [file, setFile] = React.useState<File | null>(null);
  const [step, setStep] = React.useState<UploadStep>('IDLE');
  const [transferPercent, setTransferPercent] = React.useState<number | null>(null);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const fileInputRef = React.useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  // Sync initialCourseId if prop changes
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (initialCourseId) {
      setCourseId(initialCourseId);
    } else if (courses.length > 0 && !courseId) {
      setCourseId(courses[0]!.id);
    }
  }, [initialCourseId, courses, courseId]);

  const resetForm = () => {
    setFile(null);
    setTitle('');
    setStep('IDLE');
    setTransferPercent(null);
    setErrorMessage(null);
  };

  const handleFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const selected = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!selected) return;

    if (selected.type !== 'application/pdf' && !selected.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.pdf')) {
      setErrorMessage('Hanya format PDF berbasis teks yang didukung.');
      setFile(null);
      return;
    }

    if (selected.size > FILE_UPLOAD_LIMITS.maxSizeBytes) {
      setErrorMessage(
        `Ukuran file (${(selected.size / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB) melebihi batas maksimal 20 MB.`
      );
      setFile(null);
      return;
    }

    setFile(selected);
    setErrorMessage(null);

    // Auto-fill title from filename without extension if empty
    if (!title.trim()) {
      const nameWithoutExt = selected.name.replace(/\.[^/.]+$/, '');
      setTitle(nameWithoutExt);
    }
  };

  const handleDrop = (e: React.DragEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();

    const droppedFile = e.dataTransfer.files?.[0];
    if (!droppedFile) return;

    if (droppedFile.type !== 'application/pdf' && !droppedFile.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.pdf')) {
      setErrorMessage('Hanya format PDF berbasis teks yang didukung.');
      setFile(null);
      return;
    }

    if (droppedFile.size > FILE_UPLOAD_LIMITS.maxSizeBytes) {
      setErrorMessage(
        `Ukuran file (${(droppedFile.size / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB) melebihi batas maksimal 20 MB.`
      );
      setFile(null);
      return;
    }

    setFile(droppedFile);
    setErrorMessage(null);

    if (!title.trim()) {
      const nameWithoutExt = droppedFile.name.replace(/\.[^/.]+$/, '');
      setTitle(nameWithoutExt);
    }
  };

  const handleDragOver = (e: React.DragEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!courseId) {
      setErrorMessage('Pilih mata kuliah terlebih dahulu.');
      return;
    }
    if (!title.trim()) {
      setErrorMessage('Judul materi wajib diisi.');
      return;
    }
    if (!file) {
      setErrorMessage('Pilih file PDF yang akan diunggah.');
      return;
    }

    setErrorMessage(null);
    setStep('TRANSFERRING');
    setTransferPercent(0);

    try {
      // 1. Inisiasi Upload via BFF -> Express API
      const initRes = await initiateUpload({
        courseId,
        title: title.trim(),
        filename: file.name,
        fileSize: file.size,
        mimeType: 'application/pdf',
      });

      // 2. Unggah file langsung ke Storage (Supabase Storage upload URL atau mock endpoint)
      await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
        const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
        xhr.open('PUT', initRes.uploadUrl, true);
        xhr.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/pdf');

        if (initRes.signedUploadToken) {
          xhr.setRequestHeader('Authorization', `Bearer ${initRes.signedUploadToken}`);
        }

        xhr.upload.onprogress = (event) => {
          if (event.lengthComputable) {
            const percent = Math.round((event.loaded / event.total) * 100);
            setTransferPercent(percent);
          }
        };

        xhr.onload = () => {
          if (xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300) {
            resolve();
          } else {
            reject(new Error(`Gagal mentransfer file ke storage (HTTP ${xhr.status})`));
          }
        };

        xhr.onerror = () => {
          reject(new Error('Koneksi jaringan terputus saat mentransfer file.'));
        };

        xhr.send(file);
      });

      // 3. Finalisasi Upload via API
      setStep('FINALIZING');
      setTransferPercent(null);

      const finalizeRes = await finalizeUpload(initRes.materialId);

      setStep('SUCCESS');
      onSuccess(finalizeRes.material.id, finalizeRes.jobId);

      setTimeout(() => {
        resetForm();
        onOpenChange(false);
      }, 1200);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setStep('ERROR');
      setErrorMessage(
        err.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan saat mengunggah materi. Silakan coba kembali.'
      );
    }
  };

  const isUploading = step === 'TRANSFERRING' || step === 'FINALIZING';
  const selectedCourse = courses.find((c) => c.id === courseId);

  return (
    <Dialog
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={(val) => {
        if (!isUploading) {
          if (!val) resetForm();
          onOpenChange(val);
        }
      }}
    >
      <DialogContent className="max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto [scrollbar-width:none] [-ms-overflow-style:none] [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden sm:max-w-[520px] p-5 sm:p-6">
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">
              Unggah Materi PDF
            </DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription className="text-xs text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mt-1">
              PDF berbasis teks, maksimal 20 MB dan 100 halaman. PDF hasil scan belum didukung.
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>

          {errorMessage && (
            <Alert variant="destructive" className="mt-4">
              <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
              <AlertDescription className="text-xs leading-relaxed">
                {errorMessage}
              </AlertDescription>
            </Alert>
          )}

          <div className="mt-4 space-y-4">
            {/* Pilihan Mata Kuliah */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="upload-course" className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
                Mata Kuliah *
              </Label>
              <Select
                value={courseId}
                onValueChange={(val) => setCourseId(val)}
                disabled={isUploading || Boolean(initialCourseId)}
              >
                <SelectTrigger id="upload-course" className="h-10 text-xs sm:text-sm w-full">
                  <SelectValue placeholder="Pilih mata kuliah..." />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {courses.map((c) => (
                    <SelectItem key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                      {c.name} {c.code ? `(${c.code})` : ''}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>

            {/* Judul Materi */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="upload-title" className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
                Judul Materi *
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="upload-title"
                value={title}
                onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Contoh: Bab 1 - Pengantar Basis Data"
                disabled={isUploading}
                required
                className="h-10 text-xs sm:text-sm"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Dropzone File */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
                Berkas PDF *
              </Label>
              <div
                onDrop={handleDrop}
                onDragOver={handleDragOver}
                className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-xl border-2 border-dashed p-5 text-center transition-colors ${
                  file
                    ? 'border-primary/50 bg-primary/5'
                    : 'border-border hover:border-primary/40 bg-muted/20'
                } ${isUploading ? 'pointer-events-none opacity-60' : ''}`}
              >
                <input
                  ref={fileInputRef}
                  type="file"
                  accept="application/pdf,.pdf"
                  onChange={handleFileChange}
                  className="hidden"
                  disabled={isUploading}
                />

                {file ? (
                  <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2 w-full">
                    <div className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-primary/10 text-primary">
                      <FileText className="h-5 w-5" />
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-center w-full min-w-0 px-2">
                      <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground truncate" title={file.name}>
                        {file.name}
                      </p>
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-x-2 gap-y-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                        <span>{(file.size / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2)} MB</span>
                        {selectedCourse && (
                          <>
                            <span>•</span>
                            <span className="text-foreground/80 font-medium truncate max-w-[200px]">
                              {selectedCourse.name}
                            </span>
                          </>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <Button
                      type="button"
                      variant="outline"
                      size="sm"
                      onClick={() => !isUploading && fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                      className="mt-1 h-8 gap-1.5 text-xs"
                      disabled={isUploading}
                    >
                      <Upload className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      <span>Ganti berkas PDF</span>
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2.5">
                    <div className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-muted text-muted-foreground">
                      <Upload className="h-5 w-5" />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
                        Tarik & lepas berkas PDF ke sini, atau klik untuk memilih
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                        Maksimal 20 MB dan 100 halaman (PDF berbasis teks)
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <Button
                      type="button"
                      variant="outline"
                      size="sm"
                      onClick={() => !isUploading && fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                      className="h-8 gap-1.5 text-xs"
                      disabled={isUploading}
                    >
                      <Upload className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      <span>Pilih Berkas PDF</span>
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Progres Transfer / Finalisasi */}
            {step === 'TRANSFERRING' && (
              <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/40 p-3 space-y-2">
                <div className="flex justify-between text-xs font-medium text-foreground">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin text-primary" />
                    <span>Mengunggah berkas ke penyimpanan...</span>
                  </span>
                  <span>{transferPercent !== null ? `${transferPercent}%` : ''}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="h-2 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-muted">
                  <div
                    className="h-full bg-primary transition-all duration-200"
                    style={{ width: `${Math.max(transferPercent ?? 10, 5)}%` }}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {step === 'FINALIZING' && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-primary/10 p-3 text-xs font-medium text-primary">
                <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin shrink-0" />
                <span>Memverifikasi berkas di penyimpanan dan menyiapkan antrean...</span>
              </div>
            )}

            {step === 'SUCCESS' && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/10 p-3 text-xs font-medium text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
                <span>File berhasil diterima! Menjadwalkan ekstraksi dokumen...</span>
              </div>
            )}

            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
              Setelah upload selesai, kamu boleh meninggalkan halaman. Pemrosesan ekstraksi tetap
              berjalan di antrean sistem.
            </p>
          </div>

          <DialogFooter className="mt-6 flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row gap-2.5 sm:gap-2 sm:justify-end">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="standard"
              onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
              disabled={isUploading}
              className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-[36px]"
            >
              Batal
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="submit"
              size="standard"
              disabled={isUploading || !file || !title.trim() || !courseId}
              className="min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-[36px]"
            >
              {isUploading ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="mr-1.5 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                  Mengunggah...
                </>
              ) : (
                'Unggah Materi'
              )}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

<file path="apps/web/src/components/notes/create-note-dialog.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import { Course, Note } from '@studyflow/shared';
import { createNote } from '@/lib/note-client';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import {
  RadixSelect as Select,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from '@/components/ui/alert';
import { AlertCircle, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';

export interface CreateNoteDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  courses: Course[];
  initialCourseId?: string;
  onSuccess: (note: Note) => void;
}

export function CreateNoteDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  courses,
  initialCourseId,
  onSuccess,
}: CreateNoteDialogProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const [courseId, setCourseId] = React.useState(initialCourseId || '');
  const [title, setTitle] = React.useState('');
  const [content, setContent] = React.useState('');
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = React.useState(false);

  const activeCourses = React.useMemo(
    () => courses.filter((c) => !c.archivedAt),
    [courses]
  );

  const wasOpenRef = React.useRef(false);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (open && !wasOpenRef.current) {
      setErrorMsg(null);
      setTitle('');
      setContent('');
      if (initialCourseId) {
        setCourseId(initialCourseId);
      } else if (activeCourses.length > 0) {
        setCourseId(activeCourses[0]!.id);
      } else {
        setCourseId('');
      }
    }
    wasOpenRef.current = open;
  }, [open, initialCourseId, activeCourses]);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    const trimmedTitle = title.trim();
    if (!trimmedTitle) {
      setErrorMsg('Judul catatan wajib diisi.');
      return;
    }
    if (!courseId) {
      setErrorMsg('Mata kuliah wajib dipilih.');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setErrorMsg(null);
    try {
      const created = await createNote({
        courseId,
        title: trimmedTitle,
        content: content.trim() || '',
      });
      onOpenChange(false);
      onSuccess(created);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMsg(err.message || 'Gagal membuat catatan baru.');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-[500px] max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto [scrollbar-width:none] [-ms-overflow-style:none] [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden">
        <form noValidate onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>Buat Catatan Baru</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              Tulis judul dan pilih mata kuliah. Anda dapat langsung melengkapi isinya di halaman editor.
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>

          {errorMsg && (
            <Alert variant="destructive">
              <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
              <AlertDescription>{errorMsg}</AlertDescription>
            </Alert>
          )}

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="create-note-title">Judul Catatan *</Label>
            <Input
              id="create-note-title"
              value={title}
              onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Contoh: Rangkuman Bab 3 - Thread dan Concurrency"
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              required
              minLength={1}
              maxLength={150}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="create-note-course">Mata Kuliah *</Label>
            <Select
              value={courseId}
              onValueChange={(val) => setCourseId(val)}
              disabled={isSubmitting || activeCourses.length === 0}
            >
              <SelectTrigger id="create-note-course" className="w-full">
                <SelectValue placeholder="Pilih mata kuliah aktif" />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {activeCourses.map((c) => (
                  <SelectItem key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                    {c.name} {c.code ? `(${c.code})` : ''}
                  </SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="create-note-content">Isi Awal (Opsional - Format Markdown)</Label>
            <Textarea
              id="create-note-content"
              value={content}
              onChange={(e) => setContent(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="# Bab 3..."
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              rows={4}
              maxLength={50000}
            />
          </div>

          <DialogFooter className="pt-2 flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row gap-2 sm:justify-end">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="standard"
              onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            >
              Batal
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="submit"
              size="standard"
              disabled={isSubmitting || activeCourses.length === 0}
            >
              {isSubmitting ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="mr-1.5 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                  Membuat...
                </>
              ) : (
                'Buat & Buka Editor'
              )}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import { Eye, EyeOff, Loader2, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { RegisterFormInput, RegisterInput, RegisterInputSchema } from '@studyflow/shared';
import { apiRegister } from '@/lib/auth-client';
import { GoogleSignInButton } from '@/components/auth/google-sign-in-button';
import { TurnstileWidget, TurnstileWidgetHandle } from '@/components/auth/turnstile-widget';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import {
  Card,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
  CardDescription,
  CardContent,
  CardFooter,
} from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Alert, AlertTitle, AlertDescription } from '@/components/ui/alert';
import { Separator } from '@/components/ui/separator';

const COMMON_TIMEZONES = [
  { value: 'Asia/Jakarta', label: 'WIB — Asia/Jakarta (UTC+7, Indonesia Barat)' },
  { value: 'Asia/Makassar', label: 'WITA — Asia/Makassar (UTC+8, Indonesia Tengah)' },
  { value: 'Asia/Jayapura', label: 'WIT — Asia/Jayapura (UTC+9, Indonesia Timur)' },
  { value: 'UTC', label: 'UTC — Universal Time Coordinated' },
];

function RegisterForm(): React.JSX.Element {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const returnUrl = searchParams.get('returnUrl');
  const urlError = searchParams.get('error');

  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = React.useState(false);
  const [serverError, setServerError] = React.useState<string | null>(urlError);
  const [turnstileToken, setTurnstileToken] = React.useState<string>('');
  const turnstileRef = React.useRef<TurnstileWidgetHandle>(null);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (urlError) {
      setServerError(urlError);
    }
  }, [urlError]);

  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    setValue,
    formState: { errors, isSubmitting },
  } = useForm<RegisterFormInput, unknown, RegisterInput>({
    resolver: zodResolver(RegisterInputSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      name: '',
      email: '',
      password: '',
      timezone: 'Asia/Jakarta',
      turnstileToken: '',
    },
  });

  const handleTurnstileVerify = (token: string) => {
    setTurnstileToken(token);
    setValue('turnstileToken', token, { shouldValidate: true });
    setServerError(null);
  };

  const handleTurnstileExpire = () => {
    setTurnstileToken('');
    setValue('turnstileToken', '', { shouldValidate: true });
  };

  const onSubmit = async (data: RegisterInput) => {
    setServerError(null);
    try {
      await apiRegister(data);
      const target = returnUrl
        ? `/login?registered=true&returnUrl=${encodeURIComponent(returnUrl)}`
        : '/login?registered=true';
      router.push(target);
    } catch (err) {
      setServerError(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Terjadi kesalahan saat mendaftar. Silakan coba lagi.'
      );
      // Reset Turnstile token on failure to ensure fresh verification
      setTurnstileToken('');
      setValue('turnstileToken', '');
      turnstileRef.current?.reset();
    }
  };

  return (
    <Card className="w-full border-border bg-card shadow-xs">
      <CardHeader className="space-y-1.5 pb-4">
        <CardTitle className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">
          Daftar Akun StudyFlow
        </CardTitle>
        <CardDescription className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
          Mulai atur kegiatan perkuliahan dan pelajari materi kuliah Anda dalam satu tempat.
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>

      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} noValidate>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4 pt-0">
          {/* Server Error Alert */}
          {serverError && (
            <Alert variant="destructive" role="alert" aria-live="polite">
              <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
              <AlertTitle className="text-sm font-semibold">Pendaftaran Gagal</AlertTitle>
              <AlertDescription className="text-xs break-words">{serverError}</AlertDescription>
            </Alert>
          )}

          {/* Google Sign-In Button */}
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <GoogleSignInButton returnUrl={returnUrl} disabled={isSubmitting} />
            <div className="relative flex items-center justify-center">
              <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center">
                <Separator />
              </div>
              <span className="relative bg-card px-2 text-[11px] font-medium text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                atau dengan email
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Name Field */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="name" className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
              Nama Lengkap
            </Label>
            <Input
              id="name"
              type="text"
              autoComplete="name"
              placeholder="Nama lengkap Anda"
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.name)}
              aria-describedby={errors.name ? 'name-error' : undefined}
              className="h-10 text-sm"
              {...register('name')}
            />
            {errors.name && (
              <p id="name-error" className="text-xs font-medium text-destructive">
                {errors.name.message}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Email Field */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="email" className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
              Alamat Email
            </Label>
            <Input
              id="email"
              type="email"
              autoComplete="email"
              placeholder="nama@kampus.ac.id"
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.email)}
              aria-describedby={errors.email ? 'email-error' : undefined}
              className="h-10 text-sm"
              {...register('email')}
            />
            {errors.email && (
              <p id="email-error" className="text-xs font-medium text-destructive">
                {errors.email.message}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Password Field with Toggle */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="password" className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
              Password
            </Label>
            <div className="relative">
              <Input
                id="password"
                type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                autoComplete="new-password"
                placeholder="Minimal 12 karakter"
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                className="h-10 pr-11 text-sm"
                aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.password)}
                aria-describedby={errors.password ? 'password-hint password-error' : 'password-hint'}
                {...register('password')}
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowPassword((prev) => !prev)}
                className="absolute right-1 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 z-10 flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:text-foreground after:absolute after:-inset-2 sm:after:hidden touch-manipulation focus-visible:outline-hidden focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
                aria-label={showPassword ? 'Sembunyikan password' : 'Tampilkan password'}
                title={showPassword ? 'Sembunyikan password' : 'Tampilkan password'}
              >
                {showPassword ? (
                  <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                ) : (
                  <Eye className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
            <p id="password-hint" className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              Minimal 12 karakter. Disarankan menggunakan kombinasi kata sandi yang mudah diingat.
            </p>
            {errors.password && (
              <p id="password-error" className="text-xs font-medium text-destructive">
                {errors.password.message}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Timezone Selector */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="timezone" className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
              Zona Waktu Akademik
            </Label>
            <select
              id="timezone"
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              className="flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-card px-3 py-2 text-sm text-foreground transition-colors focus-visible:outline-hidden focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
              {...register('timezone')}
            >
              {COMMON_TIMEZONES.map((tz) => (
                <option key={tz.value} value={tz.value}>
                  {tz.label}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              Digunakan untuk menyesuaikan kalender jadwal kuliah dan tenggat tugas Anda.
            </p>
            {errors.timezone && (
              <p className="text-xs font-medium text-destructive">
                {errors.timezone.message}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Cloudflare Turnstile Verification Widget */}
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <TurnstileWidget
              ref={turnstileRef}
              action="register"
              onVerify={handleTurnstileVerify}
              onExpire={handleTurnstileExpire}
              onError={(err) => setServerError(err || 'Verifikasi keamanan gagal. Silakan coba lagi.')}
            />
            {errors.turnstileToken && (
              <p className="text-center text-xs font-medium text-destructive">
                {errors.turnstileToken.message}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        </CardContent>

        <CardFooter className="flex flex-col space-y-4 pt-2">
          <Button
            type="submit"
            className="w-full h-10 font-semibold gap-2"
            disabled={isSubmitting || !turnstileToken}
          >
            {isSubmitting ? (
              <>
                <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
                <span>Memproses...</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              'Buat Akun'
            )}
          </Button>

          <Separator className="my-1" />

          <p className="text-center text-xs sm:text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Sudah punya akun?{' '}
            <Link
              href={returnUrl ? `/login?returnUrl=${encodeURIComponent(returnUrl)}` : '/login'}
              className="font-medium text-primary underline underline-offset-4 hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity"
            >
              Masuk di sini
            </Link>
          </p>
        </CardFooter>
      </form>
    </Card>
  );
}

export default function RegisterPage(): React.JSX.Element {
  return (
    <React.Suspense
      fallback={
        <Card className="w-full">
          <CardHeader className="space-y-1">
            <CardTitle className="text-2xl">Daftar Akun StudyFlow</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>Memuat formulir pendaftaran...</CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="h-48 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      }
    >
      <RegisterForm />
    </React.Suspense>
  );
}
