<file path="apps/web/src/components/assignments/create-task-dialog.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import { Course } from '@studyflow/shared';
import { createAssignment } from '@/lib/assignment-client';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import {
  RadixSelect as Select,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { DateTimePicker } from '@/components/ui/date-picker';
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from '@/components/ui/alert';
import { AlertCircle, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';

export interface CreateTaskDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  courses: Course[];
  initialCourseId?: string;
  timezone?: string;
  idPrefix?: 'create' | 'task';
  onSuccess: () => void;
}

export function CreateTaskDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  courses,
  initialCourseId,
  timezone = 'Asia/Jakarta',
  idPrefix = 'create',
  onSuccess,
}: CreateTaskDialogProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const [courseId, setCourseId] = React.useState(initialCourseId || '');
  const [title, setTitle] = React.useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = React.useState('');
  const [dueDate, setDueDate] = React.useState('');
  const [priority, setPriority] = React.useState<'LOW' | 'MEDIUM' | 'HIGH'>('MEDIUM');
  const [status, setStatus] = React.useState<'TODO' | 'IN_PROGRESS' | 'DONE'>('TODO');
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = React.useState(false);

  const titleId = idPrefix === 'task' ? 'task-title' : 'create-title';
  const courseInputId = idPrefix === 'task' ? 'task-course' : 'create-course';
  const dueId = idPrefix === 'task' ? 'task-duedate' : 'create-due';
  const priorityId = idPrefix === 'task' ? 'task-priority' : 'create-priority';
  const statusId = idPrefix === 'task' ? 'task-status' : 'create-status';
  const descId = idPrefix === 'task' ? 'task-desc' : 'create-desc';

  const activeCourses = React.useMemo(
    () => courses.filter((c) => !c.archivedAt),
    [courses]
  );

  const wasOpenRef = React.useRef(false);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (open && !wasOpenRef.current) {
      setErrorMsg(null);
      setTitle('');
      setDescription('');
      setDueDate('');
      setPriority('MEDIUM');
      setStatus('TODO');

      if (initialCourseId) {
        setCourseId(initialCourseId);
      } else if (activeCourses.length > 0) {
        setCourseId(activeCourses[0]!.id);
      } else {
        setCourseId('');
      }
    }
    wasOpenRef.current = open;
  }, [open, initialCourseId, activeCourses]);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    const trimmedTitle = title.trim();
    if (!trimmedTitle || trimmedTitle.length < 2) {
      setErrorMsg('Judul tugas minimal 2 karakter.');
      return;
    }
    if (!courseId) {
      setErrorMsg('Mata kuliah wajib dipilih.');
      return;
    }
    if (!dueDate) {
      setErrorMsg('Tenggat waktu wajib diisi.');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setErrorMsg(null);
    try {
      await createAssignment({
        courseId,
        title: trimmedTitle,
        description: description.trim() || undefined,
        dueDate,
        priority,
        status,
      });

      onOpenChange(false);
      onSuccess();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMsg(err.message || 'Gagal menambahkan tugas baru.');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-[500px] max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto [scrollbar-width:none] [-ms-overflow-style:none] [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden">
        <form noValidate onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-3.5">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>Tambah Tugas Baru</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              Catat tugas akademik atau praktikum beserta tenggat waktu dan tingkat prioritasnya.
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>

          {errorMsg && (
            <Alert variant="destructive">
              <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
              <AlertDescription>{errorMsg}</AlertDescription>
            </Alert>
          )}

          {/* Judul Tugas */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor={titleId}>Judul Tugas *</Label>
            <Input
              id={titleId}
              placeholder="Contoh: Makalah Sistem Terdistribusi"
              value={title}
              onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              required
              minLength={2}
              maxLength={200}
            />
          </div>

          {/* Pilihan Mata Kuliah */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor={courseInputId}>Mata Kuliah *</Label>
            <Select
              value={courseId}
              onValueChange={(val) => setCourseId(val)}
              disabled={isSubmitting || activeCourses.length === 0}
            >
              <SelectTrigger id={courseInputId} className="w-full">
                <SelectValue placeholder="Pilih mata kuliah aktif" />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {activeCourses.map((c) => (
                  <SelectItem key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                    {c.name} {c.code ? `(${c.code})` : ''}
                  </SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>

          {/* Tenggat Waktu */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor={dueId}>Tenggat Waktu *</Label>
            <DateTimePicker
              id={dueId}
              value={dueDate}
              onChange={setDueDate}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              required
              timezone={timezone}
            />
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              Zona waktu profil: <strong className="text-foreground">{timezone}</strong>. Jika jam tidak ditentukan, deadline otomatis diatur ke 23.59.
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Prioritas & Status */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor={priorityId}>Prioritas</Label>
              <Select
                value={priority}
                onValueChange={(val) => setPriority(val as any)}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
              >
                <SelectTrigger id={priorityId} className="w-full">
                  <SelectValue placeholder="Pilih prioritas" />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="LOW">Rendah</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="MEDIUM">Sedang</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="HIGH">Tinggi</SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor={statusId}>Status</Label>
              <Select
                value={status}
                onValueChange={(val) => setStatus(val as any)}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
              >
                <SelectTrigger id={statusId} className="w-full">
                  <SelectValue placeholder="Pilih status" />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="TODO">Belum Dikerjakan</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="IN_PROGRESS">Sedang Dikerjakan</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="DONE">Selesai</SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Deskripsi */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor={descId}>Deskripsi / Catatan (Opsional)</Label>
            <Textarea
              id={descId}
              placeholder="Instruksi pengerjaan, format berkas, atau catatan penting..."
              value={description}
              onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              rows={2}
              className="min-h-[64px]"
              maxLength={2000}
            />
          </div>

          <DialogFooter className="pt-2 flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row gap-2 sm:justify-end">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="standard"
              onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            >
              Batal
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="submit"
              size="standard"
              disabled={isSubmitting || activeCourses.length === 0}
            >
              {isSubmitting ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="mr-1.5 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                  Menyimpan...
                </>
              ) : (
                'Simpan Tugas'
              )}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

<file path="apps/web/src/components/assignments/edit-task-dialog.tsx">
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import { Assignment, toUserDateTimeInputValue } from '@studyflow/shared';
import { updateAssignment } from '@/lib/assignment-client';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import {
  RadixSelect as Select,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { DateTimePicker } from '@/components/ui/date-picker';
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from '@/components/ui/alert';
import { AlertCircle, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { AssignmentSubtaskChecklist } from './assignment-subtask-checklist';

export interface EditTaskDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  assignment: Assignment | null;
  timezone?: string;
  onSuccess: () => void;
}

export function EditTaskDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  assignment,
  timezone = 'Asia/Jakarta',
  onSuccess,
}: EditTaskDialogProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const [title, setTitle] = React.useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = React.useState('');
  const [dueDate, setDueDate] = React.useState('');
  const [priority, setPriority] = React.useState<'LOW' | 'MEDIUM' | 'HIGH'>('MEDIUM');
  const [status, setStatus] = React.useState<'TODO' | 'IN_PROGRESS' | 'DONE'>('TODO');
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = React.useState(false);

  // Subtask count tracked from checklist
  const [subtaskCount, setSubtaskCount] = React.useState<{ total: number; completed: number } | null>(null);
  const [showUnfinishedConfirm, setShowUnfinishedConfirm] = React.useState(false);

  const activeAssignmentIdRef = React.useRef<string | null>(null);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (open && assignment) {
      if (activeAssignmentIdRef.current !== assignment.id) {
        setErrorMsg(null);
        setTitle(assignment.title);
        setDescription(assignment.description || '');
        setDueDate(toUserDateTimeInputValue(assignment.dueDate, timezone));
        setPriority(assignment.priority);
        setStatus(assignment.status);
        setSubtaskCount(assignment.subtaskCount || null);
        activeAssignmentIdRef.current = assignment.id;
      }
    } else {
      activeAssignmentIdRef.current = null;
      setShowUnfinishedConfirm(false);
    }
  }, [open, assignment, timezone]);

  const executeSubmit = async () => {
    if (!assignment) return;

    const trimmedTitle = title.trim();
    if (!trimmedTitle || trimmedTitle.length < 2) {
      setErrorMsg('Judul tugas minimal 2 karakter.');
      return;
    }
    if (!dueDate) {
      setErrorMsg('Tenggat waktu wajib diisi.');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setErrorMsg(null);
    try {
      await updateAssignment(assignment.id, {
        title: trimmedTitle,
        description: description.trim() || undefined,
        dueDate,
        priority,
        status,
      });

      onOpenChange(false);
      onSuccess();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMsg(err.message || 'Gagal memperbarui tugas.');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!assignment) return;

    // Check if user is marking task as DONE with unfinished subtasks
    if (
      status === 'DONE' &&
      assignment.status !== 'DONE' &&
      subtaskCount &&
      subtaskCount.total > 0 &&
      subtaskCount.completed < subtaskCount.total
    ) {
      setShowUnfinishedConfirm(true);
      return;
    }

    await executeSubmit();
  };

  const isArchived = Boolean(
    assignment?.course?.archivedAt || assignment?.course?.semester?.archivedAt
  );

  return (
    <>
      <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
        <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-[520px] max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto [scrollbar-width:none] [-ms-overflow-style:none] [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden">
          <form noValidate onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-3.5">
            <DialogHeader>
              <DialogTitle>Edit Tugas</DialogTitle>
              <DialogDescription>
                Perbarui judul, tenggat waktu, prioritas, status, atau kelola checklist subtugas.
              </DialogDescription>
            </DialogHeader>

            {errorMsg && (
              <Alert variant="destructive">
                <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
                <AlertDescription>{errorMsg}</AlertDescription>
              </Alert>
            )}

            {/* Mata Kuliah (Informational / Readonly) */}
            {assignment?.course && (
              <div className="rounded-lg bg-muted/40 p-2.5 border border-border/50 text-xs">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">Mata Kuliah:</span>{' '}
                <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">
                  {assignment.course.name}
                  {assignment.course.code ? ` (${assignment.course.code})` : ''}
                </span>
                {isArchived && (
                  <span className="ml-2 text-destructive font-medium">
                    (Mata Kuliah / Semester Diarsipkan — Hanya Baca)
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Judul Tugas */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="edit-title">
                Judul Tugas <span className="text-destructive">*</span>
              </Label>
              <Input
                id="edit-title"
                value={title}
                onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Misal: Tugas Proyek Akhir"
                disabled={isSubmitting || isArchived}
                required
                maxLength={200}
              />
            </div>

            {/* Tenggat Waktu (Due Date) */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="edit-due-date">
                Batas Waktu (Tenggat) <span className="text-destructive">*</span>
              </Label>
              <DateTimePicker
                id="edit-due-date"
                value={dueDate}
                onChange={(val) => setDueDate(val)}
                disabled={isSubmitting || isArchived}
                placeholder="Pilih tanggal & jam tenggat waktu"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Grid Prioritas & Status */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <Label htmlFor="edit-priority">Prioritas</Label>
                <Select
                  value={priority}
                  onValueChange={(val) => setPriority(val as any)}
                  disabled={isSubmitting || isArchived}
                >
                  <SelectTrigger id="edit-priority" className="w-full">
                    <SelectValue placeholder="Pilih prioritas" />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    <SelectItem value="LOW">Rendah</SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem value="MEDIUM">Sedang</SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem value="HIGH">Tinggi</SelectItem>
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <Label htmlFor="edit-status">Status</Label>
                <Select
                  value={status}
                  onValueChange={(val) => setStatus(val as any)}
                  disabled={isSubmitting || isArchived}
                >
                  <SelectTrigger id="edit-status" className="w-full">
                    <SelectValue placeholder="Pilih status" />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    <SelectItem value="TODO">Belum Dikerjakan</SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem value="IN_PROGRESS">Sedang Dikerjakan</SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem value="DONE">Selesai</SelectItem>
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Deskripsi */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="edit-desc">Deskripsi / Catatan (Opsional)</Label>
              <Textarea
                id="edit-desc"
                value={description}
                onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
                disabled={isSubmitting || isArchived}
                rows={2}
                className="min-h-[64px]"
                maxLength={2000}
              />
            </div>

            {/* Checklist Subtugas */}
            {assignment && (
              <div className="border-t border-border pt-3">
                <AssignmentSubtaskChecklist
                  assignmentId={assignment.id}
                  isParentDone={status === 'DONE'}
                  isArchived={isArchived}
                  onCountChange={(count) => {
                    setSubtaskCount(count);
                  }}
                />
              </div>
            )}

            <DialogFooter className="pt-2 flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row gap-2 sm:justify-end">
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                size="standard"
                onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
              >
                Batal
              </Button>
              <Button type="submit" size="standard" disabled={isSubmitting || isArchived}>
                {isSubmitting ? (
                  <>
                    <Loader2 className="mr-1.5 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                    Memperbarui...
                  </>
                ) : (
                  'Simpan Perubahan'
                )}
              </Button>
            </DialogFooter>
          </form>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* Confirmation Dialog when completing task with unfinished subtasks */}
      <Dialog open={showUnfinishedConfirm} onOpenChange={setShowUnfinishedConfirm}>
        <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-[420px]">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>Selesaikan Tugas?</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription className="text-xs text-muted-foreground pt-1">
              Tugas ini memiliki{' '}
              <strong className="text-foreground">
                {(subtaskCount?.total ?? 0) - (subtaskCount?.completed ?? 0)} subtugas
              </strong>{' '}
              yang belum selesai. Apakah Anda yakin ingin tetap menandai tugas ini sebagai selesai?
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <DialogFooter className="flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row gap-2 pt-2 sm:justify-end">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="standard"
              onClick={() => setShowUnfinishedConfirm(false)}
            >
              Batal
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="button"
              size="standard"
              onClick={() => {
                setShowUnfinishedConfirm(false);
                executeSubmit();
              }}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
            >
              Tetap Selesaikan
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </>
  );
}
</file>

# Laporan Evaluasi AI & Benchmark Kualitas Dokumen — StudyFlow

| Metadata Evaluasi | Nilai |
| --- | --- |
| **Waktu Eksekusi** | 2026-10-13T14:37:55.552Z |
| **Node.js Runtime** | v22.17.0 |
| **Versi Kode (Git)** | `a8127ec` |
| **Mode Evaluasi** | `MOCK` |
| **Provider AI** | `MockAiProviderAdapter (Deterministik)` |
| **Model AI** | `reference-mock-v1` |
| **Versi Prompt** | `v1 (Summary, Flashcard, Quiz)` |
| **Panggilan Provider Dibuat** | 9 (Batas budget: 1000) |
| **Sampel Dokumen Valid Diproses** | 3 dari 20 berkas |
| **Fixture Negatif Diproses** | 0 dari 5 berkas |
| **Status Keseluruhan** | **PASS (MOCK STRUCTURAL & INTEGRATION ONLY)** |

---

## 1. Pemisahan Tiga Lapisan Evaluasi

Sesuai instruksi PRD Bagian 15.2, evaluasi sistem dibagi menjadi 3 lapisan independen:

1. **Lapisan 1: Validasi Dokumen & Ekstraksi**
   Memverifikasi magic bytes (`%PDF-`), integritas struktur berkas, ekstraksi teks riil per halaman menggunakan `pdfjs-dist`, serta penolakan deterministik berkas negatif (scan tanpa teks, berkas rusak, berkas terenkripsi kata sandi, dan berkas melebihi 100 halaman).
2. **Lapisan 2: Integrasi & Validitas Struktur Output AI**
   Memverifikasi keluaran model terhadap skema kontrak Zod publik aplikasi (`SummaryStructuredOutputSchema`, `FlashcardSetStructuredOutputSchema`, `QuizStructuredOutputSchema`), validitas batas provenance (`1 <= pageReference <= totalPages`), ketiadaan duplikasi opsi kuis, serta keabsahan indeks jawaban (`0..3`).
   > *Peringatan Integritas*: Kelulusan lapisan struktur format kuis **TIDAK SAMA** dengan akurasi kebenaran faktual materi.
3. **Lapisan 3: Kualitas Faktual & Penilaian Manual**
   Verifikasi kesesuaian klaim ringkasan, relevansi kartu latihan, dan kebenaran kunci jawaban kuis terhadap teks sumber nyata.
   > *Status Mode Mock*: Seluruh kriteria Layer 3 berstatus **`NOT_EVALUATED`** pada mode mock. Keberhasilan mock tidak pernah dijadikan klaim akurasi faktual provider nyata.

---

## 2. Hasil Evaluasi Fixture Negatif (Lapisan 1)

| ID Fixture | Kategori | Perilaku yang Diharapkan | Status | Keterangan Hasil |
| --- | --- | --- | :---: | --- |


> **Catatan Audit Fixture Terenkripsi**: Fixture simulasi berbasis teks biasa (seperti `neg-02-encrypted-sim.pdf`) tidak memiliki dictionary `/Encrypt` PDF dan tidak membuktikan penolakan enkripsi oleh parser. Penolakan hanya terbukti sah pada berkas dengan struktur keamanan terenkripsi aktif (`negative-encrypted.pdf`) yang ditolak dengan kode `FILE_ENCRYPTED`.

<file path="apps/web/e2e/main-flow.spec.ts">
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';
import path from 'node:path';

/**
 * StudyFlow E2E Suite — Milestone 8 MVP Release Readiness
 * 
 * Flow 1: Lifecycle Manajemen Akademik & Sesi
 *   Register → Create Semester → Create Course → Create Assignment → Create Note with Markdown →
 *   Archive Semester Verification → Session Reload (Persistence) → Logout → Auth Revocation.
 * 
 * Flow 2: Pipeline AI & Latihan Materi
 *   Upload PDF → Extraction (Polling/READY) → Summary AI → Flashcards Deck & Mastery Update →
 *   Quiz Attempt → Save Draft Answer → Page Reload (Answer Persistence & No Key Leak) →
 *   Server-side Evaluation & Score → Page Reference Jump to PDF Viewer.
 * 
 * Flow 3: Multi-tenant & Cross-User Security Isolation
 *   User A vs User B data isolation (Semesters, Courses, Materials, Notes, Attempts) via UI & API.
 * 
 * Flow 4: Responsiveness & Aksesibilitas
 *   Mobile (375x667), Tablet (768x1024), Desktop (1440x900) layout, mobile drawer navigation,
 *   keyboard focus, theme toggle, and empty states.
 */

test.describe('StudyFlow End-to-End Suite', () => {
  const timestamp = Date.now();
  const testPassword = 'TestPassword123!';

  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    page.on('pageerror', (err) => console.error('[BROWSER EXCEPTION]:', err));
  });

  // Helper for registration and login
  async function registerAndLogin(page: any, name: string, email: string) {
    await page.goto('/register');

    await page.fill('#email', email);
    await page.fill('#password', testPassword);
    await page.click('button:has-text("Masuk")');
    await page.waitForURL('**/dashboard', { timeout: 20000 });
  }

  test('Flow 4: Responsiveness & Aksesibilitas (Mobile 375px, Tablet 768px, Keyboard & Theme)', async ({ page }) => {
    const userEmail = `responsive-${timestamp}@studyflow.test`;
    await registerAndLogin(page, 'User Responsive UI', userEmail);

    // 1. Uji Tampilan Mobile Viewport (375x667 — iPhone SE)
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 375, height: 667 });
    await page.goto('/dashboard');

    // Di mobile, tombol alihkan sidebar (hamburger) harus ada dan dapat membuka drawer
    const mobileMenuButton = page.locator('button[aria-label="Alihkan navigasi sidebar"]').first();
    await expect(mobileMenuButton).toBeVisible();
    await mobileMenuButton.click();

    // Verifikasi menu sidebar muncul di dalam mobile sheet/drawer
    const semesterLink = page.locator('div[role="dialog"] a[href="/semesters"]').first();
    await expect(semesterLink).toBeVisible();
    await semesterLink.click();
    await page.waitForURL('**/semesters');

    // Pastikan tidak ada horizontal scrollbar overflow pada halaman mobile
    const scrollWidth = await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth);
    const clientWidth = await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.clientWidth);
    expect(scrollWidth).toBeLessThanOrEqual(clientWidth + 2); // margin toleransi subpixel rendering

    // 2. Uji Tampilan Tablet Viewport (768x1024 — iPad)
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 768, height: 1024 });
    await page.goto('/courses');
    await expect(page.locator('h1:has-text("Mata Kuliah")')).toBeVisible();

    // 3. Uji Tampilan Desktop (1440x900)
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 900 });
    await page.goto('/dashboard');
    await expect(page.locator('nav[aria-label="breadcrumb"]')).toBeVisible();

    // Verifikasi pengelompokan navigasi di sidebar desktop (Belajar, Perkuliahan, Pengaturan)
    await expect(page.getByText('Belajar', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByText('Perkuliahan', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.locator('[data-sidebar="group-label"]:has-text("Pengaturan")')).toBeVisible();

    // Uji Collapsed Sidebar via Trigger
    const desktopToggle = page.locator('button[aria-label="Alihkan navigasi sidebar"]');
    await desktopToggle.click();
    await expect(page.locator('[data-sidebar="sidebar"]').first()).toHaveAttribute('data-state', 'collapsed');

    // Kembalikan ke Expanded
    await desktopToggle.click();
    await expect(page.locator('[data-sidebar="sidebar"]').first()).toHaveAttribute('data-state', 'expanded');

    // 4. Uji Penggantian Tema (Dark / Light Theme Toggle)
    const darkBtn = page.locator('button[title="Gunakan tema gelap"]').first();
    await expect(darkBtn).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
    await darkBtn.click();
    await expect(page.locator('html')).toHaveClass(/dark/);

    // 5. Uji Navigasi Keyboard (Tab navigation)
    await page.keyboard.press('Tab');
    const activeElement = await page.evaluate(() => document.activeElement?.tagName);
    expect(activeElement).toBeTruthy();

    // 6. Uji Header Account Dropdown Menu
    const accountMenuBtn = page.locator('button[aria-label^="Menu akun untuk"]');
    await expect(accountMenuBtn).toBeVisible();
    await accountMenuBtn.click();
    await expect(page.locator('div[role="menu"]').getByText('Pengaturan Akun')).toBeVisible();
  });

    await page.fill('#task-title', 'Laporan Praktikum Socket TCP');
    await page.click('#task-duedate');
    await page.locator('[data-slot="calendar"] button:not([disabled])').getByText('15', { exact: true }).first().click();
    await page.click('#task-priority');

    await expect(page.getByText('Laporan Praktikum Socket TCP')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
    await expect(page.getByText('Tinggi')).toBeVisible();

    // 7. Uji Checkbox Penyelesaian Tugas (Keyboard Accessible & Status Persistence)
    const taskCheckbox = page.locator('button[role="checkbox"][aria-label*="Laporan Praktikum Socket TCP"]');
    await expect(taskCheckbox).toBeVisible();
    await expect(taskCheckbox).toHaveAttribute('data-state', 'unchecked');

    // Klik checkbox untuk menyelesaikan tugas
    await taskCheckbox.click();

    // Setelah tugas diselesaikan, status diperbarui: tugas berpindah dari daftar belum selesai dan count Tugas Selesai bertambah
    await expect(page.locator('button[role="checkbox"][aria-label*="Laporan Praktikum Socket TCP"]')).not.toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
    await expect(page.locator('text=1').first()).toBeVisible(); // 1 selesai

    // 8. Verifikasi Sinkronisasi Selector Semester di Sidebar dengan Dashboard
    // Semester Gasal 2026/2027 yang aktif harus muncul baik di sidebar maupun header dashboard
    await expect(page.locator('button[aria-label="Pilih semester aktif"]').getByText('Semester Gasal 2026/2027')).toBeVisible();

    // 9. Verifikasi Filter Dropdown Radix di Halaman Materi (Buka/Tutup & Opsi)
    await page.goto('/materials');
    await expect(page.locator('h1').getByText('Materi')).toBeVisible();
    const courseSelectTrigger = page.locator('button[role="combobox"]').first();
    await expect(courseSelectTrigger).toBeVisible();
    await courseSelectTrigger.click();
    await expect(page.locator('[role="listbox"]').getByText('Semua Mata Kuliah')).toBeVisible();
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
    await expect(page.locator('[role="listbox"]')).not.toBeVisible();

    // 10. Verifikasi Pemisahan Error Fetch (bukan ditampilkan sebagai semester kosong)
    // Simulasikan kegagalan network pada endpoint dashboard
    await page.route('**/api/dashboard**', (route) => route.abort('failed'));
    await page.goto('/dashboard');
    await expect(page.locator('text=Terjadi kesalahan saat memuat data')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });
    await expect(page.locator('text=Mulai dari semester pertamamu')).not.toBeVisible();
  });

function LoginForm(): React.JSX.Element {
  const router = useRouter();

  const isRegisteredSuccess = searchParams.get('registered') === 'true';

  const [serverError, setServerError] = React.useState<string | null>(urlError);
  const [requireCaptcha, setRequireCaptcha] = React.useState(false);
  const [turnstileToken, setTurnstileToken] = React.useState<string>('');
  const turnstileRef = React.useRef<TurnstileWidgetHandle>(null);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (urlError) {
      setServerError(urlError);
    }
  }, [urlError]);

  const {
    register,
    handleSubmit,
    setValue,
    formState: { errors, isSubmitting },
  } = useForm<LoginInput>({
    resolver: zodResolver(LoginInputSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      email: '',
      password: '',
      turnstileToken: '',
    },
  });

  const handleTurnstileVerify = (token: string) => {
    setTurnstileToken(token);
    setValue('turnstileToken', token, { shouldValidate: true });
    setServerError(null);
  };

  const handleTurnstileExpire = () => {
    setTurnstileToken('');
    setValue('turnstileToken', '', { shouldValidate: true });
  };

  const onSubmit = async (data: LoginInput) => {
    setServerError(null);
    try {
      await apiLogin(data);
      const safeTarget = getSafeReturnUrl(returnUrl, '/dashboard');
      router.push(safeTarget);
      router.refresh();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setServerError(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Terjadi kesalahan saat masuk. Silakan coba lagi.'
      );

      // Adaptive CAPTCHA: backend signals when verification is needed for the next attempt
      if (isApiError(err)) {
        if (err.details?.requireCaptcha === true || err.code === 'TURNSTILE_TOKEN_REQUIRED') {
          setRequireCaptcha(true);
        }
      }

      // Token Turnstile sekali pakai: reset widget setelah submit gagal
      setTurnstileToken('');
      setValue('turnstileToken', '');
      turnstileRef.current?.reset();
    }
  };

  return (
    <Card className="w-full border-border bg-card shadow-xs">
      <CardHeader className="space-y-1.5 pb-4">
        <CardTitle className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">
          Masuk ke StudyFlow
        </CardTitle>
        <CardDescription className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
          Masukkan email dan password atau lanjutkan dengan akun Google Anda.
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>

      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} noValidate>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4 pt-0">
          {/* Registration Success Banner */}
          {isRegisteredSuccess && (
            <Alert className="border-emerald-500/40 bg-emerald-50/50 dark:bg-emerald-950/20 text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-300">
              <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
              <AlertTitle className="text-sm font-semibold">Pendaftaran Berhasil</AlertTitle>
              <AlertDescription className="text-xs">
                Akun berhasil dibuat. Silakan masuk menggunakan akun baru Anda.
              </AlertDescription>
            </Alert>
          )}

          {/* Server Error Alert */}
          {serverError && (
            <Alert variant="destructive" role="alert" aria-live="polite">
              <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
              <AlertTitle className="text-sm font-semibold">Gagal Masuk</AlertTitle>
              <AlertDescription className="text-xs break-words">{serverError}</AlertDescription>
            </Alert>
          )}

          {/* Google Sign-In Button */}
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <GoogleSignInButton returnUrl={returnUrl} disabled={isSubmitting} />
            <div className="relative flex items-center justify-center">
              <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center">
                <Separator />
              </div>
              <span className="relative bg-card px-2 text-[11px] font-medium text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                atau dengan email
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Email Field */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="email" className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
              Alamat Email
            </Label>
            <Input
              id="email"
              type="email"
              autoComplete="email"
              placeholder="nama@kampus.ac.id"
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.email)}
              aria-describedby={errors.email ? 'email-error' : undefined}
              className="h-10 text-sm"
              {...register('email')}
            />
            {errors.email && (
              <p id="email-error" className="text-xs font-medium text-destructive">
                {errors.email.message}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Password Field with Accessible Toggle */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <Label htmlFor="password" className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
                Password
              </Label>
              <Link
                href="/forgot-password"
                className="text-xs text-primary hover:underline font-medium"
              >
                Lupa password?
              </Link>
            </div>
            <div className="relative">
              <Input
                id="password"
                type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                autoComplete="current-password"
                placeholder="Masukkan password akun"
                disabled={isSubmitting}
                className="h-10 pr-11 text-sm"
                aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.password)}
                aria-describedby={errors.password ? 'password-error' : undefined}
                {...register('password')}
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowPassword((prev) => !prev)}
                className="absolute right-1 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 z-10 flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:text-foreground after:absolute after:-inset-2 sm:after:hidden touch-manipulation focus-visible:outline-hidden focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
                aria-label={showPassword ? 'Sembunyikan password' : 'Tampilkan password'}
                title={showPassword ? 'Sembunyikan password' : 'Tampilkan password'}
              >
                {showPassword ? (
                  <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                ) : (
                  <Eye className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
            {errors.password && (
              <p id="password-error" className="text-xs font-medium text-destructive">
                {errors.password.message}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Adaptive Cloudflare Turnstile: tampil setelah beberapa percobaan gagal */}
          {requireCaptcha && (
            <div className="space-y-1.5 pt-1">
              <p className="text-center text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                Selesaikan verifikasi keamanan untuk melanjutkan.
              </p>
              <TurnstileWidget
                ref={turnstileRef}
                action="login"
                onVerify={handleTurnstileVerify}
                onExpire={handleTurnstileExpire}
                onError={(err) => setServerError(err || 'Verifikasi keamanan gagal. Silakan coba lagi.')}
              />
            </div>
          )}
        </CardContent>

        <CardFooter className="flex flex-col space-y-4 pt-2">
          <Button
            type="submit"
            className="w-full h-10 font-semibold gap-2"
            disabled={isSubmitting || (requireCaptcha && !turnstileToken)}
          >
            {isSubmitting ? (
              <>
                <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
                <span>Memproses...</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              'Masuk'
            )}
          </Button>

          <Separator className="my-1" />

          <p className="text-center text-xs sm:text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Belum punya akun?{' '}
            <Link
              href={returnUrl ? `/register?returnUrl=${encodeURIComponent(returnUrl)}` : '/register'}
              className="font-medium text-primary underline underline-offset-4 hover:opacity-80 transition-opacity"
            >
              Daftar sekarang
            </Link>
          </p>
        </CardFooter>
      </form>
    </Card>
  );
}

export default function LoginPage(): React.JSX.Element {
  return (
    <React.Suspense
      fallback={
        <Card className="w-full">
          <CardHeader className="space-y-1">
            <CardTitle className="text-2xl">Masuk ke StudyFlow</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>Memuat formulir masuk...</CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="h-48 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      }
    >
      <LoginForm />
    </React.Suspense>
  );
}
