'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import {
  ListTodo,
  AlertTriangle,
  CheckCircle2,
  Calendar,
  FileText,
  Upload,
  ArrowRight,
  Plus,
  RefreshCw,
  AlertCircle,
  Clock,
  BookOpen,
  Loader2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import {
  DashboardSummary,
  UserProfile,
  formatUserDateTime,
  formatFileSize,
  Assignment,
} from '@studyflow/shared';
import { MaterialStatusBadge } from '@/components/materials/material-status-badge';
import { MaterialUploadDialog } from '@/components/materials/material-upload-dialog';
import { CreateTaskDialog } from '@/components/assignments/create-task-dialog';
import { getDashboardSummary } from '@/lib/dashboard-client';
import { updateAssignment } from '@/lib/assignment-client';
import { getProfile } from '@/lib/auth-client';
import { TodayScheduleWidget } from '@/components/dashboard/today-schedule-widget';
import { PinnedItemsWidget } from '@/components/dashboard/pinned-items-widget';
import { DashboardCharts } from '@/components/dashboard/dashboard-charts';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Checkbox } from '@/components/ui/checkbox';
import { Alert, AlertTitle, AlertDescription } from '@/components/ui/alert';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { DashboardSkeleton } from './dashboard-skeleton';

interface DashboardContentProps {
  user: UserProfile;
}

// Indonesian mapping for priority
const PRIORITY_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  HIGH: 'Tinggi',
  MEDIUM: 'Sedang',
  LOW: 'Rendah',
};

export function DashboardContent({ user }: DashboardContentProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] = React.useState<UserProfile>(user);
  const [summary, setSummary] = React.useState<DashboardSummary | null>(null);
  const [initialLoading, setInitialLoading] = React.useState(true);
  const [isRefreshing, setIsRefreshing] = React.useState(false);
  const [fetchError, setFetchError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  // Per-task pending state and task action error
  const [pendingTaskIds, setPendingTaskIds] = React.useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [taskActionError, setTaskActionError] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  // Dialog states
  const [isCreateTaskOpen, setIsCreateTaskOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const [isUploadMaterialOpen, setIsUploadMaterialOpen] = React.useState(false);

  // Race condition tracker for semester fetches
  const fetchRequestIdRef = React.useRef(0);

  const timezone = currentUser.timezone || 'Asia/Jakarta';

  // Format today's date in user's profile timezone
  const todayFormatted = React.useMemo(() => {
    try {
      const now = new Date();
      return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('id-ID', {
        timeZone: timezone,
        weekday: 'long',
        day: 'numeric',
        month: 'long',
        year: 'numeric',
      }).format(now);
    } catch {
      return new Date().toLocaleDateString('id-ID');
    }
  }, [timezone]);

  // Load summary with race-condition guard
  const loadSummary = React.useCallback(async (isBackground = false) => {
    const requestId = ++fetchRequestIdRef.current;
    if (isBackground) {
      setIsRefreshing(true);
    } else {
      setInitialLoading(true);
    }
    setFetchError(null);

    try {
      const data = await getDashboardSummary();
      // Only commit data if this is still the latest request
      if (requestId === fetchRequestIdRef.current) {
        setSummary(data);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (requestId === fetchRequestIdRef.current) {
        setFetchError(err.message || 'Gagal memuat data ringkasan dashboard.');
      }
    } finally {
      if (requestId === fetchRequestIdRef.current) {
        setInitialLoading(false);
        setIsRefreshing(false);
      }
    }
  }, []);

  // Initial load and semester changed event listener
  React.useEffect(() => {
    loadSummary(false);

    const handleSemesterChange = () => {
      // Re-fetch in background without showing full-page skeleton
      loadSummary(true);
    };

    const handleProfileUpdate = () => {
      getProfile()
        .then((p) => {
          if (p) setCurrentUser(p);
        })
        .catch(console.error);
      loadSummary(true);
    };

    window.addEventListener('studyflow:semester-changed', handleSemesterChange);
    window.addEventListener('studyflow:profile-updated', handleProfileUpdate);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('studyflow:semester-changed', handleSemesterChange);
      window.removeEventListener('studyflow:profile-updated', handleProfileUpdate);
    };
  }, [loadSummary]);

  // Subtask unfinished confirmation
  const [confirmDoneTask, setConfirmDoneTask] = React.useState<Assignment | null>(null);

  // Toggle completion with per-task pending and error isolation
  const executeToggleTask = async (asg: Assignment) => {
    if (pendingTaskIds.has(asg.id)) return;

    setPendingTaskIds((prev) => new Set(prev).add(asg.id));
    setTaskActionError(null);

    const nextStatus = asg.status === 'DONE' ? 'TODO' : 'DONE';
    try {
      await updateAssignment(asg.id, { status: nextStatus });
      // Reload summary quietly in background to refresh metrics and lists
      await loadSummary(true);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setTaskActionError(
        `Gagal memperbarui status tugas "${asg.title}": ${err.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan'}`
      );
    } finally {
      setPendingTaskIds((prev) => {
        const next = new Set(prev);
        next.delete(asg.id);
        return next;
      });
    }
  };

  const handleToggleTask = (asg: Assignment) => {
    if (
      asg.status !== 'DONE' &&
      asg.subtaskCount &&
      asg.subtaskCount.total > 0 &&
      asg.subtaskCount.completed < asg.subtaskCount.total
    ) {
      setConfirmDoneTask(asg);
      return;
    }
    executeToggleTask(asg);
  };

  // 1. Initial Loading State: Skeletons matching exact layout
  if (initialLoading) {
    return <DashboardSkeleton />;
  }

  // 2. Error State on initial fetch (distinct from empty states)
  if (fetchError && !summary) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-6">
        <div className="border-b border-border pb-5">
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">Dashboard</h1>
        </div>
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <AlertCircle className="h-5 w-5" />
          <AlertTitle>Terjadi kesalahan saat memuat data</AlertTitle>
          <AlertDescription className="mt-1 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-3">
            <span>{fetchError}</span>
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => loadSummary(false)}
              className="gap-1.5 w-fit"
            >
              <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4" />
              <span>Coba Lagi</span>
            </Button>
          </AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // 3. Empty State A: Belum ada semester aktif
  if (!summary?.activeSemester) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-6">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1 border-b border-border pb-5">
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">Dashboard</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{todayFormatted} ({timezone})</p>
        </div>

        <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-8 sm:p-12 text-center max-w-xl mx-auto shadow-xs">
          <div className="mx-auto flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary/10 text-primary mb-4">
            <Calendar className="h-6 w-6" />
          </div>
          <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-foreground">Mulai dari semester pertamamu</h2>
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
            Pilih atau buat semester aktif untuk mulai mencatat mata kuliah, tugas, dan materi kuliah.
          </p>
          <div className="mt-6 flex justify-center">
            <Button asChild size="standard" className="gap-1.5">
              <Link href="/semesters">
                <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
                <span>Tambah Semester</span>
              </Link>
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // 4. Empty State B: Semester ada, tetapi belum ada mata kuliah aktif
  if (summary.totalCourses === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-6">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1 border-b border-border pb-5">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-2">
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">Dashboard</h1>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                {summary.activeSemester.name} ({summary.activeSemester.academicYear}) • {todayFormatted}
              </p>
            </div>
            <Button asChild size="standard" className="gap-1.5 self-start sm:self-auto">
              <Link href="/courses">
                <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
                <span>Tambah Mata Kuliah</span>
              </Link>
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border bg-card/60 p-8 sm:p-12 text-center max-w-xl mx-auto">
          <div className="mx-auto flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary/10 text-primary mb-4">
            <BookOpen className="h-6 w-6" />
          </div>
          <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-foreground">Belum ada mata kuliah di semester ini</h2>
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
            Tambahkan mata kuliah yang Anda ambil di {summary.activeSemester.name} untuk menghubungkan tugas dan materi.
          </p>
          <div className="mt-6 flex justify-center">
            <Button asChild size="standard" className="gap-1.5">
              <Link href="/courses">
                <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
                <span>Tambah Mata Kuliah</span>
              </Link>
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // 5. Active Dashboard with Content
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4 sm:space-y-6">
      {/* Header Ringkas */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between border-b border-border pb-3.5 sm:pb-5">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground sm:text-3xl">
            Dashboard
          </h1>
          <div className="mt-0.5 sm:mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2.5 gap-y-1 text-xs sm:text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            <span className="font-medium text-foreground">{summary.activeSemester.name}</span>
            <span>•</span>
            <span>{todayFormatted}</span>
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">({timezone})</span>
            {isRefreshing && (
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-primary ml-1">
                <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin" />
                Memperbarui...
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Button
            onClick={() => setIsCreateTaskOpen(true)}
            size="standard"
            className="gap-1.5 shrink-0 self-start sm:self-auto"
          >
            <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
            <span>Tambah tugas</span>
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Background Fetch Error Alert */}
      {fetchError && (
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
          <AlertTitle>Pembaruan data terkendala</AlertTitle>
          <AlertDescription className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span>{fetchError}</span>
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => loadSummary(true)}
              className="h-7 px-2 text-xs"
            >
              Coba lagi
            </Button>
          </AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}

      {/* Task Action Error Alert */}
      {taskActionError && (
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
          <AlertTitle>Aksi tugas gagal</AlertTitle>
          <AlertDescription className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span>{taskActionError}</span>
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => setTaskActionError(null)}
              className="h-7 px-2 text-xs"
            >
              Tutup
            </Button>
          </AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}

      {/* Baris Statistik Ringkas: <640px 3 Baris Ringkas, >=640px 3 Kolom Kartu */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 divide-y sm:divide-y-0 sm:divide-x divide-border rounded-xl border border-border bg-card shadow-xs sm:grid-cols-3">
        {/* Stat 1: Hari Ini */}
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between px-3.5 py-2.5 sm:px-5 sm:py-3.5">
          <div className="flex w-full items-center justify-between sm:w-auto sm:flex-col sm:items-start min-w-0">
            <h3 className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground shrink-0">
              Tugas Hari Ini
            </h3>
            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1.5 sm:mt-1">
              <span className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">
                {summary.assignmentsToday.length}
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">belum selesai</span>
            </div>
            <p className="hidden sm:block mt-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              Batas 23.59
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="hidden sm:flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary/10 text-primary">
            <Clock className="h-4.5 w-4.5" />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Stat 2: Terlambat */}
        <div
          className={`flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between px-3.5 py-2.5 sm:px-5 sm:py-3.5 ${
            summary.overdueCount > 0 ? 'bg-danger/10' : ''
          }`}
        >
          <div className="flex w-full items-center justify-between sm:w-auto sm:flex-col sm:items-start min-w-0">
            <h3 className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground shrink-0">
              Tugas Terlambat
            </h3>
            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1.5 sm:mt-1">
              <span
                className={`text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight ${
                  summary.overdueCount > 0 ? 'text-danger-foreground' : 'text-foreground'
                }`}
              >
                {summary.overdueCount}
              </span>
              {summary.overdueCount > 0 ? (
                <Link
                  href="/assignments"
                  className="text-xs text-danger-foreground font-medium hover:underline"
                >
                  Lihat daftar →
                </Link>
              ) : (
                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">tenggat terlewat</span>
              )}
            </div>
            <p className="hidden sm:block mt-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {summary.overdueCount > 0 ? 'Perlu tindakan segera' : 'Semua deadline aman'}
            </p>
          </div>
          <div
            className={`hidden sm:flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg ${
              summary.overdueCount > 0
                ? 'bg-danger text-danger-foreground'
                : 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground'
            }`}
          >
            <AlertTriangle className="h-4.5 w-4.5" />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Stat 3: Selesai */}
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between px-3.5 py-2.5 sm:px-5 sm:py-3.5">
          <div className="flex w-full items-center justify-between sm:w-auto sm:flex-col sm:items-start min-w-0">
            <h3 className="text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground shrink-0">
              Tugas Selesai
            </h3>
            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1.5 sm:mt-1">
              <span className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">
                {summary.completedCount}
              </span>
              {summary.totalAssignments === 0 ? (
                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Belum ada tugas</span>
              ) : (
                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  dari {summary.totalAssignments} ({summary.completionPercentage}%)
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            <p className="hidden sm:block mt-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              Total semester berjalan
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="hidden sm:flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-success/20 text-success-foreground">
            <CheckCircle2 className="h-4.5 w-4.5" />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Grafik Aktivitas Belajar & Beban Tugas (Data Nyata) */}
      <DashboardCharts
        activeSemesterId={summary.activeSemester.id}
        refreshTrigger={fetchRequestIdRef.current}
      />

      {/* Tata Letak Konten: Desktop 2/3 Tugas + 1/3 Jadwal; Mobile Kolom Tunggal */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:gap-6 lg:grid-cols-3 items-stretch">
        {/* Kolom Utama: Tugas (2/3 Lebar Desktop) */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-4 sm:space-y-6 flex flex-col justify-between h-full">
          {summary.assignmentsToday.length === 0 && summary.assignmentsUpcoming.length === 0 ? (
            /* Empty State Terpadu: Jika Hari Ini & 7 Hari Mendatang Sama-sama Kosong */
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-xs h-full flex flex-col justify-between">
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3.5 border-b border-border">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Clock className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                    <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">
                      Tugas Terdekat
                    </h2>
                  </div>
                  <Button asChild variant="ghost" size="sm" className="h-8 px-2 text-xs">
                    <Link href="/assignments" className="gap-1">
                      <span>Semua Tugas</span>
                      <ArrowRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    </Link>
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="py-6 sm:py-8 flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center my-auto">
                {summary.totalAssignments === 0 ? (
                  <>
                    <div className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-muted text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                      <ListTodo className="h-4.5 w-4.5" />
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
                      Belum ada tugas tercatat
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5 max-w-sm leading-relaxed">
                      Catat tugas kuliah baru agar deadline dan prioritas belajar Anda tetap teratur.
                    </p>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <div className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-success/20 text-success-foreground mb-2">
                      <CheckCircle2 className="h-4.5 w-4.5" />
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
                      Tidak ada deadline dalam 7 hari ke depan
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5 max-w-sm leading-relaxed">
                      Semua jadwal terdekat sudah tuntas atau belum ada deadline mendesak minggu ini.
                    </p>
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            /* Pengelompokan Ketika Ada Tugas */
            <>
              {/* Section: Tugas Hari Ini */}
              <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-xs">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3.5 border-b border-border">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Clock className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                    <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">
                      Tugas Hari Ini
                    </h2>
                    <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs ml-1 font-medium">
                      {summary.assignmentsToday.length}
                    </Badge>
                  </div>
                  <Button asChild variant="ghost" size="sm" className="h-8 px-2 text-xs">
                    <Link href="/assignments" className="gap-1">
                      <span>Semua Tugas</span>
                      <ArrowRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    </Link>
                  </Button>
                </div>

                <div className="mt-2">
                  {summary.assignmentsToday.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-4 text-center text-muted-foreground">
                      <CheckCircle2 className="h-5 w-5 text-success-foreground/70 mb-1" />
                      <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
                        Tidak ada tugas jatuh tempo hari ini
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                        Semua jadwal hari ini tuntas atau belum ada deadline mendesak.
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="divide-y divide-border/60">
                      {summary.assignmentsToday.map((asg) => {
                        const isPending = pendingTaskIds.has(asg.id);
                        return (
                          <div
                            key={asg.id}
                            className="py-3.5 first:pt-2 last:pb-1 flex items-start justify-between gap-3"
                          >
                            <div className="flex items-start gap-3 min-w-0">
                              <div className="pt-0.5">
                                <Checkbox
                                  id={`task-${asg.id}`}
                                  checked={asg.status === 'DONE'}
                                  disabled={isPending}
                                  onCheckedChange={() => handleToggleTask(asg)}
                                  aria-label={`Tandai tugas ${asg.title} sebagai ${
                                    asg.status === 'DONE' ? 'belum selesai' : 'selesai'
                                  }`}
                                />
                              </div>
                              <div className="min-w-0">
                                <label
                                  htmlFor={`task-${asg.id}`}
                                  className={`text-sm font-medium leading-snug cursor-pointer select-none block truncate ${
                                    asg.status === 'DONE'
                                      ? 'line-through text-muted-foreground'
                                      : 'text-foreground hover:text-primary transition-colors'
                                  }`}
                                >
                                  {asg.title}
                                </label>
                                <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                                  {asg.course && (
                                    <span className="font-medium text-foreground/80">
                                      {asg.course.name}
                                    </span>
                                  )}
                                  <span>•</span>
                                  <span>{formatUserDateTime(asg.dueDate, timezone)}</span>
                                  {asg.subtaskCount && asg.subtaskCount.total > 0 && (
                                    <>
                                      <span>•</span>
                                      <span
                                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-medium text-muted-foreground"
                                        title={`${asg.subtaskCount.completed} dari ${asg.subtaskCount.total} subtugas selesai`}
                                      >
                                        <ListTodo className="h-3 w-3 text-primary shrink-0" />
                                        <span>
                                          {asg.subtaskCount.completed}/{asg.subtaskCount.total}
                                        </span>
                                      </span>
                                    </>
                                  )}
                                  {isPending && (
                                    <>
                                      <span>•</span>
                                      <span className="text-primary inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs">
                                        <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin" />
                                        Menyimpan...
                                      </span>
                                    </>
                                  )}
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            </div>

                            <Badge
                              variant={
                                asg.priority === 'HIGH'
                                  ? 'danger'
                                  : asg.priority === 'MEDIUM'
                                  ? 'default'
                                  : 'secondary'
                              }
                              className="shrink-0 text-xs py-0.5 px-2"
                            >
                              {PRIORITY_LABELS[asg.priority] || asg.priority}
                            </Badge>
                          </div>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Section: Tugas Mendatang (7 Hari ke Depan) */}
              <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-xs">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3.5 border-b border-border">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Calendar className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                    <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">
                      Tugas 7 Hari Mendatang
                    </h2>
                    <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs ml-1 font-medium">
                      {summary.assignmentsUpcoming.length}
                    </Badge>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="mt-2">
                  {summary.assignmentsUpcoming.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-4 text-center text-muted-foreground">
                      <Calendar className="h-5 w-5 text-muted-foreground/60 mb-1" />
                      <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
                        Tidak ada tugas dalam 7 hari mendatang
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                        Jadwal tugas Anda relatif lengang minggu ini.
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="divide-y divide-border/60">
                      {summary.assignmentsUpcoming.map((asg) => {
                        const isPending = pendingTaskIds.has(asg.id);
                        return (
                          <div
                            key={asg.id}
                            className="py-3.5 first:pt-2 last:pb-1 flex items-start justify-between gap-3"
                          >
                            <div className="flex items-start gap-3 min-w-0">
                              <div className="pt-0.5">
                                <Checkbox
                                  id={`task-${asg.id}`}
                                  checked={asg.status === 'DONE'}
                                  disabled={isPending}
                                  onCheckedChange={() => handleToggleTask(asg)}
                                  aria-label={`Tandai tugas ${asg.title} sebagai ${
                                    asg.status === 'DONE' ? 'belum selesai' : 'selesai'
                                  }`}
                                />
                              </div>
                              <div className="min-w-0">
                                <label
                                  htmlFor={`task-${asg.id}`}
                                  className={`text-sm font-medium leading-snug cursor-pointer select-none block truncate ${
                                    asg.status === 'DONE'
                                      ? 'line-through text-muted-foreground'
                                      : 'text-foreground hover:text-primary transition-colors'
                                  }`}
                                >
                                  {asg.title}
                                </label>
                                <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                                  {asg.course && (
                                    <span className="font-medium text-foreground/80">
                                      {asg.course.name}
                                    </span>
                                  )}
                                  <span>•</span>
                                  <span>{formatUserDateTime(asg.dueDate, timezone)}</span>
                                  {asg.subtaskCount && asg.subtaskCount.total > 0 && (
                                    <>
                                      <span>•</span>
                                      <span
                                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-medium text-muted-foreground"
                                        title={`${asg.subtaskCount.completed} dari ${asg.subtaskCount.total} subtugas selesai`}
                                      >
                                        <ListTodo className="h-3 w-3 text-primary shrink-0" />
                                        <span>
                                          {asg.subtaskCount.completed}/{asg.subtaskCount.total}
                                        </span>
                                      </span>
                                    </>
                                  )}
                                  {isPending && (
                                    <>
                                      <span>•</span>
                                      <span className="text-primary inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs">
                                        <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin" />
                                        Menyimpan...
                                      </span>
                                    </>
                                  )}
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            </div>

                            <Badge
                              variant={
                                asg.priority === 'HIGH'
                                  ? 'danger'
                                  : asg.priority === 'MEDIUM'
                                  ? 'default'
                                  : 'secondary'
                              }
                              className="shrink-0 text-xs py-0.5 px-2"
                            >
                              {PRIORITY_LABELS[asg.priority] || asg.priority}
                            </Badge>
                          </div>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Kolom Pendamping: Jadwal Hari Ini (1/3 Lebar Desktop, Bawah Sejajar dengan Tugas) */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-1 flex flex-col">
          <TodayScheduleWidget
            activeSemesterId={summary.activeSemester.id}
            activeSemesterName={summary.activeSemester.name}
            timezone={timezone}
            className="h-full"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Bagian Disematkan: Materi & Catatan Penting */}
      <div className="mb-6">
        <PinnedItemsWidget
          activeSemesterId={summary.activeSemester?.id}
          timezone={timezone}
        />
      </div>

      {/* Card Materi Terbaru: Di bawah tugas & jadwal, melebar ke samping kanan penuh */}
      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-xs flex flex-col justify-between w-full">
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3.5 border-b border-border">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <FileText className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                  <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">
                    Materi Terbaru
                  </h2>
                </div>
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  size="standard"
                  onClick={() => setIsUploadMaterialOpen(true)}
                  className="gap-1.5"
                >
                  <Upload className="h-4 w-4" />
                  <span>Unggah materi</span>
                </Button>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-2.5">
                {!summary.recentMaterials || summary.recentMaterials.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-5 sm:py-6 text-center text-muted-foreground">
                    <FileText className="h-5 w-5 text-muted-foreground/60 mb-1.5" />
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
                       Belum ada materi semester ini
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5 max-w-xs">
                      Unggah berkas PDF kuliah untuk ekstraksi ringkasan, flashcard, dan kuis.
                    </p>
                    <Button
                      size="standard"
                      variant="outline"
                      onClick={() => setIsUploadMaterialOpen(true)}
                      className="mt-3 gap-1.5"
                    >
                      <Upload className="h-4 w-4" />
                      <span>Unggah Sekarang</span>
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="divide-y divide-border/60">
                    {summary.recentMaterials.slice(0, 5).map((m) => (
                      <div
                        key={m.id}
                        className="py-2.5 first:pt-1 last:pb-1 flex items-start justify-between gap-2.5"
                      >
                        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 pr-1">
                          <Link
                            href={`/materials/${m.id}`}
                            className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground hover:text-primary transition-colors block truncate"
                            title={m.title}
                          >
                            {m.title}
                          </Link>
                          <div className="mt-0.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                            {m.course && (
                              <span className="truncate max-w-[200px] sm:max-w-[320px] font-medium text-foreground/80">
                                {m.course.name}
                              </span>
                            )}
                            {m.course && <span>•</span>}
                            <span>{formatFileSize(m.bytes)}</span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="mt-1">
                            <MaterialStatusBadge status={m.status} />
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        <Button asChild variant="ghost" size="sm" className="h-7 px-2 text-xs shrink-0 self-center">
                          <Link href={`/materials/${m.id}`}>
                            Buka
                            <ArrowRight className="ml-1 h-3 w-3" />
                          </Link>
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            {summary.recentMaterials && summary.recentMaterials.length > 0 && (
              <div className="mt-3 pt-2.5 border-t border-border">
                <Button asChild variant="ghost" size="sm" className="w-full justify-between text-xs px-2 h-8">
                  <Link href="/materials">
                    <span>Lihat Semua Materi</span>
                    <ArrowRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  </Link>
                </Button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

      {/* Modal Dialog: Tambah Tugas */}
      <CreateTaskDialog
        open={isCreateTaskOpen}
        onOpenChange={setIsCreateTaskOpen}
        courses={summary.activeCourses}
        timezone={timezone}
        idPrefix="task"
        onSuccess={() => {
          loadSummary(true);
        }}
      />

      {/* Modal Dialog: Unggah Materi */}
      <MaterialUploadDialog
        open={isUploadMaterialOpen}
        onOpenChange={setIsUploadMaterialOpen}
        courses={summary.activeCourses}
        onSuccess={() => {
          loadSummary(true);
        }}
      />

      {/* Confirmation Dialog when completing task with unfinished subtasks */}
      <Dialog
        open={Boolean(confirmDoneTask)}
        onOpenChange={(open) => {
          if (!open) setConfirmDoneTask(null);
        }}
      >
        <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-[420px]">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>Selesaikan Tugas?</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription className="text-xs text-muted-foreground pt-1">
              Tugas &quot;{confirmDoneTask?.title}&quot; memiliki{' '}
              <strong className="text-foreground">
                {(confirmDoneTask?.subtaskCount?.total ?? 0) -
                  (confirmDoneTask?.subtaskCount?.completed ?? 0)}{' '}
                subtugas
              </strong>{' '}
              yang belum selesai. Apakah Anda yakin ingin tetap menandai tugas ini sebagai selesai?
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <DialogFooter className="flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row gap-2 pt-2 sm:justify-end">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              size="standard"
              onClick={() => setConfirmDoneTask(null)}
            >
              Batal
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="button"
              size="standard"
              onClick={() => {
                if (confirmDoneTask) {
                  const target = confirmDoneTask;
                  setConfirmDoneTask(null);
                  executeToggleTask(target);
                }
              }}
            >
              Tetap Selesaikan
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { usePathname, useRouter } from 'next/navigation';

  SidebarGroupContent,

// Navigation groups categorized per specification
const navigationGroups = [
  {
    label: 'Belajar',
    items: [
      {
        label: 'Dashboard',
        href: '/dashboard',
        icon: LayoutDashboard,
      },
      {
        label: 'Materi',
        href: '/materials',
        icon: Files,
      },
      {
        label: 'Tugas',
        href: '/assignments',
        icon: ListTodo,
      },

function SidebarNavContent({ user }: { user: UserProfile }): React.JSX.Element {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const router = useRouter();
  const { setOpenMobile, state, isMobile } = useSidebar();

  const handleLogout = async () => {
    try {
      await apiLogout();
      router.push('/login');
      router.refresh();
    } catch {
      router.push('/login');
    }
  };

  const isCollapsed = state === 'collapsed' && !isMobile;

  return (
    <>
      {/* Brand Header */}
      <SidebarHeader className="border-b border-sidebar-border h-16 justify-center">
        <Link
          href="/dashboard"
          className="flex items-center gap-2.5 overflow-hidden px-1"
          onClick={() => setOpenMobile(false)}
          aria-label="StudyFlow Beranda"
        >
          <div className="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-xs">
            <BookOpen className="h-5 w-5" aria-hidden="true" />
          </div>
          {!isCollapsed && (
            <span className="text-lg font-bold tracking-tight text-sidebar-foreground truncate">
              StudyFlow
            </span>
          )}
        </Link>
      </SidebarHeader>

      {/* Active Semester Selector */}
      <SidebarSemesterSelector
        isCollapsed={isCollapsed}
        onNavigate={() => setOpenMobile(false)}
      />

      {/* Navigation Groups: Belajar, Perkuliahan, Pengaturan */}
      <SidebarContent className="py-2">
        {navigationGroups.map((group) => (
          <SidebarGroup key={group.label}>
            {!isCollapsed && <SidebarGroupLabel>{group.label}</SidebarGroupLabel>}
            <SidebarGroupContent>
              <SidebarMenu>
                {group.items.map((item) => {
                  const Icon = item.icon;
                  const isActive =
                    item.href === '/dashboard'
                      ? pathname === '/dashboard'
                      : pathname.startsWith(item.href);

                  return (
                    <SidebarMenuItem key={item.href}>
                      <SidebarMenuButton
                        asChild
                        isActive={isActive}
                        tooltip={item.label}
                      >
                        <Link
                          href={item.href}
                          onClick={() => setOpenMobile(false)}
                          aria-label={item.label}
                          aria-current={isActive ? 'page' : undefined}
                        >
                          <Icon className="h-5 w-5 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
                          {!isCollapsed && (
                            <span className="truncate text-sm">{item.label}</span>
                          )}
                        </Link>
                      </SidebarMenuButton>
                    </SidebarMenuItem>
                  );
                })}
              </SidebarMenu>
            </SidebarGroupContent>
          </SidebarGroup>
        ))}
      </SidebarContent>
    </>
  );
}

function HeaderBreadcrumbs(): React.JSX.Element {
  const pathname = usePathname();

  const items: { label: string; href?: string }[] = [];

  if (pathname === '/dashboard') {
    items.push({ label: 'Dashboard' });
  } else if (pathname === '/materials') {
    items.push({ label: 'Materi' });
  } else if (pathname.startsWith('/materials/')) {
    items.push({ label: 'Materi', href: '/materials' });
    items.push({ label: 'Detail Materi' });
  } else if (pathname === '/assignments') {
    items.push({ label: 'Tugas Kuliah' });
  } else if (pathname === '/notes') {
    items.push({ label: 'Catatan' });
  } else if (pathname.startsWith('/notes/')) {
    items.push({ label: 'Catatan', href: '/notes' });
    items.push({ label: 'Editor Catatan' });
  } else if (pathname === '/courses') {
    items.push({ label: 'Mata Kuliah' });
  } else if (pathname.startsWith('/courses/')) {
    items.push({ label: 'Mata Kuliah', href: '/courses' });
    items.push({ label: 'Detail Mata Kuliah' });
  } else if (pathname === '/schedule') {
    items.push({ label: 'Jadwal Kuliah' });
  } else if (pathname === '/calendar') {
    items.push({ label: 'Kalender' });
  } else if (pathname === '/semesters') {
    items.push({ label: 'Kelola Semester' });
  } else if (pathname === '/settings') {
    items.push({ label: 'Pengaturan' });
  } else {
    items.push({ label: 'StudyFlow' });
  }

  return (
    <Breadcrumb>
      <BreadcrumbList>
        <BreadcrumbItem className="hidden sm:inline-flex">
          <BreadcrumbLink asChild>
            <Link href="/dashboard" className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground">
              StudyFlow
            </Link>
          </BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        {items.map((item, idx) => {
          const isLast = idx === items.length - 1;
          return (
            <React.Fragment key={idx}>
              <BreadcrumbSeparator className={idx === 0 ? 'hidden sm:inline-flex' : undefined} />
              <BreadcrumbItem className="truncate">
                {isLast || !item.href ? (
                  <BreadcrumbPage className="truncate">{item.label}</BreadcrumbPage>
                ) : (
                  <BreadcrumbLink asChild>
                    <Link href={item.href} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground truncate">
                      {item.label}
                    </Link>
                  </BreadcrumbLink>
                )}
              </BreadcrumbItem>
            </React.Fragment>
          );
        })}
      </BreadcrumbList>
    </Breadcrumb>
  );
}

export function AppShell({ user, children }: AppShellProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] = React.useState<UserProfile>(user);
  const [isSearchOpen, setIsSearchOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const searchTriggerRef = React.useRef<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'k') {
        e.preventDefault();
        setIsSearchOpen((prev) => !prev);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, []);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    setCurrentUser(user);
  }, [user]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleProfileUpdated = (event: Event) => {
      const customEvent = event as CustomEvent<UserProfile>;
      if (customEvent.detail) {
        setCurrentUser(customEvent.detail);
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('studyflow:profile-updated', handleProfileUpdated);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('studyflow:profile-updated', handleProfileUpdated);
    };
  }, []);

  const handleLogout = async () => {
    try {
      await apiLogout();
      router.push('/login');
      router.refresh();
    } catch {
      router.push('/login');
    }
  };

  return (
    <SidebarProvider defaultOpen={true}>
      <div className="flex min-h-screen w-full bg-background text-foreground">
        {/* shadcn Sidebar with accessible drawer for <1024px & collapsible permanent sidebar for >=1024px */}
        <Sidebar collapsible="icon" variant="sidebar">
          <SidebarNavContent user={currentUser} />
          <SidebarRail />
        </Sidebar>

        {/* Main Content Area using shadcn SidebarInset */}
        <SidebarInset className="flex flex-col min-w-0">
          {/* Header (64px) per DESIGN.md section 7.1 */}
          <header className="sticky top-0 z-20 flex h-16 shrink-0 items-center justify-between border-b border-border bg-background/95 px-3 backdrop-blur-xs sm:px-6">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3 min-w-0">
              <SidebarTrigger />
              <Separator orientation="vertical" className="h-4 shrink-0" />
              <div className="min-w-0 overflow-hidden">
                <HeaderBreadcrumbs />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Right Header: Global Search, ThemeToggle & User Account Menu */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3 shrink-0">
              <button
                ref={searchTriggerRef}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsSearchOpen(true)}
                aria-label="Pencarian global (Ctrl+K)"
                className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-border/80 bg-muted/40 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground transition-colors shadow-2xs focus-visible:outline-hidden focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
              >
                <Search className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
                <span className="hidden sm:inline">Cari...</span>
                <kbd className="hidden md:inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded border border-border bg-background px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-mono text-muted-foreground">
                  <span className="text-[11px]">⌘</span>K
                </kbd>
              </button>

              <ThemeToggle />
              <Separator orientation="vertical" className="h-4" />

              <DropdownMenu>
                <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    aria-label={`Menu akun untuk ${currentUser.name}`}
                    className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full p-1 text-sm font-medium transition-colors hover:bg-muted focus-visible:outline-hidden focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
                  >
                    <Avatar className="h-8 w-8">
                      <AvatarFallback className="bg-primary/10 text-primary font-bold text-xs">
                        {currentUser.name.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
                      </AvatarFallback>
                    </Avatar>
                    <span className="hidden md:inline-block max-w-[120px] truncate text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">
                      {currentUser.name}
                    </span>
                    <ChevronDown className="hidden md:inline-block h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground opacity-70" />
                  </button>
                </DropdownMenuTrigger>

                <DropdownMenuContent align="end" className="w-56">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 p-2">
                    <Avatar className="h-9 w-9 shrink-0">
                      <AvatarFallback className="bg-primary/10 text-primary font-bold text-sm">
                        {currentUser.name.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
                      </AvatarFallback>
                    </Avatar>
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <p className="truncate text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">{currentUser.name}</p>
                      <p className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">{currentUser.email}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <DropdownMenuSeparator />
                  <DropdownMenuItem asChild>
                    <Link href="/settings" className="cursor-pointer text-xs flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Settings className="h-4 w-4" />
                      <span>Pengaturan Akun</span>
                    </Link>
                  </DropdownMenuItem>
                  <DropdownMenuItem asChild>
                    <Link href="/semesters" className="cursor-pointer text-xs flex items-center gap-2">
                      <CalendarRange className="h-4 w-4" />
                      <span>Kelola Semester</span>
                    </Link>
                  </DropdownMenuItem>
                  <DropdownMenuSeparator />
                  <DropdownMenuItem
                    onClick={handleLogout}
                    className="cursor-pointer text-xs text-destructive focus:bg-destructive/10 focus:text-destructive flex items-center gap-2"
                  >
                    <LogOut className="h-4 w-4" />
                    <span>Keluar</span>
                  </DropdownMenuItem>
                </DropdownMenuContent>
              </DropdownMenu>
            </div>
          </header>

          {/* Main Dashboard Canvas - Max 1200px centered per DESIGN.md section 7.1 */}
          <div className="flex-1 p-3.5 sm:p-6 lg:p-8">
            <div className="mx-auto max-w-[1200px]">{children}</div>
          </div>
        </SidebarInset>

        {/* Global Search Dialog Modal */}
        <GlobalSearchDialog
          isOpen={isSearchOpen}
          onClose={() => {
            setIsSearchOpen(false);
            searchTriggerRef.current?.focus();
          }}
        />
      </div>
    </SidebarProvider>
  );
}

| Acuan produk | `docs/product_requirements_document.md` v1.0 |
| Lokasi dokumen | `DESIGN.md` di root repository |

Dokumen ini adalah sumber acuan visual dan interaksi StudyFlow. PRD menentukan fitur serta aturan bisnis; DESIGN.md menentukan cara pengguna melihat dan mengoperasikannya. Jika terjadi konflik scope, ikuti PRD dan selaraskan dokumen sebelum menambah fitur. Nilai ukuran berikut merupakan default proyek, bukan batas yang menghalangi zoom, teks panjang, atau kebutuhan aksesibilitas.

## 1. Identitas produk

StudyFlow adalah ruang belajar pribadi untuk mahasiswa: mengelola perkuliahan, menyimpan materi, dan berlatih dengan bantuan AI yang merujuk sumber.

**Kesan yang dituju:** tenang, teratur, jelas, dapat dipercaya, dan nyaman dipakai membaca lama.

**Arah visual:** permukaan seperti kertas yang bersih, teks berwarna tinta gelap, aksen biru terukur, pembatas tipis, dan komposisi yang mengutamakan isi. Identitas muncul melalui tipografi, susunan konten akademik, dan konsistensi detail.

**Prioritas:** kejelasan informasi → kemudahan bertindak → efisiensi penggunaan. Aksesibilitas adalah syarat di seluruh lapisan, bukan fitur tambahan pada tahap akhir.

AI hadir sebagai alat belajar pada materi. Tampilan tidak perlu didominasi simbol AI, kilau, robot, atau panel chat saat pengguna sedang mengelola tugas.

## 2. Prinsip desain

1. **Tindakan berikutnya mudah ditemukan.** Setiap halaman mempunyai tujuan dan satu aksi utama yang paling menonjol.
2. **Isi akademik menjadi pusat.** Judul materi, deadline, nama mata kuliah, dan sumber lebih penting daripada dekorasi atau angka statistik.
3. **Kepadatan secukupnya.** Daftar boleh padat selama judul, metadata, dan kontrol tetap terbaca serta mudah disentuh.
4. **Status dapat dipercaya.** Bedakan transfer file, ekstraksi, dan generasi AI. Jangan menampilkan persentase proses yang tidak diketahui.
5. **Pekerjaan aman saat terganggu.** Jelaskan perubahan belum tersimpan, proses yang tetap berjalan, kegagalan, dan opsi pemulihan.
6. **Pola konsisten.** Posisi aksi, dialog, filter, dan pesan status tetap serupa antarhalaman.
7. **Scope terlihat jujur.** MVP tidak menampilkan menu chat, lonceng notifikasi, kalender, atau fitur kolaborasi yang belum berfungsi.

## 3. Bahasa visual yang dihindari

- Gradient dekoratif pada latar, teks judul, tombol, dan kartu statistik.
- Neon glow, glassmorphism, blur luas, serta bayangan berat.
- Memasukkan setiap paragraf atau section ke kartu tersendiri.
- Dashboard berisi deretan kartu KPI besar sebelum tugas yang perlu dikerjakan.
- Hero terlalu tinggi, heading yang memenuhi layar, bento dekoratif tanpa fungsi.
- Ikon emoji sebagai sistem navigasi atau ikon utama produk.
- Badge berwarna berbeda untuk setiap mata kuliah tanpa alasan informasional.
- Chart, persentase kemajuan belajar, streak, testimoni, atau angka pengguna yang tidak didukung data.
- Tombol berbentuk pill di semua tempat. Pill hanya untuk badge kecil bila cocok.
- Animasi melayang, parallax, typing effect, atau confetti pada aktivitas rutin.

## 4. Sistem warna

### 4.1 Token inti

Arah visual baru StudyFlow adalah **ruang belajar yang tenang, rapi, mudah dibaca, dan terasa matang**. Kami menghindari kelebihan kartu, badge warna-warni, serta aksen berlebihan.

- **Light Mode**: Palet bernuansa kertas bersih dan hangat (`#FAFAF9`), surface putih bersih (`#FFFFFF`), teks tinta charcoal gelap (`#18181B`), teks sekunder terukur (`#52525B`), pembatas netral tipis (`#E4E4E7`), aksen indigo terfokus (`#4F46E5`), dan active surface lembut (`#EEF2FF`).
- **Dark Mode**: Charcoal netral bertingkat (`#09090B` background, `#18181B` surface), kontras tinggi tanpa rona layar biru jenuh, teks terang lembut (`#F4F4F5`), dan aksen indigo yang disesuaikan kontrasnya.

| Token | Light | Dark | Penggunaan |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `background` | `#FAFAF9` | `#09090B` | Latar aplikasi utama |
| `foreground` | `#18181B` | `#F4F4F5` | Teks utama (>13:1 kontras) |
| `card` | `#FFFFFF` | `#18181B` | Panel konten, area baca, dialog |
| `card-foreground` | `#18181B` | `#F4F4F5` | Teks di panel |
| `popover` | `#FFFFFF` | `#18181B` | Menu dan popover |
| `popover-foreground` | `#18181B` | `#F4F4F5` | Isi menu dan popover |
| `primary` | `#4F46E5` | `#6366F1` | Aksi utama dan indikator fokus |
| `primary-foreground` | `#FFFFFF` | `#FFFFFF` | Teks pada tombol primary |
| `primary-hover` | `#4338CA` | `#818CF8` | Hover tombol primary |
| `secondary` | `#F4F4F5` | `#27272A` | Tombol pendukung & tag netral |
| `secondary-foreground` | `#27272A` | `#E4E4E7` | Teks secondary |
| `muted` | `#F4F4F5` | `#27272A` | Area latar pendukung, separator ringan |
| `muted-foreground` | `#52525B` | `#A1A1AA` | Metadata dan keterangan (>5:1 kontras) |
| `accent` | `#EEF2FF` | `#1E1B4B` | Pilihan aktif dan hover menu |
